reviews.comment: Dr. Enas is a wonderful professor. She explained the material very well and tries her best to help you understand and do well in the class.

Her lectures are very dense and she doesn't always explain concepts the best, but she and her many TA's are so accessible outside of class that finding support is very easy if confused on any topic. She also has many outside resources and extra practice available. Exams and quizzes are graded generously. Dr. Naser is so sweet and accommodating.

Her lectures are good for the difficult but not complicated material and she provides a lot of things outside of lectures to study. I took over the summer and had access to LOTS of TA office hrs which really helped. Sometimes lectures were confusing and it was hard to catch a break bc of fast pace. Tests were long but graded fairly. She's very kind
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I never was able to learn anything from her. Slides made no sense, could not read her handwriting. She is nice but sometimes condescending. She worked alongside Professor Sit. Physics portion was absolutely confusing and made no sense. Would not recommend.

Physics is a very easy class, easy A. But I would not recommend taking it with this professor. I took the class this summer. She is disrespectful and doesn't take a break. Class is from 9am to 10:40am and she talks throughout this time. she doesn't pause or take a deep breath. (her body basically forces her to pause and take a break).

She is really good at teaching physics, however, I would not recommend this course over the summer. She did an excellent job teaching and covering the whole material over the summer but you'll need some time to digest the material. Instructions are pretty clear, straightforward quizzes/exams, always responds to emails on time, very helpful.

Material is straightforward if you pay attention and professor is kind and responds to emails within a day. Lectures aren't complex and quizzes are fairly similar to class material. Overall, I enjoyed the class and the having her as the professor.

She's really sweet and accommodating, never rushing, even if you're late for a quiz and is willing to give you extra time. Exams resemble online practices, quizzes are just like the homework. Doing well in lab and homework boosts your grade, and she makes physics fun. Take her for physics 132.

This class is hard, but the Dr. Enas is a very fair grader, her exams have equal difficulties, and she takes the time to teach in class when other professors would just expect you to know the material. Also, everything is recorded, and you can rewatch her lectures anytime (super helpful). She also responds SO FAST to her emails and is super sweet.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Abu Naser was the best physics professor I could have had. Not only was she accessible outside of class but she also tried her best to really give us additional points and hear out any complaints we had. She was hands down one of the nicest professors I have had at UIC and I couldn't recommend her more!

One of the worst professor's i've had. She's a good person but just bad at her job. She just writes paragraphs of text on presentations and reads off of it. Lectures are vague and homework problems are not covered in class. she also dosnt provide a formula sheet at all for hw.
The most unprofessional and unprepared professor at UIC. You will learn nothing in this class. Be prepared to rely on the TAs and spend hours outside class trying to understand this class

Prof Abu Naser is a caring and understanding professor. Physics is difficult, but Prof Abu Naser provides interactive lectures and iClicker sessions that help you grasp the material. She responds readily outside of class and you will definitely enjoy the class if you participate and get to know Prof Abu Naser. I wholeheartedly recommend this class.

The lectures were too brief and vague, I had to teach myself a lot of the material. Be prepared with the material before class, and practice problems were the most useful resource. Also, she is super nice and very understanding, so try to email her a few days/weeks in advance because she takes a while to respond.

Due to the fact that this class is easy, Prof doesn't seem to understand if people don't get it and is therefore poor at answering questions/explaining. She is often unorganized and then blames students for her running behind, and will ridicule the class for getting IClicker questions wrong or taking "too long".

Dr. Abu Naser does an excellent job of connecting with students, so my best advice is to absolutely take her and reach out to her early in the class about your background, your interest in physics, and any apprehensions you might have. Keep in contact, and don't stop asking for help! Physics is possible, and she is a genuinely good + kind prof

I took her summer 2019 PHYS 105 class. It was obviously rushed due to being a short semester, but professor Naser was super kind and her office hours were very helpful. She provided clear examples and explanations one on one. I think the big class size/lots of material just does not let her teach how she wants to; go to her office hours!

Rushes through the PowerPoints EVERY lecture b/c she has so much to cover, writes on them stuff that seem helpful UNTIL she erases it before she makes the entire PowerPoint available on Blackboard. Encourages you to read the textbook so she doesnt have to lecture. Hw every week (2 parts). Quiz every week. Group problems every week. Beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Worst science class I've ever taken! I've done well in math and science classes before, so my math abilities aren't the issue. She simply CANNOT teach! I don't understand what's going on in lecture half the time. She just rushes through the powerpoint. We go on to the next step before we even began to understand the previous concept.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Cool professor. Explains concepts well and is lenient on grading. Any type of homework or exam question you get has usually already been covered in class. I'm not very diligent but I still managed to get an A pretty easily.

Avoid this professor if you can. He arrives late to EVERY lecture. His notes were not prepared whatsoever. He is all over the place, he also has no examples. Rely upon your fellow classmates or the MSLC if he is your professor. He seems to not know what he is doing. He is not really accessible outside of class. Good luck if he is the only option.
No words, just bad

Do not take Abramov if you want to actually understand the material. I saw his rating,choose to stick with his section and it was a huge mistake. He used the word ret****d a lot in lecture which was interesting. I had 97+ in 180 and 181, might actually get a B in this class due to him.

The professor really goes into the WHY and HOW the math works, not just WHAT to do to get the result. I see the bad reviews are probably for people who are taking the class just to get the result and pass and who don't care how the math is applied and why the concepts work the way they do. Good professor if you're a curious person.
He is a terrible professor! I had nightmare every night before his lecture. He is terrible at drawing 3D diagrams and explaining concepts. Please void him if you can.

His lectures benefit 10% towards exams and quizzes (except when he review for exams) because he hates the book, but the hw, quiz, and tests are 99.9% based on the book. Just stay home and do all the assigned hw, teach yourself, show up only for quizzes, and its easy A. But if you are not that kind of learner, avoid at ALL costs.
He spends too much time on the theory behind the concepts and never has time to show examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Had this professor for Calc 3 as well and he is terrible. He's always late and only explains theory during lecture while constantly checking the time for when he can stop saying nonsense. What he explains in lecture rarely even connects with course material as he mostly only does proofs. Any online video and text are more useful than his lectures.

Funny guy, but lectures aren't helpful. Almost entirely all proofs with no connections of how to apply them. He does example problems, but only after 30 minutes of proofs jumping around the board, and too often he first does an overly easy example, then runs out of time doing an actual problem. Also, grade is too quiz reliant @ 20% IMO. Avoid

As others have said, try to avoid this teacher. I'm sure he is very knowledgeable in Calculus, but being a good teacher requires more. For my class, he was always a few minutes late everyday without an explanation and was hardly prepared. If you already have him, try to take notes outside of class through the online textbook. Only show up for quiz

Try to avoid him if possible. He grades very harsh and only teaches proofs in class. Want him to do practice problems and explain what he is talking about? Good luck, you will find more use in a textbook in which he actually despises more than students. Only way to do good in his class is to find his past exams and remember how he can change them..
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: His lectures were not prepared, but I could tell he knew what he was talking about. What's impressive was he could solve any problem in diff eq. If you want to get an A or B, make sure you know how to solve every type of problem.  Tests were similar to past exams, but we had to memorize Improved Euler method. So anything can be on the exams

An absolutely horrible professor, two lectures in I could not tell what was going on. Does not make a connection between what he is doing on the board and the application to the subject matter. Does things on the board without telling you what or why he's doing it.  There is a reason many of students sit in on other lecturers.

Terrible instructor. Do not take him. If his class is your only option, better to wait a semester and take someone else. He does not try to help his students. He is confusing and his attitude is negative.
Very difficult class. Unfortunately our class average was the lowest compared to all other classes.

He seems like a cool guy but his teaching is not so great. He expects you to understand certain theories semi-related to the topic but doesn't care to explain them. He's lenient on grading (sometimes) which I think is the best part about the class. If you take his class, be prepared to study on your own and make sure you have the book.
Probably is a nice guy outside of the classroom, but definitely not one of the best teachers I have had. Was all over the place on the blackboard.

Overall, I'd say Prof. P was OKAY for this class. I am not a biopsych major so the topic is a bit hard for me to get a grip on. Going to class vs just reading the slides posted to canvas/blackboard makes no real difference unfortunately. On the bright side, when I took it at least we were allowed cheat sheets which made the tests easier to pass.

Took 270 as an online summer course and it was extremely informative and straight forward. Professor is very reachable and gives feedback, lectures are organized nicely and exams were open note. Pretty hard to struggle in this class, just do your part and study/ watch the lecture videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took PSCH 270 over the summer and found it easy but interesting. The shorter summer session gives more of an overview, while the school-year course goes more in depth. If you want a manageable summer class and easy credit, I definitely recommend it.
Overall a mid class. Watch the lectures, take notes, and do the assignments. It's pretty hard to fail this class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very nice proffesor, but don't recommend if you have minimal knowledge in neuroscience. She says topics are "easy", so she explains as if we should already know despite the unknown terms she just throws in with no explanation. Provides a lot of study material but it feels overwhelming with all the information she provides outside her lectures.

Kind and professional, but doesn't make lecture entertaining or interesting. There's already so much content we go through in each lecture so you bet bored quite easily. Cheat sheets on exams saved my life.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is definitely one of the easier biology-based psychology courses. She gives you plenty of extra credit opportunities, and her tests are very straightforward. She allows you to have a cheat sheet as well during all the exams, and there is no comprehensive final.

I took this class during the summer but she made it very straightforward and ensured that we wouldnt be behind on content. I enjoyed the class because it focused on enjoying our learning experience rather than only on exams.

The exam itself isn't hard. What is hard is her study guides, which are basically just the word format of her slides. She doesn't even point out the main topic to study; it is the chapter. Her study material is just annoying. Sometimes, things she said are not important are on the test, so that's confusing, and her slides are very packed.

Dr. Passarotti is an excellent Professor. Very knowledgeable too. I recommend everyone to take her courses as you will learn a lot about the physiology of the brain as you complete interactive activities to check your learning and understanding of the lecture topics. 11/10!!

Adjusted her cheat sheet rule this semester, she not only said we couldn't write directly from lecture material on the cheat sheet but she also collected them. She also does IClicker AND periodic attendance sheets she passes around. Not sure what her deal is this semester but she's making an already difficult class harder than it needs to be.

Dr. Passarotti is a dull lecturer; she read off the slides and would often go off on different tangents about psych topics completely unrelated to the exams. The lectures were information-overloaded, and it was difficult to retain the content. However, I did appreciate the cheat sheets we were allowed and extra credit also came in handy.

Passarotti is amazing. I took 366 & 270 with her, and I'd take more!!! I appreciated that she was always eager to share different research opportunities available to the undergrads. 
The material might sometimes be hard, but she does a good job with explanations and offers lots of extra credit. I also met with her TAs.

I took 270 with Dr. Passarotti in summer. It was one of the best classes I have ever had. The attendance was not mandatory since all of the lectures were recorded, but you could get an extra credit for simply joining the class. The material was explained really well. I totally recommend taking 270 with her, especially when the class is online.

Great professor , four exams, two papers, lots of extra credit opportunities, no heavy homework and two cheat sheets allowed per exam. Additionally, Dr. Passarotti is very kind and flexible, always open to questions and wants you to actually learn the concepts. Her lectures are always enjoyable, informative, and positive.

Lectures and PPTs are long and at times boring (her presentation style is not good), but the tests are easy as long as you study. 4 page final paper is required as well as 4 discussion posts, and opportunities for in-class extra credit are available throughout the semester. Overall decent class, but she makes an intersting topic feel boring.
The class environment felt very professional. I also took the lab portion in this class and it gave me a good idea how research is done in a lab setting.

Professor Passarotti is a caring and knowledgeable professor. She takes the time to talk with students who have questions. Lectures were recorded, so it was easy to review and study them for exams. For this course, she allowed "cheat sheets" to be used for exams, which helped greatly and definitely eased some test anxiety.

Alright alright alright.
Hi! I am an undergrad student who finally made a RMP account despite using this website for a few years.
And fortunately, this class is the only time RMP has done me wrong. Exams are mind killers. Like sinking in a submarine filled with snakes. And like snakes, they are 80% of your grade. CAREFUL DURING REGISTRATION

I am always shocked by the knowledge and passion Doctor Passarotti has for teaching and for the content. Although it is a very hard class, her explanations are awesome, and there are always extra credit opportunities. Pay attention to details, video content and practice questions when studying for her exams, include those on your cheat sheets.

For me, this class was hard but by writing down handwritten notes it really made it easier to understand. Highly recommend taking advantage of office hours after exams and also she does allow 2 pages, 2 sides of handwritten notes for the exams so use that to your advantage! This class challenged me and am definitely more knowledgable of the brain.

Great professor and cares for our learning. She answers questions in detail. PSCH270 had 3 exams and 1 paper that made up 94% of the grade. The remaining 6% was discussion boards. Extra credit opportunities in class. No notes allowed on exams so we had to study. Lectures packed a lot of content. Many videos showing examples of the course concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I absolutely love Passarotti, her lectures are very interesting and as long as you take notes and use the practice exam she gives, you will pass. One thing I recommend is writing handwritten notes to really memorize the content. This was definitely one of my favorite classes!

One of the best professors I've ever had! Though it wasn't a particularly easy class, she offers many extra credit opportunities and her lectures outline what the exams look like. She really cares about what she is teaching and wants everyone to succeed. Lots of examples during her lecture and always answers questions. Definitely recommend!

This class requieres two lab reports, a semester long group project, and 2-3 other smaller assignments. This class is very manageable is you are actually trying and the professor and TA Allison are very helpful and understanding. You wont regret taking this class :) she also offers a lot of extra credit

I cannot recommend this class and this professor highly enough. It's not an especially easy class, but her lectures are understandable and very, very interesting. She always gives lots of examples and is happy to answer questions. A great lecturer, understanding of students' needs, and she genuinely wants you to succeed in her class and learn

I've had the privilege of taking Dr. Passarotti's course this Spring. Excellent lecturer and includes examples that really stick in your mind. Very caring, supportive, and caused no issues during COVID pandemic learning. TA's were great too an overall a really intriguing and fun class. Textbook not needed.

Shes a sweetheart. If your having trouble just ask her, shes always ready to help. Just study what is due and do the zapps, youll get points. Exams are very easy. And her lectures arent mandatory but light. Really good 10/10

This Professor is like top 2 Psychology professors I have ever taken. She is very nice, the exams are all based on lectures, but book purchase is required for Zaps labs which are probably the funnest part of the class. I was intimidated taking a higher level Psych course but this one was truly great. 2 short papers and 4 exams open book.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This professor cares about her students and wants them to do well. Many topics are covered in this course, so it is important to stay on track. The class overall isn't hard. Exams are straightforward if you go to her reviews because she shows you the specific slides which will show up on the exam.
Amazing and understanding professor! Wants students to do well.
Such an amazing professor! Highly recommend!! Very nice and accommodating.
This professor has interesting lectures and gives a lot of important insight. She is also very caring and nice. Wants her students to do well.
Great professor!
Great professor, lectures were extremely interesting. If you listen to her in class, exams will be easy for you.
Alessandra is one of the best professors I ever met. She is so understanding and graceful. Her lectures are clear and concise and easy to understand. I definitely recommend her when taking PSCH353.

Always available during office hours (if you gave her a heads up) and explained things MUCH better there. Lectures were long, but she incorporates psych news. Tests were difficult and often had more info than the study guides encapsulated (lots of trick questions so know study guide material well. Don't bother with the book.

Exams are multiple choice, but really tries to trick you on the exams so its very difficult. Shes a nice person, but lecture is quite boring and lengthy. Lectures are jam packed with info. Get ready to study a lot if you want an A in the class! Just take someone else. She did offer extra credit, but not worth the stress especially for a 200 course

No ppt or any preparing for classes, cancels classes last minute, only cares about her research, doesn't give enough instructions on homeworks which are super hard. Changed finals and didn't come to proctor for midterms, didn't come for finals then canceled it when all the students are here for the exam. She doesn't even give good grades.

i'm assuming this was a situation where she just wants to do research, not really b a professor. ended up dropping the class after meeting with my advisor and realizing i didn't have to take her to satisfy any requirements. horribly disorganized, mandatory weekend lectures, poor grading schedule, etc.
All I got to say is she forced us to have a weekend lecture that wasn't recorded.

She was barely around Fall 2025 and only came a few times. She canceled class nonstop and made us do weekend Zoom makeups. Even for presentations, she stayed home on Zoom while the presenter was in class. She read from notes, messed up notation, and made students type her lectures. When corrected she said “happy now?” Attendance collapsed.

Constant last-minute changes and schedule shifts. Adds extra lectures to suit her own travel, expecting students to adjust. No structure, poor time management, and extends classes to finish a syllabus she chose. Feels like students do all the work while she contributes little. Most disorganized instructor I've had. Avoid if you can.

Canceled class in week 1 and held extra class on a weekend with no guarantee of a recordings. Pop quizzes can be held on weekend classes as well. Brags about horrible grading and expects high workload. Got out ASAP. Would not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The prof seems to try. But holy! This was, by far, the most disorganized course I've had, in my four years here. Constant last minute shifts, a clueless unresponsive TA, exams that are exponentially harder than assignments and a last minute project. No slides, pop quizzes and no recordings for weekend extra classes. Avoid the prof at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment:
Course was very disorganized, and for a introductory course the material is taught in a way that feels very unfair, you have no hope of doing good unless you already know most of this stuff very well. 
Additionally classes are scheduled outside of the class time (on Saturdays), and a severe lack of class content (no practice exams, study guides)

Terrible person, worse professor. Constant crises—first two weeks canceled, class didn't start until after drop date. Constant last-minute delays/online switches leave commuters stranded. Unannounced Saturday classes with pop quizzes. No original content, no recordings, NINE textbooks. Derogatory, condescending, and unfairly strict in grading.

Don't take this course if you want to have a piece of mind the professor doesn't even reply to posts on piazza and here lectures are not even understandable there are no class recordings what so ever and this course is not supposed to be a 400, lot of math which is not even required to machine learning class where it is said introduction to ML
Would not recommend

wonderful professor! I came into the 251 summer course expecting it to be hellish like 211. It was nothing like that, I actually enjoyed learning this time. Prof.Ayala and the TAs were always patient with me during office hours, they explained it in easier ways for me to digest. would definitely take again!

I had a great experience taking DSA in Java. The theory was intuitive, & I got over 100% overall. His slides & lectures were easy to digest. However, he irrationally accused many students of cheating on Project 1. When I spoke with him, it felt like he didn't know the project. I was one of the lucky few who got it reverted, but overall, great prof!
I took this class twice, I find his project assignment method difficult. It feels unreasonably difficult.

251 was a challenging class, but it never was an unfair class. Lecturers were so huge, yet Ayala was able to condense and make all the information so easy to digest. Would def take again if I had the chance. Really nice professor to, and got on your level when in Office Hours.

Very chill professor and very supportive during help hours. extra credits for early project submission and labs are nice. Lectures are amazing when it comes to explaining the difficult concepts. There is also paired oral exams.
He is so sweet and explains the concepts so well. Made the class enjoyable and makes sure to help if you are struggling.
Very good professor, easy to talk to, and approachable.

6 projects, 2 midterms, 2 oral exams, and a final. The course was done extremely well having gone to every lecture made every piece of the projects seem to fall into place. Ayala presented every concept well and cleared up any confusion as they were brought up. Incentives for turning in projects early were very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very friendly and helpful professor. Explains concepts effectively. Highly recommend!

The class was alright. I feel the exams weren't designed properly, as there were 4 exams that were 10-12 questions each and had been each 6% of your grade. Projects tend to be difficult and require a great understanding of the topics at hand. TA's are accessible, professor is accessible. I think if the exams were fixed, the class would be better
Midterm exams were surprisingly difficult, but he is a great, funny teacher who can explain topics pretty well.
Helpful office hours.

Professor Alfred Thomas is an elite teacher. If you give him respect in class and follow his rules, you will benefit tremendously. Challenge yourself to participate in group discussions when prompted and speak what you think.

Professor Thomas is funny. I am not a Shakespeare person, but he absolutely is, and his passion will pull you in to the content. Most of the time in class is spent watching films, the last 15-20 minutes was discussion. Unfortunately half my class was engaged, those that participate share good insight into the films and made it fun. Take this class!

This guy is a mixed bag. He gave really engaging lectures and always tried to make the class fun for us, but is also very paranoid. Many a tangent about how his colleagues and students were out to get him. He was also VERY TMI. Loved to share things about his personal life that either made for a funny anecdote or an uncomfortable therapy session.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lecture-heavy class, no electronics are permitted. Participation can be a little intimidating. Blackboard was closed for the entire semester until the final. Honestly, he was an entertaining and passionate professor, especially when talking about Macbeth. He is honest and makes occasional jokes, he does place all of the workload on the TA though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class was very lecture heavy. No presentation slides and no use of technology. Blackboard was locked the entire semester. Did not know what my grade was the entire semester till final grades came out. Grade was based on participation, midterm exam, final paper, and final exam. Depended heavily on my TA for everything that was going on in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he is a good professor and cares, but i think if you have no interest in the course you can get lost in the lecture because its boring, he has a sense of humor that can make it less boring, biggest down side is no technology and i think if your a visual learner and like presentation it might be tough you have to take notes on him speaking

I have not seen this guy once all semester. He puts all the work on the TA, so even our essays aren't graded by him. Sorry excuse for a professor. His recorded lectures are boring and unhelpful. 0/10 never again

At the time I didnt want to deal with it (this happened in 2017) but I think this should be said. I used my phone one time during his lecture time (he wasnt even lecturing at this moment) as a habit because nothing was going on, and then he yelled at me and called me insolent. Like I understand I was wrong but the screaming was uncalled for.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Terrible to his students. pretentious as hell, just overall bad at teaching, and Disrespectful. Wouldn't recommend at all. Try a different teacher if you want an actual education.

The class is lecture heavy but he acts out scenes sometimes and makes it entertaining. He always has handouts to help guide the students and the amount of reading is not that bad. The exams and paper are easy as long as you stay up to date with the reading and you pay attention in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Thomas is awesome! Big british dude, which helps because he reads Shakespeare in a British accent! He had a dry sense of humor, which was enjoyable, but he would make weird sexist jokes every once in a while at the woman's expense, which is not cool. Overall, a good professor though, you'll enjoy it

Professor Thomas seems like a tough professor at first, but if you reach out to him for help he will give you everything you asked for and more. I sent him a draft of a paper and he sent me back EVERYTHING that I needed in order to succeed, and he made sure I knew what to study for before the final exam. If you want to succeed, he'll help you.

He required 9 chapter books. I personally didn't read any of them, didn't participate too much in class, and still received an A. We wrote a midterm paper between 8-10 pages (you got a selection of prompts) and then analyzed 5/10 articles or pictures from a movie for the final. Take notes on what hes saying to use on the papers.

Decent prof. He was a British dude. Had an inappropriate sense of humor and also a bit racist. Readings were OK for the most part. Lectures were a bit boring but he made it funny at times. He always brought up stuff or showed clips that were rather irrelevant though. Tests were manageable; essay (8-10pgs) was long, time-consuming and onerous.

Thomas is an awesome professor. His experience in theatre really helped to understand the texts. In class performances were great! Also, he tests on what he teaches. His tests are not meant to trick you; instead, they ask you about things we spoke about in class. Great class!

excellent teacher. made learning about literature enjoyable. helpful. the TAs were a different story, but that is not his issue. also, i wasnt a teachers pet, and i didnt suffer. work hard for your own grade, stop blaming professors

Prof. Thomas is extremely intelligent, eloquent and articulate. His speech flows very nicely, his English accent and acting skills make the texts come to life when he reads them in class, which he does often. His humor is dry and sarcastic, which was very enjoyable. Very clear about what's on the exam. Strongly increased my interest in Shakespeare.

Had a way of making me interested in texts I had no interest in before. Class was pretty tough, but if you do the readings, you will be fine. Only real complaint is lack of graded materials: we had to wait until the midterm to get an idea of how we were doing in the class. Would have preferred to have a short, early essay in addition to what we had

I love Professor Thomas. His lectures are wonderful (and attendance is mandatory, just sign your name on the sheet being passed around). He will read out loud a passage from whichever text you're reading and then help debunk it for the class. His TA's are wonderful and very helpful when analyzing the texts. Overall a great professor.
I love love love professor Thomas. I took him two semesters in a row because he is that good.  If you love Shakespeare, he will make it come alive for you, his English accent helps alot!

Captivating, fascinating professor with an infectious love of British Literature. His lectures are amazing and his TAs were excellent facilitators. Most of the students in his recent classes agree he was one of the most interesting and professional instructors they ever had for literature. His accent and acting ability is perfect for the subject!

Has this man completely changed through the years? he is an incredibly interesting individual with a great sense of humor. It might have something to do with half the class being grad students  but he is always full of life. I would have never known he teaches classes outside of english if it wasn't for this site. Take him for engl 413

From what I've read, he is not good at teaching other courses. But in English Lit, he is terrific. Very funny and very passionate about the text. His TAs bore me, but I got enough out of lectures that I did not buy the book. If I were you, buy it, and make sure to attend every lecture. They are very helpful.

I completely disagree with everyone else that has rated this instructor. He was very interesting in class and provided a lot of sources for his arguments. I enjoyed his lectures because he seemed to have a thorough knowedge about Shakespeare. A great asset to UIC compared to the other professors I have had at UIC.
He cannot teach. His TA's are horrible graders. Youre bound not to learn much and end up with a low grade, unless, as the previous people have said, you are an excellent suck up.

He is the BEST! Literally the goat. His reviews speak for itself... one of the only professor I've decided to review.
Perfect teacher, doesn't over complect concepts.

You want to be successful in class? Take him.
You will miss his lectures with carefully annotated content before every exam in your following courses. Took him twice and among that period, I can't wait to get the chance to take him again. Genuinely is a guru in whatever he's teaching, and cares a lot about his students.
He is the best among the best! Period!
He is good professor and what ever he tought was very easy to learn.

The only professor at UIC's CS department worthy of the title of professor. An educator who prepares notes and examples, recaps content, responds to emails and forums, has clear homework assignments and relevant practice problems. Best professor you can ever take. Every other "professor" should be ashamed in comparison to this gem.

First semester at UIC and got lucky to study CS111 with Professor Bello. He is an amazing Prof with respected characteristics. Amazing lectures were driven, he is caring about his students, their success and almost always available on Zybooks & during his Office hours. He is trying to give out the most. Would give million stars if I could! GOATT!!!

Professor Bello is amazing! His lectures are super engaging, and he's always happy to help with any questions. Definitely take advantage of Piazza and office hours - they're a game-changer. Unstuck study was also clutch for prepping.

Didn't always finish the lecture but it's just 111 so it's easy to refer to the zyBooks/lecture slides. Fell behind on course schedule too but wasn't a big deal. Other than that, he's a REALLY nice guy who genuinely wants you to succeed. Often held extra office hours for projects. Super easy grader too. Just an amazing human being overall tbh

Truly wants everyone to succeed in his classes. Very good at explaining concepts and making sure everyone understands them. Will always be able to help you if you're truly lost on a topic. Also very generous with extra credit.

Overall, he's very good at giving lectures, and his notes are extremely helpful, and it is easy to understand the lecture material. He's a very kind professor and is very understanding and helpful when asking questions.
Good prof
He's the GOAT, really good at what he's doing.

Amazing professor who does not skip steps and always redoes exercises from the last lecture so you can remember the material. Also, he is very active in Piazza, so if you have any questions, he will surely help you. The bad side is that he is too technical; you must learn the mathematical language. For labs, most of the time you will need notes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Absolutely amazing professor, if you manage to go to lectures, take good notes, and attend office hours, he will be extremely helpful and is very conscious of the student. He manages to organize his lectures to where everything you hear in that class is jam packed with useful information. You 100% should take him for this course.
I wish he taught ECE courses too. I had him for CS-151 and he was the best professor I've ever taken. Professor if you're reading this you're amazing!
Amazing professor! Have been hearing about him since my first semester, Im glad I got to take one class with him! He is smart, has great notes, explanation and actually cares about the students!

professor Bello is the best professor I've ever had, truly a kind-hearted man who cared about all his students. any questions you have or anything you have on your mind you can ask him and he will be more than happy to answer.  he gives extra credit and explains the material very well. I wish Bello taught all of the cs classes at UIC.

Bello is the best! 151 was tough for me but he has a lot of office hours/review sessions and he is willing to meet by appointment. He teaches a tough course very clearly. Review his lecture slides while doing the assignments, it will help a lot.
He is strict, Forget cheating
Best of the best.

Professor Bello is the best professor in the CS department, hands down. His lectures are really good and the lecture notes he uploads on Blackboard are also amazing for studying. He offers plenty of opportunities for extra credit and office hours are highly accessible. Definitely take him whenever possible.

best cs professor at uic. offers lots of extra credit opportunities at the end of the semester, clearly cares a lot about the subject and will always explain if you have any questions. VERY good lectures, able to explain difficult material in a clear and simple manner. if you have to chance to take him, DO IT.
awesome teacher, very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the material (CS 151)

I loved his way of teaching. He was always to the point and provided perfect examples for the new material we learned. His way of organizing everything on black board like videos and assignments and piazza was very helpful as a student. He always listens to student within reason you can see this in his office hours and during lectures.
5/5. Take him if you have the option
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Haven't come across a Professor like Prof.Bello. The way he explains the course materials and the slides he prepares are out of this world. He has a lot of homework for his class but those homework prepares you for his exams. He is very approachable and loves to answer questions. I do hope he teaches CS 418 again so I could take it with him

A great Prof hands down. The lecture slides will help a LOT. The exams cover quite a bit of content, but it is not difficult once you get used to the structure. Prof provides enough resources for you to succeed in this class.

His lectures are very well organized. The slides are easy to read and he's able to make a complex subject easier to understand as he talks. Although you might not understand everything at every lecture the labs will help you to understand the work. Also office hours are very helpful, I would use them as often as you can.
Easily the best professor in the entire uic CS department. He makes complicated topics easy to understand and is always willing to help students by going over concepts till they sink in.

Arguably the best CS professor at UIC. Definitely cares about his students. His homework, labs, lectures, and practice exams are the best example of "the work you put in directly translating to the results you get back" on quizzes and exams out of any CS or math class I've ever taken. Provides plenty of extra credit opportunity as well.
Only professor I had to spend 2.5 hrs of his day to review with us and answer questions.

Professor Bello is real asset to the department. Theoretical Computer Science may be intimidating but with him and his wonderful lectures, it didn't feel that way. Homeworks can be a bit confusing so definitely start at least early. Strong material and guides to succeed throughout this class all you need to do is put in the work for it. Great man.
He's gonna make sure you know the material.

Homework is really hard in this class, don't fret though, his and his TA's office hours really distinguished me from possibly ending with a C like in 151 to an A just by putting in effort. This class is easier than 151 if you show up to lectures and office hours. Gem of a professor, take him for any class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The practice exam is the real exam with just the values swapped. Do the practice exam, set up a community post on piazza for people to volunteer answers (volunteer your own as well, don't just ask - that usually leads to minimal participation). You'll basically have the answer key to the exam.

The angel himself! The best professor in the whole department and the whole university. Provides multiple extra credit opportunities and helps in every aspect of the course and outside class. He picks his TAs and ensures that they are the best. This man needs a good raise. His lectures are moderately paced and he ensures to address all questions.
There is a lot of material, but he teaches it very well and always stops to answer questions. If something is not clear, he won't move on and leave you confused.

OMG!this is literally the best Professor at UIC.He considers each and every student and is very understanding. His teaching style is awesome, grading is not too harsh but perfect, lots of extra credit in class,labs are useful (unlike some other professors who dont know what they are teaching or what their students are going through). He is the best
If you attend the lectures and do the homework you'll be fine. He does a good job at teaching and tries really hard to make sure his students understand the information.

GOOO TOOO LECTURE. lectures are kinda boring but make sense always and are really good. Go to class, and do everything you can to make sure you stay awake in lecture. drink caffeination or snort coffee idc stay awake if u do that you pass, labs are easy hw is hard if u don't go to lecture. Take notes during the lecture. He is a very chill dude tho.

Best professor at UIC. No other professor goes out of their way to put this much effort into their lectures to make sure everyone understands. If you lost go to his office hours and ask, he will re-explain the material until you understand it. Very generous in grading and gives lots of extra credit opportunities to raise your grade
The one of the best professor that I ever meet

I agree that Bello is one of the better teachers in the CS department. My only complaint would be that he puts grades in super slowly, so you don't really know how well you're doing in the course till the end. The class is straightforward as long as you attend lectures and pay attention. Really enjoyed having Bello though. He knows his stuff.

If you're reading this and you've seen his overall reviews already, you shouldn't even check the other professors. Just sign up for Bello. He's obviously going to be the best for your success. Nothing can be said that hasn't already been said. Thank us later.

Professor Bello is a professor that loves his students, he always offers extra help and extra credit! Furthermore, he's always spending hours with students to assure they succeed. I personally feel that he is the best professor at UIC and I'm sure many students would agree with me! Thanks for reading!
He is a really good professor who gives you lots of extra credit, but be careful of the quizzes that come every week. As long as you listen and study in class you will be fine.
At first the course seems hard, but this professor makes sure that his lectures are clear and makes sure everyone understands the material.
Very caring professor, always asks in class if everyone understands. 10/10 would take again in a heart beat!

Professor Bello is the golden standard for profs. His lectures are fast-paced, but the content in them is directly used in HW, labs, and exams. He gives many opportunities to score EC, holds very good review sessions for all the exams, and is very quick to respond to questions on Piazza. He is a very reasonable prof and should teach more courses!

Professor Bello made discrete math easy to learn. The lectures are amazing and you get 2% extra credit if you do the iclickers. He prepares students very well for the exams and always has office hours before homework and exams. If you take CS 151 try to take it with Professor Bello. I'm so glad I got to take discrete math with Professor Bello!

Best professor you will ever have at UIC. Lectures are incredibly designed, he has them down to the minute, and he cares a ton about his students. I've never had a class where I genuinely felt like I was truly learning and truly had the chance to succeed. You'll learn his content well, and you'll do well, thanks to his teaching.

THIS MAN DA GOAT! His lectures are so good and there's lots of extra credit! Participate in the Iclicker thing and get 2% added to your final grade. His study guides are very close to the exams. Participate, do homeworks, and pass!

Professor Bello is a real gem to the CS Department. If you are taking Discrete Math try to take it with him. He makes it easier to understand the course material and his lecture slides are a work of art. The way the class is organized is amazing and there is tons of opportunities for extra credit in this class. Please take the effort to go to class

reviews.comment: One of the most organized and passionate teachers I've met. One of the best at UIC.

Although this is my first semester at UIC, Bello is definitely the best CS teacher I have had the pleasure of having. This man is always responding to student emails and Piazza posts, having TA sessions, and offers help for exmas. 6 / 5, if I could
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: An excellent professor. Gives plenty of examples and clear explanations. Not once has he been unable to not answer a question asked in person. When messaged, he answers within 30min. Provides practice exams, homework, and labs to prepare for exams- all which are of reasonable amount and difficulty. Plenty of opportunities to get assistance. Smart.
One of the better professors at UIC.

He made me fall in love with Data Science, he teaches just the right amount of Math and background required and focuses more on practical aspects of things. His teaching is very good. Never missed a single class.

Professor Bello is an absolute gem. His explanations during lecture are extremely helpful and easy to understand. The midterms/final cover exactly what he goes over in class so make sure to attend and pay attention. The exams are not hard if you understand the material. The homework is probably the hardest part of the class, but overall, good prof!

I thought there weren't good Professors at UIC until I stumbled upon Dr. Bello. Enroll into this class and you have nothing to worry about. You will 100% learn, have fun and do well! He is such a caring person, and puts lots of efforts in everything he does. Dr. Bello deserves all the success coming his way.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: When it comes to teaching, he is and I'm not exaggerating, a god amongst mortals. I read a review for him saying they're worried how much sleep he gets given how late he's up answering questions on piazza. That sums it up. Great teacher, genuinely cares about students, great slides, always down to give extra credit. What more can you ask for?

reviews.comment: Prof. Bello is one of the best professors in the CS department, his teaching makes classes like these interesting and easy.
I would not take his class again ever.
Fantastic professor hands down. Has the ability to teach all concepts in a way students understand best.

Overall great professor. Unlike some other professors, he is fair when it comes to grading and giving partial credit. There are numerous opportunities to make up for lost points, and everything is fair game. Good explanations and helpful when you are confused about something.

An excellent and ever-ready professor. He knows this stuff so well. He genuinely cares about his students succeeding. His lecture slides and his in-class lectures are top-notch, and he's always on piazza answering questions. Like there's no reason you should fail this class if you listen to him. Take him, he's really the best!

Professor Bello is a great professor in multiple ways. He is very good at lecturing and really knows his stuff, it scared me because I never remember him fumbling his words or saying a wrong thing. He is also very quick to responding to piazza posts, sometimes extremely late or early in the morning. Probably the best CS professor I have had yet.

Phenomenal professor! This class was difficult but he made it look like a piece of cake:) He does everything in his power to get you to understand the concepts taught in the class. He does take a while to grade things but that's a concern for people who like seeing their grades asap. IF HE'S AN OPTION FOR A CLASS, TAKE HIM!

He's beyond amazing! His lecture slides as well as actual lectures are indisputably awesome! I feel he makes it a priority to get his students to understand his lectures, and also respond to piazza questions really quick (no matter the time). He gives decent deadlines, extra credit, and asks on exams only what he went over. Take him if you can!

I took Professor Bello for 151, 301, and will be taking him again for CS418. He is by far, with no competition, the best CS professor at UIC. His powerpoints are godtier and provide all the information you need to pass, but as an added bonus you get him! He can answer any questions on any topic in class and he gives a good amount of extra credit!

Professor Bello is the best teacher I have ever had the pleasure of learning from during the course of my CS degree at UIC. He genuinely cares about his students learning the concepts he is trying to teach. I had him for CS 151, CS 301, and will have him for CS 418. He is always prepared, and as long as you pay attention you will learn in his class
Perhaps the only good CS professor at UIC. Thats all. Im enjoying his classes
His lectures are pedagogically sound. Unfortunately, he takes eons to grade things, which is a hindrance for students who want to get feedback on their HW to learn from their mistakes.

Professor Bello is a fantastic teacher. Try to establish yourself by speaking with him outside of class. Whether you need clarification on a lesson or want to talk about your academic career, he's willing to listen and offer constructive and sound advice. He's an educator through and through. The class was tough, but he made it easy to get through.
He is the best professor I've ever taken a class with. Lectures are really amazing, makes everything so easy to understand,very caring, would love to take class with him again.

By far the best "powerpoint instructor" at this university. Amazing slides, fun and interesting lectures and extra credit to boot! The class is fast paced and can seem difficult, but he brings it down to an easily understandable level. Exams are the bulk of the grade, but partial credit is generous. Truly a Lord of Logic, you should take him!

His lectures are dense and go quickly, but that's not his fault as there is a lot of material to cover. You need to pay attention otherwise you'll be lost. He's a great professor, genuinely wants his students to succeed. Despite the fast pace of his lectures he makes sure to stop to let people ask questions. Always on Piazza.

Understands what students want and keeps you engaged. Amazing lecture slides lots of examples. At first, I did not like him because he is going through a lot of stuff quickly. Later I realized how easy he makes it look, even though the topics are tough. Going fast is not his fault, the class covers many different topics. You can't hate this man!
he breathes this stuff, he understands it so well that it seems like he's just explaining how he woke up

reviews.comment: Great lectures , approachable and helpful . Some of the material is hard like induction
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dedicated educator. Very knowledgeable about the material and will absolutely help you if you don't understand everything, if you seek it. His lectures go by very quickly because they keep you engaged.

Amazing professor, god tier hair and fit, his knowledge and wisdom can make a person insecure though, but you shouldn't feel dumb as this man is on his own level surpassing limits no human has ever accomplished before, I can only feast my eye sockets upon the knowledge that he gives to us peasants through his godly lecture slides.
He is the best professor ever.
This professor is really good and helpful and gives away tons of extra credit. But his lecture content are heavy as he goes over lot of stuff . Just pay attention and you'll pass easily.
Literally the highest quality professor in the UIC CS department.

Hes probably the best professor I have ever had in that hes intelligent, a great teacher, and truly does care about his students success. Lots of extra credit opportunities and is always active on piazza answering any questions that students have. The class material is tough, but most definitely doable. Highly recommend.

Great professor,very knowledgeable and caring. Always ready to help during office hours and even outside of office hours. I haven't seen so much dedication to students in a while. I would highly recommend him if you want to learn the content of class, feel confident, and get a good grade. His lecture/code materials are very organized on blackboard

Professor Bello is very organized and provides clear grading criteria for all exams and assignments in his class. His lecture slides are nicely prepared as well. He answers questions quickly on Piazza and listens to the concerns of his students.

Great Professor... Has a great way of explaining the subject such that everything makes sense. Loads of opportunities for extra credit in classes and in exams as well. Participation in class matters. Gives a lot of homework but also gives the required time for it. He is accessible after classes and in office hours and does his best to explain all.
Great professor. Generous with extra credit. He even showed how to do the extra credit problem on the midterm and final exam the lecture before. Very helpful and is cares about his students

Professor Bello is an amazing lecturer. He tries his best to make his lectures engaging and meaningful. Prof. also tries to give the most help outside of class. He is very accessible either through Piazza or office hours. (and he gives EC)....
He is a great professor. He is very organized and helpful.

Professor Bello is phenomenal. He cares that everyone understands the material, posting his slides with and without notes, making study guides, and making homework assignments that are genuinely helpful. I ended the class with over 100%. He is truly a great professor.

Amazing professor, genuinely cares for his students and is always willing to provide help outside of class. Very organized with lecture notes and making assignment/exam dates clear. Also offers lots of extra credit to make up lost points in your grade. He tends to take a while with grading, but overall would highly recommend him.

Gonzalo truly is a gem. He's a genuine guy and a great teacher, go to his office hours if you need to. The class consisted of weekly written homework, small quizzes, iclickers in lecture, 3 exams, and a final. Not exactly an easy A, but it is definitely doable with all the extra credit that is offered.

Bello is one of the only teachers ive had at UIC who really wants you to do well in his class and makes sure of it. He bumps your grade almost 5% at the end, answers emails and discussion posts SO QUICKLY and really cares about what he teaches. This is a HARD class so beware, but Bello makes it easy to do well if you pay attention.
really caring, everything is given to you to pass. You just need to take the time to study the material, seek help/tutoring. All the resources are provided
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lots of extra credit that actually makes a grade difference. Gives out lecture captures and notes, and sample exams to help prepare for upcoming exams. Sample exams are pretty much same format as exams, so make sure you know how to do every problem. He's usually on piazza answering questions 24/7, so he really cares about helping his students.

Professor Bello is an amazing professor, he taught the class really well, and was always available to help the students. Be sure to listen well during the lectures as they are VERY HELPFUL. Every time an extra credit opportunity arises be sure to take it, because it will help u a lot in the end, my grade went from an 85% to a 92% because of it.
Super accessible outside of class. Well respected by TA's and students, overall super-intelligent and hard-working dude. Lectures are engaging and well-organized. Cannot recommend him enough.

Prof. Bello is an amazing instructor who truly cares about his students success. He offers plenty of extra credit opportunities throughout the semester, up to 4.5% I believe. Despite our lecture rudely talking during his lecture, he handled it so well. He's helpful during office hours and genuinely a nice human being. Totally recommend!

A really amazing teacher, but the grading ethics in the class are so terrible. You will not get a grade from your exam until it's far too late to discuss about it. Personally, the class was too difficult to understand.

He cares very much about his students, goes out of his way to make sure everyone does well. Overall, the class is challenging with a lot of material being covered so make sure you follow along with the lecture and dont fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Professor Bello has a really great teaching style for the discrete math class. He gives out a ton of extra credit chances for students, and goes over practical examples of the problems. Definitely visit his office hours if you need help with the written homework. Online homework is easy, and the written homework prepares you well for the exams.
a good teacher

Ganzalo is one of the better professors at Uic. He is extremely nice and understanding, that at the beginning of the semester people are still acclimating to the class. I highly recommend him as an instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Works very hard to make sure you understand the material and succeed. Detailed lectures to help students really understand the topics, and also offers extra credit to help you work for the grade you aspire to get. You don't put in the work, no A for you. Pay attention in class, try to read the book, and participate? You get an A.

This professor was awesome! It was his first semester of teaching, but he was excellent. His lectures and explanations were very detailed and thorough, and the slides he makes for the lectures are EXCELLENT study materials. He does take a while to grade things, but he'll fix that with experience. Overall: great teacher to select for your course.
Best professor ever. Took him for 151 and got an A. I would recommend him to anyone taking him and I'm looking forward to his next class

The professor gave us ample opportunity to boost our grades, to the point where people were taking it for granted. Nevertheless, the professor was very good at explaining concepts and the online textbook, ZyBooks was very helpful. Unfortunately we did have to pay for it, under $100. He was also very prompt in answering our concerns.

Professor Lander's lectures give solid examples that appear throughout exams and quizzes. Quizzes, lab assignments, iClicker questions tie well into what you are supposed to know for the exams. Extra credit was very generous but it did bump some low B students to A's. Good if you're a B student and not if you are an A student who works harder for A
EXCELLENT TEACHER! HE WANTS YOU TO DO WELL AND HE WILL MAKE SURE OF IT.
Great Professor. Take him if you ever have the chance to.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: Most dedicated professor I've ever had. Very active on piazza and gives out a lot of extra credit. The course is tough no matter who you take but he is very good at explaining things. If you don't go to lecture then he will upload the notes on blackboard but it is strongly encouraged to go to lecture anyway. Weekly quizzes and daily iclickers.

Have you ever told your friends that you couldn't hang out with them because you had too much extra credit to do? Well now's your chance. Professor Bello gives more extra credit than you know what to do with. Super caring, great easy to understand lecturer, and an overall amazing professor. If his class is available, take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--EXTRA CREDIT--Would take again

reviews.comment: He's an amazing teacher, very helpful, and is good at what he does. His tests are easy, and he gives out lots of extra credit. His exams are doable.

He is a great professor, and I am very lucky to have him as my professor. He makes sure that no-one lags behind and keeps on making us work harder and giving extra credit assignments every now and then. He is much more focused on student's understanding rather than just completing the course.
He's a great guy who's always given in lots of stuff for extra credit to increase your grade. Wants you to get a good grade. Funny and friendly! Would definitely take him again.

Good lecturer, has a slight accent, but nothing that impedes his ability to teach or your ability to learn. He goes out of his way to upload notes and lecture slides. Sometimes I worry that he spends all his time for this class. He will be up pretty late answering piazza questions. Puts a lot of effort into making sure students get the material.

One thing that made this course more difficult for me was that he went over the content super quickly. He used typed "worksheets" rather than slides or writing on the board, so for me, it was hard to follow the material during class since it felt too fast. I did not mind having to rewatch the lectures, but it was a harder teaching style for me.

He was pretty odd, but overall a solid professor. He explained the topics well, but I personally don't like his teaching style of presenting the question without giving an example of how to do it in the first place. The TAs are super helpful; ask all the questions in the discussion class. I wouldn't have passed without my TA (shoutout Rishi!)

Really easy class but annoying professor. Feel like he does not explain concepts very well. If you took calculus in high school or not, you'll be fine because the class is easy. Take this professor only if you have no other option.

While him as a person is very odd and mean a lot of times, I think he actually did a really good job teaching and explaining the concepts in the class. there are lots of opportunities to get points, however, this is due to the 4-7 math assignments due every week. My TA was amazing though (shout out Emil)
Professor Bridges will not pace himself according to student needs.  The whole class was frustrated and he seemed to have an arrogance.  Stressful situation taking his class.

Overall he just powers through examples during class without really going step by step, and if you ask him a question he takes forever to answer and will probably just make you more confused. However, the exams make up a majority of your grade and are very easy compared to the lectures and homework, and are very similar to the practice exams.

passive aggressive when answering questions or lecturing
if you want your grade rounded make sure to email both your professor and the head lecturer before they submit finial grades and make sure they answer

Skipped steps, didn't respond well to
Questions and normally spent half the time walking around watching us solve the lecture sheets??? Waste of my time and I had to teach myself the entirety of calc 180.
He was especially helpful during office hours and is always willing to reexplain concepts differently until you understand them!

He was an okay professor. He opened the floor for questions but even if he didn't mean to answered them somewhat passive aggressively. I would say definitely review pre-calc and whatever calc knowledge you have before taking this course. There's 4 different kinds of assignments you have to complete each week so be prepared for that.

Professor Bridges is a very good professor. He projects his lectures on the screen and shows exactly what needs to be known and how to solve the problems. Whenever I need to ask a question, he is always earnest to reply. Also, I like how chill he is; he never yells at the class and never gets on anyone's case for anything. Overall, chill guy!!

He's an alright professor. He starts class on time and gets to work right away. He will stay on pace with lectures throughout the week and explain things thoroughly during class. Sometimes if you ask him a question though he might give u attitude or won't really answer ur question. Kinda short tempered.

Professor Bridges is nowhere near as bad as people make him out to be. He gets the lectures sheets done on time and explains the process of concepts and problems well enough. Granted, I had to learn on my own to learn some concepts cause he would go over it a little too fast with the little time we have but that's just how college is.
If you wanna cry yourself to sleep and believe your not good at math take this course.
he's a horrible teacher i had to teach myself the whole material
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: At first I wasn't a fan as he does just kind of fill out the worksheets and thats it but it really isn't his fault. The course is taught in a way that the professors have to rush through every lecture to make sure to get everything done on time. Definitely one of the better calculus professors as his lectures aren't unbearable.

This was my first Calculus class, and it was a terrible experience having Professor Bridges. I did good, but only because I self-taught this entire course to myself. The lectures were extremely unhelpful and confusing, and he went through problems very fast, explaining alternative ways to solve them which did not matter and were confusing.
ok professor. The coursework is not too bad but he is not very reachable outside of class. He answers questions in class in an annoyed manner. If you email him, he does not respond.

Professor Tabes was not a good teacher. Personally, I self taught this course and attended lectures with other professors. He goes through problems way too fast and explains them briefly. Most people in my class skipped his class as well (standing outside for lecture attendance LOL). You'd be better off with the organic chem tutor on youtube......

Skips steps during lectures and goes through problems very fast but in an efficient manner. Occasionally makes jokes but asking simple questions will get him annoyed. If you have previously taken calc and know what you are doing, you will be fine but for first time calc takers, you will have an easier time learning material with another professor.

If you want a professor that makes you scared to ask questions. He's your guy. Very little explanation when problem solving. This is a lecturing professor, not a teacher. Use lecture recordings and you'll pass the class.

He straight up laughed in a student's face when they asked what the squeeze theorem was. The other reviews saying he's condescending are right. The quality of his lectures are alright if you already know what you're doing. TA's are always your best resource.

He has a tendency to respond rudely or passively aggressively to questions asked in lecture and at the same time he questions why students do not prefer to email him in regards to questions about the course. He is also slow to answer emails and is not available most of the time.

Asking the wrong question could result in a passive aggressive answer that doesn't really help. Lectures involve working through problems by skipping multiple steps and little explanation which just devolves into confusion for trying to learn the material. You will find that you need to teach yourself the material.  TAs are your best resource.

Clearly very smart and knows a lot about the subject, but he also expects you to come in to the class knowing a lot, which means that he skips steps/explanations in lectures. He can come off as rude/passive aggressive when you ask questions so if you want an approachable professor, don't take him.

He's really smart, but the way he teaches is not good. He goes realllllyyyy fast and goes off tangents a lot. A lot of the times he'll explain things that you don't need to know. Not that great at teaching.

Lectures were difficult to follow since he didn't necessarily explain things through. I ended up attending another professor's lectures instead and found success in the course in that way. I would say you will end up depending on your TAs and LAs if you have him.
He knows the subject well however, he does not explain how certain answers were brought upon well and keeps on demanding that some variables are the answers he wants.
He was ok
This instructor does not teach the material, he just does the worksheets over a projector and expects you to understand the material.

This professor certainly understands the content, but getting a good explanation out of him requires asking questions. A lot of lecture time is dedicated to letting students try to solve the notes themselves, with less time dedicated to actually teaching the content. He just solves the problems and moves on. The course has video lessons- use them!

Professor Tabes doesn't actually teach he sort of just solves the lecture worksheets. Calculus 3 was harder to follow because a lot of the higher dimensional geometry is harder to visualize and understand. The class itself was frustrating because it was hard to understand and it was just memorizing formulas. However, the exams were pretty simple.

He doesnt teach math, he just makes you memorize equations for the first chunk of the semester and is boring, but lot of examples. don't go to lecture it's not worth it. Watch 3b1b linear algebra series on youtube. He explains concepts. Learn equations in class or google do the quizzes.

This professor may seem lazy at times with his methods of teaching but he teaches pretty well. He spends a lot of class time talking about concepts that may be hard to follow but the lectures and notes are very laid out and simple to follow, so simple that you could follow along by reading notes and not watching lectures. Also, review sessions help
