reviews.comment: Linear Algebra, this semester. All professors share their knowledge; some of them are good at teaching the material. Those two things are not the same. Professor Tabes *teaches* math. If you aren't learning while he's at the front, then you need to ask questions. He leaves space for - and requests - them, and has answered every one asked of him.

I would not recommend taking the class with Tabes. He was one of the more difficult instructors for this class. He always speeds through the content during lectures. If you try to ask him a question, he'll simply tell you that you should've learned it in high school. Try to take this with Jenny Ross instead she is the best instructor for the course

Tabes Bridges is one of the best teachers I've ever had. Once I was walking home and I saw a burning building. Tabes Bridges ran in there with no regard for himself saving a family and their dog. Truly remarkable guy.
isnt worth it

When we in lecture, he be rushing it. And when we ask him a question, he will say you should of learned that in high school(smart ass question). If he in a good mood he will not even answer your question. Alot of people in the class stop even bodering with the question. When you go one on one same thing i said. Just get help somewhere else.

The class was manageable, and the group project was randomly assigned and split into two parts. Her lectures didn't feel long, and she's an amazing presenter. I would take her again if she taught any other class.

Truly such an amazing professor. She's so understanding and is so rare to come by. Although the lectures do feel long she finds a way to make them entertaining. I wish she taught so many more courses because I would honestly take them all with her.

Katherine Bae was an excellent professor. Her homework assignments and group projects were very clear and straightforward. She brought great energy and passion to her lectures, making the material enjoyable. Exams were taken in person through Blackboard. Overall, it was a very positive experience, and I would definitely take her class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She was one of the best and most understanding professors I have ever had. You can tell she loves doing her job and helping her students excel. 2 exams + one group project towards the end of the course, however, she gives you a lot of time to complete it. I took this in spring 2025, but it's still the most memorable class yet. genuinely perfect.
Literally the BESTTTT!! It's that one professor that you going to remember as a savior, super easy, very very understanding, lectures super interesting, just PERFECTTTTT.

I don't know why she doesn't have any ratings yet, but she is literally the best professor ever. She is always willing to help the class; this won't ever cause you any serious stress. Well respected and super understanding. She is ONE OF THE RARE professors who genuinely care, understand, and hope the best for their students, and super easy class.

This instructor should not be teaching. She deducts points for those that are not consistent with the grading rubric. She does not grade the assignments on time, which prevents you from learning and gaining feedback. If I'm not mistaken, there are other people grading our assignments in addition to her, so there are inconsistencies in the grading.

She's way too nitpicky with things. Even if my assignments are well done she still always have something to say. She's a tough grader. She just keeps on deducting points for no reason that are not even found on the rubric. Honestly one of the worst online professors.

Follow the assignment rubrics EXACTLY and complete EVERY assignment you will pass. Shes a fair grader. The biggest assignment was making a 15 min video of you doing a head-to-toe assessment on a live person in week 7.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She would fail you by an assignment even if your overall grade is passing
Just take him! The best professor in finance I've had so far.
Aaron is a teacher you will only get once in your life, he is the Goat of Finance teachers.
Great professor, has very engaging lectures. Recommend taking this professor for FIN320. Class is easy and manageable.
He was a good professor.
The Greatest teacher

Takes attendance a few times, and warns ahead of time. Pearson textbook purchase required. Only 10 Homework assignments total and a quiz for every chapter. One midterm and final. Says exactly what to study, and practice exams are almost identical.

I highly recommend taking this professor for FIN 300. Cuts to the chase, tells you what you need to know, and simplifies topics as much as you can. Study guides are actually helpful for exams. He gives clear instructions for all assignments, as well as keeps everyone posted with necessary announcements. Made this class extremely easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Honestly, this class was surprisingly easy, thank goodness. Because I had very challenging classes, and he made this one very manageable, despite being a finance class. Simply study the focus slides and the study guide he provides, and you'll excel in this class. Also, he doesn't take attendance much and he will tell you if he will or not.

He's the most hilarious professor I have ever taken. His lectures are very fun and enjoyable as he goes over the material. He's also very accessible outside his lecture. The material isn't hard as long as you follow with him on lectures. He gives up good feedback whether it's on homework, exams, or just life in general. Amazing professor overall :)

Professor Bianco is truly the best professor I have ever had. I'm a finance minor, so taking an intro to finance class as a biology major was something out of my comfort zone, but he made it such a great experience. His class is so easy if you attend his lectures; he tells you exactly how to prepare for exams, and he gives you so much advice.

Best professor I've ever had. From the first day, he creates a welcoming environment that makes you excited to learn. He's genuine, funny, inspiring, and truly cares about his students. He makes finance easy with real life examples and motivates you to achieve your goals!!! His phrase “Find something you're passionate about” will stay with me :)

Pretty easy intro finance class. The professor is decent; you will have to study on your own, but as long as you buy the finance calculator, you are basically set for the class. The study guides he provides are exactly like the exams, so you know what to expect, and the material isn't too challenging.

I don't really rate professors but this guy is the exception. All I gotta say is consider yourself lucky if you get him. Attendance is taken once a week. If you aren't lazy and actually pay attention and do the midterm/exam review you should get Minimum a B. The only hard part are the quizzes (online) but you should be able to pass the class.
Professor Blanco is one of the best teachers I have ever had. He is super nice and also helps people with all kinds of things outside of class. Truly like a good friend.
Professor with real -life finance experience, very personable and respected. I would 100% take him again.

this prof is the best ever just pay attention to his lectures and get the finance calculator, he randomly takes attendance so show up and he's so so so sweet and caring just ask him anyyy questions u have and his pretest is amazing review for his exams. take him if u can !!
He's a great professor and makes the material come to you very easily! Would definitely take one of his classes again, especially because of how lenient he can be with certain assignments.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Was my professor for FIN250 during the four-week summer session (so lots of material packed into every class). Professor Bianco made the class a really great experience.

His lectures were heavy with the amount of slides and content we had to do but they were very engaging at the same time. We had 2 exams, 1 midterm and 1 final (non-cumulative) and you are provided a formula sheet. The study guides were very similar to the actual exams so I would highly recommend taking FIN 300 with him.

Professor is one of the best at UIC. Very well educated and knowledgeable. Really knows how to keep a class engaged and he cares for his students. Finance 300 is formula heavy but professor makes it super easy and applies real world applications into his lectures. This guy know his stuff!!!

One of the best professors I've had. Super knowledgeable and great at teaching. The class is math/formula heavy, but he clearly explains real-world applications. It's a bit harder than others, but totally worth it—especially if you're a finance major or really interested in the topic.
Very knowledgable and knows how to keep a class engaged

The best professor I've had at UIC so far. He does a great job in class of finding a balance between explaining the coursework and explaining finance-related topics that are relevant in daily life. He's great at answering questions and never puts anybody down for saying the wrong answer. I highly recommend his class if you want to learn finance.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Bianco is an overall great professor. He is very knowledgeable and very engaging to learn from. Outside of class he is very helpful with looking over your resume, helping you for internships and even writing you letters of recommendation. Go to the lectures, do the homework and ask questions you will get an A

Extremely passionate about what he teaches. Lets us know ahead of time which days he plans to take attendance. The material can be overwhelming, but he emphasizes what we MUST know for the exams. Likes to include useful advice for the real world. He clearly cares about his students. Pay attention and do the practice exams, you'll do great.

Like any Chemistry class, it will require work and extra time outside of class, going over and practicing material. Dr. Carmel is great at helping you understand concepts and theories in chemistry. PERFECT IF YOU'RE MOVING ON TO ORGANIC CHEM! Clearly wants his students to succeed, clearly cares about his students, VERY patient.

His slides were pretty informative, but participation in completing the worksheets is key to passing this class. He gives study guides for the exams, but the questions on those study guides are completely different from the ones in the exam. His teaching style is not too bad either, and he always has a positive attitude.

The lectures where great he would usually spend the first 2/3 lecturing and he has clear and concise slides and offers a wide variety of examples. The last 1/3 he would usually give a worksheet and him and the La's would walk around helping. the worksheets are like the tests. Very little HW. I clicker's where helpful. genuinely cares about students
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Truthfully amazing, I barely studied and did well. He is extremely approachable and nice. his lecture slides are skeletal an breve and he really goes into it for the lecture.
He is a great teacher. His teaching method really allows students to understand what they are learning instead of just throwing content at us. He genuinely wants to to learn and do good in the exams!

Carmel is nice, funny, and approachable. His lectures are definitely more about the concepts rather than going over practice problems. The worksheets we do in class can be a little confusing but they're not graded. Keep up with iclicker questions for attendence and practice problems. My TA was more helpful with understanding the math areas.

He's really not as bad as these people are saying. Yes, his class is very concept heavy. Just go to office hours. He also gives mock exams to study with before the actual exam which I find really helpful as the other chem122 profs dont provide. Hw/iclickers are for completion, so just try your best. Just don't fall behind and you'll be just fine.

Dr. Carmel is a good knowledable professor and a really great person but his lectures don't have enough practice on them and he doesn't post the answers to the worksheets we do in class. The textbook also has no practice in it. Not enough. enough resources to study with.

If you aren't an auditory learner, you're gonna struggle. The slides arent helpful after class as he teaches in a way of presentation. He talks about problems and concepts rather than doing example problems. Taking notes from lectures and slides is impossible. Be Socratic hw is extremely frustrating

Tbh I think most of these reviews are hyperbole. I had Dr Carmel gen chem 1 and 2, and I thought he was great. The lectures are easily comprehensible, and the exams were pretty fair. The only real complaint I had was that you never really knew what your overall grade was; however, if you keep up with hw, iclicker and discussion, you'll be fine.

Dr. Carmel is a great professor. He teaches in a way that we actually understand the concept. The discussion sheets and mock exams are exactly like his exams. As long as you review it before the exams, it should be very straightforward. He honestly makes chem super easy.

He is such an amazing professor.He had a lot of in class question practice sheets, which helped me a lot in remembering concepts and analysing topics. I really enjoyed his classes, always looked forward to learn from him. The homework and his worksheets are designed such that you actually use the concepts well and you are able connect them.
If you show up and actively participate in lectures and discussions, you're going to do fine.
euphoria by kendrick lamar, 3:10-3:25

By no means is Professor Carmel a bad instructor. Like any class you take, you have to put in a little work outside of class to earn the grade you want. He does a good job preparing you for tests (if you study), and you are provided with so much study material, such as discussion worksheets and in-class worksheets.

if you can avoid taking dr. carmel please do. his class is almost entirely lecture based so if you don't learn well like that, then you're cooked. his exams don't look like the mock exams he provides and that's all he gives you to study. class was mostly spent on worksheets. you can study for hours and still fail his exams. do not recommend at all

Dr. Carmel is an amazing professor! I disagree with a lot of these comments because he's not that bad. He is very lenient and accessible outside of class, his office hours are very fun and engaging. I will say his teaching style (concept heavy) isn't for everyone but if you keep up with the work you should do fine!
Difficult class very concept heavy. I had him for 122 & 124 this was the worst class ever. I would not take it with him if I had the option of another professor. DON'T DO IT!

You just have to pay attention and put in the effort to do good in the class.I feel like this class isn't that hard if you keep up with the lectures which are recorded and accessible to anyone and if you attend discussion which helped a lot in clearing up some confusing topics.

took him for 122+124, not as bad as ppl say. Yes he does alot of worksheets with no answer key but they do help you. Exams are similar to mock exam with small surprises. Def pay attention to lecture, go every day and do the worksheets to rlly understand how to do different styles of questions. He is nice! so reach out if you have any questions.

Carmel is not a bad professor as people may say. His mock exams + worksheets are actually helpful if you use them to your advantage. The worksheets don't have answer keys but are easy to figure out if you go through his lectures and take notes. Yes the exams are difficult but he is also lenient so you can get some points from reflection & iclicker.
Epic and good!

took him for 122 and 124- i just dont like his teaching style tbh. like he's a good prof in terms that he engages w students and he's funny, but he we do so many worksheets in class and dont really go over them and i didn't really learn well from his lec but honestly other ppl did so it depends. so like meh

Great prof, worksheets in class and discussion are exactly what are on exams. Explains concepts really well. Is soooo nice and understanding. 10/10 love u Dr.Carmel. In a world of bad profs, hes doing really good work.

Dr. Carmel has a wonderful personality and is very kind. However, his lectures barely reflected what was on the exams. Though he does provide a mock exam, none of them reflect anything close to the difficulty level of the exam. Avoid if possible

Only reason I got an A is because I took very in-depth notes during lecture. The textbook provided is a single PDF with hundreds of pages that legit reads like a book, no practice problems, wordy definitions, just paragraphs of text. Prof focuses much more on theory and understanding of concepts than calculations. Overall, nice guy/lecture heavy.

Class is very lecture oriented, the only reason why I did well in the class was because I took very in-depth notes during the lectures. The textbook is just single PDF with hundreds pages that legit reads like a book, no practice problems, wordy definitions, just paragraphs of text. The textbook was useless, you have rely on lectures to pass.

I get it, chemistry is going to be challenging at times and we'll have to study outside of class. BUT I was hoping to pass by the time the semester was ending I was on the edge of my seat endlessly hoping I passed. Mock exams don't reflect anything even remotely similar to the actual exams. Glosses over important material as well :((

reviews.comment: The exams are worth over half of your entire grade, and the mock exams were NOTHING like the actual exam. No way of seeing if the homework answers are correct. Didnt put in grades until the final week so u have no clue if youre failing. Changed up the whole curriculum from the other professors, it was so unfair. I'm warning u to take another prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Carmel was a solid professor. His lectures were great, he's really good at explaining things which helps because his class was very conceptual based. However, I will say that he never graded/gave feedback on homework assignments, and the exams did seem harder than the materials we were given to prep with. I did really enjoy his class though.

college requires u to work hard and put effort into ur classes. study a week before exams, go over learning objectives, redo discussion worksheets, review BeSocratic, go to lecture and office hours, max out iclicker and hw. he a good professor, ppl complain too much. grow up, we in college. btw textbook is free but useless, i never used it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE CARMEL. He started off chill in the start of the semester but that was all an act. He is rude in his office hours and rude to students who would ask him questions in lecture. His exam prep does not help at all for his exams, so be ready for curveballs. If you have bro as your teacher good luck gang.

I only took Dr. Carmel as last resort. A lot of his exams are very hard to prepare for since the reviews are nothing similar. It was really difficult to study and be prepared for his exams. I would recommend any other professor.

The prof's mock exams don't reflect the actual exams at all, and he glosses over important topics very briefly, and proceeds to add that in the exam with a curve ball. It's a lot of theories, more than math, so you really have to pay attention in class. I'd prepare pretty good for the exams,but the brudda somehow still manages to curb stomp my exam

People here are saying the teacher is nice but that doesn't matter he's here to teach us not be our friend. You need to know the ins and outs of everything with forces and bonds and even if you study all the resources he gives he's gonna throw really tricky questions just to mess with you. Don't take him, save yourself from the hairless.

Lectures were very clear, and discussion sheets and homework really reflected the content. Primarily conceptual course, not much math, so pay attention to the lecture/recordings. Only criticisms are that the mock exams aren't good practice, homework isn't graded until the end of the semester, but he posts learning objectives that are good to study.
he be doing too much.

guys being real he could be such a good prof if he just like put the material on the exams. like he's nice and passionate but the exams be nothing like we learned in class or on the mock exams and its a lot theory based as well which is meh but like i study the lec slides and do the mocks but then the exam switches up and its like bro.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bro is not accurate with mock exams, and the actual exams are harder. Mock exams are also not accurate, and he throws in content we barely learned into exams. Waits to put in all grades and doesn't allow us to know our grades. If you are behind, you're cooked, and you gotta learn it yourself. He is a nice person but class kinda sucked.

Im surprised he has such a bad rating. Great professor and it's clear he wants the best for students. I don't like how he waits till the end of the semester to put in the homework grades and the clickers. The test is harder than mock exams, and there are curve balls. I had a high A in 101, but this class was much different and less math focused

He doesn't give answers to the written part of mock exams which is important since he focuses a lot on theories. Homework isn't graded so we can't go back to practice to see what we got wrong b/c we don't know the answers. Nice professor overall if you go to office hours but he lacks teaching, still better than other chem 122 professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Carmel's lectures were less math focused and very much theory focused. If you don't pay attention you're cooked. Puts in homework/clicker/discussion grades in at the end of semester. Doesn't provide answer keys for review sheets. Mock exams are not similar to the actual exams. You gotta figure out how to do a lot of stuff on your own outside class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class isn't what I expected. Considering my other friends took Chem 122 and told me that the professor is making the class way too difficult is very telling. The exams are way difficult than they seem to be, and the professor tends to throw curve balls in the exams putting in content that we learned only for a minute. Exams are worth a lot...

Barely goes over important concepts, passive aggressive, mock exams are not similar to the exam at all, homework website is not helpful. Feel extremely unprepared for the gen chem 2, the worst professor I've had.

Minimal math involved, so if you're taking this class as an engineer who's good at math and not theories, you're cooked. He's very willing to answer questions, even the ridiculous ones. There are almost no grades for the class until the end of the semester. Mock exams are inaccurate, so study up. Overall, some issues, but not a bad professor.

He isn't bad at all, open to talk about anything. Main focus is theoretical and less math. Pay attention during lec, many of the topics tie into each other and are mentioned many times in the semester. He doesn't focus on the math at all, u will need to study outside of the lec, as it is included in the exams. Exam is harder than mock exam.

This class is very difficult, the prof does not grade the homework until the end of the semester, so we don't know what our grade is. There are also no sources to use to study for the tests beside the mock exams which are not accurate at all. Overall its just a very stressful class.

Please don't take this professor, I sacrifice my grade/GPA and a whole semester just to fail. Grading sucks, took him a whole semester to grade the homework. You would have no idea what you're going to get on the homework till the end of the semester, and if you're failing, good luck; there is nothing you could do. Please don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I like him he is nice the class isnt as bad as people say unless u did not take chem 101 he teaches more theory than math base which is why i feel its easier but when he goes over math problem he doesnt do a good job also, the hw he gives is annoying but its for participation grade also mock exam feels easier than real exam but pay attention.

He's an actual good person and seems really helpful if you go out of your way to ask for help. My only problem is the exams. They're way more different than the mock exams he gives us and they seen to be harder, especially the second exam. I don't even know how to study for this class anymore because of the curveballs he throws at us in exams
The lectures are genuinely not helpful. The exams had information that wasn't in the lectures.
to be honest he was just bad. like really bad, he never taught. he went on anecdotes
Truly such an awful experience, cannot speak for everyone's experience but mine was horrible.
He doesnt put grades until the end of the semester, and whatever we learn in lecture is not on the test, and the tests arent anything you can prepare for changed the curriculum
his teaching style is bad why did he change the curriculum bc now this makes no sense why are we doing a complete different way than other chem 122 classes

Professor Carmel was an amazing teacher. He genuinely cares about his students, and if you go into his office during office hours, he doesn't make you feel stupid. He tries to understand you and connects chemistry topics with aspects of your life so that they make sense. Would recommend him to anyone.

As this course may be difficult to teach, I thought Carmel did a nice job. This course is very homework-heavy with lots of assignments every week, but it adds up at the end. The practice and lectures seemed very easy compared to the exams but if you practice processes, you'll be fine. Carmel had a very interesting lecture and was easy to listen to.

at the beginning he seemed very enthusiastic and very nice but as time went on, it seemed as a front. He takes pages from the book to make his lecture slides. Makes easy questions on review guides, and then makes the questions on exams hard to understand. Also says things won't be on the exam then they pop up.

Dr. Carmel did his best to teach the subject, which is obviously a very difficult one. He was not clear with a lot of things tho & sped thru the material. He was also not the friendliest person; he acted as if students were bothering him if they asked him a question. HW every week, & 4 exams including a final. There's also quizzes every few weeks.
Super confusing course setup of the course, Very difficult to navigate and instructions unclear.

Her lectures were interesting, but the assignments were poorly organized and instructions were often unclear, so read everything carefully. She and her TAs can be a bit mean 🫣. Do the insights! it's the same questions every time, and easy points plus extra credit. The 3hr class can be rough, but you'll be fine (I hope). Good luck (u will need it)

The class is graded only by a few things. During this class, it's always the students who are teaching. She is very passionate, though. The exams are complicated, and they often involve literal details from 40+ slide PowerPoint presentations. There are only 100 points in the class, so every point matters, which can be stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall the class was easy to understand and there are only a couple of major projects that count towards the final grade.  The professor is nice and approachable but does tend to yap and being there for three hours sometimes doesn't seem necessary (they will not end the class early). The TA's are mean and ruin the vibe. Textbook is free tho.

I'm not sure why she has such a low rating. Yes, she talks a lot, but she's extremely resourceful and so smart. You can tell she loves her job from the way she shares stories. She is a tough grader and does require mandatory attendance, but she's also very understanding and flexible if you communicate with her promptly.

took this async for degree credit, professor makes blackboard confusing, lectures is optional for one day, you have to work in a group and it is the worst, you have two-three assignments a week but they do offer extra credit, pretty easy to get credit for the degree requirement.

Really unclear instructions about assignments and hardly talks about them in class until right before or after they are due. Also, both her and her TAs are judgemental. If you give an incorrect answer in class, she will make a face. She goes on tangents and honestly, two of the classes she just put on lectures from other professors the entire time.

One of the worst professors I've ever had. She and her ta's are rude and judgmental. Unclear instructions, unnecessarily long lectures, and can get political when talking. The class is dysfunctional, disengaging, and can be very strict with grading, even for the simplest assignments. Do not recommend taking this class. I have more to say.

This class was from 3:30-6:15 and the entire time she talked and honestly none of it made sense. I felt like I did not learn anything. Her, Joanna Michel, and the TA never responded to emails. They also gave us random article assignments that did not benefit us in anyway. They showed attitude and were not accommodating. I have so much more to say.

She is honestly one of the worst professors I have actually seen at UIC. I have never seen a professor give so much authority to her TAs to the point where she looks at them for a response about when an assignment is due or how to turn it in. It feels like the TAs basically run the class; they are very rude and judgmental. Not worth it, 100 level.

Can be a tough grader (especially for writing), and has a tendency to go on long tangents during lectures, but is incredibly knowledgeable in public heath and can be an excellent resource if you pay attention and participate. Also a half-decent comedian. I was not a fan of her at first, but after a few courses with her she has grown on me a lot.

I really liked the class overall but it did not need to be so long. Dr. Castillo is an extremely intelligent person who is very passionate about what she teaches, but the class is so dysfunctional. The class always had a lot of questions about the assignments but Dr. Castillo would never set time aside to answer them.

Very knowledgeable in Public Health and has good anecdotes about her experience. That being said, she does not know how to work technology and is hard on students with LOA's. She is older and I don't know if she has properly been briefed about disability law. Very rude via email and disrespectful.

reviews.comment: Don't listen to the haters about this class. All major assignments explained in syllabus, do them all at your own pace. Getting started early will help in the long run. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Jonathan Daly is a joke of a professor, and, honestly, a joke of a educator. You would think that someone who has been an educator for someone as long as Daly would care, but this is clearly not true. It seems like Daly has taken the year off to go write more ridiculous textbooks that he can peddle to his students, as his TA's are doing everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Jonathan Daly is a shining example of what not to be as a professor. He is lazy, apathetic, and more absent than the students he "teaches". The semester I took his class was by far the worst semester I have ever had in my many years of education. There was no original content posted, no work graded by him, and no clear instructions provided.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: tbh, he assigns hella busy work. I get it is a 100 level class but 2 major papers due on the same day is a little ridiculous. Like we are in the middle of a pandemic, have some sympathy. Don't waste your time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: He's been teaching at UIC since 1992. Yet, the quality of this class is akin to that of a for-profit online school or correspondence. He is totally absent from the discussion board but requires weekly answers and responses to textbook historical questions, delivers no live lectures, assigns major papers due on the same day. Not worth the tuition!
If you want to succeed, read the emails, and listen to the lectures online. And there you go! He's a good teacher and good at answering questions. The class is really engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: As long as you put some effort in all the assignments, you should do fine in the class. I'm like the worst writer and did majority of my assignments the day it was due, and I still got full credit on my assignments, including the two essays and map project.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Daly is a pretty cool guy. While taking his online class we had a couple of papers that we needed to write. If you email him and ask for his input he responds very quickly and tells you exactly what to fix to get an A. He's super nice but grades pretty tough if you're in the 8-week course. The 16-week course gets TAs. Overall he's great!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Daly is not that bad, history could be boring but he is willing to help you. Everything is posted online (lecture slides), there's no exam at all. Only quizzes that are due at the end of the semester, 3 papers and a map project. They are duable and not that difficult, overall is an easy A, if you finish the assignment on time.
Do not take this class unless you are obsessed with history. It is very tedious and heavy workload especially for an online 100 level history class. Unless history is your major, avoid this class

This class is a lot of work, way too much work for such a short period of time. He gives so much material you don't have time to learn it and do everything mechanically. The book is very boring makes even the most exciting topics not readable. Unless you are obsessed with history and history is your main life focus DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!

This is an online class and it is very easy. There are 14 online quizzes and discussion posts and they are quite easy. There is also a map project, and two papers due at the end of the semester, however, they are due at the end of the semester. As long as you stay on top of everything, this class is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: So i took the online HIST105 and it's not a hard class if you just put EFFORT in. If you don't get an A, I honestly don't know how you could do that. The only thing you have to do if read the book and write your weekly response and do a quiz too. There are projects too, but don't wait till the end. I stayed up all night doing them, not a fun time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This class was a mess from start to finish. We have to do a quiz and a discussion board each week, a map project (that was a lot more work than the actual paper), a 1-2 page paper, and a 5 page paper. The requirements sound easy but the way the course is set up makes everything complicated and to get decent feedback is difficult to get.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Easy class. Quiz and discussion board due every week plus a primary source analysis, a map project and an analytic essay due at the end of the semester. GET AN EBOOK! MAKES SEARCHING FOR QUIZ ANSWERS EASY!

So this is an online class. There's a lot of work. There's 14 assignments, a map project (which takes hours), and an essay. He makes everything due at the end of the semester so the work piles up. He offers a lot of extra credit options. The class is easy but very TIME CONSUMING!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The professor was alright, very little interaction with him, but the class is really difficult to get through if you're not up to devoting a lot of time to it. I don't recommend this class at all to anyone unless you're super hype about History and agree with Western Imperialism.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: All you need is the book (this is an online course so all you need to do is read and take quizes online). He gives extra-credit (take advantage if you can). You have no mid term exams (just a final paper). TA is very helpful and helps you format a good paper. You also have a map project due as well (fairly easy). Don't need to go to lectures.
Online class and was kinda annoying, but fairly easy. I would recommend for understanding the past gen ed.
Easy A. Just need your book for the paper and reviewing for the quizzes.  Has a lot of extra credit opportunities, so make use of them. Responds to emails right away and is very helpful.

Fairly easy class. No exams because its an online class. There is a weekly quiz or chapter summary. Need to do online discussions. The book is required for this class as there is nothing else given out. You cannot pass the class without the book. There are 2 easy 5-page papers. He gives many extra credit opportunities. Great class!

Professor Daly and his TA are incredibly helpful and polite. However, his book is very biased! The class is an easy A. Just keep up with the assignments. No need to read the book (just skim it). Show up to discussion because it counts for points. Easy class..

Knowledgable, yet some of his information is questionable, which is not a problem because you can write one of the 2 required papers questioning something he said and proving him wrong. The class requires work but he is helpful. He is also obsessed with technology and that comes to your benefit as there are many resources online

Had him twice (Rise of the West, Russian Revolution) - awesome teacher, knows his stuff, very approachable, very interesting, and get this...he allows for open and honest debate.  He understands that a university is where students are supposed to learn how to think, not what to think.  Sad that educators like Prof. Daly are such a rarity.
He was great.. just listen to the lecture and he posts so many resources to use online. He's definitely one I'll take again in the future.
He's very enthusiastic about history, very knowledgeable. Pretty easy class if you read the lectures. Just know terms for the tests.

Great teacher and very smart. His power points are very good and detailed yet there is soooo much reading in this class. If u are lazy, avoid. Hes a super cool teach. Gives 2 papers, if u get an A on the first u get an automatic A on the sec. (how awesome!) the mid term and final are hard bc u have to write a lot about 7pgs from memory! Great class

Bright, but awkward. Knowledgeable, and an authority in the field, especially of Russian History. His classes are challenging, but engaging, and he is not afraid to read a draft on a 20-page research paper and give you extensive advice. A great professor, all in all.

He's a very interesting and knowledgeable professor. He's a fair grader and very helpful. If you dislike this man, it must mean you are hard person to deal with. He's very approachable and more than willing to help his students. This does not mean it's an easy class, you have to work you butt off!

He is an incredible professor with extensive knowledge in the field (from Harvard). The class itself is incredibly easy, I go to a lecture once in a blue moon, and just go to discussion once a week for 50 minutes. Nice guy, he seems like he would help you as much as you needed.

Really great guy, very communicative and available though I don't think people talk to him as much as they should.  The textbook is super-readable and his presentation of Russian history is very, very balanced.  Do the extra credit, it's incredibly easy!

2 exams, 2 papers and a map project. Easy class. The exams are overwhelming because you need to write a lot. You know the exam before you go in so just be broad and know your outline. Went to class a few times but it really isn't necessary. He even offers 5 point e.c. (in a 100 pt class). The class was majority A's and B's. TAKE HIM!

I took this class as credit/no credit so I only attend about 2 or 3 times lectures.  But I got 79.5% overall.  B- on both exams ( which i just cram the lecture slides about 1 or 2 hours before exams), C and B+ on the 2 papers, C on map project( i finished it in 15mins).  Overall, you have to be damn stupid to not get at least a B in this class.

Pretty straight forward class.  Daly covers a lot of ground so reading the book and going to lecture really help. Provides great study tools like an outline of course, lecture powerpoints (with music), and he also records his lectures and post them online as well.  You can tell he really loves what he is teaching.  2 papers, 2 exams, 1 map project.

This guy is SO BORING. I love history and I'm majoring in it but he makes me want to go to sleep whenever he talks. Also his exams are stupidly impractical: you have to condense what he takes 160 pages to write in his book into a few pages in 50 minutes. Avoid at all costs.

Very boring but really into his job. Provides a refreshing view of West Civ instead of the usual "the West is greedy and evil" stuff that is so popular. Also seems to be a genuinely nice man. Tests were a little much content wise but are passable if you study.

Lectures are BORING!!! but he loves what he's teaching.  Class was rather easy considering i didnt really read at all. Two 5 page papers, one geography quiz (EASY!), 2 exams(pretty easy if you just go to class and take a little notes).  I got a B in the class, and class was easy, but I wouldnt take him again b/c lecture was boring. T.A. sucked!!!

Lectures can be somewhat boring, but you can really tell he enjoys what he's teaching. The exams might seem a little overwhelming at first, but they're really not if you study.He's a very good professor.
SOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO BORING his powerpoints are BOOKS he does not know how to be interesting at all.
Very balanced view of the touchy subject of communism.

He is a great prof. He is very interested in what he is teaching. 3 papers and 2 exams. Attendance in lectures isnt mandatory, but it does help. Exams are essay and ID's. He gives u a huge list and gives u a few topics from the list forcing you to over-study. But at least he gives u a list! i would take another class anyday by him!
He's a pretty awesome teacher. not creepy at all. Helps with the final paper and with sources. He's willing to extend deadlines for people that need it. just go to class and you're set.

He is a great prof. You don't NEED to go to lectures but they will really help you with you papers. He is a great lecturer, you can really tell he enjoys what he is teaching. The papers and exams are huge. Study for them! but he really cares about his students and the course he's teaching. Great prof!

He thinks that you have no other classes besides his class. I spent the whole semester reading and writing for his class. He treats all the students as if we were graduate students. His grading is really hard and subjective.

This guy is a pretty good professor of history, he has an outstanding CV. The tests are very easy to prepare for and he seems very reachable and accomadating to questions. He definitely dominates his lectures, which is important, you don't really want a professor who isn't willing to lead his class. Go to class to learn, not to get test questions.

dr. daly was really nice and a really good teacher.  he gave everyone in the class every test question we could be asked on the first day and he was an easy grader. as long as you go to class and read the material the tests are really easy too. honestly the history class i took in 8th grade was harder than this
Definitely Avoid Him. Enough Said.

I am a teaching of history major and this is the only teacher that i have encountered that i would strongly advise avoiding, mostly becuase the TA that he had with him in the Fall 05 was not from this planet.  If he didn't allow her within thousand feet of the classroom he would be a okey professor.  Easy quiz and final but midterm needed more time

His lectures are interesting, but they do not help with the essay exams. He thinks that everybody is a historian, so he doesn't really explain different topics. He shows a lot of powerpoint slides that are more like Art History rather than History. I do not recommend this professor to anybody. Definitely avoid him.

Was very interesting to listen to and to hear what he had to say about different topics, but one would leave the lecture learning nothing. This didn't help with the essay exam that were given in a 50 minute period and needed to be 5 pages longs.
He is so confusing, he has essay exams and expects you to write the entire history of a word. The papers are easy but the exams are tricky, I would avoid him if possible.
No Comments
No Comments

This class was really easy.  Prof Daly provides guidelines for the exams and the papers that are required in class, so if you follow these you will totally ace this class.  As for his obsession with Russia, this is his area of expertise and that is why he constantly talks about it, not because he is a Commie.
well you dont really have to attend lectures to do good in this class...he only gives like 3 papers and 2 tests..so do good on em! hes weird but the class isnt too hard...boring guy!

He is kinda creepy. His lectures are monotonous and boring. He has strange music in his lectures and is very obsessed with Russia. He seems more like he should be an art teacher than a history teacher with all the paintings and music in his communist lectures.

The content in the course is pretty easy to understand, which takes some of the burden off the professor. He does post his lecture notes after class, so you don't need to attend lectures to keep up with the material. I attended some lectures, but it became a waste of time. He sometimes handwrites exams, and his handwriting isn't the best. Good prof

Genuinely, the easiest STATS will get. He provides a lot of flexibility and is super caring. Quizzes are online, discussion worksheets, and homework due every week, but not hard at all. Attendance is taken through acadly. He drops your lowest 2 quiz scores, discussion worksheets, and 5 attendances. It's hard not to pass this class.

Failed this course, but was my fault. I was going though a difficult time and let myself fall. He's honestly a great prof and very understanding. Just pay attention and make sure to quiz yourself so you understand the material. Great guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great professor, decently difficult class.
take stat outside of uic

Sometimes he'll stare you down a bit and crack jokes, but nothing wild. I honestly didn't notice it much. He doesn't pick on anyone, he's pretty chill and helpful when you need it. Low-key, if you just do the discussion sheets, you'll be fine.

He's a good professor. The class and material are boring, but he's easy-going and considerate. He actually cares about the material too and teaches excitedly every day. The quizzes are based off homework so just make sure you know when they are, they're easy to study for.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Genuinely the best stats professor ever I enjoyed his lectures so much. he's such a nice caring guy super flexible and really wants to help if you ask. Attendance is mandatory but he drops 8 of them. a lot of homework but it's really not that hard as long as you keep up you'll be fine

He was really nice but a bit awkward. His lectures weren't bad but it was just kind of hard to focus. All the lecture notes were on online. The exams will be really hard if you don't study but he puts a good curve on them and the attendance gives you 5% extra credit on the exam
Extremely good and very knowledgable professor who doesn't mind answering your questions. If you're lucky enough to have him, you can do well on the exams by just keeping up with the lectures.

He answers questions thoroughly. His lectures may be boring, but that is due to the content and not the professor himself. His grading is fair, and he assigns a normal amount of homework with normal difficulty.

This class has great resources - the prof's lectures are clear, and the unlimited-attempt homework on Sapling is super helpful. unstuck ai was a game-changer for review and practice. Overall, a straightforward course with an approachable professor.

Terrible. His method of lecturing involves printing out stacks of paper and drawing circles, arrows. Even though the class is programming heavy, he rarely if ever runs the code. Class is very uncollaborative even on worksheets and he did nothing to help. Extremely unsympathetic to students struggling even if you go to office hours everyday.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Honestly, I have no complaints. All his expectations are straightforward. Participation isn't mandatory, but if you come to class enough, you'll get extra credit on the exams. Up till the first exam, the material is stuff I learned in middle school. The rest of it is more difficult, but if you take notes and do the homework, you'll be fine.

Prof Embers was awesome! He knows how to teach, so I had no problem understanding any of the material. The lectures can get boring sometimes, so I recommend that you sit closer to the front so you can focus better. He is super funny, PLEASE LAUGH AT HIS JOKES. Tests are also straightforward & you get 3 drops on the HW. Almost impossible to fail.
I took the asynchronous section, overall this class was pretty simple but lots of reading, I would rather prefer lectures
Really good professor for STAT 382 would highly recommend. Very good lecturer and solid lecture notes.

I got an A because he knows how to teach. The only thing I didn't like was that you had to take a 2 hour discussion section with stat 101 that was useless, but that is out of his control. He is great. You'll have no problem learning and getting an A.
He is just a really great lecturer, fun guy and great person outside of the class. His lecture note is very easy to understand if you understand statistics. Doable exams if you studied.

I wasn't a big fan of Prof Embers because I felt like I wasn't learning, just sort of repeating various formulas he showed. This class is the epitome of busy work since we are graded on a lot of things. However, there is room to make mistakes and the take home unit exams were very easy. Set some time aside and look through posted lecture notes.
Very challenging course, but prof explains concepts really well. You better take this class with him, since he is the best!
One of my fave teachers at UIC so far. Lectures aren't mandatory, but you will want to go because his examples are so funny.
attendance is optional but definitely helps. He is super fun and his examples are hilarious. Overall a great class (except for discussion sessions with TAs), highly recommend.

Embers is fantastic at explaining concepts or topics in an easily understandable way. He also comes across as a very nice and caring guy. I took him for STAT382 which did not require attendance so most students (including myself) did not attend lecture. It wasn't because of the prof, it just felt like a class that could easily be done remotely

The professor has attendance as extra credit, and all his notes are very useful for homework and projects. We have 2 projects and 2 exams, and then the final. He does write very quickly but still posts the scanned lecture notes.

Easiest class I have taken at UIC. The lectures go perfectly with the homework and exams. The first half of the class is things you should've learned in 7th grade and the rest will take a little more effort to understand. Professor is super straightforward and helpful outside of class. He uses fun examples and always answers questions. Easy A.

He gives me a weird-awk vibe but is a nice teacher. He won't be the teacher you have a connection w though. He writes fast ngl but lectures are recorded. Tests cover a lot of material, there's only too but the second one has the hardest concepts to grasp. Literally copy what he writes in your notes. It's best to have a ti84 but you can manage w/o.

This guy is great! Never have I felt so reassured on topics I was confused on after going to his office hours, where he provides thorough help in a way that's easy to understand. His lectures are well formatted and he has a slight sense of humor which makes them more bearable to attend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Embers is by far the best professor I have had at UIC so far (second year). He is really lenient and understanding, and makes the course easy. There's 3 pieces of homework a week, but they're really easy, and a few exams that are doable if you do the homework and pay attention to lecture. He is happy to help students and he's funny.
The lecture videos were good and informative. Keep track of the due dates for assignments.

I thoroughly enjoyed Dale for this course. I also had him for STAT382 a few semesters ago, and in both cases, he taught the material very well and his exams stuck to what he taught us in class. Lectures can be a bit dry, but still quite good. I took 475 to prep for Exam FM and passed it thanks to Dale. He's very knowledgeable and a great resource
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: His lectures are easy to understand and the sapling homework provides unlimited attempts. The quizzes are easy and straight to the point.

Completely does not understand the meaning of empathy and shares none with his students. In a time where people are going through tough times with this pandemic he showed zero care for what his students were going through. I felt belittled by him at times and felt like he was being too hard on me. I would never take a class with this guy again.

Embers designs courses very well. The coding lectures have a clear goal and the homework and projects are aligned extremely well. He stops throughout the lecture for questions. The grading criteria of the course is very clear. He made learning R enjoyable. He's also a very fast grader and a nice person. Excellent professor.

This class was not difficult in terms of concepts. The quizzes were VERY straight forward. There was a lot of homework but some had unlimited tries, making it easier. Professor gives clear lectures on everything you need to know. This class is very applicable for all futures so enjoy it!

Very good professor, always able to help through email even if you can't make it to office hours. Notes are precise and homework/projects are similar to notes. Final project is assigned group. There are pop quizzes (not scary). Amazing guy

This professor goes out of his way to help students during class and outside of class. He always attempts to put his students first and has great lectures that cover the material for this class in simple terms. The exams are based off the material and if you study at least a day beforehand, getting an A is easy. Weekly quizzes are also very easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lecture is pretty dull but clear. Honestly kind of a weird dude but hes pretty chill. Exams are super easy-homework is harder than exams. Gives an equation sheet with literal explanations of what they are on exams and final.

He always tries to simplify his explanations by using real-life examples. The lectures are pretty dull, but he tries to be funny here and there. If you miss any lectures, there's always the lecture captures that are available online. The three lowest quizzes and homework (with unlimited attempts) are dropped so it's very chill.

I'm not that good at math but Embers taught Stats very well. His jokes and weird examples contributed to my learning and I remembered a lot. I didn't have a hard time completing homework or doing quizzes. Even if I was having a hard time, he emphasized being accessible for help as well as some TAs. Very awesome professor!

Mr. Embers is very considerate and has a good sense of humor. His teaching style is a good example for other teachers to emulate! Clear class expectations, unlimited homework attempts and a note-heavy lecture really helped me to understand and actually learn statistics. The key to passing his class is to show up and be present
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Probably the best class I've taken. The Sapling homework has infinite attempts for full credit and all the content taught in class follows the book, so it's a breeze to look back again for help. The class gets kinda dull as problems get complex, but study a little and actually try the Sapling, you'll do fine. I wish more of my profs were like him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's an amazing professor. Just come to class , pay attention. the exams are easier than the quiz

Don't take him if math is not your thing. He's passionate about statistic but is really hard to understand him cause the way he talks. Lecture notes heavy, never stop taking notes. The homework and quiz are rough so are the exams. Is one of the classes that you just have to teach yourself

He's somewhat unapproachable; can be distracting. Hw is time-consuming. Good study guides. His hw and quizzes are harder than his exams. Read, practice, and memorize formulas for them. Hard final. Lectures can be boring but he cracks funny jokes. Easy and small excel projects. Gives some extra credit. Will round you up if you're in between grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Embers is a good choice for taking STAT 101. He's funny, and he manages to make the material understandable and mostly relevant for the humanities majors who are required to take the course. The exams are quite fair and the grading criteria in general (drop lowest 3 quizzes, lowest 3 homeworks) are pretty generous. Would recommend.

The first time you meet him you can tell he's a total math nut! But that's a compliment! He is super intelligent in his field, and a genius in my opinion. ASK QUESTIONS in lecture, people complain because they dont ask questions!. PLEASE if you are having a hard time, go to his office hours, he is great for 1 on 1 teaching. and MAKE SURE you study!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Very unapproachable and was unable to provide me a good experience in his class. I did not understand his way of teaching, he forces you to write pages of notes for the whole lecture and most of the time, he is incomprehensible. The class is seemingly easy but gets excruciatingly difficult. He will not round up. Only take him if you have patience.

Hes nice and tries to help his students understand but sometimes just rambles which can confuse students at least he confused me a lot. I personally hate anything with math. Dont underestimate the course its easy at first but does get more difficult. We have quizzes and hw every week and drops the 3 lowest quizzes and 3 lowest homework scores.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HIM. He will not curve and he is really confusing. n ot a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great professor. Funny and constantly encourages students to ask questions. Fair grader. Class expectations were very clear.

Here's the basic rundown about Dale, he's a weird guy who loves math. He's kinda geeky which makes the class a bit cringy, but it's bearable by the end. His homework and tests are basically from his powerpoints, so studying isn't bad if you can memorize it all. The final is harder though, and that's how I lost my A. You need to study to get that A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: AMAZING
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: First of all I want to say that this professor is OKAY. He is an amazing person and has amazing example but can get confusing at times. He does not do any extra credit and will NOT curve your grade. You fail, then you fail and he won't change anything. However, he does make it clear that he has office hours and who ever needs help needs to look4 it
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great class. Dont believe the people saying its hard because it really isnt, they just dont want to take the time to study. And this class doesnt even require a lot of studying, if you attend lectures everything should come easy. Exams were also pretty easy. Literally if you do your homework and at least study a little bit you should get a A.

People here say that he is a good professor and gives clear explanations. I could not disagree more. He does lots of examples, but he is terrible at explaining what hes doing. He also goes so ridiculously fast and mumbles the entire time that he is teaching. Could not stand him as a professor. Do yourself a favor and avoid him entirely
Pretty good, 30% of the class gets an A. Lectures are clear, but discussion is more confusing than helpful.
Don't take him if you're in CS. Just take IE with Quintin instead.

Professor Dale is good. He gives good example but at times can get really confusing . His lectures are confusing at times. I would not choose him again . But that it just my opinion. Other people have other ways of understanding things. Dale seems like he puts all his efforts for the well being of his students but his lectures are just not for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The course is fairly easy, and the professor does an excellent job teaching the material. If you happen to miss a class, his whole lecture can be seen on blackboard because he records all his lectures.

Stats is a hard subject, but Professor Embers teaches it very well. Lectures are clear and simple, but don't fall behind because they build up. Attendance is crucial. Exams are not tricky, but it's easy to trip up so pay close attention to what he says in class. He may seem a bit cheeky and unapproachable but he is definitely a great professor.
One of the most amazing math professors at UIC, way better than the one I had for Math 110
Hes super funny gives great examples, the homework is fairly easy, only 3 tests. they are not anything new you get alot of practice. Good proffesor
Best Math Teacher hands down!!! HE is awesome! explains very well, and is nice to talk to outside of class! I wish I could have him for 165
Really funny and knows his stuff. Try to do well on the midterms because our final exam was hard and I ended up losing my A.

Dr. Embers is an amazing lecturer! He is very funny and makes calculus very fun and interesting. He is very helpful during office hours. He explains things very thoroughly. Sometimes examples are just like the homework but sometimes they aren't, so it's up to you to go to his office hours or review the topic more. Would take him again!

Dale is hilarious. His lectures are great and his humor keeps it interesting. Attendance is "mandatory". It's run through learning catalytic and the question most of the time is just to click "yes" for attendance. Here are the pros from this class: 1. communication is very clear and well paced, key ideas are spoken with some emphasis i.e. you will not have to worry about a poor communicated lecture; just pay attention to the lecture. 2. class load is pretty low, we had 4 HW's and 2 MT but HW is easier than MT. 3. Grading was chill Cons: material is tedious..
Hey guys in short he is tough grader and his lecture is boring just reading the material through out the whole class. check other professors

He taught exclusively off of his notes from the screen. Lectures were very boring, and very difficult to follow along. His exams sometimes contained examples directly from the slides, or from the book. If you read the book, and look at lecture slides before exam you're solid. He gave a heavy curve at the end because everyone was failing.

Overall good professor.

Very bad course delivery - reads slides in class that too only half the semester, and grades are random too. No transparency in grading. Takes fun out of an interesting course. Would never recommend.
Nothing to learn in this course

Brutal exams. He does try his best to answer any questions but that only goes so far. Followed book closely, and didnt use any examples out of the book which i didnt like. I always ended up teaching myself from UIUC's course notes and homeworks. Homework is not a good representation of the exams either.

Lectures are all posted on website. Home works are programming and they hog a lot of time but you get loads of time to finish. The grading is fair. Final Exam was, lets put it this way, unexpected and horrible to begin with but if you studied the notes, you will not turn in an empty answer sheet.

He goes slow in his explanation. Okay I like it. Its an Algorithms class and it gives me time to think and come up with my own ideas, so that way we get to participate. Exams are okay. Homeworks are okay. He is very clear in his explanation. Overall a good prof.

Very organized.  Followed textbook very closely.  Tests were hard but fair, and he was responsive when it seemed that first midterm was maybe too hard.  Much HW, but helpful.  Answered questions thoughtfully and patiently, was accessible outside class.  Maybe showed some favoritism by addressing only some students by first names. Reasonable curve.

If you take her course for 160 just make sure you are communicating with her and showing effort and interest in improvement. Participation is key. She might be a tough critic but honestly it sets you up for future courses.
her criticism is hard but shes willing to help if you ask for it

Dawn is an amazing professor who truly cares about her students. Her feedback can be tough, but it's always meant to help you improve. Please run away

Professor Joseph did a fine job in the spring. Her teaching methods were clear and organized. The steps towards an end of a project were easy to follow, especially with her guidance. Became one of my most dreaded classes. She has clear favorites and often picks on certain students/outright ignores them as much as possible during work time. Tough grader who sometimes cannot even back up how she graded like she did, giving unclear instructions on how to improve. There are other professors who are much more helpful.

Dawn is the most dismissive, condescending professor I have ever had. The way her students fear her makes it so difficult to ask questions honestly and learn from mistakes. Hard to please if you don't appeal to her personal taste. Interesting assignments but  gives feedback that is hard to follow. Difficult to impress or please. Very narrow minded. The work environment was stressful and uncomfortable, and group critiques weren't constructive. Glad it's over.

She took forever to grade, never answered emails and was quite narrow minded when reviewing students work. She expects perfection from beginner level designers. She is the type of teacher who makes you want to quit. Luckily I won't. I would suggest another professor if you can help it.
Tough grader, tough to impress in general. Don't take her class if you're not good taking pictures or just not into photography in general lol. Doesn't answer emails, sees but never answers.
Dawn can be a tough instructor to please at times, but she will work with you to help you improve. She also provides deadlines to revise old work for better grades.
I created an account just so I could write a nice review about Professor Fagan. The most well rounded and educated professor UIC has to offer. Easy to talk to and a fantastic speaker.

UIC greatest POLS professor! He's so caring and willing to accept late work if you communicate. He lets you miss up to 7 days without penalty. I don't usually rate professors, but he is truly the best professor at UIC, ( and because he mentioned his mom reads these, your son is the BEST!) Take Professor Fagan, you will not be disappointed!

Omg, I loved having Professor Fagan! I highly recommend his class to anyone. He is super well informed and his lectures are so engaging. Homework is light, I never felt overwhelmed. He sends you a free online textbook and he sets you up for success. Attendance is optional, but you will get the most from going. 10/10 professor.

Fagan is extremely knowledgeable about political science but makes the class so much fun. Assignments are straightforward and he's always available for discussion about them. Really helpful if you get sick and need an extension, too!

I highly recommend taking this class as an introduction to political science! Attendance isn't mandatory for the lectures but I suggest going as they are really engaging and interesting. He was very sweet and understanding. He was reasonable with assigning work and I never felt overwhelmed. Lectures were a lot of information but nothing crazy.

He absolutely knew what he was talking about. Not too many grades (3 essays, 20% each, two/three short responses, 10% each, and one take-home final, 20%). Attendance isn't mandatory, but going and taking notes with the lectures helps sm. He posts the slides, but you learn way more and easier in class. He is super understanding and accommodating!
I liked him a lot he speaks clearly and answers all questions. He sets you up for success and after that it is on you to do well. I slacked off a bit but anyone can do well in his class if you try

Dr. Devi was an amazing professor whom I've ever met. Her lecture was very clear and engaging. Dr. Devi, take her for any math courses she has. She genuinely loves teaching math and straight up the best.

This woman is genuinely an angel, she wants us to actually understand the concepts and its one of the first times I've fully understood what I'm doing in math. You have been warned, don't take this professor

Great professor. She genuinely cares about her students and wants you to pass. Her lectures are not boring at all, and she keeps you engaged. Super easy class, definitely take her.

I actually forgot to post this but I took her in the summer and she was AMAZING. really wants you to succeed. super clear, repeats herself always and her handwriting and notes are great which sounds like something normal but so hard to find in a world of messy handwriting mathematicians who don't color-code their work. if she's an option TAKE HER

Shes a really good instructor but I had her online so she would be kind of pushy on responding to her in the chat and she would get mad when we wouldnt, mind you we were taking notes… but overall a good professor.
She is such an amazing prof, the way she teaches makes any topic easier. All Quizzes and exams are based on the lecture notes, just reworded to make them easier and more understandable.

She's honestly amazing, she's very clear and interactive during her lectures. If you ever have a question, she's got you, she makes you know that. I've never really been good at math but she gave me everything I need to succeed, especially for the exams. Definitely recommend taking her course!

THE BEST!!! You can tell that she cares so much about actually TEACHING the math. She is strict in lectures, but it's for your own benefit. One of the best professors out there.

she's the best math prof on campus if she taught every math class id be a comp sci major. her lectures are always packed bc she KNOWS HOW TO TEACH SO WELL. I love this woman. taker if u can. her exam review is amazing too.

Great professor, quick pace, so all she asks is to pay attention to lectures. She is very forward about what you need to study for exams and quizzes.

Shes very clear when she teaches, she gets straight to the point. No mumbling, no overexplaining. She tells you exactly how to solve the problem. Amazing professor, as someone who thought this class would be difficult, she could explain topics so well, which allowed me to learn a lot. For me, I had to study a fair bit, but I was able to do well within the class. Certainly take her if you can!
One of the best professors at UIC, very talented at teaching math and making sure that you really understand what's being done during lectures.
Professor Devi is a great. She really cares that you succeed in her class. Great lecturer, and the best math professor I've had so far.

She's honestly an amazing professor. Idk how she isn't the course coordinator for math 165, she's so much more organized and helpful than the course coordinator is. Shes really sweet and nice. Best math 310 professor I wouldn't doubt shes the best for other math courses as well. Attendance is mandatory but goes by fast lots of material is covered in such a clean and understanding way.

Professor Devi has been my favorite professor. She is very passionate for this course and cares about her students passing the class. Professor Devi is one of the few professors I have had that actually cared about teaching her students for their own benefits in the real world and future as opposed to just a grade. LOVED HER CLASS. Amazing lectures that were easy to understand! I respect her sm and she cares.

Professor Devi's impact that she leaves on her students is really noticeable as she is absolutely amazing at what she does. Devi cares for her students and does what it takes, take her

she will forever be my favorite professor. made class so much fun! she has her PHD too PURRR!
