reviews.comment: She's absolutely the best professor ever! She's very funny and really cares about her students. I'm an engineer major and her class was my absolute favorite class. She takes time to get to know her students and help them succeed. The class is a breeze if you took chem 101 (which is what I did). Her exams are pretty fair and she reviews in class.
Her style was very slow, not helpful, better off studying the material via Chem tutuors online.

Her lectures are very engaging, does a lot of practice questions. She can seem a bit short or condescending at times, but I thought she was very funny. If you go to her office hours, she makes a genuine effort to try to get to know you and she will try to remember your name and face. Big curve at the end of the semester. Had her Fall 2025.

She yells at the TA's and doesn't really care about her students (told them to stfu during lecture). Her lectures are extremely boring and the material on the exam is always way harder than what we actually learned. Overall, I wouldn't recommend her but UIC only offers a few chem instructors to choose from
you WILL cry

Many of her ratings are either extremely positive or negative; they are right that she is nice, but the main reason I rated her a 3 is because of the exams. They each had at least one question, worth major points, that the entire class ended up missing. Often the questions on exams are indirectly worded or incorporate concepts from later classes.

She is a really nice professor. Gives lots of resources like tutoring,extra office hours before exams. Go to class! Attendance is worth a lot . Labs are annoying but depends on your TA.  The class is hard its organic chem and gen chem 2, but its easy to pass if you put in work, do your homework, and there's a big curve at the end.

The class was difficult but you get the effort you put in. She was available during office hours, provided practice exams which would be similar or exactly the same as the ones she put on the actual exam. Attending lectures was a must, but she did record lectures. She was very understanding, and allowed me to submit post-lab late for credit.

She was a very kind and bubbly person which made lectures bearable. The content is easy for the first exams, especially if you took CHEM 101, just prepare for the orgo section which lots of people struggled with. Show up, do the work and get the easy points!
Best chem professor at uic. If you read the textbook, attend lecture and do practice problems 122 is an easy A.

dunno why she has such a low rating, but this was specifically for chem 115. 
overall, she was very understanding and helpful. her labs were also really interesting. she gives a lot of study materials to help you prepare for all of the exams.
She loves to pick on students and humiliate them in front their peers during lectures.

easily the best professor for chem 122, gave extensions on assignments and told us exactly what we needed to know for the exams, was very understanding when I got sick and allowed me to still get a grade for the exam, if you read all of the textbook chapters, go to lecture, and do all homework assignments on time, it shouldn't be too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hatfield was a good professor, probably the best at UIC. She offered a lot of extra credit and is so easy to get in contact for office hours. Gives a few points as well at the end.

The negative reviews here are so unwarranted. Hatfield is by far one of the nicest and best chem profs at UIC. No, she won't cover every tiny detail in lecture, that's impossible. Pay attention to her lectures, get confident in the discussion worksheets, put some effort into the homework and you'll get an A. And take advantage of her review sheets!

This is probably one of the best chem professors offered at uic. Her lectures are clear and normally paced. Never once did I feel like her lessons were rushed. The homework workload was pretty standard amongst all of the chem 122 classes.

average chem class, although known for being one of the better chem 122 professors. teaching yourself the lessons was better than listening to the lectures which were boring and repeated from the textbook. only showed up for the clicker attendance and clicker practice questions.

Of all the professor I found her to be the most enjoyable and actually enjoy what she teaches. Her work load was a lot but manageable, you need to attend discussion and if possible try not to miss lecture because you will fall behind so quick. Exam are late and will tank your grade. I dropped because it was getting too much, no way to score an A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really good on teaching! I understood the content so well, and i really believe it was because of the way she teached.

Very nice professor and helpful during office hours. In order to get an A you will most likely have to attend weekly review sessions and rewatch some lectures. Once the learning material goes past HS chemistry it gets more difficult to grasp. Make sure you turn in all of your homework on time and attend TA office hours because the class moves fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I got an A in the class, but with so much effort. She has some decent lecture videos but I had to learn a majority of the class on my own and with peers to help. Everything is asynchronous except discussions. Not that great of a communicator and graded the tests much later than other professors of the course. You have to put in the work to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor gave me so much stress this semester. She gives you way too many assignments; it almost feels like she doesn't realize we have other classes, families to take care of, and jobs to pay for school. I had to neglect the rest of my classes just to focus on hers and I still felt behind and lost. Lectures were long and didn't even help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There is a LOT of content in the class and skipping lectures will not go well. Make sure to put in effort by communicating with professor if you need help. She is very helpful when asked questions. The quizzes are basic and exams do not ask you to know all the details. She gives A LOT of EXTRA CREDIT which really helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Shes knowledgeable but does not know how to teach, she emails important information late and not the best communicator, she does not even reply to emails! I cried everyday of this class. Exams are 10x harder than what she taught. It is like signing up for class and getting mental breakdowns everyday. Definitely not recommended.
You can easily pass the class and get an A if you listen to the lectures, take notes, do the discussion worksheets, and ask for help during office hours. If you put in the work, you will do well.

Worst chemistry professor Ive ever had. All she does is read off of slides and goes on conceptual chemistry tangents that dont even make sense. Only reason lecture is worth attending is she will sprinkle some info of what to expect on exams. Shes nice and passionate, but dont see how thats gonna help you pass. Chem at UIC is literally a joke.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I heard she was the best, but her lectures sucked. She always rushed through the lectures, and it made me feel bad not being able to comprehend anything. Nice person, but didnt know how to pace. Exams were hard, just know to study much in advance!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's a very caring professor and is very helpful in office hours.
She's awesome!
Prof. Hatfield is accessible outside of class. Go to office hours to actually understand the concepts, this will definitely prepare you for exams because she goes over everything you need to know.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: To everyone saying that she cares about her students, let me tell you my story. She didn't let me reschedule the first quiz of the class so I can go to my grandfather's funeral. I literally had to skip half of it just to take a 30 point quiz. Plus she's just impossible to follow, takes her time with the slides a the beginning then rushes at the end

I had Hatfield for chem 122. She is very helpful and informative. She was a great professor its just chem 122 in general is very tough class. She would urge students to use the office hours if you have questions and very helpful in them. Her tests are pretty straightforward whatever you see in the exam pointers you will see on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Expects us to act like grad level students, but makes us put name tags on our desk like preschoolers. Attending lecture is mandatory for a 5% extra credit boost, but real impractical since she all she does is reads off her slides. Book really isn't useful as she claims it is. Learn structures, vocabulary, and be able to explain concepts for the A.
Dr. Hatfield is very caring for her students and very willing to help. Every chemistry course is hard and you will spend most of your time teaching yourself regardless of who your professor is.

The worst professor I have ever had. She spends the first 10 minutes of class talking about absolutely nothing, and the last 10 minutes of class trying to rush through slides. She incredibly hard to follow during lecture. You have to teach yourself, basically. I'm not bad at chem, but I'll probably get a low C in her class if I'm lucky.

Professor Hatfield gives curve. About 85% overall score got an A. She gives review session before each exams and quizzes. She answers all the questions from students after the class, even when she is walking to her office.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: No chem class is going to be easy. These professors have to cram content in 15 weeks so it's always going to feel "rushed". Rita gave a lot of in-class worksheets to help aid us which not all the professors did. She was also very accessible outside of class. Her class averages were also much higher than the other professors and she curves a little.

I took Hatfield because I thought she would be the best choice, but I was wrong. Her tests are really difficult and you will have to read from the book. The tests are very concept heavy and problems can be very challenging. I studied for hours and could not get higher than a C on any of the tests or quizzes. The only good thing is the curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Hatfield is an amazing professor, regardless of what anyone says. A lot of material is gone over in only 15 weeks, so every chemistry professor lectures fast. She is a great professor who commits a lot of her time outside of class in order to help her students. Go to her office hours, they help a lot. She is also an amazing person in general.
She changes slides faster than I change my mind.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr Hatfield is a gr8 professor. Yes, she reads off the slides but makes sure u understand the material and concepts. Gives Lecture worksheets which is a gr8 help for the exms. Ofcourse, chem is not going to be easy, to earn that A you have to work hard. Very caring professor wants the students to succeed. Exms are easy compared to other professors.

The professor pretty much read off the slides. If you are taking CHEM with her, you should just study from the book. Her slides & lectures are kinda worthless. Attendance is mandatory tho which is a bit of an L.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Hatifield was good, her tests were apparently easier than other profs. For her tests- I'd study from the questions at the back of the book and review from the discussion worksheets!

She is the worst professor I have ever seen. She makes attendance mandatory even tho she reads off the slides. She has strict policies on missing discussion. You lose 2 points every time you miss a discussion. I am not saying you get 0, NO, you get a -2. I really dislike her class and I am so glad I won't see her again LOL
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is a great professor however this course was more conceptual than math based. She majority reads off the power points which are derived from the textbook. Rarely goes over problems or teaches how to attempt math based problems. Could be a better class if the lecture was more engaging. Test are majority conceptual so please read the textbook
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hatfield knows what she is teaching, she is an excellent professor but she does read off slides, which she posts online later on the day. She is a bit annoying as she expects so many things on those little desks all at once and continuously going back from notebook to workbook and iClickers. Pretty good teacher.
She explains everything really well and is not strict at all. Quizzes and exams are easier than other professors.

Hatfield is okay. She goes very quick from slide to slide, so prepare to learn the material on your own. The TA isn't helpful either. She doesn't properly explain how to do something. However, Hatfield has great slides and uploads all material in a timely manner. The material that is taught can be easy or hard depending on your effort.

The class covers a lot of material and she does her best to adjust according to what the class needs. I got a C and I know I could have done better but I just did not want to do the work. She posts EVERYTHING you need and more to get an A, and chooses great TAs. Didn't need a textbook because of this.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hatfield was the worst professor I've had at UIC thus far. I learned more from my textbook, youtube videos and peer leaders than I did from her. I just went to class for Iclicker points otherwise I taught myself Chem 101. It was brutal and I only recommend taking her if you can naturally teach yourself an entire class.

this professor reads the slides off of her laptop and expects the class to fully understand what she says. Doesnt walk the students through tough problems regularly. Besides these negatives, shes very accessible outside of class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hatfield is one of the worst teachers I have had in college so far. If you take her class then be ready to learn everything on your own. She reads of slides and when she does any problems she does not go over multiple steps. Her style of teaching is very old and hard. She is so sarcastic in an awful way. I do not recommend this teacher at all.
Honestly not a bad teacher just doesn't show her work and just reads from the slides. Actually study and don't assume same problems will be on the quizzes.

Overall, she's is a great professor but don't expect to get an A just because you go to all the lectures; go to her office hrs, your TA, and peer leading. You need to make sure you have a good grasp on the material to understand CHEM. Also make sure you really try in the sapling b/c it makes a difference when you're in that 89% line

Professor Hatfield is a decent professor for Chem 101. As long as you do your homework and show up to class, you'll pass. You'll lose points on tests for not putting simple stuff like units or not showing your work. You will need an iClicker for this class.
She there to help anyone that needs help after class and she gives you more info and could help you with any subject your struggling one on one.

She's too sarcastic, stops every 5 minutes because someone's talking, picks on students if they're too loud. Lectures are boring, barely bearable, iclickers almost every day so lecture is mandatory, she gives online homework every week, plus extra worksheets in class, and expects you to come into class already have read the chapter.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is the most amazing Chemistry teacher ever! I thought I was bad at Chemistry because I normally get A's and B's and I basically failed Chemistry in high school. I only have our final left and as long as I get a high B or an A (which I have on every exam she's given) I will have an A in her class.  Now, I enjoy chemistry! I will miss her class!

Chemistry might me hard to grasp, especially if your high school teachers didn't do a good job teaching it (which was my case).  I honestly love this professor and i highly recommend you to take her! Her lectures are easy to follow, even when the content gets a bit tricky. TAKE HER IF YOU ARE LUCKY ENOUGH!!!! :) 3
All other Chem 101 teachers make it way harder than it needs to be. Hatfield is good and her TA's are awesome. Lots of time outside of class to learn things.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She gave worksheets that were very useful. I didn't pay attention in lecture and instead did those worksheets a day prior to the quizzes/exam and I never got anything lower than a B. Because this course is fairly easy, it doesn't really matter who the teacher is unless you absolutely can't self teach.

By far one of the best professors I have had at UIC. Super willing to explain hard material and work around student's schedules. If you're having problems she is super kind about it. Rounds grades up!
Lectures are read off powerpoint, very boring overall. Iclickers on wednesdays. TA's cant speak english. Just dont pick her for gods sake.

Go to office hours and get help from the TA's. Read the book! I didn't do too bad in the class but the book helped a lot b/c I didn't really pay attention during lectures. She hints things that would be on tests & quizzes so take note on those things. Nice person, but gets upset when things get out of hand. iclicker/ discuss point saves your grade.

Trust me, she is the best professor you can get for Chem 112. Her tests are definitely the easiest (no one else gives multiple choice, + she gives FREE extra credit sometimes). No matter who you take you have to keep up and make sure you know the material on your own. There's a reason this is the most dropped class at UIC.

Definitely is given more credit than is due. She talks AT the class rather than to the class. She reads off of power points the entire time and does not go the extra step to even attempt to teach the material. It is best that one studies the material on their own because you will not learn the material when you are sitting in her class.

Nice person and  tries to help students but you will have to do a lot of work on your own to really understand the material. She basically reads the slides that's it, even when explaining she reads off the slides. Be prepared to work extra hard and study the text book thoroughly. But do go to her office hrs as she is always willing to help.

This class was more self taught. Hatfield only reads off her slides. She is always there for the students and always has office hours if you have any questions. Quizzes and Exams aren't that bad you just need to know the material well.

I'm not sure how other students learn, but I learn 95% of the material by myself for all my classes. With that being said, I usually read through the book and did practice problems from there to prepare for examsquizzes. I think that method worked well as I crushed every examquiz. Practicalslabs aren't bad either. Some effort should get a B .

Dr. Hatfield is a great professor. Although she reads straight from her slides, she really clarifies the material when someone has a question. Online homework is on the difficult side. But the tests are pretty easy. Iclicker usage counts for participation.
Idk why so many people are complaining. She is a good professor compared to others and her quizzes and exams aren't bad at all. Would def recommend taking her!

Exams were okay in comparison to quizzes, which were written by TAs and very tough. Class is barely curved if you're shooting for a good grade. 89% was an A for us. Professor is nice, helpful, and good at teaching. Class involved a lot of memorization and time outside of class though. Read book for clarity.

1) Grade based on class curve. 85  A 2) Textbooks  Very helpful. Read & take detailed notes for sure. 3) Exams  Assigned homework questions come out. Word by word Everything in lecture counts. Even tiny details 4) HW  Assigned, don't have to 5) Quiz  Difficulty depends on TA, & pop quiz  e.c.

Even though I ended up dropping the class, she was an okay professor. She had plenty of office hours and knew what she was talking about. However she would read her power points word for word. Make sure to do problems from the book because a few of them will end up on the test.

I had her for general chemistry before this so I knew what to expect. She's very fair and down to earth. The exams were pretty challenging but she tells you what you need to know if you go to lecture. She gives tons of extra credit and is very entertaining during lectures. I really enjoyed biochemistry, can't wait for the medical school version.

Dr. Hatfield is great and very easy on students.  Yes, she does read off the lecture slides, which is incredibly boring, but you want to be at lecture for the iclicker points.  Watch out for her inappropriately flirtatious TA Gennadii and know how to do the in-text examples from the book, and you will do well in this class.
She was a phenomenal professor and is very willing to work with you. The class is hard, but an A is very possible. She really cares about her students

Dr. Hatfield is a pretty good teacher overall. Her lectures do get boring since she reads off the power points all the time. If you get all your iClicker points it will really bump up your grade. Shes really understanding and lowest quiz gets dropped. Out of all the chem 112 teachers that were available at the time she was definitely the best.

She's a great professor. Very understanding and easy to talk to. Her grading is reasonable and as long as you study the material-which gets tricky towards the end-you will be good. Make sure to do the online homework because it can pile up.

Hatfield's lectures aren't the most entertaining, but her class is over all easy. She gives practice problems for all of the chapters which help a lot and make the exams and quizzes simple. She's very generous with grading.
She seems okay, but its a lot of materials and she just fly through them. You'll need extra help like TAs and student teachers. Plan on spending extra time for this subject. Good luck.

Had her for biochem and the course is pointless.  If have next to nothing to prepare for the exam except for the book.  She gives few problems with no answers.  Lecutres are just summary of book.  It is basically just you and the book for a 400 level course.

Had her for biochem and the course is pointless.  If have next to nothing to prepare for the exam except for the book.  She gives few problems with no answers.  Lecutres are just summary of book.  It is basically just you and the book for a 400 level course.
She was a very GENEROUS teacher, she curves exam CRAZY STYLE, some people dont even deserve the curves she gives. If you study exam, its easy to A's an exam, if i can do it , you can also!!!!
She is a great professor! One of the best at UIC. Speaks and explains material clearly, very nice, and very approachable. The exams are NOT completely easy, so you must study for them!

She is a very nice and easy professor. All of her exams were  easy if you studied and went to lecture. OWL homework broke concepts down that were confusing. She gives a lot of grade boosters (e.c., iclickers, homework etc.)

She's a nice professor with clear objectives for the class... Tests are easy if you study. Gives out way too much extra credit IMO. Generous curves that some people don't need. It's obvious that some people study and succeed and others don't and complain. Sink or swim. Your choice.

only take her if jursich and modey are the other options. otherwise, safe yourself. you can see she has no actual knowledge about chemistry. her lectures are pointless and she knows it too which is why she throws in iclickers, forcing you to go.

Professor Hatfield is probably the best Chem professor available between she, Jursich, and Modey. She does read off the slides, but she explains things well. When she is in office hours, she will help you. She is also the Biochem professor and it's obvious she knows what she is talking about. Extra Credit questions on her tests! EASY TESTS.

BORING LECTURES! SHE READS OUT OF THE SLIDES. IF NOT FOR THE ICLICKERS POINTS I WOULD NEVER SHOW UP FOR CLASS BECAUSE I HAD TO STUDY ON MY OWN ANYWAYS. MAKE SURE YOU READ THE BOOK AND DO OWL PROBLEMS. DR. HATFIELD MIGHT KNOW THE MATERIAL BUT CANNOT GIVE IT OUT. HER OFFICE HOURS ARE NO HELP EITHER. AVOID HER UNLESS YOU WANT TO STUDY ON YOUR OWN.
Very nice lady but her lectures are boring. The bright side is that she gives many hints on what is going to be on quizzes and exams.
Really nice and helpful professor but her class is mostly based off slides making her lectures boring.

Great Professor. Very approachable and helpful. Powerpoints are very clear that you dont even need the book to study. Exams are very reasonable and easy to do well on if you study her notes. Overall professor hatfield makes the class enjoyable and doable.I would highly recommend taking biochem with her. GREAT PROFESSOR!

She's a super nice lady though; you really can't appreciate how friendly and down to earth she is, and how much good insight she has outside of her field, unless you go and talk to her outside of class casually. The class is fairly easy, but pretty boring, and she teaches mostly by reading right off her slides, so attendance is hardly mandatory.
Cool professor!

super fun course and the movie selection was AMAZING! the pop quizzes were really annoying though and i wish we had more analysis assignments/test questions and fewer quizzes/tests aimed at checking to see if we watched the movies and remembered very specific details, which didnt feel very productive.

Dr. Burson is organized and clear when it comes to his lectures and assignments. He gives great feedback when it comes to assignments, and is very approachable and gives thoughtful answers to any questions you may have. Definitely recommend taking him!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Burson is organized and clear when it comes to his lectures and assignments. He gives great feedback on assignments, and is very approachable and thoughtfully answers any questions you may have.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: took him for 232. great prof- explains class material well and engages w class. easy to listen to and only a few assignments. fun class def take him.
Really good professor: only 4 papers for the semester, the topic of the class was very good in regards to relevancy in this day and age. 10/10
This professor is amazing, very nice guy and the work is super easy as long you put in some effort and stay on top of your work. If you put in effort it's an easy A or B for sure. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Chill Professor, Easy to Talk to, Flexible, Website HW, Written HW, 3 Exams, Labs, Discord, Gradescope, and ExpertTA
Flexible, Communicative, Fair

Not a fan of his course structure at all. The weekly quizzes were too much and the group problems on thursday's were pointless. He makes this class much harder than it needs to be. His exams are nothing like the review guide or homework even though he says they would be easier. He also gives problems without any numbers and just variables on exams

Ryan is awesome! While I personally thought more time could be spent solidifying concepts, he really helped students to understand the material. He is very caring and accommodating. It is super easy to reach him outside of class, and he is very helpful if you have any questions on the material.

Dude stays up til like 10 PM to help you with physics via Discord. Very approachable and responsive outside class. Clear, concept-focused teaching style that balances rigor without being overly abstract or simplified. Lectures are engaging and well-structured.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Hazelton was one of the physics professors that enjoyed helping students whether it was outside of school hours! If you want to at least pass the class, his grading criteria make sures having a C is doable. Regardless, if you suck at test taking - you can easily can get a B even with having an average 50-60% in tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: easy B as you just need 50 average on exams to pass supposed you do good on everything else. also labs are a pain but not too bad. very nice dude.

Hazelton as a professor is great! I enjoyed having him and engaging with him in class. My complaint is mostly with the class structure itself. I really think that the exams don't match up with the review tests or problems given in the textbook. Overall good but needs more support for students who are struggling to grasp concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: AMAZING! wants you to pass truly. if he's an option do it. i took him both for 141 and 142. he's really passionate ab the subject and makes the class really easy

Hazelton's target goal is to make his students understand CONCEPTUALLY rather then just the math on what goes on in physics, and he does a very good job doing so with the group problems, which are crucial for exam studying. I do question his course structure because he crams quizzes and spends much time doing practice problems, but he's a cool guy

Good professor if you pay attention to his lectures. The class has a lot of weekly assignments with a lab, prelab, online homework, and written homework due every week. The study guides aren't great for the tests, but he gives a lot of textbook problems for practice as well. He's really accessible outside of class as well if you use the discord.

He's a great professor and has a very energetic personality. He is at the MSLC twice a week and is very helpful with difficult material. Unfortunately, the class is pretty difficult and they assign a lot of homework. You'll have lots of resources, but be prepared to ask questions at the MSLC if you want to do well. Grades are homework heavy.

Class is unnecessarily difficult. As a mechanical engineer,this class is more difficult and time than major based classes, participation grades are not in student favor, labs always took up the entire time, weekly quizzes caused a headache, and group problem time is not helpful. Hazelton is a decent professor, tries to fit too much in a short time.

He has clear posted office hours, will respond within 24hrs to messages, and answers any questions needed during, before, or after lectures. If you pay attention during lectures and actually do the group problems, you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hazelton is a great professor! As long as you put in honest effort on your end you should have no problems passing. He is also accessible outside of class via Discord and MSLC hours, and if he isn't there a TA or peer leader usually will be in case you have any questions.

Hazelton compared to other physics professors actually wants you to pass his course while learning. For his quizzes you actually go over material previously mentioned in class and homework assignments. Lectures are very helpful to pay attention as well because he goes over useful examples that appear again on exams.

This course involved a lot work, including weekly quizzes, Expert TA HW, written HW, and labs. Nonetheless when it came to professors for this course, Hazelton was the right man for the job. His lectures were great, and very fantastic. He was very accessible on discord to help students. He taught in terrific way like you've never seen before!

Took Hazelton for 141 and 142, great experience in both. Attendance not mandatory, Lecture is recorded but there are participation points that are easy to miss. Class has massive amounts of deliverables. You WILL learn physics, lectures were amazing.

Hands down one of my favorite professors ever. Lectures are engaging and professor is clearly passionate. The course is WORK HEAVY, weekly online + written HW assignments. Attendance not mandatory but missing class means missing easy participation points. Passing Hazeltons class (C) is easily doable but going for a B or A requires effort.

It's easy to understand the material if you go to all the lectures and actually follow along. DO the practice exams. I did one practice exams the day before the exam and learned my mistakes, took a good night's rest, then redid the same practice exam and then did second exam and got A's on my exams. Homework is HEAVY. Everything's on discord..

Hazelton knows his physics and keeps you engaged during class with mandatory clickers. Exams are only 45% of your grade so homework and quizzes can boost it. Once-a-week quiz at the end of class on last week's material is hard at times. Easily accessible on his discord channel where he puts effort into answering any questions. Great guy.

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, uses engaging examples in class and keeps the class interested which makes it actually fun to learn with this professor.

Hazelton was phenomenal. Structured the class in such a way that made it very easy to pass. Applied real world examples during lecture to connect material. He did his best to engage with his students during group problems and help students out one on one despite the large class size. Went over plenty of examples and recorded his lectures as well!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Hazelton is great! He is so excited about teaching and funny during lectures. Very quirky and loves the subject. He provides all the materials that you need to succeed in this class. Some might think there is a lot of homework, but the hw is necessary to learn the material and practice for the exam.

Highly recommend this prof! His lectures are interactive + fun. He rly cares for his students + structures the class so that if you put the effort in, you will for sure pass. Free textbook provided but no assigned readings. The homework is necessary to understand and prep for exams. Group problems are helpful. Very enthusiastic + loves teaching.

A very enthusiastic and friendly professor. While I personally struggle with many things in physics, I ended the class with an A. Labs were relatively straightforward, and I always went to lectures since I had no interest/desire in reading the textbook. Homework was straightforward but difficult, but due dates were clear. Overall, a great professor
Class was hard and lecture heavy, but Hazelton is willing to answer any questions to help you understand the concepts. There's a lot of homework, so it's a good idea to space it out during the week.
Need more professors like him. Dude knows how to explain everything and is very caring. Best Professor!

Good prof to take this class with. Professor was fair and eager to teach. Textbook was 100% phenomenally useless but the lectures themselves were good with good notes taken and posted during class. Hazelton is a reasonable professor and a good person overall. Supportive. Labs were also pretty pointless but hey, you've gotta jump through the hoops.

This course load is way too much if you are taking other hard sciences. Youll barely have time for any other classes. You have to read about 60 pages each week and teach yourself the content. He only goes over about 3 questions during lecture.

reviews.comment: he's really nice, you can tell that he loves to teach. And if you are taking him online, you'll be able to see his kids once in a while.

He's really kind, and helped through a lot. I struggled really badly in the class, but I still got a good grade because I asked him for help. Physics is difficult, you can't expect to understand it the first time around all by yourself.

I was worried about taking a physics class at UIC, but Dr. Hazelton made it really doable. I've never had such a caring professor who goes out of his way to help his students as much as he can, especially after the transition online. Weekly readings are helpful, and make sure you understand how to solve all the hw problems (written & online)!

I took physics 1 and 2. Physics is hard. Hazleton is no push over, but he has designed the class in a way that will make sure you understand everything. If you don't follow the way hes designed the class, thats on you. Hes a good man, funny, caring, and loves Physics a little too much.

I took PHYS 1 and 2 with Professor Hazelton and let me say he's the most caring professor you'll encounter at UIC. He genuinely wants everyone to excel and understand. I wasn't good at physics but I still tried because he made it a great experience. He provides a lot of homework that will help you understand and listens to students for improvement

For a new class, he does a really good job of making everything fair. His lectures are funny and you are given lots of examples before exams. He tries to make things really interactive so you can understand the topics. Homework heavy though, unless you are good at math.

Guy rambles about stuff unrelated to Physics, but complains there isn't enough time to cover everything he needs to teach us. SO MUCH HOMEWORK YOU WILL WANT TO KILL YOURSELF! Despite the lack of funding that is going into the course, he's working really hard to make sure every student has a good chance at getting the grade they want, by answering question clearly, making it fun to learn as a student and messing with the grades to make the class fair.

He's a new professor to UIC but he's pretty great at explaining lecture material in 50 minutes. Make sure you understand the homework problems (a lot of hw, but it helps you understand the material) and the group problems because they'll help you a lot on quizzes/exams! Two exams each 20% , biweekly quizzes (one is dropped) 20% , easy labs 15%
Was an easy class, he was understanding. Attendance wasn't required either, assignments are all in R Studio.
One of the best in UIC. Professor Khalid cares about his student's success. If you can, please take Hassaan at least once. Had him for 331 as well as 400.

Yeah I get that people usually take him because he is a lenient grader, but come on. He is a PhD candidate who is very knowledgeable and passionate with his lectures. Very kind professor. Took him last semester and he was a very kind and knowledgeable professor.
Great professor, very nice and knowledgeable. Please take him!
Hands down the best IDS professor. He really cares about his student's success. He also does not let anyone fail and tries his best to give everyone the highest grade possible.

Had him for IDS 331 Fall 23'. Legitimately so lucky to have him for Spreadsheet analysis because its a tricky class but he is the best guy for the job. I learned while being challenged and made me feel way more confident about IDS. I hope he teaches more IDS classes the field is lucky to have him.
The professor was competent and worked through problems. The homeworks were helpful and effective in preparing for the exams. I loved the CAD labs.

Like tests, the problems to expect are literally the examples in lectures, so try not to skip cuz he won't really post lectures. Also gives opportunities for extra credit.

It was very clear from the beginning what is expected of students. The homework/exams reflect the lecture very well. I like that he went through examples and explained them thoroughly. They really helped me when I was completing my homework, which also helped me prepare for exams. I attended most of sessions and enjoyed taking this course with him.

his slides are decent but his lecture is extremely monotonous and he does not apply any of the concepts, its mostly just plugging and chugging math. Hes also very unforgiving about absences, being sick, just generally being lost.

Great course, well organized.  She graded quickly and gave good feedback.

This class is time-consuming because you have five assignments a week just about two due during the week. But, its manageable. I would take class with this instructor again. She is a fair grader as long as you follow the rubric exactly as it says. I learned alot.

reviews.comment: Graded assignments quickly and answered my emails fast.  Highly recommend, she made research understandable.

Dr Innella actually met with me via Zoom when I was having problems understanding how to complete an assignment.  This is so important in an online program and I truly appreciated it.  She definitely provides a lot of support and feedback just get the assignments in on time.
She's a very fair grader and gives great feedback on assignments. I would definitely take her again. Follow the assignment rubrics and complete all assignments, and you will easily pass.

If you are looking for a professor who really cares and goes the extra mile to help her students, you have found your professor. Dr. Innella goes over and above for her students. This is the second time that I have been fortunate enough to be in her class!

Dr. Innella is an amazing professor who engages with her students. She even offered to do Zoom meetings to helps us throught Research and Statistics which helped immensely. She brings much knowledge and guidance to the class. I chose to take her for two courses, no regrets, excellent!
Took real interest in her students, and provided excellent material and learning opportunities.

Professor Ibrahim explains concepts clearly and makes class engaging through real-world examples, discussions, and projects. She genuinely cares about her students and creates a supportive learning environment. I always felt encouraged to participate and learned a lot from her classes.
Her lectures are very easy to understand. Midterm and final she allows open notes and textbooks. One big group presentation after midterms is a very easy class overall.

Professor Ibrahim (the best!) is an engaging instructor who sets clear expectations and encourages participation in a respectful, inclusive environment. Professor Shahnaz was amazing; I had her for MGMT 350 and ENTR 310- she is always willing to help, makes lectures interactive with students, and gives challenging but fun group projects! Best teacher I had - very knowledgeable and passionate

She is such an angel!! Exams are open-book. Weekly HW (straightforward). She is so easy to talk to and cares so much about her work and working with students. This professor is such a sweetheart, she loves teaching, passionate about the material. HW is easy, exams are open note. Make sure you get to know your group for the final project so you can get a good score and have a good understanding about what you're presenting.

Ibrahim is an engaging professor and is passionate about her work. Class participation gives extra credit and the homework is simple.

If you stay on top of the material and are willing to collaborate with your peers, you'll succeed. Highly recommend!

Professor Ibrahim is a great professor who cares about her students. I would recommend taking her for your MGMT 350 because the way she format the class is so convenient. Attendance is mandatory, weekly homework that consists of 3 easy questions, online exams, and a final group presentation/report.

Prof. Issa is hands down the "real-est" professor you'll encounter. The class is lecture-heavy, but he goes through so many examples. You must understand Professor Issa to understand his lectures. You will have to study a lot at home as lecture is only one day per week. You will mostly learn in the lab where you will put your knowledge to the test. Make sure to ask a lot of questions to TA Mahmoud, he is a very great individual.

Issa is a professor that teaches from a real world perspective. He doesn't waste time covering derivations of equations, and he doesn't waste time covering much theory. There are only 2 things required for success in this class.

1.) Attend every lab, pay attention, and write good reports
2.) Review lecture slides. That is the content on the test.

Great professor, great class, the professors examples and lectures are exactly what you need for the outside world, I also took him from CME 300, when I took the FE exam his examples where almost the same as the ones on the FE, very respectful and professional professor, this is one the hardest and most important classes in civil engineering

One of the best professors at UIC , the class has about seven labs which are about three long, The professor gives some jokes every now and then to break the ice to keep the class interesting. Knowledgable and Crediable Professor

He is a great professor and a great adviser. You will most definitely hear otherwise from many of your peers, but they just have trouble learning. Think about that... he is the worst instructor,he does not know how to teach.

ok guys

good professor, reasonable grader, difficult but very interesting class, and he really hammers in the basics,

She is the greatest professor ever! She is super cool, understanding, and awesome! I would take every class she teaches! :)
