Case studies, find a good group to work with and you'll easy ace them.
he had open notes exams except the final exam and I got an A in the class, attendance and i clickers were mandatory, 10/10 would recommend. he's a nice person as well :)

350 was a super easy course with professor mills. exams are open note, online, quizzes are closed note, also online. don't make the mistake of not studying for exams, though. You still need a basic understanding of the material to do well. his lectures can be kind of boring, but he gives you the information you need. would definitely retake. easy A

I took BIOS 350 with Mills and was honestly my best professor for Year 3. He gives you exam prep materials (do them, they actually help), his communicates well and cares for his students, his directions and materials are too the point. Like this is a great class and a great professor.

He makes it very easy to determine what we should know and what we shouldn't worry about/what is most important to take away from this class for future applications. Drops lowest test, extra credit for attendance. Knowledgable and ends class early a lot. Lectures to the point. Content can be confusing but he makes it worthwhile.
Do your best for the exams. They are challenging but not too bad overall. Reach out if you need help

Dr. Mills is hands down the BEST professor I have ever had. Lectures were extra credit, which boosted my grade more than 3%. He is very laid back and he truly cares about his students. His exams were not too bad, and his personal interactive study guides are helpful for the exams. I highly recommend this class, and it is also great for MCAT prep.

Amazing professor. I recommend taking genetics and cell bio before taking microbio, but even if you don't his lectures are really helpful for the quizzes and exams. He also creates and interactive practice and study guides for each chapter. He makes it easy to understand the material and wants his students to do well.

THE BEST!! He teaches the class really well. He is clearly passionate about his subject. He cares for his students and want them to pass. The exams are not really difficult if you pay attention to his lectures.

To be honest, great professor. His lectures are not mandatory but if you go you get extra credit which really helps your grade at the end of the semester. Also, his exams are online with respondus. Some of the material can be difficult but if you go to lecture and reread slides you will be ok.

AMAZINGGGGGGG! He did a poll to see if people want to make the final optional! The prof is so nice and he actually cares. Exams and quizzes are online on respondous (u can take it in person if you want), they can be a bit too detailed but if you study and go over the study guide he does it shouldn't be too bad. Highly recommend!
hard exams, they were online though. he just reads off of the slides

Best professor I've had and it was his first year! Super nice, funny, passionate, and clear about the info. Exams/quizzes were easy if you attend lecture. Gave 2 random ECs for attendance throughout semester. Clear about what will be tested on. Gives feedback on questions, good at explaining, & interesting course! Wish he taught everything!

Lectures kinda boring ngl and not many assignments to make up lost points. Case studies were fun but exams and quizzes were a bit tough. Professor is cool though and will help you where need be. It is a 300 level class so dont expect an easy A because he does not curve grades and uses a standard grading scale. Overall prof was great subject was bad

Wish I never took this class, the professor is a great guy but the material is wayyy too in depth and there is too much information that has to be learned for each exam. Don't take this class unless you really have to. Studying for exams took up most of my time, and case studies worsened grades. some exams are based on 1-1.5mnth worth of material

Dr. Mills was a GOAT, I don't know why people are complaining. Lectures are straight to the point, no BS questions on the quizzes or exams. Everything is straight to the point, with zero BS. For a 300-level BIOS course, it is painless. Love this man. One of my favorite professors of all time, seriously.

Boring lectures, reads straight off the slides. Info isn't concise. Unapproachable and inaccessible outside of class- Expect to be redirected to TA for EVERYTHING. Only giving 2 stars because the assignment deadline structure makes it possible to keep up with the class. Wouldn't recommend to take this class if it isn't a requirement.

Boring class time, Reading off power points. Unclear and missing information in the lecture. Tough grader and some questions on exams not included in the power points. Require to look for a lot of external sources when doing group activities

Mr. Mills, what guy. He is a new professor at UIC but he gives good lectures and clarifies questions well when you ask. Accessible outside of class, quizzes and exams are fair with plenty of practice questions and review sheets posted, and honestly, he's an absolute GOAT. Would take the class again. Microbiology has redeemed itself at UIC.
I thought she was really kind and easy to understand. Just know the exams are in person and no notes so if you have to actually know what you're doing to pass.
In general she was a good teacher, but sometimes, her work on screen was hard to follow and understand. I would definitely give her a shot and see if her teaching style works for you.

You'll be good if you're familiar with the math already. She was not the best at propagating her knowledge into you, hope you have a good TA (I know you can't really choose them but I really liked Farad)

She radiates such positivity that it genuinely motivates me to attend class and stay engaged. It's clear how passionate she is about what she does, and that enthusiasm is contagious. I truly appreciate her approach to teaching, and I wish she could teach all my math classes. I wholeheartedly recommend her!
Take her, you can tell she likes what she teaches and it shows, she is kind of goofy but nice and it makes class go by fast.

I am not good at math but I got a B in this class. Easy to follow, homework once a week. She explains things in depth and doesn't skip steps like a lot of math teaches do. Highly recommend taking a class with her if you can
I already knew most of the material but Alycia took time to explain all the material. I would definitely take her for another math class in the future

Very kind, approachable, and friendly professor. Lectures were very easy to follow, and she provided all the help you needed to succeed. Honestly, there was no excuse for anyone not to do well in her class.

I switched to her class from another section and it was the best choice I made. I don't think I would've done as good in the class if I stayed with my other professor so if you can get her as your instructor it's worth it to make it work!!!

Best professor by far. Super good at explaining and very excited about math. Gave a lot of practice for exams. Exam reviews are basically whats on the exams so she provides a lot of questions that are almost identical on exams. As long as you understand the exam practices you are good in her class. She also has crazy curves. A "B" is 75+. 10/10
Kind professor who clearly is very experienced at teaching the class. Helps explain material in a very digestible way and does her best to make sure students succeed.

Professor McNamara is an amazing professor, she cares about her students and wants to help them understand the material as best as possible. She explains things thoroughly and clearly. She's honestly one of the best Profs I've had, would 100% recommend taking her class. She uses a workbook that you take notes in which was great. Acadly 4 Attendance
Her lectures are great and all of the test are relatively easy as long as you do all of the homework
Amazing professor! Always comes into the lecture with tons of positive energy and really cares for her students. She has tons of resources on blackboard to help you with the material. 10/10
She is nice for a math teacher (some are horrible) Very engaging. she's just amazing and makes you feel like you can do anything when it comes to math!!

Very accommodating and engaging. You can tell she has a passion for math and for teaching. If you can score a math class with Professor Alycia, I'd absolutely recommend it. Quite a lecture-heavy class, but she's easy to follow along with. Gives adequate reviews for exams and has very forgiving policies.
Very good professor. She's very reasonable in her grading and sets you up for success. She truly cares about her students and their wellbeing. Love her!

Best Prof. I have ever had for a STEM class. Most encouraging kind person ever, was not even in her section but she gave me credit for attending her lectures because my assigned prof left me feeling clueless even after hours in the MSLC. After attending hers I was getting As without MSLC at all. She gives so many resources and extra credit take her

My favorite Professor of all time! I was not even in her section but she let me attend her lectures because the professor I had made no sense to me at all. After catching up I never even needed to go to the MSLC except before an exam to review because she explains so well. She gives you so many resources and is so kind and engaging. HIGLY recommend
I don't do well with math, but she is helpful and easygoing. I was lazy in this class, but still managed to get a B. So, that should tell you enough about this class.

I struggled in class so I would go to her office hours and she was SO HELPFUL. She will take 20 minutes to explain a 2 second problem to you if that's what you need, and when you finally get it, she HYPES. YOU. UP. fr I felt so good about math when I would leave her office hours
She's a very good lecturer and has everything online just in case you need to review the material. Fully prepares you for exams and encourages you to try your best.
Very easy to understand and learn from. Highly recommend, would take her for any math class

She is my prof in 121 rn and I am so glad.. Professor Mcnamara gets it. She is in the trenches with us and I know I will get through this class with her support. If you have the chance to take her - do it.

I personally thought she was a great professor, she went through lecture notes each class and explained well. Everything on the notes is on the exam so as long as you show up and follow the notes you'll do fine.
QUEEN. If you struggled in math in the past because your teacher sucked then take Professor McNamara because her attitude is everything. She genuinely wants to be in the room and it shows.
YALL I GOT MY FIRST A EVERY IN MATH WITH HER that's all i gotta say.

Such an AMAZING Professor helped me learn so much in math that no other math teacher did. She is very caring, kind, and straightforward; she loves teaching and doing what she loves. Class isn't that hard unless you pay attention and go to lectures. All the classwork is in the math book, and attendance is taken at the end of class so you need to go.
Learned so much more in this class than in any of my high school classes! Professor McNamara is THE best professor I have ever had!!!

she's super sweet and lectures are super easy to understand! although calculators aren't allowed for this class, the exams always had numbers that were easy to work with without the need of a calculator. and overall, this class followed a very consistent structure, there was never any unexpected or unclear instructions. definitely recommend her!

She makes learning the content as easy as possible and makes the exams VERY easy to pass. Really no reason to fail this class because of how great she is plus lectures are also livestreamed and she uploads videos so there's no reason to not get the content. In all, she loves what she does and is the best around. 110% take her class!!!
Best math professor/teacher I've ever had. Knows how to explain the material properly and effectively. Listen and attend class and you'll pass with no issues whatsoever.
Anyone complaining about Alycia McNamara is wild. This professor is GOATED. Take any other prof in the math departments and tell me she's not the best. I'll wait.

I loved her! You can really tell that she loves what she does. She always makes sure in lecture we go everything we need to go through. Homework is manageable. Tests are exactly like the exam reviews given to you but differently. Overall, great instructor and always feel free to ask questions because she will always be happy to help you out!

It's time to register so I am making sure everyone knows if you're taking 110 or 121 in the spring this is who you want! I never got math till I took her class. She's nice and easy to learn from so take her you won't regret it.
Easy a if you attend class and do the homework. Plus McNamara is really good at explaining things and she doesn't skip over things. She will review everything if you ask.
She explains things really well. She doesn't skip steps or assume you know something. I learned more in her class than in my high school math!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: On the first day she said "all of you should I already know all of this so I won't be teaching it" and stated she doesn't belive in calculators or test retakes. Her lectures are her doing math problems with little explanations or deep dives. She leaves everything to the discussion teachers.

On the first say she made it clear that she would be teaching very little as we should have "learned most of this in high-school" she doesn't allow calculators. Doesn't do retakes. She's nice but she bearly teaches. Her lectures are her solving problems with little explanation. She leaves the explaining to the discussion sections.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is great! I learned so much in this math class - like really - math I would actually use. Highly recommend this math class if you need to take a required math for credit!

PRO: Lots of help in class with the professor, the TAs, and the LAs. Exams are easier than the homework, so if you can understand the homework (go the MSLC for help) you'll do fine on the tests.
CON: You need to buy the online access for this course but make sure you get it through the blackboard site because at the library is costs almost double.
Wow, i actually learned stuff in this math class that will help me as an adult fr. Because of her I am starting to save NOW for my retirement because compound interest baby!
She is very sweet and she knows how to teach well. If you hate math she can make you like it! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
She explains things really well. I never liked math or was good at it until her class. My last exam I got an A and I never got an A in math before! Take her if you can.
Really good instructor. Understanding but fair.
Super nice and caring. Could definitely tell she cared about the students. If you asked questions, she definitely tried her best to make time and answer them.

She explains everything really well, &here is the thing - I get it! Her explanations are long but they make sense. And if I don't figure it out in class I am able to by rewatching the lectures later because she records and posts videos of her classes. Tests are easier than the homework so if you can get through the HW the exams are a breeze!
Very nice professor always answered questions if students had any. She explains problems very well and if your ever lost, Blackboard has recorded lectures.

I recommend watching the posted videos before each class and it will make lecture make so much more sense. She also records her lectures. Doesn't allow makeups but drops the lowest assignments, so make sure to follow the schedule and do your work on time because it's easy points! Highly recommend her, she's one of the best math teachers I've had!
All I can say is that she is an actual goddess. she teaches in a manner anybody can understand, super chill person. will even give you extensions for your webassign homework if you ask her.

Professor McNamara is very fun. I loved her lectures. Very accessible after lectures, I used to go to her office hours daily, and it helped me a lot to keep up with the class material. This class is hard but if you go to her office hours, she will help you.

Professor McNamara is great! She is so sweet, and you can tell she really cares for her students. She's also really funny. She always encourages asking questions, and always responds to emails quickly. There are 3 exams (evening) + a final(afternoon), and all of her exams are similar to lectures and notes in class. I definitely recommend her!

Halfway through the semester, it gets tough, and she tends to go faster in lectures. Attendance is usually taken at the end of the class period, and you do not have a chance to leave early if you need to (most of the time). She is sarcastic. You learn within two weeks at most 2 unit section and then have an exam within the week. Exams in afternoon.

Her lectures were fine and pretty easy to understand. I did have and asked a lot of questions because she always went a bit fast and would glaze over certain things because she assumed we already knew it. Other than that she was always open to answer my after class questions(there were a lot lol) and she was always very bubbly.

She is a great lecturer and makes things very clear. She did a good job explaining the material and clarifying any questions. She's also super nice. She's very engaging and it seems like she really enjoys what she does.
Very sweet professor! Grades fast!

Professor McNamara actually hopes you'll be able to pass the class. She is very caring and always available. If you missed a homework she would let you redo it. The class was online and I always hated being online but she actually made it very comfortable for the students.
Great professor.

I can go on and on about how amazing Alycia is. If you're having any doubts about taking her this is your sign to TAKE HER CLASS!! You will not be disappointed, I've never had such an enthusiastic, sweet, and caring professor. She teacher very well and will always help you if you need it! Her tests are easy if you study, you will love her!
She's super enthusiastic about what she teaches. She always answered any students' questions/concerns. Honestly I've never been good at math but she really made it simpler to understand.

This has only been my first semester at UIC, but this professor is hands down the best!! My anxiety literally eased first day of lecture. You must put in the work in this class, but she 100% cares about her students and believes everyone can succeed.

Professor McNamara is such a great professor! She is very considerate and great at explaining the concept. I love when she talks about her dog and kids, but if youre someone who likes things straight to the point then maybe not for you. But she completes everything in time and makes sure you understand!

Taken during UIC's online e-learning, McNamara's lectures were concise and used many examples that were backed by handmade note sheets. While sometimes off topic to a point of being slightly behind other professors, she always made the day a little interesting.

Prof MacNamara is the best. She made all the lectures fun involving and easy to understand. She is so sweet and even though this was online made connections with those who participated in class. She gives so much help and reviews for exams including study guides and study sessions. Overall amazing professor 100% would take again.

Amazing Professor! Very energetic. I had her for my morning class and she would always be coming with a big smile. She made learning fun. Very helpful and detailed. She knows what she is doing. Definitely recommend without a doubt!

She's amazing!! I loved her, I wish she could teach me every math course I need to take. I took her online during the pandemic. Given that it was hard to focus on the screen during the pandemic she was very interactive and fun!

Professor McNamara is the most sweetest, patient, down-to-earth person. Her lectures are great, she pushes the class do challenge themselves. If she has to go over a problem several times if you don't understand it, she will. I feel like I have tried my hardest in her class, due to all the help she has provided. SO I RECOMMEND HER. SHES GREAT!

Lectures were so fun with her! She engages with her students and makes math so easy. There were times where the lectures would get off topic but it didnt interfere with learning math. I wish there were more professors like here where they not only teach but also have fun with it.

Teaches everything very clearly and provides extra recorded videos for help. She never assumed her students already knew all previous math topics, which helps a lot if you forget them a lot. She was super nice and caring, and very accommodating. The class was never boring because of how engaging it was and her funny jokes. 10/10 across the board.

Shes such a sweetheart I love her so so much, and thats coming from someone who never actually got the chance to meet her in person. Her lectures are engaging and she has the best personality so youll never get bored with her as your teacher.
She is so awesome. Especially during online learning if you have the chance to choose her lecture do it!!!

Professor McNamara is literally the most sweetest person you'll ever meet. Her lectures are fun and interesting. She understands the stress we go through and tries to help us in however way she can. Don't even debate professors for Math 121, take her! You won't regret it!

For me, I need to have a good teacher for math in order to do well, because some do not teach well. But Alycia is literally the best math teacher I've had. She is super funny, goes over the lecture sheets one by one, and even has a math tiktok! Overall she is really caring and is accessible after class for extra help. Her and Jenny Ross kill it!

She's really fun and she actually makes math entertaining. She also has a tiktok and shares some of them with us before class. Most importantly, she wants us to know what we're doing and she's always there when we have questions and even helps outside of class hours.
Really funny, has a TikTok where she makes math related videos showing that she really cares for her students. Explains well. Overall good vibes.
She makes things so easy to understand. Lectures are really fun and tests are super easy if you do what she tells you to do. All around an amazing professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great teacher and she will go over everything that will be on the test. Make sure to do the reviews and go to discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was awesome! She took time outside of class to make sure things were completely understood. She even responded on the weekend. She definitely cares about her students passing. I will miss her!

I have always struggled with math in high school but let me tell you about McNamara. Her way of explaining problems is AMAZING! Goes step by step and always answers questions when a student is confused. If you are still struggling, going to her office hours is a great idea. Attendance is mandatory. There is no quizzes, but a total of four exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: It seems like Raphael needs to be the smartest person in the room. I don't suggest interacting with him 1:1 or by participating in the lectures. Unless you're agreeing with him, you're wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would not recommend taking this class unless you want to hear someone yap for 50 minutes. He's very opinionated and likes to dismiss his students answers. I get he's a scholar and all but please leave room for students to give their thoughts it is a discussion class.

Very passionate about what he teaches which helps with the often boring course material. All lectures are posted online so you only really need to attend the separate discussion section. Only like 5 assignments for the whole class, easy if you use the lecture notes and skim the texts. All the readings you can find free pdfs

The professor is a good teacher in the sense of attitude for the class he teaches, very excited to talk about the work we do to prepare for the class but I think this can in fact be a downside to his greatness, he's very opinionated and in ways sways the conversations too much which isn't really the best for this type of class. Not the best imo.

Professor Magarik is new to UIC (I believe), but he is certainly a keeper. He's a great professor and obviously loves to teach the subject of English. He made what normally would be a boring topic for me very fun and easy to understand. His essays are awesome because there were 5 2-page essays, which were easy if you read. Would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please do not pick her classes, just don't. You will be 100 percent happier without taking her courses.
Avoid her ANTH courses guys, choose some other professors and you will take the benefit!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please avoid taking her ANTH courses guys!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No problem with Dr. Mouftah, shes cool. Her TA Besan Jaber is the deal breaker. I wouldn't recommend taking this course for that reason alone.
Don't  take her ANTH courses.
Class discussions are so good. Readings are tough but she makes them make sense.
Everything in short, do not take any her class! She expect you to treat her course as a Rock science level project.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I personally found this class very boring, especially when it came to fieldwork journals. Including that I work this class took too much time. Also, final paper wants too much. You have to write 1500 words out of nothing. The insturctor is great, but the class is boring, dull, and requires lots of writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Such a great professor. She'll get you to discuss a lot.

. The structure of the class is made up in a way that the highest grade work will be during the end and you will not barely get any feedback. So if it isnt your major you grade is literally luck. The professor has no involvement in the course and everything has to go through the TAs which are clueless
She cares about what she's teaching and it comes through in class. Talk to her after lecture. She has a lot of information.
She loves everything she teaches. The lectures and discussions make everything click.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This professor is an absolute nightmare. Not only is she an impossibly harsh grader, but she also couldn't teach her way out of a paper bag. She's stingy with rounding up grades and doesn't offer any extra credit opportunities. Save yourself the headache and avoid her classes at all costs. Trust me, you'll thank me later.
Great speaker who makes class exciting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: This class was graded really tough, especiallly for a 100 level. Textbook was required for homework access which was annoying and there was a lot of reading.

Dr. Mouftah is an extremely sweet and caring lady and has a genuine interest in all her students. Overall, the work assigned is pretty easy though guidelines on bigger projects can be unclear (but the TAs will work with you to get things clearer). She is also extremely knowledgeable in her field and her research is interesting.

She's a super sweet professor, and if you have a passion for anthropology, you will indeed enjoy her class. Now if you don't really have that passion, you might find the class tedious to go to. She only gave one exam really which was a 4 part project.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Mouftah is very knowledgable in the topics of this course and was enthusiastic about teaching students. I appreciated her care for students' learning as well as her ability to help students understand the course materials.
Mid
Take some other professor , youll thank yourself later

If you like Anthropology, do not take this class. TA's are insanely strict and give little to no feedback. Grading is extremely tough for an Intro level course. For reference I am a junior in 200/300 level classes, and this class is my lowest grade so far. I am an anthropology minor, and I am passionate about it. Now I am apprehensive and unsure.
Solid class. Three tests and a major paper. Dr. Mouftah's lectures are straightforward. She was interesting to speak with in office hours.

Honestly the whole exam questions are off of quizlet, her iclickers, or the book... Just wouldn't put myself or my gpa through that if I was a student again. Honestly take ANYTHING else. Plus her 8 page paper and cost of books is ridiculous.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Mouftah is an okay professor. Her lectures are straight from the textbook that costs $100, and does iClickers based off of it. You only need 50% iClickers right to get all the points. Her exams require you to go through the whole book and additional readings because the questions are very specific. Not a laid back gen-ed course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her lectures make the readings make sense. Not too much to read for each week, but you have to read lots of details for the exams.

Ugh. I couldn't click with this woman. She was super unclear and would make every exam way harder than it needed to be, for example, every multiple choice question had at least 3/4 answers be 100% accurate. It's just a guessing game after that, which does not seem fair

Professor Mouftah is truly passionate about the subject she teaches. She is extremely nice and not boring. This class was outstanding. One of the only professors that I have seen who is fully immersed in the material and is caring. She is aware that not all students are as interested, so she is always accommodating and helpful. I learned much more

Interesting class discussions. We covered lots of controversial topics and I always felt like the professor was fair. She tried to show different perspectives on the topics. Powerpoints aren't that useful for studying for the exam, but she gives essay questions in advance. Mouftah is amazing. I would take another class with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Prof Mouftah loves the stuff she teaches and it shows. There's a lot going on in each lecture, but she is usually pretty clear, and makes time for discussion and questions. Really helpful in office hours.

This class is too much for 130 level. Way to intense and deep. I took it for a general requirement but ended up working harder than I had on my major requirements. Youre better off taking some other class because she really makes u work for it. Which is fine but only if there wasnt so much to study; with deep analysis and everything. It was hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: You'll learn a lot in this class. It gave me a different perspective on things.

She is a great lecturer and this class is definitely NOT an introduction to Islam. It was definitely more elaborate and specific of the course and majority of what we learned was new to even Muslim students. Nevertheless, she is awesome and inspirational. She really knows her stuff and that, as a student, is the most important aspect of learning.

A course for true learners, you will learn a staggering amount about an amazing part of the world. Nermeen is a kind and brilliant professor who will challenge you to think critically about your own perceptions and to work and study hard. Her teaching style encourages thoughtful conversation. If you want to be always engaged, I highly recommend.

Professor Mouftah's class is not meant to be taken as a "blow-off" class, rather it requires participation, thought and effort to be able to obtain a good grade. Though many would regard this as a bad thing, the reality is that her class has the propensity to teach students about anthropology as a field of study, and the Middle East as a whole.

The class is not really an introductory course. You learn more about the history of Islam, sectors of Islam, philosphy, theology, schools of learning. 80 and above is an A! You have to read to participate in class, alot of dicsussion. 4 quizzes, 1 paper.  Can't miss more than 2 classes. Nermeen is very well educated and speaks well.
Doesn't know how to get students interested in the subject.

Andy is only at UIC for the research, not teaching. His lectures are not engaging & he explained new topics in incredibly vague/primitive ways. His TA team was completely disconnected from the course, offering little help w/ homework & labs while grading harshly. He also could not hide his hatred for office hours; he rarely spoke with students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor did not seem invested in helping his students succeed. He was unwelcoming during office hours and was not much help when we tried to ask questions. Lectures were not recorded, so being present was mandatory (no attendance points though). We received 0.25 points if we got an obscene extra credit question correct in class.
Class was difficult but he made the content understandable. Would recommend!

The class is pretty much 1/3rd problem sets (5 total), 1/3rd exams (3 total), and 1/3rd lab reports (7 total). Everything on exams is given in lecture. Hes a decent prof, he gives lots of extra credit. The only thing I didn't like is there is no partial credit given in this class, you're either right or wrong, and that can be discouraging.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The hws/exams were diffcult as not even partial credit was given for a four part question. "extra credits" were one-pointers in class participation to answer his two examples which took all the class time. The TA had no idea what they were doing. Went to office hours to improve my hws scores but even TA had no idea what was going on.

Andy's class of inorganic chemistry was pretty interesting. I found him to be very engaging with all the drawings and diagrams we would practice in class. It's important to pay attention and take notes in class as not every diagram/drawing would be in the slides and lectures aren't recorded. Grading depends more on TAs though.. Exams similar to hw
Good professor
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Funny guy, not the best lecturer. It was hard to stay focused when he talked and I often had to reread what we went through in class on my own. A fairly easy class if you have no problem with writing, but the little homework assignments get tedious after a while.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A funny great person but a bad lecturer. Lectures. did not prepare us for exams, people self-taught and would stop showing up to lectures because he goes on side tangents and doesn't teach. Lecture and lab felt like two separate classes. He would make himself accessible outside of class though and offer Zoom office hours even when he was home.

If you get the chance to take ENG161 with Nestor, take it. His class was quite a bit of busy work but it was easy. He only made us write one full paper and I don't think he even read them, just gave everyone As for doing it. Super understanding if you have to miss class or turn something in late, just talk to him. Much easier than most other profs.

Overall a really solid professor and had a  class cool theme! Attendance is mandatory, but he ends up canceling class when he thinks it's unnecessary. Not much feedback on papers or homework, but if you set up a meeting with him he'll communicate his thoughts.

Prof Gomez seems like he really cares about the students. He gives 2-3 assignments every week, but they aren't very time-consuming. The main thing is that he can be found outside of class and give feedback on your papers. The only thing is that he doesn't give back any of the papers with the grades on them or feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good teacher and gives usually give 2-3 assignments every week. It is important to have time management skills in this class to maintain being on time with the writing assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's really chill and as long as you communicate with him he'll always be there if you need help. He gives feedback if you actively seek it so always give him a shout if you feel unprepared. I believe he's a newer professor so the class itself wasn't too heavy in general. Good choice for a chill professor and chill environment.

Professor Gomez was a very nice and enjoyable professor to study under. He let us interact in groups a lot and overall he made it really easy and fun to participate in class. The only thing bad I have to say is the lack of feedback, I didnt really get much feedback from professor Gomez but nevertheless it was a very enjoyable class to take.
Honestly he's pretty chill. Chooses interesting topics ( I had monsters my semester) and lets his students devolve into random topics.

Professor Gomez is a good and interactive person with his classes but not a really good professor. He doesn't give ANY feedback on the papers you submit, and I didn't even get to know what marks I was getting on my papers, I only found out my grade from the midterm and final grade sections. Overall it felt like I was teaching myself in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Muller is an exceptional educator. The lectures are engaging and broken up to make them easier to diet. The labs are fun, he even spent his own money to provide us with a mini kit so that we only had to buy the cheap one from Carolina Labs. Overall, a genuinely great professor that loves what he does!

I never want to see this man again in my life. he was not helpful towards the end of finals and also his grading scale is riduculous. nothing he says in his lectures connect to the exams and i mean nothing. prepare now cause you will cry

He gives easy credit assignments and the exam questions are almost the same given as practice exams. Doesn't always read of the slide and is hilarious. Attendance isn't necessarily mandatory but clicker questions are just participation points/attendance points.

Professor Muller was great! It was content-heavy and can be extremely difficult to catch up if you fall behind. A lot of his exams are very similar to his past exams, so make sure to study those. Labs are easy points and fun to do, so make sure to attend those.
Love his lectures and love the class but it felt like the tests always had trick questions. One of my favorite classes though.

Graded on raw points; grade is pretty exam heavy. Professor is extremely chill and proficient at teaching bio, but it's just heavy in content. Attendance optional since lectures are recorded, but you'll be screwed if you fall behind. Definitely would need to review outside the classroom to get a good grade. Bio lab pads out some easy points.

Favorite science teacher. He wants you to learn and is willing to help in any way. He always had a way to connect it to something else to make the lessons easier to understand. Makes jokes as well. He loves it when you make a question or comment. Just a really chill guy. Make sure to take notes. Recommend 10000%!!

Professor Muller is great! He lectures in a clear, easy-to-understand way. He is very funny, compassionate, and truly wants every student to succeed. The final exam is optional. I would 100% take another class with him if I had the chance!
Great professor and very understanding lectures can be very funny

He's really engaging with his lectures, and will always answer any questions during or after lectures. If you want to go over your test he'll also do that as well. Overall an amazing professor to work with and gives lots of opportunities to make up some work! Would highly recommend

Professor Muller's lectures are very useful as he teaches the material in a way that's super easy to understand for the "common person". I would highly recommend his class, as there are many extra-credit opportunities and the grading is extremely lenient. He's also very approachable if you have questions or struggle with understanding something.

He is a great professor and helps out students a lot. The class is exam heavy. He is really funny and teaches the material rather than just talking. I recommend emailing him and attending office hours.

This is such a good class to take if you need your science requirement as a non-STEM major. Professor Muller is really chill and the online lectures are really easy to understand (make sure you have notes out for the weekly quizzes though). The labs are also pretty easy and fun to do and my TA was also really chill and helped out a lot.

Great teacher. Gives extra credit occasionally. Tests are in class. Practice exams are helpful to do for exam prep. Literally gives so much material for you to study from so you can do good. Would totally take this class again. He is very approachable. You'll do fine as long as you pay attention. Don't sit in the back because those people slack.

Best professor I've honestly ever had for any class. Hilarious guy: gives great examples and shows the perfect amount of detail. Would have him for a professor again any day. If you can, request him as your professor; he's the goat.
Professor Muller was highly engaging and always made lectures interesting. I would definitely recommend his class to my peers. He's a great guy!
He made the class very enjoyable, not too bad just need to put the work in, highly recommend!

Professor Muller is the best professor to take. He is laid-back, funny, and understanding. He makes learning interesting by interweaving hilarious side-stories into his lectures. His classes are very informative, but his exams can be tough because you need to remember everything from his lectures, which is a lot of info. Overall, awesome teacher.

Bios104 honestly is not too bad, but it definitely requires you to study quite a bit. The professor is really funny and always super understanding, always willing to go above and beyond to accommodate his students. Overall not a bad class at all, but theres an easier class for the gen-ed.
Great guy hard class. Everything you need is on the slides he post.

He is pretty informative and likes to give cool fun facts. Lectures are super packed with information so going off of the slides at home isn't ideal because they're mostly just pictures. Weekly at home quizzes. Labs are pretty chill and fun. He gives lots of materials and resources to help you understand the classwork.
Pretty easy class. I pretty much just attended labs and looked at the slides and was able to pass. Long slides, but good for studying and going at your own pace. Lecture is recorded.

Mike was a fantastic professor, and I enjoyed his portion during the NATS 106 class. He is very outgoing, will make a class laugh, and is down to earth. Mike genuinely knows what he is talking about and does not make you feel terrible when you have a question or a concern. His lecture slides were very understandable, so were the weekly quizzes.

You can tell Dr. Muller really wants students to succeed by the amount of resources he provides for studying and reviewing the class material. His lectures, whether you attend in-person or online, are very informative and fun. Overall, great class!

He provides so many resources to study and review the class material. The textbook is free but even just going to lecture/watching the livestream will give you the necessary information to know for the exams. Just an all around cool guy that actually makes the class easier and fun.
I really don't understand why this class has no curve, this course is not easy and requires a lot of studying. I wish professor muller would apply a curve for this class.

I hate bio but you get everything you need to pass the class. Go to lecture (get those I-clicker points), Do the weekly quizzes (very similar questions on the exams), Finish labs (you have one week to do them, answers on slides and book), 2 essays (that are not even essays), review the past exams (again!! very similar questions on the exams!!).

Muller is one of the best bio professors at UIC. His lectures are engaging, and he genuinely cares about student learning. Take advantage of his practice exams and consider using unstuck ai along with the free textbook to prepare. Attend class and complete all assignments for the best chance of success.

It is the best and the most straightforward class if you can pay attention and have fun with it, as his way of teaching is the easiest I have ever experienced. The work amount is moderate and easily manageable.

This professor is like a once-in-a-lifetime professor. The leniency of his class is way higher for a student who saw the strict CS classes. I took his class to complete my Science Electives. If you get a chance to study BIOS110, take his class without questioning others. HE IS THE GOAT.....THE GOAT.
best bio prof at uic take him!!! Study his past exams he gives u for the exams!

Professor Muller is easily one of the best teachers at UIC.  This class is an easy A, IF work is put in.  Lab assignments are very easy and exams aren't horrible (Use the old exams and lecture slides).  Attendance is not mandatory but he has clickers (not location) and he even live streams class.  I would recommend going and taking notes for an A.

Probably one of the few coolest professors on campus. He isn't completely all business. He tends to crack jokes here and there. Weekly online quizzes with lab assignments every week. The powerpoints tend to be wordy with a lot of graphs/figures. DO go over the past exams and watch the lectures from the covid era. They help a lot when exam day comes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Muller is a great proffesor, I just feel like the wordy slides made lectures very boring so it was hard to keep up. I didnt think I would pass because I failed all the exams but I ended up passing somehow. Make sure to finish all the lab worksheets for easy points and attend to class for the extra credit. Take another bio class if its not for major

This professor is one of the best there is and is my favorite teacher figure i have ever had. He is extremely nice and unproblematic and shows that he cares about students learning. Get a spot in one of his classes before someone else does!

He was an okay professor who seemed interested in teaching, but he mostly just read from his slides which are accessible on BlackBoard. His tests are super specific and you have to memorize every little detail, which is not so great. Attendance is checked via iClicker, but you can log in from elsewhere and the questions are available on the slides.

Muller is an AMAZING professor. He is very well spoken and super flexible if you talk to him about needs help with certain things. The class itself was very easy as well, but is very lecture and note heavy. None of the material is say "hard" but you need to either watch the videos/lecutres to be aware of the test material. Labs were very easy also!

Michael Muller has got to be one of the best professors ever. His teaching style shows that he truly cares about the material he teaches. On top of this, time and time again, he has shown that he cares about the students and has the students in his best interest. Honestly I need more than the 350 character limit to say how great of a teacher he is.

Please show up to lecture!! I never showed up and failed all my exams (that was on me). He is very understanding when it comes to turning assignments in late. He is always extending assignments for everyone. You will interact mostly with TA's, but he pops up to labs sometimes. Really nice guy overall!
I had him for lab only, but he was chill.
He is AMAZING. The best biology--and overall--Professor I had at UIC.

great professor, i loved this class and learned a lot. the lectures were engaging regardless of the topic. tons of resources and materials were given to study for the class that matched with the exam content. free txtbk provided. attending lecture/lab is for your benefit it helps your grade. very understanding, great person overall.
He gave extra credit opportunities and his grading criteria is pretty clear. If you use old tests to study for the exams and keep up with the work, you'll do great.

Awesome professor. Just go to lecture and watch pre-recorded lectures (from covid time) when you don't fully understand the topic. Also, make sure to review past exams, that's the easiest way to get through the class.

Professor Muller is one of very few instructors that actually cares about his students. He is an expert on the material and assumes that most people are learning something for the first time, so he'll simply some things. Be smart and make use of his study guides and past exams, they helped me ace all of his exams. Do the quizzes and attend labs.

I didn't find Prof Muller's lectures to be helpful. A lot of information was given, and it was hard to retain. I found lectures very draining. However, he is a good guy with lots of videos and study material on blackboard. His tests aren't hard as long as you go through the review material. He is lenient with grading and wants you to succeed.

He was a great professor!! Even though I only took this class for as a gen ed, this class was very interesting. Labs are easy, he holds lectures in person and online (you can pick), and gives past exam answers in order to study better. I loved this class so much, highly recommend him!

very accommdating to any issues you may face, gives past exams to use for review on current exams. answers questions well and explains even via email if not in person. funny and easy to follow lectures. weekly quizzes, make sure to use practice weekly problems he gives they have answers to the quizzes most times. lab was boring. one of my fav teach

easy class if you put in the effort. iclicker is mandatory (and graded) but physical attendance is not. i can't speak on his character because you're mainly only interacting with TAs (i never spoke to prof. muller once), but he is very enthusiastic in lectures, clearly cares about the subject and knows a lot.
W professor seriously. Real nice and down to earth and will help with just about anything. Super chill dude and easy assignments as well. TAKE HIM!
This class is way too detailed to be a nonmajors class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Muller was incredibly caring and understanding. His lecture videos were super interesting and helpful. The weekly quizzes are not difficult as long as you actually watch the videos and do the practice problems. I would totally recommend this course. The labs were not too difficult as well. There are also MANY extra credit opportunities!

He is very nice and his lectures are pretty straight forward. There was no final exam and you just had to be in person for the labs that were fairly easy. As long as you follow the class content and do your work, you should get an east A.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor: online classes were the best structured out of all my classes. Responds to emails quickly and is very knowledgeable and personable. He cares about his students, which is hard to say for an introductory bio class. Great guy.

Professor Muller is already highly recommended, I can confirm this from taking his class. I am kind of a slacker and I regret not taking his class as seriously I should have. His PowerPoints are straight to the point and his commentary is great. Him and his TAs are incredibly caring and helpful. It is not a ton of work but you have to be consistent

Muller was an ok professor. Lectures were recorded (good & in depth) because of COVID but labs were in person with the TA's. TA's graded everything and only saw him about twice the whole semester. Seems like a pretty chill guy, but not super involved with the students. Hard to get ahold of him through email. You'll rely on the TA's the whole time

Best professor at UIC! You can tell that he is passionate about what he's teaching. His lectures are easy to understand. He also goes over harder topics in class to make sure we understand it for the exam/quizzes. Weekly assign. are easy & simple. Cares for & will listen to his students. Likes to tell jokes/funny stories in class. LOVED HIS CLASS.

Prof. Muller was the best professor I had this semester! With us being online, he was very accommodating and understanding, and was very on top of his email responses and communication. Bio isn't my favorite subject, but his lectures were super helpful and all you needed to do was watch them and take notes. Really honest and fun guy overall.

Literally the best prof I have ever had. He knows the content very well and is super passionate about it. He always keeps an open line of communication with his students which is nice. Most importantly, he listens to his students and their concerns! If you get the option, take him, it is very worth it.

Muller is an amazing teacher who makes mini lectures for each subject for the unit which are all easy to follow and informational. He also has lectures where he gives an overview of the unit and answers questions while being a fun person. Gave weekly quizzes that were easy if you watched his lectures and gave many extra credit opportunities to pass

Professor Muller is amazing! He genuinely loves his job and is passionate about what he teaches. He cares a lot about his students as well. There are supplemental videos posted for each week if you have trouble understanding the material. Extra credit was offered mid-semester and at the end.

It's an easy A. This is the type of course that if you really want to get an A, you really need to work for it. No final exam but you have weekly quizzes on Fridays. Every so often a Science in the News paper (4 in total plus intro and final essay). Aside from that an Adopt an Organism paper. He gives out extra credit mid semester and at the end.
Hes super helpful and his lectures are always entertaining. The class structure is pretty manageable, theres never too much due all at once. 10/10 would recommend.

I just stink at bio and honestly online school got the best of me. The subject is pretty vast but Muller gives a lot of help for the quizzes/exams depending on the semester. We had a paper and that wasn't too bad, just ended up procrastinating. Solid dude and understanding.

The man. The legend. My man muller. He is by far the most chill prof I have ever had, and he was really accommodating for all students during online classes. It is very easy to get an A in this class as far as you show up to lectures. Half the times he basically directly tells you the questions that are going to be on the quiz. Highly recommended!

Prof. Muller was such a fun guy and by far one of my favorite professors this semester. His lectures were always pretty decent and he sent out weekly study guides for the quizzes, and went over how to do labs during lectures.

Great at teaching material and makes lectures interesting. Exams, homework, and lab are straightforward. Three midterms and optional final. To study just do the practice exams and go to the review session. Lab activities are actually interesting and easy points. Overall, awesome professor!

Literally the nicest professor I've ever had. I've taken two classes with him and both went really well. Super flexible and helpful and nice. He actually wants his students to succeed. Overall, super approachable and willing to accommodate everyone
Guy definitely gets stoned to the bone.

Look at previous exams he posts and study those mainly. Lectures and slides help as well, but you don't have to go to class everyday since he lecture captures the lectures. I personally find it easier to focus watching the lecture capture than going to class. Super chill and funny professor, will give extra credit opportunities.

Not a good lecturer at all, but hes nice. His TAs were all absolutely awful as well. He offers extra credit to make up for the fact he cant teach. The class is not curved. Another science class at UIC where you need to put effort to teach yourself everything on your own. I suggest taking notes and not cramming before exams. Easy iclickers.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Awesome professor. Four midterms and an optional final. iClickers in class but gives opportunities to make them up. Uses Mastering Biology for online homework, but not too much work overall outside of class. Lab is easy, just do the prelabs and postlabs. Study lecture slides for exams. He also gives some extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This is such a great professor and he really cares about his students. But the tests are hard, so be prepared to study hard. He posts the old exams, so you can use that to study off of. He also records the lectures. Make sure to attend class and bring your iclicker. There are some extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Possibly the best professor I have ever had! This man is downright hilarious and very very nice. He uses I-Clickers for attendance but he usually just gives everyone points regardless if you're there or not. He gives out the easiest extra credit opportunities that don't involve Biology at all... not a tough grader 10/10 would recommend

Overall, super cool teacher, No book necessary but you have to purchase mastering biology. It's not enough to know the info, you have to understand it! He is super funny, super chill, and genuinely wants you to do good.

Muller is such a great teacher. You can tell he genuinely cares about his students and explains material in a clear way. He's organized and stays on track according to the syllabus. He's also freaking hilarious. Highly recommend - wish I could take another of his classes!
Lectures were fun and interesting, not too much homework, labs aren't bad, tests are too hard either

Professor Muller is a funny guy! The way he goes about his lectures is flat out hilarious and he covers a good amount of content. If he misses a part that comes up on the exam he'll just give you the answer to that specific question! You'll love him. He's pretty respected and I look forward to going to class because he makes it very enjoyable.

Take him, he is so easy. You just have to keep up on the homework which is some on line and labs. There is a group project, which can be a pain. 4 exams and he posts old exams on BB that you can study off of, the questions are almost exactly the same and they are super easy, drops the lowest. There are a lot of things that you get graded on.
The best professor. Made the class super fun and easy to learn, there are 4 exams and labs every week which were really easy. He also gives a lot of extra credit!

He is so funny! He offers extra credit, you do not need the textbook, everything is on lecture. He also does lecture capture and i-clickers, if you miss i-clicker he will post it again at the end of lecture. Homework is on Quizlet and exams are based on past exams.
Took him during the summer and he was the best! Really fun teacher and made class rather easy and straight to point. Highly recommend!

Mueller is honestly a great teacher and makes the class fairly easy. He posts all his past exams on Blackboard with the answers, but they dont help that much. Go to lectures and read through his PowerPoints and you should be fine. You take each exam twice, once alone and again with your lab group which really helps. Will take again.

His course is among those I like the most in UIC. He made everything fun and relatable. It's only 1 point for attendance in every lecture, so the point does not really matter. I go to lecture to see him, it is enjoyable and really amusing to see him moving around and put his genuien passion when talking about the material.

Such a great professor!! His lectures are always interesting and you can tell he loves what he does. He does Lecture Captures which are all on Blackboard. Best way to study for exams is to look at past exams!! Id say about 85-90% of questions are the same as old exams (switched up a bit but same concepts). Thats all I did for Exam 3 and got an A!

very simple. Go over lecture slides in order to get an A in exams; you get to drop one exam out of the 4 exams. I got a D in the first exam but that's was only because I didn't go over the lecture slides at all. So in short, review lecture notes and write notes while reviewing them. Also look over past exams!

i took professor Muller for bio in the summer. It was a fast paced but he was able to explain everything easily. Very understanding and willing to help with anything. Study the previous tests and focus in class and you will do fine. One of the coolest professors I've had. Wish he taught more bio courses..

BEST teacher for biology. He is very funny, explains things very clearly, and very helpful outside of class. TAKE HIM. His tests are based off past exams, he even says this. The questions might be rearranged like changing one word, but the answer will just be the opposite of past exams. I glad I took him. HIGHLY recommend him.

Muller is the best! There's four exams in the course (he dropped the lowest exam grade the semester I took him) and the rest of your grade comes from labs, online assignments and about three projects. A lot of the exam questions come from previous exams. If you're not a science major and need a lab class/four credits, I highly recommend.

If you're in need of a lab class (and you're not a science major), I would highly, highly recommend taking this class. It's a non-major class and everythingexam materials, homework, and anything else can be found online (Quizlet whoo!) or Blackboard. I never used a book during the course of the class and passed all of the labs with A's/B's.
Amazing professor, makes lectures enjoyable, and actually teaches the material for the exam. Definitely take this professor if you have the option.
very easy class, 4 exams each have a take home portion to earn more credit, one project, tedious homework assignments though

I had Professor Muller for BIOS 104 and it was a great experience! All of the lectures were on Lecture Capture so it's easy to catch up if you miss class. The labs were easy for the most part and very interesting. Prof. Muller is very easy-going and hilarious, which made the lectures fun to attend. Anyone taking BIOS 104 should take Prof. Muller!

Great Professor overall. Does a good job covering material, and is very approachable. He records all lectures and posts previous exams on blackboard. Although a textbook is recommended by the professor, I never really had to use it. Also, the professor uses clickers so you need to show up to class. Just study the past exams and you will be fine.

Professor Muller is definitely one of the best professors I've ever had. I took his class over the summer and even though it was 8 weeks long he found the time to describe concepts in detail & he tries to make sure that his students understand what he is teaching. He posts his old exams, he's willing to answer any and all questions, and he's funny.

Absolutely does not go over the material well enough. He skips over all the slides and assumes you know everything already(If I did why would I even be taking the class?) and gives TONS of homework. Very very hard. Extremely tough grader. Would not recommend this teacher unless you are already a rockstar in Bio or Chem and need it for your major.

One of the most down-to-Earth instructors I have ever met. Muller is always there to assist his students and deal with any questions or concerns. Lectures are casual and oftentimes engaging. His powerpoint slides are well constructed and easy to follow.

Muller was a really chill and funny guy. Not going to lie, some of his lectures could be overwhelming, but he'll usually tell you what's on the test. He goes fast, so instead of taking all your notes in class, go through the PowerPoint before class and then just add to it. Uses iClickers for participation.

The material was clear and the professor was straight forward. The lectures could be boring at times, but they were very informational, so you don't really want to miss. The professor helped and cared about his students. Definitely recommend this professor and class.

Muller's awesome - he's funny and actually interested (and knowledgeable) about his subject. Past tests are up on blackboard and all lectures are posted online too through powerpoint and lecture capture. Powerpoints are clear and informative and the class is a relatively easy A as long as you understand the material but the TAs are hit and miss.

Professor Muller is one of the best teachers I have had at UIC. He is so caring and genuinely wants each of his students to succeed and benefit from his class. He tries his best to make his material easy to understand, and he does a great job at it. He is just so caring, and I highly recommend taking him for BIO 100.

Great professor. Lectures are somewhat fun. You get homework online (answers are usually online). There is no final exam but you will get 4 exams (study past exams and u should do fine and go to lectures) The book isn't needed (he says just buy the code and iclicker). Iclicker is free points. Both TAs are amazing and labs are fairly easy.

Interesting/fun lectures. He's very laid back, and wants the whole class to succeed. Uses 'clickers' for attendance. Book is not needed, as all lectures and PowerPoints are posted. Very understanding and will work with you if you missed a deadline. Labs are cool, too. Definitely an easy A, yet an interesting class. Take it!
great teacher, easy class, it is not possible to get a below a C in this class. he makes learning fun and is very understandable

Easiest A ever. If you get a bad grade in this class, it's your fault probably because Muller makes everything easy to learn and super understandable. He made the concepts perfect so everyone can understand it. He kept us entertained and did his job amazingly. Make sure to look at past exams and try to learn because Muller is worth it 100%
covers briefly introduction material for biology. solid course feel like i learned something.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Muller is the the best professor I have ever had for bio!!!! I actually learned in his class, the book isn't necessary as long as you study and understand the powerpoints. Study past exams and you are set. There are weekly quizzes which you should study for. He NEEDS to teach bio 101!!!!!!!

Passionate about biology & loves to teach; offers good explanations in class. Very funny: Lecture was enjoyable. I wouldn't recommend missing class if at all possible - iClickers and attendance count (for disc, lecture & lab). Exams are not easy, but if you put the work in, you can get an A. Past exams & lecture capture are game changers.

No book necessary, just get the lab and the online code. Homework is super easy (right out of his powerpoints), and lab was interesting and fun. Group project isn't terrible, and you're given a lot of time to work on it. You can easily get 100% on his exams if you study the past exams he puts up, since most questions are from the past exams.

He's an engaging and animated lecturer who makes the material come alive. For a science class, it actually bordered on the enjoyable. Beware of his exams, though, which are deceptively difficult. Use the old exams he posts to study for them.

Chill guy, knows his stuff, super helpful. gives online homework but doesnt really matter if you do it on time. His tests are recycled questions from previous years and he has them all linked so students can view them. Group project can be a pain so choose wisely (you have to learn and present about research being done at the school).

Muller is the type of professor that is not out to get you.  He is very understanding and provides all the material you need to pass his tests.  Accepts late work at no penalty.   He did not give a final exam which was nice.  Would definitely recommend.
Super chill guy, great professor. Material is somewhat difficult but as long as you study you'll do well

Take Muller!! Im a freshman and really struggled with the content of this class at first. There's a lot of info to memorize and you have to apply it to confusing questions. But I started really paying attention and  he's great with explaining and the past exams are helpful for studying. He drops lowest exam score if you take the easy final!

Don't buy the book, didn't open it once, you need the lab workbook and online code.  Don't take notes, instead listen closely during lecture, study power points and past exams and you will do great. Class is not easy, but can't complain best teacher i have experienced at UIC, super nice, helpful, clear, funny, and just a great guy. However, STUDY.

He gives about 10 past exams per exam and if u wanna pass study ALL his past exams because 80% of the questions are copy and paste. Thays all you have to do dost waste time with the book or powerpoints!!!
Best professor in UIC period. Beware! the exams get progressively harder. TIPS: study powerpoints, like really well AND previous exams. Easy A. Beware of horrible TA's.

Mike is hands down the best teacher I'v had so far at UIC. He really cares about you understanding the material and all past exams are available to study off of. Best way to pass this class is to take good notes throughout lecture and  take as many practice exams as you can to study. He reuses a lot of past exam questions. Overall great class.

This is one of the most enthusiastic professors I've had for an older guy. For his age, dude is awesome as ever. Looks young but I'm assuming he's about 55 and usually when they are older, they are not clear and hard. His material is challenging but he's also clear in explaining. Pretty good with email and questions. Recommended. Take him.

Cool guy. Currently have him for plants in my class. Makes it very interesting and is straightforward instructor. I wish there was an ice cube option like the red chili pepper. Although he isn't necessarily the guy women would run to sign up for class, he's cool. Like a goofy big brother. Which is good because he's a teacher, not eye candy.
He made lectures entertaining and the topic is the only thing that could possibly make it a bit dry.  Defiantly do the homework it is easy points and it helps out alot

Amazing, hilarious, and engaging professor. Exams are a breeze if you take the practice exams (he reuses a lot of questions) and go to the review sections where he's be very helpful and straightforward about what you need to know. No curve but you can drop an exam if you take the final. Bombed one exam but still got an A in the class.

Had him for bio 100 and boy was it a rough beginning! His exams are really tough, however if you study at least 1 week prior to the exam you'll do fine. He also re-uses past exam questions so study those and you'll be at advantage. Labs are super easy so don't even stress about those. I stated the class off with a low B and ended it with an A. :)

He was an amazing teacher. It was very easy to concentrate in his class. He WANTS you to do well so he goes out of his way to set up as many resources as possible for you to utilize! USE THEM. On BB and in SES. Tests are good if you pay attention in class. He challenges you in the best way. iClicker questions are actually interesting. Does Echo.

He was awesome! Period. He really goes out of his way to help his students. He takes his time explaining things and he also uses lecture capture so attendance is not really necessary. You need to study for his tests though! Past exams were VERY helpful and questions for exams were pulled straight from there.

Muller is a great teacher. He makes things interesting, but there's still a ton of things to remember. He's very tricky with the tests. All the past tests are available to study online and on your actual test he'll make the questions similar, but tweak them. I found it really difficult to study for this class. Be sure to go to the review sessions.
Muller is so hilarious and fun it's like I'm not even in a class. You know exactly what to expect from him from the first day, and if you put the effort into the class, it's easy enough to pass.

Mike's awesome. HILARIOUS and probably the most down-to-earth professor you can come across. Makes EVERY topic interesting during lectures. Talented presenter given there's soooo much to cover. You have to try to fail because he makes EVERYTHING available to us. Talk to him if you're confused. Wish I could have him for every bio class!

Muller is a really good professor that tries his best to keep his class engaging. There is a lot of material but he is a great lecturer and his ppt slides are useful for studying. Muller has a background in education and incorporates his knowledge into his teaching style and the structure of the exams (there is a group portion). Highly recommended!
Best Bio professor EVER.
He is a nice guy but not easy because he doesn't joke around with the material but makes it learnable. He wants you to learn so will not babysit you. He's awesome, take him!!

Only had him for 4 lectures and feel robbed! I love this guy! Where has he been hiding all this time?! I can only imagine how my understanding of biology would've been if he were teaching me the whole semester.I am not a bio guy but love it cuz of Muller. I would almost marry him if I could. He's that awesome!

Great professor. I had him for BIOS 100, and took him again for BIOS 104. He really wants his students to learn and will go above and beyond any other professor I have ever met. Definitely one of my favorites.

Muller is an amazing professor. He strives to make you learn, not memorize. Always go to lecture! I love how he breaks things down slowly and then summarizes before moving onto the next slide. You need more than a day to review lecture captures. Get a good TA, watch lecture capture, and get all the easy pts! I got a B but bc I didnt study enough

Muller is like your cool uncle, in professor form. Basically, he is the most approachable professor you'll ever have and he is crystal clear as to what he expects from you. Past exams make real exams easy to study for. He also does lecture capture, posts ppts before class, and allowed us to drop our lowest exam score. Wish I could have him again!

Definitely read the book if you're not good at memorizing stuff straight from the ppts. Make sure you get full points on the labs and discussions because every point counts. Do every possible practice test to get an idea of what he wants you to know. He recycles a LOT of questions. Easy A IF you read and make an effort.

Muller is awesome and hilarious! Definitely not an easy A, you really have to work for it. Tests are also very difficult. He usually makes his tests off the power points and uses past exam questions. If I could take him for another science course I would. He simplifies everything for you so it's understandable. Overall, great professor!

don't study off from simply by making flash cards. This is not memorization class. it is a bio class. He really chellenged me how to approach biology. I still suck at bio, but I think it was interesting class.

This guys hilarious and really cares about bio, and he loves cats so that's a plus. Do not buy the book. We literally never used it. He even tells you not to buy it. The mastering bio you can look up all the answers online. No curve, but a supper enjoyable class!
Nice guy! I wish he did more classes. Drinks way too much coke though...distracts me during class. But do mastering, go to class, and study honestly, you will do well.

I am not even a science student and took the class for the fun of it and wow did I underestimate bio!! Lots of detail but this guy's awesome! Breaks things down and simplifies it for you. Funny too. He may have some people he likes more than others but is fair to all. He does his job fairly for a teacher. But there are special people. :)
Damn yo....I'm here to get knowledge and a good grade, who he talks to is none of my business!! Great teacher and very friendly!!

Nice guy and clear cut explaining. Very accessible and friendly to students. But definitely try to get on his good side as one annoying person in my class has done. Talks to him before every lecture, kind of irritating.
great teacher. very enthusiastic, super helpful, very clear. awesome.

Pretty great professor. He emphasizes that lectures suck so he tries to really teach the material. Likes it when people are engaged to the class and answer questions. Really funny guy. TA was new so they were kind of tough on grading which should've got me that A. But highly recommended

GREAT professor, I actually miss his lectures. He makes things SO EASY to understand and is very willing to help his students as he tries to relate to us everyday and make things easier. Do all of your online work, look at past tests, and you will get an A. No effort? That's the only way you will fail. Not that challenging and learned A LOT.

Professor Muller is very clear and makes dull topics easy to understand. His lecture was combined with Professor Malchow's, and I preferred Muller. His portion of the test (plants) was fairly simple. Make sure you attend lecture as the iClicker is used to track attendance. Pay attention, look over previous tests, and you should be fine.

He is awesome. he's Super smart yet simple for the many idiots in this non-major class. Biology was actually understandable for me and Ive take 3 bio classes in my liftime lol maybe im an idiot 2 either way loved the professor (he's funny af) and despised the (unneccesarily long) labs but they were ok.. Great professor & pretty cool class overall.
