Professor Muller is a boss. He's so funny and as a student who loathes science, he made this class definitely more enjoyable. Read your textbook, look at the practice test, come to lecture, and it's an A. Lab isn't bad either. It's pretty simple, just labs and one research paper. Professor Muller is definitely worth having as a teacher.

Muller is great! He's funny in lectures, often cracks jokes, and is super approachable. If you do the work, it's pretty easy to do reasonably well. He goes over EVERYTHING in lecture, and you also get more points if you go.
He is a good teacher but just be prepared to work extremely hard in this class!

I played on my laptop during his lectures, never opened the book and still got an A in the class. Im not the smartest kid, it's just that he tends to recycle tests quite a bit. FORMULA FOR AN A:  1) Learn all the bullet points on the study guide before the day of the exam. 3) Take the last 3 fall practice exams on the day of the exam, and know them

Easy class if you keep up with the work. Exams are not hard if you read the chapters along with his powerpoint slides. Pay particular attention to i-clicker questions which appear in a slightly different form on his exams. His exams only test what is on his powerpoints. but the book explains the finer details. Do all Mastering and lab homework.

Mike Muller is a really good teacher. There is no way anyone should fail this class! He has plenty of resources available to us and he really makes sure the information is delivered in a way we can relate to. I would take anything that he teaches.

Muller is a great guy. Approchable, friendly, smart. This guy knows his stuff. Going to him with questions really helps alot. Just study throughout the unit and you'll be fine. Exams are a lot to cover but as long as you're investing a little bit of time to study you'll be fine. Awesome lecture, easy labs. Overall an amazingly easy, fun course.

This professor is a G! I took his summer class and he's awesome! I didnt do so well on the tests but I got an A on the final which was super easy! I ended up getting an A in the class! But it wasnt easy! You have to study! & do good on the mastering bio so you can get all your points. Also go to class for iclickers! these are easy points!

His lectures are great and you have to go if you want the iclicker points, labs and discussions are easy points if you do them, the new grading on the online homework makes it hard to get 100% but he drops a good portion of everything in the class.  His exams are sort of tricky so make sure to get high grades on everything else.

Probably one of my favorite professors I had at UIC. He is really funny, has great lectures, teaches you the subject well, and is very understanding. Awesome class. He actually made it a pretty easy class too. Take this guy. Muller is a great biology professor.
This guy is amazing! Take him, you won't regret it. He honestly makes you love the subject. Easy class, easy exams, easy labs. OG professor
Best teacher ever, no studying, easy lab points, easy tests.
Just pay attention in class and you will be fine. I messed around in class so I ended up pulling all nighters before his test, but his online notes are perfect and kept my grade up.

This class was ridiculously easy. Memorization is crucial in this class. You memorize all the exams. you get an A. that's all you gotta do. Lecture is very helpful. Labs are a waste of time. they are horrible. They gave me free points.but its not hard. you just gotta do your stuff and youll be fine ;)

This class was WAY TOO HARD for a 100-level class. His lectures are essentially useless as he doesn't even go off of his notes, but reading the book is also pointless, because his tests are based off of the lecture. Lab is incredibly boring and tedious, and he does little to make class or his tests any better. I HATE THIS CLASS!!!

Muller is a great professor who actually cares about helping students learn. People complain because his tests are 'hard', but I found them easy with a little studying (i.e. 10+ hours). It's a very enjoyable class with a lot of payoff if you pay attention, go to class, read the readings, and ultimately try to learn the material.

This was the hardest A I've earned yet. I took the summer course so it was a lot of material crammed into 8 weeks. His tests are HARD. I managed an A on 1st 2 tests and B on 3rd. I was one of maybe 10 students out of 100+ to get an A on any test. They are going for higher order learning but they only test HARD. Homework and labs help pad for points

I don't know why these reviews rave Professor Muller. HIs exams are ridiculously HARD. Its a 100 level course! THeres waay to much material to learn. He wants you to understand it...but thats better off for Chemistry. I use to love biology...not anymore
He is a really good proffesor he will make sure you learn your material.

Muller is an amazing professor! His exams are hard but you learn so much in the class considering the amount of material that is covered. If you read the book and study his notes on a regular basis you should be fine. The i-clickers and mastering biology assignments are easy points. Hes also really funny which makes lecture enjoyable

He is a good person. Labs and discussion are easy. However, his exams are hard. He also wants to you to know why rather than memorize. That technique is better left for Chemistry Muller. Average for exams were all in mid C's. If you are not an independent learner, do not take this class. Wait for the spring semester and take other sections.

The lectures are like lullaby(s). He typically just reads off the slides and ask i-clicker questions to take attendance. The labs, online quizzes are fairly easy, but the exams are HARD. The exams are terrifyingly hard unless you've already had basic knowledge about biology already.

This class is awesome, but Prof. Muller does tend to put you to sleep sometimes, his jokes in lecture are amusing, but the class as a whole is kind of redundant! While the material, homework, and labs are easy the exams are ridiculously hard!
he is a great guy and all but the exams have become way too hard. unnecessarily hard. good luck

Professor Muller is one of the best science professors I had at UIC. He posts a bunch of sample exams on his website and posts notes online. Study his online lecture notes really well and used the book to clarify material. This class isn't bad. I got an A, plus Muller makes it enjoyable with his jokes.

Muller is a GREAT lecturer - he makes bio relateable to students, mostly via sexual metaphors haha.Memorize his notes & do practice tests for his exams, attend/do the labs and you will be fine. If you do well enough on his tests, don't bother with iClicker attendance- just watch LectureCapture. I never went to class, never read the book & got an A

awesome guy and class! Actually enjoyed lecture... made me laugh. Clickers for attendance but you can always hand it off to someone if you will miss. Fall 09 was tougher because switched to a new higher learning but DO THE PRACTICE TESTS esp. ours and summer 09 because they are closer to what it will be like. I acually read, helped my A. enjoy it:)

Mike is extremely FUNNY!! He makes lectures very entertaining. However exams are not easy and there is no curve. Average on third exam was 65/100. He seems easy but this  class takes much study time and effort.

Not as easy as previous comments indicate. Shifted teaching toward higher order learning, made the exams considerably harder. Class averages for fall 2009 are around a 65-70 with no curve. All in all, no longer an easy A, be prepared to work somewhat harder.

Mike's a really funny guy who doesn't take academia that seriously. Exams were really easy if you study past exams that are on his website. Lectures were ok - a little fast at times. Go to his review sessions - they were REALLY helpful in studying for tests - he goes through most of what you need to know. Does give attendance points using iClicker.

Easy A -- optional final - great professor, what more can you ask for from a class?  Labs were alright, kinda boring, but you can finish up pretty fast if you read it beforehand and know what you're doing.  Mike is great at communicating with students and replies to emails fast - uses blackboard too, and test grades are usually posted within a day.

Great professor, no one at UIC even comes close to his teaching style and his ability to keep your attention - I'm gonna miss him. Be warned though, the textbook is dry as hell, but Muller's lecture notes allow you to bypass reading most of the textbook (just use the textbook to clarify some things) - he even posts 5-6 sample exams per exam.
I miss Professor Muller! He is a great professor and very nice. He was one of my favorite professors at UIC.
This man is awsome he rocks my socks! He makes lecture fun while teaching you stuff. Id party with his crazy ass!
mike muller you rock my world! i did absolutely nothing in his class and i got an A. bethany brown is the best TA. you ask her questions and she basically gives you the answers. TAKE HIM, TRUST ME.
awesome teacher! This guy makes you interested in a material and he knows his stuff. They should make other teachers sit in and learn from him.
what can i say, the Michael Jordan of professors.
Funny, helpful, and an interesting lecturer.  Tests are hard but manageable.  Overall, a great 100-level bio teacher.

the best!!!! so funny and helpful! you dont need a book! study his lecture notes, to class and study the SAMPLE EXAMS!!! my highest grade (98) was on the last exam...i only studied the sample exams for that exam! it helps a lot...it just took me a while to realize:(

Excellent! Has great notes for every section. He stresses the important points of the notes he posts on Blackboard by writing them on the overhead during lecture while thoroughly explaining to us what he is talking about. He is easy to understand and funny. Keeps you awake!

An extremely funny and helpful guy - it is a good thing that he has notes online, though, because his handwriting sucks!  Exams are online - there is no excuse for not getting a good grade in his class...
Funny guy, his tests were hard, but if be sure you check out the practice exams. The style doesn't change too much
memorize the lecture notes and use the book for in depth clarification, if necessary...i got an A in the class even with the first edition textbook...great professor!
He is a cool professor. He tries to make class interesting. If you study his notes he gives on website, you don't even need book.

I really liked Mullers approach to teaching the materal. As the previous post says he does present the materal with energy/enthuasm which makes you want to learn. On average, his tests usually have a 80% class avg better than Molumby. I would disagree with him being funny I thought he was more straught forward then a standup come(Molumby)
I had him for only a few weeks but he was awesome. He is very funny and knowledge. Doesn't even look like a professor due to his laid back appearance (I thought he was a TA at first). Take him
super easy. easy to get along with and his test are fairly reasonble. i got an a in his class no problem. highly recommend him!

He's one of my favorites. Most of his exams are bits and pieces of previous exams so just memorize answers from sample exams. Lectures were ok. I rarely went but when I did, it wasn't so bad. He's a funny guy.
GREAT PROF!!!! Hilarious at many times....one of the guys! Overall....lectures online....labs are EXTREMELY easy....just go!!!! Good class....a little hard in the begining though....

he's a really good professor.  his exams are mostly from his lectures.  his lectures are not boring compared to other bio teacher because he speaks with energy.  he finds ways to make the subject relate to college students.  for some reason, he likes to talk about sex during lectures.  he'll give extra credit . I highly recommend him!

Mike muller is the best bio teacher I have ever had. He tells a lot of jokes and tries to make the material comprehenisble for you in any possible way. he is eccentric, fun and very amiable. mike Muller deserves a big kiss for doing a great job, even though the exams are challenging if you go to lecture you will be fine.

Not impressed.  Tried too hard to be funny and prove hsi comic book chops while skimming.  Likes to zap you with trick questions that further prove his coolness.  Often refers to self in 3rd person.  No bitter grapes here, I got an A, but it's all memorization of his lecture notes.  He focuses on minutae.  Lab was dull.  Almost killed my interest.

reviews.comment: Nelson changed the way she teaches this course significantly. Although she recommends 2 books, her powerpoint slides contain enough information for the exam. All her tests are multiple-choice and quite easy. Each test has couple points of extra credit. The homework she assigns is very easy. I was expecting this to be a hard course but it was easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very boring class. She's a nice person, but she really drags out her lectures instead of just getting to the point and then complains that we're behind. Tests and homework assignments online are mostly multiple choice but questions can be very unclear/confusing sometimes. There's also 2 books for the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She explains things very well. You have to go to lecture, definitely. She expects you to read. I thought she was very knowledgable.

I would not recommend her to anyone. We were behind 7 lectures, she cut half the material due to limited timing, exams were multiple choice with "choose the best answer" approach, hardly any homework, and was reading intensive with 2 textbooks. She even messed up final grades upon submission. You think you know ecology until you take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lectures are posted but there's often glitches so just go to lecture. MOST people don't go to class, that's why the average is so low. This class requires DAILY studying. Know every single detail as exams get harder over time. Lab is difficult at first, but gets better over time. Don't take if you aren't willing to put the work in. Class is curved

This professor literally opens the books and points to make her tests. Be ready to hear about iguanas. As a prerequisite know the difference between a lizard and an iguana. Also if you dont have a strong understanding of bios 100 and 101 you will do poorly. There are also two books.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tips on how to ace her class: - Pay attention to her class lectures, even her obsessions on marine iguanas will be on exam - Get 100% on homework assignments - Look at her PPT slides These are what I did to get an A in this class. She will say that she does NOT curve, but a lot of people who had an 88 or 87 ended up getting an A. Hope that helps.
Her exams were all written. You have little room to improve your grade if you do bad on one of the exams.

Nelson's lectures is not bad, just very lengthy and often talks about her research on marine iguanas. Most of your exam questions will be based on the PowerPoints and the few homework assignments she will put on BB. I think she also curves (she'll say she doesn't) because I had an 87% in her class on BB but somehow got an A. Hope this helps:)

I think she had really interesting stories to talk about but overall the class was overloading in chapters to read. She is a ok lecturer but her ppts are very vague. Alot of the detail is from the books. you should NOT take this class unless you are ready to read 10-15 chapters per test or cram a bunch of information.

Some might have personality issues with her, i did in the first lecture. But she grew on me because the stories she tells are interesting and informative. Its nice to have a real life perspective from her stories vs a prof that reads off the slides. Overlook the personality part and she is VERY informative and entertaining. Never went to office hrs
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I enjoyed her lectures very much. She is very passionate about what she does. I read the book for the first exam then didn't as much for the last 2. Know her lectures in and out and be able to apply that information to the way ecology works. She gives 10 points extra credit on the exams but don't overthink the questions!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Had this professor my senior year. This professor alone has dimmed my view of UIC's choices in staff. She spends lectures talking about her past research "glory days", makes jokes about being attractive, and spends most of class degrading confused students while self loathing. Good luck trying to find her during office hours for help on anything
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Honestly, I have never come across a narcisstic, self victimizing waste of a prof like her. She constantly complains about things not going her way yet does not care about anything in her student's life. She does not deserve a respectable job of a teacher when she is this ungrateful and opposite of growth for students.

She barely discusses the material. She heavily talks about her past research, and expect to read more on your own. You won't pass the course if you don't read the book and understand the concept on your own.

This was one of the hardest bio classes I ever took, and thats saying a lot since bio is my life. Exams had 10 chapters on them, & as someone said below, she barely scratched the surface of the material. They should spilt the class into either Ecology or Evolution because its too much otherwise.  Save yourself the pain and take someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: It was a difficult course in that each exam tested on 6-10 chapters each. You need to go to class because she is very thorough and detailed. Her lectures are very interesting,but you also need to read the book. Nothing is off limits on exams.  I learned a lot, but there's an extraordinary amount of reading for this class. Need to be diligent.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Please save yourself the misery and do not take this professor. She is very rude to her students especially when asking questions. She does not seem like she cares one bit about her students. There are two books and the exams have anywhere from 10-15+ chapters on them. You need to eat, sleep, breath this class otherwise you will fail.

I actually kinda enjoyed her humor, but she wasnt a very good teacher.  She doesnt stick to the syllabus and I got very confused by the grading.  I went to every lecture, but the tests revolve around application and the questions can be pretty tricky.  Homework is taken straight from the book

She is very unprofessional. She only scratches the surface of the material during lectures (you need to know way more for the exams). Responds very sarcastically to questions and is overall unpleasant to talk to. Exams are extremely hard and include around 10 chapters each. A lot to study, read and understand on your own. Beware.

nelson is the worst professor I've ever had at uic. her exams are hard she expects students to know every detail in the book. Her lectures are boring. Gives homework assignments late in the semester with a project. DO NOT TAKE HER. SHE IS HORRIBLE!! Take someone else but do not take classes with her, you will regret it!!

Had this professor for a couple classes and will never take her again. She can be funny but also rude. I attended every lecture, took notes, studied and felt like I answered all questions on the exam correctly but the TA kept taking points off for everything. Also, Assignments are assigned last minute and you don't receive back.
Extremely rude and sarcastic.  Tests are hard. She will not help you if you are struggling.  She gives 10 EC pts on the exam. NOT an easy A, not even a easy C. Take someone else.

Lectures are interesting but exams are tough for they test details from the book. Unorganized! Spends too much time talking about her adventures. She crammed 8 chapters  the lecture before the exam and expected us to know them well.  Gave 10 points extra credit on exams. Pretty strict about the cutoffs. 89.8% was a B. This class was a stress!!!!!!!

One of the best professor at UIC. If you keep up with the readings, take notes, and do your homework, you will be fine. She gives 10 extra credits on every exam and easy assignments to bump up your grade. English is not my first language and I was able to keep up with the readings and do very well on exams, what is your excuse?

One of the hardest bios classes at UIC to get A grade. Exam questions are from details in textbook and random examples outside of her lectures. NO CURVE even if you are 1 POINT AWAY from next letter grade. Exams have 10 points extra credit, but still hard to get good score. Homework might help but not much as answers are difficult to find. AVOID!!!

Read this carefully. I will NEVER take her again. Don't get me wrong her lectures are interesting, but her exams are too hard. I studied so hard for her exams and even so I am lucky enough to pass with a C. From my personal experience, if you are good with multiple choice exams suit yourself, but if you are not (like me) DO NOT TAKE HER!!!

She is very knowledgeable and I enjoyed her lectures. There were 3 HW assignments that were pretty easy and accounted for a quarter of your overall grade. Three tests, expect to read and study for them as they each account for a quarter of your grade. Tests are rough, but if you study you should be fine.

The animal behavior lab class is an easy A. I have taken Ecology and evolution plus Animal behavior lecture with her, and in those classes she is an incredible tough grader. HOWEVER, in the animal behavior lab you practically just need to show up to get an A.

She's a teacher that wants to make sure you really understand  what your being taught, not just  short term memorization.  Her workload is relatively low (3 test, 3  hw assignments and a paper) so not  much room for error.  She's very willing to help you just have to talk to her after class or at office hours.  Go to lecture and read the textbook

Horrible teacher, her exams are really tough, she brings things out of the blue. She does not curve the class. Do not take her, take a different teacher if you can. Would not recommend anyone to take her. Will not curve even if your a 2 or 3 points from passing.
Save your GPA. She is good lecturer, but her exams are crazy!!!!! If I had the chance to drop it, I would... Averages are 50-60 % and she does not curve... ONCE AGAIN save your GPA!

I took Dr Nelson last semester and I ended up withdrawing because it was just too hard. But she is really nice , caring etc. I STILL EMAIL HER TIL THIS DAY. SHE IS HILARIOUS BUT i WOULDNT TAKE HER CLASS UNLESS YOURE A GENIOUS!

The test were straight out of power points and power points straight from book.. I thought the material was EASY others disagree but either way if you read or show up you are sure to do well, plus she makes it fun
easy class! The first exam was just like the power points and the second one was even easier. Great class and she was the nicest person to approach.

Her class was pretty easy, but she doesn't curve at all which sucks. So whatever you get is what you get. Her exams are pretty fair and the hw assignments are easy. Just do well on the exams and don't blow off the hw and you can get an A.

Karin is a great teacher. She's super passionate about what she teaches and expects you to pull your own share of weight in class. Read the books, pay attention to her lectures, and ask questions. She doesn't post her slides beforehand, so it's a hassle to write down notes. Always helped me out when I needed it. Careful with her tricky tests.

People said this was the easiest course for bio majors before I took this course and I found it to be the hardest after homeostasis because Nelson made exams extremely difficult and that made it hard to get a good score in the course. I advise strictly attending lectures because she hints on what will end up on exams.

Dr. Nelson has very interesting lectures and her stories are cool as well. Unfortunately your entire grade is based on exam scores only, as there is no homework or quizzes. If you are up for a challenge, go for it!

great teacher, not easy by any means. She does make her classes a challenge, I am currently taking my third class with her, do not slack off, attend lecture-pay attention, do the readings and you should be fine. She doesn't like responding to emails bcuz most explanations are long n elaborate, but if you visit office she will help, do your part

People are rating her badly because her exams are VERY hard. She makes them hard because people skim lectures. Maybe if people attended class, she wouldn't make them so brutal. Pay attention in lecture and to her stories and you'll survive.

First,she's pretty funny and clear in lecture for the most part. Now,this class should be easy since it's pretty much review of general biology, but it's not!Exams are very hard and some questions have more than 1 possible answer(ambiguous). Memorize the tiniest detail in her slides and know all her story examples,they appear on the test. No curve.

If you can deal with a challenge. This is it. But if you're someone who likes homework, quizzes and extra credit. Take someone else. She's not a great teacher. She doesn't curve, no homework, 50% of the time boring lectures that are highly important for the exams. She crams 4-8 chapters in an exam. All in all, don't take her.

Her tests are extremely hard, she sometimes rants about other useless stuff that is not even part of lecture. She does not give homework maybe because she is too lazy to put in the grade book saves her work. Lectures are also very boring its ridiculous, a lot of reading included as well. Do not take this teacher. I had better professors than this.

At first I was intimidated by the course because the exams were hard, but I adjusted by listening to specific examples she said in class and that helped me on following exams. If you ditch even once, that means a couple of points off an exam. This is a big deal because 3 tests=grade. No curve, but there's extra credit on all exams. Funny.

DO NOT TAKE HER! She doesn't care about you as a student. She won't help you. Only 3 tests NO CURVE! I went to almost every class, read both her textbooks and studied ahead but it didn't help. She is rude and not professional at all. If you are a bad test taker DO NOT TAKE HER!

Things she says in class end up on exams, so pay attention! Do the practice problems and read required articles. Read the book because exam contains some book content. Funny teacher. Hard exams! No curve, but there's extra credit.

Class grade consists of three exams and exams are difficult. The key to doing good in class=paying attention to lectures and reading the book. If you do these things, you should be fine. If you ditch lecture, no wonder you're doing bad. Things she says in class end up on exams. Funny teacher.

DON'T take this class. It's extremely interesting but extremely difficult. The average in the class was a 63%. She only curves about 30 points. She asks extremely difficult specific questions like what era certain specific dinosaurs were from. (she uses only scientific names). She's not helpful at all & generally is rude if you ask for help. V HARD
her class was not easy but is possible..just need to understand the concepts and how apply it...above read the book in order the concepts to be clear..

Professor Nelson exam's are so difficult, it is not even funny.  I paid attention to class, took notes, and studied for her exams. For this class, you really need to know and understand EVERYTHING! I will not take her again.

This class is pretty easy. At first I was a little turned off by her attitude and teaching style but I quickly learned to really like her and got used to her upfront attitude. She held my attention during lecture and is pretty funny too. Not a bad class, pretty interesting.

I have taken three classes with Dr. Nelson and never have I been met with so much animosity when asking questions or trying to clarify her terribly written test questions and assignments. Coming from the anthropology department where teachers are extremely helpful without "academic babysitting", the UIC biology department has been a let down

I found Dr. Nelson's lectures to be clear, concise, and informative( and at times, even humorous). There's no lecture capture, so attendance is imperative. Tests can be a little confusing, and there are only three. It sucks if you have an off day.  That being said, I'd rather have another lecture than another exam. Highly recommended.

I don't understand why her rating is so low. She is an excellent teacher, especially since she's able to make a boring topic interesting. Her lectures are great. She hints of topics we should know. The reason she makes exams hard are because people ditch. Exams have extra credit, it's basically equal to a 10% curve if you get it all.

Nelson is a good lecturer, especially since she's funny and hints at topics we should know for exams. Read required online articles, do practice problems, and definitely read the book because the third exam contained a lot of book material. Tests are very difficult, especially the first two. Class is not curved, but each exam has extra credit.
super easy class with funny professor
Lots of tests. Lots of material. This class requires dedication, but she does curve it.

3 tests = final grade. No curve. I got a 66 on one of the exams even though I studied, read the book, never skipped class, and went to TA office hours for help. Her teaching is fine - with lots of stories about reptiles.

Prof. Nelson has problems.  She spends more time talking about random crap that she has done in her research career than she does about Bio.  The slides look like they have been thrown together by a high school junior.  There is absolutely no reason to attend class to get an A.  I'm sure she knows her stuff, but it doesn't come through during class

Her lectures seem to last forever. Her powerpoints are basic and sometimes useless for studying if you don't attend lecture and take notes because she adds on a lot of material. KNOW specific examples in the ppts because they will come up on exams. The textbook isn't really necessary unless you're skipping lectures.
Her class was good and you do learn a lot, however, you have to study because she DOESN'T curve no matter what...so therefore, read the book and study a good amount and you should do GREAT...:)

What is everyone talking about?! Nelson was a good teacher, and this class was NOT HARD. Her lectures were really interesting (if you like bio..), she knows her stuff and has lots of helpful anecdotes. I never read the book; tests were straight from lecture and I got an A no problem just from going to class, taking notes and STUDYING.

I don't understand peoples' critiques about her?? I thought she was actually pretty interesting, her tests were ridiculously easy.. I didn't even read the book. I just read all of the articles she posted online and I payed attention in class. She's a nice/funny person!

If I could go back, I would of switched to a different professor. Grade is based on 3 exams ONLY. I was 1 question away from a B and she doesn't care if you come to lecture everyday. Does not help. Does not reply to emails.

WORST PROFESSOR AT UIC! If you want to do well, do not ever take one of her courses. She Hardly knows her material, does not post powerpoints until after lecture. Her slides are all over the place and make no sense. Her exams are very hard regardless of the fact that you spent hours studying. She would probably fail at her own exams.

I got exactly a 90%, which is the cutoff for the A. Lectures are boring, but she tries to make it interesting by using her experiences. Attend lecture, you would be a fool not to. The reason why she makes the exams hard is because no one attends, so by not going you guys end up hurting yourselves. Find old ppt's, print them and take notes and STUDY
Extremely hard class. Only three exams. If you mess up on one exam, like literally your grade is screwed. She shows up to class late everytime and you can barely hear her.

She is not that bad. There are three tests, all multiple choice. Most of the information is on the powerpoint but a lot is also based on what she says during lecture. You have to read and attend every lecture. Take notes from the book and her lectures and you'll be fine. Study hours before the exam and it will be worth it. For BIOS 230, Nelson wins

So her lectures are boring because she reads right off the ppt slides. lectures are NOT mandatory. exams are literally STRAIGHT out of the ppt slides, u don't even need to look at the book. but you have to study the picture slides too. grade is based on three exams, but she has TONS of extra credit on each. just study, and u'll be fine
WHY IS SHE STILL TEACHING? She is very unenthusiastic about biology, indifferent and disrespectful to students, always late to class! What a waste of my tuition and tax money!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I thought it would be hard at first in her class, but it's actually pretty decent. Most of the questions on the exams require a lot of good reading to fully understand them because they can be a little tricky. Make sure to take notes in her lecture and also to read the book and you'll do fine.
she makes it easy when it comes to lecture, but when it's on the test she likes to use "big" vocab which can be indecisive at times, she's also always late to class

SHE IS A HORRIBLE PROFESSOR. I DON'T THINK THAT HER LEVEL OF TEACH NOR THE BOOK PREPARES YOU FOR THE EXAM. HER CUT-OFFS ARE RIDICULOUS. I BELIEVE THE BIOLOGY DEPARTMENT REALLY NEED TO TAKE A DEEPER LOOK AT THE BOOKS WE USE FOR THIS COURSE AND SEE THAT THE LEVEL OF UNDERSTANDING YOU GAIN FROM THE BOOK IS MUCH LOWER THAN THE INTENSITY OF THE EXAMS.
She explains the material very well. The class itself, all points come from exam with extra credit on exams. That sucks if you are a mediocre test taker, but not a bad class by any means.
If you think you will get an A in her class... forget about it. You're getting a B.

KN kicked me out of class for being high out of my mind. And thank God, because she taught me a valuable lesson about the history of life. KN, you may have a long blonde ponytail, but I don't judge you. You're a good person!!

Attend all lectures! even if they are power points. just print out the power points, attend lecture, and write notes. She loves using specific examples in lecture, which will be on the exam. Main problem occurs with the wording of questions on her exams. There is no curve.  For exams build a vocab list, questions cover the definition precisely.

A lot of people are complaining about her but I disagree for the most part.  Go to class, take notes, read the book.  You know, be a STUDENT.  I've had her for 230/236/335 and done well in all of them.  She doesn't curve, she makes difficult exams and forces you to actually know the material.  It's mostly upper level Bio, it SHOULD be harder.

One of the worst professors I've had at UIC. She does not show any sort of compassion for her students and makes exams much harder than necessary. She mumbles whenever she does not know how to clearly understand a concept and always drinks diet coke.

I've never had a professor who could successfully put SO many people to sleep within a 75 min time frame. Lab and lecture are like two different classes, but I'm pretty sure my TA taught me more than she did. Very inconsiderate and doesn't seem interested in helping. Tests are stupid, she asks the most random facts from her boring lectures. Ugh.

Im an A student. Took her, got the first C in my life. She is the worst professor in Illinois. HORRIBLE attitude problem, couldn't care less about her students, cant teach this material if her life depended on it, NOT helpful, lazy. Syllabus has wrong chapters to read. exams=impossible. If UIC knew what was good for them they would fire her ASAP.

One more thing - attendance is not mandatory at lecture, but it's a good idea to go. She gets mad as the class size dwindles down and on the second exam, she added 4 questions that you would have only known had you been at lecture. She tends to mumble, so watch out for that. Also, another thing that's nice is the final is not cumulative

Don't get me wrong, this class is hard. You've got to put in plenty of work, but if you can do that, you'll be fine. There are 8 exams, each 100 pts, 3 in lecture and 5 in lab. The lec. exams are each more difficult than the last, while the first 2 lab exams are challenging and the last 3 are quite easy. Ex. the 5th lab exam avg. was 89.58%.

One more thing - attendance is not mandatory at lecture, but it's a good idea to go. She gets mad as the class size dwindles down and on the second exam, she added 4 questions that you would have only known had you been at lecture. She tends to mumble, so watch out for that. Also, another thing that's nice is the final is not cumulative.

Don't get me wrong, this class is hard. You've got to put in plenty of work, but if you can do that, you'll be fine. There are 8 exams, each 100 pts, 3 in lecture and 5 in lab. The lec. exams are each more difficult than the last, while the first 2 lab exams are challenging and the last 3 are quite easy. Ex. the 5th lab exam avg. was 89.58%
terrible. questions are tricky.. only a 30 point difference in between letter grades. only gave 26 extra credit points, which was absolutely no help!!

You would think that the exams would be easy cuz her lecture slides are so to the point but you are wrong. They are difficult, you coming out after the 2nd & 3rd exam feeling confident and then get a C or B. The 1st exam is the hardest, messes up our grade. For extra credit u you get 3-5 question on the exam, its not bonus points

You think the tests would be easy because the slides seem so to the point but don't be fooled. This class is difficult. The 1st test is the hardest and after it you can't get an A in the class. You are left with getting a B or C. Bullshit. Don't take her. Plus the extra credit is usually 3-5 extra questions on the exam so don't think its free point
One word to describe her: HORRIBLE!

Exams are straight off lecture slides, of which many are pictures so you gotta go to class to figure out what she says bout' them. 2 exams, 1 final, all 100/each and thats it. Around 30 points of EC, most on exams, and some in easy 2 min. assignments. SHE F-CKS UP grading the scantron, 1 or 2 questions/exam from book, Articles not really necessary

I somehow got an A in this class. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS IF KARIN IS TEACHING IT. Her lectures are VERY confusing because she just puts random slides together. She shows no enthusiasm for teaching and her tests are ridiculous. Only 2 people got A?s on our first exam. It is possible to do well. But, this is my no means a blow off class.

her lecture is interesting... tests seem easy but after i was always shocked looking at my grades... little extra credit is offered. i took notes, went to every lecture understood material but still didnt help.. so i wud say u shud avoid her, u get a bad grade even after working hard.

Wow lady lay off the cokes its getting to your fat head. The other fat ta make life miserable for us healthy people. Stop grading so hard its animal behavior. Its not that complicated animals want to survive or reproduce why make tests so hard.

Okay, these bad ratings are ridiculous. I hate biology and this class was a breeze for me. Who cares if she comes 5mins late and drinks coke, she makes everything very understandable and all you have to do is come to lecture, take notes, and study them and you are guaranteed an A in class, on top of that she offers EC that really helps your grade.

Very unorganized, I attended every lecture and studied from my notes and still did not do as well as I wanted to. To those that say pay attention to lectures, I say not worth it. Just read from the book. She only talks about her research in the Galapagos and her love for lizards. She appears passionate but does not engage the students at all.

SO HARD! we had no homework of any sort, but 8 exams!  lectures were boring and i couldn't pay attention for long. she sometimes arrive 10-15 minutes late for the first morning lecture. lab exams were so painful, and i study. one particular question, we had to feel out a huge bone hidden under a musty blanket and name the bone in 30sec!

She seems unapproachable but she made the class more interesting than I thought it would be. She's actually very passionate about the subject. You can do well on exams if you go to lecture and take notes on it (most people didn't go and that is probably why they complain). If you go and take notes, you don't need to read.

Avoid if possible. Can't believe UIC still keeps her. Very bad teacher with bad personality. Material is not hard but she trys to screw you up in any possible way. Think about ur GPA before taking the class w. her. I am an A student and taking the class w. her was my biggest mistake and worst exper. ever.

Horrible professor! Boring, mean, and unsympathetic. The subject is easy but exams are tricky. She put stuff that wasn't covered in lecture on our 2nd exam. She later on admitted it was her mistake but claimed "that's life." Very unfair class with no curves.

Worst professor at UIC! She doesn?t know what she is doing. The syllabus and powerpoints were outdated. Lectures were very unorganized.  Powerpoints were posted weeks after lecture. She puts material on the exam that she says won?t be on there.  Questions on the exam don?t test your knowledge of the material, they are just dumb questions.

I am an A student, and I got an A in Bios 272.  But watch out because this class was horror.  This class was extremely time consuming and you don't get any help from the teacher who has no sympathy or the TAs. Don't take the class.  I haven't met one person in my class at that time who didn't regret taking it. If you take it, devote ALL YOUR TIME.

The material is difficult at first then once it's understood, you will realize that it's very TIME-CONSUMING.  The exams are very easy compared to what's covered. Exams are straight from the lecture slides.

Worst class ever. There are 8 exams, and when you do dissections you leave the class smelling like cats and fish. Prof shows up late to exams, is not understanding, rude, and doesnt know material well. Labs do not connect to lecture, are not structured, and are very time consuming, time outside of class is required! material very detail oriented.
She is one of the great professors I have seen so far. But be careful, class is not curved and this policy is not chenged, just keep up and don't mess up on the first exam.

She likes to mention material briefly in class and then put a large chunk of that topic on the exam so no one will great it correct. She puts up the powerpoint slides AFTER her lectures to encourage people to come to class, but this is actually useless. She once said after a difficult exam that "Life is a B*tch and so am I." DO NOT TAKE HER.
She knows her stuff, and she makes the class interesting by relating the ideas of the class to her experiences (of which she has many.)  It is a an easy class, as you can probably assume by the name.
I was really interested about what I learned in this class

I took this Nadine for three different classes and I must say some of the most memorable times in university where in her class. She provided an alternative view on feminism which many people do not hear or know about. Please read and ask questions and you well be prepared for the exam. Also, she a little sensitive so be careful of what you say.
Great gen-ed. Discussion-based and the final exam was fairly easy multiple choice. I recommend her class!

She's a nice professor but she is passive aggressive. The class is heavily participation based so keep that in mind. I really don't recommend this class if your taking it as a gen-ed because its not worth it.  Too much work load and she assigns a bunch of readings that you have to take notes on.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Naber is UIC's best! She is super caring, and lenient. She is very engaging and knows how to keep us all interested in what she's saying. Was always clear about guidelines and of what she expected from us. Super intelligent and knows how to get her point across. Make sure you read, because it is a discussion heavy class.

Naber was new to UIC when I had her, but she was way more focused on her research & the other hats she wore than teaching this (mandatory for GWS) class. She truly ruined the semester I had her by constantly changing the readings & syllabus on the fly. 

Hope she got it together for later students.
The group therapy you didn't know you needed. Professor Naber is AMAZING.

She is such an amazing human and is so caring during the pandemic. The readings can be challenging but you learn so much in the class. She always encourages everyone to participate and she is very lenient with the work she assigns. If you want an interesting class, take her for sure. She is so great and UIC is super lucky to have a brilliant mind.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is extremely amazing! Yes, one might have mixed emotions as the topics challenge the common stereotypes. She is one of the nicest professors I have ever had and she is amazing with communication (replies extremely quickly to emails)

Professor Naber has been an ANGEL during online classes! She and her TAs have been working with us to ensure that we feel prepared and that our mental health is okay. Themal (TA) lets us guide the discussion sections and actively communicates with Prof Naber. They also understand everyone's situation and will accomadate! Exams are SUPER easy, too!
Amazing, very beautiful and sweet! I love how she teaches and how reasonable she is!

Professor Naber is the best professor I've had so far! She assigns readings after every discussion, but they are all super interesting. Her lectures are based on the readings (so make sure you at least skim through them) and she explains everything in the lecture extremely well. She is amazing and I would definitely take another class of hers!!

an insanely confused person that cannot teach. he cares more about hearing himself speak than anything else. i'd get a headache at the end of his lectures because he'd take hours to explain something that should only take a couple mins. feedback is in all caps and is hard to parse through due to how verbose he is. do not take! got an A tho phew

reviews.comment: Just dont.

Do not take his classes. Take it from me: trust the rate my professor reviews. He spends more time ranting than teaching. Intense grader and takes months to send back feedback. I still have nightmares, and it's been a year!
This guy honestly isn't bad as a teacher - he's quite lenient with when things are due and sometimes even extends deadlines / makes sure you are able to get a decent grade on due things.

very difficult, gives literally 3 minutes for group work because he spends all of class trailing off on a different topic, sends back assignments 3-4 weeks after submission despite needing us  the feedback for his next assignment. Meaning we can't complete the next part until he sends it back. Harsh grader Made us buy a book we used for a week.

Ive had Michael Newirth as my English professor for a full semester. He is a good teacher overall, though sometimes he tends to ramble. You need to pay attention to the syllabus online and prepare extensively before class. Participation heavy grading.

I don't know how this guy still has a job. First day of class, he says that it's a 100 class and we shouldn't worry about doing bad but then he grades essays as if you are supposed to be a world-renowned author. He also forces kids to participate and answer his questions in class, and if you don't it will negatively affect your grade. STAY AWAY.

This teacher is a joke. He started by admitting his bad reputation and claiming he's fixing it, but quickly proved otherwise. He spent nearly an hour ranting about politics instead of teaching English. I'm here to become a better writer, not hear political opinions. He even contradicted himself by calling the course both important and meaningless.

Literally the worst professor anyone could have. He overcomplicates everything and makes each assignment ten times harder than it needs to be. I wasted so much time on this class, which took away from the effort I could put into my other main classes.

reviews.comment: Just don't take this class if you genuinely have a life outside of college, because this class will haunt you like no other, cause you a lot of stress, and you won't even learn how to become a good writer in this class.

Newirth has experience editing in the book publishing industry and has lots of good feedback despite the heavy workload. If you would rather challenge yourself, I would take this course because professional writing skills are useful in any career field. It took a lot of work as an A student to earn a B, but I feel that my writing skills improved.

He expects students to stay engaged and put in effort. Participation is a large part of the grade, and contributing in class matters, even if answers aren't always correct. If you get flagged for AI, meet with him. He may seem firm, but cares when you meet one on one so make sure you do that.

Acts like his 161 section is the single most important class you'll ever take in your life... talk about egotistical. I consider myself decent at writing (5s in all AP writing courses), so trust me when I say he grades harshly. Disorganized with assignments and practically schizophrenic with tangents/rants. If you're reading this, avoid/drop.

Dear Prof. Newirth, it was a pain to come to your yap session lectures twice a week, deal with your high standards, and indifference. Please reevaluate your teaching ways immediately. Also, please stop grading our work as if we're in grad school, this is a freshman level class, thanks.

reviews.comment: This professor grades every assignment as if it were graduate level work. He keeps restating that this is a 100 level class, yet expects us to complete the assignments as though we were were taking a graduate class. This class caused me nothing but stress. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!!!

reviews.comment: This professor puts all the assignment directions in the syllabus, so I have to scroll through it every time to find the instructions for each writing project. It's really time-consuming.

reviews.comment: So basically, do not take this teacher for ENGL 161, I never knew English could become such a confusing course until I took his class. He complicates every single assignment and makes it confusing. I had to go to the writing center many times to get help on how to even start on every single one of my essays.

nice guy, harsh grader. yaps for an hour straight. hates adapting to tech, assignments turned in & graded thru email. takes long to grade, got two small journals graded w/ 3 wks left of class, started a research paper w/o knowing if my proposal was valid or not. spent 1st month reading a book that was irrelevant at the end. don't take PLEASE
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
DO NOT TAKE, DO NOT TAKE, DO NOT TAKE.

I hate that I have a 350 character limit, as I could write an entire paper on why you shouldn't take Michael Newirth as your english 161 professor. The one thing you need to know is on the first day, he told us not to view his RateMyProfessor rating...

Terrible at returning work on time, feedback is very vague and passive-aggressive, and he's hypocritical and egoistic. He cares so much about perfection but isn't perfect at all himself. NEVER responds to emails, and when you try to talk to him after class he barely listens.

I feel like this class is the only class that seems like a nightmare. He gives so much work and wants us to finish it in an short amount of time. The feedback is never clear as he provides the feedback within my essay, making it hard to understand and harder to find. He always goes off topic in class. I WOULD RECOMMEND TO NEVER TAKE THIS CLASS.

reviews.comment: If you are on your first week in this class, drop it and take another class you are wasting your time.

reviews.comment: When I had this guy's class, everyday, I tried standing a little closer to the CTA's railways.

reviews.comment: As a person, he's a good guy.  As a professor, he is impossible to stand. Take's forever to grade, constantly says "this is a level 100 english class & most of you guys are not english majors" yet he grades like your degree depends on it. DO NOT take this class, take it in the summer or a different semester, even he's your only option.

Newirth is a great professor if you want someone who is engaging and fast paced but expects a very high level of commitment and skill. People often talk about how he doesn't return papers back on time, but he is very vocal about how if you go to his office hours, he will look at your papers then. He is incredibly kind as long as you communicate.

Getting an “A” took alot of effort, but I have to admit, he gives great advice and really did improve my writing. He's also very passionate about what he does. However, his class does need much better organization since it was very hard to keep up with the workload. I suggest to decrease the amount of work assigned so it's easier to keep up.
ENG161 with Professor Newirth is tough, but you'll improve as a writer. The workload is heavy, but Unstuck ai was a lifesaver for practice. Engage with the course materials and you'll see progress.

I don't know my grade as he never grades on time. The paper I submitted in late October was given back to me on finals week. He refuses to change though admits his faults. His feedback is always redundant and never helps. He yaps a lot, and mainly about politics. No tech in class, by the way. I wanted to minor in English and now I don't want to.

reviews.comment: Terrible professor. He takes forever to give feedback and lectures non-stop for the entire class. He gives you an option to switch classes at the beginning and you should take it.

I'm not even done with the semester and I hate this class so much. Although he has office hours, it does not matter the amount of time he expects you to dump into this class is insane. His classes are long and boring and consistently over 75 minute time slot. There is no work time and he gives very little insight on how to structure your papers. :(

Wow. I can't believe this guy still teaches and the fact that he's still able to get away with the deception he got away with. I took this guy in 2007 and by far most fraudulent professor I came across. He is a malignant narcissist and will give aspiring writers that he's jealous of a bad grade and accuse them of plagiarizing. He should be sued.

I like Mr. Newirth, he's a good man, but not at teaching. He's a very hard professor to accommodate and I felt like this was the hardest class I've ever taken. I used to excel in English classes. I almost failed. He's an extremely tough grader and gives minimal instructions on how to improve your writing. Class of Nightmares and I'd steer clear.

reviews.comment: I had multiple nightmares about this class throughout the semester.

He takes forever to grade, lectures are horrible and has way more coursework than other 161 teachers.  Your writing will improve but at the cost of your grade.  STAY AWAY!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I could gush about how great Professor Newirth is, but instead, I'll keep it short and sweet. He is a very accomplished professor, but he is also self-aware. Not only does he recognize that other people may disagree with and dislike him, but he also differs from many people I interacted with this semester. He doesn't try to preach to the choir.

This man... what can I say. He was my favorite professor this semester. I know a lot of people dislike him, but if you just listen to his feedback, communicate with him outside of classtime, and in general look past him being slightly rough around the edges, you will end up enjoying the class. He is passionate about what he does, and seeks to help.

Professor Newirth is a wonderful professor. He is passionate about what he does, and if you attend his office hours and communicate with him, he'll help. He is understanding, really caring about you as a person. He concluded the class by saying that as far as he concerned, he is always our teacher. He really wants everyone to succeed, and shows it.

His lectures consist of incoherent babbling, he is extremely snarky, feedback on material isn't given until weeks after submitted (often close to final draft's due date), feedback is unhelpful (all caps, not specific, use of undefined acronyms), and his time management is awful (only once in a semester was class dismissed on time). Avoid his class!

He's a tough professor, but you can take a lot from this class. I would take it again to learn the fundamentals of writing papers. This class is super useful if you want to get better at writing but prepare to do a lot of work. These skills will carry on when creating your LinkedIn account, graduate school essays, and emails to job opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: The class was very difficult and there were a lot of essays assigned, but overall if you do the readings and go to his office hours you will pass. He grades so slow and only emails assignments. Most disorganized teacher and should be forced by the school to use blackboard. Also explains a concept longer than it should by rambling a lot without saying anything.

When you ask for help outside of class he is passive aggressive and talks you down if you don't write the way he writes.

He clearly is passionate about the topic that he's teaching, and he is very esteemed and established since he's a book reviewer. Though, he does require you follow his outline and schedule, but understands outside concerns and stresses.

Do you like waiting 4 weeks to get drafts back? What about working on 3 assignments, each worth 10+% of your grade, all at once? That's what you'll get in this class. I have never had such a disorganized and self-obsessed teacher in my life. Take literally ANY other 161 class and save yourself the misery of his.

reviews.comment: This man is the absolute worst. He loves to hear the sound of his own voice and spends all class talking about absolutely nothing and leaving students to fend for their own. Don't take this class. If you ask him for help during office hours he'll ramble on some tangent for 5 minutes and then rush you out. Expectations are completely unclear and all of the course material is incredibly disorganized--there are at least 4 different documents on top of tons of emails. He also complains about masks every. single. day.
This man did the world a disservice when he chose to become an educator

I thought Mr. Newirth was a hard-ass but he was also hilarious and genuinely cared about his work. I wouldn't recommend him to someone just trying to "get by" but if you truly want to get better at writing papers and analyzing arguments, he's your guy.

reviews.comment: Professor Newirth was not my favorite. He has a tendency to get off track very often. He is also a difficult grader. He also apparently started crying during office hours. Overall, avoid!

Prof. Newirth truly cares for every student that put effort into the class. If you contribute in discussions and listen to his feedback, you will be set! I always thought my writing was good, but this course refined it. I recommend going to his office hours even if it isn't related to class! You'll learn and have a great conversation, guaranteed.
