Really wanted to like the class. He means well but the work is rough. Felt like my classmates were scared to contribute sometimes due to intimidating nature of the class. Love ENGL and writing but wonder if my future ENGL courses will feel this way. Intelligent but difficult to ask for help. He shouldn't have to like you for you to be successful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have ever had. One time I felt so depressed coming to his class I turned around and walked home. He rambles, assigns his own readings, and grades much tougher than any other 161 professors. Do not take him if you like yourself and your state of mental health.

Does not let students interact during workshop (which is the point of workshop), told a room full of English majors that liberal arts students will not earn money or be successful, often speaks negatively about the university, often passive aggressive towards students, talks over students or interrupts them, not particularly helpful.

He is smart but he's very disorganized. He rambles for about 30 minutes about "administrative" stuff, leaving you bored and worn out. He will drown and overwhelm you w/ essay work. He gives around 40+ pages worth of reading after every class. If you are not a reader, do not take his class. As a first year student, I regret having him as a teacher.

He acts like this the only class we take. He is arrogant and he makes it seem like he is the only class going on in UIC. He is going to make you buy a lot of books and make you read 30+ pages a night. He gives too much homework. He is very scatterbrain is never on topic. He tries explaining something and does not fully explain it.

His lectures are extremely long and kind of boring, but if you write it all down, it's extremely helpful for writing the 3 essays for the class. He is really accessible outside of class and very helpful and actually cares about you and your work. If you go see him for 15 minutes in his office and complete the drafts for each paper, an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: SO MANY PAPERS--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I've never really liked English and I hate writing but I had received a high enough ACT score to be placed in Eng 161. There are 3 papers; analysis, synthesis, and the final research paper (10 pg) along with homework assignments. Newirth can appear cold and harsh at times but you can tell he cares about his students and will help you if confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He writes a lot on the board, so prepare to understand scribbles. You have to read 100+ pages before the next class which is a lot if you have 15+ credit hours for the semester. Sympathetic, but oblivious to student life, especially to those who are taking science classes. He seems to think you're taking his class because you're an English major.

I have always like writing until I took this class. He tends to ramble in class. He's never clear on what he wants. He's very rude and arrogant. There's  a lot of workload in the class and expects a lot from students. He doesn't seem to realize it's  a 100 level class.

His grading criteria is personalized based on whether or not you made changes on your rough draft which makes it easy to get an A.  If you have a talent for writing, though, Newirth will draw it out of you. I've learned more in the last 3 months than I have in 20 years about the art of writing. My grade: A-  Effort applied: 3 hours every two wks.

Lectures are one-sided. He speaks the whole time, asking narrow-ended ?s. Changed due dates to accommodate grading time. Willing to work out deadlines if you talk to him in office hours. Class had intriguing topics, but workload is quickly overwhelming. He enjoys topic, but that leaves him with a lot to say and thus misses discussing some material.

DO NOT TAKE! I have always loved english and this very quickly became my least favorite class. Rambles on about random content for an hour and a half without ever being clear on what he wants from you. Expects way too much for a 100 level class. Feedback in unclear and unhelpful. The entire class makes no sense, never know what he wants from you.

As a human being, he's very nice. As a teacher, he's really difficult to work with. When he writes notes and assignments on the board, it's difficult to understand what he means and he abbreviates a lot. Then he says he sympathizes with all of us since he assigns a lot in addition to the work loads from our other classes, which doesn't seem true.

Mike Newirth is the WORST professor I have ever had. He is extremely rude. He doesn't seem to realize that it's only a 100 level course, and that we have other classes as well. He isn't clear on what he wants you to write in your essays. Went to his office once and he shut the door in my face. I do not recommend taking him.

Michael Newirth is rude and expects a lot from his students. We work and take other classes along with his class, yet he seems to think our lives revolve around his class. He accused me of using an old essay I had supposedly written for one of his paper assignments because my work was "too polished" and did not seem like a "rough draft".

The class I took was centered around cities and he was very passionate about the class. He talks very quickly and writes everything on the board. Taking notes is super helpful as he refers back to old lectures often. You get graded on participation. We wrote papers back-to-back which was overwhelming but prepared me for the final research paper.
I took him for creative writing and i'm so glad I did! His class was small so you must engage in the text, but the texts are all short stories and only three short stories to write. It's so easy!

dont take this guy unless youactually want to learn english!  He would be great if you really wanted to be a write maybe but i did not i jsut wanted to fill teh rquirment and dropped this thing asap. dont take him!

He does expect a lot from you in this course, and he tells you that from day one. You really need to read and analyze the material fully and write a thorough paper to get by in this class. It really did make me a better writer though. He does have an attitude, but he's still very helpful at office hours. Get on his good side! An A is possible!

Rambles on and on and on and lectures are very boring.  But he definitely is helpful if you actually take the extra effort to learn.  He is also very lenient in terms of due dates of essays and such if you actually make use of office hours.  Interesting, smart guy.  But if he's in a bad mood, he shows it and doesn't do a very good job of hiding it

As a teacher, he's not bad at all. All he asks is that you go above and beyond. The only way to get an A in his class is to write 8 pages when the min is 5. Participation is huge as well as attendance. I'll admit that he is rude if you bother him at a bad time.

Newirth is an interesting guy but a subpar professor. His classes are never interactive. He usually just lectures most of the time, reviewing handouts and going over basic grammar and other common knowledge. An A is possible but the workload is ridiculous- he expects you to start a rough draft of one paper while finishing a final draft for another.
Quit defending this guy. He grades hard and very bad professor. Everyone deserves an A. The ones who work their butts off don't. Worst than Glomski.

Newirth may be a hard teacher who gives a lot of work, but he sure does not cheat you out of an education like some teachers do. I put more work into this class than all of my other classes combined, but I do feel like I have become a better writer, as a result. If you want a challenging class with interesting subject matter, then take this one.

Prof. Newirth was one my favorite professors.  He wants nothing but the best for his students.  Some students receive poor grades because they write a BS paper (which he can spot from a mile away).  Take his class seriously and it will pay off.  He's very reasonable and made me a better writer! He may be disorganized but, somehow, his methods work!

I was worried when I learned that he was my professor for the fall term, but he isn't as bad as he is portrayed. He is very lenient when turning in assignments asking as you speak with him beforehand. The work is difficult, but he is always willing to help.

An absolutely horrendous professor. He looks down on you and rolls his eyes whenever he gets a question. No matter what you do, you will not get an A. He's just one of those guys who think the world revolves around them. You need to buy a lot of books that are rather useless. Also, is this a HISTORY Class or ENGLISH? You learn more history than ENG

Going into his class I was worried because of these negative ratings. Although he can be intimidating, as long as you take notes and pretend to be interested he'll like you. Make sure you show up on time, don't miss class and don't ask him questions during class-he'll roll his eyes at you. He has a dry sense of humor talks a lot, but verypassionate

He is a very hard teacher. you have to work so hard and as much as you try he always will give you a low grade. he expects to much out of his students and makes very smart ... comments. you do alot of work in his class and expect to have homework everyday. avoid him at all costs unless you want a lot of work. you have to work hard for a B.

very confusing.  He demands a ton of work and multiple long assignments due on the same day.  Rolls his eyes, talks down and seems disorganized.  I can't imagine anyone in the class getting an 'A' because his standards are sky high. Disliked this class.

He's extremely smart and is very clear in what he wants, but he's as tough of a grader as there is. Eng161 wasnt my main subject and i barely had time to work for my other subjects since i was killing myself for a B. he keeps offering students to come see him in his office, but no matter how often you see him, he'll use that time to criticize you.
He was a hard grader, do not expect an A unless you bleed all over the page a little during the process of writing it.  He is arrogant and does not try to hide it.  His topic in class was boring

Prof newirth seems like a pretty cool guy, but the fact that he makes himself seem like a bad guy on the very first day of class, and the fact that he digresses so much makes him a very difficult person to understand during class. he's not very specific on what exactly the homework is, and all of his acronym usage is very frustrating.

Mr. Newirth was a good teacher. Some cons about him was he was confusing, difficult at first, and very specific, but some pros about him are he's very organized, has great office hours, and has a dry sense of humor, which i found very amusing.
Although his intellectual attributes are no where to be question, his teaching methods and personality traits are major factors why many students do not consider him to be an A+ professor.

I thought he was really helpful and my writing did honestly improve by taking him. He was not an easy teacher where you can slack off and still get an A.  You had to work for that A, but through that work you ultimately increased your writing ability. The subject was interesting and he tried to make everything fun, but it all depends on you.

He really is great and he made me laugh. He's fiercely intelligent, entertaining and receptive in discussion. If you have no sense of humor or intellectual curiosity you probably won't like his class. If you apply yourself, he's passionate about what he does and he'll teach you how to become a better writer.  The best professor I've had at UIC.
He's boring and not too helpful but he does let you know what he wants and what he expects. His teaching style can definitely hurt your grade if you don't like it.

He made it pretty darn clear what kind of writing was good, and what wasn't. He's not the easiest guy to talk to, and he gets off topic easily, but other than that, if you want a somewhat challenging (I do use the term challenging loosely here) professor where you actually have to EARN an A, he's pretty good.

Wasn't sure about this class at first, but really walked out feeling like I actually applied myself. Newirth is a great teacher-not always the most inviting person, but a great teacher nonetheless. If you pay attention, take notes and see him when you have a problem or need help then you'll do well. He gives you the grade you work for.

You'll do fine if you go to class and read the articles, but he's ok with you turning in stuff late if you talk to him. Plus, he's gets off topic really easily, so just ask him a lot of questions and you'll get nothing done.
I think this professor is tough but fair.  If you show up to class, do the work and ask for help if you need it, then you will do just fine.  I like his cultural references in class.

just write good papers, that's all I can give for advice. u can't slack in his class. if you work hard, there will be no reason for him to give u a bad grade. personally i do think hes a bit arrogant but hes a good professor and hes not biased as said earlier. just do all the work n u'll succeed.

the ppl who gave him a bad rating are simply dumb. he's not biased at all, u get the grade u deserve. I admit his class is extremely boring but that's no reason to get a bad grade. i never visited his office hours, but did work tremendously hard on my papers. I got an A in the class. I admit his personality isnt the best but he's a good professor!
hard workers will do well

He's smart but would be better off alone in a hole writing alone instead of teaching young people. He makes u buy an expensive $25 dollar packet of papers tht u only use once! personally i think its cuz one of his essays is in there so he gets $ 4 every copy tht sells. BORING ARROGANT UNORGANIZED. AVOID HIM AT ALL COSTS!! He was nice to me though

He's really really smart but I can't believe he's a teacher. He's horrible at teaching. Always hands papers back late, disorganized, the stuff he writes on ur paper is nearly impossible to read, it's so messy, he's also quite pretentious. It's a boring class but he's not a horrible guy. Very dry, sarcastic, and funny but frequently goes off topic.
the subject and the professor are really boring. he talks about a lot of pointless unrelated crap. hated his class, regret it to this day, dont take!

very boring, he just talks and talks. he thinks what hes talking about is so interesting. if you miss even one of his classes, he'll take it as some type of personal offense. he's also really disorganized and arrogant...he thinks his students are dumb. ugh I couldn't stand him or his voice!

Newirth is pretentious and arrogant, and it shows. His self-proclaimed room-sized ego is not an exaggeration. It's almost required that you visit him at his office hours to kiss his ass. His topic is boring and so is he, unless he's talking about something completely irrelevant, which happens pretty frequently. Personal recommendation: don't take.

his class is verrrrry boring. i never wanted to go. he talks the entire time and most of the time would let us out 5 mins late. never finishes on time. he is pretty helpful but i wouldn't take him again.

the people giving low ratings must have been*****y students. just like any other professor, if you work hard, you'll do good and he'll like you. hes an intelligent teacher and although he talks a little too much he's a good professor who helps his students.
He talks way too much about irrelevant stuff. He doesn't even breathe, he just keeps talking. He's also really repetitive.

He's not an easy teacher and you won't ever get a chance to slack off in this class. BUT, his class was entertaining and very useful. All the intellectual, as well as (relevant) pop cult references, still help out (it's been a year). You had to just work really hard, but it paid off in the end because of how extremely resourceful he is.

Simply the worst professor at UIC.  He takes a personal vendetta towards students he doesn't like. If you are a student that likes to kiss a lot of ass he can be helpful. I spent minimum of 6+hrs a week outside of class and ended up with a B. I went to his office hours around 10-15 times in the semester and he still treated me horribly.
Overall, I had a good time. He is easy-going and really helpful with the material. If you are interested in good conversation on culture and media, check it out. You won't be upset.
While his topic is not the most interesting one in the english department, he is one of the most helpful professors I've had this semester. He can be a wise-ass sometimes, but its all in good fun.

If you're interested in Creative Nonfiction in any way whatsoever, you'll be very happy taking this workshop. The instructor focuses on keeping the readings well-rounded and up to date while making sure to provide context and background for the genre. As long as you attend and make an effort in your writing, you should be able to get a good grade.
teacher is extrememly helpful, and is always available and dependable.

real dry sense of humor, receptive to questions and opinions, always helpful/supportive. basically a music snob, knows a good amount; if you have good taste in music, he'll like you and that's that. the class is mainly a discussion on music/current events/politics, and he keeps it interesting with his wit. best prof i've had at UIC.

Really nice guy and very smart. The class could get a little boring sometimes but all in all not so bad. He's really easy going and flexible with times which was a big help because workload sometimes can get overwhelming.

If you come to his office for help or just to talk he will help you out because he knows you care about the class. Talks about current events alot which was very interesting. He chose intersting topics for us to write about. Cool guy, good teacher.

Readings are interesting and relevant, understanding about extensions and stuff, and grades fairly. The people below probably didn't do their work and magically expected an A/bitter freshmen who don't understand how college works/or both. Sometimes I forgot I was in a class and felt like it was an informal discussion on everything under the sun.

Professor Newirth's course proved to be quite helpful in further developing writing skills. He was always there when help or guidance was needed for an assignment, and he was lenient if deadlines could not be met. I def. recommend taking him, it will be useful to you and it is not a hard class...he actually made english interesting.

His class was useful not as bad as I expected. Workload is pretty light; there's a lot of time to do papers. He also offers a lot of time out of class, which is helpful. He does expect a lot of work, and tries his best to keep to an everyday schedule. I'm an Art student, not an English major, but overall the class was enjoyable.

HE is the worst professor and he never stops talking. We you talk in class, he'll start to throw his opinion in your face. He grades papers based upon his personal bias towards your personality. BASICALLY, if he does not like you, he will not give you the grade you deserve. TRUST ME ON THIS ONE, IT'S HELL!!!!
When I went in for help, all he would tell me is to read the article again

He is so funny! This class is very easy except the papers are annoying. His grading is inconsistent. One draft he'll say something is good so you'll keep it but by the next draft he'll mark it up and say that "good" part needs a lot of work. Hard to keep up but he's very helpful and SO funny. A know-it-all. It's amusing

He's great, he truly wants to teach you the stuff, and his passion for it all gets you intrested as well.  the papers are a little bit of a pain in the butt, but hes always avilable to help, and his classes are interesting.

I really liked him.  He had so many amusing anecdotes and this really dry sense of humor, which made going to class a less painful experience.  Class discussions were very interesting and he didn't just focus on the readings, he made the discussions relevant.  Great taste in music, too.
EASY CLASS. You will get an A if you participate in class and do the work.
A great teacher. You can turn pretty much anything in late and still get full credit. An easy A as long as you do all your work and participate in class.
took forever to get papers back, but hes cool and understanding. thumbs up

Awesome teacher. The topic for the class was focusing on urban conditions, so going to UIC, I could relate to that, and the subject was interesting. If you turn stuff in late he's pretty understanding about things, so usually he doesn't mind. If you do ur work, you can get an A.
The material in this course is a lot, but not difficult. However, she mainly reads off of her slides when answering questions and giving lectures, so it was a dense class
She was so helpful and understanding,  ready to meet you after class and explain the material to you. The study guides she provides are so helpful for the exams and quizzes.

The professor is great but the way the class is made and the grading system is horrendous. The content makes no sense and you have to read the lectures on your own and memorize a million things to do well on any of the exams/quizzes. Study guides are a chunk of written words over 4-5 pages with no actual explanations, just topics.
just dont take her
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This rate my professor does her no justice at all, I feel that she is a great and very understanding professor, her slides are straight forward, sure clickers suck however they help you understand the material better, her study guides are clear on what to focus on the most, sure the study guides are long but they're better than nothing & theyre E-Z
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I think the reviewers below are confusing "hard class" for "bad professor". Dr. Orenic's lectures and slides are perfectly clear, and if you're worried about the price of the textbook, just pirate it. It is a very lecture and quiz heavy class, so be aware of that.

Please do NOT take this class if you don't have to. Graded out of 550 points. 300=3 exams, 100=4 quizzes, 100=10 discussions, and 50 iClicker. Really nice person, but not good at teaching. PPs are a mess and FULL. Repeats herself, goes back and forth. Feel so lost every lecture even after watching recordings.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Teresa Orenic is... Way too harsh on students... The curve gives you a hint that it's rough. You get only 4 quizzes, 10 discussions, 3 exams and iclickers. NO DROPS. NO FREEBIES. You feel stressed and strained trying to figure out what she wants and what to study for. Even when you put in effort, it's not up to her standards. I just wanna cry.

Textbook is a waste of money as quizzes are based on the lectures. She crams a lot of unnecessary details into slides and will expect you to memorize every tiny bit of it. None of it is difficult to understand, just a lot of content. Would recommend making quizlets, fill in the blank style, to study for her quizzes; make them right after lectures.

Orenic gives no feedback on tests, the book is $100, her slides are poorly made, and the homework is busywork. There is very little engagement in her lectures. There are no additional resources given, the slides are the only source of study material. The quizzes/exams are obtuse, and the grading curve compensates for her ineffective teaching.

He is meant to be a professor, one of the best at UIC. He was transparent and genuine. Don't miss deadlines- why I got a D. I appreciated the common humanity he shared with us. He was open about mental health which made me feel less alone in my struggles. He always maintained focus by leveraging strong strategies like random mid-lecture shrek memes
He is a pretty good teacher. I would take him again.

He's one of the few professors whose lectures I genuinely feel engaged with, he tries to connect each finance topic to his own experiences and is rather chill. If you feel confused during his lecture, he'll answer any questions either during or after class. The homework can sometimes not coincide with the lectures, but make sure to practice!
Loved this professor. Lots of information received and comprehended during his class. Classes were engaging and taught me extremely valuable skills in excel. Would 100% take again and recommend.

I don't really do this rate my professor, but this professor had gone beyond my expections as a Professor. He is by far my favorite Professor I've ever encountered with during my years here in UIC, and I'm a Junior. If you get a chance to have him, you're in good shape. He is so eager to teach! Definitely recommend him 100% everytime.

If you can, take his class. It is hard to come across a professor that not only cares about his material but also his students. His lectures were engaging. This is a topic I do not feel strong about and he made it easy to understand. I wish he'd teach more courses. You won't regret this class!
This class bomb yo

O'Brian is the goat. Fin 300 is and can be hard, but he just knows how to teach so well while making it entertaining that you end up listening.. Also - he is literally willing to go above and beyond if you need any help or assistance. Im an Accounting major and am going to miss taking FIN because I wont have him. Take his class and u will behappy!
I don't write reviews on professors ever but Professor O'brien was honestly such an engaging and funny professor and is the perfect professor to take to get introduced to finance.

He's everything you want in a professor. He's extremely engaging and knowledgeable. Attendance is taken at random times during the semester (especially when the weather's bad). Assignments and quizzes and on Pearson. Exams were pretty easy, just get a financial calculator and go through his study guide. Too bad he doesn't teach other FIN courses :(

He's him. Curves tests, hosts review sessions, a little goofy, but very caring. Sometimes class is confusing because it is formula heavy, but easy to catch up me thinks. Textbook was very expensive and I needed to buy a finance calculator for the course, but not his fault.
Very fun professor to take, makes sure his students succeed.

Took him during the fall of 2023, one of the best decisions I made in my academic career. I've had teachers who have surpassed my expectations, but this guy is simply the Jon Jones of teaching. He's straight to the point, offers tons of materials to help you and his lectures are very entertaining. He will enrich your life.

O'Brien is a great professor, his lectures are easy to follow and the majority of his lectures are engaging. The coursework is pretty easy and I feel like his class was way too lenient with extra credit but because of the many extra credit opportunities, he does not round up grades.

Will is an amazing professor and human being. He shows up to class and gives 100% every single time. Lectures are super engaging and he's hilarious. And most importantly, he truly cares about your SUCCESS, that's why his students stay in contact with him after graduating! He always replied super fast and will try to accommodate to every student.

Exceptional professor, profoundly caring and tailored to individual needs. Inspires enjoyment and understanding in class. Homework and quizzes are very beneficial. Would eagerly take his classes whenever possible.

He is the nicest most considerate teacher and genuinely cares about his students.He makes sure people actually pass even if some things are easy other things are harder, he understands.He's really funny too and easy to talk to and ask questions not just about finance but about literally anything in life whether that be entertainment or life advice.
Great professor, lectures are very fun and engaging. Tough on deadlines.
Amazing Professor! The content is really tough but Professor O'Brien really helps you through it. Best teacher at UIC.

The best professor I have ever had in my life. He is extremely caring and accommodating to each students needs and truly wants his students to do the best. He makes this class so enjoyable and I truly understood all the material. The homework and quizzes he gave were extremely helpful. I would take his classes every chance I get.
Great professor, cares about his students and makes finance not hell. Gives solid curves and makes class tolerable with occasional use of dad jokes.
William  GOAT. If you get the chance to take his class take it!!! He is honestly one of the best profs at uic.

Bill is the best. He challenges us to think more critically about financial concepts and helps us apply the content we learn in real-life examples through Excel. The content was hard, but he breaks things down and makes lectures more bearable with his humor. Put effort into the homework and you'll do well on the quizzes and exams.

One of the best professors out there. He's always willing to help after class, via email, or at office hours. Homework is mainly completion based, there's ample study material for the quizzes, and the exam reviews are EXTREMELY helpful. We also got a huge curve on our final exam and final letter grade.
The greatest and most accommodating professor UIC has! Take him if you have to take Fin 300! Like others have said, he is truly the GOAT!

He is a must-have for FIN 300, and you'll be thankful if you do get him. He is a great teacher who truly cares for his students. He makes funny jokes during lectures and makes finance a more enjoyable class. HIGHLY RECCOMEND.
One of my best professors
He is the GOAT, period.
He's fantastic! He made asynchronous finance class bearable. He's hilarious, gives curves on tests, overall very reasonable person who understands how hard finance can be. Take him!

Literally the best class I've ever taken in my life. I was anxious taking finance, but professor O'Brien really made it wonderful. He is one of the few professors who not only are teachers, but also remain people. Very caring and thoughtful of each student in class, even though it was asynchronous. He really tried engaging everybody. TAKE HIM!

This professor is really great, the homework is easy, and I will admit I missed a few and still ended with an A. If you fill out your homework each week, the quizzes and tests are a breeze. The excel assignments are very difficult though, I definitely recommend finding a partner and setting aside time because they are worth a lot of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof O'Brien is one of the best professors at UIC. I'm not surprised he has a 5 average rating, I would be surprised if it was lower. He is super caring and wants you to not only learn but truly understand what and why you're doing it. He'll extend deadlines and give extra credit, I was worried taking a finance but I'm so glad I took it with him.

Greatest professor of all time. Very understanding and tries to extend deadlines as much as he can for students. Genuinely cares about his students well-being, understands that we have other classes and the workload is too much sometimes, and he's VERY generous during these online classes and understands that its not easy for everyone. Great man

Great Professor! Class was interesting, assignments were clear and alot of practice quizzes and practice exams were provided in preparation. Also, there was extra credit offered numerous of times, on exams and quizzes.
He is one of the best professor I have ever had. He really cares about his students.

Bill is the DUDE. He treats students with the utmost care and respect. He WANTS you to understand the material and PASS! His class is entertaining yet educational. The class and his demeanor are both super easy going and he wants to make a one-on-one connection with as many people as possible and does so by being so approachable. TAKE HIM!!!

Such a great professor. Really cares about his students actually learning the subject. I've used a lot of what he has taught me in my corporate job. Just do the work, do the studying, ask for help and you will pass.

Amazing professor. For exams and quizzes, just do the past papers that he provides, and you will ace it. The Excel projects definitely made me wanna rip my hair off lmao. The group projects are slightly complex, so email him questions. Word of advice, he takes academic dishonesty very seriously. Do not plagiarize in group projects. He WILL penalize
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Hilarious

reviews.comment: To be honest, the best professor I have ever had in my life. He DOES care about students, he cares about you getting a great knowledge which leads to a good grade. He is very passionated about his class. A real professional. Also, he is super friendly.
Prof. OBrien. If you are reading this, youre an amazing professor, but the GROUP PROJECT MUST GO!

This is easily the best professor that UIC has to offer. I wasn't sure Finance was for me until I took FIN301 with him this semester. He pushes due dates, grades more than fair, is absolutely hilarious, and genuinely cares about what he does. I cannot express how much I enjoyed coming to class. I wish he taught more classes!

Throughout my four years of college, he is definitely the BEST professor I have ever had. He gives everyone a chance and curves tests, even though they are super easy. Makes class enjoyable and is funny too. I highly recommend taking him whether or not you're majoring in finance.

Great professor. One of the best at UIC. Truly caring. He will do anything it takes to make his students succeed. He makes the material easy to learn due to his teaching style. He is funny and shares a lot of relatable stories about his personal life. Only thing to be aware of is the group project. It is challenging, so choose your group wisely.

He is a great professor and he will do anything to make you successful in the future a lot of connections he give students and makes you feel like a somebody not a nobody. Everyone who goes his office hours and see you pay attention of his work. His assignments are easy but you need to understand the material. You will learn excel and useful stuff
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is the best professor at UIC for a reason. Take him and you'll love going to his classes. Super fun and gem of a person during his office hours, will help you a lot. You won't regret it.

He is a great professor, he tells joker throughout his lectures to wake up the students and for the class to not be boring. He applies concepts to the real world. The quizzes are similar to the practice quiz as well as exams, excel homework is somewhat easy, and other homework are easy. He takes random attendance...
Good guy, understands students and lectures are hilarious.
My favorite teacher at the UIC. Never thought I would "enjoy" studying finance. O'Brien is a caring prof who educates at his own style. 10/10 would do again

Great teacher. Tells jokes to wake you up. If you do the homework and study guide you will pass exams. You can use the later edition for his class, just double check with him. There is a group project in the end but easy, if you start it ahead of time. He takes random attendance for points so miss if you want.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at UIC. The only problem I had in his class was the excel project but it's not that hard. I ended up getting 94 or 95% in the class. UIC needs to have more teachers like him.
Tries his best to make lectures entertaining. Really nice guy, you can tell he wants everyone to learn and pass.

He is amazing and I felt in love with his extremely nice personality. I never felt bored in his lectures, he is a young and extremely educated professor with so much information to offer. He makes lectures fun and useful. if you want to go to the class happy and leave happier, take it with him.

Hands down... best professor on campus. Great personality, cares about the students. Will definitely be on the lookout for more of his classes. He gives several quizzes and tests, Non-cumulative btw, and curves like crazy. Records lectures and gives "extra help" lectures for tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: By far the best professor I have had. He is passionate about the subject and it shows in his teaching. He made some of the tough concepts really easy to understand. All of his lectures are online. The HW is really easy and he also gives out practice quizzes/tests. The Excel project is easy. The group project is not too hard but start early.

best professor at UIC. would take this class again. His class isn't even hard, everyone can get a easy A. Exams are the same as the practice test. If you want to get an A in all the exam, I would say go or watch his exam review. The exam review are only 1 hour along and don't even have to attend class.

One of the best profs at UIC. The guy is very entertaining, caring, and humble!! He really wants you to do well in the class, exams/quizzes aren't meant to be hard, he gives practice quizzes and tests that are similar to the real ones, homework is more for just practice (online) and not to screw you over. Awesome class overall.

I would take him again because he is enthusiastic about teaching Finance. I didn't find it particularly hard because he explains everything very clearly. There is barely homework, and they are easy to do. Quiz and exams are straightforward. I love this guy to bits. He's funny, down-to-earth, & charming prof. No joke, I am low-key crushing on him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: What a great guy! Two exams/quizzes which are almost identical to the practice ones. Random attendance, hw is easy, and a group project that isn't too bad. He will always help you out with questions. Humble guy and I will definitely miss this class. Easy A

I read all of his positive reviews and couldn't believe how everyone had good things to say about him but after taking his class I get it! He doesn't have an ego, he is humble, approachable, and he can teach finance. Points are earned through doing online hw, access core is required, 2 in-class quizzes, 2 exams, attendance, and a group project.
Great Professor! He is the only one that I like his teaching style in UIC. Go take his class, you won't regret !!!

I love this guy. Makes finance, dare I say, a little bit fun. He's hilarious and extremely relatable. Your grade consists of a well rounded amount of different material. Randomly takes attendance, so be sure to always show up to class. Gives practice quizzes and exams. Lots of help if you need it too. Highly recommend!

Such a sweetheart! Quizzes and exams are very similar to the practice version, and he makes sure to go over them in class before taking the quiz/exam. He also posts all lecture slides and lecture capture on Bb. Takes attendance randomly, doesn't allow graphing calculators, and this class does require myfinancelab access code. Overall funny & caring

I'm so glad I took this class with Professor O'Brien! There is work involved, which I don't mind doing as long as the instructions and material are clear enough to work with. I don't really like anything to do with numbers so these kinds of classes are a pain for me as it is, but taking the course with him made it bearable :)
Easy  class if you show up and pay attention to the power point slides he makes sure you know how to do all of the calculations gives practice exams that are similar to the real exam

He's a really great professor. All of these reviews so far describe him well. I didn't try too hard in the class and got a B, but if you put a little extra  effort you can get an A. Best professor at UIC!

Best professor I have had at UIC. I am not even a Business major (Poly Sci to be exact) and he made finance come so easy to me. He takes the time out for every student and is extremely enthusiastic about what he is teaching. He takes attendance at random and his tests are a good enough curve. There is no reason why you should not get at least a B.

O'Brien is very helpful outside of class. His lectures are somewhat boring even though he has a lot of beneficial things to learn. As long as you know what your doing on the practice tests, you'll get at least a high B on the real tests (2 midterms). Go to class for attendance points and start on the group project early.
Take this professor if you have the chance! He is enthusiastic when teaching and always willing to help you understand the material if you're having a tough time. He loves what he does and it shows.

Amazing professor! Topic of the class is not too interesting but you can tell he is passionate about it, and he makes the lectures interesting.  He cares more about his students actually learning the material than he does about being a tough and unreasonable grader. Would definitely recommend him to anybody.

He is a really nice and caring  professor. I would say this is an easy B class if you literally B.S everything. Put in a little more effort, and you can easily get an A. There are specific days he takes attendance. There are 3 excel assignments, which were kinda annoying, but there are very detailed instructions to help you. Really liked the prof.!
Invest in a financial calculator.
You must take him. Best professor at UIC

Best teacher in finance and it's a shame that this may be the only class I have with him. Makes all lectures fun and interesting and posts lectures on echo. Actually knows what he's teaching, absolute genius. Helped finalize my decision in majoring in finance. Caring, compassionate and understanding teacher, is humble and willing to help. Take him!

Professor O'Brien is great! The material can be tough, be he is very clear with his lectures and his class is enjoyable. Attend the exam reviews and you will be able to pass his tests. Your grade will reflect the effort you put in outside and inside class. I'd take his class again if I could.
He's a really great professor and he's helpful. I highly recommend him to anyone taking Finance 301.
He's the best Professor for Finance. His knowledge is simply brilliant. I definitely recommend him.

Best professor at UIC! He is very clear on what he expects from his students. He also knows how to teach. He doesn't expect us to teach ourselves and he teaches the material at a good pace. He's great at replying to emails. If you put in the work, you will get the grades. Tests/homework are fair- I'd highly recommend him for any class! Learnt a lot

Hands down the best professor at UIC.  He is a compassionate, intelligent, and humble human being. He is an amazing teacher and a good man (he is the kind of man you want to marry). He explains everything so well and I never feel like I am lost. He genuinely cares about the students and wants us to succeed. And he is enjoyable to look at  ;)

Professor O'Brien is a great professor and human being. He treats students as his equals while commanding respect. He truly cares about students' understanding of the material. He is also very organized and does a good job of clarifying the more difficult material. He is approachable, easy going, knowledgeable, and genuine.

It was his first year teaching and he may be one of my favorites. He's funny and makes the class easy. Show up to class for attendance, the homework is graded by the time you spent on it, and the practice tests help tremendously for studying. The group project wasn't too bad: 15 ?s for 5. You don't need the book but buy a financial calculator!!

Great professor. Exams follow his practice ones online and he'll curve them as well if need be. Lectures are clear and easy to keep up with, and he'll take attendance on random days for credit. Gives extra credit at the end as well, I definitely recommend him.

Great teacher for his first semester. Everything was easy until the group project, which was a bit harder, but still easy. Textbook is not required, but the online code is. Points are awarded for attendance on random days, but you can check in online if you cannot make it to class.

Dr. Ondrus explains the content in a lot of detail, and if you pay attention during lecture, you will learn a lot from it. She answers questions well, especially in her office hours, and does a great job of distilling challenging content into foundational concepts for better understanding. Complete projects ahead of time to ask the TAs questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is very challenging, as homework problems tend to not resemble the exams. The projects had some unclear directions and we had to ask for clarification. She helps clarify some material if you go to office hours. The slides are good and the primary source for review. She curves based on class performance, but exam averages are very low.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures were useless (literally only for iclicker points). Textbook was useless. 60% of your grade in this class is exams alone. If you want to survive, assume anything and everything on the lecture slides will appear on the exams. Take notes and do all the practice problems over and over again until you go numb. Then, pray.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Genuinely a terrible person and even worse professor. She cannot even answer a simple question without having to revert back to a slide. How you going to call yourself a "doctor," when you cannot even answer a simple content question?? TAs are even more useless and braindead and seem to hate undergrads as if they were not and immigrated here

She is THE WORST professor I've ever had at UIC and the chem department. Homework, book problems, or practice exams will NEVER represent the exams and her lectures are extremely unhelpful as she asks google, or worse, gemini AI for answering questions during lectures. Genuinely, either take with another professor, or read the lecture slides + pray.
Terrible professor.

Never in my life I thought I would write a negative review for a professor, but she deserves one. She always had a negative attitude was always clueless when she got asked any question and her best answer to those were "yea I guess that's right". Horrible professor and I can't emphasize that enough, save your grade and your gpa!

Never have I had a professor or teacher so bad up until now that I had to write a negative review about them. She provides resources for the exams, but they do not reflect what you're actually being tested on. There's really no way to review for the exams other than to hope for the best and pray that her or the TAs take mercy on you (they won't).

reviews.comment: Honestly no point in saying much. Just a terrible person, professor, and class
Do NOT take this class, save your GPA and take it w another prof.

Ondrus and her TAs have a underlying hatred for undergrads. They don't attempt to meet you at undergrad level but treat you as inept and with contempt because you are undergrads. I questioned my intelligence in her class, not a great feeling. Its obvious Ondrus and her TAs don't want to teach and you're more a burden to them than a student.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: horrible. worst class of my life. somehow tries to fit what seems like 2 weeks worth of information into a 1 hour lecture and she basically reads off the slides without explaining. everyone stopped showing up within the first month. insanely test heavy, even the TAs dont know what theyre doing, projects are vague but graded horribly, ruined my GPA

Terrible person and professor. Clearly does not want to be here and teach. TA's were beyond clueless and brain-dead. Just sad how UIC seems to let its Chem department be so poorly run and managed. Only class that has warranted me to write a poor review. Take it in the fall to avoid this professor since she believes life is all about research. Sad

The class was an afterthought for the clearly disinterested prof who was also unprofessional, dismissive, and disrespectful. The TAs and prof regularly contradicted one another. There were a number of instances of bait-and-switches where the prof promised one thing and then operated quite differently. Poor use time and money.

This class was an experience. First, time I failed an exam. READ THE TEXTBOOK. The homework and study guides tended not to match the exams, and the instructions for the 1st project were unclear. The tests were mainly free response. The TAs were not helpful. However, the curve was amazing (a 79 was an A) so I can't complain too much.

Absolute worst experience of my life. 75% of the grades are exams that have no study guide or preparation at all. She reads the slides directly copied from the book "lecture." I stopped attending after week 2. She really can't teach, idk why the department let her lead such a hard class. Projects are both 5-10% combined, HW is 10%.
If you can get a different professor then I would
Pretty chill tbh. There's a mostly regular homework schedule so just keep up with that and you'll be fine. Lectures can be a little boring but if you really lock in, you'll get the material.
Class was very fair. The main worry is the tests, but as long as you do the practice tests, they'll feel pretty light. Olga was really nice but a bit quiet, so make sure to sit close to the front.

Olga was a very nice professor and seemed super caring, I would say the things we would learn were overcomplicated and could be explained in a more simple way. Also, about 60% of what we learned in this course we were not tested on and the study material was generally more difficult than the exams. Great course but just study some extra.
Found it hard to understand the topics discussed in class, as the explanations of the work were not thoroughly explained and were quickly glossed over.
loved this class, would take again she was really good at explaining and if you did the work you were fine.
loved it, would take again with her she was so good at teaching

As a non-mathematics student the class was definitely tough, but that should be expected for a proof-based course. The homework took quite a long time, but provided helpful practice and insight. Random problems graded for accuracy, the rest participation. Very helpful professor during office hours, and the exams were fair and manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: prof is average. she just teaches but her teaching is very simple and isn't too confusing. the only thing is she tends to make A LOT of mistakes during her lectures and students would point it out. she's super nice however and if someone didn't get their attendance properly in she lets students have a second chance. overall she's good.

I am a CS major and I asked if I can take the class all online and she said yes. Material is heavy proof based and CS 151 like so if you did well on that then you should get a pretty good grade. Worksheets are graded leniently and exams are kinda tough but class is curved a little bit so you shouldnt stress.

She is very kind-hearted, cares about her students, and grades on time. The course material is complex, but she is ready to answer questions and help any of her students. Just be prepared to do the worksheet (homework) every week; that is a straightforward curriculum and syllabus.

Olga was incredibly good at explaining very abstract concepts to us and would always go out of her way to answer every question in detail!

Was available and very helpful during office hours and after class. Homework is very manageable and helps a ton with the course. She gives some EC, is easy on grading, and gives note sheets for tests.

I highly recommend anyone taking Olga. Her lectures are amazing. She is very organized which I like and thats a must for me. I feel like she was almost "born" to teach. She is definitely the best math teacher I have had at UIC.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is such a great teacher. At the beginning of every lecture, she starts by asking if anyone has any questions whether that be from MathLab or Crowdmark which is super helpful for homework. She also takes the time to go through small detailed steps that most profs skip over. Only note is that she doesn't have lecture capture which is annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Abstract Algebra. Required Major class. Difficult class. At first, she did not teach well and simply instructed information without it making sense to us. After everyone did bad on first exam, she tried helping more and added more computational exercises. Test and homework were hard. Not a bad teacher, but she could not teach this difficult course.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: she is a very qualified teacher although she sometimes makes some mistakes. She teaches well and whenever you ask a question, she will try to explain it as best as she can. Take her. An easy A. My best professor ever.
Don't take her. Trust me. She doe not teach she just writes a problem on the board and expects you to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She takes her time to explain the problem. Go to her office hours and connect with your TA
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She's a great professor and is willing to add points to exams if you reach out and ask her. The lectures are slightly boring, however the exams are not too bad and she goes over everything on the exam before during lecture. The discussion section of this class is also very helpful.

Olga is a wonderful professor. I enjoyed her lectures and they were fairly helpful. She is pretty clear about the expectations and is always willing to help. I would certainly recommend her. The class itself is pretty easy but you need to put in the necessary work to do well. I would certainly take her again. Note - her accent can get in the way.

She is an okay teacher. She gives occasional pop quizzes to check attendance, but she ends up dropping the lowest quiz and homework score. Attend the lectures so you are able to learn the material but depending on the TA you get you might learn better from them instead. Lectures can be boring but the material is pretty easy to understand.
She was really cool, MUST do homework, and try to do well. Make sure you look over your graded test because everyone makes mistakes. And yes she curves if needed.
Defiantly do the reviews she gives you before tests, they help a ton. You also might have to sit near the front if it's a lecture because she writes pretty small.

She was really nice and she definitely does curve. The class was hard for me but I took 215 at the same time so I didn't know much about proofs. Weekly homework, one midterm and a final. We were supposed to have quizzes, but that didn't happen. We also didn't have a syllabus. Your grade is basically how you do on the final.

For those who haven't done any proof-based classes before, Linear Algebra will be a difficult topic. The homework is mandatory, and she grades it on correctness; it's hard to do well on them, but it really does help understand the material. Sometimes it's hard to follow what she is teaching, but she answers questions thoroughly. Overall, not bad.

Good teacher. If you attend lecture/Discussion and take solid notes the class is easy. She likes to help her students and is willing to stay  after class. Overall, attend ALL LECTURES/DISCUSSIONS, and you can receive a B.
She is a very nice teacher. I definitely recommend her for Calculus III.

She is great! Clear, concise, and LOTS of examples. She doesn't mind going over homework questions that you don't know! Sweetest lady and math teacher I have EVER HAD!! She makes everyone well prepared for the tests! Take HER!

Her lectures were okay but she was definitely not helpful outside of class. She wouldn't correct your proofs you showed her and help you understand it, she would just cross it out and tell you to redo it, or do it for you.  Felt like I didn't learn a thing the entire class and 0 partial credit.

English may not be her first language (her voice is low too), but yet she is way more clearer than most of the other better english speaking professors and not as garbled. She's hard, but not in an unfair way. Both times I had her were for retakes and her lectures really helped me to understand the material and move on to graduate.
I liked Olga a lot. Helpful, but sometimes not the clearest.  I thought it was funny how she says the word "square"

I feel that she is not very good in explaining calculus. Believe me I have experienced many Math teachers in the past. The good thing about her is that she is very helpful and answers all your questions.A Nice person by heart. She makes Math 180 an easy class if the student is ready for some self study.
Gave good, clear lectures. Lots of examples and did HW problems in class. Very reasonable with quizzes and HW. Do the HW, listen, and skim the book once and a while and you should be fine.
I think she is one of the most helpful professors there is. But the exams are not easy and you will have to work really hard if you want to get a good grade.

Olga is great for pure mathematics courses. She might not be as creative but she is clear and concise. Just make sure after class you look over the proofs and the ask questions! She sincerely cares and thankfully knows her content very well. She is one of the best at UIC if you give her a chance and you do your part as a student.

Olga is a great profess for this course. She is hard but she gives a lot of examples in her notes. GO TO OFFICE HOURS! It helps a lot and clarifies a lot of the things you probably didn't understand in class. The homework is hard and so are exams but it is a proofs class so that is kind of expected. She's worth it.

I thought she was amazing for Linear Algebra. Her lectures and notes explain the concepts significantly better than the book. She was also VERY flexible and helpful during office hour. Was able to clarify abstract concepts such as Vector Spaces, Linear Transformations, Kernel, etc. I would strongly recommend anyone to take her for MATH 310.

In my opinion, she is a great professor. She helps during office hours, which includes office hours that are not listed on her syllabus. Some people who gives bad comment about Professor Kashcheyeva, they should consider their position, Bachelor vs. Ph.D...

One of the best math professors I've ever had! She gives plenty of examples and is very helpful if you have any questions at all. Just do the homework and go through her examples and you should be fine! I totally recommend her! Only thing is she does have a bit of an accent .. but it wasn't too bad!

Olga goes through the material very quickly and is sometimes hard to keep up with. The exams are pretty difficult. Calculators were not allowed for our first exam. There's no need for that kind of strict teaching. We live in an age of technology now. Why not allow a cheat sheet for the exams? Your students are going to cheat anyways. It's a fact.

I asked her if i could take the first exam a day early more than a month in advance and she wouldn't bend. this is complete nonsense. for 310 she is a decent teacher if you can stay awake, but she speaks in monotone so this is hard to do. I'm hoping for a A in the class tho. Also, in her office hours she gives off many snide remarks.

She is a decent teacher, there are much better ones at uic. She is not understanding at all and her office hours are useless. I got a A on the final and ended up with a C in the class because i couldn't take the second final due to personal reasons. She wouldn't let me postpone it or anything. She is mean
Good teacher. Calc is calc, so you pretty much need to do most of the work on your own. She's good at clarifying, but you need to ask.
Good proff, very knowledgeable on the subject. Easy tests if you prepare yourself for them, and know exactly what material to expect to be covered in the tests.
Hard tests..but hey it's calculus. I think she was a great professor and very clear on what she wanted you to learn.  Just study

Olga is a pretty decent teacher. She explains the material pretty well but she has a very soft voice and refuses to use a microphone. Her exams are somewhat difficult but if you do the homework you should be well prepared for the exams and quizzes.
Her class is almost impossible to sit through. Watch out for trick problems on her tests.
She is a very tough teacher. Picks hard problems for tests and quizzes. For some reason she refuses to use a microphone in a large lecture hall.
Very nice professor. Exams are OK. Does very good review sessions. Make sure you do the homework.
She is a great prof. Her explainations are clear. She is very nice and helpful. The tests are hard tho. but 85 or > is an A.

She is the best 180 teacher. She teaches the material very well so that you can understand it, if you don't she will explain it to you. She reviews for the exams and what she goes over in the class is on the exams. She curves the exams and class. BEST teacher I had for Math.

she is a very good prof. she moves fast and doesn't explain the material as well.  she is very nice and helpful.  her exams are somewhat easy.  i think she is best math 181 prof...unlike the rest, who are hard.
good teacher and easy tests
she's alright.. moves fast but definitely knows what she's talking about.. tests are not too bad.. the 85+ for A is helpful.

Very good professor, very kind in one on one situations and is very willing to answer questions during class. She may be a little hard to understand because she has an accent and moves a little quickly in class, but you can't exactly blame her for these pitfalls. Tests are rather easy. You can confidently choose her courses.
Goes to fast in class. Exams are pretty easy and straight forward if you study for it. STUDY THE PRACTICE EXAMS!
average teacher. accent. theres probably worse.
she's alright.she explains a lil fast...definitely need to go home and do extra practice. 85 and up is an A.if u put effort, you could get an A! tests are decently hard.
Really amazing!

I have had many instructors in my lifetime, never have I come across a professor that does not understand a life medical emergency. I reached out over email, stating my circumstances, and she responded with an extension. I assumed she would have gave me full credit for a medical emergency, she did not. She completely docked my grade. Disgusting.
I found her to be outstanding, the best professor in my degree.
An inspiring professor who I will forever consider the person who changed my life.
A brilliant teacher who really inspired me to be better, and work to achieve my goals.
The best professor I have ever had, a truly gifted teacher, she is the best, kindest, most thoughtful person I have met, just wonderful.
An outstanding teacher who is so gifted and caring. She taught me 5 years ago, and I treasure her lessons. She is a real role model for me.
A wonderful professor who is a high quality teacher, and expects high quality from her students.
An incredible professor who inspired me to work hard, and develop my own critical perspective on literature and life. A magical teacher.
A really amazing professor, who got me to take responsibility for what I am doing and what I need to do to succeed. Also one of the nicest people I've met.
as longs as you do your assignments youll receive a solid B. If you want a A definitely need to put some work in.

What a super professor! She changed my understanding of what I need to do to get on in life. I was in college, but not really thinking about it, but she has gotten me to think about everything, reflect on everything, and take responsibility for my own life. I'm not going to whine about things any more, I have the power to make my life better.

She is a friendly person but she is strict and old-school. No extra-credit. No extensions except for an extremely good reason. No computer use unless allowed. Deadlines are not at 11:59 but around 6PM on a Friday. Attendance is must or else you'll fall behind. Will not answer Qs through email if its not a good Q. Rely on your peers type of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A super professor, who definitely makes you work for your grade, but will help you if you need it.

Honestly the worst professor I had my freshman year at UIC. God awful woman who had a "better than thou" attitude. I once tried to email her about the very vague guidelines she gave for an assignment and she told me to listen better in class. Still passed tho.
She is very demanding and disrespectful. She doesn't dismiss class on time and gets made when you leave on time. She grades very hard and makes you rewrite papers when she doesn't like them.
She is the nicest professor I have ever had. She takes all the time you need to sit down and chat with you about yourself, your work, and your future. An amazing person.
Makes the course really fun, I learned a lot about myself as a writer and how to become a critical reader

I took one class with her, and it completely changed my life. I was doing well, but unfocused and lazy, but she made me work hard, and she saw the talent in me, and finally got me to see the talents I have. I have just had my first book published, and in a large part it's thanks to Prof. O'Hara

She seems at first scary when she sets the rules, but she is super nice and tries to help everyone. The only thing is to not forget to bring in textbooks and papers due. She is a fair grader and most of the time when she says there will be a quiz it is just to have everyone prepared for discussion aka no quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher, we were enthralled by her ability to teach, to make ideas so clear and so interesting. She is the most gifted teacher I have ever had in all of my educational experience.

An amazing professor; truly one in a million. She knows how to teach, and how to teach very very well. She wants us to learn, and wants us to study, but provides all the resources necessary to accomplish what is needed. A brilliant teacher in class, inspiring, kind, funny ... a real genius.

Shes a really great professor !! Our topic was nature so it wasnt the most interesting topic but it was manageable. As long as you complete all four essays and revise what is needed you will receive a B. Youll need to do an extra revision and go to the writing center for an A on your papers. However, shes a really great person and professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor O'Hara will make students work hard until her expectations are met. The course is hard if you do not put enough time and effort. It is very hard to receive an A in her class. The social environment is friendly; Professor O'Hara like doing class activities so everyone can be social. Also, her grading is very strict.

Professor O'Hara will really make you work for an A in her class. She even says that just doing all the work will have you receive a B. you must spend extra time and out of class efforts to obtain what you need to get an A in her class. There is a lot of homework and she demands A LOT from you. But she is ultimately a great and respected professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Teaches the class really well, the coursework was too much for me, not that I'm majoring in English or anything
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Very hard teacher, but actually knows how to teach. Yes, her class was challenging but she is there if you need help, and is very helpful when you ask questions. One of the best teachers I have had thus far in my college experience. Take her if you are ready for a challenge!

Professor O'Hara is a tough grader, but you can tell that she really, genuinely cares about all of her students and their success. The toughness is honestly helpful, because it helps you to put out your best work. If you're in STEM though, maybe take someone easier, because her class is a lot of work.

An excellent professor, but makes you work for your grade. I worked with a study group who were all moaning how it was unfair of her to expect us to do independent study ... please, grow up! we are all going to have to get jobs and learn to do our own research. Prof. O'Hara really opened my mind to literature.
She's literally the worst professor I have ever had. SO unclear on all assignments and all guidelines. Never answers a question without confusing you more.

The class is tough, the grading is especially tough. However, the teacher is very understanding and friendly and does her best to help you through the criteria of her assignments. The assignments aren't too crazy if you stay on top of them, which I didn't. But she's a very energetic person, the class won't ever really be boring.

Grading is way too strict, especially for a required writing class in which there are almost no english majors. She does not have access to the internet on a daily basis so any e-mails or information on blackboard is updated irregularly. Avoid her writing class at all costs.
O'Hara is by far the worst English teacher I have EVER had. She is an extremely tough grader and doesn't really spell out what she wants from students. DO NOT TAKE HER!

Don't understand the point of having a professor for this course. It can be done fully online and the professor assigns some unreasonable deadlines some week by stacking numerous assignments. Honestly seems like a waste of money to pay someone to teach this. Overall easy class though
Not really available since this was an asynchronous course the TA's are tho. Online course might feel a mess since prof isnt tech savvy.

reviews.comment: The homework was tedious but otherwise easy class
you pay $100 for pearson and assignments are due every wednesday, easy A

Easy online class that actually teaches you interesting and relevant things. Clear lectures that line up with the homework that line up with the exams. Just stay on top of the work/work ahead and you'll be fine.
The online class had a good amount of assignments and videos. Typically would take me 2-3 hours per week to complete assignments not including any tests. It is a good class, def would take again
Pay to win A.

Required to pay $100 for Pearson—a bundle of the textbook, online homework, and online tests in one go. While this class is easy if you know how to pace yourself... if I wanted to learn strictly through Pearson and with no actual professor-made lessons, I would have just paid $100 to Pearson on my own time and have not spent tuition on this course.

Easy class, did not need much interaction with the professor as all assignments were in the textbook. She would send out reminders of upcoming assignments, exams, and overall information. If you do the homework, it's pretty much an automatic A.

Very nice professor. Post weekly assignments due every Wednesday, 4 exams. Class is very manageable and would definitely recommend to take as an elective! I'm a psych student and found the class so interesting.
Easiest class ever. Just do the few peices of work once a week and that's it.
I took the class Fall'24 online and it was really easy. There are a few papers here and there but they're not difficult at all. Super easy class, highly recommended taking it.

The class is so easy. The textbook was $100, but worth it. The class was not demanding at all; the homework and tests were straightforward. I was able to use a lot of previous high school knowledge for this class. I recommend!

It is a super easy class; the assignments are all open once the semester begins, and you can do them all in one week without worrying. I liked this class, and the grading was clear. This class is worth the $100 textbook; you will pass it with an A. Essays are easy and take AT MOST an hour to do. No stress class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: The class was online, and there was an online textbook that needed to be purchased that cost $100, but it was required to do all the tests, readings, and assignments. Overall, it is a pretty simple class. You can do it anytime until the deadline day as well. For the exams, the professor gives you a week to complete and there are a total of 5 exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Easy class but everything online and you have to pay for a Pearson book to do the homework and quizzes. The exams are 100 questions long which I think should be condensed. But other than that I enjoyed getting basic information on nutrition since this is my major and first semester as a grad student.

Not much to say about the professor because its an async class. The work is straightforward and nothing to stress over. The only annoyances are the 2 essay questions that must be 500 words each when they could be answered in a couple sentences. This class is "pay to win" if you need a GPA booster, just keep in mind the $100 course fee.

Pretty straightforward class. 4 exams, some homework every week. There was a $100 Pearson textbook, but outside of that, everything else was on blackboard. Easy class, and useful if you want to learn about nutrition
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Most of the work wasn't too bad, but when it came to essays it was annoying. Not only did you have almost 10 assignments due in one week, but she would then add 2 500 word essays that you could answer in 1 sentence. Overall very annoying.

This professor 100% uninvolved, absent, and inattentive in this class. This course was taken 100% through Pearson, a program where it is mandatory to pay $100 total for textbook access AND access to the homework together, but never any actual TEACHING involved, just memorizing answers. There is no feedback for this class at ALL.

I can't say much about the professor bc it is a straightforward online course. You can't fail this class unless you really try to. All you have to do is keep up with the due dates, you can probably finish all the homework in one day if you want to. The downside is you have to pay $100 for the e-textbook to do homework/exams so you better not fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: She a really nice professor and has everything organized through the Pearson Textbook. Exams and homework were very straightforward. Take this class as a GPA booster!
If you're thinking of taking this course just do it

Sharon pushes you to do your best and works with you to develop your ideas. She does one on one critiques with the occasional group critiques. Her feedback is specific and she genuinely cares for all her students.
She helped shape my views as a designer, student, and individual. She paid close attention to detail and really cared about her students

Sharons course was pretty tough but she really worked along with me and pushed me to become a better designer. I wouldnt be as confident and ambitious without her influence and guidance. Literally a gem

Sharon has been an amazing and understanding professor. Her critiques are informative, she helps you if you are stuck and gives you help if you ask. She never turns down a students question and she strives for everyone to become a successful designer.
Shes really great! She makes you work for things, but shes very inspirational and caring. Youll do great in her class if you stay passionate and work hard!
She really knows what she is talking about, however; she seems shy which sometimes makes it hard to grasp what she is saying.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She is on her A-game all the time and is interested that students to get in the design field early. It is true that she only guides students. It is important as a designer and as a person to be assertive in the decisions you make and to research as much as possible. She is very patient and listens your thoughts about the process.
