reviews.comment: Boring lectures, soft voice. Don't sit in the back if you can't hear very well. He lets you take a cheat sheet into the exam, but it won't really help anyone. Overall, he's better than Professor He, who I took the previous semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He speaks softly and is hard to hear even if he's wearing a mic. He's not forgiving when it comes to misunderstandings/mistakes etc. That said, he's not completely unreasonable, but with a class average of 65% on an exam worth 25% of total grade, no curves, all he has to say about it is "That was the easiest test I could have given."

The concepts in this class are pretty simple. Not many equations. Exams were multiple choice, short answer, and some relatively simple math. Q offers a half-note sheet for most exams. There's an on-going group project throughout the semester. Show up to class and show Q that you care, and you'll get a B at worst. You'll learn a lot from this class.

Prof Q is AMAZING ! He wants you to be successful and learn the material the best you of your ability, go to his office and talk to him and care about the material and show to his class and participate a lot ! Never ever come late to his exams! Never take pictures of his exams , he takes it seriously. I highly recommend him !
prof is chill and nice but class is boring and study guide doesn't help much. overall its a chill class and the curve is amazing omg
Professor Quadri was an amazing teacher. The class was super interesting and all the assignments make you think so much. Overall great class, cant wait to take 278!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Very passionate and amazing teacher. Very understanding person. Easy assignments. Overall easy A.

its an online course with mandatory discussion sections. he basically posts lecture videos each week, roughly an hour long. In my opinion they were very interesting so I didn't have issue with getting through them. Exams were directly based on the lectures, so if you watch and take notes you're good. Possible short answer questions also posted.

Take the class online. But watch his lectures every week. They are usually a hour just put it in 2x speed and attend discussion section. My ta was nice her name was Sarah. He also offers a lot of extra credit and 85 is a A. whatever you do don't take history 104!!

I took this asynchronously, lectures were somewhat long but they were interesting enough. There is a textbook but you can find it free online. However, I never actually used the textbook and only watched lectures and still do pretty well on tests. Theres only about 4 tests and two papers you need to write but the criteria is very straighforward.

reviews.comment: Bro thinks hes teaching at Harvard

reviews.comment: Gives absolutely phenomenal lectures, and although he does give a decent amount of reading its all very interesting material. The material given is what is going to be on the exams, there will be no surprises. He is a really nice guy when you reach out to him and is always open to offer his help. Highly recommend both this professor and this course
Took the course asynchronously but the lecture videos were still informative and engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Quadri is incredibly well-read and talks like an expert. He speaks from a perspective of great knowledge and humility. He is very good at conveying complex ideas in simpler terms and is a respectful communicator. He is one of my favorite professors I've had and if someone is a history major, he is an excellent example of a true historian.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Hes a very good person and a passionate lecturer. You could tell he really does care about the topics he discusses. Chooses interesting texts in order to discuss the issues that he sees between the West and the Arab world or just within the Arab world.

Intelligent, yet down to earth. He wants his students to succeed. Is very understanding and is willing to work with any issues you may have. Gives extensions for assignments when acceptable. Good lecturer, and also good at answering questions. A decent amount of reading, since this is a senior level class, but nothing too crazy. Highly recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: It was a pretty large amount of work for a 200 level class. Two book reviews three pages each on books you choose. No final instead a ten page paper that you're supposed to work on throughout the semester. There are four quizzes and three books to read not counting the books for the book reviews. He's a good lecturer and class was interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great class!

Quadri is a very intelligent professor, but his lectures are really dry. He helps his students a lot but also makes you work hard for the grade. His powerpoints are key to passing the class so pay attention and go back to them when studying!

Prof Quadri is a great teacher.  Very helpful if you go to see him outside of class.  He's also very intelligent, which can make his lectures difficult to understand at times. He cares about students doing well, as there is a 5 percent curve in his class (85% is an A,etc). Coursework includes one project, 7-page research paper, and two exams.

If you can take comm 301 with any other professor, do it! The group work and overall work we did didn't really make sense half the time and everything was very confusing/ when asking for help it seemed like she avoided ever giving a straightforward answer. She seemed to change up her instructions when it said otherwise on the syllabus.

Dr. Quinn is a wonderful, accommodating professor. COMM301 as a class is infamous for being the most difficult communication class at UIC. A good grade requires effort, consistent attendance/participation, and good exam scores. If you take Dr. Quinn's class seriously, she'll take you seriously in return. Again, attendance and participation = vital.

She was a really nice professor, but I would never take any of her other classes again. She seemed a bit confused about what she was teaching as well as gave very little feedback on her tough graded papers. There are so many papers to write, and overall was a very stressful professor to have. The group project was rough and overwhelming.

this professor gave questionably vague directions on papers/assignments, required a notecard written weekly for the first half of the semester, was hard to reach/speak to inside and out of class, and the final group project was the worst with the lack of guidance. glad it's over. take any other professor for 301 when possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Quinn was a nice professor, but her class stressed me out throughout the whole semester. She was a really tough grader and the amount of homework given is so unnecessary. Attendance is mandatory or you will fall behind so quickly.

Professor Quinn is one of my favorite professors I've had while at UIC. She is by far the kindest and most caring and helped me better myself and my grades while getting through a rough semester. Her classes are interesting, enjoyable, and easy to manage alongside my other senior-level Comm courses.

She is awful. She doesnt explain any of the projects. You have to figure it out yourself. Shes not sure of herself when shes teaching. If your late and shes already going over homework dont bother telling her you did it, she will not count it. Overall, shes bad at explaining anything. Good luck.

Professor Quinn is an incredibly nice person, and I think she goes through the material really well. Good, detailed step by step explanations on the white board. That doesn't mean it's easy. This is the worst class I've ever taken. I don't know if I'm going to pass, but I hope you do!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: If you're a Communication major, good luck attempting to get over a C and pass this class. She'll count your homework as incomplete even if one question isn't finished, and then she won't even both to give you enough time to complete the necessary projects that need to be turned in. Not to mention the fact that this class is very fast-paced.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class will be hard if you do not put in the effort in it. Professor Quinn's grading criteria is straightforward and clear. The material itself is difficult if math has always been a hard subject for you but if you go to Professor Quinn's office hours, she will help you grasp the material. Going to the T.A's office hours is also very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Kelly is the kindest professor I have yet to meet at this school. She understands her students and cares about them. Her teaching style is straight forward and you just need to stay on track with course work and you will do well.

Professor Quinn is so awesome! Such a sweet lady who wants nothing but her students to succeed! She explains each lesson very clearly and in depth. Her and her TA, Chad, are very nice and understanding people. If you have problems with ANYTHING within the course, go to them!
You will enjoy her class if you pay attention and do the assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Look, of course the class is going to be challenging it is a stats course.  However with that said if you buckle down and really try to learn the material it will come easy.  Think of it as puzzle solving.  She did offer extra credit, she encourages students always, take advantage of her study sessions they help SO MUCH and you will get good grade.

The COMM-201 was the worst class in my life. If you don't know about statistics, don't take this course. Professor Quinn does not good at statistics.  I learned statistics by myself and YouTube. There were 4 exams, 2 data projects, and 2 article essays. Avoid her if you can.

This course is required for COMM majors and Professor Quinn is a wonderful professor! There are online quizzes due before the start of each class, but it gives an insight as to what the lecture will be about the next day. She is always helpful, and so is her TA Leslie. She assigns 4 tests and 2 data projects. Always there to help you succeed.

Dr. Quinn is great. She wants you to do well and will help you in anyway she can, so if you need help, ASK. TA Leslie is awesome too. Material can get tricky but she will answer anyall questions. Not sure why she has such poor ratings, she's one of the best teachers I've had at UIC.

Fantastic professor. Very nice, helpful, engaging, and explains statistics thoroughly in each class. If you are having difficulties, she is always available to assist you in one on one meetings. Tough course, but she makes it understandable. Daily homework assignments, 4 tests, and two data projects. Couldn't ask for a better professor. Take her!

I was afraid to take statistics, but I ended up actually enjoying the class. There are online quizzes due before every class for what will be covered that day, and it really helps to have thoroughly gone through said material before class. If you are confused about ANYTHING go see Professor Quinn in her office hours, it helped me out a lot.

Quinn wants you to pass. Will you?  Unless you have taken this class before( you will have people repeating it.) or if you're really great at math. you will! So congratulations! Otherwise, good luck. Tip: take pictures of the PPTs just do it don't try to write them down. save yourself the agony. Get a tutor or another major.

She is a great lady that would do anything to help. She wants everyone to succeed. Finally a professor that cares about her students at UIC. One of my favorite teachers and overall people at UIC. Her TA Leslie Dzike is also a great person. Best professor I've had at UIC

Quinn really cares about her students and wants us to do well but the materials are just confusing sometimes. She does everything through powerpoint but goes really fast without explaining much or let us finish copying notes. Writing on the board wasn't much help neither. Very genuine and caring but lacks knowledge on teaching statistics.
Quinn is the worst professor at UIC. She mixed up the formulas while teaching. She is not good at Statistic. She should not teach statistic (COMM201). Do NOT take her.
I took Professor Quinn in spring 2014. She was a poor professor. She did not know about the statistic and did not know how to teach. Avoid her if you have other choice.

Extremely nice lady, but hard to understand sometimes. She uses ppt to do problems instead of writing them out and that can make it harder. I've taken stats classes before tho and can say its the material not the teacher that makes this class difficult. If you need help, ask her, she is extremely approachable. She clearly wants everyone to do well.

Overall, Quinn was a nice person but not a very good teacher. She tried to give good explanations, but I constantly found myself still not understanding material after asking extra questions. She tried to teach math using a powerpoint which was extremely unhelpful.

Recommend finding a topic you are highly interested in b/c you do continuous research all semester long. Quinn is super helpful as long as you talk to her outside of class. She will give you guidelines throughout your whole project.
Very nice lady.  She means well and wants her students to succeed.  Very passionate about the class.

I have her for a class (required towards major).  She is awful! Goes way too fast, doesn't know answers to student's questions AND makes mistakes on her equations!!! doesn't do examples, just reads through her ppt slides and then we split up into dumb groups she assigned.  Book is awful too.  Lacks good examples and clarity.
worst class i have taken so far, stay away if you can. she goes to fast, maybe she think we will one day become statistic majors

Do not take this teacher if you are trying to actually learn/understand the material. She really is awful at statistics. She doesnt teach but rather read her PP and then assigns problems from the book. Doesn't really know answers to a lot of questions. Tests are VERY hard. Last test is awful. She does not curve the class at all.
Nice teacher. 3 test - last test is hardest. I recommend her -she 's always willing to help or clarify the material. Be sure to attend class.

Class wasn't easy, but she tries really hard to cover all the material and have the class actually understand it. She is a great teacher and actually cares about her students. If you have trouble, see her in her office - it will help you for sure. Great teacher, but difficult class. Recommend her.
Nicest lady! Cares a lot about her students. The class is not easy, but she will try her hardest to help you through anything your have problems in. Wants her students to do well. Take her!

Quinn is a very sweet teacher and she cares about the students. Her class may be difficult but she is very passionate and wants everyone to pass,so she likes when you ask her for help.Very long pwrpts and she goes fast bc so much material,so i had to reteach myself a lot by going through chapters b4 exams.overall- good teach though recommend her!

Attendance is crucial in this course. If you miss a class, you are responsible for getting required notes she gives in class during her lectures. Also does not share her presentation slides or notes after fact. Gives and takes away points for attendance.

she is very nice, always available to answer questions. the most difficult part is the speech outlines, they are graded very rigidly. also picking out a topic was sometimes difficult b/c it had to be an issue related to social science
No Comments

He was mildly funny, but his teaching was...subpar. He went over time every lecture period. He was late about half the time. He did not get to relevant exam material in time for the exams. He did not explain concepts well and wasted time on irrelevant tangents. Be prepared to rely on yourself and TAs

Avoid taking him at all costs. He rambles on for the first 10-20 minutes of class and his lectures are super hard to understand. I only passed because I went to a different teacher, Vi Diep!. Genuinely don't take his class if you can avoid it.

If you need a professor who will actually teach you so when you study you wont struggle, please go for another teacher....He isnt the one for you. He doesn't really teach.....just writes on his lecture sheet and talks throughout the whole class.

The classes are often quite heavy, and sometimes the explanations are rather difficult to understand.  Additionally, the handwriting is small and messy, which affects note-taking. Attendance is also quite strict; if you miss a session, it will not be counted, even though I sit in the front row right in front of the professor.
if you are taking him as your professor, good luck! (you'll need it)

Clearly knowledgeable, but lectures lack clarity and structure. Handwritten lecture notes are hard to read, and homework sometimes doesn't align with MyLab assignments. The subject matter doesn't feel well connected wth homework, so students should be prepared to self-teach much of the material.

He's one of the professors that forces you to self-study outside of class because the way he teaches his lectures is just bad!!! His handwriting is illegible - i swear it just looks like hieroglyphics. Ngl, I've been attending different professor's classes (Vi, you the goat) to learn and skipping his lectures because it was THAT bad.

Please do no take. He does not teach during lecture. You will have to learn everything on your own outside of class. Lectures are a waste of time as he spends the first half of class just standing at his desk not talking. If he is the only option you have, good luck.
Watching the videos beforehand definitely help with the course content review in class.

Wouldn't recommend anyone take his courses, even if it's the last choice.
Lectures were a complete waste of time, he would spend the first 20 minutes completely off topic and then walk around as we did problems instead of lecturing. Be ready to teach yourself everything. Only positive was the helpful TAs who were also clearly irritated by him.
Do not take this Professor unless it's the only option. Every option is leagues better. You will find yourself learning the material on your own

He does not provide good explanations, and there is a lot of studying to do outside of class. A lot of the harder concepts I needed to learn on my own time. Discussion was the only useful part of this class.
Lectures were very confusing. He has a thick accent that is hard to understand and his hand writing is not legible.

Everyone I know who has taken one of his classes dislikes him, not only as a professor but also as a person. He made everything difficult by wasting our lecture time with useless topics and having illegible handwriting that resembles hieroglyphics. Everything I learned came from YouTube, Chat GPT, and his TAs, who are as great as he is horrible.

He is genuinely not a good teacher. He doesn't start class on time, makes unfunny jokes, dilly dallies and then rambles on for 10 minutes after class ends. His accent and handwriting are not understandable at all. I didn't learn anything in that class and barely got through with ChatGPT teaching me. Do NOT take him for any math
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: He's honestly not as horrible as some say. Yes he does waste time every now and then with irrelevant videos and polls on Acadly but he still teaches you everything you need to know to pass the class. The biggest thing I can tell you, is to do the study guide for the exams. The actual exams are basically copy and paste of the study guide.
To be honest, whether you got a good grade from him or not. He will waste your time, he makes no sense at all.
You won't learn math for the first 10 minutes and you'll leave 5 minutes past the time slot unless you decide to leave early

I have had some time to reflect to be able to give my professor's fair reviews. I cannot even begin to think about the unprofessional manner of Professor Protsak. He spends the first 5-10 minutes of class with mindless videos (taking away time from lecture material). His work is sloppy, the lectures were not engaging, and he has a rude demeanor

I do not understand some comments here: Protsak a great! He is intelligent, and a funny guy who really makes efforts to communicate with his students. The class was challenging (there were quizzes and homework every week, but his skills and enthusiasm) made it all rewarding. He is also good when you talk to him. I think he is a great professor!
The worst professor I have ever had. Many people feel it in the same way so his lecture is always empty. Do not pick him if u wanna succeed in Math.
Holy cow, he is really bad and wastes your time.

Would go over class time every lecture. A lot of students had to leave to catch the bus to go home he would get mad if you left when he wasn't done. He would spend so much time in 1 question without explaining. His handwriting is awful. He would do polls during class that had nothing to do with math. Wouldn't teach if you weren't enthusiastic.

It's hard to understand his Eastern European accent when he talks fast, and he will cold-call students when no one participates. Sometimes gets passive-aggressive about no one wanting to sit towards the front.

Hard to understand- not very good at teaching. His handwriting is so sloppy i was fighting for my life. I stopped going to lecture and began watching youtube videos because it was so confusing to learn from his lecture. He also cold calls a lot

One of the worst professors I have had yet. He has a very thick accent, is weird about class attendance, and treats you as if you are a high schooler. Also, he cannot give notes well at all. It is sloppy and he overcomplicates all of the material so you are left more confused when you leave the lecture. He is also always behind on lectures.

Try to avoid taking any classes with this professor. He's a nice and funny guy but his handwriting is sloppy and has a very heavy accent. When you can't understand what he's saying you can't read it either. He expects the class to interact with him a lot throughout the lecture. I would say that the live streams are very helpful. Discussions matter!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My goodness, he is so hard to understand whether it is his handwriting and he is a jumbled mess. He uses polls in class which makes no sense. He also wastes a lot of time in the beginning. Save yourself the trouble!

Not a good professor. I took both his 180 and 181 course. I didn't necessarily struggle with either class, but attending his lectures are the worst. He doesn't explain the content really well. He's usually behind compared to the other professors. To top it off he has a really thick accent making it sometimes hard to understand what he's saying.

His handwritting is horrible, didn't explain the concept clearly at all. He has been spending a ridiculous amount of time on unrelavent polls in class. I know a lot of friend ending up simply just skipping his class because they find its useless to go to the class. Avoid taking his class at all cost, you'll learn nothing from him.

Writing is very bad
Cannot see clear
Paper writing , paper goes away very fast

Take a class with anyone else, too much time is spent on polls on useless topics. I wouldn't mind this if it weren't for the fact so much of class is taken up by this. I couldn't really understand him, generally with his thoughts and explanations and more so did the problem and asked if it made sense. He was rude and unhelpful.

He is a very sweet person. However, I would not take another course with him again if I could. You have to do much of the learning outside class, which is understandable. However, I didn't like watching other professors' lecture videos to understand a class I was just in 20 minutes ago. Be ready to watch many YouTube videos and go to discussions.

Differential equations is not that bad as long as you consistently study and memorize the procedures to solve problems. However, his handwriting is terrible and he tends to post the homework late but not extend the due date. His accent makes him kinda hard to understand. He's nice and has a good sense of humor but not the best instructor.
Goes off topic then teaches 5 minutes after lecture ends and speeds through everything, didn't learn much from him and had to learn mostly everything outside of class to get an A.

If you can avoid taking this professor please do. He goes through lectures really fast but also talks about stuff that has nothing to do with Calculus. He consistently goes overtime and overcomplicates every single lecture. He is a sweet and unintentionally funny guy but you will learn nothing about Calculus if you take his class.

He's a nice enough person but he does not teach whatsoever. Everyone I know in his class watches another professor to catch up to the course. Wastes the entire class on one question and is constantly behind every other section. Starts rushing through important content AFTER class has ended and people are walking out. Careless and irresponsible.
Wouldn't recommend. Usually don't review but his teaching method is terrible and his handwriting is atrocious. Take Will Ash if possible.

Protsak is a sorry excuse of a professor. If you get him for Calc 2 you should just drop the course. He wastes 20/25 mins of each lecture on polls on Acadly and discussions of non-calc related topics. When he realizes he hasn't actually taught anything when there are 5 mins remaining he quickly scribbles down on the paper while everyone leaves.

Protsak is one of those teachers that will start his lecture late by a couple minutes and extend it over the end timing for possibly 10 minutes. He also doesn't explain much of the lecture just rushes through it. After doing one question he usually does a poll wasting another 3-5 minutes, then proceeding with his “Rush through the class” behavior.

Lectures were fast and handwriting was sometimes hard to read. He had a few brain breaks so you do not get overwhelmed by information. He also stops frequently for questions, so clarifications can be made if necessary. He was optimistic when coming to answer questions. Also, he offers a lot of resources on Blackboard to use for your benefit.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His hand writing is bad and he teaches fast, makes it hard to follow lecture.

Protsak is a very nice professor, but you will see the same complaints across all comments. His hand writing is very poor which makes it difficult to follow, he gets off topic a lot and only does 2-3 example problems in lecture. Discussion is very important because that is where you will get most of your learning done.

Protsak is great for this course. He knows what he's talking about and does a good job of visualizing/explaining the material. Though, he usually starts class 3-5 minutes late and ends 3-5 over. He also tends to go off topic and tell stories (which are a little interesting). Pay attention and engage in lecture and you can easily get an A.

This professor has uploaded several homeworks late. Instead of doing the common sense thing, i.e. giving us an extension due to his incompetence, he still makes it due on Thursday. Today is tuesday at 3PM. HE JUST UPLOADED THE HOMEWORK AND IT IS STILL DUE ON THURSDAY.

Would not recommend. His handwriting is abhorrent and students have to ask multiple times during lectures to clarify what he writes. Attendance is taken using an app which people (not me personally) have had trouble with. He also keeps lecturing 5 minutes after the class period ends. Sometimes he's funny, which saves him from getting a score of 1.

Protsak knows his math and he's a pretty good professor in calculus 3. He does good visual drawings to explain concepts and does a good combination of practice problems in review and the theory. He's a pretty funny guy and can crack good jokes too!

This professor: starts new examples 4 minutes before class ends that go past the end of class, has unreadable handwriting, gives very time-consuming and labor-intensive written homework.

Let's you use 3, 8" x 11", note sheets front and back on exams. First midterm average was 66% even with these note sheets. This should tell you a lot.

Was so lost and confused this entire class. In his lectures, he only really does examples, he does not explain much of the basics that you need to solve a problem. A few myLab homework assignments and one quiz a week.Overall, very vague and this class requires you to do a lot of teaching yourself the material.

He is a hilarious and good professor. Always starts class with "Good afternoon!!! Welcome to MATH 220, Introduction to Differential Equations, how are you guys doing today? And those of you in the back?" He applies differential equations to real world examples. His writing is a little hard to read but he cracks good jokes. Helpful office hours.

Protsak is the final boss of the UIC Mathematics department. You're gonna have to work very hard to succeed. In regards to his lectures, he speaks softly but carries a big stick. He has accessible office hours and will happily help you one on one. He's a very funny professor though and he dresses very formally everyday. Study hard and pass.

Assigns a substantial amount of work but with drops, which can sometimes be challenging. However, he's a harsh grader and what's more, he doesn't show much sympathy for students facing difficulties. One of the biggest downsides is the limited time he allocates for exams, which is quite stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor is almost always late for class, rude, and explains concepts in a complex and unhelpful way. He often wastes time during the already limited time during lectures. He refused to take attendance at the end of class for those whose acadly apps didn't work. I would recommend avoiding this professor.

He goes off topic and always wastes a lot of time at the beginning of class. As a result, he's always at least a few minutes late to finish class. His lectures are hard to understand and his handwriting is very messy. The class is difficult, but if you put in enough work, you can get an A. It moves fast though, especially at the end.

During lectures he talks fast, writes fast and messily it is difficult to keep up. He also often goes 5 minutes past class end. Homework is fine though, along with quizzes, which helps us prepare for the exams.

Prof Protsak is simply OK. He wastes a lot of class time with irrelevant topics, he is VERY passive aggressive, he is a mask autocratic. Mandatory attendance, weekly written homework, weekly my lab, weekly discussion, & weekly quiz. His TA's are good tho. I wouldn't take him again tho because I personally found him to be insufferable.

Great professor, He might be tough on grading and provides a lot of HW. But the HW helps a lot with getting ready for exams. 
Definitely would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Does get off-topic occasionally, but he talks about interesting things or applications of the work. His lectures go by quickly because of this teaching too, while getting the learning experience.

The class itself isnt that difficult when you pay attention in class, take notes, and do the homework on time (written due thursday and online due sunday). Yes he does get sidetracked a bit and is occasionally late/ends class late so plan accordingly. He is an entertaining and very knowledgeable professor so if you pay attention, youll be alright.
Protsak gets off-topic way too much, and falls behind in lectures. He can be reasonable, but gets testy sometimes and is passive-aggressive.

Lots of homework, is disrespectful to students, continues to lecture 5-10 minutes after class is over, I'm sure some people used his lectures but I did not find them helpful and pretty much taught myself this course
Some people love him, some hate him. I  enjoyed his class a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He makes mistakes during lecture, and is incompetent at teaching.
DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!!! He makes homework assignments and exams very difficult and grades them extremely harshly.

Weekly written homework, in class quizzes, MLM homework, and discussion sections. The homework deviates from the book and the lectures. You will spend hours attempting to complete it because it mixes various topics together that aren't covered jointly. The homework is also a poor indicator of what shows up on tests; averages were 62%, 65%, 55%.

The class has a lot of hw (mylabmath and written) and only 3 exams (2 midterms and a final) but the weekly quizzes, weekly homework (written), and access to materials from previous years provide enough practice for you to do good on the exams. Lectures can get boring and aren't even necessary (he sometimes repeats lessons) but are required.
There are only a 3 50 minute lectures per week, so you do have to do a bit of independent study or peer teaching, but if if you do the work and practice, it's not the hardest math class out there.
His lectures are badly organized. He, the TA, and the book all have different methods of doing problems. He goes kind of fast. Not the worst, seems nice, not a fan of his teaching style.
Standard UIC math class, weekly homeworks and mymathlabs, 2 midterms and a final exam. Overall takes a lot of work, but an A is doable.

His lectures are amazing, hes always willing to answer any of your question. As long as you participate in the class and do not skip the homework, you will be fine. An A is not easy to get in this class but it is possible if you get enough practice before the exams, so make sure you do the practice exams or past exams before your actual exams.

Professor Protsaks class isnt easy. But he gives you all the tools to succeed. If you put in the work to attend lecture and get your assignments done on time, you will do well in this class. Professor is also really funny and kind, which made the class enjoyable even with the difficulty of the material. I highly recommend taking this course!
The worst Math Professor you could possibly have. The final exam is really difficult so get ready to lower one letter grade.

reviews.comment: Dr. Protsak is a funny guy, always finds a way to make class entertaining

reviews.comment: He had me cheesing many times this semester. I was excited to wake up in the morning just to see his face. Not only is he a great teacher, but he was also an amazing artist who touches your soul. The class was a bit difficult, but it wasn't too bad if you did the homework and paid attention. Would take again.

Amazing professor. Prof. Protsak is trying to make his lecture interesting by engaging with students. Even in the online format, he always read our comments during lecture and responded. Biweekly tests helped me not fall behind. In his class, if you do your homework diligently and come to class, you should get an A.

After reading review on here I was very weary of taking his class, but I am so glad I did. Yes, the class is difficult, but in my experience, math classes are incredibly boring. He always found a way to keep class entertaining and as long as you put the work in outside of class, you will do just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I took his synch online classes. Yes, there's a lot of content to have to go through (lots of homework, biweekly exams, every lecture's important), but considering online classes, I appreciate it. A lot of graded works mean a lot of buffer (especially since he drops your lowest test and homework grades), and a lot of practice. You'll need to work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I am glad to be in Prof. Protsak's class. Every lecture is organized and clearly explained. He answers students' questions in detail, and seems enthusiastic about teaching. If you do your homework, attend lectures, ask questions, then you're almost sure to do well in his class. I recommend taking his session. As a bonus, he is also funny.
He gives a lot of homework that could take hours every day and exam are difficult. There is no study guide but old exam that "could" help on exams. It was very stressful taking this class.

Gives lot of exams and homework assignments, can be somewhat hard to follow. Very nice and tries to be friendly to class and make it enjoyable. Doesnt give very good lectures, but his example problems are very helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've taken at UIC. Others have already explained why it was bad.

The bi-weekly tests are insane because the week of a test you can't study the new material because you're busy studying for the test. His lectures are old, I think from the Summer. His lectures are powerpoint, he doesn't really explain things well and his slides have a lot of errors. He seems nice but you really have to teach yourself the material.

Worst class ever. Biweekly exams that were way too hard and we only had 50 minutes to complete it. Homework assignments are extremely tedious and don't even relate to the exams. I basically had to learn everything on my own because the lecture videos were confusing and made no sense. It's a miracle that I even passed with a B given how hard it was.

I took him in Fall 2020 for an online DiffEq course. In one word, he is "horrible". He uploads a tons of long and non-sense lecture videos. There are seven module tests throughout the semester that are worth 10 % each (60 min to do the problems and scan) and a final exam that is worth 20 % of your final grade (2 hours). DO NOT TAKE HIM!

I took math 220 with him online and it was a complete disaster. For starters a majority of your grade depends on biweekly test(100 points) w/a time limit of 50 minutes, this includes scanning and uploading to gradescope. These test consisted of 5/6 questions but every test had at least 1 question(30 or 25 points) not on the HW or barely disscussed

Honestly the worst math class ive ever taken. Unfair course structure with little benefit of the students during a pandemic. Too many exams for no reason! Submitting an exam even a second late will guarantee you a 0, so be sure that doesn't happen to u and submit timely. Lastly you're better off learning yourself because this class is disorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: this professor really killed my self worth when it comes to math. The class is incredibly hard and his asynchronous lecture slide show doesnt help at all. Be ready to take and submit a 5problem test within a hour every two weeks, weekly MML, and the occasional survey. hes an ok guy but the TAs really save the course this semester

The amount of videos we had to watch for this course was inappropriate. For a 3 hr course we had to watch more than 3 hrs of course materials. The fact that this is a math course and we had to look off PowerP. to figure out how problems were solved, and even worse being read to. only 50 mins for exam. Do not recommend, take this course else where.

Where do I begin... this class was miserable at best. The professor creates more lecture videos per week than number of days you are in class. Its a MWF class, yet sometimes there are 4-5 lectures all above 50 minutes, sometime over an hour long. Also there is a test every other week. You will basically teach yourself everything through YOUTUBE.

ROUGH.  Had pre recorded lectures that were extremely long and used pre written text to solve math problems. Since he didnt solve the math problems as he went it is really hard to follow.  Majority of the class ended up not watching lectures after the 2nd week. Had live sessions once a week and were 50 minutes, so it was rushed. TAs got me through

The experience is horrible. I'm not even done with this class yet and here I am. Test timer is too short for an online math test. Material is hard to understand. Tests throw the most random unexpected questions at you instead of what you actually expect. Takes forever to go through study material because theres way too many and they aren't labeled.
Online lectures are pre-recorded and difficult to understand, so no real-time questions. Exams are very frequent and only 50 min to complete.
Very difficult!

I understand that COVID made it difficult to learn and teach, but how this professor went about teaching this course is a real failure. All this class is is homework. You will have to teach the material by yourself because his online video lectures are too difficult to understand. And his tests are frequent and brutal, only 50 min too. Good luck :/
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took him for MATH220, Diff EQ. Pros: charismatic, clearly passionate about what he does, good sense of humor. Cons: spends more time deriving and explaining the backstory of some equations than he did explaining the equations themselves. Almost always goes beyond the allotted time.

So victor is a solid professor. He offers a ton of extra credit if you attend ALL lectures. He posts a ton of past exams and quizzes, so you know exactly what you need to prepare for the exam. He is very organized, lectures clearly, and even changed his material to be more engineering student friendly as of Fall 2019. Would take again!

Dr. Protsak is a helpful, clear, concise, and entertaining professor in the subject of differential equations. His class piqued my interest and well prepared me to take both MATH 480 and 481 with confidence of receiving a good grade in the following semesters.

He spends the entire period with his back to the class doing problems on the board without much explanation. Pop quizzes every week, so you have to show up for at least the beginning of class. One pro: the exam grading was very fair with lots of partial credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: horrible grader, lose so many points for making a very small mistake. would not take again. A MASSIVE WASTE OF EIGENSPACE
this is the worst class I've taken, makes the class so much harder than it needs to be. very thick accent. BUT MOST IMPORTANTLY, THIS CLASS IS A WASTE OF EIGENSPACE. IF YOU DONT NUL, YOU WILL FAIL.

Professor is not good at explaining concepts, and the TA is rude to other students. Class is disorganized, dull, and hard, even though Math 310 should be a relatively easy class. The quizzes and the midterms are challenging and more often than not, you will not have enough time to complete all of them especially the midterms.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is considered by many to be a very easy class but this teacher makes it very difficult. This teacher is very bad at lecturing and rambles on about random stuff in class instead of showing how to so example problems. The teacher grades very hard too. The only thing that he is good at is tongue twisters so ask him about those.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He wastes so much time during class reading the book and not doing any practice problems. Quizzes too hard for the given time, TA was also very rude.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The class was not fun at all.

DO NOT take this class with this professor as he is terrible at explaining basic concepts that you learn later on. Also, he rambles on about random topics not relating to the lesson of the day. Finally, he gives out exams and quizzes that take more time to complete than the 15 minutes given. Overall bad teacher making an easy class hard.

Spends most of this class time reading from the book. Doesn't explain anything in detail or spends time on stuff that doesn't matter. Always goes over class time but during test he kicks us out early. Quizzes and Midterms are unnecessarily hard compared to other professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Take Shulman or Olga! His lectures are disorganized and unprepared. He only posts half his notes online, forcing you to come to class. The class is inherently easy, but he makes it 10x more difficult. Unlike the other 310 professors, his midterm and quizzes are harder than normal. Esp for engineering students, it isnt worth it to take him

I appreciate how he makes attendance 3% EC. But like, he's really bad at teaching. He focuses on things that are not important, and takes too long on insignificant things. He does get off topic sometimes which can be good (lectures get dry). But considering that this class is very easy, it says a lot that hes a bad teacher for an easy class.

Victor Protsak is a math demi god. He explains theorems and demonstrates procedures in a very crystal clear way. He is also very organized and Blackboard savvy. He is kind but at the same time challenging. His exams are hard but straight forward. Great sense of humor and very passionate about mathematics. I was lucky enough to have him as a discus
The BEST Professor at UIC! I took Math 181 with him as a discussion professor. He clearly explains all the material.
I took Dr. Protsak for Diff EQ last semester. I liked him a lot. He is very caring and if you take the time to talk to him after class he's a pretty cool guy. He definitely knows his mathematics too.
This guy is a mathaMAGICIAN. 11/10 would take again.

Great professor! Expect a heavy use of the book, you have to work, but Dr. Protsak but he gives great classes and many examples that prepare you well. He knows very well what he teaches, and he is also very approachable. His class made me reason, understand, and even enjoy differential equations! A brilliant guy.

This professor does not have any lesson plans and he is very unclear on his explanations. He pulls up the textbook and rarely shows any examples. He mumbles at the board and it's really hard to understand anything he is saying. His class has no curve. Please do yourself a favor and do not take this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He is a textbook reader in math course. Instead of teaching math, he goes on a tangent wasting class time like asking how to say a word in another language, what we are doing this weekend. He doesn't make appointments for office hours so good luck getting help. No curve. HW is hard cause he doesn't show examples in class.

He is a very fun professor and doesn't make me dread coming to class or discussion. He is very nice and friendly. As a teacher I think he is also good, he gives harder examples in class that if you can do and understand will prepare you for the exams. I don't know why students expect to become experts after one lecture. I feel my grade is my fault.

Great professor! He is passionate about teaching, extremely professional and a professor who cares. His tests are fair and you learn a lot. If you are engaged, you will not be disappointed. He is really good!

Doesn't lecture. She just assigns textbooks after textbooks of reading and reads off the key points in the textbook summary as her "lecture". This shouldn't even be qualified as a class, perhaps a Book Club gather.

I took Dr. Qato for Pharmaceutical Policy class when it was in-person and it was a great course. A lot of readings, but she was open to feedback if there were areas that you were interested in.  Dr. Qato is not afraid of stating her opinions in class, but don't be afraid of sharing yours. If they are well supported opinions (read!) you'll be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great professor loved her lectures

Lectures are super boring and attendance is part of your grade. The assignments and quizzes are super easy and you don't need to attend class to understand them. There is also a lot of Iclickers to do. I'm 1 point away from an A and the professor wouldn't give me it.

She's a very clear explainer and rarely loses her track. Her class workload is a bit heavy, so get ready to work. During my semester in her class, we had no final exam, only a quiz every two weeks and weekly assignments that would take about an hour if you attended lectures. I would definitely take this prof. again!

She is a great professor!! She gives a lot of everyday examples to help students understand concepts, and they really work! Class consists of weekly homework assignments online, and biweekly online quizzes. NO in person exams or final. Attendance in discussion and lecture is required, but if you miss a few you'll be fine.
Good class, learned lots of new things. No exams, just quizzes every other week around 15 questions but if you paid attention you'll do good.
It is a very easy no exam course. However, must pay attention in lectures to complete te weekly homework correctly.
It is a no exam course!!
W class

Took this class as both a general education requirement back in the Fall 2022 semester -- beneficial in learning preparatory economic concepts. Lengthy lectures but encouraged input and participation. Gave tons of examples & real world applications of economic concepts discussed. Homework was fair but doable if you participated in lectures.

She was a really good professor as long as you paid attention on lectures you should be fine. The class was cool because the homework was only around 14 questions a week and the quizzes were online 10 questions

She is really great we did attendance based on iclicker and she records the lecture live so u can watch from home as well! Loved her not exams just bi weekly quizzes and homework every week or every other week

Not sure if it was because it was online, but the class was very easy and very clear in terms of grading. All her lectures were prerecorded and from what I could see she was very concise and clear about the concepts. The assignments were simple, so it was a nice gpa/credit boost. I actually did learn some cool stuff so overall a pretty great class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Qureshi always had the best examples to give in order for us to grasp the economical concept. She is sweet and caring for her students.
Super understanding and caring. Her lectures videos are all you need to watch in order to pass the class. She welcomes feedback and actually encourages it heavily. 10/10 would take again.

Hardly went to class, but studied hard for all the exams and completed the hw's. Got to get the attendance checks in, but that's pretty much it. Got an A and it helps that she offers a big 80-100 curve for it. She gave some great lectures too! I didn't go to many of em, but I enjoyed the ones I did attend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: There's a lot of lectures, recitation section is mandatory. The teacher paces out class very well, no midterms or finals, just straightforward, understandable biweekly quizzes. Most of the quiz questions are very similar to the homework, the professor explains concepts quite well in a variety of ways, so you can definitely do well and learn a lot.

Prof Qureshi was a really good professor. Her lectures were engaging and easy to follow. HW was pretty light - only 3 problem sets over the course of the semester. Exams were a little difficult personally. She also does Iclickers for attendace/participation. Overall great professor!
One of the worst prof, I ever had. Even though her A is 80%, she is one of the most hardest graders ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Attendance counts as a grade, but you honestly don't have to stay for lectures since she puts all the information on the slides. We were told to get a textbook but you can pass the class without it. She gives good examples and explains the material very well. 3 midterms and pop quizzes but it's only a one question quiz and very easy.
Dry and extremely boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Kind, but extremely dry. Uses iClickers. Knowledgeable, but very lecture heavy. I don't think I even looked at the textbook tbh.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Class was pretty straightforward. Attendance is iClicker based and as long as you participate about 4 or 5 times during the semester you should receive full points for participation. I believe the class had a slight curve so if you do pretty well on the midterm and homework assignments you should easily get an A or B. Overall great class experience

She is a good teacher. Really cool. I just didn't really care for the course material. Grading was nit picky at times. But I think the TA did the grading. She does a good job of simplifying complex concepts in an advanced-level econ class. And she is really hot.

Professor Qureshi was a good choice for ECON 120. There's a curve to the class in which a 80-100 is considered an A. There's 5 homework assignments which make up 30% of the class. The lowest homework grade is dropped. There's 3 tests which make up 40% of the class. Then there's attendance and quizzes remaining. She provides good examples in class.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's a great professor. The material of the course is very straight-forward and as long as you pay attention (and take some notes), you shouldn't have a problem getting an 'A' in this class. She's very professional and friendly, trying her best to clearly explain the material. Lectures are well prepared on slides, which really helps a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Attendance is technically not mandatory, but is taken everyday. Pop quizzes. Textbook is free through UIC library. Other articles are posted by her on blackboard.  She has a soft voice but you can tell she enjoys teaching and studying economics. Great professor. Always open to questions and encourages class discussions. Great class overall.
everyone should take it.

Professor Qureshi is one of my favorite instructors at UIC. She is very professional and friendly. She is helpful and cares about students. Her class doesn't require a textbook. Instead she uses a lot of interesting readings and videos. The topics covered are interesting and eye opening. This class changed my worldview and that's why everyone
A bit dry, but a very useful course.

She's an okay professor. She's pretty annoying, and mostly just reads from the slides which are definitions taken from the textbook. This class is all definition memorization and knowing basic math. Takes attendance and is a hard grader with homework/exams!
She is thorough and understands her econometrics.
She's okay.
Tough but far from unreasonable. She clearly knew what she was doing, some of the concepts moved pretty quickly.
She is not approachable.  Can go on and on in class.
The Econometrics sequence has considerable information including articles that complement the textbook.  But she is not easy to approach and can go on and on in class.

Professor Qureshi teaches the class based on the readings, sometimes including outside research. It is not a difficult class if you do the readings (which most don't, anyway). Yet she is quite generous in her curve for the course: Most get Bs. If you want an A, make sure to include the models, theories, which you learn, not to state your own view.
She's thorough and covers a number of models. However, she is very unhelpful and unclear in her examples and explanations.

I thought she did good. Her lectures are tough and monotone but what can you expect of Econ. Show up, take notes and you'll get an A. Seriously. Grading scale was easy (80-100 = A) and quizes were super easy too. The only tough part were the tests. Never opened the book.
Not veryhelpful.
She reads right off the slides, which are based right off the texbook, nice professor but very monotone and boring, minimum to no class interaction.

Students who have never taken spanish should take a spanish class with a different professor. She never encouraged the students who didnt participate to try and speak spanish, only the ones she liked and could speak it perfectly. Very rude. At the end of the class, she would say nobody come crying to me about BB issues b/c she could never fix HW
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Really easy to understand. She's nice and helpful. Lots of online homework. Sucks that the book is so expensive.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I would have to say if you're not willing to learn or speak Spanish, then don't take this one. Professor Quarles expects students to engage in class, but it's all for the benefit of the student to learn. She grades the first draft hard, but if you make the corrections you'll be fine. Plus, the online homework is easy.
Decent teacher, rough grader. If you put in an effort it's cool but not an easy class. Also make sure you do the homework.

Just do all your work and study a bit. Professor Quarles is nice and a very good teacher. She is not a native Spanish speaker so she understands the struggles of learning a language. All the exams/quizzes/assessments are standardized across the department so she has no control over that. She is very blunt, however, and will tell it like it is
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She thinks that Spanish is life. I was really sick once and she wouldn't let me turn in an assignment. This caused me to get a B in the class instead of an A. If you talk at all, she will take 1 or 2 points out of you participation grade. She is crazy when it comes to grammar. She takes a lot of points off for things we haven't learned yet.

tells you buy the very expensive book with code or expensive loose leaf with code or you wont pass the class. then come to find out i could have just used the last edition book and just buy the code. she does not say anything in English at all. very nick-picky.
LEAVE WHILE YOU STILL HAVE THE CHANCE 20 kids in the beginning of the semester, 11 withdrew enough said

Not the best teacher, but the tests were essentially based off the quizzes. Study the quizzes and you should be more than fine. He also allows a cheat sheet for the test. I didn't buy the textbook and honestly you don't need to buy it. Definitely recommend!

His teaching style is mediocre but that's countered by how easy the quizzes and exams are set up. You get 10 attempts at quizzes and his exams aren't that bad. He tells you about what problems to know for exam, his exam is essentially 85-90% quiz questions with some alterations. Just cram the quizzes on the guide and the problems he tells you about
Bad at teaching but makes up for it with easy quizzes and tests. allows a note sheet for every exam.
Great professor and easy to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: At first i didn't do well in this class. But then i followed what the professor suggested to follow and ended up with an A. Follow the syllabus and what professor says and you'll do well

So the class is mostly weekly quizzes and a test every month. The tests are easy to prep for and he lets you have a cheat sheet. I skipped the lectures, he's hard to understand cause of his accent and complicates everything. Easy A tho, you'll love his grading scale!!  Above all he's nice tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: very easy professor, don't even need to go to the class.  You can find his tests online.
Cool guy, homework and practice papers were very useful.

He is pretty easy, allows on page notes for the exam. However, he is really confusing to understand. He jumps around alot within the lectures. Honestly I didnt learn anything from his class. Barely showed up because I left more confused. Take just for the easiness.
He is a good professor. Take him if you can. Easy A.
Great Professor. He gives very easy exams but loves to teach the material to the students. 150% recommend to take him.
The course is not easy, but the exams are manageable. The investment ideas are very interesting.

I would recommend Prof. Nguyen. He really tries to make what you're learning easy to understand. And the exams were a breeze. You could bring a 1-page cheat sheet for them and they were just like the online quizzes. Plus he still curves the exam if needed. He can be hard to understand sometimes but it's manageable. Definitely take him. Easy A!

It was his first semester teaching at UIC so I will try to not be too harsh on him, but it was terrible, a complete mess in the class, he has a heavy accent, make mistakes, class was so boring that only few students were showing up towards the end. Hope he gets better

There is a lot of reading. This semester she decided to have multiple choice exams, rather than essays. No final.  She asks questions about the reading so reading is very important, if you no one speaks up she just talks about it. Her just talking about it is boring so read what you can since the readings are long.
Incredible insight to qualitative work; often brought food for entire class; easy-going; good critical feedback; challenges students

worst teacher EVER. literally. doesn't bother answering your questions, and comes off as arrogent. do NOT take her. she has a LOT of credentials, but it went to her head. I as well as many other students have tried talking to her about her assignments that make no sense, and she is very short to answer and doesn't want to be bothered.

I took her for summer semester and she is AMAZING! We read from an anthology and did easy weekly assignments. She also brought us food a couple of times. There was one paper due at the end but it was just an opinion paper on what you had learned from the course. She is very engaging, knowledgeable, & laid back. Totally recommend her class!!!!!!!!!!
His class is super easy if you just do your course notes and follow along in class. His practice exams are very similar to his exams.

Without a doubt, one of the best professors at UIC!!! He genuinely wants to see his students do well and goes above and beyond in supplying students with helpful course material and recommendations. As long as you pay attention in class and be respectful of everyone's time, you will definitely learn something.
Take this professor. He is so funny and makes you want to learn accounting. Take him for AGT210 and you're in good hands.

Professor Zufarov is honestly the GOAT for keeping class entertaining and actually making accounting fun. He is super chill and genuinely cares about you learning the material rather than just stressing about grades. The course notes and doing practice problems together in class were a total lifesaver for the exams, making this my favorite class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He's really good and supportive. I didn't pay attention in lectures, but just did the course pack, and you should be good. Do the sample exams for sure they were really helpful. He was really nice otherwise.
He is a man of joy always use memes and super easy to master the course. What he will give you is the key for easy 20-40% of the whole exam

Professor Zufarov was amazing! Even though the class was tough for me, he was super supportive and always made time to help. I felt comfortable talking about my concerns, which is usually hard for me to do. Future students are in for a fun challenge and I definitely recommend.
Rustam is dedicated to teaching and cares for his students. Accounting isn't my favorite subject, but he made the class enjoyable, and I always felt comfortable reaching out for help.
Professor Zufarov is a truly great professor! As an accounting major, I found his class gave me confidence in choosing this field. Hope to have him for other accounting courses in the program

Professor Zufarov's explanations on the course of accounting were thorough and in-depth, making complex concepts simplistic and easy to understand.  He expresses great passion for teaching accounting, and always encourages student to not memorize the information, but to learn its applications and interpretations of the principles of accounting.

He is amazing!!! He is literally the best accounting professor; he is so funny in class. He asks for feedback, and he does his best to implement it. He also has a lot of resources, like podcasts to help if you don't understand a chapter.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The professor went into subjects deep and was super helpful and he seemed extremely knowledgable. It didn't feel like he was just reading off the screen, it felt like he was trying to figure out what we didn't understand and bettered the way he explained something.
Honestly one of the best professors at UIC. Gave extra credits and taught the materials well.

Professor Zufarov takes lecturing to a whole new level! His lectures are entertaining, and he always makes sure that everyone leaves class understanding the material. Before class begins, he would play music and connect with his students to make his class a welcoming environment. Showing up to class and practicing the material is the key to an A!
Best prof at UIC. Always came to class with a smile on his face. Wish he taught more accounting courses. If you get him as your cohort prof trust you're in good hands!

The course was super fun and great environment! ACTG was one of the classes I always looked forward to. I loved the corny and pun jokes! Overall, Rustam's character as a teacher and individual held my interest in this course to the fullest extent!

THE GOAT OF ACCOUNTING! Always brings a smile to his lectures, and makes them more than what a class should be. There hasnt been one time where professor Zufarov hasnt made me smile. 

Hes a very cheerful person, being amazing charisma and is always I mean ALWAYS willing to help his students. Also is super open to feedback on how he teaches. Amazin

The best accounting professor you could get in my opinion. His assignments are easy and he makes accounting easy to understand. He talks slow enough for you to understand the material and the practice exams are really helpful as well. Although he is not the main professor I feel he is the best out of the three other professors that is offered.

Professor Zufarov made the course interesting and his explanations were very good. I really liked when he would take time out of the class to talk about something other than the subject because it made it more fun and when he would play music at the start of class was nice because it felt welcoming.

Only thing I didnt like was there was homework every week but I guess thats standard for CS students. Very active on Piazza to help answer questions. Exams were tough.
