Awesome professor. You can tell she's super knowledgeable and passionate. Her assignments are clear and graded leniently. Lectures are recorded so you can go back and fill in notes. Allows a cheat sheet for the exams. Tells you pretty much what's going to be on it too. She can come off as strict, but she's actually really nice! Would take again.
took for Bio 305 and 222. Very strict on grading but if you put in effort it matters. lectures good and she let me do research too. Very clear explanations.

Lecture is not mandatory (but heavily recommended) outside of drawing days. she's very stern but nice, lectures are very content heavy and get boring towards the end so just thug it through. exams aren't that hard if you study she gives you a cheat sheet as well it's one sided paper but it's really not necessary if you just do the work and study.
Best Profesor for Cell Bio. Do not take anyone else

she does talk a lot so the lectures are pretty boring. but whatever she says is verbatim on the exam. she allows for cheat sheets on the exams and gives a few extra credit points every exam. GO TO THE DRAWINGS!! they genuinely are such a mindless way to boost your grade

She seems strict, but she is genuinely very understanding and is a sweetheart. She allows cheat sheets on the exams and literally tells you what's on the exam, it's just about actually paying attention and attending the class.

Dr. W's class has a fair grading system - cheat sheets allowed for exams, easy participation points, and manageable assignments. Lectures are helpful, though attendance is mandatory. Using Unstuck AI alongside the course materials can make study prep a breeze.

Cancer section was best classes. The cheat sheet makes a big difference but if it is not detailed it would not help because exams are often involved questions. I espially liked: 20% of grade was more participation. DrW had drop in hours. She helped me make a better cheat sheet after first test.

Warpeha is alright. She talks alot during exams which can be quite annoying but they're really not that difficult so it's not a big deal. She's pretty stern but not too intimidating or rude. Lectures are extremely boring but that's because the course content is just an absolute drag. Cheat sheet is allowed which is cool but not necessary imo.

Warpeha is definitely a bit stern and can come off as rude, but its sort of just her personality. 4 exams, 4 (easy) papers, 4 in-class drawings. Content isn't hard whatsoever, but a lot of content is taught, but not on the exam. Cheat sheet is allowed which sort of makes this course a joke. Would definitely take this again for an easy A.
The cheat sheet. If you show up and make an effort it pays off. Strict on deadlines. I feel like the cheat sheet really made me remember things for exam. I didn't even look at it during the exam.

She tells you to be quiet during the exams, and then talks during them??? Like which is it girl... she lets you have a cheat sheet for your exams. Goes through a lot of content for things to not show up on the exam. Grading isn't too bad but be sure you do the different assignments she assigns, so you don't fail.
Allows a cheat sheet for exams--this is everything. Explains things in easy to get-it way. 8AM is too early but still good lectures and there was 20% participation easy work, 80% exams.

I wish I had taken this class before genetics class. The lectures are recorded. I had 305 too with DrW. There is no textbook which I appreciated since most textbooks I barely opened in bio classes. If you show up and do the non-test things, it lifts the grade but she is strict on deadlines. She explains things really well, really clear.

Easy class but not thanks to the professor. I literally would not listen to a single word of her lectures after the first week. She mumbles and talks during exams. There is not enough characters here to describe the frustration caused by this professor. The lack of empathy for students is no joke and I really wish she can work this out.

this class is terribly boring to sit through. I appreciate how knowledgable she is but her voice is so monotone the entire time it's hard to focus the whole class period. only 4 assignments the entire semester, with 4 exams and a handful of in-class drawings for points. The exams were hard for me but you were allowed a cheat sheet for exams
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So confusing. Kind of a joke. I guess if you just want A on the transcript, it's good. If you want to learn biology, maybe take another class. Super, and I can not emphasize this enough: super disorganized. In summary, all over the place, but pretty easy A!

Dr. W is not my cup of tea but that doesn't take away from the amount of pure knowledge she has. its just a shame to me that she relied a lot on youtube videos to teach, when I would have much rather heard her take. her feedback is iffy, I followed feedback she gave on a paper to a T and she said that I didn't follow her feedback and graded harshly
Dr. W's exams are very straightforward, and the participation points she gives on select class days are easy points!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Warpeha is great. Though lecture isn't mandatory, her lectures and PowerPoints are straightforward and really helpful for exams. She does have strict deadlines for the assignments but they aren't too challenging. Overall, she really cares for her students and wants them all to succeed. Go to her lectures and you'll succeed. Loved her class!

Really good class! Attendance isn't mandatory, though there are labeled attendance days. The lectures are clear and the powerpoints are super helpful. She makes things easy to learn and has good resources to help memorize things. She's a bit strict but does a lot to help students get good grades (a lot of extra credit and easy point assignments).

Dr W is great and an amazing lecturer. But here's what you're here to know: 4 Exams (no final), 4 1-page papers on a topic relating to the lecture (20 pts each), 4 in-class assignments (only days attendance is mandatory, 4 pts). 440 pts = A. You are allowed one sheet of notes on exams and she typically tells you what topics to cover. Great class!
She is a horrible person with no empathy towards students.

Dr. Warpeha is an excellent professor and truly is passionate about the courses she teaches. She also provides numerous opportunities to earn points (ex. one-page mini assignments, drawing lectures etc.) Although she may come off a bit harsh at times, she truly cares for her students and wants them to exceed in her class.

She is a good professor just seems very inpatient at times, especially when students have question. Other than that if you study for exams, go to the mandatory class days, and do the miniterms you'll pass

I have yet to have a professor that is as passionate and caring as Dr.W. She really wants her students to learn and her content is engaging. Also with covid, she has been very understanding and has made the class very stress-free.
worst teacher ever, doesn't understand that people don't have wifi and still tried to continue with an Exam. TAs are no help either as they don't respond to chat messages.

Very passionate about cellular biology. Did not require textbook purchase. Her exams were completely original and gave out extra credit. Lecture slides/videos were also completely original while still being well detailed. Additional resources were provided to help learn the topics. She respected our class during my time taking her course.
Dr. Warpeha is the best professor out there. She is very caring and wants her students to do well. She has a good personality and teaching style.

This class is an absolute joke. There are only four assignments! The 2 exams are just responding to three questions from readings (each response is a page long). The 2 mini-term papers are just one-page responses to the assigned readings. For a 400 level BIOS course, this class is easier than any BIOS course you'll take. Dr. Warpeha is awesome!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: The best professor from the biological sciences department!
She is a very caring an understanding professor.

Cares a lot about her students, and is super helpful. Sent out a bunch of links that would help students during the COVID-19 crisis so shows how much she cares. Exams were straight from the powerpoints, but make sure to study!

One hour and fifteen minute lectures at 8am aren't anyone's cup of tea, but Dr. W made them bearable. Lectures are content heavy. The material is not difficult as long as you take notes (print out the lecture slides and take notes directly on them). Your grade is based only on exams, participation, and short one-page essays. DO NOT BUY THE BOOK!

This class was pass/fail and about plant metabolites. We only needed to show up and do a final presentation (8 slides). Guidelines for presentation were super clear. Prof was super nice and approachable (brought tea and coffee every week for us).
She cares about her students. She is very clear about what she will ask on the exam and wants all her students to succeed. Study for the exams and do the assignments. You will get an A.
Dr. Warpeha is definitely the best professor for BIOS222! I would highly recommend than any other professor for that class. She cares for her students, as long as you show her that!!

Most overrated professor, there are better BIOS 222 professor options than her. Exams are based off lecture slides but she goes more in depth than what she puts on there. Really really annoying and monotone. Interrupts and rambles on about announcements and is strict on term papers. Regret taking and would never take again.
Dr. Warpeha is truly amazing!
the natural chemicals class is the most interesting class I have ever had at UIC. It's like a mini-pharmacy class mostly on plant chemicals. great lectures and clear explanations.
Shes so annoying when ever she wants to give out a test, she would say she wants to interruptions, but she keeps talking in testing time.

Dr. Warpeha is probably one of the best professors out there. She is very caring and wants her students to learn, and this is why she explains her lectures in a simple way and also tells you what's going to be on the exam. She isn't mean or rude to her students as people say, she is just strict in class because she wants her students to learn!
Dr. Warpeha is very caring and wants her students to succeed. She explains topics in biology in a simple way so that students can understand.

Rude to students but great professor! Tells you exactly what's going to be on the exam & sometimes even tells you the Qs she'll ask. She explains everything clearly and saves you time by telling you what not to look thru. Dr. Kay is the complete opposite! he taught 2nd half & lowered my A to a C in the class bc of how tough his exams were
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hard tests but if you come to lecture and read slides it is not too bad. Pay attention in lectures and write down what she says.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I like her section of the class more than Kay's. She tells you exactly what you need to know for the exam and will sometimes tell you what she'll likely ask on there. 450 total points, 400 are exams and 50 are pop quizzes. An A is 88% but doable. Her exams are easy if you take notes on/study everything she says in lecture
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I wish I took this class before I was a senior. Dr warphea and Dr kay are the best at explaining anything in Bios. Notes are serious--they test from slides and lectures. They are thorough, and helpful and answer questions. go to class because of quizzes and go to office hours.
Very rude towards students. Gives pop quizzes. Complains about her son instead of lecturing. Highly suggest a different prof for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A lot material covered. she was excellent at explaining things compared ti the other professor. She is very clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is one of the best professors at UIC. She gives you an idea as to what she expects you to know for the test.

Clear explanations. Grades are on scale but one exam is dropped. very straightforward and I appreciated no-talking-allowed in class and lecture capture is such a big help for reviewing. Extra credit based on attendance and boosted my grade into A. she had reviews for tests.

TAKE HER! Her tests are soo easy! She holds review sessions and goes over the specific topics to review. She basically copy and pastes her lecture slides for questions on the test. Extra credit if you come to class, which is great.

I advise any student to not take this course with her. Although her exams are somewhat easy. She is extremely strict. You can forget any type of curve to your grade. Even if youre .3% off. She starts exams 5-7 minutes late and ends 2-4 min early. She always yells at students for sitting in the wrong seat and is overall a horrible human being.

Dr. Warpeha is an amazing professor. The material she teaches is interesting and she teaches it well by taking her time and explaining it thoroughly. She tells you exactly what you need to know and what will be on the test, so make sure to study that. If you put in the time and study hard, you will do good. She is also a good person and is caring.

I wish I had Dr Warphea earlier at UIC. She is the only professor in Bio that actually can explain things so everyone understands. She also gives extra help and she let me volunteer in her lab, which was great. Bio needs to get more professors like her who know How to teach. Online book and materials were excellent.
I'm only here to reminisce on how I took her for granted before taking microbio. Appreciate her. She's probably one of the few bio profs left at uic that isn't useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Warpeha was so far the easiest teacher I've had for a 200 level bio class. Her questions were easy and straight forward to a point where I scored a 100 and a 95 on her exams. Linns portion of the class was alot more challenging but I would recommend going back to lecture capture and write everything he says and studying it and you'll be fine.

Dr. Warpeha is easily one of the greatest professors I have had in my life. She is very clear about what is on her exams and the whole class is based off her lectures. All lectures are posted online so you don't have to come to class, she offers 4 extra credit opportunities, and the A is set at 85%. If you put in the work, this class is an easy A.

Crystal clear lectures and clear slides. Wish she taught the entire class (class is team taught). Wish she taught All the bio classes. She knows how to explain things. Exams right off slides and lecture. went to office hours and this helped.

She's straightforward, offers extra credit for attending lecture, gets straight to the point, only puts stuff on the exams if she talked about it in lecture, and makes everything easy to understand. She seems uptight when you first meet her, but it's only because she's trying to manage over 300 students at once. She's organized and gets stuff done.

Dr. Warpeha co-taught this class with Dr. Saxena. I honestly thought she was one of the best professors Ive had at UIC. No bs, doesnt put up with talking in her lectures. Super straightfoward with content, and exam questions are straight from lectures. She uses lecture capture, so only showed up on exam days, got an A. I would highly recommend her
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I felt well prepared for exams. Did not feel like a big class, prof willing to meet with students. exams really organized and straight from lecture. good class, 2 professors.

It was a huge class, terrible UIC! but the professors made it quiet (no talking or phones)  participation and drawing out things in class, and had alot of office hours right outside clas. Go to office hours. The tests got harder but this was the best class for the mcat and I just liked that it was QUIET. very knowledgable and got me into research.

Warpeha is great - shes monotonous and her lectures are boring - she expects absolute silence during class (which I loved!) You must take good notes - she makes her tests solely based on the slides she presents in class - nothing else. Listen to her lecture captures and study the slides an you will do just fine! I highly recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Shes a really nice person, but her lectures were that useful.  She seemed very all over the place in her lectures.  She does let you know what is important to know for the tests.  The tests aren't that hard.  Overall pretty good.
Dr. Warpeha is a great professor. I enjoyed her lectures, especially on the ones on plant cell biology. If you attend lectures and watch her lecture captures, you will do awesome!

Great professor! I like her no nonsense attitude when it comes to kids talking in her class.  It shows that she cares about your education.  Just come to class and take good notes and you'll make an A. I unfortunately had a bad professor for the second half but thankfully her portion saved my grade.

Dr. Warpeha is an excellent teacher for this class if you are newer to cell biology or haven't taken it for a while. She is very clear in what will be on the exams, and the tests only come from Lectures. If you take good notes and listen to the lectures, an A is easy. The textbook is a good supplement but not necessary. Some extra credit is given.
hands down best class and lectures. tests from lectures. TAs and prof willing to help every week.
need to have the book. excellent lectures, take notes, attend class. go to office hours.

Her exams are strange, but doable. Just show up to class or watch lecture capture and you'll be fine. She points out what will be on the exam and likes to use pictures. Her questions can be wordy. Quizzes are easy. Lectures are not very organized and stops to read her notes. She's not the best, but not totally off limits. Not my personal style.
Difficult class, a lot of material. Really good explanations and clear tests. Team taught class I don't like but I did think class good for MCat. Go to office hours.

She explained things really well, and good thing because the class is huge. Share the book, not worth buying but you do need to read. Kay made you know definitions, Dr Warpeha asked about figures and terms too. willing to help and go to office hours. Too many quizzes but you can drop 2. You really have to go to class. Excellent class.

Honestly, the worst professor.  I cannot take this professor seriously. She is all over the place. She says "this is important for the exam", "this will be on the exam" way too many times and it NEVER is on the exam. I highly recommend NOT taking her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Alot of material but I felt I learned it well. Explained things really well (crystal clear), and helpful on essays. Questions on test fair. Knowledgable and willing to help me understand.

She can seem all over the place during lectures at times but she really focuses on you understanding the diagrams. Her tests are extremely straightforward. Most quizzes are basically free points. If you go to lecture and study from the book you'll do great. She had a genuine interest in her students doing well.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I really want to respect her as a scientist, but she was not my favorite professor. She seemed very frantic, rushed, unprepared, scrambling to find material in the book to tell us. She jumped around in her slides and made it rather hard to follow her lectures. Read the book, know the diagrams--she's very diagram heavy on the tests.

honestly if youre not passing cell bio with warpeha you're not very smart. Out of all the science professors that I had(I have my fair share of extremely hard professors) Warpeha is the easiest out of all of them. You still need to do the readings and put in effort but other than that her test is very straightforward.
Amazing Professor! She truly cares for her students. Power points are very straightforward. Exams are a breeze if you attend her lectures.  Very approachable outside of the class. Highly recommend
Her lectures are abysmal, and the one she provides online arent useful either. She expects you to read and attend lecture despite the lecture not being as useful as the book.
Great Professor! Very helpful!
a lot of reading, work. but crystal clear and good for mcat and anything science. you have to go to class.

Had her for Fall2014 and earlier for BIOS240. She can seem like she's in a rush most of the time and she relies on her TAs a lot in terms of managing students (grading, questions, etc) but she is also there to help. Lectures are straightforward and she uses a lot of information from books. Expects you to know your stuff and study.
Everything you need for tests happens in class. You have to go, and you can ask questions. The book helped for background but i shared. Tests not hard if you go to class, totally on the lectures.

Super easy class. Don't attend her lectures. They are a waste of time. Absolutely every question on her exam can easily be answered by reading the book chapters assigned on the syllabus. You have to be a brain dead oaf (which are unfortunately plentiful at UIC)  to not get As on her exams and an A in the class.

Awesome professor but very strict. get to class on time and don't leave early because she'll call you out. She teaches you only the information you need to know and skips all the fluff that isn't important or won't be on test. Like other 200+ level bios if you don't do well, then consider switching majors or get better study habits

She was all over the place, sending emails the day before exams with promised study guides or new assigned chapters to be tested on. She always seemed frazzled and disorganized, and either rushed through concepts, or ate up time with whiteboard  quizzes that were in no way a benefit to the class. Terrible professor.

Proff Warpeha is a phenomenal science professor and I wish she taught every one of my classes. Extremely thoughtful lectures meant to make the exams a breeze. She cares a lot about the success of her students and you''d have to be truly awful to not get at least a decent grade. 1010 highly recommend

oo-rah. welcome to the Marines. She is very strict, but I think the good habits paid off for Cell Bio grade. You have to go to class and take notes and I liked the boards. If you don't go to class she Knows.
Her lectures (things on powerpoint slides and things she says)=all of exam content. I wish she taught the whole course. She's really nice when approached.

She comes off as harsh to students who never talk to her, but she is SO helpful if you have any questions. Her lectures and exams were incredibly straightforward. Go to class, the exam is 95% material right from lecture.

Her class is easy if you attend the lecture because her exams are very straight forward unlike other bio professors like UIC. I didn't think I would ever say this but I think she is one of the fairest and clearer biology professors that I had at UIC.
Her lectures are crystal clear with the explanations she provides. Reading the book helpful, but her exam questions come straight from the lectures.

Such an amazing person and teacher (though she seems strict in class). She has become easier (unlike comments below), but maybe it's just that her teaching is that good. I highly recommend her. You won't regret it. You have to try to do bad in her class.

Warpeha is an amazing teacher who cares about the subject and the success of her students. Shes really nice and will help you do well in her class.  Alfonso on the other hand... prob one of the worst professors you'll ever take
Amazing teacher. Alfonso on the other hand...

She is such a good teacher. Her explanations of lecture are crystal clear. She tells you what's on exams, what more could you ask for. Just study slides. Willing to answer questions. Tries to come off as strict, but very nice in person.

Don't buy the book. Only buy the lab manual. Exams are all from the PowerPoint. She does review before the exams which are helpful. Go to lectures because she tells you what's not going to be on the exams. And the lab sessions can help your grade. And there's also that research paper.

DONT BUY THE BOOK! Waste of money I wish I had never rented  it! I didn't crack it open at all. All the tests are based off of her lectures which are on blackboard, but it helps to go to class because she tells you whats on the exams. Easy class, would recommend.

I took bio 104 lab. At first I didn't pay much attention and didn't study for the 1st exam-and got a 64. The next text I was told to ONLY study her powerpoints, and I got an 86. She tells you what is on the test, and the labs are extremely easy. I recommend this lab to anyone who wants to fulfill their lab requirement. Don't buy the book though

4 tests:drops the lowest one. LOTS OF MEMORIZING JUST TO PASS THE TESTS. 1 presentation, 1 paper, and Lab HW. She said its easy to get an A or B in her class. Well, its actually not. IN fact, a lot of the students have a hard time getting a C.

Prof Warpeha is a drill sergeant and barely 5" which is comical.  Lots of info to memorize but she spoonfeeds you exactly what's going to be on the exams.  Great class for non majors. Dave the TA is totally laid back and very helpful.

She uses power-points, which are straightforward. The only thing is that there are a lot of materials you have to study/memorize. Other than that, she literally tells you what is going to be on the exam. She definitely understands that this is a Biology class for NON Majors, so she makes it very easy!
VERY HARD class. 4 overall test. she drops the lowest one. thers alot of memorizing.

shes a good speaker and knows her stuff. very knowledgable but way to strict when it comes to hw and exams. she expects you to know what shes specifically talking about and you cant write more than she asks or points off.

Her class is fairly tough, but she's actually not a bad teacher. She presents a lot of info, so it's hard to remember everything. If you attend class everyday and put in a reasonable amount of effort, you should be able to get a B since she curves the grades at the end. Her demeanor in class is rather strict, so she didn't come off as friendly.

She's an AMAZING professor. Very clear, incredibly helpful at office hours (which no one goes to, unfortunately) and very honest in her exams. There are no trick questions and everything is straight from the lecture slides (just like she promised). I wish I could have every bio class with her....

i had Prof warpeha for 2 200 level Bio Classes. 222 and 240. Not the EASIEST class but who said 200level bio would be?! Her tests directly reflect the class slides. Shes clear, and humble. iclickers were a big help. Shes fair and a Great Prof.

Very reasonable, clear, and fair. Exams are straightforward; just take good notes in class and pay attention! Office hours are very helpful so make use of them (and not at the last minute). Mostly 95% of her exams are straight from lecture notes. This course will teach you how to study effectively and will prepare you for grad. school!

She is a great professor! All the lectures and tests are well organized. You will know exactly what to expect on the test, which is mostly multiple choice but essay questions as well. She will let you know what slides are important (which will most likely show up on the tests), and does not test on info from book that she did not  talk about.
I had her for Bios222 also. I think this class is harder but it is very useful if you want to be inPharmacy or medical stuff. Essays are similar to Cell but plant and animal physiology.

She's an AMAZING Professor! Very knowledgeable and extremely willing to spend a whole hour explaining something to you. You should definitely take the initiative and go to her office hours. She's a very charming lady!
Horrible. Exams are pretty hard for a 200 lvl class.

Never miss lecture, take notes during lecture, study the lecture slides at home, read up on information you are not sure about in the book, and try to go to her exam reviews. Look over her lecture slides like 5 times a few days before exams and UNDERSTAND what they mean. Exams are not hard, very straight forward. Class average was mostly around 80%

Very nice and helpful professor who always means well. However, her speech pattern is horrible: Repeats the same concepts hundreds of time and thereby confuses students. Should work on her lecture outline and in class presentations. Her slides follow the same yo-yo approach. Her exams are fairly easy, meaning it's not hard to get a B.

Warpeha makes you go to class for credit.It's easy points and it's helpful for your grade but it's idk frustrating.The thing about her is she's trying to get everyone ready for med school-even if u're not going.So her tests are killer! She takes off for spelling errors and if the answer is not short enough. So even if u study hard u might not get A
i have to agree with the below comment. I study very hard and got nowhere but a B. Why do teachers like her hate giving A's. She hates when the average is good. AVOID TAKING HER IF POSSIBLE.

I am currently taking her. This class is about following directions. She tells you what will be in the exam! how much better can it get?!?! She is very organized, post slides the day before each lecture, always there for office hours, wants to make sure that ALL students are doing good in class. I would definitely take another class with her.

Her lectures slides contain mostly pictures and expects you to read from the book.  She doesn't explain the material well, she expects us to learn those on our own.  The exams are based mostly on the background information from the book.
She's slightly florid at times, but covers related material well.  Be diligent about studying and be sure to read up on background material from the book, and you're sure to do well.

Extremely organized, bordering on obsessive and pedantic. Slides posted several days prior to lecture, which is nice. Method of lecturing needs dramatic improvement as she effectively reads off of a list of disconnected topics that appear on the exam. Spends little time  connecting concepts, making it difficult to gain comprehensive understanding.

This is definitely a class where you have to go.  She will basically tell you what to focus on... so she'll basically tell you what's going to be on the tests.  I printed out all notes prior to coming to class and took detailed notes.  She is always there to help students and is great with students who have a disability.  She wans people to do well
Very good speaker, lots of material but easy grading on exams.  Must go to class.  She had office hours and good reviews
She goes too fast. She doesnt stop in btwn lecture to ask if anyone had questions. HARD tests. Confusing lecture slides. Doesnt seem like she wants to put an effort to help students pass.

terrible. she keeps talking and talking. she says the txt book is optional but keeps telling us to look at figures in there. very unclear. ppt slides are just pictures..NO WORDS. and she dosnt breathe inbetween sentences ahhHH!!!
hard but learned about the environment, physiology, and the best is genetics and family trees. Get to lab on time. It's a lot of work but worth 5 crediit hours. professor will meet with students.
she is very anal about school policies and procedures.  labs are easy, but you have to go to them. the tests are kind of hard...You really have to study for them!

Kind of anal about some stuff, but not bad. Talks about family history a lot.  Tests on power-points that she puts up on blackboard. If you study for the exams and show up to lab, you should do fine 'cause she drops one of the exams and one of the labs. Paper and presentation required.

She was helpful in her reviews.  Labs are very important. try to get oliver for TA.  this class was similar to a high school bio class.  however, to pass the tests a couple hours of studying is required!!

Professor Warpeha is an erudite of a sensible, modern nature. She takes ownership of her students’ disadvantages and concerns as if to empathize on a great scale; coming form a student with a number of handicapping barriers she along with the aid of her lab associates help to facilitate a vigorous and productive locale to thrive in.  Yet, do note r

Pretty easy class.  Definitely don't blow off labs, paper, or group presentation. Her exams are pretty easy; she gives you a review packet beforehand.  The review sessions are optional but she gives you lots of hints as to subjects that will be covered on the exam.  Her lectures can be boring but if you print out the notes she posts on blackboard a

This teacher is very knowledgable about this Biology world. Genetics is her specialty. She takes the time to explain everything. Tests are fair. Don't miss labs, they are an easy way to boost your grade. The project and paper are also great grade boosters, dont blow it off.

Super nice professor! Unfortunately, her classes were a huge drag to get through. She was caring and graded the presentation pretty leniently. Our final exam was online so that was a huge plus, but our midterm was in person and much harder than expected. It was pretty easy to get an A so I would ultimately recommend her, just not the most fun.
Professor Wang is very kind and is accessible outside of class. Honestly, the class is mostly just lecture, and the homework is easy. There are also two group projects that aren't bad.

Very kind and relaxed professor. Assigns 2 projects worth most of your grade (1 group paper and 1 group presentation), so communicating with classmates is key. Lectures are read from the slides, and iClickers occasionally used (not for a grade). 2 Exams, multiple choice, which can be a bit tricky. She's great at responding to emails! Overall, kind!

She's really nice, and the class doesn't have a heavy workload. This class won't be much of a worry if you take it with her. Lectures tend to get a bit monotonous, though. Expect group projects and communicating with classmates.
She's a kind-hearted soul, but she tends to read of the slides that are accessible on Blackboard. I only show up because attendance is mandatory. She is also super lenient, she's chill
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: An awesome professor who provides thorough explanations and covers every detail. Although the class itself is challenging, the way he teaches makes it feel much easier to understand. I would definitely recommend taking his class.
Amazing professor. Explains everything and makes class easier

This course is very useful, especially for students who want to do deep research in advanced ML topics. His lab assignments are tough but allow learning a lot. Not recommended for students, who want to escape the heavy mathematics, especially probability, statistics, optimization, and calculus.

The professor is good from a teaching perspective but I expected this course to be more application oriented while it turned out to be a fancy Maths course in disguise. The course could have used less math and focussed more on programming.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Not a CS course, but a Math course! Felt like I was learning math and not CS. 11 assignments,7 labs,MCQs every class,midterm,project,endterm. Lot of work to do! Didn't really like the course, learnt the math behind the ML, but not really where and how it could be used. Would avoid the course and rather learn ML online. Teaches pretty well though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lecture recordings were uploaded. The recorded lectures and assignments discussed in the live lecture. 1-3 recordings for a week and each lecture about 1 hr long. Assignments are moderate and professor gives the solutions. 55% of grade depends on exam and others are assignments and project. Maths heavy. Overall good course.
Discusses assignments in class. One of the best professors of Machine Learning, both in terms of ability to teach and in terms of knowledge. I liked the class so much I took 512 as well.
One of the most Hard Working and Amazing Professors I have ever seen.

Knowing that this class was tough and it's not really the professor's fault for that, he did explain the concepts very well in lectures, especially the homework and lab assignments. If you attend every lecture, study hard, and know how to solve problems without any struggle, you'll definitely walk out of there with an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Explains concepts very well, very good at clearing doubts, was ready to show some leniency due to the semester being online.

His classes are math heavy. But you get to learn a lot. Also fine tunes his content every semester. Considerable workload, but A achievable if you work regularly. Really nice as a person too. Upgrades your grade if you missed it by a few marks. Gives deadline extensions whenever possible. Loved his courses tbh.
You will get an A if you study hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Enjoyed his classes, really makes an effort to make sure students understand the material(repeating many times if necessary). Somewhat heavy on the maths/stats. Fair grader, not too difficult to get an A if you work throughout.
he gives sooo much partial credit for the exams. really easy homework's and a great professor. no complaints!

The course was really interesting (really tough to conceptualize though), and the grading scale was simple. Two homeworks, no midterm, and an open note/open internet final. He wanted everyone to get an A. There were 4 books used, even with them as a reference, the class is still hard. If you take this, expect to have a background in probability.

5% participation, 4 homeworks; two leetcode homeworks, two written assignments. Midterms are some T/F, some written, some coding, where you are also expected to know your time & space complexity. I never showed up to class (meaning I lost all 5%), I did my homeworks, showed up for the midterm, and ended with an A. A very easy A if you can code.

If you can overcome his accent, then you should be able to get through this class without a problem. The workload is okay, but the written assignments in this class are tough to get through since it involves lots of proofs.

The only two drawbacks for him is that sometimes you'll find it hard to get past his accent and that he doesn't make the class participate much in lectures.. The class being hard though is not his fault. Attendance is not mandatory at all and you get a few reasonable homeworks. A smart and a considerate teacher otherwise.
Reasonable workload. His class is very helpful for understanding the course. A small dropback is that sometimes slides is not clear.

Amazing professor. UIC is so lucky to have her, an actual national treasure. All readings were available on Blackboard, homework was manageable. Some concepts were tough at first but they always became clear through in-class work. She was super understanding and accommodating, always ready to help outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Xiang is super nice and takes the time to listen to every student. CHIN 300 was heavy on readings and homework. HW included multiple choice, written response, and speaking (online submission). Projects were usually group work. Had to present slides every now and then. Every student gets called in class so your time would come eventually.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Very kind!

Professor Xiang goes above and beyond to help her students succeed.  I had a special circumstance and she sacrificed her personal time to ensure that my studies stayed on track. UIC is a better school for having her.

I Love Professor Xiang. She is amazing and very understanding. She is always approachable no matter the case and is a big help. She noticed we had a lot going on with other classes she reduced the work load on us. She respects her students, and there was no exams in the class. The grade was based upon assignments, presentations and papers. Amazing

She's a super nice woman. If you study all of the handouts and pay attention to what she has to say and pay attention during reviews, then there should be no problem whatsoever on the exams. She makes the class pretty easy too, it's just the basics of linguistics. Downside was that there was a 10 page research paper due by semester's end.
She is awesome. A lot of assignments and busywork, but she is very understanding and helpful. Also, send her a draft before the date due. If you follow her feedback, you definitively get an A.
Incredibly helpful and approachable. Answers emails at 3 am!

Very bad handwriting, unable to formulate cohesive thoughts to explain material, and spends the lecture time copying other professors notes. Better off skipping class and reading a different professors lecture notes from blackboard.

His handwriting is difficult to read, and he has an accent. The material is easy, and you can always look up other professor's lectures on BB. If you pay attention in class, you can keep up, you just need to put in more effort to understand. The class itself is super easy and super doable to learn everything before exams. Maybe take another prof
if you can take a different professor for linear algebra. hard to understand and bad hand writing dont mix well.

The professor has a heavy accent and hard to read handwriting. I am only able to get through the class because he has other professors notes and lecture recordings on blackboard, the only thing is attendance is required.
took fin 340 not 300 idk why there is no option for 340 but slides are very easy to follow and the slides and hw deff prepare you well for the exams

reviews.comment: From the beginning I wasn't interested in physics, so taking this class was already difficult. His lectures aren't as structured as I thought it would be. It's best if you had taken MATH210 prior, because there are concepts that you will need to apply here. Demonstrations were cool to watch, but doesn't do group problems like the other classes do.

Physics itself is extremely difficult but taking Dr. Barkan's class made it a lot more manageable. He's immensely caring for his students and has extremely well organized lectures with many examples. He's very approachable and never once made me feel dumb about not knowing anything. Despite it at 8AM, it was always worth going at that time.

Physics is difficult but Dr. Barkan is genuinely one of the most caring and understanding professors I have met. He is clear on what he expects from students, has really good lectures that are also available online, and is willing to help if you ask. Highly recommend him.
Awesome guy, I would fail this class to take it again!

He seemed kind in the beginning of the year, and over time that changed. He became like all the other professors, and he doesn't really seem to care much. I dreaded going to this class. But if he's your only option you can handle it. You truly need to put in the work for this class, and if you do I don't think the professor will matter.
Barkan is an amazing professor. He really takes his time to teach the concepts in physics and makes the class feel easy.
So far so good, slightly fast paced but makes sure to be clear and does a lot of example problems.

Awesome professor. Very passionate and knowledgeable. His lectures were great and he was always available after class to help with homework or just answer questions. If you go to lectures, pay attention, and do the homework (legitimately), you're guaranteed a good grade. The material is difficult but completely doable.
Tests are really hard because of the way he taught.

Although physics is really hard, Dr. Barkan really cares about his students and makes the lectures very engaging. I couldnt see myself doing well if I had any other prof. He makes it very easy to take notes on the lectures, and the examples he does in class are more challenging than the quizzes/exams.

Dr. Barkan is such a cool guy and a lot of fun to have as a professor, one of the best ones i've had at UIC so far. Physics no matter what though is going to be challenging for some people, so its not an easy class. If you are struggling, just reach out to Dr. Barkan or the peer leaders, it helps a lot.

Dr. Barkan is a very good professor. He is clear and well-spoken in his lectures. He gives a lot of examples. However, the class is very hard. Do not expect to pass the class without putting in extra work. Dr. Barkan fulfills his role by providing high- quality, clear lectures, but many students still fail by not doing extra work.

This class is hard, but Dr. Barkan makes it easier to understand the material. The course itself is not organized, but Dr. Barkan is super organized. The tests are very hard and have nothing to do with the homework or the quizzes. Super nice prof! Definitely recommended!

Dr. Barkan was an amazing professor, I repeated phys141 while I received an F the first time, I retook the class with Dr. Barkan instead and instantly understood everything and got an A. Thoroughly explains everything and has awesome experimental examples!!! highly highly recommend him for any class.

If you have to take Physics 141, Barkan is the best. He has a good sense of humor so the lectures don't seem long and boring. He basically does all example problems in the lectures so you have something to refer to later on. He explains the material very well, and has offices hours after class. If you do the work & show up, you will be fine.

I had Dr. Barkan for Physics 1. Although his class is VERY tough, it is easy to tell that he genuinely wants his students to pass. during the whole COVID 19 mess. Because of quarantine, I wasn't able to study as effectively as normally, but Dr. Barkan ensured that I received the help I needed despite being bombarded by emails from others. I passed

Exam are pretty hard and homework is much harder. Homework is completely different then what he teaches and he explains it in 5 mins on the day its due. Some one the topic he teaches are not very useful.

Dr. Barkan is an excellent lecturer and goes out of his way to meet his student's needs. The class itself is extremely difficult, but that's just how physics is. Practice problems are the key to success. My only concern is that the problems done during lecture were too simple compared to the ones on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really great professor!!! (Best Physics 141 professor at UIC) Teaches material very well and explains problems so that students are able to understand. Pauses many times during lectures for questions from students. Very helpful during office hours and answers emails quickly. Best way to get an A is to do extra problems. Not too much homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Pretty good. He's chill and funny. Can be boring and lecture intensive but is very available during office hours.

I failed but only because I didn't put in the effort. Great professor, keeps you engaged, wants you to pass. You HAVE to go to lecture or you won't understand the examples. The textbook is not necessary, but the online homework is, he will put those problems on the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Barkan is probably the best professor I've had so far. The class is tough, but he made it worth it for me. He has humor, he knows the material well, and he covers many examples in lecture. On top of that, he performed many practical demos in class that really show what you're learning. If you need help, he's willing to help you between classes too.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: In lecture, he gave very useful example that can save you time for reading. And, I feel more comfortable to ask questions in his lectures than any others'. I feel he's a hardworking prof. Especially, he respects his students, so if you have trouble, don't hesitate to ask. However, you need to prepare for the exams, it's a bit harder.

I can promise you he is the BEST physics professor ever! Work hard, do the suggested problems, redo the examples done in Dr. Barkan's class, and take interest in the demos, and you will be absolutely fine!

This man is my ultimate man crush at the Physics department. PHYS141 is crazily hard but Dr Barkan makes it entertaining and engaging with demos and his goofiness. He's helpful during OH and emails when he isn't on campus. Do the suggested problems and you will be fine, and don't forget to ask him "compared to what?" when he says something is small
Super great! One of the best profs at UIC. Very approachable, never makes you feel dumb for not understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He is truly one of the best professors at UIC. He will try to make you understand the problems and concepts in any way possible. He really cares and is very inspiring!

I signed up for the class in order to take PHYS 141. This class was by far the hardest class I've ever taken at UIC. The professor taught the class as if we all had advanced knowledge on the physics even though this was a intro class. A chunk of students ended up withdrawing over time.

Barkan really knows his stuff. I'll admit I don't enjoy physics and I struggled in this class, but Barkan isn't to blame. If you do the work and go to class, you'll be ok. The labs were painfully long but not difficult. I recommend doing more than just the weekly homework as his tests are hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors at UIC. He is so organized and makes it very clear on what will be on the exams. If you go to class, do practice problems and the practice exams, you should be able to get at least a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: For future students who are taking physic 141 , you have to go on blackboard and do your prelab homework before every labs.  idk that "prelab homework" even exists so i missed every single one of them, same as other 10 people in my lab class (alone) . So PLS be aware of that.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Barkan is a great guy. He takes really good, organized notes and it's obvious that he really has an interest in Physics. He does cool demonstrations for real-life applications of physics. The class is TOUGH. No doubt about it. You need to study hard for this course. Labs vary in difficulty but are more on the harder side.

Barkan is extremely thorough and organized. If you can, go to his office hours because he is such a nice guy and he really does care about you. He isn't a researcher, his primary goal is to teach you which can be unlike some professors in science courses who are just here for the research. The class is tough but what do you expect? Barkan is great!
Physics is hard in general but he makes it easier than other professors. He always hows examples on friday which makes class exciting. Take him if you can as he cares for his students

He is the best professor I ever got. His teaching style is energetic. I was taking 8 A.M class, never felt sleepy. You are not going to pass physics no matter where you take it if you don't attend the lectures.  I mostly email him for help, he always replied.

Dr. Barkan is an amazing professor. He is very organized with his notes. He is very passionate about Physics and teaches the discussion section himself. Writes all the notes on the board at a good pace. The grading curves for the exams are extremely generous.
Nice guy, well organized. iClickers for attentdance/extra points. Brutal exams, huge curves.

Lectures are more helpful than reading the book. All the homework problems are on Google or Chegg but I suggest reviewing the work after completion of problems. Test often have a problem or two similar to homework problems. Ask him for help, nobody goes to his office hours!REVIEW feedback from graders and check answer keys to obtain the most points

Barkan is great! He actually cares about his students, which is awesome. He gives great demos, and his lectures are helpful. The exams were brutal, but he curves them a lot. He's always willing to help you out if you need anything. So much dedication to his teaching... The class is hard regardless, but with barkan at least it'll be enjoyable.

Currently taking this class. He is an  AWESOME lecturer, professor, friend and is very helpful. However, his exams are extremely hard. I work my ass off doing hw problems and have went to every lecture but I feel his exams are totally different.  ( sadly I have not done well on either of his tests. I might fail the class if lab doesnt boost grade

This guys knows how to teach unlike other physics prof. at UIC. He explain the material by doing some simple problem and then jumps into hard ones that might show up on the exam. If you do a little work outside class and show up to his lectures and pay attention then you should easily get a B and possibly an A.
One of the most enthusiastic lecturers I've ever had.  He really loves physics, and it shows in his passion to teach.  He tries his best to make sure you understand the material.

This class is going to be really tough regardless of the prof., but Dr. Barkan's helpfulness and leniency gives everyone the chance to get the grade they want even if you're not physics inclined. His demo's are great, lectures clear and helpful, and he is very generous with his time, and points. Top-tier prof in the university, take him!

Barkan is a great teacher. His notes are incredibly clear and organized. This class is incredibly difficult, but he will gladly help you if you go see him. He's very friendly. DO THE PRACTICE EXAMS, at least 1 problem is copied verbatim each time. Write down as much stuff (formulas, pictures) as possible for partial credit. Massive curve on exams

Barkan is very helpful, organized and knowledgeable. BUT, this course is tough, you need to have a strong background in geometry and calc. Labs are boring and repetitive. There are no discussions. The exams are really hard but he gives partial credit and he is veeeery lenient.

Dr. Barkan is one of the best professors at UIC. He tries to make a difficult class with difficult material understandable for everyone. His demos are pretty cool. Any question is welcomed and answered, even if it's the dumbest question ever. He goes kind of fast in class but covers everything so only read the book if you don't understand a topic.

Great professor who is very motivated and interested in teaching. However, I struggled in his class because he moved through the materials pretty fast and I ended up falling behind. The exams are hard, but there's usually a curve.

Cool professor, but I didn't really learn much going to his lectures. He had iclickers and masteringphysics for homework and prelectures. Smart physics would have been much more helpful in learning instead of mastering physics for prelectures. Study and do lots of problems relating to the hints he gives for exams. Quizzes were like the hw problems.

Really nice guy. Good teacher. Questions are always welcomed. Very organized notes. However, this class is difficult. Review your notes, fight for every point, and READ THE BOOK if you're having trouble understanding a specific topic. For the tests, expect and prepare for the worst. Make sure you practice a lot of problems prior to quizzes/test.

heads up! u will struggle a lot. get perfect scores in mastering physics, quizzes and esp hw and labs>though both require a lot of time dedication as there will be no one who can help u out ;( going disc is a waste of time but points matter. do great in all the above stuff exclude exams because these stuff will give u a hope to pass the class :(

Although there is online homework and pre-lectures, this is a very enthusiastic and fair professor. It will take effort of the student's behalf, but he will help if you put in an effort. Attendance highly encouraged. Has a dialogue with students and welcomes questions.
Great professor!! Does many examples in class (doesn't finish them but it's not that hard to do so your self). He is always willing to help & make sure you understand!

Is an ok teacher. Not the best. He doesn't work through the examples in class completely (always leaves you hanging on the algebra). Relies HEAVILY on online homework and online pre-lectures. That could be good for some and bad for others. His lectures are easy enough to follow, but I don't think it is enough to prepare you for the exams given.
Practice tests are similar to exams. Will help out if you attend office hours. quality.

If you wanna pass Phys 141, please DO NOT TAKE him. If u r struggling w Phys, he is not n option at all. His tests r very hard compared to the problems he explains n lecture. He's a nice individual n is passionate for Physics; but, unless u dedicate great amount of ur time doing physics, u wont b able to pass his class.

Extremely enthusiastic, willing to help if you need it. He won't go over homework problems in class, but if he always stays late to answer student's questions. If he can't help you right away, he'll send you an e-mail later about your question. I found the class to be moderately difficult, but I pulled off an A doing a lot of problems from the book

My rating may be not proper 'cause except the first week of classes, I NEVER paid attention to his lectures. I couldn't stay tuned to his lectures during the first week and I decided to be a self-learner. But that's my own opinion, others say his examples were too easy compared to the tests. I think his test were OK, but the final was quite harder.

He's a very enthusiastic professor,definitely loves physics and loves to teach it.However,the exams are just horrible,questions are different from the practice problems.He also tends to do really easy problems in lectures,which doesn't help at   all.I wished he had some kind of review session b/c you have no idea what he might put on the exams.

One of the best physics professor. Very Enthusiastic. Loves to teach. Great sense of humour. Keeps the class interested. Very helpful. Does a ton of examples in class. Though he will skip over the algebra. But still, he will get you to understand the concept Definitely take him for any physics class that you might need to take.

He's not a bad teacher, but the exams for 141 were annoying because they alwyas had problems vastly different from the practice exams. Subjects that you spend 10 minutes in lecture going over that seem irrelevant will end up on the exam. Vectors vectors vectors
I thoroughly enjoyed his approach to physics through practical real-life phenomena. Very enthusiastic and highly organized instructor.
He is awesome. He is very enthusiastic about teaching and is always willing to help.
Physics is tough with any professor but he makes it easier with his tables and examples better than any other physics professors at UIC

This class is really hard, but he's super helpful. Always in his office for office hours and responds to emails really quickly. His lectures are really clear and he makes note taking very easy. Don't rely on his class examples for exams though. Do book problems or buy Haliwell's cd. I did all cd problems and pulled off an A.

He is one of the best teachers i have ever had. this is a very hard class in general. our midterm averages were about 56 which is high at UIC. Because of him and the curve I didn't have to take the final and got an A in the class. But this class is not easy so you still need to work hard. He very organized and knows the subject. Great PROF.
very helpful! worth taking his class! funny guy

I think Dr. Barkan is seriously underrated at UIC. He is a great lecturer, and has a pretty entertaining sense of humor. He knows his stuff and it definitely comes through in his lectures. I felt like his lectures adequately prepared me for the exams, and his example problems were always well explained and relevant. Great teacher!
this guys is a really good phys teacher. one of the best intro to general mechanics lecturers at UIC
he is enthusiastic about what he teaches and he tries to go out of his way and does enough examples to get the concepts fully across to his students.
good professor and caring. A lot of work though and it is quite difficult.

Pretty good professor that genuinely cares that students get the most out of his class. Lectures are fairly organized, although he does go off on tangents on some occasions. Labs are easy and purely participation, but good for learning. 2 Projects and 2 Exams. Not nearly as bad of a class as people make it out to be.
Great prof.

Not sure why Professor Koehler's ratings are so low. He teaches very well, is always eager to explain concepts if anyone doesn't understand, and responds quickly to questions on Piazza. The class wasn't as hard as I expected. it's very manageable to get an A since he offers extra credits on projects and exams.

Not sure why Prof. Koehler has low ratings, he's genuinely a good professor. He has clear grading criteria, lots of opportunity to increase your grade, and he's pretty flexible for a lot of it. Even assignment heavy classes, he gives grace periods. Also super accessible and helpful outside of class. If you show you care, he def does as well.

I'm currently in his class and honestly have no idea why his rating is so low. He provides tons of resources to study with. Yeah, the class does require work and self-studying, but I've learned so much I went from just knowing how to write code to actually understanding how it runs at a lower level, which is pretty cool.

He's rude and monotone. Lectures have a lot of wasted time where he's simply not discussing course material. The homework assignments are tedious chores that don't help you learn. Our TAs had nervous breakdowns in every lab section and sometimes we would sit there for 2 hours learning nothing while they fumbled over their words. Exams were ok.

reviews.comment: This professor does give extra credit for lecture participation and rewards course evaluations at the end of the semester. He gives great advice for how to succeed in the class.
Please read emails

Professor Koehler is a steal in comparison to some CS instructors, he literally gives videos of the study guides!, you have an ammunition of resources to prepare you well for the exams. Machine assembly is hard as a first for many, so lots of upset kiddos who haven't learned accountability, but you have lots of opportunities to do well and pass
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I was scared to take Koehler because of his reviews but he was a great guy and teacher. I can see how he comes off blunt but that's just how he talks. I went to his office hours multiple times and he was very nice and approachable. Yes of course the course material was difficult but doing labs, homeworks, and exam reviews were very helpful.

reviews.comment: Worst professor and worst class all in one

reviews.comment: You need lots of time to spend on the class. Lectures are long and boring, and labs are sometimes confusing. Prepare to self-study.

reviews.comment: One of the most caring professors, he goes above and beyond to ensure you learn. Lectures are well planned (PPTs, videos & notes before class) He provides videos for HW's, projects and study guide. Grades are balanced so your learning efforts are never in vain. You are highly incentivized to keep trying, which genuinely helps you master this class

This professor was rude in emails, vague in answers, and unclear in lectures. He solves problems without explaining, makes grading confusing, and gives projects with unnecessary stories. Overall, not helpful and I would not recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His teaching style is the worst; he does the calculation in his head or on paper that he does not show us, and tells us the final answer. He never tells how he got the answer until students ask him. His lectures are slow and without enthusiasm, so you start feeling sleepy in his class. His course policy is harsh. Only 1 drop for homeworks and lec.
I like his class! He offers a ton of material for you to review, and I love the concepts he presented. It's easy to fall behind, but stay on top of things.

He cares a lot about his students and adjusting the curriculum so it suits students' needs; his main goal is to make sure students leave his class well-equipped for future courses and the workforce, so students who are just there for the grade may not enjoy it. Although, his lecture style can be confusing sometimes.

I took his CS 141 course in the summer for 4 weeks, and even though it was loaded with a lot of assignments, he explained and taught how to code on the projector and answered any questions on the spot, he made the class humorous at times, and I personally found his cards and dice examples useful and it kept me engaged. Bro is goated.

reviews.comment: (4 Week Summer Course) Class examples with cards and dice were useless. The class could've been more effective for students transitioning to C++ and should've had lessons coding it yourself in class instead of him coding and trying to explain. Work load is very heavy and often his explanations do not help much either. Would not recommend taking him
Shows a lot of empathy to his students. Gives good career advice and feedback.

Excellent educator. You will learn if you go to class. You will receive a good grade if you follow instructions. 211 is a challenging course, though utilize resources (including Koehler) and you will be successful. Exams are tough, but use Koehler/TAs to check answers. His RMP is outdated. He is one of the best UIC has to offer. TAKE HIS CLASS!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Now, CS251 has always been a hard class. It is one of the most important classes within the CS Dark Horse Trilogy (211, 251, 261), and I could not have been more glad to have taken it with Koehler. Heres my list of pros and cons ~
Pros
- Fast answers
- Great lectures and bonus videos
- great project selection
Cons
- tbh, can't think of one!
Decent guy, funny lecturer. Class was easy, no complaints.
Prof Koehler is a solid professor to take. His CS 211 class wasn't that bad. He is funny in lectures and from what I heard is a very nice person. Definitely don't hesitate to take him

Very rude and passive aggressive. He was basically a bully to students on online forums like piazza and answered questions in an insultingly rude manner at all times. I really despise this professor as he doesn't deserve to be called one and or to even teach at a highschool. I truly hope karma teaches him a lesson or two
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Honestly, I do not know why he gets a bad rep for 251. Yes, the course was hard, and unless you're going into data science, tbh... mostly useless. However, as a professor he was not bad, he WANTS you to succeed, he gives a lot of resources, and explains most topics rather well in lectures. Labs were mostly about reinforcing lecture topics.

I am not taking CS 251. I am taking CS 211 this semester, and my friend and I finally decided to drop this course.

He is often aggressive towards students, which makes me feel extremely uncomfortable. I also heard about this from other students who took his classes before. I feel so bad seeing his replies to students...
Drop his class if you can. He is very aggressive to students.
DON'T take his class. Perhaps the top 2 worst instructors I have ever seen.

I was hesitant taking a class with Professor Koehler due to the reviews, but I am so glad I did. He expects a lot, but only cause he wants you to learn. The programs are challenging, but not impossible. He was very responsive on Piazza and his project descriptions and what he was expecting from you were very clear. My favorite thus far.

He wants you to succeed. The oral exams are LeetCode question interview style with a partner. The projects are not easy, but are manageable. He posts tons of resources on blackboard like code from class on his GitHub, and short video lectures on YouTube. His lectures are also good but make sure to pay attention and don't sit in the back.

I know some people don't like way he taught 251 when he started, but I don't think I could ask for a better professor or class structure. He set up the class to help students succeed in CS. Our oral exams are with partners and he is accessible through office hours. His lectures are great, but don't sit in the back.

SPRING 2023
---
PROS: He is accessible outside of class, and will willingly explain things to you. He grades fairly, and in my opinion generously gives out points. He only gives out oral exams, no written
---
CONS: He doesn't give out extra credit. He grades fair, but also strictly. 
---
SUMMARY:
He's underrated, and his RMP score is outdated IMO.

reviews.comment: Can be a quite unorganized with the course, however that could be used to your advantage. He is very generous with grading and tries to help you out as much as possible. reviews.comment:
he is a really good professor, the structure of the class is great and he is flexible with deadlines and he is willing to help you out. 
Great professor he takes feedback seriously and is trying to improve as a professor!!

I think half of the criticism on RMP for him has now become invalid since he did change a lot of his practices due to the backlash. He knows the material very well and is also flexible with deadlines in many cases. There is literally no written exam just 3 oral tests in a technical interview format which I think is a great way to test.
Often times very passive aggressive towards students.

He was very accessible outside of class and was able to elaborate really well on the questions in class. I feel like I really got a great understanding of data structures through his class and the conversations that I had with him outside of class. He had a lot of knowledge on the material and taught it well.

reviews.comment: If he says project will be graded by xxx, don't believe him. He grades projects manually and from my experience, tries to get you as many points as you can get. Decent professor, but unacceptable start to the semester. Teaches moderately well. Projects are a lot of the grade, DONT fall behind. He is aggressive on Piazza at times. No issues with OH.

He was okay. He wasn't the best at the start, but he improved with time. Not very organized and late about release of projects and other important assignments/announcements. The projects are similar, but he doesn't provide no solutions and lectures don't really help. Office hours are packed and piazza responses are late and passive aggressive.

He is very knowledgeable professor one thing students don't like about him is that he grade projects manually which is a good thing, as your project will be graded on the accuracy and not on correctness

people dont like him because he had to hand grade hundreds of projects and it took him a while to do that. hes honestly a really chill and knowledgeable professor but the way students were verbally attacking him was out of control. hes one of the only cs profs ive had that actually responds to emails. if you need help in his class, just ask him.

reviews.comment: people really hate on him, not sure why. no one attended class or started their programs early, so they like to complain. the dude was solid, fair, gave extensions in certain circumstances and admitted when he was wrong. ppl need to get real and stop expecting easy work

He reads off of the lecture slides and takes up 20/45 mins on class logistics.

reviews.comment:
Went almost every single class, struggled, and when I reached out for help on Piazza/office hours, it was radio silence.
