THIS CLASS IS VERY HARD AND EXAMS ARE TAKE HOME BUT REQUIRE A LOT OF TIME.  HIS LECTURES ARE BORING AT TIMES ESPECIALLY WHEN HE TAKES SWHOLE CLASS PERIODS TO TALK ABOUT HIS WORK.  HE HAS AN ACCENT AND ITS VERY HARD TO UNDERSTAND HIM.  GETS VERY DEFENSIVE IF YOU INTERRUPT HIM. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOUR LOOKING FOR AN EASY A.
Horrible teacher. Its hard to understand him and half of the time he will just waste class time talking about himself or random stuff. I do not recommend him!
His English is very poor.  He likes to brag about himself a lot.  His lectures are below average.  Definately do not recommend him.
WORST PROFESSOR EVER BEWARE...DONT DO THIS TO YOURSELF!!!!NOT OVER...ALL HE TALKS ABOUT IS PERSONAL ACCOMPLISHMENTS! NO HELP..DOES'T REPLY TO E-MAILS...HORRIBLE!!
He has a very heavy accent and he is very cocky.  I don't recommend him at all.

I have taken all my courses at this university and he is the worst I've had. He has no ability nor interest in teaching. The only reason he is still hanging around is because of his research. I do agree that he a brilliant man, but his class is regrettably useless and unorganized. Don't take it.
Terrible professor, probably one of the very worst that i've ever had. The course material is extremely difficult, but easy B if the take home exams/final and project is worked on in groups

1. HOWEVER, easy A,B if u work with groups on the take home exams.

Hands down the worst professor i had in my life! believe me i m not exagerrating: can't teach, doesn't explain clearly,grades randomly, Full of himself,...the list goes on and on! he gives the school a bad name.

Take FIN 466,472,or 371 instead.Exams are posted online,due the next day.The class is easy if you form study groups and know how to use Google.But the final exam was horrible. Easy B, but hard A.Can't understand him 65% of the time. The project is a lot of work,but I think he gives everyone the same grade.Only take this class if 40+ are enrolled!
He sucks

One of the worst professors ever. Does not know how to teach - instead, goes on and on about personal accomplishments in the field. Has no sense of teaching methodology or speaking skills. Bad Professor, Bad Teaching

Text book is required but not needed.

Lidia is an amazing professor with amazing lectures. She makes sure every student understands the material. She was so caring and made her students feel comfortable. Her feedback on assignments is very helpful, and she ensures all her students succeed.

Prof. Lidia was so nice and caring towards the class. She made sure that we understood the material and made it known that she was accessible if we ever needed help. Very easy to approach and always appreciated questions from students.

reviews.comment: She was very understanding to everyone and genuinely cared about her students. Her lectures were very interesting and she had a great energy. Honestly, one of the best professors I've ever had. She is very understanding and super funny. My Spanish has definitely improved after taking her class. She is not a tough grader and gives amazing feedback. Definitely an easy A if you just do the work (I obviously didn't, hence the C).

Lidia is so sweet and a great teacher. She cares about her students a lot and is willing to work with you if you communicate with her, very understanding. A lot of daily reading and writing for this class but nothing very hard. Whole class is in Spanish. Work is constant so if you do not manage your time you will fall behind but its reasonable.
He uses old fashioned teaching but is very easy to follow.

Do not take this professor at all. Take komperda if you can help it

only this course prepared me so well that i could read the research papers related to combustion and flames analysis independently . Course  included fair amount of homework's and three projects. He really admires the research work done by others and openly talks about it during the lectures.

Smiley & friendly but not helpful, adamant! make fun of and sarcastic. Graded on personal attitudes & his solutions; Can't understand other correct answers. Terrrible research professor and he gives bad grades. Don't do research with him because it is terrible.

worst professor ever, he just does his job and he doesnt care about anything. he always tries to make fun of you. he grades very bad and deduct out of nowhere. you cant take notes in the class. dont take any course with him

Professor Aggarwal was a very friendly professor.  His lectures were a bit dry, but if you paid attention and did the homework, then there really isn't any problem whatsoever.  He was open to discussion in class, and more so was very knowledgeable.

Overall a very pleasant teacher with an impressive background in academia! Spanish is a hard and often times tedious subject, but I think Dr. Aguilar helps greatly. I never had as a professor, but she is the head coordinator and I have a disability, she is really helpful and accomodating.
good teacher, very helpful. easy A if u keep up with the class.
i loved her ,shes awesome!!shes nice but strict when need be. when she sees students struggling she does not move on she keeps on explaining.

It sucks being forced to take Spanish, but with most of the majors at UIC you have to. I definetly recommend that you take Liz. She is very devoted to this class, she always e-mailed us study guides and went above and beyond teaching expectations. She was never absent either. OKay..i think the material is not difficult, however, i think she is really strict and goes way to fast. Everything in that class was review for me, but I can see why others struggles
The perfect example of a true teacher.  Helpful, yet serious about the material.  She is able to the get material across better than any prof I have had yet.

One of the best professors I've had.  Teaches clearly and throughly, and manages to not be too boring.

Professor Cetin is very knowledgeable in computer vision and explains the concepts excellently. His practice exams are beneficial for preparing for the midterms.

Agnieszka is totally AWESOME! She is very nice and caring, and the classes are always fun (I loved making comic strips in Polish!!!) You do have to study a lot though, but if you do, you'll be fine.

The average on the exams were under 40% for the class. I got a 3% on the final but passed the class with a B because the curve was so huge everyone would have failed.

The worst professor of all time. Exams 90%  HW 10%. The exams consist of memorization of matrices and equations, despite saying exams don't require memorization. The average for all exams was really bad (>40%) There was an extra credit project, but it was crazy. He curves at the end, tho. Do yourself a favor, and don't take a class with this guy.

DO NOT TAKE HIM. LECTURES NOTES DONT MAKE SENSE. TEXTBOOK AND LECTURES ARE USELESS. EXAMS ARE TOUGH. CLASS FAILED EVERY EXAM

reviews.comment: Take his class only if you're interested in multi-body dynamics, otherwise you'll end up with a B! Get ready to work hard on the homework..

Basically re-copies the textbook on the board during lecture. Doesn't give too much more than the text. doesn't hold students intrest. answers questions, and repeatedly asks students if they have any questions. unfortunately he can't see the student are so far lost they just nod their head. Grading is incredibly strict. avoid if possible.
If you pay attention in class you will pass she has very helpful lectures and notes.
Bad at explaining, when you ask for help she tries to do either the bare minimum or directs you to "trial and error method or google".
She's very clear
Really don't like this class or professor. Exams are so hard and material is hard as well. She does not explain the material clear enough for me to understand and learn. Don't take her class!!

Professor El-Amin is a one of a kind teacher but no one appreciates her because even though she speaks kindly, aisha is hell bent on being on top even at the cost of your grades. She will make you work   but allow others to get by less work
Not very inspirational, quasi-smart.

For me this class (ED 205) was required, but I loved it.  Aisha is very passionate about what she teaches, so even if you're taking a required class she will get you interested. She makes it easy to participate even if you're nervous. She is easy to talk to and has a good sense of humor too. You will definitely learn from Aisha.

If you're taking Ed205, I totally recommend this teacher. She is very approachable. During the semester we only had one test (through blackboard), and two essays due. No homework (that I can remember of). However, you still learn in this class if you take enough interest in it. A lot of interacting w/ the teacher and other students. Loved it!

Pretty sure he hated my class cause he was being weird and petty, cause everyone else in other classes liked him. Giant lecture hall so sometimes it's a bit hard to hear him. I only survived this class by going to the tutoring sessions, (join the groupme btw.) Allows a few notecards for tests and stuff. You may have a better experience than I did.

You are going to have to get used to his accent and his lectures are boring, however, the practice test materials he gives you prepares you perfectly for his exams. As long as you do the homework and study for the exams, you should be able to get an A in his class.

Great professor! My experience with him was amazing. He helped me when I failed my first exam and told me strategies on how to pass his class. He also opens up missing homework if you talk to him or he assigns 10 extra credits, which is 5 points each. I definitely recommend his class because he doesn't want his students to fail

If ur looking for an econ professor, Behzod is the choice. Even though his accent was kind of difficult for me to understand lol, he would still try his best to teach the material. most of the time, the class is boring but the exams are decent and easy if u just study.
He was a chill guy and his teaching was very easy to understand. The tests were pretty easy too.

Behzod is an excellent professor. Although sometimes boring, his lectures were helpful, and he's a good teacher. Homework takes a while to complete, but there aren't too many assignments. iClicker can be done from wherever lol, so you could lowkey skip class.

Very chill professor. He does have an accent but it is something I got used to after a while. The class itself is very easy if you pay attention and he lets you use notecards on the exams making the class even easier.
Very easy to follow along with his teaching style. He has a heavy accent however it doesn't really get in the way with him teaching.

So many issues: talked too fast (and his thick Uzbek accent did not help), either underexplained or overexplained which led to confusion, cannot keep eye contact to save his life, and he does this really annoying pen tap on his desk to get people to quiet down, and it makes me want to put my head through a wall! DO NOT TAKE THIS UNLESS YOU HAVE TO!
Behzod is an outstanding professor who genuinely cares about his students. As long as you do the work, do extra credit, and focus in class, you can't score below a B. DO EXTRA CREDIT!!!!

He's an alright professor. He knows what he's talking about, although he can talk really fast. However, he at least helped me when I saw him once, when none of the tutors showed up. He also has so many extra credits, & lets us make 3 notecards for the midterms & 5 for the final.

I have never taken an economics class but this was honestly such a great first experience. I did struggle in the start but he gives so many resources in able to do well in the course. He is very specific on what will be on the exam and his lecture notes are super helpful, I would take this class again 100%.

If you need to take ECON 120 or 121, take him for both if you can! Makes everything extremely easy to understand, questions on the study guide are practically the same on exams, and helps give extra credit from assignments and iClicker. All you have to do is put in the work, and the class will be a breeze.

Best econ teacher! He basically sets you up for success by giving SO MUCH extra credit. If you've never taken an econ course before the material can be confusing so it requires some study outside of class but his reviews and study guides are so helpful. I liked his class a lot because no other teacher gives extra credit like he does.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The professor is very nice. He cracked a lot of jokes throughout his lectures which kept class entertaining. I know a lot of students are weary about him when they start class with him, but trust me, you'll learn to love him.

The midterms and final are basically the study guide provided by him. If you can do the study guide, the tests are a walk in the park. Lectures are boring, but you can relearn the material through the homework assignments. Attendance is mandatory through iClicker.

Really funny and good classes, I'll say its hard to take notes because he writes his own notes in class so theres really no slides that he goes over (there are slides you can use outside of class) Pretty few graded things so make sure you study- as well as 2 midterms and a final.
I had him as a sub in for my actual Econ teacher but he's a great explainer and helps you to understand the material with clear examples and explanations

Very easy class, doesn't matter what professor you take you should get an A. His exams are literally built off the study guides so please work on those before exams and I promise you will get a 90+. Some complain about his accent but it honestly isnt so bad and should not deter from your class performance, he also gives extra credit.

I really enjoyed this professor! His class was one of the first I took after not being in school for a while. I was struggling and even with failing a test, I still managed to get a B in his class. He gives extra credit and he is very understanding/flexible. In my class a lot of people would talk over him, I felt he deserved more respect than that
only professor to make a 6 7 joke.
Econ 120 &121, content can be a lot but homework is do-eable, he makes sure you understand the content. Do you want to pass? take notes and take this professor.

Funny fellow with a very odd accent, but if you can get used to it then the lectures won't be as confusing. The material is easy to understand if you pay attention, the work isn't too bad with 1 week + due dates for homework. The tests/exams were material that was covered in class, no surprise content. Also allows 3 notecards for exams. Recommended

Has to be one of the kindest and best profs ive ever taken at uic, he ALWAYS greeted almost every single student everyday with a smile after class. his accent wasnt hard to follow tbh, hes got tons of extra cred and very accessible outside class. Topics do get repetitive and boring sometimes, but id strongly recommend him!

The lectures are quite long, but were mostly interesting to me. If you can, pay attention as he'll be doing practice problems and concepts that will be on exams. The homework can be time consuming so don't procrastinate the very last minute. He does truly care for students and is quite funny at times. Lock in and study for those exams.

He is an amazing person, super kind and gives out so much extra credit. Make sure u take advantage of it! the course itself is easy but without studying you won't make it. I personally failed all of his exams but the extra credit and homework saved me. His class is however super boring and I fell asleep so many times but overall it's ight.

I've had this professor for both ECON 120 and ECON 121. The topic is super interesting, and he explains the topic clearly. Exams are super easy, especially because you can bring 5 index cards of notes. This class is enjoyable, and you learn a lot.

I had him for both Econ 120 and 121 and he is great and actually teaches. I actually learned something in his classes. Honestly, I don't know how you don't get an A on his exams. You would either have to be stupid or lazy to get anything other than an A in his classes.

He is amazing for both ECON 120 and 121. The study guides are pretty similar to the tests, and they are pretty straightforward. As long as you pay attention, you will do great in this class. The programs he uses for homework also help plenty for the tests!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Teacher is a very very nice guy, although his accent can make it hard to understand at times. Econ 120 and 121 are easy passes. Attendance is mandatory but lectures are very light. Homework is minimal and he offers extra credit. Use the exam study guides he provides and you can pass with an A.
this is the GOAT but study for your exams or you will get a low grade. online homework and iClicker.
Awesome professor. Delivers content though engaging lectures and provides many extra credit opportunities.

Pretty average class and professor. Very medium teaching and coursework levels. However, what was nice and helpful was that this professor gives SO many extra credit opportunities and he provides an outline before every exam highlighting exactly what will be tested. Still, a very average experience wasn't the worst and wasn't the best.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a great professor, and we only had 3 exams. If you put in the work and effort the exams are precisely like the study guide. Attendance is mandatory, and he does use iclicker.

This guy is the GOAT. Take him. That's all I can say. You get so much extra credit to make up for a bombed midterm, went from a C to an A. Take. Him. All it takes is to get past his accent and you'll realize how good of a professor he is.

His attendance is mandatory. He takes attendance on iclicker. But he doesn't have a discussion for his econ compared to other econ courses. He does have 3 exams, but the exams are super easy and exactly like his study guide. also, his review session before the exam is pretty much what will be on the exam. Overall he is great and make its easy.

I don't know how he has such a high rating cuz to be honest i've never struggled so much in a class. Unless u wanna teach yourself everything and take a test that's so long in under 40 min then take his class lol. He also has a thick accent which unfortunately makes me struggle to understand his points. Also the i clickers r so fast 2.

if ur not good at math or anything analytical, then this will be hard, especially first years. midterms are half of ur grade so no flunking those. but the professor is nice (but strict, no talking during lecture) so as long as you make this class your priority then you should get a decent grade.
Me personally, I love Behzod! 🥹 He is a great professor 🧑‍🏫 and he does great work in the classroom.
He is one of the best professors at UIC and an easy grader. I was getting a B by a few points, but he curved it to an A. He is awesome.
Great prof! Attend lectures... Concepts are not hard but you can get behind quickly. Super chill guy

Although Yes - he is VERY lecture heavy and can get very boring hes a professor whos very nice, understanding and gives you the resourced to sucseed on the exams. He also hands out LOTS of extra credit so if you flop and exam or two it wont hit you as hard. Also his curve to get an A is around a 200 point system, and considering the amount o
The reviews weren't lying he is truly one of the best professor at the university. I wish he taught more classes because I learned so much from him.

He's super chill and a good lecturer. For this class, just pay attention to every lecture and take good notes and you will hardly have to study for the exams :D Offers extra credit and allows note cards to help for exams. Don't come to his class to talk, he's super nice be respectful.
Take this class. I swear he offers extra credit like candy. Although his accent is kinda bad he makes it up by providing easy exams and you could literally ask him almost anything and he'll do it.
The only professor I will rate. He is the best, choose him.

Amazing professor. He does have an accent so lecture can be hard to understand sometimes. Loads of extra credit. Exams weren't that hard as long as you showed up to class, you don't need to study too much for the exams. Nice guy and is willing to help. Take him if you can.
best uic econ teacher ever.

The professor was very helpful, but lectures were hard to follow along with due to the really fast pace and their thick accent. The good thing is his extra credit opportunities. I would not have passed the class if he did not offer extra credit. The exams also allow several notecards.
He was overall a nice professor but it was hard to understand his lectures due to his accent which made it hard to understand the materials. He gave extra credit which boosted my grade.

He is a really good professor. Lectures are clear as long as you read beforehand and pay attention. Exams are open-note (with notecards), and there are many extra credit opportunities. Behzod is always willing to help his students, and he really cares about them.

SO MUCH EXTRA CREDIT. Just be respectful in lectures, show up to class, do iClicker, do the homework, and take good notes and you'll do great. The professor allows you to use a generous amount of note cards on the exams so make sure to make good note cards they will save your life. Do all of these things and this class is an easy A!!!
While the tests were very hard, he offers a lot of extra credit and opportunities to improve your grade.

I expected this class to be difficult, but it was super easy and he offers extra credit and helps prepare his students for the midterms and exams. He gives amazing explanations on the topics and I would 10000% take his class again. As long as you study and review examples you will do great on the exams. I got A's on both midterms and the final.

Professor Ahundjanov was one of the best professors at UIC. He is the ideal teacher you want at your school because he cares about every single one of his students. The homework is easy and doable. He is extremely accessible outside of class as I, myself, have gone to office hours many times to get help and he has always helped me out. Great Prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Gotta love him cause I do(as a teacher).

EXCEPTIONAL!!! He needs to hold a lecture for other UIC professors so they can learn how to teach from him cause he is great. You just gotta love him. Goes out of his way to help his students. Loves and cares for his students and has a passion for teaching.

I loved him and his class. I wish I failed so that I can take another semester learning from him. Very knowledgeable about economics. The best professor in the world. I wish I can take every class with him.

Very good at explaining and providing lots of real life scenarios as explanations, accessible lecture slides & notes, lots of extra credit, skip more than 5 classes lowers a grade, allow index cards for notes during exams, must pay for ebook to do hw, the exam reviews are very helpful for the exams.
Gotta love daddy behzod

His lectures were all very boring and hard to understand because of his accent, for some people they were enough to learn off of but I preferred reading the textbook instead. The class itself wasn't bad once you knew the material, which wasn't hard to learn.

The best professor at UIC. Not one of the best but the best professor at UIC. The school needs to give him a raise and more recognition. I loved his class. He cares about every one of his students even though one class has 300 students. He wants everyone to succeed and do their best. Offers tons of extra credit. Great professor.

Best professor at UIC hands down. I loved his class. He knows how to teach and makes sure his students learn. Gives tons of extra credit. Theirs no way you won't have an A. I wish he taught more classes because I wanna talk more classes with him. Absolutely an amazing professor. We need more professors like him. Take him for Econ and no-one else.
Professor Behzod is amazing. This is my 3rd time taking him and I definitely recommend him to everyone and anyone!

Very straightforward! He goes over the slides during class and goes over examples. He shows how he works out the problems and draws diagrams so very helpful if you're a visual learner. Also, he shows real world examples! The exams are the same as review and he lets you use index cards for them! Go to class and do your homework and you'll be okay

He did a great job going through the lectures. He goes over examples and explains them through his notes on his ipad, take notes!!! they help you with homework and prepare you for the exams! he asks you if theres any questions through the lectures. there is 2 exams and a final (we got to use multiple index cards for each :)) overall, a good class.
lectures are well explained with handwritten diagrams and presentations and lots of materials. provides extra credit activities

i love this professor! literally anyone who has taken his claws have said that they love him. He is great and giving lectures and explaining things thoroughly, you are always able to go to him if you need help and he will explain things and go through things with you or really help you with your grade

He was super friendly and caring throughout the course. Gives lots of extra credit opportunities and it is not a very difficult class. Took him for both ECON 120 and 121. Also allows notecards with whatever notes or formulas you'd like to use for the test.

ECON 520 does not have a list to choose from here.

He is the great professor and give a great involvement.

Easy to follow if you do HW and listen to his lecture proferrly.
This guy is awesome. Gives extra credit opportunities, and the midterms and final exams are very easy. He allows notecards for the exam. Overall, an easy A class.
Great Person
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Great professor, give a lot of extra credits. Homework once a week, 2 midterms, 1 finals. Attendance is mandatory because of iClickers and the questions at the end of class. He allows the class to use 2 notecards for the second and 4 for the last midterm. Show up to class, do your homework/extra credits.

Sometimes a little hard to understand and read his handwriting but he gives a lot of extra credit at the end of the course. The class is easy to keep up with, he also assigns few homeworks throughout the semester. Would take him again.

He is the best professor of economics he cares about each student and helps them to get A in class he gives extra credit activities at the end of the semester which really helps to boost your grade. also, he assigns homework every single week which is so easy, and topics are covered in the class. He is the best professor of economics.

Loved his tech-savvy teaching style, a very good professor for the MBA 520 Econ class. 

At the beginning I tough it was going to be one of the toughest courses but it wasn't!
Attend the lectures and you're set for a good grade.
Great class overall, just had one homework each week, interesting lectures, and also allows you to use note cards in exams
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor really enjoyed his class. Attend lectures and you should get a good grade. Recommend taking any courses taught by Behzod!

Behzod is the best! One homework assignment per chapter (every week or every other week). He offers extra credit for each chapter, and allows 1 index card front and back for the midterm. Attendance is mandatory and through iclicker. Posts all his notes after the lecture! Really put time into what he shares. Would definitely recommend.

Behzod was very understanding, he stayed after class sometimes if you need him. He offers extra credit, and allows 1 index card front and back with notes on it for the midterm. Attendance is mandatory but not in-person, just join the iClicker and you should be good. Do your homework, do good on tests and you should be good.

He is a really good teacher. He is very smart, and his lectures are very interesting. The homework is easy, and you can learn a lot from it. Everything is super straight-forward, and the tests are extremely related to everyday coursework. I have taken a couple of his classes, and I have learned so much more about economics and the world.
He has amazing lectures and gave us homework once a week which was really easy. If you want grade A there is nothing difficult, just make notes for yourself and read them 2 hours before test.
One homework per week. He really explain really well. The first ECON class that I like and understood.
He is a good professor overall but you have to pay attention in his class to pass the exams.
Professor Behzod Ahundjanov gives good lectures. As long as you pay attention during class you will be fine for exams and homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: LOVE PROF BEHZOD!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: When it comes to intro classes, he's pretty good at it. But for econ 344, he was so confusing and the homework was super hard. Honestly, the only way I passed was having a study group. If you work with your classmates, this class is manageable, other than that, it was really hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Behzod was awesome. He is very intelligent and just knows what hes talking about. He explains subjects in a way where youll understand but be prepared to keep up! He talks quickly and covers things fast just because of the nature of the course. He loves what hes teaching!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor held lectures virtually and used iClicker to keep track of attendance and give us pop quiz questions during class. He lectures fast, so I just took notes from his PowerPoint slides. Homework can be tricky, especially since the questions had limited attempts. Professor made study guides for quizzes and exams which were very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Ai is a pretty seasoned professor, normally teaching grad classes. She places quite a lot of emphasis on group work and will expect you to find time outside of class to meet with your group and (at least from what I've experienced) most of the grading is done by her TA. All in all, she's pretty engaging but can get a bit carried away.

Loved her passion for econ and care for students. The class was engaging, and she knew how to foster discussions. However, she spends too much class time asking questions, which leads her to rush the lecture toward the end and makes it difficult to learn. She and the TA graded big assignments harshly, even though the instructions were vague.

Great professor who really cares about the success and wellbeing of her students. Her lectures can feel overwhelming but just make sure to pay attention. Decent grader, very lecture based, and there's a lot of homework but it's primarily small weekly assignment. She's very flexible so don't hesitate to ask for help if needed.
Lectures for the entire class. After a while you just begin to zone her out. She's really smart though & has a lot of knowledge to share. She just doesn't teach well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures the full 265 minutes, at times exceeding 3 hours unless stopped. Rarely gives feedback, except on techniques she never taught. Supposed to be skills-based but just a repeat of her 570 lecture. Cramming massive amounts of lectures, readings, and side-projects caused the class in failing to finish a city-contracted report by the deadline.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice and funny professor and willing to help out whenever and accept class feedback. Often lectures for 75+ minutes and asks for participation frequently, sometimes random and sometimes she will wait for a hand to raise. Overall, the topics can get very difficult at times and the homework can get a little rough, but it's not too bad.
She cared a lot about students. Sometimes the class felt disorganized, but it always worked out. Very flexible!
Very friendly and helpful but also difficult coursework, a lot of it, and terminology can be hard to understand. But if you need help and want to ask questions, she tries to be available.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice teacher. Always willing to help. Would definitely take her classes again.

She complained about us being behind but would lecture from start to finish. I would be so bored and she couldn't hold my attention very well. She was nice and cool, but you had to deal with many assignments and there was so much you had to learn from the lectures

Professor Ning Ai gives extremely long lectures that barely hold any attention. She also gives a lot of homework with little to no grading criteria but gets upset when you email her to ask questions or feedback. Probably a good professor for graduate students but a hard pass if you are taking US 240, which is required for Urban Studies.
Great class and the professor offers a lot of help.

This topic is really hard so the class is difficult, but Professor Gray makes it as accessible as possible. You get 5 skips, but go to as many lectures as possible because if not you will get behind. Takes notes because it helps a lot with the homework, and go to discussion sections and office hours too so you don't get behind.

PHIL102 can be a very difficult class but he goes out of his way to explain it as simple as possible. If you ask a question during class he won't make you feel dumb and will go out of his way to make you understand. He can ramble sometimes but overall a pretty good teacher.

Prof. Gray was very welcoming at the start of class, later in the year this all went out the window. I hope you're liberal, otherwise, this Prof. will let his political beliefs overpower the student-professor relationship. As a reservist service member, I have a commitment that I must fulfill. This Prof. does not like that, nor does he condone it.

Do not take this class if you are just trying to finish the general education requirements. Professor does not want technology in class. He whispers in a big lecture hall so barely anybody can hear him. No point in going to class because he gets distracted by people with their masks barely under their noses. Condescending and rude, but manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very good at thoroughly explaining a decently difficult subject. Lectures were content heavy, Professor Gray always answered questions with great detail, was very attentive and helpful during office hours, and encouraged attending group study (very helpful). Homework and tests weren't overwhelming and accurately reflected what we learned in class.

Teaching online is not the easiest thing to do, but Dr. Gray does a fine job presenting this course. Keep up with the lectures that he posts each week, and it'll be easier for one to achieve better in this course!

professor gray was great and very understanding. hard (but fun) class; you'll get through it if you stay on top of lectures and homework, go to discussion sections and tutoring group if need be. most of the pre-recorded lectures are from a different professor that sounds just like michael cera at 1.5x speed lol.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He has a very dry and stoic attitude mixed with extremely vague and abstract subject material. Not sympathetic toward online learning dynamics at all. Wish I wouldve taken regular math!

Hes a very chill and laid back professor, but I just wish I had more interactions with him. His powerpoint slides are super easy to understand, and he does a good job of making his lectures informative. However, I just never really had any interactions with him:/
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Whatever you do don't take this class as an easy intro course. There are 6 problem sets and they get harder and harder. Quiz every week. It's basically a math course with nothing to do with philosophy. You will struggle unless you like math and complicated stuff. Professor was nice but the class was extremely hard.

Philosophy of logic is a scrutinous topic, it's easy to mess up, but once you get it it's not too hard. Tough grader but provides extra credit. A lot of your grade is based on the 6 problem sets, which you should try to finish as soon as possible, because each one usually takes about 6 hours to complete. A lot of helpful resources are provided.

I really did struggle with this class. I am surprised it is a 100 level class and definitely should not be taken as gen ed or an "easy A". If you are good at math and complex equations, you might really love and appreciate this class, but as someone who chose this as a random gen ed, it was definitely tough.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you are taking this to fulfill your Gen ED requirements, don't take. There are better professors and classes out there. The main problem is that attendance is mandatory and he forbids electronics, which normally isn't a problem but he is REALLY boring. Oh and they want you to go to study sessions on top of that. It's too much work for a gen ed.

Professor Gray is very knowledgeable about the topics he teaches and I would take him again. Even though I took logic as a pass/fail class (I thought it was going to be super hard) , I got an A and I thought it was easy. He goes very slow, repeats things many times, and ask to every students' questions to make sure they understood the topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor overall. The course can be difficult to those who do not like math since the materials taught resemble equations you see in a typical math course. The class was very interesting and it definitely boosts your logic quite a bit. Easy class and easy professor. Go to the group study sessions to get help and earn extra credit.
Easy class and easy professor. The materials may be confusing at first, but with practice, its easy. Go to the group study sessions available every week and you can get a 5% extra credit

Professor Gray was awesome! For Phil 102, he taught the class very well. He offers a 5% extra credit if you attend a group study sessions for every problem sets he gives us. The 5% extra credit is a huge help to your grade, and no other logic professor does that. Love the professor!

Professor Gray is a super awesome teacher!  You can really tell he loves what he teaches and he does his very best to help his students understand the materials.  I was in the class about Death and some of the concepts were hard to understand but his lectures and lecture slides really helped!  If you need a gen ed this is a good class to take.

Read the excerpts assigned, but don't worry too much about remembering EVERYTHING. Go to class - notes help and lecture is fun. Skills exerciseseasy. Paperseasy (I got 90 on both with hardly any effort). He's awesome and you can tell he loves his job. He's really good at explaining things for the most part. Hands down, one of the best profs ever.

Prof Gray was always helpful, chill, tried to explain in different ways, and continuously asked if anyone had any questions throughout class-he always claimed that if you were confused, that it was good. 2 major papers & 10 total "Skill Exercises" (short answer prompt quizzes) are assigned. For the most part, the course is reading text/notes.

Professor Gray is one of the best Professors I've ever had, he's 100% interactive with the students throughout lecture. I took this class as a blow-off class and was set on doing the bare minimum, but this guy is amazing. Completely surprised me how much I love this class and my new found respect for Philosophy!  Definitely take a class with him!

Gray is fantastic! I definitely recommend taking his philosophy course. His powerpoints are clear- cut, so you don't have to do much of the reading. He can be dry at moments, but otherwise he's fun. The topics are engaging, and the class had 2 short essays and 2 tests. I felt I'd leave that class contemplating my entire existence sometimes...
Good professor, easy class. 2 papers(3-4 pages),2 tests, but no midterm and no final. Definitely recommend.
Very helpful professor who genuinely wants to help students who put in the effort. Understanding and listens to students. Open to counter-arguments and does not shoot our ideas down. Good professor.

I took Gray for two classes: Phil 100 & 102.  He is extremely helpful; genuinely wants to help you understand the material. During lecture he would constantly ask whether you had questions. He would explain more than twice if need be. Understands that people take his classes as gen eds & is lenient when grading. Overall, great professor!

I never comment on this site, but I had to for him! I loved this professor- he's very laid back, intelligent, a good listener. I liked that he encouraged discussion, though I sometimes wished people participated more! The power points are posted online - all of the material is from those. Pay attention, study, you'll get the A.

I am an English major and not very good at math, so I took it to knock out UIC's math requirement. This class seemed easy at first, but became very difficult halfway through the course, and a lot of people drop around this point. Gray explains in different ways to help everyone understand, but usually the TA is who you would ask questions to.

Logic is a difficult subject to understand and to teach. I give Aidan a lot of credit for the work he did. He's a very intelligent professor. Make sure you do the hw sets with others and you attend discussion. These things will help you a lot with the class. Aidan was also available to help his students.

The class was interesting and relevant to today which is why I stuck with it. Class is online but the prof is slow is respond to emails and waited to grade posts. Grading criteria was changed a few times and final exam had no study guide. Keep notes from quizzes for final and key topics from reading for reading responses.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is very careless and unempathetic with her students. Her class in itself is not necessarily difficult but her grading is irrelevant and too extreme for the tasks being asked. She limits her help to her students and is very unrealistic with her expectations. I ended with an 89 and she refused to round it despite my hard work.

This class is based entirely on one big group project that lasts the whole semester. There are no tests or quizzes, just group presentations. Tanja made this an awesome concept and it was an easy, enjoyable class because of this. She has an amazing background prior to coming to UIC and anyone who takes her class has a lot to learn from her.

This class was actually really fun! She puts you in groups and gives you a problem that you have to solve with your team throughout the semester. She is always there to clarify things, or if you need help. She wants to make sure everyone is involved, but having fun while doing it. I wish I could take this class again!

Good professor confused by the large amount of bad reviews on here. She is not the best lecturer that can be admitted but the hw and tests are not that bad. Plus the curve is heavily working in your favor you just need to put in a little bit of effort for this class. She is very helpful if you have an issue or problem and speak to her one on one.

Great prof! She was funny and her lectures were engaging. If you go to her office hours or ask her questions she will genuinely want to help you. Not sure why her rating is so low, but her class was made easier by preparing well for lectures and doing the HW. Easy class to pass.

While she herself may not be the best lecturer, the grading scale is so generous its practically impossible to not pass. Exams (especially the final) were not very difficult. Be sure to always attend class and do the homework since more than half of your grade comes from just that.

She is a great professor. The only thing I would say is that she tends to get monotone during some of the lectures, making it hard to pay attention. However, other than that, it is a great class, and the tests aren't really that hard; just try to stay focused.
Class was so easy, I showed up to every lecture and scrolled tiktok, did all the homework, but bombed every test and still got an A, annoying class to take but its fine.

If you use the lecture videos, study off the achieve homework (bios 222), and use the study guides she posts a week before exams, you'll do fine on the exams. She does read off the slides a bit but she knows what she's talking about. I spoke to her during her office hours and she's a pretty nice woman. Would def take again.

horrible. i signed up for a dif prof who had good reviews but on the first day of class she was there..? even when i studied and understood content, exams were extremely difficult and averages were low since she asks things we werent told to study. objectives for exams are so vague and slides are not helpful. dont take if u wish to keep brain cells

Lectures provide almost no information, slides are mostly images with little explanation. The “Textbook Resources” section on Blackboard has no textbook, just modules that don't support the lecture or learning objectives. You'll end up teaching yourself. Only plus side is exams are 30 multiple-choice questions.

Professor Alfonso is a pretty good teacher. She does have her moments where she seems strict, but I think she just wants a fair environment for the students. The classes are mandatory. The only issue is she basically just reads off the slides the entire lecture so you could learn from home. Overall interesting class though would reccommend.

Prof. Alfonso is one of the kindest and understanding professors I have ever had. willing to work with you if you are concerned about your grade, just communicate with her!! Go to her office hours, stay on top of achieve, attend class, and you finish w/a decent grade. she curves exams based on how well the class did. I would 100% take her again!

Gave a lot of resources to study/prepare (online textbook, learning objectives specific for tests, review sessions). Her lectures felt like they dragged on a bit and she gave more info than what was on the test, but she explained concepts pretty well. She is caring about students and is great to email ?s.

Exams do NOT reflect the content taught in class. Has literally said making the exams "harder" is a way to "prepare us for the future." No point in studying cuz the study guides and slides are useless. No point in even attending the class. Might as well just come for the exams and accept fate rather than sitting in her class and wasting your time.

Class is doable if you have bio prereq but you need to take notes in the class. She isn't the best at teaching but she tries and will curve tests. Tests are not easy but they're fine if you study slides and textbook.

Professor Alfonso can be demanding, but engaging with her system pays off. Lectures are dense, so staying focused and using resources like Unstuck study for study prep is key. Overall, a challenging yet rewarding class.

By far she was the most rudest, most difficult and OBNOXIOUS teacher I have dealt with.
1: Unorganized slideshows 
2: Long and boring classes 
3: No practice questions and no help
4: Tests WERE NOT about the stuff we learned in class
5: She memorizes your name and face 
6: Mono toned 
7: Just plain out horrible professor
8: Better to teach yourself
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Alfonso is a good teacher and her lectures are fairly easy to follow along. The exams are hard but she is very generous with points in homework, quizzes, and attendance. You will definitley have to put a decent amount of time in outside the class to understand the material the way you need to for exams.

She cares about her students, if you don't understand, she tries to help you until you understand. Her lectures are interesting and very relevant to her exams. If you are confused with her slides and cannot reach out, the book is useful. but she bases exams off slides. Overall kind and amazing professor that knows her students' name and face.
Don't take her class I dropped the average grade for a test was 67% bad teacher pick someone else. Gotta retake it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Alfonso is a knowledgeable professor whose lectures simplify more in-depth textbook readings and incorporate aspects of current research in cell biology. The homework is manageable and the exams closely follow the learning objectives. Attending lectures, doing i-clickers, and attending office hours can help a student excel in her class.

I value Dr. Alfonso's expertise in Cell Biology, but her lectures were challenging to comprehend. Despite the inherent complexity of the subject, the teaching approach, mainly reading off slides, lacked depth. I recommend relying on the e-textbook for a more comprehensive understanding, and reviewing assignment/quiz questions before exams.

Professor posts homework when she feels like it, and does not post on a set schedule making it very hard to keep up with. The lectures are all pictures, but she claims you don't have to read the text book to understand material. Exam averages are usually mid 60s and professor does not provide any study material for the exams, so they are very hard
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I personally do not hate professor alfonso just because of how great she is as a human being however as a teacher she cant teach to save her life, she refuses to make practice exams, exam guides, or anything that can help you with stuyding material that will be on a exam. If you do all your homework and I mean all of it you just might pass
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Alfonso is a great professor so don't worry about other reviews. She is very knowledgeable and explains every concept very well. It can be difficult for some but as long as you pay attention in lecture you'll do just fine. No physical textbook except Achieve which has the textbook but it's main use is the chapter homework and adaptive quizzes.

Very kind and empathetic professor. Homework is a must if you want to boost your grade. Exams 1 and 2 were extremely easy, but the last 2 got tougher. Read the book and watch the lecture prior to coming to class. A passing grade is granted just attending class, doing homework, and participating, so do not mess up and do not procrastinate.

I can see how others find her class disorganized. But, if you Watch her videos before lecture and use the lecture time as a review you will pass this class. She is very understanding and offers extra credit if she feels the class is not doing well. The participation and homework assignments are a large portion of her grading.

Easily the worst class and professor that I have taken. This was the most disorganized class and I completely regret taking the course due to the set-up and "reversed" teaching method.  The class is very difficult and you will not be passing this class if you aren't putting your full attention into content for this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: While I understand why people might complain about her and she does  sometimes lack understanding to situations. I genuinely do not think she the worst Professor in the world. Compared to other cell bio professors, I think shes probably the best. Just put in work outside you youll be okay. She may come off rude but she really isnt.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I consider myself good at bio; however, this class is so disorganized and not helpful. Her lectures don't help and I would rather read the textbook than attend her classes. The test questions are sometimes so weirdly specific or poorly phrased that I feel isn't a good reflection of the topics we learn. Avoid.

Honestly one of the worst professors I ever had. Her lectures are just her reading the slides and the tests are UNBELIEVABLY hard. Also very hard to understand, she does not speak clearly. It's not the accent, it's simply her voice. She is always mumbling.

This entire class is inconsiderate of any family problems, any issues with passing the class or even marginal grades. While she claims that there are opportunities to improve, she doesnt understand life happens for many people. Dont take her if you think you can convince for even a border grade. Just save yourself from the misery
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Not a good teacher for online classes. Just dumps 30-40min lecture vids, no interaction between students, tests have questions not covered in textbook, etc. Better to take her in person.

This Professor is very sweet and explains everything clearly. You can ask her hundreds of questions and she will try her best to answer you. I don't understand why people are complaining about her accent, it has nothing to do with your grade. Overall watch the lectures and ask her for help if needed. Stay on top of weekly work. Pick her!
This class covers the same exact things you've probably seen in highschool / BIOS 110. Just pay attention to her special topics and the exams are a walk in the park.

Fairly nice and organized, responsive to emails, and funny. Gave some EC; was generous w fixing an exam we struggled with. Can be a bit strict, especially w her grade cutoffs. Quizzes kinda hard, exams harder w shorter time. Can be a bit hard to understand at times. Lectures/Zoom are ok but the book/slides and drop-in hrs are more helpful, imo.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Does not speak clearly and mumbles through what she says. When she says things like rna dna and protein its hard to hear what she is saying. I cant hear the difference between rna and dna when she says it. This has never been a problem before for me. The first half of the semester with a different professor was much easier to understand.

This is how i got an A: i watched the lectures to get the idea, then watched youtube videos on basically every word she said to understand the material, then rewatch her lectures to get an idea of how she would word the questions. God bless youtube ppl because she is so bad. On the bright side I did learn a lot, but from youtube, not her. AVOID

Boring lecturer. She periodically switched back to a thick Spanish accent during the first lecture. And she would speed through certain words that should have been emphasized in normal english. Why UIC does not have better professors is not clear to me.

She is very interested in her work and what she teaches in class. However, her lectures are dense with material and at times can be hard to follow. The reading material is pointless to attempt as everything you need to know is in her lectures. Her quizzes are incredibly hard and specific ,but her tests are manageable if you study.

Her exams are nothing like what she talks in class. Her teaching was very bad. She would mention a topic but not explain it at all. he slides are useless. she is also very rude with her students, arrogant. don't take her class!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: barely gives extra credit, her lectures have alot of information. does not know how to teach,is rude,do not take her.. unless you are ready to get an F on the first exam. she definitely not the move. our class average was sixty two percent the entire semester. she gives questions on what she hasnt even taught.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Alfonso leads a class with A LOT to cover. The tests are heavy in terms of content and it takes a lot of time to study for them. She herself is very friendly and caring and passionate about cell biology. I just found her class to be somewhat stressful (especially when she couldn't explain things clearly due to a slight language barrier).
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor will tell you exactly what to study for the exams and provide material for that information. The professor's lecture slides are very visual-heavy with little words, missing a lecture and attempting to look at the material at home is difficult. She is accessible outside of class most of the time. She is straightforward, not mean.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prepare to think critically. NEVER MISS CLASS, please read her power points before class. Her exams are from lecture power points and iClicker questions. The book is great to understand the concept, but not for exam. please use her OFFICE HOURS. Topics mentioned during class will mostly be in exam. Optional presentations will boost your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Aixa Alfonso was the worst professor I've ever had. I have my Masters with a 3.9 and I needed this class so I continue my education. Alfonso was very rude. She criticizes her students and makes them feel unintelligent. She called me rude names and has a very hard accent. She is difficult to understand.I wish I could say more. PLEASE DO NOT TAKE HER
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor unless you need to. She is rude and hates when someone asks a question. She doesn't answer emails. The exam questions are more difficult than clicker and homework questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Alfonso is one of the rudest professors I have encountered in my education. If you have a disability, don't expect her to try to accommodate you. Her rudeness aside, I struggled a lot in this class. She reads off the powerpoints and is very confusing. I would take another professor if you could.

you can tell she cares a lot about her students. she gives clear guidelines on how to do well in class, has practice exam questions, & a good class to prep for MCAT. grade is exams, homework, clicker & participation. A is 85

Read the book and do the question banks for an A. If lazy just look up the answers online and look at her examples in her slides for the same grade. Lecture was confusing and long, and she forgot about homework by the third week. She curved our exams and gave us a massive curve for our final. Easiest advanced bio course, easier than Bio 100.

Her lectures are not helpful at all but she gives us all the "homey" feeling and genuinely cares about us. If you do and understand the question banks as well as her learning objectives on slides the A is very doable. The question bank and book go hand in hand. She also ended up giving us plenty of extra credit and curves on tests for our class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The exams of alfonso and dubreuil are very difficult in class they just read PowerPoint that anyone can do on their own, they do not explain anything. You will be able to do a little bit better with so much struggle in Alfonsos section but in Dubreuil section you will not be able to understand a single thing and his exam so difficult. Dont take!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Alfonso is so sweet, she really knows her material and really wants you to understand. The tests are difficult but you get full points on iclicker just for answering and every once in a while she uses echo 360 questions. Lectures are lecture captured. The class isn't easy but i really like her as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It is better to take other professor for Cell Bio. This class makes my life miserable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She does not know how to teach. Her PowerPoint are non sense. Exams are very difficult. Her practice papers does not help at all. She is not organized. She doesnt explain anything well. She just read PowerPoint, and she doesnt explain anything, its like any student can go and read that!
Alfonsos exams are extremely hard, she gives practice exams that dont match whats on the actual. She reads straight from the PowerPoint so i dont feel like she actually teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: When taking Bio 222 at UIC i would recommend taking a different professor. Alfonso is very kind, but her class is extremely difficult compared to other professors. Other professors offer extra credit and drop your lowest exam- Alfonso does NOT. I received a 84.99% (85%+A) in her class and got a B, so when she says she does not curve she MEANS IT.

She is not fluent in English. During lecture she repeats words a lot like many times she does not speak words correctly so she correct by saying it again. Exams are difficult, and they do not meet to the level of her lectures. She does not explain stuff at all and ask everything in exams like she explained it very well.
She doesnt explain her power points well. Her exams are very hard.
Try to avoid her if you can rather than you will regret.

Professor Alfonso was my favorite!! Her exams are very fair. Mixture of lecture and powerpoints. No book needed, she will tell you this too. She is very straightforward. She focuses on understanding the diagrams and what is written on them. In order to get an A read the powerpoints a few times, do the question banks she posts, and ask her questions
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Avoid taking her if you can. Most of your grade depends on exams and they are extremely difficult. She doesn't teach effectively AT ALL. She reads off of her powerpoints and that's it. Lectures are boring and she says you don't need the book but it'll prepare you for the exams more than her. If it wasn't for iclickers I would never go to class.

I've never had a professor that cares so much about students actually understanding the material. She doesn't make you memorize unnecessary details. She wants you to learn. Her exams are very fair, all based on her lectures and not the textbook. Uses iclickers every day and they are just completion. Very few hw assignments. An A is an 85%!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Aixa is awesome. Attendance is taking via iClicker every class period. She uses lecture capture, which is great. The tests are hard, but if you prepare ahead of time you should do okay. A lot of test questions are taken from iClicker questions and the study guide. 85% is an A. She doesn't teach straight from the textbook, so read what's assigned.

she is awesome, she gives lectures which are so helpful. her exams are tricky but you can pass if you study hard. dont miss her lectures. I like the way she is teaching. she doesnt give any work to get extra credit, but she has in class exercises and 2-3 work paper that you need to upload to blackbored.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: EXTREMELY difficult exams  . she teaches REALLYYYYY bad. compared to what you will get on tests. Grading is really bad. dont take her.

Dr. Alfonso is a nice and understanding lady but her exams are very difficult. Prepare to be studying a lot for this class. She is helpful during office hours as long as you show the effort and go there. She will try her best to explain the material but students find that it is still hard to grasp. Be prepared for a hard class.

-READ THE BOOK- But even then, an A is not easy. You need to work for it. You need to review ALL her PowerPoint slides (which are jumbled and nonsensical, to say the least), and read each chapter word for word. Everything is fair game. Not so easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: She can be boring at times, but she is very sweet and helpful. She made the class somewhat enjoyable where as the other professor who taught sections of this course was very rude. She makes you feel like she truly cares for us students and is always available for help. She gets a lot of bad rep because of the other professor unfortunately.

I regret taking this class with professor Alfonso. She teaches something else and test you on something else. Sincere recommendation would be to not take her. Extremely tough exams with averages of 40%. She's very slow spends time explaining only one thing and the rest read on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's honestly one of the nicest professor's I've come across. I got an A in her class, and here's how. LISTEN TO HER LECTURES, she had lecture capture when I was in her class, if she doesn't now, find a way to record her. Her diagrams are KEY. Study her slides. If you can explain the diagrams like you're telling a story then you're good.

Her lectures are really boring.  The slides are a bunch of diagrams and pictures so they're useless to refer back to.  THE KEY TO DOING WELL is reading the book.  Reading each chapter clarifies everything and is a pretty good read as well.  Make sure to do practice ?s as well.  Very helpful. Challenging but try doing well early.  Hard to catch up.

there's no way to get an A! you don't know until last point what you're getting basically your grade is based on others grade! 45% got a C almost 120ish students. Her quizzes are impossible!!! I got As in first two quizzes with other prof and with her I failed both of hers! DON'T TAKE HER unless you want to get a C!

If there's someone else teaching, pick them. Otherwise, get ready to spend half a lecture discussing a question she has for you from ONE SLIDE. Literally, she drags out some of these slides. Half her exam is from the practice problem worksheets and I-clickers and the other half.. do not remember ever reading or discussing some of those things.

Her exams involved taking more details from the book and memorization rather than concepts, but there were still some conceptual questions. Nevertheless, knowing the concepts and big picture still help a lot with her exams. Just watch out for cutting corners during studying! Do the practice questions. They help a lot at organizing the book details!

hard to get A in class. not good in teaching. we covered only 1/4 of book. doesnt have office hours. doesnt post old exams on bb & TA is useless. exams are based on memorizing slides. read book chap three times to get hold of concept. get ans for study bank ques. boring class. give iclicker to ur friend and study for it during class time. hate clas

The book is somewhat of a necessity.  To do well on exams is to memorize both the text and lecture slides (which are simply a rehash of the book).  Many questions are pulled from the question bank. Bland style of teaching.  If attendance wasn't taken there is no point in going to class.  Overall a mediocre teacher.

Dr. Alfonso is not as bad as everyone made her seem.  On the contrary she made the material very understandable as long as you listen to her. Only con is her accent(I've had way worse). Test were very straight forward. Material was interesting. Easy A if you STUDY and put in the effort.

Doctor Alfonso is a great professor. Her exams were very fair and she was always willing to explain material during office hours. Her exams were based on the powerpoints and the textbook was there for further explanations. If you listen and understand what goes on in class you should be fine. Lecture capture is also available!

Monotone, just skims slides and isn't clear on what to know. Exam questions are solely based off memorizing chapters. Gives difficult take home quizzes. Tries to memorize peoples names in a lecture hall and tends to put you on the spot while asking questions
Mean and condescending. Lectures are monotone and exams are a game of decoding diagrams or remembering a million facts. Not very much learning buts tons of load.

I actually really liked her. Not because she was easy, that's definitely not the case, but because she suited my style. I'm more of the book oriented person and test taker so for her, exams are literally all the book. But make sure you know the chapters front and back. If you don't like that you might want Featherstone, he's more of concepts.

I had her for the 2nd half of the course and Featherstone for the first. Day and night opposite. For Featherstone, if you can read and think, you will pass, her, there is no way you can get anywhere without memorizing every single page of every chapter covered. He didn't focus on factual recall much but her the details are deadly.

Professor Alfonso is a really sweet person, but her lecture slides are not helpful. Listen: To do well in this class, you need to do the homework sets and back of the chapter problems. Probably ~60% of the exam questions come word-for-word from the problems she gives you and back of the book. Do them. And read the book before class.

She does not teach. All she does is ask simple questions to the class so you'd expect exam content to be general. No, exams are extremely difficult and the content is wayyyy tougher than what she "teaches." I wouldn't even say she reads off slides b/c she doesn't even do that. She skims over stuff and says "you don't need to memorize this."
Class is decent but Alfonso is one of the worst professors you'll ever have. She's extremely rude to students and her lectures are completely useless. avoid if possible

Lectures are useless to go to- she reads off slides and exams are straight memorization. Her exam questions are not clear at all. Alfonso and Featherstone teach in completely different styles. The class is tough but only because of their grading scale- the material really is not hard if you put in the time.

In my opinion, her exams were based off of blind memorization and very little actual learning. Her exam questions were unclear and ambiguous, especially compared to the prof who teaches 2nd half of course. Her lectures are boring (monotone voice), and I find it impossible to stay awake (although I'm a "nerd" who usually never sleeps in class)
Really nice (brought us candy for valentine's day and let us take quiz home), good at explaining material, fair exams. Best biology teacher I had at uic so far.

She is very nice. She only teaches for the first half of the class. The first two tests are hers and they are in my opinion, much easier than the teacher who teachers after her. All exams are pretty much based off of the book so if you read the book you should do fine. The exam will seem ambiguous and confusing if you don't read the book!

She's an extremely nice lady. She's stuck teaching a crappy class so I sympathize with her. She's a decent teacher, her tests are pretty easy, and she does a pretty good job of covering the material. Her outside knowledge is a bit questionable at times, but she's tolerable.
Her slides are very well put together and she explains very well. The only problem is she is not very good at answering questions but she at least tries her best.

She's really nice and also a decent teacher. Her powerpoints are really long and detailed, but she's pretty clear about what's going to be on the exam if you e-mail her or ask in person. Definitely have to read the book. Lectures were a bit slow, but people asked some pretty stupid questions at times...80% was an A so it's not that difficult.

Lets clarify one thing, she sucks. She has no interest in teaching and makes you feel like she is very bored with the class... How can people say that she is a good teacher?? She didn't even know what a butyne is lol actually every time someone asked something her response was,"i will look it up". Only UIC would keep such a professor in their staff

I thoroughly enjoyed professor Alfonso's lectures! She explains things very well and has a sense of humor. I prefer her over the other professor who teaches the course as professor Alfonso explains things more thoroughly.

She is so cool with her funny comments! do one thing, buy book and read the entire book like and memorize every single line of it! MOST IMP: study diagrams and FIGURES from book. you will get an easy A

She can put a fly to sleep and makes no effort to make the material memorable, she always says you need to understand this but doesn't explain it thoroughly. She'll describe what's going on in the diagrams but not WHY its important just that its important or what happens when it doesn't function properly which is what's on the exam DO NOT TAKE HER!

Difficult to understand (not a language issue though), I just read the book which isn't half bad.  Lectures are extremly boring.  If you are interested in cell bio, do not take her! She does seem nice so maybe office hours would be benefical to you
She was very helpful when asked questions. Lectures are all powerpoints which she posts before. Read the book or you'll fail the exams. Curve is pretty decent.

Doesn't believe in "babying." It means she doesn't really help.. I got an A. It was the TA that helped me, though. Alfonso doesn't solely write the quizzes. Her English is lacking. Usage of the phrase "nature of" in a quiz is not something a modern scientist would use. "What is the nature of this protein?" for example. Smart lady; bad teacher.

THE worst professor I have taken at UIC. The test questions were ridiculous and impossible not 'challenging' and didn't test your knowledge of anything. Studying hours for her tests won't get you anything higher than a 65 percent, hence the class average. Her quizzes were open book but still impossible. Save yourself the misery,and dont take her

For any bio or science majors, this class is interesting but Alfonso's teaching style really sucks. Her quizzes are open book but they are EXTREMELY!!!! LONG and HARD!
