She is very nice person,she wants to help you and you can see that,she cares about her students.she is very fair with her grading.the course by itself is easy.if you study the book,no way you won't get an A.You have to write 2 compositions and you'll write 6 exams and the worst one she will take it out.I got an A and i believe you can too..
LOVED HER! She is avery helpful and there is no reason you cannot get an A in her class! She does not ask for much from any of her students. She prepares you very well for each and every exam!
She does all she can to help you get an A in her class.
Very funny lady. She says whats on her mind. Understanding and easy to talk to. Makes the class entertaining.
she is a great instructor and definatly an easy A
In high school, I was taught Spanish only by white women. I was nervous about having a native speaker as a teacher, but it worked out great. She's excellent. Loved her class.
Cool Spanish accent but very helpful and funny!
She is a really funny lady. Participating is very important to her.  she is very accomodating. TAKE HER!!
class was pretty dull, but shes a very sweet and helpful lady.
Funny person.  Easy to understand.  Very easy going.
the goat. take this class 10/10.
Very caring towards her students

I loved Profe. Arana-Rochel, I took her 113 Spanish Class which was a nice introduction to bilingual Spanish. I reached out to her when I was overwhelmed with classes and classwork. She extends deadlines and genuinely cares bout her students and wants to see them succeed. She's funny and makes class fun. I would love to take her again.

Professor Arana-Rochel is amazing. She's very caring, relatable, and funny. Wants all of her students to succeed and makes sure everyone is on the same page before moving on. Lectures were great and engaging.  HIGHLY recommend her for 114!!

Overall, a caring professor. 
I am grateful that I had her as my Spanish professor. 
I wouldn't take her class again because I am done with college Spanish.

She is the best, super sweet and caring. Reaches out to her students if they miss class being concerned and wanting to help you catch up. She is funny and class was always fun I never felt overwhelmed.

Profesora Arana-Rochel is so nice and genuinely wants her students to succeed in the class. Exams and homework assignments were online & she basically gives you the answers with the PowerPoints from the class. The extra credit is very easy too. You will write a lot in this class but the topics are easy to write about if you pay attention in class.

Prof. Arana-Rochel genuinely cares about her students and is incredibly understanding. Some participation is required but she makes sure everyone feels comfortable. She will even extend deadlines if you feel overwhelmed by work from other classes. Easily one of the best professors at UIC!
She passed away this june. Was a nice professor

people dislike her but I recommend her cause she has a lot of knowledge. She has her ups/downs but she will give the resources you need. This class is difficult to most students because they don't put in effort. if you put in your 50 percent you'll end up with the desired grade cause Dr Hammerich does her part. Not bad, don't be too afraid of her.
I learned a lot. I only wish she was more approachable.
i would give her a 0 but it wouldn't let me. terrible. not only as a professor but as a person. spends more time complaining than teaching and talks down to her students. she needs to retire already.

Dr. Hammerich is not as bad as people make her seem. Yes, the class is a lot of work, but it's five credit hours so that should be expected. If she sees you working hard, you will be rewarded in the end. Her lectures aren't great but she's very approachable during office hours. Her quizzes and exams are tough, too, but she curves very generously.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The curve is the only thing that will save your grade. I would not recommend taking this class she doesn't know how to teach and the TAs will probably be better instructors than her. She's really nice during office hours though so I would recommend setting it up at least once. The lab is the only part of this course that is mandatory to show up for

The lab reports can be very time-consuming and confusing, so make sure to prioritize them. The class is hard, but the professor actually wants you to do well, and she will help you out if you reach out and show that you're working hard

This class is a good example of a entry level course taught by research faculty. Explanation of the basics of chem are lacking, and higher level material is interspersed but not explicitly taught (which makes it confusing for people who have not taken chem before) that said, if you have not taken highschool chemistry do not take this course.

Quite an intense course, feels like two classes at once (the lab and the lecture). Study her slides, get as much practice problems as possible, and hope for the best for the exam. Quite brutal especially being a freshman

Tough 3 credit class requiring a lot of self-study. She doesn't hand people the A easily, so make sure you understand the equations and concepts behind the things you learn. In terms of difficulty, quizzes are harder than homework, which are harder than exams. Exams are basically the bread and butter of your grade, so master the homework.

Lectures are extremely bland, and barely resemble the quizzes and exams. Homework tends to be extremely quantitative, quizzes conceptual, and tests are a mix of both. She can come off as rude sometimes. Your best bet is cramming slides before quizzes, and cramming homework before exams. The final was so left field and super conceptual.
The absolute worst prof I've ever come across. I don't need to go into detail there's plenty of reviews for that. All I'll say is save yourself before it's too late and rip if you're stuck with her
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took this professor as she was the only one available for Analytical Chemistry. She has yet to teach me anything, as most of the "learning" I did came from reading the book and completing Sapling assignments. She's a good person but NOT a good instructor. She doesn't know how to teach and therefore most students don't attend lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Hammerich is definitely a professor who means well, but I would avoid her classes. Her lectures are very content-heavy, however, she does not use powerpoints. So, if you miss a class, you will be behind in the course material. Finally, her exams are difficult since they are more conceptually based, rather than the questions she goes over in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Tries explaining concepts but ends up confusing students more. Jumps around to different ideas during lecture so is extremely difficult to follow along. Exams are really challenging so that the class average was a 40. Points out what is on the projector slide, but does not explain it. So point is: if possible do not take any of her courses!!!

Not good at teaching material during lectures but a bit more helpful during office hours. Homework is due Monday morning at 10 while every other gen chem 2 professor is 10pm so you cannot get help from MSLC with almost double the amount of homework. She does not record lectures or have slides and makes many mistakes during class.

More work for this class than any chem class. Lab section was so full it took 35 min to even mass something out. Going to lecture is absolutely useless. I went for quizzes and used only my gen chem knowledge to get through the class. I have no respect for a her. She showed up to the final over an hour late. I was 0.07% off an A, did not round me.

worst professor ever. showed up 50 minutes late to THE FINAL and still made us take it. treats class as if it's a 400-level class. over complicates all concepts. 2 labs per week on top of online hw, written hw, and quizzes. grading scale is never clear. PLEASE AVOID!!!

She's definitely knowledgeable. However, this class is very hard and she made it difficult by not being able to convey the concepts to the students. Her exams are similar to her homework; her lectures don't really correlate with the homework. She makes many mistakes in class, so it's difficult follow. Awesome person, but should've been a scientist.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She constantly makes mistakes during lecturers. She is not very useful in lectures but is very helpful in office hours. DO THE SAPLING to study for quizzes and tests. The textbook is pretty good so let that carry you. The tests are quite hard and most of the class doesn't finish. Stay on top of homework and labs, use the textbook, and you can pass.
Exam questions are nothing like the material she covers in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Her exams are tough but they are curved and so are her quizzes! It depends on the class average though. Watch a lot of YT videos, go to discussion sessions or TA office hours!!!!!!!!!!!

The material is a little difficult to get. I did not purchase the book and I'm still passing. She does expect you to put in effort; if you contact her for help she will make time to help you grasp as much as you can. Truly not as bad as her score on here. 100x Better than the other professors for this course. She's really sweet and adorable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Her lectures are ridiculously confusing. It consists of her simply standing there for 50 minutes and deriving equations, which only serves to confuse students even more. The worst professor I've taken at UIC. She also gives insane amounts of homework, and her test averages are extremely low. Avoid at all costs.

Dr. Hammerich is one of the hardest Chem professors at UIC. She treats CHEM II as if it was a 400 level course. However, she curves the quizzes, every single page of the exam, the whole exam, and the final grade so you can't really complain. Read, study, and practice the problem sets and you will be fine. DO NOT SLACK OFF!
SIMPLY THE BEST!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I thought that she was a great teacher. After reading the reviews I was worried about taking her but she was the best professor I've had so far. I think people do not like her because she has a very old fashioned teaching style but I loved it. She would use one of those projectors that I hadn't seen since elementary school and write everything out.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Mega nice
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Hammerich truly is one of the hardest professors I have ever had at UIC tough one of the cleverest and most caring ones. She sincerely wants you to succeed in her class and is willing to help you whenever you need so. Her office doors are always open to anyone who struggles in class and she is very amusing some times. The class is HIGHLY curved

A lot of people claim she is the worst but they don't work for it. Prof. Hammerisch is tough but an 80 and above is considered an A without the curve. The exams are hard but she curves every exam AND the final grade so you can't really complain. Don't need to attend lectures but make sure you know you study a lot and attend discussions.

I had a perfect 4.0, all A's in my previous classes until this class. The lectures just confuse you. Her lectures damage brain cells and they make you stupider. Avoid any class she teachers, you will regret it. Your money will be wasted if you take her classes.

I have enough credits to have a Bachelor degree and then some. Decent person I think, but worst professor I have ever had. Lectures are confusing and don't teach me anything. I had As in every other class but a C in hers. I barely passed. I worked hard and studied 16 hrs without sleep for the final and still barely passed. AVOID THIS PROFESSOR.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!! This is THE WORST professor I have ever taken at UIC. If you see this professor teaching CHEM 340, wait or take the class at another college. The exams are insane and the lectures make no sense. Her curving of the grades is a trick, it will not be a good curve. RUN!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Hammerich has been truly an amazing Chemistry teacher. She truly cares for her students and really wants them to understand the material. The reason why so many people had a hard time in her class is because they did not want to read the book. Overall a fantastic teacher and I only wish she would teach Organic Chem 1

Compared to other pchem professors at UIC, she can make hard material digestible. I really enjoyed her lectures as they are engaging. She is also a nice and interesting person to talk to outside of class. She is good because she likes what she does! I also like hes sense of humor and found some of her mannerisms amusing in a good way of course.

Dr. Hammerich is overwhelmingly a difficult professor, but she does care. Her teaching style is hectic and seems geared towards those who have already taken chemistry. Be prepared for tangents in lecture. However, the class is curved nicely and there are opportunities to raise your grade through showing improvement. She isn't awful, but not easy.

Professor Hammerich is definitely one of the hardest professors I have ever had throughout my studies of General Chemistry, however, she provides lots of practice problems and cares about the success of her students. The class is curved so even if you get a low grade, you might be getting a C in the class. Take her if you wanna challenge yourself.

Does not explain any concepts thoroughly during lectures. You barely understand what she is talking about because she has a habit of fling through concepts and expecting to understand them all. Does not use Slides/Powerpoint for lecture; uses a projector. Lecture notes are on a Word Document shared through her website. Also doesn't use Blackboard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Average professor. This class I feel was not too different from General Chemistry II so I paid very little attention and still passed. She makes small mistakes like addition and multiplication errors, but not wrong equations. Do the online homework and you are set for the exams. Anyone who says shes a bad professor probably doesnt know how to study

She's a terrible professor,makes a lot of mistakes while teaching , sometimes giving the wrong equations. Her lectures are a waste of time. She spends most of her time explaining graphs instead of going over problems. Her exams and quizzes are way different from sapling and assigned homework. Please future CHEM 222 students don't take her.

You write down the answers shown in the textbook and in lecture and they are marked wrong on the tests. Her tests do NOT reflect what is taught in the textbook, homework, and lecture. If she is teaching this class, do NOT take her & wait a semester for a new teacher for CHEM 222. Only positive is she is a nice person outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: She is a very boring professor but she makes the material easy to understand even though she is sometimes vague with her explanations. As long as you continuously go to the lectures and take good notes, you will undoubtedly succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The amount of homework she assigns is exaggerated, especially if you are taking other demanding courses. On top of this, you are penalized heavily for getting wrong answers. The same goes for her tests, they are just too long for the time allotted. Worst professor I have had, and I am a senior Biochemistry major.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Usual teacher. Passed exams with minimal effort (for a C grade). Way too much work for this class though, theres a 3 hour lab twice a week on top of 2 lectures a week and atleast 3 hours of homework a week. That doesnt include studying on top, thats just the basic requirement if you want to do the bare minimum.

The worst professor at UIC by far! She is not fair. She gives a crap load of homework assignments to turn in person and to submit online. Her quizzes and exams are not the same material she reviews in class, so be prepared to study on your own. Absolutely hated her lectures, apparently so did she, she would have tantrums on how confusing it was.

Lectures are useless. Vast majority of the class never finishes the difficult exams. Every question appeared to be a curveball. Most of my semester involved doing work for this class. Labs are basically just data analysis but are graded harshly by TAs. Avoid if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Awful awful class. More work than in pchem or orgo 2, tons of homework. Homework is due before she explains it in lecture. Labs are graded seemingly randomly, as well as lab notebooks. Impossible to get an A unless you put HOURS AND HOURS of work into this course. Not worth it. Garbage structure, would never take again.

She has no real idea how to teach. She has good intentions, and she's obviously brilliant, but she doesn't know how to impart that information. The lectures are a waste of time; she might even cover some material, but it doesn't help you complete the homework or even do the tests. Too fast-paced, and goes on tangents a lot. Good luck keeping up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Too much work, so little time. VERY hard grader. Very confusing, lecture difficulty vs labs, tests, quizzes difficulty was no where close to the same.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Her lectures are good if you come to class prepared but you won't understand anything if you havn't given any original thought to a problem. Here's how to do well in UIC pchem: find your own textbook with sol manual do the easiest problems figure out the units kno the equations. start asking her questions about her homework because its really hard.

At this level you'd expect to follow the math pretty well on your end. However, there were many math errors during most of her lectures. supplemental material was often more helpful than going to lecture.  she likes to do in class assignments randomly to give extra pts for those who attend class. Material can be real confusing, but it's do able.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Chem 114 isn't something you would expect to be quite easy. Professor Hammerich isn't the best one but she truly prepares you for Organic Chemistry. Her exams are quite challenging but then again she curves a lot. Lectures are not mandatory but attending the lectures helps you prepare for the exams. Go to her office hours and she will help!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Honestly, Chem 222 (analytical chemistry) is not that hard, but the way that Hammerich "teaches" just confuses everyone. Don't bother going to lecture, just study Sapling and the textbook. Her lectures are very basic while her exams/quizzes are more difficult and in depth. Also be ready to do A LOT of homework: 2 labs a week + sapling + written hw
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Very difficult course follow all the homework and memorize how to do each problem on her discussion worksheets that got me an A.

Hammerich is the hardest 114 professor but definately glad I took her. She prepares you for Orgo and even though her tests and quizzes are hard she curves a lot which makes your desired grade more manageable to attain. If you want to learn take her class. I am not a science major so I find chem harder than usual.

A very approachable professor. It's a difficult class and the tests are very difficult, but the class curve makes the class manageble. Very accomondating professor really sweet outside of her lecture and if you sincerely ask for help she will sincerely give it to you. If you're the student that misses an exam and expect a make- up well no!

Her class is tough but she's there in office hours if you need help and is always willing to help you out. The class is intimidating but she's soo nice. She curves the class a lot, but you still need to work for the grade you want. Read the textbook and do the OWL homework it helps!

I didn't think Dr. Hammerich was too bad. The average of the first exam was a 50 something % and she said she was VERY pleasantly surprised and that we might ruin her reputation (as a hard professor) lol. She curves left and right, the quizzes, labs, practicals, each page of each exam, the whole exam, and the final grade. Be sure the read though!!

Most people say this class is hard yet for some reason i received a better grade here than in chem 112 by a more highly rated professor. Curves a lot for the exams, for example I received a 66% on one which was a B. If you ask a question in lecture she sounds angry to answer the question. Work gets tough but study and you'll get it.

I found out why her class is the only chem section at UIC with about 50 spots open. All other sections were full and its been like that every semester. She is very mean when answering questions, very confusing as well. She just works on problems and doesn't explain the formulas . Homework and quiz right on the second week of class!! No make ups!!!

Dr. Audrey Hammerich is a kind teacher. Sit in the front b/c people like to talk toward the back. Throughout the semester the lecture room will get empty because this is a difficult course; however it is not impossible if you pay attention and read. She curves generously, but you still have to work hard. Her office hours are what saved my grade!

Hammerich wants you to understand the material rather than be able to just do problems you've previously seen. I got an A, but it was very challenging. She sets you up for orgo which I finally appreciate now that I'm not stressed anymore. Read the book and extra assigned readings to pass. Overall, I would take her again despite how hard it was.

Hammerich is a tough professor for a gen chem class. There are 3 exams, weekly sapling assignments, 4 quizzes, and 4 practicals, so u have to be on top of ur game because this class will take a lot of ur time. She curves her exams by a lot.  If she sees you putting in effort she will bump your grade up if you are borderline. Hard work, but got an A

Hammerich is definitely the hardest professor for 114. She makes you work hard for your grade but she also curves a lot which is helpful. You can't study the night before for an exam. Find a good TA and study hard. She prepares you for orgo!

It's a hard class and her teaching style during lecture is confusing. She still uses an overhead projector. If you go to her review sessions before the exams, she's really helpful and will tell you what kinds of questions to expect on the exams if you ask her. She curves the exams a lot; for one exam a 70% was an A.

Make sure to do all the weekly worksheet problems and supplemental problems. Lots of exam questions come off of those with just the numbers changed a little bit. Prof's super helpful in office hours. Really sweet and fascinating professor in person.

She's really passionate about chem but she's just not good at teaching it.  AT ALL. It seems as if her exams are designed to fail. Expect homework, 30 questions per week. She's also rude to her students when we ask questions. She gets easily frustrated when we don't understand the concepts right away & she expresses it by embarrassing us in lecture
She's definitely helpful if you go to her with any questions. She really knowledgeable and knows her information. As long as you put in some effort, you will do fine.

She really dumbs down Chemistry and all you have to do is show up to class and the tests are basically what's on the ppt. She is one of the best chemistry professors out there. I would definitely recommend her.
I liked her. She was willing to work with me once I went into her class to get help. It's not an easy class by any means, and you have to work hard to get the grades.

I must say having a good amount of knowledge prior to entering her class, I still felt due to her teaching style id have to work hard to earn a decent grade. Her lectures are unnecessarily complicated. dropped.

Hammerich is the hardest chem professor I have ever had! She makes everything much more complicated than it should be, you have to know the concepts well. She doesn't use blackboard nor does she provide study guides or PowerPoint lectures. All her lectures are on done on an overhead projector and goes through them fast. She makes the tests tricky!

My first ever college class was CHEM112. Of course my first class was hard and I just thought it was because it was my first day, but it only got harder. Do not take this class coming straight out of High School, it will destroy you. She is very mathematical in her teaching and she goes super fast so it is hard to follow. Try to take someone else.

This was a general chemistry course. Her lectures are helpful if you pay attention. Her tests are long and hard, so make sure you know the material. Overall, she's a cute lady. Online homework every week. Mandatory discussion. If you ask for help it's there in the form of the professor andor the TAs. Good luck!

I took her for Chem 112 and I never spoke with her because I chose not too. I would rather get help on my own or from my TA.  She would do problems and then mess up her algebra and get lost and would work on her fixing her algebra for 5+ minutes. As a person I am sure she is nice but I simply don't like chemistry and I would never take her again.

What most people fail to understand is the fact that no matter how "good" or "bad" the professors are, you are the one who has to teach most of the content yourself. I think that the mark you get in her course is directly reflected on the effort you put in chem. Exams as always are going to feel hard, (not everyone can get A 's you know?) Study m8!

You should definitely attend lectures. Her discussion worksheets are useful for preparing for the exams. Labs are pretty straightforward if you have a good partner, but the calculations can get very confusing. REMEMBER all the weird elements and compounds.

DO NOT TAKE HER. What ever you do, do not take Hammerich unless you want to ruin your gpa. She won't care that you did badly either, even if chem is your major. The other Chem 112 classes are SO much easier. Take someone else. Please don't make my mistake.

Her lectures consists of her talking about global warming and the history of Chemistry. She's all over the place when explaining how to do a problem. Her exams and quizzes are way harder than other professors that teaches CHEM 112. Overall, don't take her for any classes.

I had the opportunity to compare my first exam with the first exam of other professors and realized that they are fairly different. I  would say Hammerich makes her quizzes and exams much more difficult than needed for General College Chemistry. First exam was a little hard, Second exam was killer, and Third exam seemed like she eased up a little.

WARNING: Do not take this professor. I took Chemistry before, got an A, and still struggled in her class. She treats her Chem 112 like it's 114. She knows her stuff but she is a horrible horrible teacher. Even if you all your homework and do well on labs, if you can't do well on her exams then you won't even make a B in the class. TAKE SOMEONE ELSE

Hammerich is hands down the worst professor that I have ever had. She is scatter brained and not very helpful to her students. She is very condescending to her students and her TA's aren't any better. Made me think that I was dumb at chemistry even though its my major. Must work ten times harder to get even a B.

This class is hard, especially for an introductory chemistry course. Dr. Hammerich is amazizing at chemistry but makes this class like a 300 or 400- level class. Reading the book is MANDATORY! If you read the sections in the book before lecture, you would be as confused because it's hard to keep up with her during lectures.

Absolutely horrible teacher.  She knows her chemistry but can't teach it. Her lectures lack conceptual info that is relevant to understand material and she adds things on the exams never mentioned in class or in the book. I highly suggest taking any other teacher.

Dr. Hammerich is very smart woman and obviously knows her stuff. But, for 112, she has designed a class that much harder than it needs to be. You need to put in a LOT of work on your own just to get a B, maybe an A. Her lectures make sense but when you apply them to the tests, it's nearly impossible. Take 112 w someone else.

Dr. Hammerich I am sure is a great person and you can see her passion for chemistry, she just isn't the best at communicating things in lectures. She makes many mistakes, and goes over topics way to fast in her lectures. Often I leave class feeling worse then when I went in. She curves tests greatly due to extremely low averages.

She is seemingly incredibly passionate about chemistry.  I had her for an honors general chemistry course and I learned and retained a lot from the class.  I really don't see how one can dislike her but I guess that is just me.  She is real with you.

Amazing teacher! If you have the opportunity to take chemistry with her, please do! I don't think I'd be as successful as I am today without her help and ability to teach such a difficult, complex subject. Seriously though, take this class!

AVOID TAKING THIS COURSE WITH HAMMERICH AT ALL COSTS!  She's hard to understand, and isn't good at explaining things.  Her notes are hard to understand and you basically have to learn everything from the book.  If I hadn't taken Chem before I would be completely lost.

Dr. Hammerich is a fantastic teacher. Yes, the subject material is very difficult and you must put a lot of work into this class if you want to do well. However, she is very open to helping you if you ask for it. Go to her office hours and get help right away if you need it. Learn how to take partial derivatives and do error calculations!!

I loved Professor Hammerich. I was terrified of her at first but if you actually take the time to go to her office hours she will go to the moon and back to help you out. She assigns way too much work, but she knows her stuff--in fact she seems really overqualified to be teaching undergrad. Developing a rapport with her will go a long way.

She is very good at explaining chemical reactions. although lectures can be boring, it does help to sit there and listen to her. She is strict, but she is wiling to help. The first 5 weeks can be difficult, but it should get better. Just do well in labs, and... her exams does require good understanding of chemistry, not just problem solving skill.

OMG! DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE WITH HAMMERICH!!!! This course itself is very hard and lots of labs. Hammerich gave us assignments every week, 2 sapling hw and quiz in every two weeks. there are two labs in one week. very hard to keep up with all the works. do not take this course with her.

I cannot recommend this course and instructor highly enough. Hammerich gives difficult exams, tough lectures, and a lot of homework, however, she is EXTREMELY helpful in office hours, and the class is set up such that if you show up to lectures/ discussions, and do the suggested work, an A is very doable. Definitely go to office hours!

Her lectures are at times difficult to follow.  She expects her students to prepare for class and gives a clear outline of what needs to be done prior to showing up.  If you are lost or confused she will gladly help you to understand it.  She loves chemistry and knows her stuff.  OWL homework online was a pain and worthless.

Hardest class i've taken so far. 2 labs every week that take all your time up plus the online hw and turn in hw. its been 3 weeks since the beginning of class and i feel like hell. Doesn't know how to explain. still going for the A though.

ALOT of work for a 200 level class. 2 3 hour labs a week, online homework plus written assignments weekly, and quizzes in class every 3 weeks. As a professor, she gives you notes online, but she expects alot. Approachable, with office hours and kind women. Not a chemist however, and tends to make math mistakes when explaining. Challenging course.

It's obvious that chemistry is a subject that requires a lot of practice (lab + homework).She's an okay prof. if you didnt understand chem before this, you still wont by taking this course. if you can, get harwood. yes, or fetzer. stay away from hammerich. you know the devil baby in the hull house? it grew up to be hammerich.

This teacher is horrible. Her main goal is to fail as many students as possible.  She was on probation for failing %60 of her 500+ student class. Her tests cover two to three times the material that the other chem112 teacher covers. Overall, I must say that this is the worst professor I've ever had.
Cannot understand anything that is going on it that class

this is a 300 level professor, your not going to understand her. You gotta teach yourself, which is possible. Make sure you do good on your labs that helps and get exams from previous years, THATS KEY!
She seems like a monster at first but the farther into the semester it gets the more she tries to help you out.  Her tests are tricky but if you read the book you should do okay.

Her tests were hard. But it was obvious that she loved what she was teaching. Always willing to stay after class to answer questions. Had study sessions for the exam. Good preparation for Organic Chem.
WARNING: DO NOT TAKE HER!!!!!
confusing at best

Class is super hard! Try and keep up w/ readings before class...MAKE SURE YOU READ!!! and her test are impossible !!! But luckily curves are high..TRY and get Brian as a TA he made class fun worth goin to...good TA

She never knows what she's talking about. If you are having a hard time getting sleep at night, just start going to here class. PS, most of the material on her tests is out of the book and she doesn't even go over it after the test.

Do all the homework, don't study the day before the exam.  This class is OKAY..could get an A...if you work your butt off! But an A is possible...but at the end...it all depends on your points, there is no rounding up!

she is super stupid! well actually she is really smart but she cant teach for crap. wtf is this?! i go to class...study more than what i did for 112 w fetzer, and I STILL GET BAD GRADES! her TAs even hate her. haha she looks like the thing from lotr
i hate her. i dont know how i pulled off a C last semester. but this semester is even worse. dont take her, and if u did, DROP her. fast.
Worst prof I have ever had.  She doesn't teach and rambles for 50 minutes.  I would never recommend anyone taking an chem classes at this university
final is this week.  i'd be happy with a C
She doesn't teach, she talks for 50 min. Her test are impossible and writes them so the ave is 50%.

I've never worked so hard and still get bad grades. Her way of grading homework is unfair and her tests are impossible. She has to make such a huge curve on them and still we do terrible. Her notes are hard to follow and not helpful. DONT TAKE HER!!!
Ridiculously difficult. Horrible at teaching and explaining. Impossible tests - made for maximum failures.

Hammerich is a beast and her TS's suck. Don't take 114 or 112 with her... you will work your ass off and won't get a good grade.  The tests are designed for an average of 50, but everyone fails pretty much.

Awful teacher.  I have never seen a worse teacher.
tests are impossible.she doesnt care if everyone fails. shes just mean

He's nice and a light grader. His lectures are hard to follow since he moves fast. If you miss something there's no way to find that info again since he doesn't post his completed lecture notes anywhere. Attendance isn't required but he has pop quizzes. I ended up teaching myself the content from the textbook and barely got a B after the curve.
His class is sort of slow; however, he explains the lecture problems really well and takes his time. There is pop-up quizzes but there are worth like 8% so dont worry. He also curves

He is a great guy and is really good at conveying his knowledge; however, he does not upload his annotated lecture notes. When studying for exams or referencing for help on homework, this can be quite frustrating.

He is pretty chill. Pop quizzes are open-book, and you can bring a cheat sheet to all 3 exams. He doesn't upload his annotated notes to BB so make sure to go to class. But in general, he's a really good professor; he knows a lot, and as long as you study, you can get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Respected

reviews.comment: Best professor. He really knows his stuff.
This guy is the best professor. He is a subject matter expert in his field and he teaches the concepts very well. Well respected.

Arbel herself is a really nice, caring professor. She tries her hardest to make sure her students are taken care of. With that being said, her class and lab tend to be unclear. While she uses the Ace manual, it never matches up with her teachings. Her TA likes to harp on students for small mistakes. She also rarely teaches, flipped-ish class style.
Just show up and do the work and you'll be a-ok. She has lots of connections and is very sweet so I would suggest creating a meaningful connection with her.

class is just discussing wishing groups. you don't need the textbook. For lab exams the rubric leaves a lot of blank areas where you can lose points. Grading is inconsistent, you much reach out immediately or you will be shrugged off.
If you have the oppertunity to take one of her classes, do it!

Amazing professor!  She really cares about her students and is very understanding if anything comes up. The tests are based off the powerpoints from class. So, as long as you review those you are pretty much set.
Honestly one of my favorite professors so far. She clearly cares for all of her students and constantly inspires us to succeed in our career. I would definitely recommend taking her class.
easy class. i would be surprised if you got anything other than an A. the professor is also really nice and wants to see her students succeed.

Professor Arbel is an absolute GEM! Very accessible outside of classroom. Always ready to help you whether about material related to class or if you need advice on anything else. Very inspirational and easy going. KN100 has a lot of papers but super easy. as long as you submit on time, youll get full grade.

Arbels class was just a low run down of other classes Ive taken. This class wasnt really necessary in my opinion yet it was mandatory. I dont feel I learned anything knew. She was biased when grading group projects. Never responded to emails and her exams were extremely hard when the material was not even covered on it. Overall I dont like her

She cares soooo much about her students. Very passionate about Kinesiology and wants the best for all. Do all assignments and you will pass. Reading is required if you don't get help from quizzlet on weekly quizzes ;) But, its pass or fail class so.... Great professor shows love to everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Super passionate professor, knows what she is talking about. Class itself can be boring but once a week there is a guest speaker which is super helpful on career choice options. Nice and friendly and very approachable professor. Highly recommend and easy A as long as you show up and do the 20 minute assignments given.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He talks very monotone and slow. Doesn't really cover a lot of things, and attendance isn't mandatory. It is EXCEL heavy so if you don't know how to use it, it'll be very confusing in the beginning. So please go to lecture on those days. Tests are open book open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice prof and I learned a lot. Sometimes disorganized but is good at following up about stuff, just have to check the blackboard announcements. He's pretty hard to catch by email, the best way to reach him is to talk to him after class or at office hours. Also genuinely cares about students and incorporates feedback which is cool

He is quite literally exactly how all of the bad reviews describe him. The class is very excel heavy and he refuses to explain how to use the program works but uses the shortcuts constantly, he doesn't respond to emails, his blackboard is disorganized and his deadlines always contradict each other, and when you ask questions he's condescending.

Do NOT take this class for a gen ed. The material is hard especially for a level 100 course. The professor is unorganized and never interacts with students. You have to REQUEST to access the lectures, which can sometimes take days to gain access. The TAs do everything, and even then, there's little communication. DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!

The TAs do everything, other people have already left comments on how his lectures go so I won't get into it. I just wanted to say how abysmal his communication through email is as a professor. Nothing gets through to him and it infuriates me because he's the PROFESSOR.

pretty disorganized but i learned a lot in his class and the excel instruction was very helpful if youre not familiar with it coming in. quizzes and assignments are online and he does not give reminders. lots of statistics but its very easy.

The coursework is light but confusing and almost completely unrelated to the lectures and tests sometimes. The professor is very disorganized and there is almost no communication with him or the TAs. Even then, the TAs do basically everything. Lectures are long and you have to request access (which can sometimes take days). Do NOT take this class.

Takes slides from other professors (not a huge deal, we all busy) but he literally never reads them before he's actively teaching it. He constantly has to quietly talk himself through it, backtrack and redo/reteach, or realize that the numbers/math are wrong. Absolutely infuriating. I've had 2 classes with him against my will.

He is not very organized and does not really respond to his emails. However, the class and assignments are overall very easy and he offers a lot of extra credit. Just email the TAs if you need anything.
Very messy and never posts clear instructions, it was the worst class i've ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: the worst class i've ever taken. Has no sense of organization and this class is way too try hard to be an elective, it's embarrassing.
DO NOT TAKE CLASS. LITERALLY DONT DO IT.

Arguelles is a very kind man. Yet, his class felt impossible. We were always a week behind on the syllabus, there were constant tech issues, grading errors were to be expected, the TAs were never around, and the homework did not always match the lectures. He is a caring person though and will try to work through these issues and personal problems.

He wasn't a terrible professor but neither a good one. Lectures are VERY BORING and are pretty much the same up until the last 4 weeks of class. He does online exams, including the final. The class itself wasn't hard just very repetitive.

Really nice guy with lots of opportunities for extra credit. While he isn't super accessible outside of class and his instructions for homework are unclear sometimes, as long as you come to the lectures and pay some attention, you will be okay. Tests are all online, open note, and not super difficult. The class is pretty statistics-heavy.

Worst teacher ever, he doesnt respond to emails, doesnt teach well, cracks jokes that arent funny, and he uses slides that are almost identical for the first 2 months of class with little differentiations. Please dont take this teacher and get a different professor if you can, or just report him to the school. He doesn't deserve to teach.

A kind human that cracks silly dad jokes, but so, so boring. I managed to keep my focus for the first 4 weeks and already noticed half the class no longer attending lecture at that point -- the information just drags and seems so elementary, but catches up to you quickly. Week 13 & no one knows what's going on; we can't even help each other.
Homework given does not have clear instructions and he's a tough grader. I wouldn't recommend anyone to take this professor.

Professor Arguelles was by far the worst teacher I have ever had. Please run. His lectures do not correspond to testing materials and he never responds to emails. As others have said the syllabus/schedule changes weekly/whenever he feels like it. He also calls off class right before its supposed to start.

Don't take this class if you need easy gen ed. You will need to put in work to get an A. The course workload isn't too difficult for the first half just tedious. The exams near the end of the semester had a good amount of statistics and were more difficult.

He is a decent lecturer and is passionate about what he teaches. There's a lot you can learn from him if you want to get into public health. There is a lot to learn but he makes sure there are enough resources to help you.

Somehow makes the incredibly interesting topic of epidemiology more boring than watching paint dry. Slow and overly complicated lectures. Content isn't too difficult if you can manage to pay attention - but you'll definitely benefit from having taken an introductory statistics course prior to this class. Very disorganized; due dates change often.

Syllabus and coursework changed weekly. Be mindful of deadlines as they may randomly change throughout the semester. A lot of work is assigned, including discussion questions after each lecture. Online exams are very long and detailed. This course (PUBH 120) was more about statistics, so make sure you know different formulas and how to apply them!

WORST  professor in my college career. Horrendous at communication, changes/ puts incorrect due dates,  inconsiderate of students' time. Exams/quiz reviews or study prep is nonexistent even for final exams. Gives no opportunities to improve grades, despite the difficulty level of the class. HIGHLY  NEEDS  to revaluate ineffective teaching style.

he had us take our first quiz after our midterm. none of this class makes any sense. so unorganized, this professor has no idea how to run a class at all. i didn't attend lectures for the last 6-7 weeks and it did nothing to change my grade. directions are never clear, assignments graded differently for students. PLEASE DONT TAKE THIS CLASS EVER!!!

He was honestly one of the worst profs I've ever had. He was not prepared at all for this semester- he changed due dates on quizzes 3 times, and due dates on homework 4 times. One quiz had absolutely no explanation to what he was asking and was impossible to complete because the questions weren't asked properly. I HIGHLY DO NOT RECOMMEND
Hes not the most organized but he will show you exactly how to do the problems he asks you to do on major projects, assignments, and homework. Give him your attention in class and youll do fine.
i wouldnt know what grade i recieved bc the TAs take forever to grade one assignment. THIS TEACHER IS SO DISORGANIZED

please dont take this class if you are a student that needs structure. he always changed the due date on assignments, tests, and projects. his instructions for assignments were NONEXISTENT! he has switched the date for the final twice now and instead of it being taken in one day, its now been split into a two day final... im so exhausted bc of him

HE IS THE WORST TEACHER IN THE WORLD HE CHANGES INSTRUCTIONS EVERY DAY AND I HAVE TO EMAIL HIM AND HIS ASSISTANTS EVERYDAY BECAUSE HE CHANGES DUE DATES AND WILL NOT NOTIFY THE CLASS I STOPPED JOINING HIS CLASS AFTER THE FIRST DAY BECAUSE I COULD SEE IT WAS GOING TO BE USELESS DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS HE HSI VERY DISORGANIZED RUN AWAY PLEASE AVOID HIM!
WOST PROFESSOR EVER. RUN THE OTHER WAY.

Spends an hour to explain the most basic concepts in the most complicated manner. He never give clear instructions on anything. He talks in the most monotonous voice and his lectures are very disorganized. Assumes that students know a lot of the information he's supposed to be teaching. Overall awful teacher. Please spare yourself.

Hes an excellent professor. Students must pay attention to pick up concepts and material. Hes friendly, so asking him a question isnt a hassle. He responded to every last one of my emails in a timely fashion, and gave me clarification when needed. Majoring in PUBH, so I look forward to utilizing the info that I learned in his class in the future
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hes a nice man but a horrible professor. His voice is low and monotonous. We had to constantly remind him to turn his mic on. He assumes we know what hes talking about without explaining well. Hes a very slow grader. There arent much assignment to boost your grade. This is by far the worst class Ive taken at UIC.

Very nice guy but the worst professor. Just reads off PowerPoint in a very low, monotonous voice. Extremely unorganized and does not explain concepts well. Doesn't seem to prepare for lecture beforehand and constantly sending emails to correct mistakes in lectures or assignments. Just read the book if you can't avoid him. Cool guy, bad teacher.

Prof. Arguelles does not reply to emails, is extremely unorganized and very unprofessional. He's barely prepared for class, does not offer help outside of class, course info. is very complex and he doesn't think students need help. Quizzes usually do not reflect what we review for the quiz. I would not recommend this course at all.

This course was the worst course I have taken at UIC. I was confused 90% of the time and Prof. Arguelles was no help at all. He does not take the time to explain info that students don't understand, he doesn't reply to emails, and he's overall a bad prof. Would not recommend this course or prof. at all. The TAs were just as confused as I was.

I had Professor Rao for three consecutive semesters
while finishing my undergrad in the College of Ed. Many of my classmates agree that Rao's classes were some of the most useful and engaging in the program. She challenged us, pushed us to engage in meaningful discourse, provided amazing feedback, and still managed to keep class fun and relevant

Dr Rao is so sweet! I will miss her so much. You can tell she cares for her students. She always listened to us if we had problems in the field. She is very interactive in class so class flew by, especially for 3 hours. She is very productive and doesnt give busy work. The work that was given helps for teaching. Im so grateful I spent my senior yea
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is caring and accommodating to her students. As long as you go to class you should get an A! Her lectures are interesting and interactive, making the 3 hour class fly by.

Dr. Rao is amazing. It is hard to find professors who actually care about their students, and it is obvious that Dr. Rao is really invested in her students. Great feedback, interesting classes, and a lot of support in the field. She worked in CPS before UIC, so she knows what its like to be a teacher, so you can learn so much from her. she's great!
Disrespectful and rude. Loves stirring up drama in the classroom. Has made college of education a joke.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: As a graduating senior, looking back this was the best course I took at UIC. All classes and learning materials were very well organized. The material is rigorous but the professor wants you to succeed.

This is a must-take business elective! This course content and schedule are down to a science. No busy work, just quizzes, exams, a presentation, and a final project. There is an extra credit opportunity on every quiz and exam! There is required attendance, but the lectures are well done and engaging, so you want to be there!

I agree with all the reviews - she has teaching awards for a reason!. She is very nice, caring and smart. All exams were off the lectures and the recordings she provided. Lectures were very engaging and teaches you useful stuff. TAKE HER!!!

Great teacher! I'm not one to write reviews, but I liked her so much I decided to write one. She explains concepts very clearly and even her posted lectures are great! Not only is she a great educator, she's super nice and approachable. Have a question? she'll be happy to answer!

She got her teaching award for a reason! Very caring and knows very well what she's doing. Attendance is not required (summer class), but showing up and listening helps you learn a lot. Extra credits are extra questions in every single quiz/exam. 1 paper, 1 presentation (both group project). I would take this class again if I could!

She is great! The course is very group project-heavy, but as long as you understand the material and study, you will be fine with the multiple-choice exams. No PowerPoints, instead the notes are written out in class and you are expected to follow along (better imo). I learned a lot, and the class was very practical. I would recommend!
This was the most useful course I took at my major. The material is tough with math equations and graphs but the professor teaches it in a very clear way.
This course is more like a 400 level but you learn a lot. Professor is a fountain of knowledge and very classy. Exams are hard but extra credit helps.

Very tough class, little assignments only the 2 tests and 2 quizzes and 2 presentations. which are quite difficult. Lots of equations and note taking. Theres no study guide, only 28 lecture videos which are 40 minutes long  (7 per exam/quiz). Exams and quizzes are the same, 25 multiple choice and 2-3 bonus questions. But overall super hard class :(

Professor Ayaydin is the best. I saw her freshman year in my BA 101 class and from that moment I knew that she is an amazing professor. Her lectures are easy to understand, quizzes/ exams are reasonable, presentation is manageable and the final assignment is challenging however she is always more than happy to help. Truly elegant and knowledgeable
One of the best professors in UIC! She is very smart and interesting. She made the content easy to be understood. I enjoyed attending all the lectures.
She's an amazing professor; it was very easy to follow along with her lectures and everything she would tell us would be seen on tests and quizzes.

The professor is an amazing teacher, interesting, and super nice. However, her teaching material is outdated, her teaching method is copying her 12 year old notes onto another piece of paper. 2 quizzes, 2 exams and her reviews are not helpful at all. She rudely interrupts during presentations and her final assignment is confusing. Her TA useless.
A very classy, smart and elegant professor! Also her lectures were very clear. Actually if this course was thought by another teacher it would ve been really tough. TAKE HER!!!

She is a great professor, and very knowledgeable in her field. The class is straightforward, 2 quizzes, and 2 exams which are all multiple-choice. There is also a presentation analysis and a final assignment that requires you to use the Bloomberg terminal which are both worth 40% of your grade. Don't wait until the last minute to do your Bloomberg.

The prof is cool and smart. You could learn a lot about financial markets from her. Attendence is counted as extra credit. Tests are only multiple choice. 1 group project.  1 class presentation. She has a policy of no late submissions for the project.

One of the best finance professors at UIC. She has a structure to her course and sticks to it and makes it so easy for the students to understand the subject. Please do not miss out on the opportunity to take this class.
Attendance is extra credit (5% of the grade), 2 group assignments (40%) , 2 quizzes (20%), 2 exams (40%). Lot of extra credit.
The creme de la creme!

Very descriptive lectures. All tests and quizzes are multiple choice. If you pay attention in class, they should be easy. There are 2 group assignments, which are not too hard. And if you fully complete those, you should have a great shot an A, if not a B. Great professor, and I have continued to take her for multiple courses.
The best professor in UIC and I will take her class again.

Absolutely amazing professor. She gives multiple examples for questions that you'll need to know for the course. She covers everything that will be on the tests, and she makes sure that you will be well prepared. One of the best professor's out there, and I'd advise everyone that has her as a potential option to take her.

The class is interesting and applicable, but Professor Arslan-Ayaydin's teaching style is what takes the cake. Very engaging and encourages class participation. I have nothing but positive things to speak of!
She is very passionate for teaching. Write down the notes that she gives in class and take advange of extra credit if you want a good grade in class.

Very kind and great at teaching. The material in class can be tough to understand, however, she makes it easily understandable if you attend her lectures, pay close attention, and definitely take notes. If you need FIN340 credit definitely try your best to have her as your professor!

Her asynchronous work contradicts her teaching values. Shes very keen on having in-person classes because she feels as if we learn better, but if that were the case she would make things synchronous when we have snow days. She does not upload any content to blackboard, so you better hope you don't get sick and miss a class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's very enthusiastic so class is always enjoyable. Attendance is not mandatory but 5% extra credit. However, lectures are not posted online so you have to attend class to get the notes. Her quizzes and tests are exactly like her lectures, so if you understand the material, you'll get an A. Final exam is not cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love this class!

Amazing professor! She is really passionate about what she is teaching and does a phenomenal job of explaining all of the material. The content on her quizzes/tests reflected exactly what she taught in class. The professor was easy to access out of class and even offered to do individual skype calls in case you needed help with the material.
She's an amazing lecturer and makes clear lecture videos to watch. She really cares about her students and I finally understood a lot of concepts I did not understand before.
Her online asynchronous are EXTREMELY slow and will put you to sleep. Otherwise she's a good professor but needs to make her videos engaging.
Best professor in the UIC!!! She is so charismatic and her accent is amazing! Her teaching style is the best. And every finance major should take this class. The recorded classes were very engaging.
Ozgur mastered the craft of teaching. Took her during the four week summer session and she made me love finance although I thought hated numbers.
This class couldnt be taught better. Prof Ozgur is amazing! She makes the hard stuff to be understood so easily.
Just study the notes and you will be fine. The professor is very enthusiastic to teach this class.
Does not help prepare for exams. She just keeps saying "study the notes". Not the same style as FIN 301
Professor Ozgur is one of the best professors in UIC. She is very professional and is knowledgeable. She is the reason i am now minoring in finance!
Professor Ozgur is the best professor I've ever had the pleasure of taking at uic. You're dumb if you don't take her. She made Finance a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The best Professor I had in UIC so far. Take her for finance 301!

I learned the most from this class thorought my time in UIC. The professor is an economist so that she makes a good connection between current economic events and the financial markets. Come to each class and take notes. You will end up with an A.

This course is composed of two quizzes, two exams, one news paper group presentation, and one big final assignment. The quizzes and exams will not be difficult as long as you pay attention in class and youll be fine studying the night or two nights before. Dont be scared of the group presentation, like I was, itll help your confidence!
Amazing class and a stellar teacher. Go run for this class because it fills up quick.

There are one group project and one presentation. There are 3 tests (MC plus problems). Quite easy stuff. You can get an old edition of the book but it's not required. No homework. Come to class, take all the notes that she writes and class will be an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Ayadin has been my favorite professor at UIC. She manages to teach a hard subject in a very interesting way and communicates the material extremely effectively.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great lectures and she teaches a hard subject in a way that makes it easy for you to understand. Only 6 grades total; 2 exams, 2 quizzes, and 2 group projects. Projects are easy but take a while to complete don't save it for the last minute. Exams only have a few problems but are graded nicely.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Arguably the easiest class I've taken so far. She give 2 tests and 2 quizzes, which are easy enough if you take notes and go over the textbook (optional). There's 2 group projects, one of which is the final. They're simple enough but tedious so don't wait until the last minute to start. She writes a lot of notes but they're detailed and clear.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Ayaydin was the best professor I've had in the four years I've been at UIC; she is really nice and extremely helpful. Her class is so EASY! The problems that she goes over in lecture are sometimes the same exact problems on the exams. There are 2 easy team projects; If you show up to class and take notes, you should get an A!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Ayaydin's lectures are clear and comprehensible. You do NOT need the book. If you listen attentively to all of her lectures and take good notes, there is absolutely no reason you won't get an A. Her tests are 100% based on lectures, so taking extensive notes is a must. Still, she makes the class interesting.

Prof Ozgur was a great professor! She answered any questions that we had, graded very leniently, and super approachable! I would definitely take her class again. She is very knowledgeable about finance and provided real life examples.
She is the best professor in UIC. Exams are slightly tough but she is overly generous while grading the assignments. She teaches with passion and professionalism. She will make you love finance.

Great professor and class, made finance very interesting and gave good lectures.  Grading was very fair, and those who studied and attended class did well.  Group projects helped grades a lot.  Let class out early often, but wasn't able to get through the last two chapters.

She is a great professor. Pretty easy course load. Two exams, two quizzes, and two projects. Even though the class was pretty easy, I was sometimes confused during lectures because there are no power point notes, and she just talks about the material (instead of writing it). Overall, she is a nice and pretty easy going professor.
I got something interesting out of every class. She is really smart but she dumbs down the material really well.

She knows her stuff well. There were only 2 exams, 2 quizzes, and 2 group projects. No final! The quizzes were somewhat difficult but the exams were easy seeing that the questions came directly from the textbook. If you go to class, pay attention, and take notes, you'll do fine. Easy A!!
This was my fave course at CBA. She communicates the material very effectively. She is very knowledgeable in the field. Stick to her notes and you will do very well. Bloomberg assignment was great!

Best professor at UIC. I took her during the summer session and really had the chance to learn from her. She is to the point and facilities note taking. As long as you pay attention, take notes, and redo problems, then you should be fine. Take her if you can! For such a hard class she makes it fun and enjoyable.

Took her summer course. As long as you show up to class, pay attention, and take notes you'll pass. She's not out to fail anyone, but don't take thing's for granted. Because it was only a 4 week course, we flew through the material which wasn't all that hard. Not everything will be on tests/quizzes.

She's nice... but not helpful. She will give you vague answers and not go over real life examples for class projects. Disorganized notes and lots of extra information that won't be tested for. Easy grader. Blazes through material and gives no homework so be prepared to make your own practice exercises to learn materials. I took Summer Term though.

She's an amazing professor and one of my best so far. Her class is interesting but if you skip class, it would be kind of hard to pass so make sure to get notes from friends. Just study notes and the problems you do in class and you will be good.
Clear grading criteria. 2 quizzes, 2 exams, 2 group projects. Her lectures are long and sometimes boring. As long as you put in effort, you will get a good grade.

The best teacher at UIC!! I took her for FIN 301,302,340 and 494. Her syllabus is the same 2 quizes 2 tests and 2 projects with groups. She is very smart and you just want to attend her class! Please do take her and you will learn!
She's a great teacher- very clear and to the point when explaining new concepts. Take notes during class and you will ace the quizzes and exams.

solid choice!

Amazing teacher. Please take him if you get a chance. I have learned a lot from this class.

Mitra is the man. Would take any class he is teaching. Go to class, participate and listen to what he's teaching. Easily the most helpful and beneficial business course I've taken in my three years at UIC.

My favorite class of the semester. His lectures are great and very interesting. He is very passionate about teaching this material. Exams are straight forwards if you study the study guide.

genuinely cares about his students. provides a lot of real world examples and you can tell he has a lot of experience and is extremely knowledgable. amazing professor

One of the best professor ever. Explain things so well. Extremely organized, fun.she really makes math fun and easy.

Professor Azad is always willing to help. But she makes lectures very tough with unnecessary materials that make you very confused. Take an R class on LinkedIn you will learn everything easily. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. Please save yourself the headache and the mental breakdowns. Worst teacher ever. Otherwise, you didnt receive any credit for it.
worst professor ever , please change

It's an all or nothing class with no curve meaning you have to get each topic 100% right or you don't get credit for that topic going towards your grade. Partial credit is only awarded near the end of the semester but still in an all or nothing format. The amount of homework assigned each topic is shown as 5+ hrs per chapter in the system.

Proffesor is ok. But TAs refuse to let you go to the bathroom during 3-hour exam even tho you give them your phone and everything is crazy. I hope the professor will spend more time instructing them. Also if you lost on the course go to Jeff Hanson statics playlist.

Best professor I've had by far; he made the material so simple that even a nonstem student could understand it. The exams are not challenging if you study straight from the book, unlike other professors who make up their problems. If you are not going to class, study the lecture slides. Amazing professor!!!

The class was straightforward and to the point. As long as you understand the topics, which are pretty simple, and you study reasonably, you should get an A easily. The professor has very engaging lectures, as they are both funny and informative. If not enough, you will get an extra credit exam worth about 40 points. I would take him if I were you.

Amazing professor who is very accessible during office hours. He jokes occasionally and his lectures are pretty straight forward. His method of teaching ensures you learn the material very well and he spends lecture explaining a topic and then does practice problems. He will skip over some stuff so pay attention for the first few topics.
Super easy class, great professor. He will accommodate you and makes sure that you will get an A. He was nice too and had good lectures.
The exams are too tough and need deep knowledge to perfect the topics to pass.
Don't take her unless you have to, that's all I have to say.

I've only been in this class for 2 weeks and I already wanna kms. Pick another professor. So many insignificant assignments that make you question why you're paying so much to be there.

Has trouble controlling the class, lets students walk all over her. Inconsistent grader, if you lower the bar for yourself at the start and improve to your current skills you will get better grades. This class was a joke. We learned nothing within the lectures despite it being mandatory. We get graded on meaningless assignments while all the grading is very inconsistent. reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

Honestly the class is kind of useless and you can learn everything this class has to offer by just socializing with professionals. I didn't like her way of teaching and she put to much emphasis on unimportant things.

Not bad, not great. I thought she was mostly fair, except sometimes it was difficult to know why we had missed points. Professor Bailey was the middle of the pac type of teacher. Just your typical professor who goes by the book. 2 Tests(In Person), 4 Vocabulary Quizzes(Online), 3-4 group projects.

he is a great professor, def would recommend to someone else. he is so sweet and so helpful. he is the head of the English department and it honestly shocks me because he's not who you would expect to be a boss of everyone because he is so soft spoken and wouldn't hurt a fly

i loved this man. he is a superb professor and really cares about his students. easy A with work involved of course. but it's just writing papers. hes a great guy
Best English teacher at UIC? Extremely understanding and helpful. As long as you do the work/papers you should be fine. Highly recommended!

Good teacher. He actually reads your papers and writes comments/suggestions that will help give you a better grade after you revise a paper. He is a great professor! Although the reading load in this class was heavy, and we did need to write 4 short responses and 2 major essays. However, he made everybody's life a lot easier especially toward to the end of the semester. He is a very nice professor, take his class!

he is a very nice instructor and is very helpful toward individual student. not like other profs. students can expect valuable detailed feedback on each paper. most of time students get decent grades. two thumbs up.
very helpful. great teacher.
cutest and nicest teacher! wish he would teach more classes. he is what a professor should be!

Hes really a cool professor. very easy and open with all suggestions brought up in class. very clear. leinent compared to other english professors....overall "A" grade!

I highly recommend this professor for English 160 classes. He is amazing and ready to listen to you. Don't skip the classes without talking to him.
He's a chill teacher. As long as you communicate with him that you won't be attending class, he's very understanding and a nice grader.

Professor is really understanding and considerate about the work he assigns. This course was easy and I would recommend taking him. It is important that you show up to class, you get participation points this way.

reviews.comment: Erturk was a very nice professor who really cared about his students. Although his lectures and exams are very complex, the exams are curved very generously. Overall was a pretty good class and I would take him again in the future!

Tries to engage the best he can with asking questions to students, though not many people unfortunately answer. Worst part of the course really is Pearson, at no fault of the professor.

Overall, yes, this class and the tests are difficult. But the professor is kind and understanding to student's circumstance's. He is very generous with curving exams so if you do the homework and group projects the class is very passable.

I found Bilal's class to be pretty fun. As any other finance professors, the tests were brutal, but he curves them a whole bunch. He is a great person who genuinely tries to engage with the class and has clearly a lot of knowledge on the subject. You just have to go in depth on every lesson, and truly understand the correlations in the material.

Professor Bilal Erturk is a very nice, respected person. He seems to want to help and answers emails in a timely manner. The exams though, thats where I struggled. Tests are nearly impossible. No study guide, 50 mins on the midterm, closed note, with time consuming questions that take nearly the whole time to complete just one. He's knowledgeable, but he also goes way too quick in lectures and it can be hard to keep up with.
Just extremely boring lectures, makes you want to go to sleep. Not engaging in my opinion. Exams were the hardest I've ever taken in my LIFE. Study 2 weeks beforehand to do okay.
