reviews.comment: She is a great professor, very lenient and gives great feedback. If you follow her feedback, you are guaranteed an A paper. Majority of the classes only consist of turning in papers, so more than half the classes finish within the first 20 minutes. She is doesn't waste time, so once shes done with what she has to say, she lets you go.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Boulay is a pretty cool teacher. While there is a lot of writing projects throughout the semester to do (five in total), she makes us work at a decent pace.

She is the best English teacher I have ever had. She cares so much about her students and will help you improve your writing tremendously if you put in the effort. I'm saddened to not have her next semester for 161. Thank you Professor Boulay for helping me so much!
Great class taught by a great person. What more needs to be said?
Amazing teacher. She can help with anything you need very informative and can be very understanding. I would take her again.
She is an amazing teacher. Her personality is really cool. She is very nice with every student and helps every one.Great teacher..:) :) :)
Very cool professor. She's really understanding and flexible, not to mention she has a great sense of humor. Participate in class and ask questions.
WOW. What a superb teacher. Just very funny. She doesn't waste your time and puts your education to use. She is also very understandable and flexible. I wish she wasn't just a visiting teacher :(

Excellent Professor! She makes class very enjoyable and interesting. You can really learn a lot from her. Also if you have any questions about your writing, she will gladly help you during her office hours. If you work hard and value your classes, take her. You will not regret it.

She is a really good teacher. Even if you don't have an interest in politics and the media she is still fun. Also a really hard grader. She will teach you a lot and she is always really helpful and very willing to help, all you have to do is ask. You better be pretty good with your gramar or be willing to work hard to proof read a lot.

She's a very good teacher. Really helpful and understanding. She will explain to you what's wrong with the paper and what exact things you have to fix. She's a little hard on grading but that is because she helps you a lot and expects you to know what to do.

She looks at all the details in your paper. Her readings are sometimes hard but she goes over them in detail .She is really good at going through your paper with you and helping you get the best grade you can.
IF THERE IS A CLASS HE TEACHES, DO NOT HESITATE TO TAKE HIM! HE IS SO CHILL. THE CHILLEST PROFESSOR @ UIC.
TAKE HIMMM!! IF HE IS AVAILABLE THEN DONT THINK TWICE AND TAKE HIM. Super easy class if you just do what you're assigned. He is caring and understands if you communicate.
Really chill and nice professor. Class was really simple and easy. One big group project, a few smaller assignments that's would be done in class with groups and then quizzes and homework was online.
Great teacher, made his class very interesting. Assignments were fairly easy, it was a lecture heavy class and some group assignments and group projects at the end, but nothing was ever tedious.

super chill and understanding, just show up to class and turn in your assignments on time and you'll get an A or B, communication is key but i've taken 2 of his courses and he's the same way for all levels.

An amazing professor who is so chill. He has interesting lectures and is always cracking jokes. There is a group presentation, but it is fairly simple. The term paper is also completed with your group. Make sure you choose a good group of people!

LOVE PROF ANTWILER. He cares about his students, teaches on relevant material, and wants us to succeed. Lots of groupwork in class, a group presentation/paper, but it is very fun! Exams are online and not difficult. Take his class for MGMT350!
EASY Class. I mean it is a management class so its bond to be easy. This class is just busy work and just a way for the university to charge us money.

Very chill guy, his lectures could be a bit boring but he usually lets students out really early. There are small group assignments (mostly just talking to a partner about a question) and one group presentation and paper. He takes attendance through iclicker so you don't really need to be in class.

Nice professor, very chill and relaxed. Everything is in textbook and if you find it elsewhere, great, no need to spend $. Clear syllabus with 1-2 easy assignments after. Easy to pass, chill class in a big spacious lecture hall.
Amazing professor, very understanding, easy assignments, not many assignments, a group project slides and paper, fun and easy lectures, explains the concepts very well, 100% recommend
Super easy professor, you would have to try to get anything but an A in his class. Overall would take again.
Professor Antwiler is great. Lectures are easy to understand, case studies are very useful, group projects are fun, and the course in general was not difficult to understand.

Super nice teacher, there is a lot of group work every week but is doable if you split it. There is also a group presentation, and group paper, and final paper. 1 midterm not proctored and 1 final not proctored. Easy class easy A.

Great professor. The exams are online and the class is pretty easy. He takes attendance through iclicker so students would check in even though they weren't in class and it made me feel bad for the professor because you can see he enjoys teaching.
Very nice guy. Lots of group work but I think its manageable if you split up the work efficiently.

Awesome Professor at UIC! I received my undergrad degree from here at UIC 10 years ago and came back to pursue an MBA. Professor Antwiler honestly one of the better professor here at UIC. A lot of participation and discussion for this class, so attend class. Work load not overwhelming at all. Lectures are interesting.

He is one of the best (if not the best) professor in the IDS department. His lectures is amazing with a lot of example. He knows that the material can be tough so he always double check if students are all on the same page. Just a side note, exams are weighted 80% of your overall grade but he does allow cheat sheets on the exams. Great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took IDS435 with Professor Sturt during the Spring 2025 semester. He's very knowledgeable, caring, and enthusiastic which makes his lectures always great to attend. If you're someone that likes problem-solving and logic, this is a great course. A lot of what is discussed is also extremely practical in the real world.
This class was the highlight of my semester! The lectures were so fun and the material was well-paced and delivered.

Professor Sturt really cares about his students and actually takes their recommendations into consideration. This class is difficult but he really makes an effort to make sure you know the material and understand it. Definitely take his class if you can!

He's nice, but the lectures were long and I found them hard to engage with. Discussion is optional, but you should attend when the TA discusses something you need to know for the homework. Make sure to start homework ahead of time as the assignments are very time-consuming.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Sturt is the best IDS professor at UIC. He genuinely cares for his students and is an excellent lecturer. Encourages questions. Data mining is not easy but prof knows this, so he makes sure to repeat concepts that he knows students will struggle with. I am very new to IDS so I was worried about keeping up but he made it easy. Learned a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Sturt is definitely the best business stats professor. HWs are given plenty of time in advance, lectures are not at all boring, and he truly cares about student success. We had a few case projects which were very interesting and heavily discussed in class. He is very active on email and even posted extra office hours during weeks of exams.

This data mining class dealt with complex topics and coding them but it was very interesting content. He expects you to struggle on HW to actually learn. If you ask him a specific question about HW he will never give you the answer directly but only guide you. Overall he is great to learn from because he is truly an expert in his field; Stats & ML

Prof Sturt was great! He was very caring and flexible with deadlines. Additionally, he was a great lecturer and always clarified any questions. In addition, the office hours he held were very useful and I would recommend them.

Professor Sturt is great at teaching and is a really kind and caring person. You learn a lot from him and the course work load is reasonable. With that being said, his class was extremely challenging. To understand the content I had to go through the lecture slides several times and the homework usually took a while to complete.

you get two weeks off no attendance, all you have to do is attend, and write the journal DONT FORGET TO UPLOAD IT FOR A GRADE although he might take it late at the end of the year. replies fast, nonchalant, says what's on his mind. DO THE ROUGH DRAFTS. he won't take those late, but he will take the final drafts late. take his class

Prof. Bryson is so chill, man. He nonchalant and calm, regardless of the day or time. He will respond to you as quickly if you have any questions. With that, the extra credit for his class is easy as you need to take a picture of a certain place he says you should visit. He also gets when you can make it to class, just let him know ahead.

Professor Bryson is my GOAT. He's so chill and nonchalant I def recommend this class! If you fall behind he's willing to work with you in order to bring your grade up. Writing topics in this class are very interesting, Overall a great teacher and would def take his class again!🔥
Chill professor and an easy grader.

Eng 161 with Prof Bryson is definitely not difficult; he is extremely lenient with deadlines and is also not a harsh grader when it comes to essays as long as there is effort put in. During lectures, he is hilarious and talks casually about his life, which makes the class fun; however, sometimes the lectures can get off topic and be quite long.

An amazing professor that teaches his class without actually teaching. He makes you feel comfortable and open about the topics discussed in class. My class felt more like a conversation than a lecture. Assignments and guidelines were simple and easily manageable. It allowed students to explore different areas of media and expression of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I'd be surprised if he wasn't the best the best English professor at UIC. This man found a way to make every lecture interesting and still find his way back to the main topic every time. He made sure to cover the topic at hand and keep us engaged while doing so. Textbooks were provided freely online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He was very easy to talk to, very understanding and considerate, and does not treat students as if they are inferior.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Bryson was a very fun teacher to have. He makes assignments well known and goes through them before diving in/ provides various resources if help is needed. Very comedic and makes his lectures enjoyable. Be prepared to read and write quite often.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Hands down the BEST professor at UIC. If you need to take English 160/161 take him! My class was online but his homework and papers are so easy. I didn't even turn 5 assignments in and he still gave me 100% in the homework category. There were a total of 4 papers and he doesn't even read the papers I got 100% on all my papers. I ended with an 100%.
He is one of the great professor ever met in UIC such a nice person would recommend his class again esay A

Professor Bryson is hands down the best professor you can take for English 160 at UIC. He is such an easy grader he is hilarious his lectures are fun to attend. He is very helpful and respectful. He is a good guy I highly suggest yall take him
Dudes honestly the best if I could have him for all 4 years of college I would, funniest teacher so far.
Probably one of the few professors at UIC who cares about his students and goes above and beyond to make sure you get the grade you want. Easy A if you do your work. His lectures are simply amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Awesome teacher, even possibly the funniest teacher I've ever had. Still wondering whether or not we'll have class the Monday before Thanksgiving though. Other than that do the work and get your easy A.

Really boring class. Had a very detailed, day to day curriculum but turned out to be a load of bs. Spent every class just talking about himself. Pretty funny but I'd rather take a nap that pay to sit through a lecture about his youth. Never checks hw or even reads the essays b/c everyone gets the same grade. Good guy just not a worth it teacher
The class is fairly easy as long as you show up and turn in all your work the class is an easy A.
Hes so funny and an easy grader. All he does is rant in class and the last five minutes talk about then actual material. Its surprising that you actually end the class with learning a lot.

Bryson is hands down the easiest professor at UIC, his "lectures" are just rants and have nothing to do with the actual class but super interesting to listen to. Only 4 essays and yes they're long but SUCH AN EASY GRADER, you will get an A for sure, he's even the lowest grade he's ever given someone was a C and he rounded it to a B too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The best teacher I've had.
He is so funny, but I wouldn't take him if you want to actually learn how to write well and enhance your writing skills. Otherwise, he is amazing. EASY A.

Amazing teacher, I wish I could take him again for ENGL 161. I would recommend being prepared for a lot of jokes. He tends to get off topic a lot and talk about politics, but he makes it very fun and interesting to listen. He does assign homework every class, but it's only like 250 words or less from an article you have to read.
Very funny professor! Definitely, my favorite at UIC, gives very good feedback on papers, follow it and you will do well. Also very laid back

super funny gets distracted easily, but relates his stories back to the point of the lecture. took him for 160 and 161. due dates not super clear but he doesnt mind if you turn it in late, can be confusing sometimes but 10/10 would take again for english.

He is literally the BEST English Professor hands down! He is very hilarious and his rants during class are the best. You will not want to miss class, that's how great they are! If you have the choice to take him, DO IT! You won't regret it!
Likes to rant in class, but its always enjoyable to listen to. Fantastic class with easy homework

Great professor, very funny and passionate about his subjects. Tends to talk though most of the class time, but his rants were quite entertaining if you paid attention. Very laid back and gives good feedback on rough drafts.
A cool guy and an interesting class. Take Bryson!!! Thank me later.

I learned a lot in this class not only inside the class, but outside of the class as well. He challenge us to think, which I respect. He's very reasonable if you can't make it in deadlines. This class is 10 out of 10.
A great professor, his class was super easy. He wasn't a tough grader and made the class enjoyable. He often goes off topic which is great because you can get bored of the class topic very easily

His class was fun even though not everyone participated (including myself), but it was an entertaining class nevertheless. This was the only class I had that was not part of my major courses, so showing up was a good break.  I knew the first day he walked into class wearing a QOTSA shirt I was gonna like this guy. Good guy Bryson.
Great teacher, extremely funny, turn things in on time and you should be set. Takes a while to grade sometimes but not a harsh grader. Loved the class even though English isn't my thing.

Bryson is great. He fosters a welcoming and creative environment for students, he's extremely knowledgeable about the subject matter, and he's willing  to provide solid feedback for anyone who is passionate about fiction writing. He's absolutely hysterical, but he handles class tension like a professional. By far one of my favorite teachers!
Best professor i had in the fall semester.I hope he was my ENGL 161 professor too. Looking for a good grade i suggest you to take him.

Awesome Professor! He loves to talk and does not take this class seriously at all. If you do the work you are guaranteed a good grade. I recommend to anyone who wants a good grade in English and does not care much about learning. He's a nice guy and very understanding overall.

Bryson is the best teacher I've had at UIC. He's funny and overall knows a lot about the subject he's teaching. The little course readings were really helpful, I really enjoyed them all. He is very helpful with writing too, he genuinely cares about his students and their grades. He has helpful comments on your short stories too!
SO EASY! He goes on rants during class and It's literally like watching a standup routine- super funny/jaded guy. He assigns two papers- thats it. Easiest class at UIC so far.
He was super easy and he always cancels class. He is nice, but he may make fun of you. If you dont understand something go to his office hours and he will help you a lot.

I loved my teacher. He was great and I wish that I could find another one like him : ) I wish that he would have gotten to know our names though. The homework load equals nothing. And he curses in class which is always fun. He also is willing to help with your papers if you ask! Would take him for the rest of my life if I had to!

ANYONE WHO WROTE ANYTHING BAD ABOUT HIM DON'T KNOW WHAT THEY'RE TALKING ABOUT! I had a MWF class and he canceled the WF part and we only had to come for mondays and he always let us out ten minutes into the class. He's funny, interesting, down to earth, and basically just requires you to write the 4 papers, which he always changes & interesting.
If you like a teacher that cancels class then this is for you. Just do the papers, and you will get an A in the class.
Did not learn a single thing in his class. Waste of my time. However, he is funny. Canceled many times for reasons not valid.

Very interesting guy, but seems pretty wrapped up in complaining about the world around him. He also swears tremendously and makes fun of just about everything under the sun. If your in his class, your bound to be offended/insulted. I learned more about what he likes and dislikes as opposed to the things we were supposed to learn in class.
JUST AWESOME! Had thee best time in this class.
He is overeall a good professor. His lectures are pretty easy to understand and he seems very passionate about the subject

Bauer is a good prof, not the best but you'll get a good grade if you put in some effort. He mostly reads off his slides but the ideas are easy to understand and remember. He does use some outdated terms but you'll prob learn and retain more info from your discussion. Attendance wasn't recorded. Keep up with class and you'll be fine!
genuinely the best prof, good lecturer, sweetest lil guy cutie patootie, retests, no textbook, light work

Amazing class and professor. Offers retests. Very helpful and will happily answer questions. I took this as a gen ed and it is completely worth it. He is also very funny and does his best to keep the students engaged.

Lectures are very useful but the recorded ones are just as good. Brauer is passionate and good at teaching, but course organization is sloppy and unorganized. Lectures contain test material and will help you pass. Most TAs are pretty good but some of them are overboard with attendance and participation, but are still helpful. Overall 4/5 prof.

Dr. Bauer is very nice and I would say hes pretty accommodating which is helpful. I just feel like sometimes the class was disorganized with some of the TAs' ex: never responding to emails, the discussions every week were also unnecessary at times. it is more work expected for a 100 level class but if you study and put in the work its an easy A
too much work for a 100 level class dont recommend just take the online version of this class

Overall he is passionate about his course and knows what he is talking about. The class is a bit unorganized and TAs don't respond emails on time. There is no extra credit in this class and it is exam heavy. Attendance isn't mandatory but everything you need to know is on the slides for the exams. The final exam isn't cumulative which is nice.

Great professor, very funny and chill 
A lecture class with slides and it did have a lot of material so it's just a matter of studying and going over it which can be a lot of reading. Truly not hard. Got an c only because I didn't take the time to study all the way sadly! 

Would def take again though!

The lectures were very content-heavy, but he was very knowledgeable on the topic and would stay behind for any students who had questions. He made the exams super easy (he understands that we have other things to worry about). He's a very nice and funny person, he was such an amazing professor!

Prof. Bauer gives good lectures, but you don't have to attend as the majority of the class is going over the slides given ahead of time. With that, group discussions are worth more, as are the discussion posts. Tests are relatively easy, and you get retakes.

Worst professor ever. I struggled with things outside of class my first year (2023) so, I kept in contact with him for help. He failed me and told me that I wasn't ready for college and that I should attend community college instead. This is extremely unacceptable. He was not good at lecturing, he reads off of the slides. Too much work.
He is really funny and his class is really easy. He reads off the slides, but I think that what you'd expect. Just study the slides and you'll be fine. You have to actually study for the test.

Im a terrible student and have been doing the bare minimum but, I'm confident I'll pass this class. Not a lot of work, listen to the lectures of even just go through the slides and you should be fine in this class. :) Bro is chill, lectures are nice. Attendance not even taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: never went to lecture. took good notes on slides. easy A. highhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhly recommend.

Dr. Bauer has a lot of interesting things to say and tries his best to get people interested in anthropology. There is a lot of work for this class especially given it is a 100 level class. I am very interested in anthropology but this class caught me off guard for a bit. That being said he really cares about his students and their well being.
Professor Bauer is incredible and really passioned about his subject. Have to admit that work load for this class is hard. You have to do few assingments every week and read every week readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took Bauer's Anth 100 course online asynchronously. His lecture videos are about 1 hr each 2X a week but you can also just take notes on his uploaded ppt. He's kind and willing to listen to his students if there is an issue with the course. For a 100 level there is a bit more work than expected but it's never hard. There is a short research paper

The professor is very passionate about the subject but the workload for a 100 class is beyond what it should. There are weekly readings (readings!! not just one) and videos aside from the lectures, a weekly discussion that needs to be at least 300 words, weekly quizzes, & TA's take turns posting weekly "recaps" which involve questions due mon 8am.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The work load for a 100 class is crazy. There are two lectures over 30 min each, there were additional readings and YouTube videos to watch, weekly response, a weekly quiz on the material, every Friday we would get access to a discussion video that included quiz questions that needs to be done by Monday 8am and every now and then homework due Fri

Brings his dog to class once in a while. Class doesn't involve textbooks but a lot of online reading is required for those that will be included in unit exams. Involves a lot of memorizing of dates, names, features. Study well and you should do okay. Attendance isn't mandatory but would recomend you show up inorder to do well in the exams
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His class isn't hard. Although he posts every lecture on BB you still have to go to lecture because 90% of the material for the test comes from his lecture. Discussions suck. truthfully just pick another gen ed this class is so interesting yet sooooooo boring
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: ANTH is pretty boring. Took this class for gen ed and regret it. Lectures are so boring. Feel asleep during them a couple of them. The class requires a Term paper. 15% of the grade. The discussion was worse then lectures. You had to read long boring articles and had quizzes on the reading. I passed with a B but work effort was a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: His class is pretty easy, not hard to get an A if you put in some effort. 3 Exams that are multiple choice (the bad part is he requires you to memorize slides and things he has said in class for these exams making attendance mandatory in that aspect). You have one 7 pg essay which is a good way to boost your grade if you do well. Very interesting.

I was not expecting much when I took this class, it was just for general education credit, but it ended up as my favorite class of the year, if not my four years. Bauer is a great teacher, funny, accessible and especially clear on what he wants you to learn.
Dr. Bauer is a great professor who tries to be "hip". He makes things very clear and easier to understand.
Very clear lectures. No textbook required; online readings.

WAY TOO MUCH READING for a gen ed. Very nice teacher but I have more work in this class than I do for my major classes like microbiology and physics. You have to read 2 articles each week for discussion that are typically around 15 pages+. Also these articles are not even on the exam. This class has WAY TOO MUCH busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Here is a world class researcher who brings his dog to class, and what a beautiful dog! He made all the lectures interesting, funny, and insightful. I check out his CV and he is a major investigator, written dozens of books, but still clearly loves sharing his excitement for the field with new students. I would take the class again if I could !
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He has designed the whole course with power points that are shared after reach lecture. They are amaize. Jokes are woven it, relevant topics discussed, and grading was straight forward. This was a huge class but his love for the topic inflected everyone. Many of us were still talking about the lectures over lunch.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very cool and laid back professor, also passionate about the material. His powerpoint slides were amusing. As long as you read the material and the slides you will get the A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests? Not many--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. He has cool stories & uses a variety of methods to teach such as lecture slides, videos, movies, etc. The teacher explained things very well. As for the course content, it was very easy. Just about basic human evolution. He didn't require us to know dates & tests were all multiple choice. Test material was exactly the power points

Read all of the articles, go to class (slides available on Blackboard, but really, go to class), and ask for help when you need it and you'll be fine. The quizzes are easy, the tests could be if you pay attention in class. I didn't and I regret it. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I can't stress enough how much I recommend it.

This is the kind of professor I love. This is not a class where you just breeze in and breeze out. But its still pretty easy. you dont have to go to lecture although itll help you understand you have to go for discussion. there are really EASY quizes there every week. just give anthro 2 hours studying a week you'll be fine. plus NO TEXTBOOK saves $

He is an interesting professor. Grading criteria is clear cut. 3 exams, 10 quizzes and 1 paper. Quiz section is a major part of your grade so don't skip. All material presented through PPT. No textbook. Articles are assigned reading for Quiz sections. TA's are helpful Sandy - Rebekkah (Preferred). Lets you rewrite the paper for a better Grade.

1) 90%  A. Low avg  less than 70, curves 2) Textbooks  No textbook (Fall 2014) 3) Exams  Easy. Entirely from lecture slides & videos 4) Paper  Spend some quality time on it. Read the instruction manual thoroughly. 5) Quiz  Based on weekly discussion reading. Please go to discussions.  Tip: I posted study guides for each exams.

Simply put, the class is tough, but if you show up and actually pay attention to the lecture material, you'll do fine. Do the readings, show up to discussion; it's really not as bad as people make it seem. Bauer makes his lectures interesting, but in short, if you're not interested in anthropology and are looking for an easy A, don't take this.

Brian was a mediocre Teacher. His lectures are pretty boring and will put you to sleep. The topic of the class was interesting but they found a way to make me hate it. I would not take his class again.

EASIEST class ever! i retook 100 and i wish i would have taken him the first time. no book. show up to lecture, pay attention, do discussion readings for the quizzes (one every week) no discussion the last 2 weeks. very easy class. required reading but if you dont read them youll still most likely pass.

This class is just okay. The professor is nice and can be funny at times. There's not any engagement with the students (asking?), so you're just supposed to sit there and listen. The discussion readings are interesting, but the quizzes are so annoying. Anyways, there's a paper and 3 exams. The class isn't difficult. Just study, you should be fine.

Bauer is very enthusiastic with his lectures. He makes lectures incredibly fun. However, he stresses a lot on the paper. He almost makes it seem as if the paper should be done perfectly but this is just a 100 level course. Also He is very slow at putting grades in and uploading midterm grades. We had no grades uploaded and it's already spring break

Great professor! Extremely enthusiastic and passionate about material. He's super friendly & nice. Attend lectures (& actually pay attention), go to discussion, read the readings, do well on the papers(2), and STUDY the lecture slides and you'll get an A.  Reading the book time to time also helps. Make sure you study because there are only 2 exams!

Liked the class a lot. He lectures well and you can tell he's passionate about the material. Honestly, it's a very easy class as long as you attend lectures and discussion classes. The quizzes were simple and easy, questions taken directly from the readings.

He makes the lectures really interesting. The research papers are super easy. You got extra credit opportunities. Everybody messed up on the discussion quizzes, but they are not worth much anyway. Quizzes are kind of tricky. Overall fun class.
This class was really easy to pass, all you had to do was go to lecture. I didnt read the book and still got an A. Just go over his powerpoints and go to discussion for quizes and youre set.

I took this class expecting it to be easy however it was not. Only grades given are a midterm, paper and final. Big emphasis on research paper!!! If you don't like going to class I suggest not taking Bauer!!! And it's good to read the book.  But he does curve. I'm still praying on receiving a B!!

This is too hard for an intro to Anthro class. Exams are very detailed, hence hard. Paper requirements are a pain. I would not recommend taking him, but I dont know how the other profs are. But Dr.Bauer just made this class too difficult for an entry level class. Disc are mandatory due to quizzes, but not bad.

probably one of the easiest a's ive gotten.  all his lectures are easy to follow are on powerpoint.  never read the book, just went to lecture.  extra readings are short and the quizzes are easy if you read.  Research paper was annoying but its all curved
Greatest and easiest professor ever! He teaches the material very well but does not have high expectations on exams. Definetly reccomend him.

It isn't a very hard class, but it's pretty reading-intensive. Lectures are usually quite boring, but you'll need the notes if you want to do well on exams. I got an A, but I still wish I'd taken another anthro class/proffesor instead of Dr. Bauer.

This class is a lot of work for a 100 class.  There is no point in going to lecture. Have to go to discussion because of the quizzes. He has some pretty decent curves so the class isn't too bad.  Prepare to do a lot of reading though.

I didn't think I would enjoy his class but it was easy. I never opened the book, just attended lecture. Just take notes.. midterm and final are easy he talked about everything in class. Attend discussions because there are quizes on the articles, but they are easy. Just pay attention to what he says and its an easy A!!

You don't have to go to lecture, but be sure to go to discussions! Read the articles that he puts on blackboard because he gives quizzes in the discussions. It's an easy A if you actually go over his powerpoints which are online.
I actually enjoy the class.  He makes it at least a little interesting.
I found the class interesting, even though he's lectures were a little boring at times. He repeats himself a lot, but all that information is on tests, so it's an easy A.
Made class environment needlessly morose. Didn't talk down to me, though. I think it's because I'm taller than him.
he really knows his Incas....
Great teacher, knows his stuff, lectures can be boring at times but handouts make it easy to catch up outside of class.
Boring...very boring class.
I thought he was very interesting, and really nice too.  He took a genuine interest in individual students.  A pretty easy A.

The notes are clear and concise, he lets you photocopy them out of the library. He is slightly amusing, and you get to watch numerous movies. Overall the class isn't as boring as most, and the biggest assignment is a 5 page paper.
The proffesor was very boring. For a 100 level class the class was very challenging.  way to much reading and the tests were difficult. papers were also graded harshly
There was a lot of reading, but i only read because i stopped going to lecture half way through the semester (it was a 10am class, and i dont like to wake up early).  It was an easy A.

Unclear! Monotone! Boring! Exam is not based on lecture notes. Discussion are sh*tty. Just repeating lecture and nothing new. No wonder they have pop quizes just to make u go to discussion. Be aware 1% of the exam is based on lecture and discussion.

I thought that he was a good lecturer but he doesnt have notes which makes it harder. you have to be able to write fast in order to get a good grade and be able to read so to keep up with his notes. I didnt think it was THAT bad though.
Wanted to shoot myself to put myself out of my misery on SEVERAL occasions
boring. does not make an effort to make class interesting.  monotone voice, NOT a good teacher unhelpful-
He should be teaching a higher level of Anth, this class is horrible.  Its way too much info for and intro class.  Only 2 tests and a paper though! Tons of reading, if you want an A.
No Comments
Absolutely amazing teacher!!
Follow the rubric, do the work. Get a good grade.

Professor Angie is amazing, her feedback on papers and assignments is well thought out, she explains very clearly what she expects. If you ever see her name for any future classes always pick her!!! She genuinely cares for her students!
Shes a very fair grader and gives great feedback on assignments. I would definitely take her again. Follow the assignment rubrics and complete all assignments and you will pass.

Professor Brooker is an amazing person and professor. I absolutely had success under her guidance. I would highly recommend her. I have taken two on-line nursing classes with her. She gives great feedback, is incredibly quick to return assignments and emails. First-Class!

Professor Brooker CARES! She is an excellent professor who comes with knowledge, energy, and is incredibly engaging. I have taken other courses from her and only wish that she taught more as I have learned so much from her.

Sarah is a great professor. The entire class was based on one project split into multiple parts that you tackle one by one as the semester goes on. She can sound a bit passive-aggressive at times, but she is always able and willing to help you whenever you need her. Do not be afraid to ask her for help! An easy A so long as you attend class.
Sweetest english professor I've ever met. She's also funny and enthusiastic. We did a podcast for this class instead of bunch of essays and that made me stay in this class.
She is very caring and nice professor. I would recommend you take her class and she cares about student's opinion on what grade they should earn. She is very kind.

For the most part, Professor Buchmeier is kind and pretty funny. But, she has a big issue giving back feedback. Some of her assignments required you to resubmit applying feedback she gives you, but she won't give you any, and then expects you to use your own time to meet with a tutor. Lots of reading before class but not the worst professor.

This professor will make you want to rethink your life decisions at certain moments. She bases the course on one project that gets worked on throughout the semester, but what she expects is not very clear, ESPECIALLY in the feedback. While she is nice, there are some points where it's very difficult to stay engaged and focused in the class.

The course itself is not difficult, but dealing with the professor is. She's so insufferable and passive-aggressive. She has loopholes in her syllabus. She says she won't drop your grade for attendance, but attendance is mandatory, so it still affects your grade. She says you can use AI, but then gets upset when something sounds like AI.

She is very passionate about the articles we read. Tries her best to genuinely improve student abilities in writing. She is very kind and has good pacing for you to follow through with the class. Syllabus and blackboard is well organized and contains all the information needed to pass. She is a bit strict on participation and AI so avoid that. 5/5!

161 was an interesting experience in that the final product is a single research paper. Deadlines for drafts are every week. Sarah is very heavy on peer-reviewing. You will get split up into random groups that you meet every week to discuss. Her feedback is insightful and she genuinely cares. As long as you keep up with deadlines, you'll get an A.

One of the nicest English teachers I've ever had. The class is centered around writing an 8-10 research paper. Throughout the semester we did research and wrote the paper bit by bit and submitted the final paper as our final exam. The class is very revision heavy, revising and peer reviewing is crucial but I never felt burdened with work.

Course is structured around a final research paper. Each week there is a deadline for a section of your paper. Gives good feedback and gives adequate time between assignments. Just show up to class, stick to the deadlines, put effort into revisions and you'll be fine.

Sarah is the best English teacher! She was able to make it a fun and engaging lecture. She is super caring and gives amazing feedback. Not a lot of work for this class just busy work to help prepare for papers. Plenty of time is given between assignments and she is understanding about any given situation. She wants her students to succeed

Took for summer school and so glad I did. Only one 10-12 page paper instead of 4 like a regular semester. Topic was social problem. Graded tough on the first few drafts of the parts of the paper, but once you put them all into one I got an A. She'll cross out entire paragraphs in your drafts if she wants tho so a lot of reformatting.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Sarah was able to make a dull subject pretty entertaining. Her lectures were always informative and she is extremely helpful. She provides excellent feedback on all assignments and it's clear that our success is important to her. Show up to class, turn your homework in on time (with effort!), leave your phone in your bag, and you will do just fine.

She was my TA for Engl241. Her discussions were really helpful. She was nice and caring. Graded pretty fairly. Was approachable. Kept optional review session at the end of the semester, which was really helpful and awesome of her. Would take again.

She's helpful, clear, and makes the process for writing complicated papers in an easier way. Sarah is always around to help and tells you what you need to do to  an A. Plus, she's hilarious and very approachable. Class was more like a "conversation" than a "lecture".

She always makes time for you despite her own busy schedule and makes sure that you're understanding the material. She doesn't spoon feed you and provides a lot of feedback on exams and papers. That being said, she isn't a particularly harsh grader, but she's honest and the grade you get is most likely the one that you deserve. Sarah's great!
shes awesome
Fun class although could use some more energy from time to time. Overall great class and pretty laid back atmosphere.
Sarah is a great english professor, she is really helpful and is always willing to assist you.

She is great! Her assignments are easy and clear. She gives enough time for completion. Her class was easy going and she was a laid back teacher. Go to class, do the light homework, and it'll be great!

Bruhl is funny and caring. There's lots of homework, there aren't really any due dates until the end of the semester. It can be overwhelming since he doesn't use blackboard much and requires that all assignments be printed and turned in person. You can redo all assignments except for one. Not difficult but a lot of work when the topics are dense
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lots of homeowrk, and he may be tough on grading, but he lets you turn in assignments for regrades. His lectures can be him rambling on, but they're pretty good. Also, you're gonna have to print out assignments. Overall though, pretty chill class, just do the homework and show up, that's all you have to do and you'll get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Respected

reviews.comment: Listen, he is a tough grader, but he will let you redo assignments as many times as you want until you pass. Use his office hours; they're a godsend. Attendance is taken, but communicate with him if you're missing class; he is typically very generous with it. Also, listen to his random rambles; they are very insightful. also get ready to print!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Bruhl is amazing. Such kind, gentle demeanor and genuinely wants us to learn. May God protect him

He is very harsh grader. I got all my calculations correct and when I did spss which is drag and drop excel I had to use another function instead of the normal one because spss does not let you use < less than 10 hours as an example and he gave me 12/15 then 5/10. Because it did not match spss results. I even check with YouTube and google. HORRIBLE

He is a tough grader, and he will lower your grade if you don't include some very specific details that he thought of (in open-ended questions). I also found him very opinionated, and he expects you to follow his opinions. Overall, I wasn't impressed with his lectures. He is very caring though.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: he doesn't take attendance and does not care about due dates, which was really nice. He is a tough grader and has specific things he is looking for. even tho this is a political science class you will be doing math as some of the assignment have calculations. overall an easy class with no tests.

It wasn't my favorite class, but the assignments were straightforward. If you're majoring in political science, you'll likely need to take him. A few books and assignments to go along with them. Worth the time and effort!

The professor does care about the material he is teaching. He is willing to accept recorrected or late work at no cost. Attendance is also not graded. However, he is very particular about what he is looking for in his homework, and he is slow in grading. He is an ok teacher for a specific POLS requirement.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This was an online gen-ed course for me, and somehow had more work assigned over my calculus 2 course. It was honestly ridiculous. I don't believe any of the 4 papers I completed were even read by the professor, but instead the TA. Textbook required, and Bruhl was easy to reach but there wasn't any reason to because he didn't teach anything.

Professor Bruhls class is really good. You learn a lot without the pressure of deadlines, and many of the assignments are very easy to understand. I recommend everyone takes his course, its a good one to balance out a more intense or stressful course. You will learn a lot about research and the methods used in studies as well.

Prof Bruhl is really sweet and keeps lectures short. My only problem with this class was the grading and textbook. If you got a few things wrong on an assignment he would give a zero but he allows resubmissions! The textbook didnt make much sense to me but everything else was okay.

I thoroughly enjoyed Bruhl's class. His lectures were engaging and he fostered an excellent learning environment. While the homework is not difficult, there are a decent amount of assignments, as well as three projects, one being a group project.

Really chill professor. Lectures aren't mandatory and the stuff you get graded on isn't really related to the lectures. if you do go to lecture though, he is very helpful if you need clarification on anything and cracks a few jokes here and there.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor, super chill with homework policy. Only 3 projects one being a group project. Not too hard for the first half of the semester.

One of the nicest and most helpful professors I've ever had. If your a poly-sci major and a freshman his pols 101 class is an easy transition from high school. He loves to crack corny jokes and has very good tips for your paper and assignments. He is always free to talk in his office about anything.
Failed the class but Bruhl is truly a god among men. 10/10 professor that teaches well.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures are not mandatory. The discussion that is held once a week is mandatory though. I stopped going to the lectures after week 2 and was fine. The assignments that we were doing had nothing to do with the lecture, and you turned everything in at the discussion so you don't really need to go to lecture after week 2.
He was an okay professor, nothing special. He wouldn't round my final grade of 89.46% to a 90%. I would have had straight A's.

It was a true honor to have taken Professor Bruhl. Professor Bruhl cares about his students and is flexible with the assignments he assigns. Professor Bruhl assigned a total of two projects and two extra credit opportunities. I recommend him and to take advantage of the extra credit opportunities. The midterm was short essays on topics covered.

Overall is a nice guy but a very disorganized professor. Claims he doesn't assign due dates then days later sends you 3 assignments due the following week. Randomly will lecture in the most boring ways. He's flexible on turning in assignments, that's the only pro. This course is wayyyyy to much work. Also, you rarely get homework back

reviews.comment: He is a very chill professor, does not really care about deadlines. Three projects and lots of readings. Lets you correct work to earn back points. Offers a few extra credit opportunities, make sure you take advantage of those. Attendance is a big part of your grade. Make sure you stay on top of your work to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Bruhl has the best attitude of any professor in the political science department. He cares about the subject and is always extremely attentive to student concerns on any assignment.

Bruhl is awesome, POLS 101 is definitely a boring intro class. Grade is based on 4 papers and light reading Lectures are VERY optional for grading but interesting if you care and he'll give lots of extra credit to those who do. Bruhl is better in POLS 200 when he can discuss, I went to lectures for his insights. He cares about students who care.

POLS 101 WAS A JOKE! This class was so unorganized, which in my opinion I didn't mind because I was okay with skipping lecture. To pass the class all you have to do is show up to the discussion, get a good grade on the 4 papers that you get assigned on and do the chapter reflections, which I did not do but got a good grade considering I did nothing
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Awesome guy, and Easy A class. There are a lot of one or two page assignments based off of readings but you don't really have to read them to answer the questions. "Late work" is accepted until the last week with no penalty and you can re-do assignments you did poorly on. One semester-long group project and 2 smaller individual projects

Going to the lectures is not mandatory. I stopped going as he mainly repeats everything and reads off slides. All the work is on the syllabus . There are four main papers. Three of them are 8-10 pages with cited notations. I did them all a few days before the due date and got an A. Easy class, weekly summary on chapters. Don't procrastinate easyA
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: A lot of homework
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: ! He's super chill and super lenient. In Pols 101, there are no tests, quizzes, or final exam. 3 big papers and 2 town hall meetings. A lot of work, but so easy! T.A grades us, and they allow redoes and accept late works on all assignments. The class is perfect for bad test takers. ABSOLUTELY RECOMMEND. I got a 101% in the class. #thatshoweasyitis

He is an awesome professor who truly is interesting and fun to be around. He does have many assignments over the semester but he gives you ample time to turn each one in. His TA's grade pretty harshly just as a heads up.
He's a great teacher. He does give a lot of hw but it's worth it. Super funny, carrying and fair grader. I'd totally take this class again
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Bruhl is awesome! He's such a chill teacher, and there are no tests and quizzes. There are 3 eight papers you have to write and you have to attend a town hall council meeting. I know it sounds a lot of work, but trust me, it is a very easy class. If you are a bad essay writer, then no worries. Most TAs allow redos. Absolutely recommend him

God Bless Professor Bruhl! He is one of the best Professors I've had in UIC. The class relies on three important assignments that are not that hard. If there is any confusion Professor Bruhl always makes sure to ask if the assignment was clear enough. I honestly wish I could take his course again. He is the best!
grade consisted of 3 projects, reading assignments (which can be redone if you get a bad grade) and attendance. very well educated and understanding. be friends with him, you won't regret it.

I loved Bruhl, he's one of my favorite professors ever. Took attendance every day, but you could probs get away with skipping sometimes. Our class was from 3:30-4:45 and he let us out super early every time. Easy assignments throughout the semester, not strict with grades or due dates. Very helpful and nice. Laugh at his jokes and he'll be happy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's a difficult professor. Despite this, I really enjoyed my time in his lectures. While it was one of the most difficult classes, he's great. If you can work at it he's a fair grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's a good professor, a tad dry sometimes but he enjoys feedback. If you're in his class, be sure to nod. Also PLEASE laugh at his jokes, otherwise he just looks at you. There's a lot of assignments theres no real due date, there will be but he'll take it anytime. Try to make it the last class of the day, you'll get out early a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Amazing Professor. Just go talk to him if you need anything. This was my first A at UIC. So you can take from me that getting an A in this class is very attainable.

Lectures are based on power points (uploaded to blackboard).  There aren't any exams or quizzes, so lecture attendance is not mandatory.  Discussion attendance is mandatory because each discussion is worth 5 points to your overall grade.  Very simple reading reflections (5 important facts from lecture, and 5 from chapter) & three 8-10 page papers.

There are 5, 8-10 page essays you have to write in the class on top of weekly homework assignment that you need the book for. There is so much unnecessary work he makes you do, and if you thought this class would be easy and you're taking much harder classes DO NOT TAKE! There is hours of homework every single week and you have to earn that A

says "okie doke" so you know he's a good guy doesnt take attendance but expects you to participate in class if you do show up presentations instead of tests and there was no final reading reflections due for every chapter but easy and he clearly outlines what you need for every assignment
Very easy class. Just do the work which is mostly available online. Whole semester is spent doing a group project so get it done soon. Easy A. Only buy the big textbook.
Awesome professor, may be my favorite at UIC.  No tests but occasional homework assignments which he is super leanient about late work. I didn't buy the textbook and got by just fine

Simply awesome! I learned more in his class than any other college course. He does not overwhelm you with the workload and you actually have time to focus and learn everything very well. I would take any class that he is teaching again.

There were about five books to read for the course. The material was really interesting, though. The assignments related to the readings are manageable. There is also a group survey project along with an individual survey project, both of which are manageable if you put in the effort. The professor really tries to make you think, which is great.
Prof. Bruhl is very calm and clear. He is a smart man and is very patient with students. Really enjoyed his class, most of which you spend on a large group project.

Professor Bruhl is great! He keeps class light-hearted, and gives you every opportunity to succeed. The class involves a series of readings and short papers on the readings, a group project, and an individual survey project. Highly recommended.
This class was an easy statistics course. As long as you took notes and came to class everyday you will be fine. There are many hw assignments that you have to do and you can resumbit them for a 100.

Attending class is not mandatory but it is helpful. There are chapter reflections and quizzes regarding those chapters. Quizzes are hard if you don't really read or study. There are projects which your grade really revolves around but no tests. Take the class

Dr. Bruhl is really nice professor. The lectures are extremely boring and honestly I only went the first day to lecture. The TA is super helpful. He believes in quizzes, no exams which is awesome. Two projects that are fairly easy. If you read up with the chapters and study off slides, no need for lectures. Just go to discussions :)

Lecture is extremely boring. You don't really need to attend it to pass. There are 4 quizzes, chapter reflections every week, 2 big projects, and most importantly NO FINAL! :) Overall, if you turn in all your work and put in some effort this class is easy.

I don't understand how people said this class was an easy A. I guess my TA was just super hard. I studied so hard and got D's and C's on the tests. It's not intensely difficult, but definitely NOT an easy A.

will go over material to no end, accepts late work with no penalty, asks you do the work completely and correctly, but is flexible with deadlines, very cool guy, looked forward to his class, actually learned statistical analysis in the process.

Easiest POLS class at UIC. 1 homework each week, 1 exam, and a couple of class projects to boost your grade + EC worth 30 points! Professor Bruhl is absolutely awesome! He's the uncle you wish you had. So nice, funny, and made the material a breeze. (Don't need the book). Hand in work and you'll get an A.

AMAZING teacher!!! beyond helpful and actually wants you to learn. The class is great. 2 tests and a few HW assignments. Knows his material. One of my favorite professors at UIC. I would highly recommend taking him.

awesome professor! take this class with him because it is so easy. if you dont get an a please withdraw from this university. he allows late assignments which is awesome! overall i recommend you take him with all the classes he teaches for easy A and gpa booster!

Class is super easy. Three midterms,the last one of which is a take home exam,a group project and really easy weekly homework which you can do by reading the chapter summary. Great class for Gen Ed requirements. The tests can be sort of hard if you don't read through the powerpoint notes, all of which are online.

This class is NOT a pushover; however Bruhl tries very hard to help you understand the material. There are 11 homework assignments, 1 midterm and 1 final. The assignments can be redone for full credit once turned in and graded the first time, this allowed me to receive an A in the class because the mistakes I made were noted with feedback.

Easy class. easy A or B. really easy class 3 quiz's no final and the last quiz was a take home. 2 papers. pretty simple course. though i have to warn you if you attend lecture,you will be board out of your mind. this guy is so dry. but overall he seems like a good guy

This is the easiest class ever. No exams, no papers. Just some homework assignments that you can turn in WHENEVER you want, and three projects (beware though, one of them is a group project). He's a nice professor but the lecture is dry. He takes a long time to answer emails and he isn't very clear with directions.

this class is so easy. I never went to lecture or read the book and got A's and B's on the quizzes (3 of them). you do write 2 papers..but they are easy...the weekly assignments are also a piece of cake...all you gotta do is summarize the chapters but I  just wrote definitions of certain words from the end of each chapter. Easy A or B
Such an easy A. If you are not a math major you will be FINE. No tests and easy hw assignments. We did not use textbook at all! Quirky guy too. Take his course if you want to get an A!
Lectures are VERY dull, he posts all PP to Bb and only his discussion sections are mandatory. Pretty easy but you have to study for the 3 quizzes he gives out.

He puts all his lectures on BBL but the discussions are mandatory and you have to turn in 2 chapters of "Reading Reflections" every week,,, write the 10 most important thing from each chapter and why its important.

Most boring lectures I have ever attended. TA was arrogant, and tried to put a "fresh" spin on material to no avail. Also unprofessional with replying to email, and following up with students. I was disappointed as PS is an interest of mine.

My Favorite Teacher!!! DO the Homework attend the lectures, and there it's virtually impossible not to get an A. He is a very easy grader, and is a good-down to earth lecturer. His HW, exams, and Projects are not very hard. He actually like class participation. Take every class you can with him, get easy A's,  and actually learn something.

I LOVE THIS PROFESSOR!! If you're looking for an easy A, this is it! He's a sweet guy with corny jokes, he tries to make you laugh, there are no exams just "projects". In the summer we had a total of 11 projects, all were easy, in an 8 week period, I wasn't there for 2 weeks because of family vacation in the summer, BUT he really helps you out! <3

He is a very good professor. He can make hard courses easy. He is also very helpful and kind. I like the book he assigns to us because it is very interesting although they are long. I love this professor!
Class is rather easy. He assigns projects and homework and doesnt really care when they're due, as along as its by the end of the semester. No tests or final.
He is a really cool guy.  The class isn't hard just do the assignments.

Easiest political science class I have ever taken.  You just need to do the homework which is extremely easy.  There are a couple of group projects and he has some extra credit to.  class is a bit boring, but he is a cool guy.
Great teacher. Easy class as long as you do the assignments. Really laid back guy and truly cares about his students. Take him if you can!

I had Bruhl for 201 and 200 and he was a very helpful teacher.  Since I'm a POLS major, a lot of his teachings carried on to my other classes which also made those classes clearer.  I really enjoyed him and his personality.  I think if you show up to class everyday and engage in conversation, he will recognize you are interested.

The absolute worst teacher I have ever had. Every single lecture was a complete waste of time. Projects were pointless and expected to be done without guidance. He has students read very important texts then neglects to actually TEACH them. Considering he never actually teaches anything he is a hard grader.

He teaches you what you need to know. He understands that this class is not tuned for mathy people and makes changes accordingly. He makes the tests like his study guides so make you sure you study them. He does not want to trick you or anything, he just wants to make sure you know enough to pass the test. Projects are very easy.
not fun, too many projects...final's easy, just study review.

Very easy, but interesting class. You will spend some all nighters in this class since there are projects which take up a lot of time, but other than that, go to lectures, and you will do fine on the tests. Complete the projects in full, and its a good class, and I actually learned a lot too. He made the class fun and interesting .

Great teacher, took him because of his feedback on here and I was not disappointed. Although attendance was not taken I always went to class, he was very helpful, didnt even have to open the book. Projects were simple, they were prepared for months in advance, I didnt start them until a few days before and still received exceptional grades on them.

I had Bruhl few years back. The class was very easy, however it was extremely time consuming. The projects would take me about 8 hours to complete(not because they were hard, but took much of my time). I heard he changed his grading scheme now though, if this is the case I feel sorry for everyone, I used to go to like every lecture(I was a freshman

The Wise One... very well read on social and political philosophy and knowledgeable on most areas of poly sci. Very opinionated but always open and never condescending. Reading assignments include philosophical classics such as Machiavelli, Aristotle, and Hume, all of which shouldn't be painful for any poly sci student. Has funny dry sense of humor
He is a good professor-he really cares.
Que horrible!

Dr. Bruhl is a very nice person. I am taking his class now and THERE ARE EXAMS AND QUIZES. We had one quiz which counted as our midterm and one exam so far. we will have final exam as well.  There are lots of projects that are time consuming, but if you do those   it is an easy A.He is very helpful and understanding as well. Take his class!!!
people that dont do well in his classes are the ones that really put no effort into it..if you do the work. its an easy A. hes such an awesome teacher, very linient and understanding.
He now has test in his class, they didn't have them before. A lot of reading is assigned but nobody does it and ended up with As and Bs.
As a class its the easiest one ive taken in college but as a professor he is aweful but you should get an A no matter what
Great class, very little work... as long as you complete the few assignmetns assinged you will get an A

i took him for 101, 200 and 201. So, he assigns those readings but really just go to lecture and pay attention in discussion first exam IS open notes and you don't have to read the western civ book!
