reviews.comment: I felt Dr. Bui was very fair and I had no problem with her in the least.

Make sure to do all the readings before class because she gives pop quizzes on them! Lectures were pretty boring most of the time. You finish the book in the first half of the semester and then get guest speakers from the Comm department the other half and we had to write research article reviews before each. 2 exams, one final, one 5-7 page paper.

I loved professor Bui! There is a TON of reading, and be prepared to do a lot of studying. It's tough, but it prepares you for the rest of college. First half of the semester is all book material, and the second half of the semester is research articles & speakers. She likes to give out pop quizzes, so be sure to stay on top of the material.

Professor Bui is a tough grader but she teaches the material well! Comm 101 appealed to me so much it made me want to declare it as my minor. Be sure to read the textbook, study for exams, go to class, and pay attention! Attendance is worth a lot and can benefit your grade.

LOTS of reading! Seriously! But it prepares you so well for college-level reading, it helps in the long run! Take her papers seriously, she doesn't just give out A's. You need to put in some solid effort. An A is possible if you follow her very clear guidelines and genuinely try. She's pleasant to talk to, understanding if you respect her.

I honestly appreciate Professor Bui so much. She does not try to be confusing or tricky in tests - she explains things very clearly. She always shows passion and wisdom behind what she teaches. She's also very nonchalant. Above all, VERY helpful outside of class as well and makes sure you succeed in paper. I'll miss having classes with her!

Being a non com major, I just took this class as an elective thinking it would be easy.  I was wrong.  She is a tough grader.  There was two 100 questions tests and a 140 question cumulative final.  i ended up getting a B on all the tests.  Even though I got a B I was hoping for an A in the class.  For a 100 level class it was pretty hard.

Bui's class is a lot of work! Although the workload was heavy, her class really gave me a great foundation for my other comm classes. I recommend taking her cause it'll make your life easier later on.

Let me make it clear that I did well in class and the course content was interesting. But no credit will be given to the instructor. Bui is the most useless "instructor" I have ever come across. She is biased, demeaning, ignorant, and dull. Do not waste expensive tuition dollars so it can be wasted on this woman. Choose a different instructor.

She is very nice but yea she can be rude as the person below said. He gave us an option from 2 readings and quizzed us on both! WTF but beginning of class is easy because all you literally have to do is focus on vocab from the book. Go to class though, she passes around a sign-in sheet and randomnly gives quizzes. They're easy if you do the work.

Although she presents herself as nice, she is kind of rude.  Like somebody mentioned, she doesn't negotiate.  When there was confusion about us needing to do 2 readings instead of 1-she gave us a pop quiz and many argued that her directions stated that we could choose between the 2 readings. She said we were supposed to do both and ended discussion

I've taken 3 classes with her. She's great! Her classes are easy. She's a fair grader and is always available for help. She kept my interest during class. I've noticed the negative comments are all from students who have taken comm103 with her, that class is boring. Not even Bui could make it interesting. She was definitely my fav prof at UIC.
She is a very nice professor, surprised her rating is not higher! Very easy. Show up to class, do the work, and you are guaranteed an A.

I have taken 3 classes with this chick and as "nice" as she seems to be, all of the comments posted are completely true.. except the first one. Listening to her talk is comparable to watching paint dry. You can pass her class but you will be pissed at how she weighs everything. Just boring and vague..

I took this class because I have read the first and only review.  I don't know who wrote it, probably she did it herself.  The first review is a total lie, everyone in class agrees.  There are no discussions, just copying tons of notes from PP.  She made me hate this subject, I think I will change my major now.

Unexperienced and incompetent.She displays extremely long power point presentations and expects you to write down everything word for word.  She talks at the same time when you write, so you can't understand what she's saying. She won't negotiate over anything, total power tripper. No discussion, no critical thinking, just memorizing. HORRIBLE!!!

She is a fabulous professor! Amazing class discussions, take one of her 300 or 400-level courses while she is still at UIC. There is a lot of work, but she is a fair and helpful grader, and you'll actually LEARN something for once!!
nice professor, but terrible teacher.

I really do not know how he qualifies to be a professor at a university. I've had better ones at a community college. Looks down at the floor while he goes through powerpoints. No structure to his course and not clear on explanations. No study guides and does not clearly explain what specific material to study for. Homework is not helpful.

Attending class is virtually worthless. He reads a powerpoint and it is not helpful towards tests or homework. You only get one check on your homework and one submission; not to mention that it is extremely difficult and time consuming. The tests are multiple choice and the averages are low. He also states he doesn't curve! Joy. Good luck!

Teacher is a fair grader. Exams might be tough but homework and the project points will bring your grade up assuming you get all 100%, which is not too hard to do. I suggest forming a study group because it helps a lot. There is also a curve so don't lose hope if you aren't doing too well.

The homework for this class is hard and he gives u one try to check it. He talks off a ppt about calculation problems...if you've ever taken a math class you will know that just talking about it will make no sense. You have to have examples and practice and he simply doesn't do anything. Taking this course...take it as a self study class

Tax is a tough class and must be taught by someone who knows what they are doing. Having said this, this prof will just read off a powerpoint (which he won't give you) at supersonic speeds and then assign you homework. You and the texbook should just get married because the final is cumulative and he tests on the most useless info without telling u

Do not take him! He is horrible at teaching tax so be ready to teach yourself. The homework is very difficult compared to what you learn in class, and you only get 1 attempt to check your answers. I actually started to skip class to teach myself instead. Definitely buy the book because you will not learn anything from him.

Super easy class, good for a divisional, kind of a tough grader, but just make sure you're following ALL the assignment requirements and including information from the readings. Prof. Garrett is the best and I really enjoyed this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally free. No tests, one assignment a week (which are a lot of reading but its not difficult), attendance is not required. There is a participation grade but just talk once a class and you'll be fine. Final is a group project that you work on the whole semester that is just annoying and you present it during finals. Cal is also very caring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: NO exam, attendance is not required. Super easy class

Easy and interesting class. Only one assignment per week, either a short essay or reading notes. You have readings before every class, but it doesn't hurt if you don't read it sometimes, and the readings are interesting. Super lenient and understanding. Probably going to take again! (at Wake Forest)
Professor Garrett is such a caring and excellent professor. They took the time to make sure their students understood the assignments. Highly recommend
Very great teacher, explains the material amazingly. She definitely cares about her students and is willing to help them to the best of her ability.

Organized on Bb right away. Liberal abt creative mediums on projects. ALL readings were available as PDFs on Bb! She loves&is knowledgeable on subject
We all laugh in class, esp bc her lectures are basically group discussions.
Cares about all students, not just us disabled ones—you won't fail if you communicate about late work!
She's srsly the best
She is the nicest teacher I've ever had. The assignments are very easy and she is very lenient. I definitely recommend!!

This prof is super dismissive. Won't help you solve issues with classmates. If they cheated/did 0 work on a project, she's gonna blame you instead. She will report you to the dean for that...which doesn't make sense.

So if you want true French snarkiness, take her. Otherwise I recommend the other profs, unless UIC really cuts off language courses
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hard-working, committed to her students, and a straight shooter!
Hard-working, committed to her students, and is a straight shooter!

She is an awesome professor. She's fun and understanding but the best part about her is how she teaches. She makes french easy to learn and comprehend and doesn't make you feel stupid for getting it wrong. She's always willing to help out her students and I really appreciated that. I'd love to have her for french again in the future and I hope I do

Definitely my favorite professor this semester! French is still difficult to learn but the lectures made it much more understandable and Prof. Lapotre has the patience of a saint. She's also fun and a bit quirky, so I'm hoping I get her again for FR 104!

If you do all the work you'll do great in this class, honestly its all about putting in the effort. She's great at getting students to interact that might be a bit more reserved. Very helpful. If you're the type to be on your phone, or laptop during class, then don't bother taking this class. you have to pay attention and engage.
The BEST UIC has to offer. seriously. Outstanding professor, if you're debating on taking her believe me and take her class. I'm hoping to take her again next semester.
She does an amazing job of explaining concepts and makes class enjoyable. Honestly, she's so great--put the work in and you'll be rewarded in the end. I'd take a class of her's again in a heartbeat.

Carly was a really great professor who has a lot of real world French experience. The class has a LOT homework but all language courses do at UIC. So expect to put hours into the class a day. She was really nice when it came to grading exams, pretty lax. Only negative thing was that she would get angry easily; like with phones and talking.

She is a great teacher and she really knows her french. She is always there to help whenever you need it, and she's so Chic. She's an easy grader, LOVED the class, she made it fun with jeopardy games, races between teams, and participation games.
Carly's great. She's chill, intelligent, and explains the material really well. Nothing much else to say, honestly. She's also really attractive.

Fairly overall a pretty good class and excellent, nice professor. Class attendance is highly encouraged along with the fact of participating and completing assignments in the class. She's great so make sure to take her!

I highly recommend her. She's not boring and she makes the class interesting. If something is vague or difficult in class,she'll help explain it in english.You won't regret taking her class. Do the work and attend class, and i assure you, she'll take care of your grade. She's awesome.
Very nice and understanding teacher. If you attend class and do the work that she assigns, you will very easily get an A. There's no cumulative final exam!!

This is honestly one of the busiest classes I've had to take for my senior year. Idk if it's my senioritis but I felt as though there was always something due in this class, like at least three times a week. They use McGraw Hill which I've never been a fan of. The simulation is all throughout the semester and difficult if you don't learn it! So do!

Felipe is a great professor, the capstone class wasn't that hard. Group projects heavy, and you don't get to choose your group, so do your best to work together. My advice is to get ahead of the CapSim simulation, learn the fundamentals because it will be helpful for you when its time to take the end-of-the-semester CompXm exam.

He's pretty nice and understanding. Does his best to be engaging in his lectures, though he doesn't really cover everything that are on the McGraw Hill exams. The class isn't terrible, just can be a bit boring sometimes and there can be a lot of work to do sometimes. Overall would recommend.

I enrolled in this class because it was the only available time slot I had free. The professor is a nice guy, but he grades really tough. If you arrive 5-10 minutes late to class, you will be marked as absent. I'm not the most talkative person, but I do participate in class. Participation is worth 100 points, but I didn't even get half of that.

An incredible professor that is chill and gives great lectures. Definitely the best option for MGMT 495. Attendance makes up 10% of class so it's definitely worth showing up and there is up to 5% extra credit available. Professor provided class time on Thursdays to work on Capstone and group projects. Exams and quizzes are all online.
Easy class if you just do the work on time and follow the rubric.
i love him, he is so amazing! he is a good grader, loves to teach his class, he is very funny and has little dad jokes, his assignments are very clear and easy!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Casey is straight forward and explains things in a way that is easy to understand. He is also extremely clear on grading requirements and provides feedback on a draft before the final submission. So, if you're on top of things and have little to no absences, then this class should be a breeze!

One of the best Engl 161 professors. There's multiple assignments that build on each other but Professor Casey gives you clear feedback on what to improve before the due date of the final draft which makes sure you get the best grade possible. Stay on top of everything, because he doesn't grade final drafts unless you submit a rough draft before.

Professor Casey is a nice guy and very easy grader, but he was not knowledgable enough to teach a Native American Literature class. The books were amazing, but he lacked a lot of cultural knowledge and sensitivities. Said some crazy stuff in class... very white man coded. Would have preferred an actually Native professor to teach the class.
Prof Casey is really great, I highly recommend!

Great teacher! Class consisted of 4 papers, but he provides a lot of feedback on the rough drafts that will help when submitting the final papers. Overall the class is pretty straight forward, as long as you attend class, do the in class writings, and do the 4 papers + rough drafts.

The class was very easy if you follow the syllabus, stick to the readings, and do the in-class writing. The class consisted of 4 papers and in-class writings. The professor gives clear feedback and cares about each student, is very friendly and respectful, and gets straight to the point of what is needed, class is an easy A, attendance is mandatory
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I was intimidated to take ENGL207 because I wasn't an English major like everyone else in my class. He made the class environment warm and nonjudgemental that anyone could participate in our discussions. The novels were solid, and he reviews your papers with you before submitting. As someone with social anxiety, his class was a breath of fresh air.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: The class was easy, you can definitely get a guaranteed A or B if you just do the work. On the other hand the professor himself chooses favorites and it's quite obvious, I had a girl in my class who sat first row not even and play subway surfers for the entire 50minutes
This professor was amazing to have! He seemed genuinely interested in the subject and the students. It was so fun having him, and I would definitely learn more from him if I could!

He is a very nice teacher. He really wants all of his students to succeed. Gives plenty of time to finish a writing project. He provides very good feedback on students rough drafts so they can fix any mistakes before submitting in the final version.

Prof. Casey is a great professor. The course itself is a lot of writing, but if you put in the effort, he will grade you accordingly. He is super available for office hours outside of class and is happy to help students. He genuinely cares about his students and gives really good feedback.

The hardest part about this class is time management, and he gives you SO much time between big assignments to stay on top of it. There was a wide range of vocab abilities and writing experience in my class, and he was able to work with everyone equitably. Go to the lectures and you'll know exactly what's expected of you, overall a super easy class

Professor Casey is a great professor. He's very understanding and humble, and clearly cares a lot about his students. The work in this class is pretty easy, 4 final papers and he has guidelines for everything. He looks at drafts multiple times to ensure u get an A. I got a B because I turned a paper in pretty late, but he still took it! Take him!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Really enjoyed Professor Casey, he is such an understanding teacher. He is also very easy to talk to so don't shy away from asking questions. The beginning of the semester will be a little tuff because of all the heavy readings, however once you're done with that everything else is just writing.

Professor Casey showed a great extent of knowledge for the contents of this class, which resulted in very helpful lectures that really helped me grasp the concept of each activity. He really connects with students, gives great feedback, and is very understanding. I really enjoyed having him as my professor!

By far my favorite class this semester despite English usually being my worst subject. Professor Casey is an incredibly understanding and funny instructor who is easy to communicate with. The workload is pretty light, and he gives good feedback to help you get an A on your writing projects. I definitely recommend taking his class!
An extremely empathetic professor who will look over your rough drafts unlimited times and give you feedback so that you are ensured an A.

I absolutely love professor Casey. He's literally the sweetest professor and actually cares about the mental health of his students. He's funny and the class isn't too lecture heavy. He also checks over essays before we submit final drafts, so it's really easy to get a high grade. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PROFESSOR.

Great professor. The assignments are easy and straightforward. He is willing to check your work before you turn it in so you are guaranteed an A on every project if you go to him beforehand. He is reasonable and understanding when you need accommodation. His feedback is very clear and useful, definitely recommend him as a professor.

Professor Casey is an amazing professor! His class is very easy if you come in to class and submit the rough drafts. He provides valuable advice for your papers, which you should use to receive a good grade on your papers. Otherwise, very chill professor! Highly recommend taking him!

Professor Casey is a really chill person who cares about each and every person's grades and his grading is real easy to understand and to meet his criteria. His class was chill asl, you will be in good hands. Meet your deadlines, always communicate your ideas and use the feedback given to you on papers to get an A in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Casey is superb in giving good feedback. He is also super flexible with any issues you might have for anything. He is not a tough grader and will let you know if you should correct something within an essay / project. You will not regret taking a course with him.

I wish I could give him so many more tags! He is my favorite professor out of 4 straight years! He cared, gave us multiple multiple examples and feedback and always put us first especially being stressed in a pandemic! Although we did many papers it was manageable, and what do you expect! Its an English class!

Wonderful professor who was very understanding of the pandemic circumstances. Often allowed extensions, and his grading criteria was clear. As others have mentioned, infrastructure is such a broad topic that you can choose so many things. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: He is such an amazing professor. Very caring and understanding of our time. Discussions are really interesting because he lets us share our thoughts on the books and is very open with us asking questions. The books read were very interesting and some able to relate to. His instructions for every assignment were clear. Would totally take him again!

Such an amazing professor for first-year students. Lectures were really thorough and informative. Hes extremely caring and conscious to everyones situation regarding the pandemic. Most of the books were incredibly interesting and related to our society today, and the instructions for assignments were very clear. Would definitely take him again!

Professor Casey is by far easily the best English professor at UIC, if you can take his class do it you won't regret it! He is very understanding and is ok with giving extensions, he also provides enough feedback on each draft to improve by at least a full letter grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Casey is a king. He really cares about his student's success. There are four parents due throughout the semester and for each rough draft he gives you thorough advice on ways to improve your paper. If you pay attention in class and complete the papers you are guaranteed a good grade. If you have the chance, definitely take him!!
He gives really good feedback and he is very good at explaining things. He makes himself accessible outside of class. He has a nice personality.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I loved this class. Professor Casey really cares about his students and gives great feedback. Hes not a super tough grader and gives a lot of flexibility on research topics. Also is really understanding and just wants you to succeed. I dont recommend buying the textbook we dont use it in class very often.
Absolutely the most genuine, funny, and relatable teacher i've ever had. If you have the chance to take him for a class, do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very genuine and funny professor who's easy to talk to and really cares about his students succeeding, and the topics that he teaches. For a class I thought I would hate, he's made it a real pleasure.

Professor Casey was wonderful, cares about his students and genuinely wants them to do well and write about something they're passionate about. He's funny and understanding when any issues may arise. One of my favorite profs at UIC.

Super interesting and funny professor, cares a lot about his students. He's very clear on what you need to do to get a good grade and gives amazing feedback and is very easy to talk to. He had us get the FIAW book but rarely used it in class (used approx. 5-6 times). 4 writing projects that weren't that hard and 1 group presentation. Great class!

*2018 Update* His class actually is an easy A. He's literally the most chill grader ever (Just use Grammarly if anything). Gives you a lot of time to do the work (Literally like a month). He's really accessible, funny dude in class, relatable, and understanding of the student life. Probably the most "human" and understanding professor I've ever had
*2018 Update* : His class are not an easy A class anymore.

If you have the chance, TAKE HIM. Graded on 4 term papers and a group project, literally the easiest class i've ever taken but not because the class is easy, rather, he gives super in depth feedback on every paper so you can turn it for a better grade and he genuinely cares about each student. Literally the best english prof at UIC.

Great guy, easy grader but expects you to do work. He is funny and gives great advice and sees every student as an individual. I HIGHLY recommend taking him for 161. His writing topic is Infrastructure, which is very broad so you get many options.
Not much homework. Great lectures.
Great
Great Professor! He is a nice person and cares for students. He gives great feedback on papers and it helps you bring up your grade. We have 2 papers and 1 group project. Chose this professor!

Professor Casey really was awesome to have. His class was challenging, but the valuable feedback he gave and the decent amount of time he allowed students to work on assignments proved that he really cared. He was pretty funny, too. I am so grateful to have had him as my first English professor at UIC.

An amazing professor! He's willing to go far and beyond to help his students. He gives you a chance to write a draft before turning in your final paper and provides good feedback to improve it.  His lectures can a bit a bland at times, but he always makes the class have a good laugh here and there.

Great professor. While the lectures are sometimes a bit dry, he does try and spice it up with some humor here and there. Definitely someone I would not mind striking up a conversation without outside the realm of the class. Be prepared to write quite a few lengthy assignments in his class that is all you are getting graded on. Not much everyday hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Great professor! Textbook was used first half of the semester. 1 grammar group presentation. 1 solo presentation about your research essay. He allows 5 absences before he begins to mark down your grade. Availability outside of class is great - 2 hour office hours before every class. He made the topic of infrastructure interesting.

Lenient attendance policy (allows 5 absences without penalty). Material can be a little dry sometimes, but the new class format helps to build critical skills for writing research papers. Casey is a very approachable person to come in and ask for help from if you ask for it. Do what's on the syllabus with some level of effort and you'll be fine!

He'd really great! The lectures were sometimes boring, but the discussion sections were amazing! No exams at all and no midterm! The papers were super boring, but you get a draft or two before I didn't get an A. Just listen to his feedback on the first drafts and you'll ace the papers. He's really awesome and funny!!!

Had him for a critical theory class. He's pretty laid back, and really into class discussion, which made it less boring. At least when people had something to say. Grading wasn't harsh, he's pretty fair/easy. Many of the assignment give you some leeway in terms of topic as well.
HORRIBLE. His topic is architecture, which is really boring. I had the hardest time trying to write my research paper. He drives you to too many different directions, it gets confusing.
He's pretty chill. class is boring most of the time. As long as you put effort into the class you'll be fine.

He's a really cool professor really laid back. I could be using my phone right in front of him and he wouldn't mind. As long as you do all his assignments and put some effort into them you should get an easy A.

Casey is a nice person. He is interesting to listen to and is not too boring for an English professor. His grading techniques seem a bit random though. It seems like he just assigns random grades to assignments without really reading them.
Good teacher

Cool guy. He'll bend over backward to help you succeed. He's interested in architecture, and the reading materials in this class are often somehow related. I've taken similar classes at other universities; while it's hard to be thrilled about all the writing b/c I've already done it all, as far as these types of classes go, this one's the best.
he was okay, i barely read the book. some days were interesting but other days i felt like he dragged on about some of the material.

Easy A if you do all the papers and assignments for the class. You basically have to read short stories for every class and talk about them (even though I didn't read 3/4 of them). Overall he's a good teacher...funny and smart. Don't bother buying the Writer's Handbook but you will need to buy the book with the short stories.

He's a really cool guy.  Having said that, do not take this class.  Sometimes I think he doesn't want to teach it anymore than I want to be there.  The topic is terrible (The Western Frontier), and the books he chooses are worse.  You do not learn anything in this class, though he makes it easy.  Still, the books are just awful.
Best teacher ever.  He is cool like a stoner, but smart like a nerd.  Awesome guy.  Kind of a wierdo, but really sweet and funny.

Professor Casey is awesome! One of the best at UIC, by far;he not only makes the topic interesting for his students, he is able to seamlessly relate present day topics to what we're reading. To do well, do all the required readings and be prepared to raise your hand and participate in class. Make sure to attend class regularly- attendance is noted.
very good teacher, i dont know what everyone else is talking about. grades fair. and is helpful. very nice compared to other uic teachers.

he was the ta for the class. seemed friendly and helpful enough. i thought he was kind of a harsh grader on the paper, but not so much on the test. pretty much all our learning was done with him, as the professor was impossible
great if you're looking for a 5th grade level class.  prof is condesending and quiet rude if he doesn't like you.  i took this as a requirement.  if you're not required, don't waste your time.
He is a great teacher and understands all his students. I took this course beacuse it was a requirement.
Class was boring and useless. I didnt learn anything that will be helpful this semester
Class is a lot of fun, he's an incredibly EASY teacher, not in the "no work slack off" kind of way but in the "wow!  I learned that and it wasn't so bad!" way.

Very knowledgeable prof! One of my favorite classes at UIC. The reading selections were so interesting/eye-opening. Read and come prepared to participate, ideally with some ideas for contemporary pop-culture examples of what's covered in the readings. We had the best discussions because of this! A bit disorganized, but worth it. I'd take it again
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is disorganized with her TAs and not great at making tests which are a huge majority of your grade. Dr. Celeste is an incredible lecturer when she doesn't fill section time watching videos. We rarely covered readings in class to the depth I feel like was required. She has made me decide to drop my minor in Women & Gender Studies.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She assigns at least 1 reading for every class and will expect that memorized them well because on the test she asks for specific quotes within the excerpts that she would like you to recall. She only will accept APA citation which causes for strict guidelines you will need to follow or they will deduct points. The class is also lecture heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: dropped after first midterm because it was that bad. whoever said freshman do not take i agree. extremely heavy course and TAs will not help. our TA canceled discussion all the time last minute (an hour before once) even though thats the only way to even grasp heavy material. lecture content will not be posted at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you're a freshman, I highly DO NOT recommend it. It's highly disorganized, and there are a TON of readings to do EVERY week. It will make your first semester tough, especially if you lack time management skills and struggle to stick to a study schedule for classes. You have to actually carve out time for this class. Only 2 exams but very hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Will not help you if you need it. Will point you to the TA, who will also not help you
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The expectations she has for students make this class feel like a graduate-level course, not 204 in undergrad. Reading-heavy & doesn't prepare you for exams. She's funny & class discussions are lively, but her grading is unnecessarily tough. I thought this would be a fun class but it's become my most intensive & I'm a senior.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class itself is interesting but she is rude and condescending. I told her I had a question at 1:52 and she cut me off saying she was trying to start class( the class started at 2). She doesn't share her slides which makes it hard to study at home since her lectures are so heavy on the slides. Shes just overall rude.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is clearly passionate and very knowledgeable about the subject she teaches, but instead of treating class as a welcoming experience to pass on knowledge it feels harsh and judgmental. Every single class if you ask for any help or feedback you can expect Dr. Celeste to cut you off mid sentence and speak condescendingly towards you.

Some rate Dr. Celeste negatively, but you get out of her classes what you put into them. If you attend lecture and pay attention, it's easy to get an A. If you think this is a "blow off class", you won't. It's simple. The  readings are short and usually skim-able. Take her classes seriously, they're really interesting when you know what's going on!

Most of people are freshmen and they are taking this class for just general education. This class is the most toughest class I have ever taken. Her test is also hard...there are only few multiple choice, fill in the blank, and there are a lot of short answers like have to related to write from readings or lectures less than five sentences.

Lectures were disorganized, incohesive, and seemingly about random topics. Assigns an absurd amount of reading each week that you are expected to remember specific details of for the class. Takes forever to grade projects and gives vague feedback despite grading harshly. In my experience is condescending in emails. Class isn't worth the headache.

Dr. Celeste is a very nice person and she is very passionate about gender studies; however, the class is quite unorganized in terms of criteria for the bigger assignments and there are way too many readings weekly. I liked the videos and documentaries watched in class but there was way too much expected for a 100 level Gen ed class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Celeste is a very picky grader for her class being a 200 level course!! Do not take her class if you want to be stressed out. She gives back terrible feedback, cannot even comprehend handwriting. She also does not share her slides for some reason, and always is content heavy. I never had a problem with a GWS professor until Dr. Celeste. Sucks.

Avoid any class with her as the professor unless you want to be stressed all of the time. The professor assigns about 3-4 readings a week, 1 film, and lecture material. The study guide that they give you is incredibly unhelpful and consists of maybe 10 words, plus the professor does not share her slides. Save your sanity and avoid this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Celeste assigned 2-3 articles and a film for weekly homework. Besides this heavy homework for an introductory, 100-level class, her tests were nearly impossible to pass. She included on her midterm fill-in-the-blank questions from quotes from lecture or in class speakers. She seemed rude and unprofessional in her lecturing style.

Professor Caliskan is one of the greatest professors to have walked into UIC and has done an amazing job teaching courses like 115 225 and 310. As of 2026 he has become a tough grader but as I understand and have heard from other students, it isn't for no reason. Do the work, attend lectures, study daily and he will make you a better engineer.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is BAD. Took ece 225. The class was 90% test 10% lab. Homework was not graded. He refuses to post any lectures and the lecture are on the expo board. Exam averages were so LOW with no curve. Doesnt post any practice problems or exams he just gets everything from the textbook and tell you to read it. He just does the bare minimum.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The overall grade is 90% for 3 exams. There is no quizzes to help you study. The exams are way harder than any of the lecture and homework problems. I had always felt confident in my studying before each exam, but the exams would have problems I've never seen before.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy going and accessible professor. His lectures are amazing and easy to understand and the way he explains the topic is very clear. His office hours are very useful for one-on-one time and further explanation if necessary. Not to mention he has pretty funny jokes here and there.

This man is simply the goat. Gives online quizzes that u can get up to 105% for, so many opportunities to pass, easy homework with clear solutions, insanely good professor. If u don't take him, ur making a huge mistake.

He is the best professor hands down he just born to teach he is worth the hype he is getting from students.I have taken so many classes with him 115, 225, 310 etc.He explains well.Any fundamental classes you have to take,take it with him cause your other classes build on it. His exams are fair,his homework's teach you a lot.Strict with attendance.

Best professor I ever had. Love his lectures, I took several classes with him and all of them was easy so far. Funny makes a lot of jokes, when i am in his lectures I want to do ECE very motivational person. Take his class if you see his name easy class.

I took him for ECE 340 & 310, and to this day I don't get the excessive praise he receives. In both classes, half the students had a C or worse weeks before the final. He drags out basic concepts but fails to actually prepare you for the exams. Maybe he's considered “the GOAT” for lower-level courses, but that didn't match my experience.
He will make everything clear, all you need to do is follow his steps
Best professor ever!!!!!!!

Probably one of the best professors I've had at UIC. Homework prepares you for quizzes which prepare you for exams. Not a walk in the park but he makes it pretty clear on what you need to know to be successful.
Possibly the greatest to ever do it
Vahe is the best. I would give him one million out of 5 if I could. Took engineering 101 with him cause I don't understand wires and electricity. I still don't, but he's a cool dude .
ECE 115 was very easy with Vahe. He's funny and explains the topics well. If you come to the (optional) lectures and pay attention, its an easy A.
This guy is the goat, he will teach the heck out of you.
Very fun lecture, makes a lot of jokes to keep everyone interested. Lots of extra material and clear solution manuals if needed. Lectures are raunchy!

I had Vahe for both ECE 225 and ECE 412 and he is a professor that wants you to leave class with new knowledge. His sense of humor makes his courses engaging and fun. However, I wish that ECE 412 had a lab section.
Amazing Professor, definitely deserves a raise!!
Literally one of the best professors ever! Prepared you for the exams and provided a bunch of resources to help you pass the class. 5/5 teacher and I hope to take more classes with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing Proffesor

The material is already difficult and then he tricks you on exams. I wasn't expecting this at all. If you do bad on a problem he will say those were straight forward, yet most student get it wrong, and the grade distribution shows it. I dont recommend taking this class.

As all the other comments say, Vahe's just great. Best professor? Sure. Funny? I don't recall a lecture where he didn't crack a joke. I had him for an 8 AM and never missed a lecture because I genuinely liked going to his class.

Caliskan is a fantastic professor. He makes the classes interesting and does a great job teaching the subjects. There are only a handful of homework assignments, the labs are interesting, and the tests are straightforward. He genuinely cares about the success of his students and has a great attitude.

Prof. Vahe is one of the best teachers in the university. The exams and homework are based on his lectures, so make sure you attend them. He's funny and also interesting. I'd take any course if he's teaching it!

Challenging course but as long as you show up to lecture & take notes, you should be fine at the end. Labs are ok. Homework is heavy having around 5 to 8 problems each with multiple parts but he helps guide you to complete a question via lecture or piazza. Do well on the first 3 exams to not take final but drops lowest exam grade if final is taken.
ECE 115 with Professor Caliskan was awesome. It was a challenging course, but all was explained thoroughly. 10/10
Amazing professor. Funny in class but make sure to actually pay attention. The material, while being introductory, is still challenging if you don't take it seriously.
exceptional professor. not much else to say
This guy was literally such a good professor. You are guaranteed to learn in this class, while he is also making it fun. He is JUST A GOD PROFESSOR
Amazing professor, gives lots of resources
Good Morning Professor!
As long as you go to class and do HW's you'll do good in this class.

He gives very good lectures and notes. His teaching archive is the way to go where he posts hw's, tests, and the solutions from previous years. He tells you what's going to be on the test by doing sample problems with different numbers the day before it. As long as you show up to class and do hw's you wouldn't have to worry about this one.

Prof. Caliskan gave good lectures and notes. His teaching archive is the way to go where he uploads all the previous hw's, tests, and their solutions. He tells you what to expect on the tests and does sample problems with different numbers right before the day of the exams. As long as you go to class and do hw's you'll pass with a decent grade.
vahe is the best!!
Perfect way to start my electrical engineering degree. The class always moved at the perfect place. He really did a fantastic job transitioning this class to online.

As long as you do your work and pay attention/ take notes during lectures, you will pass with an A+. Do not wait until the last second to start labs, hw, or quizzes. He gives a lot of time to do them so start early.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This man is a legend. Not only does he teach extremely well but is also just a really good person to talk to. His classes are fairly easy as long as you pay attention and attend class. If you study exams arent too bad and theres generally a curve put on at the end of the course

Super easy class, has lecture capture. If you do 2-3 homework problems per unit you will get at least a B. Vahe is one of the coolest professors I've had and he tries to make everyone do well. The average test scores were 60% but that was weighed down by the people who never went to class once. He also curved at the end so an 84 was an A.
Do Homework if you want to get high grades in Exams. Vahe is good if you talk to him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: easy class

He is one of the best ECE professors at UIC. There is a good amount of homework but if you understand the fundamentals of what he is teaching the homework and exams should be straight forward. He genuinely cares about teaching his students. Also his joke are a great wake to start your day of at 8 AM.

I have taken multiple classes with Prof. Vahe. He is one of my favorite professors. As always he give a good amount of homework but if you have an understanding of the homework you will be set for the exams. Also if you need any extra material to practice he always has previous exams online. He genuinely cares about teaching his students.

Hes honestly a good professor, the only downside is the grading structure. You have three exams, and a lab grade and thats it nothing else to determine your grade. His exams are decent, dont bother studying from past exams because they wont help, he makes a new format each year. Also doesnt give a midterm grade so you dont know your standing.

Professor Vahe is amazing! His lectures are the best. He really cares about his students. All he asks is that you do your work with full integrity. Homeworks will be assigned but it's not for a grade, its for your own benefit and will be very helpful during the exam.

Wonderful professor, extremely smart and funny (dad jokes). Easy grader. You don't need a book for his class, he spends most of the time solving problems during lectures. Similar type of problems would be on exams. It was an easy A for 115 and 225. I'm not sure why he ended up applying such a huge curve. So long as you study you will get an easy A

Best professor ever! He actually care about how you are doing in his class. He makes attending his lectures worth a while. He is HILARIOUS! Just make sure you go to lectures otherwise it will be hard to pass this class.

Took ece115 with him. He explains the material well. He usually post notes online and test are almost always very similar to test from previous semesters which are also available online with solutions.

He is the best professor I have taken yet. He is funny, he is an excellent lecturer, he was able to wake up an 8 am lecture. That being said he doesn't like people who don't show up. He drops your lowest exam grade which is helpful. Make sure you do the HW even though it is not mandatory the exam questions are basically the same thing.

I didn't really find his lecture notes to be helpful, but he uploads them to Blackboard after every lecture. Gives out old exams to study for upcoming exams. He hates people that don't come to class, and then ask for help on piazza later. If he already answered the question in class, he pretty much ignores your question or gives a rude response.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Vahe is one of the best professors I have taken. Very intelligent and a phenomenal lecturer. He drops one exam including the final so make sure you study well before each exam so you can opt out of the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Tests are really easy, sample test will be provided. Try it out at least once and you will get an A

Very good professor, if you show up to class and pay attention you WILL get an A. He knows how to explain problems in simple terms and he tells you what types of problems will be on exams. I did not have much time for this class and slacked the semester and still got a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Hands down best Professor I've ever taken! He Makes difficult concepts very easily understood. He some how makes it super easy to get an A while still making sure you learn a lot. I'm usually a B student with my best effort and his class was an easy A BUT I learned more then I think I ever have in a class! This man has a gift, take him!

One of the best professors I've had. He really knows how to break down the concepts and explain them in a simple and clear way. Also he's so hilarious and really cares about us understanding the concepts. Pay attention in class, do the homeworks, and getting an A should be easy. Take him if you ever get the chance. He's such a great professor.

Enforces learning through fundamentals, rather than getting lost in the details. Excellent instructor that absolutely wants you to pass. Attend class and do the homework. Funny guy that knows how to run a lecture.

There is no reason you should not get an A. Do your part in being a student and he will fulfill his part in teaching. I got a B only cause I started getting sidetracked during the middle. Easily could've gotten an A. He is funny, extremely intelligent and teaches you about the real world as well.  Take classes with him if you can!!

Outstanding class. Humor is his main weapon in making it fun, and his ability to relate concepts for students is endless. Don't cheat in his class or you're gone. HW is easy. Tests are easy. If you get a high enough grade you don't need to take the final. Easy A.
Please take this class!

Great professor, he is very clear but you have to pay attention to every detail. Exams are kind of difficult but if you go to class and study all the extra exercises he gives, you will be fine. He curves generously and his lectures are very interesting and funny. I really liked this class :)

He is a GENIUS! Even though he has a Phd. from MIT, he really knows how to break the subject down for his students to grasp. He also gives amazing advices in general about anything, so definitely show up to his office hours, even if its just to say hey. His exams are very easy if you pay attention in class. Take him for any ECE course!

ECE is a difficult subject, but Vahe make's everything so easy to understand. Class is tough but very fair. Do all the homework, don't skip class, and go to office hours often and you will do really well. One of the best professors I've ever taken. His jokes are really bad most of the time, but has a great personality and a very down to earth guy.

He makes complex concepts seem as easy as middle school math. That said, you HAVE TO study his previous exams and do the homework if you want to do well on the tests.  He posts all solutions to his homework and previous midterms so you have plenty of study material though.   As long as you're not lazy, his class is great.
Hes the best professor ever. His homeworks are tough but are very useful during exams. Very funny and inspirational. His was the only class that i used to attend.
Really Good Professor. I took ECE 115 and although it was a tough class, an A is attainable with work.

Great personality, and extremely friendly, but he doesn't make the subject that clear. He will sometimes rush through parts without a proper explanation or example. He repeatedly says we only need to know three things KCL,KVL, and Ohms Law, but doesn't do a great job at explaining it when we have to apply it to harder problems. His jokes are great.
One of the best professors UIC has. Interns of everything. Extremely friendly and makes the subject really easy to understand for you.

Vahe means thinking, thinking, and thinking. you don't want to think don't even bother taken his class. he encourage you to think differently. I love the way he writes his own HW, and exam.  yes I had a C in his class but you know what that C to me worths more than many A's I got at UIC.  very friendly, I always go to his office for advice.

Vahe taught this class for the first time ever. He is a very smart professor and helpful as well. He seemed a little unprepared to teach the course but as the semester went on he seemed more focused. Exams are easy if you study. Do the HW and go to lab.  I could have gotten a better grade but decided to slack off in his class.
One of the BEST professors that UIC has.

DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE IF YOU WANT TO LEARN SOMETHING. This is one of the hottest course in department because its easiness, but you'll find you learn nothing at all useful, he can explain the same thing for like 5 courses, one sentence is useful out of ten, inefficient, no textbook, disorgnazied, joking everywhere. I dont see why it exists

Vahe is one of the best ECE professors at UIC. His lectures are interesting, and he is very down to earth. He does his best to explain concepts that are difficult and it is very clear that he is passionate about the subject matter that he teaches. His exams can be tricky, but if you pay attention, he shows you all the tricks in class/homework/labs

Best Professor ever. clear, funny, friendly and easy to understand from. You'll love to attend his lectures. His focus is to make you understand not to memorize anything. I hope I can take all of my classes with him. Don't make Kirchhoff angry and take his classes.

Excellent class taught by Vahe! He will teach beyond the equations and how everything applies in the real world. Makes easy quizzes. He could have chosen more difficult problems but he tries to make it simple for everyone. Makes final optional so the people who work hard get to relax and focus on their other classes at the end of the semester
Best teacher in ECE department. If you are lucky enough to get into one of his classes before it fills up, you will learn a lot in all of his classes. If hes teaching a class take it!
Best ECE professor at UIC!!!

Professor Vahe is simply the best professor in the ECE department. I had him for ECE342, ECE410, ECE412, ECE396/397. I also had him as my advisor for my senior design group. This man is so great at teaching that he had a class of 90 students in his 400 level class which is almost unheard of.
Good professor with clear explanation.
If you wish to learn fundamentals or gain fundamental knowledge to solve any relevant problem take his class. I follow one rule at UIC. If coach Vahe teaches a class, you take it!
If you desire learning the subject instead of memorizing then this is the professor for you.

One of the best prof's in the dept. The material is not meant to be easy but his lectures go a long way, so attend every class and be prepared to take good notes for studying. Very easy to talk to if you are having trouble with the material or issues with the course.

This guy is great. He clearly explains everything in the material and will repeat it over an over so that it's ingrained in your brain. He gives you examples about how the material he teaches is used in industry. He is gracious in grading and will follow your work and give you points even if you made a mistake that changed the problem (compute n).

Vahe is a solid dude. Great teacher, fun to talk to. He is a great lecturer too. The book for this class is HORRIBLE though. It is almost useless. The lectures and the book really don't correlate very well. Go to EVERY lecture and take good notes. I skipped some Friday lectures early on and payed dearly for it.
professor made class very challenging although highly recommended

Great teacher.  Highly interested in seeing his students learn as opposed to just passing the tests.  He switches quizes/midterms/finals every semester.  He makes sure to throw in small "tricks" into his midterms so that you can't just memorize formulas.  If you are interested this class should not be hard to pass with a high grade

Please stay away from vahe if you have hard time understanding the material.He goes over his notes and examples very quick. He never repeats quizzes or exams. He really enjoys problems with sketching. Most of his quizzes are tricky.

WOW.Before you take Vahe please review past material. He goes over the material pretty fast. So if your a slowpoke do not take any of his classes. This guy wants you to learn the hard way which is the good way, meaning that you must understand the material in order to pass his class

Only good thing about this guy is that he speaks english. He gives you two options, two exams or quizzes every week.  I suggest you take the two exams instead of the quizzes. Quizzes are fair but tricky....He rambles on with theory, and goes over problems really quick. If your a slow poke, do not take him
He is simply the best!!

Quite possibly the best teacher at UIC across any department. Cares about his students and is willing to help you out. If you put in the time you should have no trouble getting an A or B in the class.
Everyone at UIC should try his courses..
So far the best I have seen at UIC.

Vahe is the BEST ECE professor at UIC hands down.  He quit his higher paying job just to teach students. He loves his job and what he does. He is very helpful and a very reasonable guy.  UIC needs more professors like him.  Take classes with Vahe!!
Great professor, best in the department.

This is my third class with this teacher and I have to say that he is the one of the best UIC has to offer. A very nice guy who really knows his material and how to teach. Has multiple quizzes through out the semester and one final which is optional. Take him!!

He is a very nice teacher who actually cares about his students. He is also a good teacher who keeps his lectures lively. Very knowledgeable although sometimes he has the tendency to get over excited and keeps talking if you go to his office :) All in all very competent professor who has experience in the industry but still knows how to teach

Vahe is a great teacher. He explains things very clearly and his exams are fair. If you don't understand your other subjects, he might actually explain them better! Would love to take some more courses with Vahe, but unfortunately I am graduating soon, so that won't happen. But if you have a chance, I highly recommend this guy!!!

This guy is possibly the best UIC has to offer. This man really cares for his students. there are 3 quizzes; fairly easy. His exams are descent. He gave us a trick problem on one exam but his good excellent teaching more than makes up for it. Homework is optional but you should do it. Has no accent. He is very nice. take ece w/ him. Grades nicely.

Truly an amazing professor. He supported me through difficult personal times and genuinely cares about his students beyond the classroom. He listens and tries to understand your perspective. His pushback isn't personal, he wants you to articulate, stand on, and defend your ideas, because others will challenge them whether you're right or wrong.

This professors was bad ! 

-Wouldn't post the notes 
- treated 100-level course like a 300level course
-you had 3-4 dif readings each week and each week it's more and more readings up to like 10-20 pgs for EACH reading
-This course had a lecture and discussion class (the discussion teachers were so nice and helpful as the professor was not) !

reviews.comment: I took BLST100 which is similar to AAST100 and administers the same credit. In his lectures, he spends half talking about his personal life and the other going over the course material. However, I think the grading is pretty fair because his TA's collaborate on how deserving each student is of their grade. They take quite a while to get grades in.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good professor and good guy in general. Clearly passionate, more lecture than discussion. Reading and engaging makes class better though. Lots of reading though, not quite mandatory but interesting. Attendance not really taken unless it's a lot of absences. Not tough grader, just wants you to try and think critically. Not too many assignments imo.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Nice guy, but lectures can drag on at times. Mid term and final are take homes which are nice, and two papers alongside that. Pretty clear what the class is about and what is graded, just show up, pay attention, and do your work.

My favorite teacher last semester. He is passionate and interested in what he teaches, although sometimes his lectures are a little boring. He's a harsh grader and expects very long papers when he asks for you to turn things in and often includes no page or word count. Do the most you can on the few assignments he assigns and it's a very easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Johnson really cared about his students, The content was really interesting and he encouraged discussion. He is a bit of a tough grader with essays, but not anything too unfair. Overall I recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Caring

reviews.comment: One of my favorites. An intellectual in the truest sense of the word. Unlike much of academia, he engenders original critical thinking with students. He engages with the material in meaningful ways. Puts thought into readings. Discussions are great. His writing and scholarship are also as impressive as his teaching. An absolutely brilliant man.
Hes amazing, kinda seems really strict when you first meet him. Only two exams and two film papers. Honestly didnt read much in the class but still got a B. Just follow his study guides.

Johnson was pretty cool, class was boring most days though. The content was interesting, but his articulation could be better. Attendance isnt really required. He grades kinda tough and is really critical of your writing. Overall an okay dude.

He was one of the few teachers that was really passionate about learning and investing in your education. He was never boring and if anyone found him boring it was because they were not engaged in conversation. Racism, Tech., housing, poverty etc., you name it he taught it and well! He deserves an award He is a wise and woke man. Take Him!

Professor Johnson is an amazing teacher. He is very intelligent and has a lot of passion behind his work. I had him Spring of 2018. He expects you to just have a simple conversation about real life situations. He makes you motivated and think about how you may want to change the world around you. I love him and would be happy to take him again!!

He was a cool professor. Class waas kind of boring, but the content in it was great. We watched movies, tv shows, and music videos that were all connected to the material. I enjoyed the class. Study what he says to study. Do almost every question on study guide you will get an A. He's real chill and with the movement.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He is a great professor that makes this class very interesting. Their is no way you could get anything lower than an A in this class. Not only does he give study guides that covers everything, but he also goes over things in class before the test and exam. Johnson is a cool-cat of professor.

Professor Johnson was great. His lectures and course material were useful throughout the entire class. It's important to go to class to get the main idea of the readings from him. Plenty of students failed to do so and got a C in an easy A class, it's ridiculous. Exams are straight forwardeasy. Grading done by TA's, don't disrespect the TA's!

Was a little boring and dry, but overall cool. The reading wasn't too heavy. There was only a mid term and final, then two writing assignments that were fairly short and easy. If you pay attention, you won't have a hard time. He taught very interesting material and integrated good movies into the course.
Rarely teaches, mostly has TA's do the work for her, very passive aggressive and can be picky, overall not really a professor. She's just there for decoration.

Overall, a pretty easy class. I just felt that Celia was a little passive agressive and got mad at little things. Contrary to what others said, but I felt like she wouldn't want her TA to do anything, even though the TA had really helpful tips. Overall, she was fine but also it's an easy class that only meets 1x a week so it doesn't really matter.
