reviews.comment: She's amazing has different experiences which means she's a good advisor and really want's the best for you.
Doesn't really teach much. She has her TAs do most of the work. She's very clear about her expectations and the work is easy, so it's not hard to get a good grade. Very passive aggressive, though.

Rarely speaks or teaches at all, she instead has other students teach the class for her and gets mad at them for minor mistakes. she mostly just stands in a corner and stares at you with an angry expression on her face and she doesn't even care about the students learning and picks on random students for the smallest things.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very clear about deadlines and is always willing to accommodate scheduling conflicts regarding outside-of-class assignments and group projects.
Great prof

She is a really nice professor. She made astronomy so interesting. For a few weeks we had other professors for Subs.... She is by far my favorite. She uses slides and helps you understand the material. The labs really weren't much fun and were a lot of work... be careful who you choose. But the lectures are great. just study for the tests :D

Professor Gerber lectures from her notes which she posts in advance. It helps to go to class, but online material and online practice quizzes really help to prepare for tests. The test questions are identical to what is in the extra credit online homework and practice tests. Labs were ridiculous but she had nothing to do with those.

Physics 244,2010 Spring semester. She has an accent, but her english is pretty damn good. The class is not that hard, she is a VERY GOOD LECTURER. Topics covered in modern physics are: SPECIAL RELATIVITY,QUANTUM MECHANICS, AND HIGH ENERGY PHYISCS (PARTICLE PHYSICS). SHE GIVES ALOT OF HINTS ABOUT WHAT SHE IS GOING TO PUT ON THE EXAMS!! GO TO CLASS!!

She fell sick through the semester and never returned. We were left to go through the rest of the semester with 3 different subs. Nobody knew what happend to her . The class average on the midterm was 40 out of 100. Its a hard class and the professors were not very helpful.

Good teacher, she is excited about physics, which makes me excited to learn.  Gives old exams problems for practice and teaches her own discussion class.  She has always been very helpful and friendly whenever I asked a question.

I dont think she knows how to teach the damn class.  She does the stupid example in class and when go home do the problem, they are nothing like that.  She does all the easy problems in the class and never does hard problems.  I do the homework online and trying to use the notes but they are not good.  None of the professor at uic cant teach physic
at least she speaks english, but when she talks to you she always sounds angry.

she messed up grading my 2nd midterm...twice!! her practice tests are nothing like the real tests, and she goes off topic and emphasizes the wrong material, while glossing over the important stuff. she always seems frustrated when students ask questions. avoid, avoid, avoid!

Test are nothing like any of the homework problems, sample exams, or lecture problems. She is the course coordinator and not our professor, so we wont know what type of problems she picks, has labs during exam weeks, do not take this class when she is teaching, try to get hofman if possible

Okay, she is a nazi about points!! I missed an A by about 6 points - and she wouldnt give it to me. i went to all the labs, discussions, and lectures. atleast she dint have a horrible attitude...she was nice about it - either way, NO A!~!!

She tries very hard but has some problems explaining the material clearly. She does not solve the problem compeletly. Her examples in the lecture are stright from the book. Take ansari she is much better
she is an excellent techer.  defintely take her class.
I took Professor Villarruel's condensed Native American Lit course during the summer. Everything was easy if you read the books she assigned.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took her at Oakton for Native American Literature. This course fulfils 3 requirements toward a degree. It is a difficult course and will require you to be interested in the subject matter. Don't expect an easy pass. There is a lot of reading and writing. You actually learn something significant.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took her class at Oakton and I really liked the structure of the class - 12 opportunities to write 6 discussion posts, 3 opportunities to write 2 essays, super easy weekly quizzes that take maybe 10 minutes to finish. I wish there was a little more guidance/explanation in her lectures since it was asynchronous, but overall a good class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Cecy is by far one of the best professors I have had during my college career. She is very detailed and clear about the expectations for assignments, so no room is left for misinterpretation. She provided thoughtful feedback and always ensured students were in loop of any updates or deadlines. Dr. Cecy is the best!

She really focuses on learning. Show up, participate, ask questions, and really engage in the material. She doesn't expect you to know everything and won't penalize you for not knowing everything. Really a great, understanding person. Available to meet and chat. Hilarious and personable. I love Cecy!!

Professor Villarruel is by far the best professor I've had. She's got amazing lectures and discussions. Her class was something I looked forward to every time. Put in the effort, you can do great things in her class. Her feedback is always extremely helpful and helps you become a better writer. I highly recommend taking her classes when she teaches

Her Native American Literature class was awesome. The books were very interesting to read. Do not hesitate to take her, she's the best. 4 papers, 1 project, and 3-4 exams. You actually learn something.

There is no reason why you shouldn't get an A in this class if you do the readings(quite short) participate in the discussions, and revise your essays. 1st draft is peer review, 2nd- she comments on what is good,should be fixed,3rd- if you want an A do exactly what she told you to. 4 writing projects (last one is reflective) & final presentation.

There is no way that you won't get an A in this class. All you have to do is show up, turn your essays in on time and revise your papers based on the feedback given. There are a lot of group discussions in this class. Also, there is no textbook, but there is a course packet that you need to buy for this professor which is like $20.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Cecy is absolutely awesome! She is so caring and truly likes being with her students and she also grades your drafts thoroughly, so there is no reason why you shouldn't get anything less than a B.

It is not a hard class if you pay attention in the class and follow her guidelines. She cares about everyone. Grades clearly. Easy to talk with. Really nice teacher! For the writing projects, if you correct the mistakes she pointed out in Draft2, you will get an easy A. I like her a lot.

Cecy was the best teacher I've had at UIC so far. I took her for English 161 and it was by far the best class, considering I hate English. She made the class more enjoyable and really cared about us. When grading papers, she will give you clear feedback. There is no way you can't get an A.

She was really friendly and kind. She has clear grading criteria  even with attendance. She shows all the criteria that she uses during grading. She also gives specific feedback that we need in order to improve. She really cares about her students a lot.

She is not only a great professor, but an amazing person as well. She genuinely cares about each student. She spends a lot of time grading and making sure you get the grade you deserve. If you do the work and put in an effort there is no way you won't get an A.
She is an amazing person and teacher. She truly cares about her students and actually wants us to learn and understand what she teaches.
Cecy is by far one of the best professors at UIC.  She gives great feedback on rough drafts and she honestly cares about her students.

She's amazing; I love her.  Very kind, chill, and wise. She spends a lot of time reading your rough drafts and writing feedback for you to get a better grade. She accepts your writing style as it is, answers emails quickly, and DEFINITELY cares for all her students. SO glad I had her.

Overall, it was a fun class!! The chapters of the course were ordered differently, so you learned the most interesting stuff first and the least interesting stuff at the end. The professor is a lot of fun to talk to during office hours or between lectures! The exams rely heavily on the textbook, so prepare for long chapters...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Really interesting lectures, had a great TA (big shoutout to TA Sterling) and only two papers to do. Only had to pay around 50 dollars for a textbook.

Cervone is a fun, engaging professor who really cares about his students. While the material can be dry at times, his lectures are interesting and he's always happy to answer questions. Attendance is a must, and using tools like Unstuckstudy alongside the textbook will help you succeed. Overall, a solid class!

Great professor! Really chill and funny guys. There are two research papers, that are kinda easy, and the exams are taken online. There is a textbook that should be read because the exams are based off that and there are also online quizzes worth for a completion grade.

A $50 textbook is needed to complete readings and HW. 2 research papers, and you have to participate in experiments or make them up with more papers. It can be tough to stay on track, but he was very understanding. Tests are online, and there are only 4 of them, and experiments mentioned in lectures can sometimes appear. He made this class very fun
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Even though going to lecture wasn't mandatory he made it fun for the people that showed up. Definitely read your textbook because the exams have things from this and lecture. Overall, he's a sweet guy and as a non-psych major I appreciated how he broke the topics down.
Amazing teacher, loved the class would take it again, very informational and light work.

He's such a sweet professor who genuinely looks passionate about his job. He often uses sarcasm in lectures, and he also records and posts his lectures. There are only two papers the entire semester, and you get to choose your topic from the ones provided! I'm a decent writer, I got a 97% on both.

overall awesome guy! he cares alot about mental health. there's easy 1 point assignments due every other week. he wrote the text book so the tests are all on that,make sure to read it! he's a great guy, you don't have to attend lecture but he loves when you do. he cares alot about his students, they need more teachers like him. take him if you can!

I really enjoyed the course. The lectures were sometimes a bit dry though. In his lectures, he focuses a lot on research findings, and I wish he went into greater details about real-life applications of that. He is always willing to answer students' questions. In general, great professor.

Very sweet, chatty, a overall cool grandpa vibe. I would've totally have gotten an A if I had put in more effort. Also, please laugh at his jokes, sir is a comedian and students looking at him with blank stares, it's unfortunate; he tries.

hes soooo funny. like u can tell he cares abt psych and wants to make the class the easiest for his students. even tho attendance is not mandatory pls come to class he loves when ppl actually come and his lectures are so interesting idk how u couldnt go.the grading criteria is a lil confusing but he makes the class rlly fun and actually interesting

It's easy to understand him but he tends to go on long tangents which makes it sometimes hard to pay attention to when he talks. However, all tests were taken online and you don't have to be present in class to take them. Plus attendance isn't mandatory and he always posts lectures so as long as you watch & read the book, easy class.

Really good professor. All the questions in the exam is going to be based on the E book so make sure to read, There are 8 PECs you need to do before the end of the semester and the 2 APSP paper are really easy. You do not have to go to class everyday but it is advisable to get some information from him that might show up in the exams.

super chill actually cares about students and he really cares about your mental health. Cervone knows we have a heavy load of course work and goes the extra step by letting his students take their time and their own pace. i would defiantly recommend him over any other professor also his TA'S are cool and very understanding.
Exams are way Too hard for a 100 level psychology class. Not a blow off for sure. Make sure you attend lecture because the readings are way too broad
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: you dont have to go to the lectures but you must read the textbook as it was written by him and the exams are basically about the material in there. 2 papers assigned that are easy if you follow the rubric

Dr. Cervone is an amazing professor, he is incredibly passionate about teaching everything related to psychology and he really tries to make his lectures interesting by adding a little humor. The grading criteria is very clear. I will say that the lectures are a bit long which can make them a bit boring but it's still a great class!

I only got a C because I forgot to participate in research studies ran by the psychology department (not the class). Tests were easy if you mostly paid attention in lecture and discussion. had to write 2 research papers. Fairly simple with a clear grading criteria.
I loved having Professor Cervone as my first psych professor at UIC. His lectures really aligned with the content of the exams and were enjoyable to attend.

Professor Cervone is charismatic, and funny. Any good adjective describes him in a lecture. All of his exams are also online. There is a lot of reading and memorization in the course. Take note of specific examples he covers in lectures as they will probably come up on an exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Cervone wasn't for me lecture-wise. Most of the content you can find in your books applies to homework and studying for tests. He is very nice as a human and incorporates jokes in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love professor cervone! He tries to incorporate some jokes and light moments in lectures to keep them interesting. I feel really bad when people start to leave like 10 minutes early and he's still talking :/ the homework is really self-explanatory, and he does an excellent job applying topics to real-life scenarios.
Professor is very easy to understand but doesn't respond to emails, unfortunately.
i loved his lectures, he makes them interesting. He is also really respected and nice!! also makes bank lol

I haven't met him personally but the class is really easy and straightforward. Most of the time I would read the book, the exams aren't heavily based off lectures. I would recommend reading the book and annotating/summarizing. It was really easy, would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is so kind.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Decent professor. His level 100 class wasn't difficult but it was a lot of work. You need to read the textbook and the last chapters get more complex with lots of terminologies so you need to take good notes. There are also two research papers but they are extremely easy since the research is already provided. Overall, it was an interesting class.
Very good professor!

Dr. Cervone is honestly the best professor I've ever had. He responds to emails so fast and just really cares about his students. I had a tough first semester and he was so accommodating to my circumstances and made sure I was able to get everything that I need to, completed. I 100% recommend taking any class with him.

His tests are basically verbatim from the book and lecture slides, theres a boatload of homework due essentially every week, its super easy its just time consuming. Hes a little cooky but really knows how to explain/teach. All around a pretty standard class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Super easy A, funny professor. Was worried about readings, but so glad I took this class. Book is very interesting! Exams are great, don't need to memorize random stuff but understand easy concepts. Aced each exam by going to lectures and reading the book for 4-5 hours the day before. Take it to boost your GPA and take your mind off chemistry :)

The class consists of a lot of reading but I found all the readings very interesting. If you miss class, just read the chapter and you wont be confused. The tests are heavily based off the readings and some of the lecture. He is a very funny and caring guy. He's always in his office if you have a concern about the class or your grade. take it!!!

Dr. Cervone is very respected and filled with knowledge. However, the class is heavily focused on the textbook. If you do not read you will most likely not do good on the exams. There are 3 exams and the final. The final is not cumulative. There are also two papers throughout the semester.

Cervone is an average professor. The exams are purely based off of the readings you have to do (it's a lot of reading). Chapters can be very long and the exams may cover material that you weren't expecting. He also has Kahoot pop quizzes every now and then (just for review purposes). I recommend him to people who enjoy reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is funny and very accessible outside of class, but his tests are very hard. He makes you read about 100 pages for every tests and study the notes as well. I did everything to prepare, and yet still got C's on all of his exams. They are very hard and confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: really nice guy but horrible at teaching his own book that he read. going to lecture is useless and doesn't help. only go for attendance. if you wanna pass the test just memorize the textbook honestly

He's really funny and easy going. Not a tough grader. No extra credit is given however he curves tests and the final grade. His lectures are fun to listen to because he is not boring. Homework is not given often but it is easy. Only 2 essays in this whole course! TAKE HIS CLASS!!! Also, he gives pop quizzes during the lecture to take attendance.

Great professor with a great sense of humor. He has a decent name in the field, and he's really good at explaining stuff at this introductory level. If you ask him more complex stuff after class for personal interest he gives great answers! He genuinely cares! Two short papers, non-cumulative final and three other tests.

Interesting class; nice professor. Final isn't cumulative. Curves grades. Long lectures. Constantly refer to the syllabus and keep up with the readings! Exams are specific, multiple choice, and heavily based on the readings and lectures. I recommend him if you're a neurosci/psych major or minor. Easy points: discussions, Kahoots, Launchpad, + PECs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He is a really easy professor to take, but his class is heavily focused on his lectures. Its a long class, and participation somewhat matters because he gives pop quizzes on Kahoot.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I think this teacher was good just boring. A lot of people in the class weren't even paying attention. It is unfair the other teachers drop a test, but he doesn't. $ exams, 2 papers, and online hw. The good thing is at the end of the semester he curved a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cervone is a fascinating lecturer and makes some of the more confusing material easier to understand with his examples. He wrote the book required for class, so he will include lots of that in his exams. 2 papers in this class that are boring to write but not difficult. Lots of extra credit. DO YOUR PECS EARLY.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Cervone is one of the best teachers I've had!! He is so enthusiastic it makes me want to go to class. He is also great at explaining his powerpoint and is a great person!

Best proff I've had in a while! His lectures are very clear and funny. You don't even need to go to class, honestly. There's 4 exams total. Just read the chapters ahead of time and do the self-test questions at the end of each chapter and you'll be fine in the class. There's 2 papers, really easy and short. Need 8 hours participating in studies.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Amazing class with a goofy professor who is passionate about his course in work, lectures were interesting along with the projects and never boring. There is a lot of reading for this course and the textbook will make this course 10x easier.

You will not pass if you don't buy and read his textbook. The exams-4 total- consist of questions heavily from the reading. The chapters are super long so it gets difficult. Lectures can get dry and powerpoints can get chaotic. Overall interesting course but the workload is far too heavy for a 100 level class. Also 2 papers but they were easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Changed my major to psychology because of him! He's passionate, intelligent and funny! He made intro psychology easy and fun to learn. He wrote the textbook and it's easy to read and uses many modern-easy to understand examples. However, I agree that showing up to lecture isn't necessary, as long as you read the book.
His class was very easy. Take it if you need an elective and like learning about yourself. Really recommend him as a professor also.

Prof cervone is really good at what he does. The course consisted of 3 exams which the material comes from lecture and from reading the book. Overall the course is easy as long as you keep up with the work. Exams can be tricky with the wording but as long as you read the book you should be fine!. Highly recommend to take this course with cervone

He is a very entertaining professor, but there were times when he came off quite boring. However, his enthusiasm shows in his teaching. It is a good class if you want to learn something interesting. There are 3 small papers and one big one, which you can ask him for feedback if you send it to him.

He is an understanding professor. He gives clear announcements about due dates and exams. Sometimes he even extends the deadlines. Uses lecture capture for students who don't come. His enthusiasm about class helps you get through the the semester.

Prof. Cervone is really funny. I feel bad that not many students participated during class while he would make little random, relevant jokes. He has this voice that makes you want to listen. He is knows his stuff well. Tests are straightforward. He didn't check attendance, but show up so he knows you care. Talk to him! I never did, so my mistake.

He is all over the place, but its also rather entertaining. Clearly he is very passionate about what he is doing but he really doesn't have a filter at moments. Despite that he was a very nice guy and it was an easy class - 4 exams, 2 papers, discussion points. Have to buy his book though... so that sucks.

This was a difficult class for an introductory psych class. He made everyone buy his own textbook, which was about $200 and was just released this semester. The chapters assigned for each exam were minimum 40 pages each and had a lot of details to remember. Exams are a bit detailed, but sometimes he pulls questions straight from his textbook.

Great professor! He made class interesting, goes on tangents, has dry humor, and is fair. Mandatory attendance for discussion (at least 12 weeks to get full 15 points). Don't read the book? You'll find tests to be harder. 4 exams (not cumulative) and 2 easy applied knowledge papers (3-4 pg), if you go to lecture & read book (he wrote it)  Easy A
Very interesting and easy class. Take good notes, review, understand, and that's it. Class doesn't require much studying time, and it's definitely easy to get a good grade.

he's kinda loud and get off tangent a lot but you have to go to lecture or listen to lecture capture b/c most of his questions on the exams come from lecture and you have to read the book (he wrote it), a lot of work kinda. 3 exams and a paper and some little assignments. you have to work a little hard for the A.

Not a blow off class at all. Don't even bother going to lecture, read the book and make sure to study a lot for the exams because they were hard. Assignments were easy but doesn't really boost your grade. There are only two exams and a final so make sure to do well on exams. Good professor but he rambles a lot.

He is a great professor. He wrote the textbook by himself. We have 3 exams, 3 brief memo (one page writing assignments, 1 paper (5-7) pages, and discussion questions. You don't have to come to class because his lectures are posted online. his tests are easy if you pay attention during the slides, and read the book

He seems to enjoy the topic and is enthusiastic about lecturing the class. However, he talks non-stop so it does get a bit boring. He has easy homework, a paper and kind of hard exams. Make sure to study.

This class was probably the easiest, yet most informative classes I have taken at UIC. He wrote the text, so study it for exams and you will be good. 3 2pp that are easy, and a 5 pg final paper which is manageable. His lectures are very entertaining as well.

He is an amazing professor (One of the best at UIC). He truly cares and motivates his students. It is necessary to read the book and attend lecture because the test are based half and half on each. Studying is not that hard, because the material is interesting. He makes it more appealing by showing videos and examples. He is funny. Great class!
Tests are hard. Go to class.

The class was surprisingly difficult as far as intro courses go; overall not too challenging though. Cervone is pretty funny and easy to listen to, although he can go on tangents that don't facilitate note taking. Be sure to read the text and take notes in lecture and you'll be fine.

Dr. Cervone is one of the best professors I had. He's awesome. He does talk a lot gives unnecessary information once in a while, but his class was still really fun! There are 4 exams, 2 papers, and 8 ours of psych tests you have to take part in. Put some effort into the exams & papers, and you have an A! ATTEND LECTURES and read the book!

Totally would recommend him! He is funny and does his best to keep the class interesting. Some of the T.A's aren't the best but they try to help. Everyone should buy the book for his class. The tests are typically 50-50 (lecture & book). Only 4 tests and two papers. Not necessarily an easy a, you have to put work into the class, but he is awesome.

I have honestly not learned a single thing in his class. He tries to be funny, but is not. He mumbles to himself and he flies through the lecture. His lectures are the worst hour and 15 minutes of my day and I could not wait to be done with this course. He instructs the TAs to do jack crap. He is VERY wordy. He's nice though at least and he tries..

Awesome and amusing professor. Keeps the lectures interesting and informative that isn't straight from the book (despite the tests being based off of book facts/definitions). Rather his lectures elaborate more on the theories given.

exams are so easy. he is funny. he doesnt post powerpoints up, so you gotta take notes. but the exams are basically from the material in the book. you read that, understand it, & you got yourself an A.

One of the best teachers at UIC. This guy knows his stuff, and passes it on amazingly. He really knows how to teach and is very fair. Attend lecture, read, and you will get the A. Plus, hes funny so it makes it easier to pay attention.
He's an easy professor. 4 exams (45-50Q), 2 papers, 8 PECs, and points for coming to discussion. Read the chapters few times and you will get an A. He's nice and helpful. Curved grades at the end.
You dont have to go to lectures but there are test questions that are only in lecture and not in the book..so if you want a good grade you should go to lectures!

This guy is the man- period. He's got a really dry sense of humor, which keeps lectures interesting, even when the subject matter is far from it. Furthermore, he'll address your questions and report back with copious material if he doesn't know the answer. Tests are not a cakewalk, but they are fair. Attend every class and take good notes.

I like Cervone.  The class is long (about 1 hr 15) so at times it can seem dull and drawn out.  Cervone seems like a really nice guy though, and the info he presents is interesting.  You can tell he has a real passion for psych.  His tests are difficult if you miss a lecture or two, so try to go to class. I would probably take his class again.

Very nice guy. Tries to make jokes and are funny at times. You need to read the book, but if you take good notes during lectures, you can pull off an A- on exams. There's a decent curve in the end. Decent class, but really nice prof.

He was a great teacher. I would def recommend him! Class sometimes got boring, but sometimes it was interesting. Tests were pretty easy if you read the book and go to lecture. The book is pretty interesting. You only have 2 research papers that aren't so bad to write. I enjoyed this class and got an A.
don't take him!!!
His jokes are sometimes funny.
don't recommend

If u do not take his class, u r ignorant. He makes fun of himself nd he is so damn hilarious I literally almost peed in my pants. He is the funniest prof at UIC, and he explains things well. Also, he is tooo nice. I got an easy A, he should be an entertainer rather than a prof. TAKE HIM THE BESTTT
He is very enthusiastic about the subject. A great professor.

He really makes his lectures interesting.  The only thing is that he is very disorganized and sometimes it is hard to follow him.  His tests are 50/50 book and lectures.  He wrote the book, so he really knows his stuff! Attendance is not mandatory but go to class if you want to get at least a C.
this guy is boring as hell, you have to read the book because he wrote it, and he didnt give me a B when my grade was 79.44. He kind of sucks.

He is super funny and straight forward with his exams. He uses his own book so he teaches us clearly with the notes we need for the exams. He provides exam previews which is really rare with all the teachers at UIC. He's the best teacher I had at UIC and would suggest ANYONE to take him.

here's the deal... he is really good at explaining things just not good at being organized. You'll have to take alot of notes in his clas and probably have to rewrite them when you leave. You have to go to class cuz aliot of his test are pulled from lectures NOT the book
He is an amazing professor making an otherrwise dull subject interesting. you have to read the book to get higher than a C, and you have to take good lecture notes.
Cervone is the one of the best teachers at UIC, if you had a choice, take him! Although he has outlines on blackboard, you must go to class in order to pass the exams.

Dr. Cervone has been one of the best professors I've had at UIC. He's nice, funny, approachable, and you can tell he really knows the subject matter-- he wrote the book! If you have any questions, he's always glad to talk to you or answer your questions. He's always very clear when it comes to what he wants on a test or essay question.

Such a nice guy, makes jokes, and is very easy to talk to. Read the book/go to class and you'll be fine. Tests are a little hard, but not bad if you study. I don't know why others would complain, he is a great teacher. for those of you who complain because you didn't do so well: GET OFF YOUR BUTT AND STUDY!

Well as a professor he is very medicore.  If you go to class and take notes you should get atleast a B. He is very smart when it comes to exams. If you go to class but, dont read the book ull get a C on the exams. If you read the book but dont go to class you will still get a C. So read the book/attend lectures. One of the niciest professors

Prof Cervone is an exceptional teacher. There are 3 tests and 15 chapters in the book (1 test=5chapters), so you have to read 1 chapter per week (35-40 pages).  Tests are challenging but somewhat easy. going to lecture doesnt guarantee anything. Make sure you read the book and you will get an A in the class for sure. Good teaching skills and funny

This is a class that you need to take notes and read the book to pass the tests. His reviews for the exams are very helpful though. I didnt think it was that bad.  He is very nice but does talk really fast in his lectures and may be dull at times.

Well, The only thing I can give him credit for if you go to class you will stay awake. Everything else about the guy sucks. He makes a seemingly interesting/engaging class seem like a typical Nyberg Biology lecture. The exam average is always a 75. I have stayed up all night once to study for his second exam and recieved a D on it.
Horrible professors. He spent 4 weeks on Freud and there was one question on the exam. He babbles on and on, and nothing makes sense until you read the text. Going to class is pointless.

seems like a really great guy. The first 3 weeks he was very very dry but, towards the second half of the course he is very good. The only problem I had with him was that he scaled down the points.  So if you only got 5 questions wrong on the exam you are down to a B.

Dr. Cervone is great!  If you approach him after class he will talk to you in a polite manner and help you understand.  He is very intelligent and cares about his students.  Be sure to read his book.  He wrote his own book and tests come directly from it. He is even better than the T.A.'s in class!
he's alright. i rarely went to lectures but read the book and got deent grades on the tests. (B's) he rambles and digresses a lot during the lecture tho.

I like Dr. Cervone a lot. He is easily one of my favorite profs I've had thus far at UIC. Mainly because he has a quirky sense of humor and seems like a really nice man. Yes, he does ramble during lecture sometimes but GO TO EVERY LECTURE. There isn't a discussion for this class and he doesn't post all the notes online (just an outline of the notes
He rambles alot, but read the book, and you will be fine.

I admit, this was a hard, tedious and dry class. If you like to understand people's behaviors, take the class. If not, take something else. Dr. Cervone is nice and helpful, though. Just pay a lot of attention in class and ask him if you do not understand anything at all.

Dr. Cervone is a nice, funny, enthusiastic instructor. He was willing to answer some questions people had. Yes, he was a little unclear. But if you stay focused in his class and read the text, you will do alright.
He throws wierd questions on his tests sometimes.  He is ok. I would rather take someone who is a little more clear. Easy to get a C or D in his class.

Professor knew his material. Class was a lil boring but the material covered was interesting.  his exams were multiple choice and have to write a paper as well.  Exams are easy if you read the book.  Overall it was a good class
Class is pretty easy, but his lectures can get boring sometimes.

He is a very enthusiatic professor but his lectures can be a bit boring. He does provide some notes on the overhead during lectures. The tests aren't too bad (all multiple choice). Just read the text and you should do good. Overall the class isn't too bad.
tries hard to make lectures interesting...doesnt work...notes, reading the chapters, and going to class will help on his tests..overall not a bad class

His lectures are extremely boring, but he does know everything there is to know about Personality Psychology.  The reading is essential, I went from a C on the first two tests without any reading, to an A on the last test with reading.  He cowrote the book.  KNOW THE RESEARCH!!!!

His lectures are really boring, but you can tell he really knows the topic well (he wrote the book) and he is enthusiastic about teaching.  Your grade in the class really depends on if you read the book.

I really enjoyed her lectures! She knows you if you come to class and you can tell she appreciates it. Only graded on 4 tests ands 1 is dropped. If you go to class and listen and take notes during the lectures you will easily pass this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is not to terribly difficult. Drops one exam, difficult to get an A if you don't do well the first two exams as they are the easiest, class is worth 160 points and the final is 60 points. You have to review lectures and essentially memorize information.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor who cares about her students. Extra credit is given randomly throughout the semester. This class requires a good amount of time but is soooo worth it with the valuable information learned. VERY RECOMMENDED
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I think she's one of the best professors in the Econ program. She is tough and yeah she hates when people are texting or on their laptops. But she does give you every opportunity to succeed with extra credit. Tests could be frustrating because of the legal minutia. I wanted to learn more about the Financial crisis and valuation. But great teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor was friendly to me, but was very annoying and condescending to the class. Bullied classmates for taking notes on laptops or sending texts. Class itself didn't teach anything useful like real-estate investment valuation, but rather nit-picky contract details and area borders (which are calculated for you irl anyway). Disappointing class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Very enthusiastic teacher. Her exams are pretty hard, but if you go to class and read the book, you will do fine. Her lectures are helpful and she goes over a lot of examples. She also drops the lowest midterm and homework, and just doubles the grade. I did terrible on the first midterm(think F) but on the second midterm, I got a 91%.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Great lecturer. Keeps you engaged. She really wants you to do well. She never comes out of left field. She knows who comes to class and who doesn't. She's very encouraging and always willing to help. Bottom line: she's straight forward, not too much hw, and keeps lectures engaging. She sure loves her coffee!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Cepon is an AMAZING teacher. She has the sweetest personality and wants everyone in class to do well.  She does not take attendance, however, if you do not show up don't expect to get an A... She does give extra credit some days for attendance unannounced. Though grader, however, she does this for a reason. Best teacher I've ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Has great lectures I looked forward to showing up to class. Sometimes attendance will be taken and you will get extra credit. She is very knowledgeable and passionate I look forward to taking another class with her.

Very smart and knowledgeable in all of econ. Going to lectures will either make you or break you. She goes over crucial calculations in class and shows how to solve diff. things. Very enthusiastic- especially about housing market crash. Truely cares about students and pushes you to understand the material. Overall, great prof! Exams are not easy.

She's a very smart teacher and knows the material from experience and in general knows the material really well. She is very energetic for 8a.m. and can become a little annoying, but very picky with how things go in her class like no texting or talking feels like high school again. However she is caring and human, isn't a hard grader. Not so bad
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Pay attention in class and read the online book and you'll be fine. Great teacher that is enthusiastic about a rather difficult subject.

Clear lecturer, but get ready to study. If you go to class she goes over pretty much majority of what will be on the exams. She shows you how to calculate certain things and as for knowing concepts, just read the damn book. If you fail any of the 3 exams, you will most likely not get an A in the class.
Be ready to study or else you will fail. I am a 4.0 GPA student, and this was the first time Ive ever gotten a C on one of the exams. You dont learn much. It is basically all MEMORIZING.

Margie Cepon is by far the best Economics prof i have ever had. She is so detailed and if you go to the lectures you do not have to read the book. For the lectures, she makes power points which are very explanatory. Trust me! If you have the chance of picking her go for it. This is an easy A class if you go to the lectures.

Cepon has a high pitched and annoying voice that wakes you up for this 8am class.  The course consists of plethora of material to study with two exams, two homework assignments and a CUMULATIVE final.  There is a few points extra credit and NO curve. Exams were tough and if you fail one, you will have a hard chance of passing.

This class is very interesting. But the professor makes it hard for no real reason. Over enthusiastic and a little annoying seriously. The exams are hard. The class itself isn't so bad. Attendance isn't mandatory. That's the best part and the homework (only 2 assignments) is super easy.

I've never written any of these reviews for professors but she was so amazing I just felt like I needed to write this. Seriously one of the best professors I've ever had. She's understanding and friendly. She teaches with  such passion. She's seriously one of the best. She keeps students awake for an 8am class (well, all except for one) lol.
Go to class and you'll most likely get am A.

I loved this class. Yeah she's a little enthusiastic for an 8 am, but isn't that what you want? The lectures were super interesting, and I feel like I actually learned useful things. TAKE THIS CLASS. She is super nice, and very concerned for her students. She wants you to do well. The two homeworks aren't hard, she goes over it basically in class.

Incredibly well organized. Lectures are sometimes long, but if you go to class every morning you probably do not need to read most of the assigned readings. Posts all powerpoints before class, but elaborates and explains A LOT during lecture. VERY helpful to bring slides to class and take notes on them. Wrote me a great letter of recommendation.

Professor Cepon likes to be in control and is extremely detail oriented. If you don't do things exactly her way, be ready to lose points or get yelled at. She gets emotional and upset when students are uninterested or don't show up to class. She either talks so quietly that you can't hear her in 2nd row, or she yells really loud. Overall, annoying.
She's wonderful! the best class and the best professor i've taken! the class is not easy, but she makes it so interesting! you will love her! no textbook was really needed if you take o lot of notes

Professor Cepon definitely knows her stuff. Summer Session: 2 Tests, 2 Assignments. Book is not necessary. Uploads power points to blackboard. Attendance is not mandatory but you need to go to do well on the exams. Go to class and study power points and you'll get at least a B easily. Also, she is rather loud so prepare for that.
She is a good professor, but her exams are hard, you have to memorize evrything, even a small detail in the handout to do well for exams. If you can handle it, it will be fine

Very enjoyable class. Attendance is required but not graded. Hardly ever used the book. 2 assignments & 3 tests all straight from her powerpoints and lecture. Her tests are MC, T/F, & short answer(usually the math work she has gone over). She does walk around the class & loves participation. Loved her! Actually learned useful things!

If you have a hard time staying up during 8 AM classes, her voice is bound to keep you awake. Excellent professor. Is honest if she does not know something and gives you great insight on how real estate works in our society.

Best 8am class I've ever taken. Loud, annoying voice, walks all around the room so you will probably not fall asleep. Material is useful for the real world. No tricks on the exams, easy homework, loved it! I was very hesitant to take an 8am especially with the class only 40% full. Lectures are great and filling.

She is awesome, learned plenty. She is very well organized. She gives homework that relate to the course. Exams are great, however you need to attend class in order to pass them. She is a great professor, i wish she would teach other 300 level Econ courses. Take her if you need ECON.
I never showed up for the class. I got an A, but i hated the class. The homework are easy. The test is hell. I think I will stick to my engineering courses.

She is one of the most organized and prepared teacher in the economic department. She knows her stuff and the material is presented crystal clearly through her lectures and power points. Her tests are fair. I highly recommend her.

She is a very good professor. She is extremely hyper, engaging, and knowledgeable. Also class is not mandatory and exams are not that hard. I found this class very helpful. I would recommend this class for any finance or econ major.

Enthusiastic and loves her subject, which makes it that more interesting.  Keeps your attention during class, brings outside speakers to talk about what's going on in the real world. In-class problems are very helpful and are exactly what's on the exam except for a few number changes.  Not much need of the book if you take good notes, uses ppt's.

I did not like her. I was very interested in the material but, if you want to learn something useful she is not the right person to take. Her exams ask you VERY specific questions, so if you want an A then you have to read 100% of the material, I got an A but this class was a pain in the butt. I do not recommend her.

She's nice and helpful and encourages participation but she's just a little bit quirky.She's obsessed with making sure class starts and end exactly on time (a 1 hour 15 min class I mind you), her tests can be challenging but aren't that bad. Her class will keep you pretty entertained.
I LOVED her! she is an amazing teacher. She goes out of her way to make sure her students understand the material. She is my inspiration for majoring in Economics. A++++ :)

Had her for Intro to Real Estate. She is a very good teacher, gave lots of practice problems so that you will understand then before the test. I took it in the summer so it was easier I believe than fall. Less work. Two projects, two tests. EASY!

Had her for both 120 and 371, hands down, the best teacher I've had at UIC--actually made me want to be an econ major. Very helpful, goes out of her way to help students understand the material. Extremely energetic!

She was a wonderful teacher! i understood what she was teaching and i did so well in that class. i got all As on her exams, but her finals are ridiculous! it was hard, i seriously failed that final. so study your butt off for the final, as for everything else, its easy. She makes it fun and energetic. :-)
She is really energetic, and hyped up on coffee a lot of the time, but does care about students and wants them to learn, she is anal on grading though. This person below me is a bit conceited haha

A tremendous teacher with a passion for economics. Economics comes very easy to me since it is so logical so the class was never an issue for me academically but she makes it easy for those who have trouble. She takes great care during lecture to make sure that the concepts are clear and understood. Attend c class and participate and youve got an A
soso teacher
Her lectures are very repetitive and she can be sort of anal grading but the quality is good and she cares.
One of the best professors at UIC. Made sure material was well understood. Extremely helpful and very enthusiastic in class. Her class is a must take!
Great Prof. if u attend her class all the time and listen carefully, u can get an A. interesting class. She likes student discuss with her during the class.

I took this class a year ago. She is really nice, and this class is super easy. She basically goes over everything that will be on the exam in class. She is very willing to make time with any student that needs extra help. She has a lot of energy and tries to make econ exciting.
She is extremely helpful. The class is super easy. She goes through everything that will be on the exam. Most of it was common sense.
No Comments
Don't know what the dyslexic person in the previous review is saying. She's far out there and not really good.

Margie is a great teacher when it came to micro.  She nows whats shes talking about and makes sure the class does as well. Tests and homework aren't tp bad either, she gives out study guides.  Highly recomended!

Do not take this class if you are white or conservative. He is super liberal and will tell you you're wrong if you try to say any other opinion. For a class about diversity, diverse thoughts are not allowed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: No weekly assignments so that's good, but you'll have to write 6 7 page essays
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The only thing he does is lecture, plus the assignment is really hard (six 7 page essays). He's also a tough grader. He encourages you to participate, but sometimes he makes fun of you if you ask a dumb question so it's a little daunting to speak up.
He is a very dry teacher. His lectures put me to sleep. However, the class was not hard and he gives many options to redo papers, so he is a good professor.

Great professor, anyone can get a "good" grade as long as you participate in class and pretend you read the readings. 4 papers DONT write your opinion, just regurgitate the books. if you write them early, you can re-write and his comments r really helpful- regurgitate!! secure an A by visiting him: rly values ppl  that visit him just 2 talk

I've only just started class with Professor Cintron but he is by far one of the most amazing professors I have ever encountered. He was truly helpful and held an entertaining class. You could learn so much from him!

Really caring and smart professor. Knows what he is talking about. Philosophy heavy rhetoric. Bi-weekly response papers. 1 midterm "paper" (responding to questions) and 1 final paper; 10 pages. You must go to class to understand the material. It is dense and challenging but rewarding and relevant to lean. Participation matters.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Well, I don't really know how I can fit what I think of Cintron here but here's the gist. He is incredible at what he does and his teaching approach is very optimal. If you are a science major and want a break from your core classes and don't want to take a weird music or drawing class, take rhetoric!! 100% Prof. Cintron, Hi! :)

Mr. Cintron is excellent. He tries to involve everyone in discussion. He also tries to make complex concepts easy to understand for everyone. He is very nice and open to any opinions. He challenges you but in a good way. There is a midterm take home exam, final paper, and 1 page reading responses scattered throughout the semester.

Most passionate professor I've had in UIC. He's brilliant but makes a conscious effort to walk you through the materials. He understands where most English majors are coming from. This class is a gem and the professor will change your perspective in life. Must take!
Ralph is awesome. You should do the reading, it's important. He is ridiculously smart, but if you make an effort he will facilitate the learning process.

He is a very good professor, hes very helpful during office hours, let him get to know you. Let him understand the way you think and how you can learn from his class. I highly recommend taking his class!
excellent teacher. class was engaging and Cintron is very helpful outside of class.
He's able to listen and converse with all students in class and can make spontaneous dazzling discussions happen in class--rare.

He was very helpful outside of class.  2 papers and a take home midtern.  Very lenient with due dates.  He encourages you to think, but he has no problem putting you on the spot.  He makes sure that everyone contributes to class.  Sometimes he's hard to follow because he is extremely smart and has many difficult but interesting theories.

Frustrating - it was often difficult to figure out what the class had to do with English, and his disinterest in anything approaching traditional literary studies made the whole experience, well, frustrating. Very helpful and accomodating, though.
I echo the first rater: simply AMAZING.  By far the best teacher I have ever had . Smart, engaging, and provacative.  He will make you think . . . literally until your head hurts.
Beyond words. He is just a VERY VERY VERY good teacher.

Nancy Cirillo was the first professor to challenge me to unlock my potential and begin to achieve excellence without  pause. In 10 weeks, we wrote ten 10-page in depth literary analyses. I was pondering ever higher level topics and difficult pieces of literature and synthesizing my thoughts, without a moment to breathe. It was the best of times!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was an absolutely amazing professor, and her class always had very interesting and thought-provoking discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: An absolutely amazing mind. A very tough but fair grader, expects a lot out of students. Sometimes grading criteria is unclear. Get on her good side and you'll be set, as long as you maintain the quality of your work. An joy to have been able to converse and discuss with
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Stay away from her. Do not take her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: if you don't see her during office hours, good luck passing. She only has about 4 papers and then you have 2 presentations. She makes you read a book a week but you don't really have to read. You can google it and as long as you participate in discussion you should be fine. Make sure to constantly see her about your papers though!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is a wonderful teacher and nice to talk with. Sometimes we go on tangents for the whole hour but it is good discussion. Essays are a little long and the response papers are really short. Definitely a subjective grading scale but if you go and talk to her, or participate in class it is a definite A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I took several classes with Mrs Cirillo back in the 1970s.  She remains one of the finest teachers I was ever privileged to  work with.  I'm thrilled that she's still teaching

WORST PROFESSOR EVER! DO NOT AT ANY COST TAKE HER CLASS! This is a clear warning! Literally the worst professor I have ever seen at UIC! Grades your papers at grad level despite the fact that its a freshmen level class. Worst criticizer! Forgets the fact that you sent her papers! Terrible memory and teaching style! Rambs off in class about nonsense

If you're ready for harsh criticism that leaves you in mid-tears.. make sure you take this class! Be forewarned, she may have full blown discussions that take up the whole hour and 15 mins explaining how many terrible writers exist in her class. Instead of actually trying to help you, she may just drown you in her "critical thinking" pool of death.

She is awful. She told our class that "college isn't for some of you and maybe some of you should consider dropping out and taking a year off." She also directly told my friend and I that there is nothing wrong with becoming a barista. She doesn't help at all and is so old and forgetful. Don't expect to get an A unless you are a professional writer

Possibly the BEST teacher I've encountered. She is so passionate about what she teaches. I was concerned when I realized the grades were just based on participation, two papers and a presentation, but if you go to her office hours and ask for help, she'll lead you towards getting an A. She's an amazing woman. Everyone should take  a class of hers.

Really passionate about subject and will teach you to analyze the heck out of the books.Going to talk with her is really nice and interesting.Usually you have to read a book a week(varies from 200-300pgs,youre lucky if only 100pg or intro) and hard grader on papers but office hours will help along with great feedback.Only hw is reading and 2 papers

Dr. Cirillo is a fantastic educator. Her passion on the subjects she teachers (Trans-Atlantic Slave Trade, Australian Founding, etc) is very clear as she is extremely enthusiastic in her lectures. Prepare to work hard in this class and spend many hours on your coursework. Graded homework doesn't exist, but large papers do!
Coolest prof I've ever had... a true intellectual who a lot of us students loved having discussions with. Rate her A+ (Class of '73)

She is a good professor and passionate about what she teaches, which is great. But, she is a very hard grader and has her own system of grading. Going in for office hours will help but will not guarantee an A...

Very helpful, and genuinely cares for students. Sadly, most student don't care enough to listen to what she says. Show interest and see her during office hours and I think u get an A! (at least im hoping for one).But i honestly learned a lot in her class; just pay attention!

How to get an A in her class: 1. Agree with everything she says. Any ideas conflicting with her own will automatically ruin your chances of an A, or 2. become some sort of specialist. Be the religious person or the economist. Be the Greek or Biblical allusion person. Remember, anything else and you will not have any chance of getting the A.
She was an adequate professor.  Her enthusiasm about the material made lectures okay, but I felt she was a hard grader and not very approachable.

She's a great teacher outside of class.  In class she can be a little boring, but give her a chance and she'll teach you about things you never new existed.  Very worthwhile to see her on a one on one basis.
She is a great teacher and really helps to teach you to think critically. Although the lectures were sometimes boring, I always learned alot.
This woman is absolutely amazing! You will learn A LOT!
She's such a wonderful woman, even if you don't have class with her, she's an incredible mentor and advisor.
The class is difficult, but completely worth it if you pay attention and meet with her to discuss problems.  One of the best profs at UIC.  You can definitely get an A if you work at it.
Not the easiest professor, but one that you will learn the most from.

Wouldn't recommend taking if you have accessibility needs. He grades format over content for his assignments, and refuses to explain concepts discussed in class during his office hours, in case you fail to attend. He also does not teach much and usually puts on a movie or expects students to just engage in discussion for the entire class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I usually hate discussion-type classes, but Whan makes them incredibly fun. If you want to skip class, then don't take this class. It's amazing how interesting and fun he makes class. The reading and review assignments are heavy, and you are required to participate in class to pass. Tough grader, but that makes it more fulfilling!

This professor is insanely strict, you have to write everything his way or he will knock you down points. You have to do a weekly 1 page paper, which is really just your thoughts and isn't difficult. The class though is very interesting and we've had good discussions. Like I said the professor is a very tough grader so be cautious of that.

You will get a good understanding of international politics. Especially if you want to understand Donald Trump's foreign policy, you must have him. The class discussion is great and the grading policy is strict but fair.

Strengths: Great Professor, Interesting Movies on Political Leaders, Stimulating Class Discussion 

Weaknesses: Early Morning Class, Tough Grader

It was the only course that made me read, write, and speak up every week. He will really motivate you to do the work. If you don't do well in the early semester, you can recover all lost scores from extra credit opportunities if you have paid close attention to his instructions.

Stay away from him, he does not post grades on blackboard so you don't know your grade until the end of the semester. He is a hard grader and gives 0 on papers until it is done the way he wants it to be. Do not recommend.

Awesome professor! One of the better ones within the dept. I really enjoyed his lectures and class discussions, which are very stimulating. He's a tough grader, but fair with detailed grading guidelines. You will get a lot out of his class if you're willing to do the work.

Every week there was a one page critical review (13 in total), but no midterm. Final was a paper of 10 pages, but the prompts were provided on syllabus. He had opportunities for e.c. but definitely participate because he would bump up on points for final if you had showed engagement. Def take this class if interested in international relations.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you don't want to write essay every other class for homework, do not take this class. Class is very boring and attendance is mandatory. He is also TOUGH GRADER and don't post grade on blackboard so you won't know your grade.

Choi is awesome. His discussion sessions are informative but genuinely funny and entertaining. He also cares about student success and grades fairly though he is a tough grader. Learned tons from his class on how to come up with a research idea and how to write a well-organized paper, he's a great professor, would recommend.

I liked the course materials, highly relevant to current affairs of international security and extremely informative.

I found the students to be inspiring in their engagement with one another.

I learned how to write a first-rate paper for the first time since I entered the school.

He is an ok professor. He is a tough grader and the only thing you do in his class is write, no tests. He doesn't post the grades on blackboard and I went to his office hours he wouldn't let me know my grade for some reason. if you like to write then you'll like his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: The professor does well with what he has. I think he is a bit too hard of a grader, but he is fair and provides good feedback every week. The class can be a lot of work with mandatory attendance, but overall I would take him again because he really cares for his students.

would be the best class if you want to learn how to write an excellent paper. If you hate writing, don't take it since he has a very strict grading policy. You'll receive detailed instructions on writing and grading. If you don't follow them, you'll be penalized as he says - no mercy! Second chance will be given later, though.

If you want to actually be able to speak your opinion, critically think about international relations, and walk away learning anything about INST, I recommend professor Whan. Extremely interesting professor, you will not regret taking his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: It was online. He tried to interact with you rather than leaving you bored. Must have him if you learn something about international security.
Lots of reading but very useful. He cares about how you are doing in class. Must have him.
You will not regret taking his class. Very grounded Professor and wants to see you succeed.
Very nice guy, as long as you show up and do the readings you should have A/B. Highly Recommend.
He has very high standards for your writing assignments and thus gives you very detailed explanations multiple times.
As long as you take his instructions seriously you will do well. He knows how to make you read, discuss and write. You will like his weekly reviews as time goes by.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He is a great professor and he explains well about the past, current and future of Korean politics.
Dont take this class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I loved the way this course was based on discussion rather than long boring lectures. I also loved Professor Choi's stories, which he tied in to the lesson. This course has a good flow and enjoyed it a lot.

The weekly critical review due every week were very helpful to my understanding and learning process. The class discussions were by far my favorite part of the course. I enjoyed participating and debating with students and the professor. Prof. Choi is clearly very knowledgeable, but encourages students to solve their problems, rather than give them

If you follow his very specific writing guidelines that he gives out multiple times throughout semester, you will do well. Near the end of semester, he allows you to redo your old assignments for extra credit. He instantly responds to your emails all the time.

Class is easy. You just have to read a book every week and write a critical review for it. We only have a final paper which had to be 20 pages long. You cant miss class or youll get points deducted. He does try to reason with students and give extra credit so thats good. Hes a nice professor and teach well his lessons.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is extremely specific on how he wants the papers formatted, if the slightest thing is off then he'll dock you quite a few points. If you're out sick he doesn't post on BB that it's different, you're screwed if you miss a class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If I could I would take all my classes with him. His a great teacher everyone in the class puts worth their thoughts and the are more than welcome to voice themselves.

Whan is the bomb. I think he is one of the best professors because he is so genuinely interested in your success. The class is totally discussion-based and he actually listens to what people say and contributes meaningful feedback.

the best teacher i've ever had at uic, really made me look at things from a different perspective on international security. i tell everyone even if they're not poli sci majors that they have to take him, he's that good.

He really cares about whether you're learning. He tries to make you think critically rather than memorize some basic concepts. What I liked most about his course was his discussion was open to any ideas, traditional or unorthodox.
He is extremely helpful and understanding. He's very much willing to work with you about any problems that you may face.

Mr Choi is a stickler for formatting and attendance. But seriously, he should be teaching quant or statistics because that's his area strength. We didn't really cover much actual IR theory in this class. Just the basic concepts you can find in any textbook. His grading was based mostly based on following formatting instructions. Blah.

Whan is probably one of the best pols professors at UIC. Incredibly understanding and down to earth guy. He understands that sometimes you just need to chill, so around the time papers are due you watch movies in class. He throws out Extra credit opportunities all the time so if you're not doing well it's entirely your own fault.
It looks like he will be the best professor whom I have ever had at UIC. His lecture and discussion are very interesting.
Whan is a great and caring professor. His reputation is astounding and he tells you how to do well in class.
easy to show your skills,he is very understanding person if u r not lazy

He's awesome! encourages interaction and is considerate of every1's feelings in class. Mandatory attendance, weekly reading summaries, 3 papers and extra credit movie reviews! no exams!!! He can be slightly difficult when it comes to paper formatting and stuff...but he defenitely gives you second chances... Totally recommend him! TAKE THIS GUY!
He is the best! He does require attendance and debating is a must, but there are no written exams... just 3 papers that he calls take home exams. Recommend him!
the best!!!
