The professor is very nice and cares about his students, however, his exams are hard and he has his "expectations" in terms of how much students should study. In order to do well, you must listen to his lectures closely and write down all of the things he says which aren't clearly stated in the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: People might say that the exams are hard and they're right. But, like most things if you study and understand everything, actually understand the concepts, not superficially, you will do good. Don't skim slides but actually understand them and make connections. Evolution is hard so you have to work for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Chong is such a sweet professor! He is very understanding and genuinely has a real passion for evolution. He goes out of his way to help and answer the questions of students, even at odd hours of the night. His lectures are easy to understand, and every exam question is either pulled straight from slides or was mentioned exactly in lecture.

Professor Chong is super sweet, but the course (specifically tests) are extremely hard. Whole class did terrible on test and he was nice enough to add a 10 pt ec hw to help. I really understood concepts and still don't understand why I did so poorly on tests. Tests are pretty much the only grades aside from 1 pt quizzes which barely boost grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Chong is one of the nicest professors at UIC. He teaches the first half of this Evo/Eco course. Although he is super sweet his tests are impossible. Coming from a straight A student, I understood concepts of the course very well, but out of the two tests in this course, I failed one and got a C on the other. Wouldn't recommend.
Exams are so harder, and he doesnt explain stuff. He just read the slides every time, and in his exam, he asks conceptual questions, which he never explains.

Chong is a really great professor. His lectures are very clear, informative, and to the point. You can be sure that whatever is on the test is on the lecture slides and about what explains in class. He keeps lectures interesting by showing cute/funny videos which also helps when remembering material
Just group discussions. Can be boring at times, but very easy.

This class was very laid-back, and easy to participate in. It was a group discussion each class, where the agenda would change depending on what the students were talking about/interested in. There is a text book, but she teaches it through story telling & examples, and broke down topics enough to understand. Participating gets you more out of it.
Very good class. Take it now. Attendance is mandatory but thats it.

Lecture was really enjoyable, a lot of group discussions, but professor Clayville is extremely kind and caring. You can really tell that she cares about her students, and the work she gives is very reasonable.
Attendance mandatory with 3 free passes. One group presentation at the end based on any topic of your choice. Assigns 2-3 discussion questions every or every other week. Easy A.

Overall, I really enjoyed this course. Discussion topics in class were interesting and current. The book droned on at times, but that is to be expected. I thoroughly enjoyed discussing current events and felt the course was impactful overall. The professor is knowledgeable and open-minded which is a must for this type of course!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is passionate, intellectual, and kind. Some of the assignments don't have clear grading criteria but the class is still an easy A. Lectures are enjoyable. 1 group presentation and other smaller assignments.

Lectures are not as motivating, but the paper assignments are very straightforward as she is a light grader on almost all of them. Just make sure you do the assignments to the best of your ability, turn them in on time, and youll most likely end up with an A.

Overall a very enjoyable class that covered topics relevant to current society as well as their origins. He does a good job of lecturing and also having students insert their input. Two weekly readings that take time. Not an easy blow off gen ed. Make sure to do all the readings since he does pop quiz writings based off the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The topics we covered in the course were extremely interesting and he seems like a great guy but for some people it can be hard to sit in class for over an hour and listen to the same person talk. Don't get me wrong, his lectures are interesting and it's worth it because we only met for twice a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had prof Clarno for SOC225 and BLST207, and he was such an amazing lecturer both times. There are a lot of assigned readings, but they line up with the corresponding lectures, so be sure not to skip out. He is also very caring, approachable, empathetic, and he is someone who cares about current issues. One of my most memorable professors to date.

I took his Policing in Chicago class, one of the best professors I've ever had! He really is such a dope and knowledgable person all around on so many important issues. He is very mindful of cultures, and he never overwhelmed us with work, but really cared about our learning experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, really understands his students. There are no exams, mainly two term papers as well as the weekly papers for the discussion portion of the class. However, he posts two questions about the assigned readings, so read religiously, show up and always have your iclicker handy. Easy class and enjoyable, I would take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really easy class to get an A. HOWEVER, to pre-health students, he is a horrible teacher to prepare for the MCAT. HE DID NOT GO OVER FUNCTIONALISM OR CONFLICT THEORY AT ALL, which are high yield concepts on the MCAT. While his class addresses important issues, this class is pretty much useless for the MCAT.
Weekly papers 1-2 pages. There's two big papers around midterms and finals. Attendance is mandatory for lecture and discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Weekly assignments which are a page long but they are not hard. My TA was super nice even let us leave early if we participated enough. There is no final but there are two papers you must do. Again, not very hard. As long as you do the weekly assignments and go to lecture because he does take attendance with iClickers. Easy A if you go to class!

TA grades everything, mine happened to hate me. Long class, first time I ever received a C in college, and it was this class. Not an easy gen-ed and not worth working for. DO NOT take it if you do not have to.

Took this class to balance my pre-med course load because it seemed super easy. I soon quickly realized that wasn't the case. If you have a passion for sociology this class is ok but he makes you actually put in work to get an A. Lots of writing and TA's are picky graders. Lots of reading but not essential to do all of it. Not easy for a gen-ed.

Dr. Clarno was a nice professor but, he does not grade anything other than one assignment. The whole semester depends on you GSI and how they grade. The lecture portion wasn't bad at all. Discussions are what matter the most. Only two papers and 8 assignments. Not a blow off class.

This class was very interesting, however, the grading is done my the TAs. The TAs can be tough graders. Going to office hours of your TAs is very important to do well on assignments. Overall, this class was a great way to understand the world issues through a sociological viewpoint.
Lots of readings! Weekly one page journals with a midterm and final paper.  Uses iclicker for lectures so attendance is mandatory for those points.
Awrsome class, very interesting. TA is a hard grader though.

Great professor. Great reading assignments. He was inspirational. He definitely taught me to be mindful of the social activism and issues occuring around me. The course was very interesting and thought provoking. Very easy. No Exams No Final. I would take it again! One of my best classes here at UIC so far.

Too much work for a 100 level class and gen ed. If you right something that opposes his a opinion, he will make you feel like you're wrong. There aren't any exams. But there are 2 papers that you really need to write well to get a good grade. Weekly exercises that are harshly graded. Take anyone else!
I love this guy. The readings he assigned are mostly boring, but the class is super interesting. He's also a total cutie :D
Definitely recommend this class, extremely easy. The professor is engaging and makes his notes and lecture interesting.

the TAs were very picky and tough graders. Class is really boring. Really long articles that you gotta read weekly and write 1 pg summaries on. It's not too much work but it's super boring and lots of reading. And he takes attendance, and asks random i-clicker questions that are worth points.

Great professor! Very outgoing and down to earth.  No textbook is required.  All readings are posted on BB. No exams but there are random quizzes based on the readings assigned.  Definitely recommend him.
Makes it interesting!

I am pre-med student and this was a gen ed for me. I didn't do any of the readings he assigned. I went to 8/15 discussions (you get 1 point for going to discussion). Got a 74% on his midterm and a B on the final paper. 25/32 on clicker points. Did all the weekly assignments. With my poor effort, I got a B.

This class is a lot of work for a 100 level class but it is definitely worth it. The class is LIFE CHANGING. I strongly recommend taking it bc it will change ur outlook on life. Professor Clarno is a cool guy, lectures are entertaining. Just make sure to have readings done bc his iclicker questions only count points if u answer correctly.

Decided to take this class based on reviews on here.  I am taking it credit/no credit and figured it wouldn't be too challenging.  This class is ALOT of work (~60pgs reading each week+1pg response+view 1hr film sometimes) -Very time consuming, assumes students will be familiar with all readings (theres like 50 of them)-did i mention, TIME CONSUMING
Awesome guy, one of the best professors I've had @ UIC... If your interested in taking a Soc class, take it with him!
I absolutely Love Him. One of the Best Soc teacher I've had.

If you have a chance to take SOC 490 or anything with Clarno... DO IT! He is extremely helpful & managed to make some drier sociological topics interesting. He was extremely understanding and more than patient with some people. Moreover, Clarno's accent and mannerisms are entertaining. Super nice guy!
Andy is a GREAT Professor! He's extremely nice, great teacher, and passionate about what he does. just hard grading depending on ur TA. I'd def take another class with him!
Class was an easy A. No tests, just a few papers which were simple. Clarno's a good speaker.

Fun, although the material can get fairly dry.  Depending on your TA you can get away without doing any of the readings, although you need them for the papers.  Readings range 35-65 pages per week on Blackboard.  Short 1 pg. assignments every 2-3 weeks.  Discussion grade based largely off participation.
passionate professor, as stated by others there are no exams or textbooks, just readings on blackboard and papers..pretty easy class..like others said as well some TAs suck

Andy's a great professor. There are no books, no tests, no midterm or final. He assigns two 3-5 page papers for the entire semester. He takes attendance with the iClickers though so make sure you go... All iClicker questions are based on the readings he posts on Blackboard so read those if you want the points! Some TA's suck :/ but you'll be fine!
Prof Clarno's class is interesting and its a pretty easy A. No tests so yea hes awesome

He is a really nice laid back professor. There were no tests in this class.  Your grade was more depended on class attendance/participation.  Also, there were four short 3-4 page assigned throughout the semester that are not to difficult.  I highly recommend everyone to take a class that he teaches you wont regret it.

This man is down-to-earth and a great teacher. He actually cares about his students and you can easily tell how passionate he is about what he teaches. I was so interested in all his lectures. And, he was very funny as well and dresses so nice. He talks kind of "hood," which I find makes him genuine to his personality.

I had him for BA111, not sure if he's new to teaching this class but he can't teach. Teaches you absolutely nothing in class, everything that you do learn in class will NOT be on the test. Oh and don't think you can study for this class at all either, he doesn't provide anything practice. He offers more preparation for the midterms than the final

Professor Ross is very authentic. He is pretty realistic with the work and lets you know what information is useful in the real world, and he's very easy-going with his class. As long as you show up and do the bare minimum work, you'll pass his class pretty easily.

The professor is so chill and fun to talk to. The lectures are easy to follow, and he doesn't assign a lot of homework. He will take the time to help you out if needed and the work he explains is helpful in the real world.

I absolutely loved this prof, hes so engaging and hes really not afraid to call himself out when he makes a mistake. I absolutely recommend taking his class for BA101! He is pretty lenient but dont take that for granted.

Because of the nature of BA 101, your experience varies depending on the people in your class. Overall, super easy A, just turn in the work and it's basically guaranteed. Ross is the most chill and understanding professor you'll ever have. In a presentation from a guest speaker, he walked up to my friends and I and showed us a meme on his phone.
Professor Ross was very monotone and just read off the slides basically. There is basically nothing to learn in this class besides taking it to fulfill your seminar requirement.

Mr. Ross was a good professor. His class was very easy and only require a small amount of effort. If you just show up to class, you will get an A. The assingments were simple and require the bare minimun for them. He was very honest in his teaching and would even say that some of the curriculum being taught isn't useful lol. Overall, good professor

She mixes unhealthy personal opinions with the course material and shows total arrogance toward opposing views. This was my worst class experience; she stops students from asking questions if they don't say what she wants to hear and refuses to answer whenever there's any conflict.
I really enjoyed class with this professor. She's a great professor but doing the readings is essential to passing the class. I would take a class with her again.

Although POLS120 is heavy on readings that aren't the easiest, Prof. Moruzzi's manner of teaching barely makes you feel the difficulty of the course. 4 essay-type exams that are easy As if you read your text and follow her lectures. Only thing's that she does struggle with time management a bit and doesn't really discuss all the readings in detail.

She is an amazing Professor I enjoyed her class so much and look forward to taking another one of her classes. She keeps her lectures interesting and her exams and prompts are clear, overall easy to understand and she is a great professor.

reviews.comment: Professor Moruzzi really cares about her students and wants to make sure everyone succeeds in this class. Her lectures are really detailed which is always helpful. Her overall style of teaching is great and she's very thoughtful.
Too easy. She need to update your old lecture notes...

Professor Moruzzi is amazing! She is so sweet and caring. Her lectures are filled with so much passion for the subject and books we read. She gives great feedback on essays and wants to see students improve. Also very flexible and understanding if you're struggling and accessible outside of class. I would 10/10 take this class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Really interesting class, and she and the TAs are cool. reviews.comment: Professor Moruzzi is one of my favorite professors at UIC. she's tough and you can tell the most important thing to her is that you show growth. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is awesome! She is caring, understanding and always there for the students. A lot of reading, but if you go to her she will help you out. Her tests are not that hard if you study for them! But you need to go to class

Absolutely the best professor @ UIC. Understands exactly how to explain and teach complex philosophical and political arguments to students. It pleasure having her as a professor for the past two semesters

She was really helpful and clear during class. There are some books that you have to read on your own but the class is easy.  She is an easy grader because you just have to write what she said in class to get an A on the tests.

Moruzzi is excellent. She is has a way to fold everything back into the topic. She offers opportunities to challenge your conceptions and expand your understanding. She is a fantastic professor. Her courses have a heavy writing emphasis but her feedback is valuable. You develop your ability to critically write. Love Morruzzi!

Moruzzi has an awesome attitude towards her students.  Lectures remained on topic and she discussed at length what she wanted for exams.  Books were a bit dry.  Although she says she would rather you read the books than attend lecture, I was able to get the required information from lecture. 2 Exams and 1 paper. First time she taught, so may change
Excellent class.  I loved coming to her class everyday because she really enjoyed the texts.  Tests were easy as long as you payed attention and took notes in your book!

Moruzzi is the bomb.  THe reading lists for her class are amazing.  Be prepared to participate in discussions, since that is the bulk of class time.  Sometimes I felt that her lectures were too obvious, but, as in most GWS classes, there was a wide range of backgrounds and knowledge in class.

I highly recommend taking a course with Professor Moruzzi. She's extremely helpful when you're writing papers and her class discussions are awesome! She's very clear in her lectures and allows for creative discussion and interpretation. Overall, she's a great professor!

His lectures can get pretty boring, but he goes slowly and makes sure everyone understands everything. The class is mainly graded on the 3 exams, aside from the weekly homework assignments. Overall, he's a good professor and his class is pretty easy.

Doesn't consider any requests or excuses or emergencies. Attendance system is crazy he randomly takes attendance at any point of the class mostly in the first minute of the class. Exams are easy as hell but lectures are too boring and he is really non cooperative.

Professor Clack is amazing! When looking at professors for ECON 221 this semester, he didn't have a rating so I just took a chance and I'm glad I did. I was warned 221 would be hard but Prof. Clack has made it enjoyable. Lectures are great and he is very helpful. Workload isn't tedious either. I recommend Professor Clack for anyone taking 221!
Worst professor I have ever had

Prof Decoteau's class was lecture heavy and I honestly learned more with the TA's. The papers omg... the papers were always difficult to write in terms of the content. Make sure you takes notes of the lectures and discussions (they really help with papers!). She's really thoughtful and flexible!

reviews.comment: Never updated the class on important things and she grades tough. Honestly avoid any classes w her if you can
The only problem w the class is that she is a tough grader but she doesnt assign a lot of assignments. Its 3 long essays that are most of your grade and reflections

READ A LOT !!!!!!!!!!!! She doesn't do power-point so be prepare to do your own notes and sometimes she goes through her lectures quickly. Her TA for Spring 12 simply sucked!!!!! She was no helped at all honestly.. If your a shy person like me you might have difficulty in this course but you will learn from this professor.. I would take her again

Get ready to read....A LOT. She can at times go reallyyyy fast and its insane the amount of reading you will have....but since the class is required for Sociology majors, you have to deal with it. There are 3 papers - not bad, but they can be hard. The TA was awesome, she helped a lot

Intensive course, but she is very willing to work with you if you seek her help. Must pay attention to everything said in class in order to pass. She gives you all readings, no need for a text book! Very upbeat and nice. Creates a positive classroom environment
No Comments

He is a genius. Excellent professor. He can teach physics to anyone. His DVDs are exceptionally helpful in visualizing different concepts.

He allows you to use a cheat sheet for the exam. TO GET A GOOD GRADE IN THIS CLASS. Buy his CD and come Exam time he posts exam topics on the website. He is an interesting guy. physics is nearly impossible but if you study a good amount you will do well. He makes class entertaining.
Ask him for help if you are confused, he is very helpful, and in general a really cool guy!
Great prof, very enthusiastic and quite a character. Entertaining and educational!
UIC is lucky to have him. He's one of the best prof I've ever had. EXTREMELY clear and helpful. If you go to his lectures he will prepare you for an "A" on every exam.

he was probably the querkiest man ive ever met but he knows physics realy well. he is very deliberate in lecture and you need to practice problems from the book and his cd like crazy to do well he puts a huge curve on all the tests which is cool. he tries to teach you how to think a certain way and i highly suggest you adopt his way cause it works
He really knows how to teach. The class is by not easy but he makes it very enjoyable. I got a lot out of his lectures and from the cd he produces.  Great guy!

This professor is one of the best physics teacher you'll ever have. He has a desire to teach his students and have them do well. His dedication to the class motivated me to attend all his lectures and pass his exams. Although the material is difficult, he teaches it extremely well.
If you can get into his section do it.  Learning is fun with Halliwell.
Dr. Halliwell is an awesome professor! He truly is the best physics professor at UIC!!! His exams were not too difficult, but the final was intense. I never thought I would like physics but now I do.

I had halliwel for the summer session and he was great! Physics at UIC is hard! avoid if possible and try to take at community college. If thats not possible, Halliwell is a good teacher. He is very enthusiastic and loves to teach. awful teacher.should focus on providing examples-rather than deriving useless equations.avoid taking this class-take it at community college if you want to save your gpa

HE MAKES THIS CLASS HARDER THAN IT NEEDS TO BE.  HEY BUDDY, THIS IS COLLEGE PHYISCS, WE NEED IT FOR MED SCHOOL. WE ARENT GOING OUT THERE TO BECOME ROCKET SCIENTISTS. MAKES TESTS IMPOSSIBLE.  AVOID PHYSICS AT UIC PERIOD BECAUSE HE MAKES ALL THE TESTS.  HORRIBLE HORRIBLE CLASS
Great teacher.  Believe what when he says "I WILL HELP YOU".  It's your choice to respond.  Hard course but enjoyed every day of it.

He's absolutely great... the best professor I've had at UIC.  Don't believe the guys who moan and complain about him.  They're just looking for an excuse for ther own failings.  They're losers and probably got (and deserved) a "D".

people that are bashing halliwell are just upset at their grade. half his tests are homework problems and he solves similar problems IN CLASS. he's one of the few professors that is actually enthusiastic about teaching. its no walk in the park but its no orgo2
great

i was always scared of physics ,but this professor created interest in me and am thinking of changing my major to physics

horrible horrible teacher horrible horrible horrible teacher. WORST PROFESSOR EVER PERIOD. I DARE ANYBODY TO TAKE IT IF THEY WANT TO DO BAD

totally antisocial, intimidating and unhelpful. Tough class and lectures hit you with a ton of information but hey thats physics.  Its no secret that you're going to have to put in a lot of work outside of class, and that is especially true with Halliwell.   He is helpful in office hours, don't be intimidated, he does care and wants to help.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!!!!!!! I MEAN THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER. He is the kind of professor that truly motivates his students and changes their lives for the better.

best professor trust me

This class is a lot of work, and the Prof. can be confusing to understand at times.

This class is lecture heavy, will take up the whole class talking. There is usually a 500-750 word assignment due every week that's based on 3 options that he assigns. 8-10 page final paper due at the end of the semester but, he made it exempt for students who earned an A average on the weekly assignments (don't know if he does it every semester)
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: A 10-page paper is assigned towards the end of the semester; however, if you manage to keep your grade at 90% or above, you will be exempt :) There are weekly papers and readings. This class is a bit too challenging for a 100-level course. But as long as you stay on top of your work, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Had to read about 20-30 pgs a week to make a mini 2-3 page essay and apart from that the professor had a google doc titled "notes", wasn't much help. he pasted so many documents on there got to the point of 600 pgs. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took him for Nahua Studies, amazing class. He provided all the readings needed, doesn't usually mark attendance but attending is highly recommended. reviews.comment: If you hate writing don't take this class. Had to write a 10 page reflection paper, so unnecessary for a 100 level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Don't get me wrong, he's a nice guy in person and the class is pretty interesting but when it comes to assignments and readings its just way too unreasonable. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Roa is helpful and understanding. I took a class on Mixtec culture, and I had no interest and it's quite boring, however he clearly explains every concept. reviews.comment: Love Him!!! He is very helpful and allows for rewrites and restests as long as you show him effort. His goals are for you to understand the theories, not memorize textbook answers. Extremely open about his past experiences and how there relate to material.

He is the cutest person ever. HE goes out of his way to be nice to students. Also, I hate colonial literature, and Colon was never that exciting. Thumbs up, we love him. (Class is tough, though!)
Monotonous and repetitive.  Material was interesting, the professor was not.
No Comments

This class is hard asl and he does not even curve the class!
It is a hard class but that's college and it's a high level course so duh you have to work hard. He is helpful and wants you to know the information. Just study and ask questions!
Favorite Professor ever

Never finishes a lecture, therefore it's in your own hands to learn the rest of the material and show up to the lab quizzes and pass them to the best of your ability. Great expert for the field of exercise physiology. 5/5 but being a professor and teaching a 1.5/5. The material is alot and he does want to help as best as he can but he grades too hard. He is very technical so be very accurate in answering his essays.

Terrible professor, gives doctorate level/lecture heavy content for a 4 credit hour undergrad class. Not good at explaining things, lots of terms to memorize that are extremely brief in class and very messy/unorganized lectures. Hardest class and worst professor in major for sure
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Horswill is a genius but his standard is very high. The toughest professor I had so far. His exams are tough and he grades really strict. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I would say Professor Horswill is a decent Professor. However, like what the person said below, his grading method on his Exams are unclear. reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable and teaches in an engaging way. Encourages group discussion but doesn't expect it. He cares deeply about topics and connects it to current events.

Great speaker. Awesome examples.

Professor Stovall is the best professor at UIC. You will never get bored attending lectures. He makes the lectures very entertaining as well as informational. His passion and dedication for the topic of education for minority students made this course enjoyable. I actually took Stovall's class when I was in high school for dual enrollment credit.The course was around educational  social justice and it was one of the best classes of my life. I now attend U of I in Champaign going into my senior year and I have yet to meet a professor who speaks with the passion and diction that David Stovall has!

I'm currently in Stovall's class. He is very entertaining and holds a short discussion that gets the group talking. He discusses topics that aren't advertised about today's educational system. Nice & Extremely Attractive

One of the coolest laid back teachers I've had at UIC. 3 papers and a research paper is all he does. Very flexible with due dates except research paper. I didnt buy the book but used an online version to write one paper. I recommend his class

He was an amazing professor. Really cares about his students. final was a presentation and mid term was a quiz

He made the class very interesting. Actually really liked going to his classes. Straight forward about assignments and how to pass. As long as you do the assignments you will pass. DEFINETLY should take his class.

Chill + Funny Professor. Assignments include presentations, quizzes, memos, resumes, Cover letters, and an in-class exercise. The final was just a writing assignment.  Attendance is sometimes counted and not.
Very simple class. Most stuff taught was common sense. No complaints.

Professor Andrews is great at what he does. Every class is engaging and easy to follow; there are not many assignments, so it is also easy to manage. I'd recommend his class to any business major filling the BA 200 requirement.
Great guy, his managerial communication course is pretty easy and straight forward. He is kind, caring and interacts with all his students.
This class is entirely lecture based. There is no homework. 3 exams all online but proctored. As long as you review the slides before the exams you should be good.

easiest class ever, just consists of 3 exams and 1 extra credit plus attendance. She is super nice and passionate about her job, her lectures are interesting and she tries to engage. A really good elective to easily pass.

Dr Kolar enjoys teaching, and you can tell because of the energy she puts into her lectures. She always tries to make lectures fun and loves to hear students' opinions on certain topics. The most responsible and friendly professor I've ever met! She's always willing to assist students to get whatever they need

reviews.comment: Not an easy class, but very helpful during office hours. The class is very well organized which makes it easier to succeede.

Favorite and Best professor by far. In the beginning I wasn't thrilled about Structural but now I totally do. She makes the tough subject simple and easy. Come to class and participate and you will do well :)
My favorite Prof and the best person I know.

Professor didem is awesome had 301 this semester. She is very helpful, very nice and at this point VERY pregnant. she is often available and always willing to answer questions. definitely come to class, she doesnt take attendance but knows who comes.

Rather unorganized and does not seem interested in actually teaching the class.  Her English is terrible, making the class even more difficult than it should be.  Find another professor for this course if possible.

I will say time and time again that Professor Daemicke is the best professor and truly wants you to learn. She lays out clear expectations for the quiz and what to study for. The lab work is completely manageable with the lecture portion. Best Professor!

Lots of studying is required to pass but her grading policies are VERY generous and she even hosts review sessions every week. Truly an amazing professor and person who wishes to see students succeed.

Great professor! The content we learned was not by any means easy, but she somehow made it so much easier to understand. You can tell she loves teaching and wants her students to succeed. Lots of opportunities for E.C. as well! The only thing I was not a fan of was the group project, but it was not too bad. Definitely take her class if you can!
One of the best professors I've ever had. She clearly is very passionate about what she teaches but doesn't get lost in the details. I highly recommend taking BIO-343 with her if possible.

She is by far the greatest professor that UIC has to offer. Everything was so perfectly set up for our success. She was so understanding and helped fix any situation if one did arise. You can tell that she loves her job, and for that, I will be eternally grateful to have met her. If I could, I would only take her classes.
Best professor I've had at UIC. She's very easy to understand and very willing to help out. As long as you keep up with the content you'll be good.

Wonderful professor. I would love to take Professor Alex again. There are so many resources to succeed, and as long as you take advantage and push yourself, you are set up to succeed. Truly enjoyed biology because of Dr. Daemicke.

What a kind and caring human being! Prof Alex has helped me fall in love with biology. I feel fortunate to have had her and hope to have her again as a professor. She wants you to succeed so if you put the effort in you will genuinely learn and get the grade you want.

Such a good, genuine professor. She wants you to pass. Does review sessions and is a good person at heart. Very understanding and willing to help. Labs were fine and not too tedious. TAs were good. I highly recommend having her as your professor if you have a chance to. Great professor!

Such a nice professor I'm ngl its literally impossible to fail this class like I rarely attended lecture or studied and I still got a good grade. There are so many opportunities to improve your grade. Also all the quizzes are multiple choice, anddd the final is optional, she is too good to us

There is no better professor at UIC, her lectures are fun and engaging. Her exams are fair, and provides resources to study. Not much homework, and all her lectures are recorded. Came into the semester hating biology, left loving it.
she's so sweet bro and genuinely passionate about bio and she teaches things so well honestly just put effort into ur studies and u can do good.

Prof Alex is AMAZING!!! by far one of the kindest and most caring porfessors i have come across. Shes great. hands down one of my favorite profs of all time.
Love queen Daemicke shes the best its hard not to get an A with her

Professor Alex is so accommodating, gives out EC assignments every unit, always accessible. She hosts reviews almost every week. Studying is needed to pass, review after EVERY class.

My favorite instructor in undergrad. It is evident she loves teaching and she always tries to acknowledge the students' perspective. I love her use of drawing activities to help students learn physiological mechanism. This is something I hope to continue to do in graduate school. Her class has helped me become a better at applying content to life.

her exams cover a lot so stay on top of the work but this class is super great! she gives out extra credit, does weekly review zoom meetings, and is super accessible outside of class. the group projects kind of suck because they are random groups, but still super doable.

I've never had an instructor help me grow more as a student. If you're planning on going to graduate school you'll definitely benefit taking her class. She help you become better at thinking critically and her passion for the material is infectious!
Best prof I've had by far. If you can fit one of her classes into your schedule before graduating you should consider yourself to be lucky. She is very caring and positive.
I love this professor!!!! She wants you to pass!! She gives extra credit per unit and exams are based off lectures! She wants you to succeed! I would 100000% recommend this professor!!!!

She's great and wants you to pass although it may feel like a heavy load sometimes. You're hit with a lot of information in the lectures but she posts practice quizzes and weekly outlines that focus on the information you need to know, 100% do them bc that is your key to a good grade in the class. Lots of extra credit. Overall, I recommend her fs.

Professor Daemicke is a wonderful teacher, and it's very obvious how much she cares for her students and wants them to succeed. Her office hours are always fun and informative. SHE IS THE BEST!!! I absolutely love her, I would take all her classes if I could go back to undergrad. She is an amazing teacher, she actually cares about her students and she makes lectures so much fun! I was actual

Prof. Daemicke is truly one of the better professors at UIC. She is so caring and understanding. Her exams, for me, were very difficult. However, because of all the other assignments and e.c opportunities scoring well in this class in not impossible.

Prof Daemicke is probably the one of the best professors I had, what she says in lecture is very important for the quizzes. She also balanced the Animal Comparison Assignments, Knowledge Checks, and Quizzes very well so that there is cushion for your grades. Highly Reccomend!

Prof is super nice but be prepared for an information-dense PowerPoint. The best strat is to look at slides before class so you'll know what to look for during lecture. Mind-mapping notes is handy. The lab is relatively easy and if you need help you can ask your TA. Be sure to utilize her EC assignment opportunities. (one per each unit)

Daemicke was amazing. She makes it easy to pass the class, attendance isn't mandatory especially since she records her lectures. As long as you take good notes of what she talks about you will be fine. The labs are also pretty easy to pass just make sure you do alright. Her study guides are also useful.

This is the best professor at UIC! Her exams are tough, but take your notes and follow her lectures and you will be good! Her office hours were also super helpful and she is so sweet and caring. She explains every topic in such an easy manner and I would 100% retake her. 2 group projects and 5 exams including the final (1-2 are dropped).
This professor wants you to pass! She always posts resources to watch/learn. There are also Zoom reviews and you can attend or watch the recordings.

One of the best professors at UIC! She cares so much about what she is teaching and especially cares for her students. I love going to her office hours and just having a conversation with her about anatomy content or just life! Her lectures are never boring. Going to lectures and reviewing can ensure you understand the content. She's the best!

Professor Daemicke made the transition to college easier. She wants everybody to succeed, and will help you get to where you want. There's extra credit after every test, on top of only 4 quizzes plus an optional final. If you'
re taking BIOS110, I would suggest Professor Daemicke

Daemicke is such an underrated teacher! If you truly want to pass this class with an A and put in effort you will get there. Other teachers go much more into detail while this course is more general!

The best prof I've ever had. Her calling it teaching and you'll find that you start looking forward to her lectures. She is fun and cares deeply for her students. I wish she taught more courses in the department.

She made me love the sciences again! I had a really bad experience with Chemistry and Chemistry professors at this university but Prof. Daemicke is really passionate about her job and she genuinely cares about her students. I would have loved to take her again if I could!

Daemicke inspired me to get into healthcare again. She's knowledgeable and approachable. Have review session, record her lectures, tech savvy, and honestly very passionate. She made lessons real world scenario and make sure she have extra credit opportunity for her students.

Best professor ever!! Professor Daemicke is seriously so smart. You can tell she is passionate about her job and what she does, helped me learn a lot! Her slides are interesting, and she gives examples outside of them and answers everyones q's. easy extra credit every unit, no hw, 4 quizzes plus optional final, dropped lowest lab grade. TAKE HER!!

She is a literal ray of sunshine in this swamp. I don't really need biology nor was I studying a lot, and still ended up with a B (could've gotten A if I took the final). The final is optional btw. I didn't go to lectures because they are recorded and attendance isn't tracked. Assignments and knowledge checks are easy. Exams are multiple-choice.

I am not a science major so I came in with very little pre-req knowledge so I definitely struggled quite a bit with the content, however she has easily made me the most interested in science in my entire life. The grade weights are extremely favorable to the students(exams are worth 30% TOTAL). Make sure you take advantage of her review sessions.

Alex Daemicke is, in my opinion, a good lecturer.  She respects her students, and responds to their concerns reguarding her class and the material that she presents.  She is concerned when people might have problems, and is readily available to give them aid in their attempts to solve those problems.  In my opinion, a good teacher and person.

Prof Daemicke is the best teacher I have had in college. She helps you learn the information not just to know it for the quizzes but for the long term like grad school. She cares for her students and it's pretty apparent that she loves her job. She makes you smile a lot :)

It has been a semester since I took Professor Daemicke and now having a new set of courses I come to realize how rare she is in not only making hard information a lot easier to understand but also in how much she cares about her students. She has your back and is very approachable if you have any questions about the content or need advice.

Professor Daemicke was one of the best professors I've had throughout these four years. Her passion for the subject is apparent and she always makes sure we know exactly what she is talking about. Overall, they way Professor Daemicke explained and broke down complex topics into easy and relatable ones was amazing. Her way of explaining made it easy for me to understand and absorb information. She also was always available to answer any questions I had and was extremely kind and understanding

Professor Daemicke is one of my favorite professors at UIC! Her lecture slides are detailed, and she is always open to answering questions after class and during office hours. She also offers extra credit, which gives your grade a boost!

If you're taking BIOS110, get Prof. Daemicke as your instructor! It's obvious that she's very passionate about biology and she is wonderful at explaining the multiple biology concepts presented during class. She always comes with a positive attitude. She cares about all of her students and wants to know more about them. A+ professor!

She is super enthusiastic about teaching her subject and makes you want to attend lectures every day. An excellent option to take for bio 110 and always makes herself available for office hours. She keeps her content straight forward and is generous with extra credit. If you are struggling she is always willing to help! I hope to have her again.

professor Daemicke explain stuff too fast but she helps but sometime you won't understand. I regret taking this class. The assignment are very hard. The best option for BIOS 110. Shes very kind and encourages everyone to go to her for help. Shes also very good at breaking down tough lectures into simple concepts. Overall a lovely professor to be taught by and will definitely take her other classes.

It is clear that this professor is passionate about teaching. Even though there is a lot of content to keep up with, as long as you put in the effort you will be fine. The lectures are easy to follow and the professor always makes them fun and engaging. The quizzes are also easy and are only based on the things covered in the lecture.

Although the classes are content heavy, Professor Daemicke is always here to help. She will go out of her way to help you in any way she can!! I would 1000000% recommend her for any incoming freshmen because her BIG lectures feel like a small classroom. She asks questions, is interactive and always has the best attitude every day.

Class is hard as she gives out too much material and expects us to know and understand by the time we take the quizzes and knowledge checks. I thought this class was going to be alright since all the reviews said that they got As and would take her again, but I realized they took this class online. It's not anymore. I have an A but I'll get a B.

I took BIOS 343 with Professor Daemicke in Fall 2021 and she is one of the best professors I had during my time at UIC. She is so nice and was always helpful. I enjoyed this class and if I had the opportunity to take another class with Professor Daemicke I would definitely do it.

Professor Daemicke is my favorite teacher. She continues to show her passion to teach students. I really want to thank her for being the first teacher in my life where I genuinely felt on the same level as and not inferior.
Her lectures are nice and she gives out extra credit. I scored Bs on all the exams and ended with an A take her.

The professor's lectures are super interesting. You can tell she cares a lot about the topics she teaches, and I think that makes a huge difference! Professor Daemicke is very knowledgable and she made the concepts fun and engaging. She was always open for questions and her powerpoint lectures were easy to follow and understand.

Instructor was receptive to feedback that students provided during the course and maintained constant communication which I found extremely helpful. I thought that the structure of the course material and the resources provided to us helped with understanding the more complicated parts of the course.

Professor Daemicke is so great, she is honestly one of the greatest teachers at UIC. I have a good grade, a high B,  in the class I would only say that quizzes can be unclear on what to study and how to apply it conceptually. I enjoy the content given but I find it difficult to make it applicable to study and how we are supposed to study

Professor Daemicke is one of the only good profs in the bios department at uic she is extremely caring and loves teaching and wants to see you succeed and offers some extra credit ! Would take again in a heart beat

I loved the way Professor Daemicke taught this course, she was always enthusiastic coming to class and was fair when grading. She was extremely passionate and cared about the students. Lectures were designed to help you succeed. I really loved this course!

Best Professor youll ever take! Professor Daemicke is extremely caring and loves to connect with her students. If you ever need help, shes always available to you. Best Professor youll ever take! Professor Daemicke is extremely caring and loves to connect with her students. If you ever need help, shes always available to you. I came to most drop-in hours and review sessions and did really well in the class because of her! She is passionate in her teaching and is extremely patient! Definitely worth taking!

Professor Daemicke is by far the best professor I had during my time at UIC! I wish she taught all of my Biology courses. Sweet, cute, funny, fun, and understanding. No exams; weekly quizzes + KCs not too hard but challenging enough and prepares for grad school. Great lectures and helpful slides. Some busy work but not too bad overall.

Professor Daemicke is one of best Bio teachers at UIC. Her lectures and slides are easy to understand and well organized. Her quizzes are different that others profs. Prof. Daemicke is amazing! Take her, you won't regret it. She is so enthusiastic about the material so her class is really refreshing and engaging when so many of my other classes are online. Prof Daemicke is the only professor that seems energetic about the material that she teaches! Alex is literally the best thing since slice bread. She has been the highlight of my semester so far. Alex is understanding, wonderful and should be tenured. I ENJOYED this class so very much. Thank you for all you do :)

She was hands down the best instructor I've ever had. Explains really really well, cares about her students, makes sure everybody understands, welcoming to questions and doesn't mind repeating information if asked to. She is great at clarifying and simplifying concepts. A real gem.

Through the midst of the crazy and scary, I was glad to be able to sign in to Professor Daemicke's class and actually enjoy a zoom meeting for once. She made learning fun and I honestly wished more teachers cared as much as she does for your students and material.

I really liked how the Prof Daemicke took out so much time to help us learn. She is also very passionate about this subject and loves teaching, making the class more interesting. She's one of the few professors that justifies the obnoxious cost of college.

This professor, hands down, is the best professor I have taken during my time at UIC. It is evident that she cares about her students and about their education. Professor Daemicke's class has helped me immensely in deciding what I wanted to do after my four years of undergrad. There aren't many instructors out there like her.
Good choice for this class. Wish the lectures were a bit more dense than pretty, but a good choice definitely! You will have no problems.

Bios 343 was the best bio class I took. It is very interesting. Dr. Daemicke cares a lot about students and very very passionate about teaching you and actually understand. I am probably not the only one who says this, SHE IS AWESOME! She makes the best out of hard times like these and for us students, it means the world to us. So please continue to be awesome! It means the world to me that there are professors like her out there.

I truly appreciate, with my entire heart, all the patience and understanding that she generously give me. I learned so much from Prof Daemicke and will be cherishing my notes from this class as I continue into med school!

Professor can be a bit rude at times, one time I said hi to her and she just rolled her eyes and walked away. I was perplexed and cried, but it's all good tho. Just make sure to study and do all the HW!! Don't give up guys!!

PLEASE take this course with her

Professor Daemicke is hands down the most caring and kind professor at Uic. Her class is tough but she wants everyone to succeed no matter what it takes. Prof Daemicke is extremely understanding and cares for her students! She is not any professor that just wants to throw material at students rather she wants you to understand and learn. Professor Daemicke is amazing. Her lectures are filled with diagrams and pictures and she explains them all well. She holds multiple drop in hours and review sessions to help students. She is a very fair grader and you will learn a lot in her class to help on exams such as the MCAT and others. Totally recommend this class to anyone at UIC in BIO.

Dr. Daemicke is phenomenal! She is the nicest teacher I have had at UIC so far, and she really cares about the students. She's very knowledgeable, approachable, and kind, and her class makes me enjoy biology again.

Professor Daemicke is a WONDERFUL teacher. She makes bio so fun! Lots of lecture slides but she makes everything understandable. She most DEFINITELY cares about her students. Professor Daemicke is a wonderful teacher! I feel like every students mental health improves whenever they have professor Daemicke as a prof and attend her class. She can help students achieve their goals by simply just being herself and thats what so amazing about having her as a professor.

I believe that Professor Daemicke is one of the best professors Ive ever had. She does a great job with communicating information via slides and explaining things in simple terms verbally. Im glad to have shared the semester with her this year

Best teacher I've had at UIC. She has been so understanding during this time we've been learning online. I've never been in a class where the teacher really takes to heart student needs. What an amazing educator! I wish I could take more classes with Daemicke and more instructors taught like her. I feel like I've not only learned a lot in her class, but also become a better learner. The best teacher I have ever had in my entire learning career. Her care for students is incredible and you can tell she loves what she does. However, she challenges you reasonably and knows how to make you learn. To do well I suggest knowing all the assignments you need, do all extra credit, go to office hours & STUDY FOR QUIZZES, they're hard.

Quizzes are a little challenging but if you study the slides and take good notes from the lectures they shouldn't be that bad. The TA's might make a few grading errors just be sure to check your graded work. Its not a blow-off class

Yeah, she's great. Very friendly and of course knowledgeable about her field. Some professors give off a weird vibe about questions and can make you feel stupid for asking, this is the complete opposite of what Daemicke does. Tests aren't easy, but she gives study guide assignments that help.

BIOS 343 is a content-heavy class but Professor Daemicke made this class very interesting so she made it fun to learn it all. Her exams are tricky in the sense that if you truly don't understand the content, you won't get the scenarios she creates for exams. Nonetheless, she is very helpful during office hours and is such a caring professor.
If you are taking a bio class and Daemicke is an option, TAKE HER! She is truly an amazing teacher and I highly highly highly recommend her! You won't regret it.

Mrs. Daemicke is hands-down the best professor that I have had here at UIC. She is amazing and made my two semesters of A&P enjoyable. She truly really cares about her students and is very passionate when it comes to teaching.

Professor Daemicke is absolutely brilliant! She is incredibly enthusiastic and passionate about the course material. Her caring is inspiring. It is clear that she loves her job, and she wants myself and my classmates to learn and have fun learning about anatomy and physiology. Truly an outstanding professor!
This class has helped me learn a lot about the human body and Mrs Deamicke's attitude towards the subject has helped me look forward to learning this material.
Professor Daemicke really worked with all the students to help us all understand the content. She slowed things down in areas that were more difficult. She also offered extra study hours!

What a fun instructor! Going into A&P I must admit I was a bit nervous because I heard about how hard it was, and while this semester was tough Mrs. Daemicke made me want to come to class every week. I couldn't help but to grow a new found love for the human body with her enthusiastic teaching! I can't wait to take her next semester

I have no clue what the number courses are about, but I took her for BA 420, and she was the literal best. Despite the course being almost 3 hours long, it honestly goes by so fast with her. She had genuine care for all of us and did her best to ensure none of us were left behind. I would take her over and over and over if I genuinely could.
HORRIBLE TEACHER

She's the sweetest! She cares for you, she makes sure you understand the content by having interactive lectures and if you struggle with anything else she will try and help our guide you. Had dialogue and BA, wish she could be my professor for all classes. Participate and try your best, she appreciates effort.
She cares just enough where it's annoying. She didn't like the class clown. I didn't love the class but it was easy.
This is the worst grader i have seen in my life

Such a sweet professor! Always looked forward to her class. Even though it was 2 hours long, we would actively be engaging with the class and it went by fairly quick. If you turn everything in, and try your best on the presentations it's an easy A! She cares for her students and is understanding if you have a valid reason to turn something in late.
Very nice professor. Definitely take her if you want a A in this class.

reviews.comment: She's super sweet and the homework is not too difficult. She's going to make the class get up for some improv activities, just follow along even if it seems silly. There are multiple presentations, a few being impromptu, but as long as you do your best, you'll get an A.

Dr. Dingeldein was a great professor! She enjoys the content she teaches. Dr. D doesn't assign any unit tests, but I gained more knowledge in this class than in most classes I've taken that do have frequent tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: My absolute favorite teacher at UIC, she is very knowledgeable and does an amazing job of teaching regardless of what level you are entering at. Take the class ! :)

Fairly easy class as long as you do what you're supposed to. Participation matters HEAVILY with tons of discussion and a semester-long group project. reviews.comment: Very easy class, just be prepared to read and answer questions. Homework policy is reasonable. Note taking heavy.

Dr D runs a pretty tight ship. She is well-read and very articulate.Tough grader but still fair. The 2 papers in the class are VITAL. Got B- on the 1st paper. Uphill battle to get raise grade to A. reviews.comment: When I took this course it was RELS295, history of early Christianity. I really liked this class, professor was very good, not too heavy workload. She seemed very knowledgeable about the subject she was teaching, and I feel like I learned quite a bit. She seemed to legitimately care how people in the class were feeling, and I would take again.

Professor D is amazing. She has such passion for what she teaches. Grades are based primarily off 3 essays, a few quizzes, and participation. Participation is a HUGE chunk of your grade, so be sure to express your thoughts in her class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She is one of the best professors period! Her love an passion for the subject is extraordinary. She makes the class super engaging and fun. There are only 3 papers, a couple of quizzes and some small activities here and there. Second time taking her!

Great professor for Gen Ed. She makes class engaging and thought provoking. She wants people to learn something worthwhile. Class based on participation/attendance, outlines, and 2 papers. reviews.comment: Dr.D is one of the best professors I have had at UIC. This was my first CST class and she made me enjoy every last piece of it. She is so nice, and so caring. There are hardly any words to describe her. If you need an easy class, take her for any CST or RELS class you need.

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've ever encountered. If you have a chance, do yourself a favor and take a class with her.

Dr D. is simply the best! This has seriously been my favorite class here. Her lectures are as interesting and fun as they are informative. She is so nice and helpful, and cares so much about her students. She is truly an expert on the topics she lectures on. I 100% recommend people take this class, an absolute must take!

This course is a refreshing departure from a typical religious studies class.  Dr. D fosters a dialogue that challenges preconceived notions and allows for some interesting mental aerobics.  If time permitted, I would take this class again just for fun.

Gets political.... I don't think it's appropriate for a religions professor to express her opinion on the president, VP or republican party during almost every single class. The content is not hard and quite enjoyable, easy class but as I said she made me feel uncomfortable many times in class and I did not appreciate that.

reviews.comment: Amazing Teacher!

LOVED this class! Dr. D is an amazing professor! Very passionate about what she is teaching. No exams. One paper (learning portfolio) for the final. The midterm is just feedback about the class, which is extra credit. There are Blackboard discussions and long readings, but the readings were helpful and meaningful. Impossible to not do well.

LOVE Dr. D, she is an amazing lecturerperson. I had her for RELS 100 as well, and one of the reasons I decided to take 101 was because she was teaching it. She is extremely helpful and super easy to talk to. She knows what she's talking about and knows how to teach it.  Definitely take any class she's teaching!!!

Such an amazing Professor!! Very inspirational, there for his students, encourages to students to chase their dreams, Please take him if you can! I'm sad I'll be graduating next semester so I won't be able to take him again he only teaches in the fall :(
At all my years taking classes at UIC Mel Diaz has probably been the best professor I've had. Expect Good and Honest feedback on all your presentations.

Professor Diaz was one of the best professors I've had at UIC. He genuinely cares about each and every one of his students and makes sure he prepares his students for success. He always made sure to incorporate personal experiences into his lectures as an example. The course load was manageable but prepared to speak in front of the class.

Lectures seem to be based off of generic slides from the online text book, but he incorporates his real life experiences and gives you his honest take on what he thinks about certain aspects of the course content. He engages with students and challenges them to be vocal and confident. This class was not what I expected - in a GOOD way

Professor Diaz makes class comfortable and easy to participate in. There's no pressure to always have the right answer—it's more about getting involved and learning as you go. The class is really interactive, and if you show up and engage, it's an easy A.

Dr. Niebylski is extremely knowledgeable and engaging. Just do the readings, think about them honestly. She's personable and wants you to succeed and will adjust syllabus to fit where the students are at. if you have a hard time analyzing works, I would recommend taking notes. Would totally take her class again. (Class i took not a selected option)

This is for SPAN-192. It's a Spanish class taught in English about Latin American horror literature. Coming from someone who doesn't even read for fun, this was my favorite class and I LOVED the assigned stories. Professor Niebylski is knowledgeable and breaks down the readings with extreme detail. Come to class having done the assigned readings.

No surprises on the content, it's well reflected on slides, readings, quizzes and tests and definitely manageable. Keeps you sharp, would take again.

Professor Niebylski is kind, very knowledgeable in what she does, and provided resources/advice throughout the course that could benefit us in our future careers. There are 3 exams and a few pop quizzes, which can be challenging, but if you study and understand the material, you'll be fine. If I could take another class with her, I would!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Dianna is kind, supportive, and truly cares about her students. Her class is pretty challenging, so it's important to take notes, participate, and stay focused. The course is not an overload of vocabulary, and instead is focused on seeing what students are able to come up with. As a non-heritage speaker, the structure was intimidating at first, but you can really see your skills grow exponentially with time. If you are willing to ask questions and reach out to the professor for help, you'll learn a lot!

Professor Niebylski is a great professor. The class had rigorous content but she did a great job at explaining the concepts. If you want to pass, you have to show up, pay close attention, and put in the effort. The class was mostly based on exam and quiz grades, with some assignments. She is a tough grader but the feedback was very helpful.

Professor Niebylski was an amazing professor, she is funny, caring, and really wants you to learn. As long as you pay attention you will pass! Definitely participate, she gives 10 points extra credit at the end of the semester if you participate. If you are interested in learning about spanish to english translation, she the the perfect professor!

She is a really intelligent person and I learned a lot from her. She really knows what she is talking about. Three writing assignments, midterm and final exam and small group work. Professor Dianna was a great professor. She always made sure to make time for her students & to explain anything we didn't understand. She was a demanding professor, but if you want to learn then that's how a professor should be. Participation is how she knows her students understand the material. She's not a mind reader. I have learned a lot from the material that she has assigned and from her. I would gladly take her again in a heartbeat.
She was a bad professor. The only good thing was her grade inflation, that is a 50% is a C. Still the unnecessary class discussions in lectures should never be necessary.

Worst Spanish class and professor ever! Because of this, I no longer want to major in Spanish. Her TA was no help at all. She needs to go! The person who reviewed her earlier is a liar! She complains that not everyone participates, yet she keeps asking insanely difficult discussion questions that nobody has the answer to. Professor Danns is easily one of the best professors I have had the pleasure of experiencing. She fostered an environment that made majority of the class feel comfortable talking. As long as you make it to a majority of class meetings, you should make it through with a good grade.

She really cares about her students and is  giving a lot to teach. I enjoyed the class, would recommend it if you are okay with discipline and constructive criticism. Please save yourself and do not EVER take a course with her. She is extremely difficult and frustrating and will teach you nothing at all. Her class literally gave me panic attacks.

So if you're okay with not knowing if you'll get an A, B, or C feel free
Participation matters with Diana, but often only in her own way. Prepare to adjust, and prepare to compromise.

Dianna is such a nice and caring woman, but make sure you work hard in her class, because with her, art is no joke. She is very good at constructive criticism, and will often give you the freedom to work with the medium and the style you want to. She values innovative and unfamiliar forms of art.
She is very involved in helping her students and challenges us in a good way!

Shes a crappy bookmaker and so she makes everyone in all of her classes make books for her so that she can steal students ideas. If you want a class that is full of pretentious nonsense, taught by a crazy person, that will teach you nothing and take your art practice nowhere, take any of her classes.

Dianna was a nice teacher, but she was a hard grader, in my opinion. It was "either her way or the highway." If you didn't do a drawing like she requested, she'd lower your grade. She was very critical of your work. She was very understanding though, if you were sick, and she was willing to help you. Would I take her again though? I don't think so.

Frid is a decent teacher. She's friendly and offers help/feedback when you need it. Expect the workload to be medium to heavy, but she gives you extra time in class to work. Lectures can be dull and I didn't learn much from them. Never had quizzes or tests, but she will note the amount of effort put on projects and homework.

Not the greatest class in the world, but it's passable. The biggest problem I had with her was that I didn't do two out of the six drawings required for ONE project and she said it would be next to impossible for me to get an A. I completely everything else and attended every class I could, and she still threatened me with a C.
SHe is too much of a control freak. Knowes a lot but doesn't know how to pass her knowledge to the students and treats them disrespectfully.

Pretty much bullied us into doing what she wanted to see. Picked on individual students. Has "pets" so if you take her, be sure to kiss up. Asked us to rate her teaching, but got defensive and angry about it afterwards. Doesn't take well to criticism. Very knowledgeable but a terrible teacher. Disappointing class.

absolutely awful.  friendly outside of class, demanding, stuffy, and cold in class.  no pedagogical skills.  she'll give you the lowest grade you've ever gotten, and it'll be the worst class you've taken.  thumbs dowwwwn.

Dianna seemed to really care about her students & tried her best to help everyone enjoy/understand sculpture.She did touch on Art history, but it was not the primary focus in her classes. She gave a few very small hist. quizzes BUT, The only one she counted was one everyone did good on (she even gave everyone a study guide & word bank ON THE TEST!)

This class is by far the worse class I have ever taken at U.I.C thus far.  Nothing makes any sense, you could compare it to playing a game and you have no idea what the rules are, but 100X worse.  She is vauge, over demanding, and turned what I thought would be a sculpture class, into a class on contemporary art history.  Avoid by ALL MEANS!

She is one of the worst teachers I've had in my life. She's harsh, likes to say what she thinks, and usually won't listen to reason. She also doesn't explain things well for sculpture projects. She used the class as an art history class, rather then a introduction to sculpture. She demanded too much, I didn't get anything out of it.

Everything was mostly on Pearson. As long as you did the homework and Pearson grades you were fine. Just make sure to go over lectures notes since that's what's on the quiz. Attendance is taken through Acadly so it does matter to show up. Also, Lab was easy we had a good TA and make sure you turn all those assignments in and you'll pass.
The professor himself is very kind and understanding, but the lectures are pretty boring. The class in itself should not be a requirement... but Professor Dierks does his best to walk you through it.
Super cool teacher, is very understanding and patient, however, the lectures don't really go in-depth on applying the formulas

Not my favorite professor but he's not bad. The class itself is just boring and not interesting. Attendance is mandatory and he takes attendance every day without and there isn't any freebies really. Not a hard class, just do the homeworks, pay attention a bit and you'll do fine. The labs are the worst part of the course really

Dierks is knowledgeable, but he jumps straight into problems. He could explain the basics a bit more before qns. Maybe the univ can introduce a prereq course.

Professor Dierks class is heavily focused on mathematics. If you don't have any background knowledge in math, his lecture can be very difficult to follow. An actual professor of the subject he teaches. Would highly recommend. Very fun classes. Took 421 and 423 with him.

Great professor!
I took him for mcs 421. He is really good and knows his stuff. Better take the class with him. Lots of examples but the subject is still hard so expect to invest time.

reviews.comment: Mubayi was the best math professor that I've had so far in my college career. He's definitely not an easy professor. His does lots of examples, which is nice, and he stops to gauge if everyone is understanding the material. He grades fairly and curves fairly. He's happy to help, and gives lots of very difficult homework but it makes the tests easy.
Great class overall.
Know's a lot of stuff. Classes more lecture-heavy but gives enough opportunity to discuss and ask questions. More group work would be nice.

Has very good knowledge of philosophy and philosophical traditions cross-culturally. Sometimes a little theoretical although group discussions and exercises helped. Had many helpful conversations outside of class/office hours.
He is funny and nice. Show up and speak and you are good.

Great class. A little abstract and philosophical, but changed many of my preconceptions about world religions and what religion is. Prof. Nagar expects you to be able to read tough material and asks tough questions. Not for everybody.

Dhruv is a first time teacher. I took this class for a general interest, but this was the most philosophical and confusing class I have taken so far. He is a great man, but his lectures are SO boring and the reading material is SO difficult. Definitely not an easy A, the class is vague and boring.

reviews.comment: He is very nice.  Easy grader on exams and presentations.  I got an A in the class even though I didnt understand a thing he said.  He cares a lot about his students and wants us to understand the language not just how well we do on tests.

He is a very nice person. Dont be intimidated by him because his english is not every good. He is very lenient in grading the tests, especially the oral presentations and the final exam. His teaching can be confusing only because of the language barrier. I was sure I failed every single one of the tests and the final but I got an A in the class.

He is a very nice person.  Don't be intimidated by him in the beginning because he doesn't speak english very well.  However, he is extremely nice on the grading of the tests and esp. the oral presentations.  Stick with him, i was sure I failed every test and the final but I got an A in the class.  He cares a lot about his students.
He is from africa and doesn't speak english very well so he is hard to understand sometimes. However he seems to be a nice person and a good teacher.

This is the third course I have taken with Professor Epstein. He is clever, clear and capable in his teaching.
