reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Really nice professor, very funny, gives good grades, very helpful. Project is important. Not much work load. Exams are based on the lectures and PPTs. Attendance is not mandatory. It's easy to get an A in MBA 590 Web Analytics.

Pretty funny guy, although I hated this class usually. The topic didn't interest me. He knows his stuff though, and makes it pretty enjoyable. The tests are not bad at all, use the notecard wisely. Do the homework, go to lab. It's not a tough class. Also, pop extra credit quizzes (the only reason to go to lecture)! Great guy from what I can tell.
he is super easy. 770

easy A. tests are all multiple choice and conceptual in nature. 4 other assignments in excel. 10 labs 5 points each. attendance not really mandatory, unless you need to boost your grade with the extra credit quizzes. overall easy A

Teaches 355 with Ouksel also, he is by far the more entertaining of the two. The class is straightforward, 5 Excel assignments which are fairly simple, 2 midterms 20% ea and a final @ 35%. Seems like a cool guy, relaxed.

Professor Lundquist has on average over 300 students to attend to during a given semester.  That being said he has a tendency to come off abrupt at first.  Give him a chance.  If he sees you're trying, he'll give you his time.  Read the text.  Study the powerpoint slides.  Don't tune out during lectures.

He's a cool guy, but he can get a little carried away with the homework with just seems to take a few hours per assignment. The tests are thankfully a little easier, but for a boring class he's not that bad a professor. Far more entertaining then that guy Ouksel, still though he should be a little easier on the homework.
SUPER EASY!! DO YOUR ASSIGNMENT & LEAVE CLASS..WHAT COULD BE EASIER???

We read books I never thought id like, but he made the so fun. There's some annotations and exams but they were really interesting, especially the detective one! Just show up and talk tho! So many people just stay quiet but he hears you out and sees the connections you're making.
He was really nice and if you made an appointment with him he'll talk you through everything. It's a lot of reading but all that's the class I guess.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Assignments are not carefully graded, with no reasoning for the grades given. Students won't know what could be improved later. Got As in major writing projs, but instructor's feedbacks are minimal. Many readings & annotations, which in my case, dragging overall grade to a C since was not able to get them done, but that's at my end so no complaint.
Lots of reading and annotating; however, the books were interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Mr. Sheldon was a great professor. We read 4 books throughout the semester and they were really good. This was probably the first time in my life where I actually liked the books I had to read. It is a lot of reading/annotations but if you do all of it, your midterm and final will be a breeze.

ENGL 154 with Prof. Sheldon was one of my favorites this semester. We read four short books, and they were all fun to read. The subject matter of the class was SO interesting and impactful to me and how I think about the world. There's no big projects except for the midterm and final exam, so it's easy to keep up with if you go to class.

Prof. Sheldon was wonderful to have for this course. Readings were a great part of the course so make sure to pay attention especially as there may be an occasional quiz. He greatly cared about students understanding and would encourage us to ask questions or contact him if anything was needed.
Very helpful in a class that can be tedious. Books were fun novels and made the research less challenging.
I like his dedication to the subject but I feel like he expects a lot from students for a 161-level class and is not flexible with deadlines in emergency situations

Prof. Sheldon is a good professor when working with dry subject material. The class consisted of weekly blogs, a midterm, final and presentation. Please show up to class, half of our class didn't show up in the second half of the semester and you need to attend lectures to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He made the online classes not so tedious. You have an assignment after every class but was his way to make sure that you don't let your entire paper for the last minute.

Prof. Sheldon gives great feedback. If you come to his office hours and fix what he tells you to, you should do well in his class. You are expected to fix your paper on your own, though, so make sure to read what he assigns (don't slack!). Consistency and improvement is what his class is about, which is why I learned a lot.

I really enjoyed this class! The professor was really funny when discussing the books we read and they were pretty good choices. I'd definitely take his class again or a similar class that he may teach. The work wasn't too hard and we had a quiz each Tuesday, but they're group quizzes, so it isn't too much to stress about if you did your reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Sheldon's class was pretty enjoyable. There was a lot to read, but I found the readings to be interesting and relatable. You can see that he really enjoys what he teaches and is a fair grader. He is also easy to talk to and always willing to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Sheldon is a nice guy, but not a good teacher. He can't explain what you're doing wrong if you didn't get it correct for the first time. He never replies on email, but is available during office hours. I've been at his office several times trying to improve my essay, he said it was okay and then gave me a B. Also,all 4 books are mandatory
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Don't be intimated by his look, he's quiet friendly and has a good sense of humor. There will probably be a lot of reading and perhaps a novel that you have to read through throughout the semester, but it would be worth it at the end to improve your writing.
He is a pretty cool professor there is a lot of reading and you do talk about it but I was able to pass without reading pretty much anything but the readings we used to write papers on.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: Since this was a lab course, he wasn't really available in person but the TAs were. His instructions were clear and concise. He's very outgoing and caring because he sends a lot of emails to remind about due dates.

Prof. Wink is a very kind man, he offers extensions and material to explain what you will be doing on lab day. He also gives second chances and sometimes will remove the late penalty from your lab if he feels like you are willing to improve later on in the semester. Worry about your TA because some can be kind but others aren't. Overall good prof.
Lab class. Accessible by email and very helpful. Just do the labs on time and prepare beforehand. Not hard to get a good grade.
Very nice and will help put if you need anything but the Ta's are teh ones who will be working with you most of the time

CHEM 123 is led mostly by the TA, so you won't have much interaction with Professor Wink. Make sure to do all the work outside of class and make sure you are thorough with the post-labs since those are graded harshly. Also make sure to watch Wink's video lectures. They are super informative and probably taught me chemistry better than CHEM 122.

I have never had a conversation with the professor, as the TAs run the lab. The quizzes are easy as he sends out emails ahead of time with a study guide of the exact questions that could be asked. He gives very clear instructions, but the post-labs are the only thing that takes a lot of time. If you simply do the work, you wont get below an A.

His lab is actually extremely doable, as TAs basically set everything up for you, you just have to do the actual work. Definitely an easy lab, the hardest part is probably the post-lab reports, which are super manageable if you learn the material from the slides. Current reviews are misleading. I personally really enjoyed the lab structure.

If you attend every lab and keep up with online assignments, this class is an easy A. The TAs run most of it, and your grade mainly comes from lab work and reports. There were two short lab quizzes with the exact questions given beforehand. My TA wasn't great, but the professor was responsive and very accommodating.

This is the first class I ever failed. I'm a chem major who had a 4.0 gpa who failed a 101 chem class thanks to the professor. Like he has no idea how to teach. You know the material but we don't its your job as a professor to teach us. I spent thousand in tuition if I wanted to teach myself I wouldn't be in college. Never taking him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He makes the class so hard for no reason. Like your a professor teach me something if I wanted to learn on my own I wouldn't go to college.

If you attend labs and do the online assignments, you will easily pass. The course is mainly conducted by TA's but I was able to access prof Wink many times through email. Make sure to go through all of the lab videos for each one to make the lab process much easier and faster as well. Online quizzes, imbedded quizzes in videos, pre/post lab, EC.

very difficult to communicate with on issues with labflow
doesn't respond well to emails
as long as you don't have major issues with labflow the class is ok and manageable to get an A
be aware you will spend on average about 10hrs a week for this class, be very careful with the data labflow is extremely sensitive

He's a great lab instructor. He gave extra credit quite frequently and his lectures were very informative. He even sent us videos of the experiment so we knew exactly what to do. Just prepare well before going into lab and you'll be good.
He's the goat fr, he was a good chem professor for lab. His lecture videos were informative and I understood everything.

If you just go to lab & do the work, you'll pass. Don't forget about the online lectures or quizzes, because they're basically free points. The online lectures are pretty entertaining and MAX 25 mins, majority are 10-15 mins long.
We rarely saw him in person because the labs were conducted by the TA's. His online videos explaining the labs were decent but the lab reports required a lot of work.

Super friendly and understanding. His online videos are his lectures, containing miny quizzes in them but you can retake as many times as you want. Labs are pretty easy as long as you watch the videos and do the pre-lab. If you ever need help he's always there.

This was a Chem 1 lab course, you don't have lectures or anything, just lab sections with mandatory attendance. He posts weekly videos for more assistance. He responds to emails quickly too. Only gave him a 4 because I had a 89 and he didn't round to an A, but otherwise, he's good.
Chem 123, online course. Good professor makes detailed videos and lectures. He has panapto quizzes, but most of the grade is dependent on the lab.

I had Wink for CHEM123 which I couldn't select for some reason. Anyway you don't actually interact with him very much, just watch his videos. Your grade in lab is very dependent on the work you put into understanding the material and getting good data. Also your TA grades everything so try to be chill with them. Wasn't difficult, just requires work

I had Wink for CHEM 101 during the pandemic. He wasn't as responsive through email, and I suppose it's because he had a lot of emails coming in. You'd be better off emailing your TA. But he's really clear about what's due, so you can expect the same assignments every week. Also expect to take quizzes every other week,

overall, a pretty understanding guy especially during the pandemic. usually available. if you study what he tells you to for the quizzes and tests youll be fine. lots of assignments that helps your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Not very helpful when you have questions. Acts like we all are dumb when we have questions, goes through material so quickly and will not answer questions during class because he says theres no time. Expects you to know things he never taught.
He gave a lot of extra credit which really helped!

doesnt try to explain the topics AT ALL. He constantly rushes and doesnt give examples for what hes talking about because he assumes that you know what hes talking about. Even went for his office hour and asked how I can improve, he just said study harder like wow.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I liked him. In order to get good grades on tests, SHOW ALL WORK!!!! Be SUPER meticulous about showing absolutely everything. Class is super easy but you have to show all your work to pass. Homework can be difficult but I missed a bunch of assignments and still got an A. Gives extra credit after each exam.

I'm an A student and I'm struggling to get a B in this class. Yeah he's funny during class but I need a professor who can teach. He assumes you know everything..... but its a 101 for a reason.... I agree with other students that he words exams and quizzes completely different than practice and homework problems. Honestly take someone else like pls.

You get online homework assignments and one pre- discussion homework questions once every week. Frequent clicker points, extra credit points for exam, hilarious. Be prepared to ready every chapter in the textbook for the chapters of the day or week.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He's a good chemistry professor. If I could change one thing though, it would be for him to actually go through some problems instead of just completely moving on to the next concept. He does give extra credit points though which have saved my grade a couple of times. Just make sure you go to class! (He records lectures in case you miss something).
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Pretty good professor. I recommend putting effort on the saplings because they help a lot before quizzes and exams. Also he gives on average 2-3 bonus points on all quizzes and exams and it has saved my grade a couple times. I recommend doing the practice problems from the textbook and if can do those than you'll be pretty much okay for exam/quiz
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Has a great sense of humor though, BUT he is the worse professor! He doesn't prepare for the exams or quizzes. The exams he gives are worded way differently from what he goes over class or the textbook. He never curves anything the most you can do is get 10 extra points on an exam which is nothing when you receive a 50%! No extra credit or curve.

Great professor! He had a quiz almost every friday, although they were very easy. There were four tests including the final and it was a very straight forward class. If you look through his lecture slides and discussion material its an easy A.
doesn't give a curve. Grades hard. Isn't helpful when you go to him. Teaches well in class and then gives homework with problems you've never seen.

He's a great professor. He makes the material really simple to understand, as long as you pay attention. Study and redo the worksheets he gives you before tests and exams and you will get an A. Gives a lot of extra credit points out.
This class is very very easy , but the homework always has questions he has not teached and the homework sometimes has questions that dont look anything alike from what we are taught

Great professor! He has a great sense of humor and is easy to understand and talk to. He gives lots of extra credit and teaches the lectures very well. He gives lots of worksheets which helps so much. He made chem one of my favorite classes. I really wish I had him again next semester

His class is really great! For the most part he explains everything to you and he does it in a way that is very easy to understand. He gives ALOT of extra credit which has saved my life. He wrote the textbook, so the way the teaches it in class is the same as in the book. Reading the book helps. Amazing class and professor! I would recommend.

If you pay attention and read the textbook youll be good. He gives extra credit on tests and quizzes. He does daily clickers and if you get the question right he gives you an extra point! Great class.
He's very helpful. I had him for an 8am Chem 101 class. It is an 8am class, but he explains things very well.

AMAZING 112 prof. I was skeptical because his reviews weren't that high. He was such a GREAT TEACHER I didn't even have to open my book to learn the topics. The difficulty level of the course was PERFECT. HE WILL HELP YOU! He offered extra points on tests, tells you what to focus on, posts practice tests, etc. I would take him again in a heartbeat!

Professor Wink gives worksheets during lecture, which are extremely helpful in learning and practicing the material. And it keeps you engaged in the class. He also gives  you opportunities for extra credit! I recommend him if you've taken AP Chem--he makes what you learned so much easier to understand!
There wasn't a single lecture or topic that he wasn't able to explain clearly. He  updated blackboard and grades and there are extra credit opportunities with weekly surveys.
Lots of Extra Credit. Don't need the book. Do the Sapling and you'll be fine. Ask Questions for Clarification. Good Teacher. Funny.

Be ready to learn on your own.  Dr. Wink does not teach, he just gives out worksheets.  Don't bother seeing him after class; he'll dedicate minimal effort in trying to understand your problem and actually helping you.  His TAs are the worst. Most are from China and have terrible teaching skills. Good luck, with this awful professor.
He assumes that you will read before going to lecture. Sometimes he is not that clear. Overall he respects his students and is very understanding about there situation.

He never posts dates for important things like lab practicals and exams. Also, he openly admitted to ignoring my emails. He really made me not like chemistry at all. At least he gives a lot of extra credit. Overall, If you're good at teaching yourself, you'll probably get a B. If you're good at sucking up doing extra, that A is  all yours
Good at what he does

Dr. Wink is an amazing professor. His tests and quizzes reflect everything done in lecture and discussion. Make sure to do the Sapling homework and the optional practice problems on MasteringChemistry if you want an A. He is very helpful and clear in lecture and during his office hours. I STRONGLY RECOMMEND HIM. You will not regret your decision.

He respectsfeels fondly of students that always attend his lecture and sit in the front of class. Attendance is not mandatory, but you need to get a certain number of clicker questions done. Lectures ARE helpful (he walks around and answers your questions and demos labs), so go! Superexams before tests are a MUST DO to get an A. Some extra credit

This professor does not lecture. Instead we have worksheets. The topics on the homework are often not covered in class before the homework is due. Therefore the student is left to figure things out on their own from the book or other resources. This is frustrating because sometimes clarification from an expert is necessary. We pay to be taught.

This teacher is horrible! He rambles about math problems and teaches the class if you already understand what he is talking about and I do and he is still confusing. Be prepared to teach yourself. Test are impossible and the last exam the average was a 55% so that will be curved to passing. HORRIBLE!
He is one of the good chem prof. at UIC, I highly recommend him to everyone, very clear with all the material that needs to be covered, all tests are straight forward. TAKE HIM!!!

This man in awful. In a class full of education majors, not chem. majors, taught the class like we all already knew exactly what he was talking about.  He is incredibly unhelpful and even when you go to class, you don't know whats going on, becuase he is so unorganized.

His tests and homework assignments have always been straight forwards. He also offered extra credit points with portfolio assignments...the portfolios were a good way to understand the material.  Overall he's fair about the class
this class is a lot of work but you have plenty of chances to make up points labs are really important-plz do all of them and get 10s...study for his exams they are tough!
No Comments
Very nice man.  Good teacher who knows his stuff.
No Comments
One of the few professors @ UIC who empahsizes learning in-lieu of research.
No Comments
No Comments
TA Kong is incredible! He motivates students and provides great feedback.
Awesome professor who teaches really well and helps with everything.

Doyeon Kong was my TA for MATH 180 and he was great! He's very good at explaining difficult topics and is very personable. During group quizzes he gives many hints and will ensure you get as many points as possible. If you need extra help, he's happy to explain things and he has hours at the MSLC. I would highly recommend having him as your TA.

He made Calc II easy to understand and actually fun. His teaching style is straightforward and clear, and he's always accessible outside of class. He's also very kind and funny, which made learning more enjoyable. I'd definitely take his Math 210 class if he's a TA for that.
Made calc 2 way more easier and understandable, and fun.
Made my class way easier more understandable, and enjoyable. he would make the class fun and concepts dumbed down for you so it was way good to pass calc 2.
An amazing TA that always helps his students. If you ever take a math course and he is a TA take his class! Very nice person and always explains things in great detail.

A tall Korean guy. His first impression might be a bit intimidating, but he has a great sense of humor! He will teach math in a variety of ways and you will definitely learn a lot from him. Also, his office hours are also incredibly helpful. He's very good-looking and a genuinely nice guy. Don't hesitate to take his class—HE IS THE BEST TA!
He is really cool and fun

On the surface he seems really grumpy, but that's just because the way he talks and his frown. He actually is really caring. He once stayed with me after class 20 minutes to help me with my homework. He would even bring math props to class to show out of his 'math tool history' class from AIC. He just speaks a bit monotone, which made me sleepy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mid - lectures are boring in an already boring subject

Spring 2025. Class uses Acaldy to take attendance. The professors notes are very thorough, and the notes very much matches with all the hw assignments. There is written hw, 1 for each unit. There is also online hw through MyOpenMath. Unit exams are open notes, so copying the profs notes matters greatly, they are the ticket to passing!
Lectures require pen and paper and no electronics which is fine, however her lectures are lengthy and very dull and could be more enriching if she spoke faster.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best prof at UIC hands down!

Course was numbered 314 this year -- Anthropology of Food. The course is more of a systemic review about food systems and how it affects farmers. It's not a class about food and culture per se. 

Great class, especially if you enjoy smaller group discussions. Doane is passionate about what she does and has a enjoyable hippie aunt-like quality.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Doane is the most passionate instructor at UIC. No one cares more for their subject material than does DR Doane. Her passion combined with her teaching leads to lectures that leave you intellectually stimulated and ready to take on the world. The books are easy to find, and great reads.

I absolutely loved her class, Molly is a brilliant professor and she is very passionate. If you do not like to read or write I would not recommend her class. I will say that she picks insightful books and you will not be disappointed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Molly Doane is brilliant women and scholar, as well as a joy to have as a professor. Though at times she may become a bit preoccupied by cats.
Professor Doane is brilliant women and scholar as well as a joy to have as a professor, though at times she may become a bit preoccupied by cats.

This is essentially a class on capitalism. That being said I had no idea I would find this topic interesting! Professor Doane is an amazing teacher and she really has a passion for what she teaches. She explains everything very simply so you get it. Their is reading and writing every week. Midterm and Final were also papers. Highly reccomended

Hands down best class I've ever taken at UIC.  She's a really nice person and she's easy to approach.  Be prepared to read quite a bit and show her that you've read in the weekly discussion guides.  She will open you up to a whole new worldview so take her!

Probably wouldn't recommend her as an ANTH101 professor. It was hard to stay awake for her lectures since it got pretty boring. Lots of short essay responses throughout the semester. Not really helpful with preparation for exams (lots of reading material). She's alright, but this class is not "an easy A" with her as the professor.
10 "discussion guides," and two 6-page papers. I thought she would do more teaching but mostly it's a discussion class. We read 5 books along with some other readings.

Lectures were usually boring.  But she is a very nice person.  Readings are assigned every week and you typically have to write a response for each paper.  there is a total of 10 response papers but they are not difficult; one page double-spaced, and questions were easy.  she was an okay professor.

Anthro of food was pretty interesting! Prof focuses a lot on globalization and fair trade, which can end up jading you. But I liked Doane. She's also a great person to chat with. Weekly discussion guides can be a pain though. Wouldn't call this class an easy A, but it's straightforward.

She knows her stuff and the books we had to read are really interesting. She makes you think about the readings and it really changes your perspective on a few subjects. The only complaint is that she takes a while to get her point across but bear with her and you'll understand everything.

Has a kind of quiet passion and dry, ironic sense of humor. Grades based on weekly discussion guides and two tests (one take-home). You definitely need to read the material and come to classes on discussion days: don't be late! The books and movies she chooses are awesome and she explains complex concepts in clear terms.

An absolutely brilliant professor who helps to engage her students in the topic. Don't take her if you aren't willing to come to class and read assigned work, but if you are dedicated and willing to learn, you will have a wonderful time with her!

I agree with the previous poster. You will learn alot from her class, and she integrates the political sphere very well. For people who need a different perspective of current political issues, she's the professor to take.

Dr. Doane is a really interesting professor.  Her readings were always engaging.  She did expect attendance and every week a discussion guide was required.  One possible criticism: not much anthropology, but she tried really hard to connect the political seams with the anthropological.  All in all a professor that you will learn a lot from.

idk what everyone here is talking about but there is a reason so many people skip his classes. He is a nice guy don't get me wrong, but his lectures are so boring. I would've skipped all of them if I wanted to but I felt bad cause BARELY anyone was coming. His homework however is so easy one of the easiest homework out there and hes a light grader!

Clearly very passionate as he is Muslim himself. I'm not Muslim and took this class for more insight and understanding of the religion and culture and walked away with a thorough and unbiased outlook on Islam beliefs and practices. Great class. Great professor, he does go on tangents a lot, but I get it as someone who is also ADHD
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I thought of dropping at first but he throughout the class he has taught us so much. Idk why but it was a very chill class. Anyone could debate freely put their thoughts and everyone respected each other. He is also a very funny professor XD

The professor is fantastic; he's a revert to Islam and is very knowledgeable. The way he teaches the class is outstanding; when he talks about a topic, he'll go in-depth but it will make it easier for the students to understand. I highly recommend this class.

Professor Doolin was an amazing professor who is very knowledgeable on Islam. He's a revert to Islam aswell. He has 2 exams that are open note paired with 2 essays that only need to be 4 page length minimum. There are weekly reflections on what you learned in the class, but they only need to be 5 sentences minimum. The TA was outstanding as well.

She is friendly and very enthusiastic. You will get an A as long as you turn in all the assignments on time. She also gives a lot of helpful advice for your writing. Her class is super easy and chill!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The great teacher always delays essays if she's sick or if the class is behind. Always fun to talk to and funny to talk to. Always great with feedback and will be online if anyone needs help with their essays or projects. Would recommend for anyone taking English 160 to have her, for it's an easy and nice class. The only problem she's sick a lot.

Heather is AMAZING. ur so blessed if u take a class w her. she's so extremely chill, and her grading actually makes sense! i really love her, and i'll miss having class w her next sem. she's also really funny, and so easy to talk to! this class is one of the easiest A's ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was an awesome teacher!! We had 4 writing assignments ranging from 3-6 pages throughout the semester the most difficult being the proposal but she made it very easy to get information and research well. She does have some medical issues so be prepared for zoom classes, however overall she's an amazing professor I would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a nice and sweet professor who actually cares about her students! As long as you turn in all of the assignments on time you'll be good!

Very enthusiastic in lectures even on days where we'd have class online due to some health problems. Just try to participate in class, meet the criteria for each writing assignment, and communicate via email and you should end the semester with an A. Heather gives several opportunities to fix or ask questions about your work. Medium workload.
best prof in UIC.

Heather Doble is such a nice and sweet teacher. I had her for Engl 161 which required by the University and she does her best to make sure that everyone does well in the class. She doesn't grade hard at all and is only looking for the things that are in the grading criteria. If you put in minimal effort, you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Heather is an amazing teacher. She is straight to the point with her lectures and doesn't waste time making you do unnecessary work. The class discussions are always interesting and the workload was amazing compared to what i've heard other students have. Over the quarter I had a few outside issues but she was very helpful and flexible.

Took this class my first quarter at DePaul, and Heather is amazing. Shes so understanding and adjusts things to work for you. She doesnt seem to be like a professor who punishes you for things you cant control. I can tell I totally grew as a writer in her class and she became a trusted adult at campus. 10/10 recommend her

I loved professor Doble, but I absolutely hate English. She was the most caring and understanding teacher. Of course all of our assignments were writing papers, but she gave clear instructions and example papers! Super easy to contact outside of class. If you correct your papers with the feedback she gives you, then you're pretty much set.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--So many papers

reviews.comment: Good and amazing Professor. Appropriate number of papers and feedback was all in detailed. She gave a draft points (normally slow as D or F) but if following her instruction and comment, easily A. I got 97% overall. Lots of Extra Credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I love Professor Doble.

Its English so ofc theres papers but she is probably the nicest Professor Ive ever had. Super understanding and reachable, just send her an email to meet up or stay after class. Very lenient bc she understands youre a human too. Class itself is easy, literally just follow criteria and examples and youll be fine. Can also go to class on zoom!

A chore to deal with at first, but once you get into it it's just like any English class. If you do not like writing and doing projects drop this class immediately. Most of your assignments are writing based, and the Writing Projects are sometimes tedious. If you enjoy writing and are not lazy, this is a enjoyable class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: What I like about her is that shes very specific about the feedback she gives so in order to get a good grade, you just have to follow her instructions carefully. Also, shes open to discussing about topics so you dont have to always do what she says. Overall, a fun Professor as long as you do your work. 10/10 would take it again

professor Doble is a really nice professor and shes cares about her students. she's accessible outside of class most times to help students. even though the class was not easy at all but if you put in the effort and work you should be able to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Heather is a nice person, but I did not enjoy her class. She does believe in giving students A's and isn't a teacher that makes it impossible to do so. She does, however, assign a lot of reading and writing. She does this as if her students don't have any other classes. Her paper subjects are boring and she talks about her personal views too much.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: She gives great feedback but you occasionally (or pretty often) won't be able to get your paper back on scheduled date. She grades on how much effort you put in the paper, not how perfect it is. If you follow her feedback and revise your paper accordingly, you will readily get an A. Show up and actively participate in the class.
awesome awesome highly recommend for English 161. you are guaranteed an A if you d the revisions and put an effort.

Heather is incredible!! She cares about her students and understands when things arise in our life so she will let you push back a deadline. You just need to talk to her and she will understand. She always grades a draft of yours and tells you what to fix in order to get an A. So if you put in true effort you should be able to get good scores.
Heather is great at giving feedback. Follow her revisions and you pass with an A. Show up and participate, that also helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She's an easy professor for those of you looking to finally finish English classes once and for all. She shows what she wants from you in your revisions and all you have to do is show that you care about your writing and you want to improve. Go to her office hours once in a while to show you actually put effort. Extremely kind and caring

She is AMAZING! She actually helped me improve my writing! Really great professor who actually cares about her student. She has a busy schedule but ALWAYS makes time for her students. She deserves the world!

I am not a big fan of writing but Heather made this class super enjoyable. She gives great feedbacks on drafts and tells you what to fix so that you can get an A. If you put in effort into her class and listen to her feedback you'll do great.
Prof Doble is pretty run of the mill, she genuinely cares about her students. She's a little bit of a harsh grader, but she gives you pleanty of time to do a lot of drafts so its fine
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She was honestly the best professor I had in my first semester. She knew how to teach the class, but also made it fun for the rest of the students. She's great at giving feedback for essays, and she makes it clear for exactly what she wants in the paper.
Great English teacher if you want the easy A and get the gen ed out of the way.
Pretends to be nice, is probably a secret hater on the inside. A lot of favoritism goes on in this class. Kind of sad. Get over yourself.
Heather is a wonderful, brilliant person. If you don't like her, it's you, not her.

Professor Doble is an amazing TA and a wonderful teacher!!!!! I don't know what the people below me are talking about. She is so kind, sweet, and understanding. She grades fairly. LOVES ALL HER STUDENTS AND WANTS ALL HER STUDENTS TO DO WELL. She's amazing and anyone would be lucky to have her as a teacher.

I'm glad I took her. She is very easy-going and loves British literature! She's so cute when she talks about books - you can tell she really loves what she teaches. Everyone read what you're supposed to before going to class because if not, discussion is dull, and she realizes that know one's done the homework and that can be a pretty big let down
She's honestly amazing. If you have the chance, take her class

Heather is an awesome professor! If I had to take another English class I would definitely take her again. She is helpful and gives good feedback on work. She does not judge and is willing to do all she can to help you pass. Overall a nice and relaxed professor and she connects with the youth! P.S. she knows music very well!

She is one of the amazing professors ever at UIC. She understands each student's struggles and is willing to help. She's Very chill, cares the students' opinions, and always makes the Lectures very enjoyable. The study guides are given, and the tests are straightforward. Take her and you won't regret.

Heather is an amazing teacher. She understands her students and what they're going through. I think by far this semester, she is my favorite teacher. The amount of work she assigns is reasonable and she's very down to earth.

Heather Doble is a genuinely caring one-of-a kind professor. She gives a lot of good feedback on papers. She loves when students use the Writing Center because she sees that you actually care. Very enthusiastic, lively and funny. Honestly walked out the class as a better writer. Loooove her!!!

Know one thing, she was a DJ! Google her nd make sure to pay attention when she talks about the Writing Projects because she clearly states the guide lines and she WILL answer your questions. She's super chill and if she was a student she'd be my bestie.

She was super nice and seemed to genuinely care if you were struggling. She was chill and casual a majority of the time but every now and then got a little rude. I HATE english and writing but really enjoyed her class.

Great class, and easy to get A if you follow the syllabus and ask for help. The book is interesting, If you're interested in the subject, but can be overwhelming. Follow her suggestions and make sure to revise and turn in drafts. Overall it was an enjoyable class, nothing to fear. Even if you don't consider yourself a good writer.

Fun and ecstatic. If we felt overwhelmed with homework she would push back deadlines. Comments and feedback were helpful. Textbook was kind of dense in some parts, but she taught the course well :) Easy to get good grade if you tried and revised completely on her feedback.

Very knowledgeable professor who makes complex topics easier to understand. I took him for Business Law 355 and 470, and he was consistently engaging in both courses. He stays involved with students and ensures everyone is keeping up. Easily one of my favorite business professors! Exams are multiple choice, and his lectures prepare you well.

I just started the semester but he's honestly great!! If someone answers the question wrong, he doesn't make them feel bad. He thoroughly explains why the question is one answer. His class is interesting!! Plus, he is also very cool and has many experiences in different fields!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very easy to self-study with his slides and outlines. If you attend class and re-read his PP and Outlines, you will get an A. He's also a real lawyer and makes class fun you can ask questions and participate

His lectures were interesting and had us students involved a lot. There were basically no homework assignments so your grade is based on 2 tests and the AICPA exam or his final. The second test didn't go over much of what we did in class. Overall, this class was ok. This can be a risky class to take but if you are a good test taker then go for it.

Easy to follow lectures, BUT the content is very dense and hard. Your expected to know all the material and will not know what you will even be tested on. His "review exams" were 1/3 or less of what was on the actual exams. It is definitely a interesting class and he does teach well but the class had little to do with accounting, imo avoid
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Exam heavy class, but they are curved. His lectures are easy to follow. To do well in the class, all you have to do is show up and actually listen. His practice exam solutions give you a lot of notes to work with before an exam, and he also has a review Zoom call the night before each exam. The final is optional if you are unhappy with your grade.
Very difficult exams and lecture heavy. The professor treated us as if we were law students.

Completely disorganized, didnt grade anything until the week before final grades were due, overshared in class rather than give any guidance or clarity about the material or assignments. not a harsh grader and not too much work but youll spend way too much time trying to figure out what to do and when to do it.
I would rather sh*t in my hands and clap than to take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Just make sure to write correctly and put in an effort. He is excellent, and he teaches in a significant way. I enjoyed being in his class every day.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I learned a lot new things in this class. Reinvented my habits, improved my critical thinking, became a better person after all. Professor Jim is really nice person, he is a critical thinker, has great sense of humor and plenty of expirience in fields outside of English. He provides great feedback, not strict about attendance and participation.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kind of annoying how he assigns homework on google docs and expects you to check it when Blackboard is available. Calls on random people and expects them to answer the question and doesn't accept "I'm not sure".
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The work is not overbearing; it can be easily missed, as some of the homework is listed on Google Docs, but the major work is laid out from day one. Caring, funny, & sweet, very accessible outside of class. The professor clearly loves graphic novels, making the class feel authentic, lots of papers at the end, give yourself time.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very unorganized, his answers to questions just made it more confusing, a lot of work but that's not even the bad part, theres no examples, or a rubric, no clue what was even being graded. I would drive to this class without a seatbelt. Hes a good person with a good personality, but honestly a bad teacher, glad Im done with english after this class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: My classmates and I were often confused on the assignments that needed to be completed for the week because the assignments on the syllabus for the year did not match with the homework he would assign at the end of class. Other than being off-topic a lot, he clearly cares about his students success and tries to keep them engaged in the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was disorganized and everyone was always confused about what was due and when. He goes on tangents and is very eccentric. It takes him forever to grade things on blackboard, and when he finally does, he will give you a random grade and not give any feedback explaining what you could have done better. He is very vague on what he expects.

Really funny professor with cool interest. He does talk about them a lot but in relation to the class does well, I recommend if you don't mind. He is considerate of his students and tries to connect and see other views in order to broaden the class. My only critique is that he is a bit disorganized with due dates even when stated on the syllabus.
Great guy, take this class if you're a manga/anime nerd, it will become the easiest class for you. Will fulfill the Creative Arts requirement.

The first week of the semester he assigned a 30 page reading w/ 2 other articles to read over a weekend. The class itself didn't have a strong sense of direction, he'd go on a tangent abt something loosely related (usually about anime) so much time wasted. Honestly, he made everything so confusing and mentally frustrating. Great guy, awful teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: very funny and lectures are entertaining. However, he is way too tough of a grader. I got 100% on all the assignments and gave me a B for the midterm. When asked about it he said he doesn't give out A's.never happy and it is annoying when I am a STEM major and this is the hardest class I am taking, and this class doesn't even relate to my major.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is an English class! You are going to have a lot of reading and a lot of writing. This professor talked a lot in class, as well as had you do individual and group work. I had him for an 8am, so I got a little sleepy, but his lectures are definitely different. He grades relatively easy, but the syllabus isn't 100% accurate.

This professor cares a lot about his students and will give you good feedback although he doesn't have a syllabus he is one of the goated English professors. He kept me engaged in class like no other professor could definitely one of the best profs

This was the worst professor I've had in college. It was so confusing from day 1 I wasn't sure what I was supposed to do, it was never clear what the essays were even supposed to be on, and when trying to ask a question you never get a clear response that answers your question, it's something completly different.

Worst professor experience ever. I had a lot of medical problems going on when I took his class, he told me he understood. However I get to the final paper and gave me an F without any good reasoning and left it at that. This professor set me back and wasted my money. I was at a B all semester until the final. He used his power to his advantage.

Nice guy, a bad teacher. If you like clear direction and teaching, Drown isn't the professor for you. His lectures are just him talking and you will constantly feel in the dark about what is due. When participating in class he will interrupt your answers and will breach uncomfortable subject matter with little regard for how his students may feel.

good luck emailing him it's like trying to solve a puzzle there is nothing clear about him at all. But as a teacher, it isn't good he has no sense of direction, no structure in class, and half the time I didn't know what I was doing. He makes a 3 credit course hard for absolutely no reason at all everything about him was difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor James Drown is the chillest person I have ever met. Sometimes he made joke in classroom and telling story midway. His teaching topic are debatable ( some people may find it hard ) but for me, it is really unique. 10/10 would recommend.

Professor Drown has a good personality and is very nice. However, he is a bit unorganized and teaches confusingly. No syllabus is provided and you will need to do ALOT of reading. class with him was nerve-wracking, as you never really knew what to do. Nice guy, an unorganized way of teaching.

Instructor Drown is such a cool person! Seriously! He is so chill. Based on the reviews here, I thought I had signed up for a terribly clumsy and bad instructor. However, he was nothing like that...
I took his graphic novel course and he grades fairly and is okay if you miss class in person, since he almost ALWAYS provided them through collaborate.
He takes very long to grade assignments and he wants students to answer while teaching so he knows that we understand.

Really cool and funny guy, his classes feel more like a conversation than an actual lecture.He does tend to get sidetracked and sometimes the class can be really boring but he does put a smile on my face before I leave. There are a lot of writing projects but he grades pretty generously, so as long as you can keep up with the essays you'll be fine.

There's also a lot of work and while he doesn't (1) grade harshly, if you are like me and like things to be written clearly, he's a not the professor for you. It gets quite confusing as to what is due and he doesn't really say much in class  but he does email us towards the end of the week which is confusing if you don't happen to check. (2)

So far I have mixed feelings about him, he's pretty nice with his students, pretty engaged, likes to joke around, HOWEVER, he is very unorganized. We start the next assignment while finishing up the last and it can feel very confusing as the syllabus and the submissions links are very vague. There's also a lot of work and while he doesn't (1)

Prof James always helpful and funny in the class, he talked a lot of films related staff in this class. This semester, specially, The Matrix. if you love films, I believe it is really easy to receive As in his class
If I can rate Mr. Drown a zero I will. Worst Teacher Ever. Don't respond to emails and just ignored me during class for help.

Honestly not a bad class. Straight forward with assignments and grades fairly but do be aware there is a lot of work. But if you stay on track you will not feel overwhelmed. Just ask questions if needed
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: HELLO fellow readers!!! This professor over here is a delight to have. He really allows you think outside the box and is very easy on papers since guidelines limit a student and their creativity. Also very understanding when it comes to be late with assignments. Some assignments are difficult and time consuming but worth it.

Easy class, I hardly paid any attention in his class but still received an A at the end of the semester. One day out of the week, we would watch a movie based in the 70's and would be expected to answer the questions he had posted on BB. Overly, the class was pretty boring and will definitely put you to sleep.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best
One of the best professor, who really interested in what his students think.

Perhaps one of the few professors who understand their students, although I had to write a lot, but the professor always explained everything in detail during the lesson, so I fully understand how to work on my composition.

he is one of the best professors I had during my college years... he was so good, he understood my situation and would give you as much time as you need but don't take it too much. he is so good and would help you a lot, his grading are fair and good. he is funny and caring his lectures are fun.
He's one of the best Profs ever. Very considerate of his students' needs, gives extensions if you're unable to finish the assignments in time. Goes out of his way to help students.

Awesome Professor!! I would definitely take his class again! He really cares for his students and makes sure everyone is understanding  the material before moving on. He also offers one on one weekly meetings to revise in class projects which really helps you improve your work.

Prof. Drown's lectures aren't based on note-taking--more thought provoking. We watched films in class, asked questions, and discussed (he did most of the talking). His comments are hilarious sometimes. The two textbooks weren't used at all. Homework once a week: short prompt response due on Blackboard. One group project and then the final. Easy A.
Great teacher. Easy going. Easy to talk to. Occasionally make jokes. He's gay, but that doesn't really affect anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: One of the greatest professor.

I thought this class would be a blowoff going into my first year.  I was mistaken, there are reviews that we had to complete for every movie.  These are very important in film class.  I got a B on the midterm but still pulled out an A in the class, the reviews probably had a lot to do with it.  Make sure you do not fall behind on them.  Great guy.

One of the best professor I had. He's funny and outgoing. He really tries to connect with their student. No quizzes, minor reading assignments, a couple of essay which are like 2-4 pages long, he doesn't grade too harshly, and his mandatory meeting are super helpful.
He's a great professor!!!!His one-on-one meetings are really helpful. He'll be honest with your work, and he will not find an easy way to sugar code it, but he will give you constructive criticism.
One of the best professor at UIC. Take him and you wont regret it. Highly recommended for ELL students

His class is really good for the fact you get a wide range of movies and understanding of how film works. He's very knowledgeable, you just have to be prepared to participate and hope your peers do too. He asks very deep questions and gives helpful hints/advice on how to solve them, he's also witty and funny. I greatly recommend his class.

I love film, but will probably never watch the films we had to watch in class ever again. I thought this class would make film more enjoyable and interesting, but I was gravely mistaken. He knows what he's talking about, but he's not a good teacher. Do not take his film class. Take ENGL102 with Douglas, or 110 with Cassidy (highly recommended).
This guy is awesome, best teacher I ever had and is really there to help you.

Great professor. I enjoyed every second of being in his class and he is very open to questions and getting help. He really wants you to learn.  Overall the work load is a little bit but it's an easy A and you will learn a lot.

Best professor I ever had at UIC. He is there to teach you no matter what and enjoys it. Without his teaching, I wouldn't have be to move on and learn so much about grammer.  He taught me much more. He is a good professor that wants everyone that puts effort into work to pass. Best professor you could ever imagine!
Prof. Drown is my favorite teacher at UIC! He is really helpful and funny. If you come to class and participate then you should have an easy "A".

Professor was not only the first professor I've met, but also the most helpful and kind. I do not regret going to UIC because of this. Although it may be a hard grader at some point, he wants use to learn the true feeling of college.

If you are desperate to have a non "A" class, this is the guy. The highest he would give would be either a B or C. Hard grader, doesn't curve nor explain what he wants in papers. If you don't want to give up your 4.0 gpa, avoid him at all costs.

The topic didn't really interest me which was politics. Though his class is very easy and comprehensible. Essays are doable. He's funny and very nice and will actually help you write better essays. Prof. Drown is a chill guy and doesn't really return your papers but you'll get an A for sure.

I took 150 and 160 with Drown. He's an awesome guy- quirky, fun, and a very interesting person in general. Although his exams are very hard (he knows it too) the way he teaches the material is so interesting that it makes the class enjoyable. I learned a lot from his classes. If you work hard and pay attention to his discussions, youll be rewarded.

He is wonderfully entertaining and truly cares about the subject he teaches.  He knows the tests and midterms are hard but it's for your own good.  If you listen in class and take notes, the tests should only be difficult time wise, not content wise.  Overall, he's one of the best professors I've had at UIC.
I believed these negative comments about him at first but after i got to know him...he is very nice and helpful...great professor :D I REALLY ENJOYED YOUR CLASS PROFESSOR DROWN.

He knows his tests are hard and long and he comments and tells you that you will not have enough time.  No one finishes midterms and exams on time.  Class averages are low and he doesn't do much about it. Obviously if the average isa failing something is wrong.

Is a hard teacher.  Makes you learn from the book and do the homework and then teaches you another way in class.  I felt like I understood everything in class and then you take the midterms and final and it's like a..HUH? I don't reccommend him.  The class turned out more boring and I ended up hating it.  His tests are so long

This is a harder class but he is a great teacher. You need to be able to understand the material but in class, I have a great time and believe I am learning a lot. The midterms and final are hard but the class itself is just amazing. I would recommend to anyone who is willing to put a few hours in to the books.
he's chill, fun to argue with, and presents points from both sides of the argument
Challenging topic but good prof. Will help if you ask. Be willing to think and you'll learn.

There are few professors at UIC who help you understand the material/try to improve your writing skills. He was not really a great teacher in terms ofimproving ones writing skills however he certainly did try and I give him credit for that.

Lots of material covered in the class but he made it seem interesting. He was really into groupwork and allowing us to discuss our homework with everyone else before turning it in. When finals came, he gave an opportunity to write an extra credit paper and boost your grade. Only problem is that it takes him soo long to get everything back to you!

I had Drown few years ago when he first started teaching. He is a great lecturer and a very very very nice guy. He will work with you to bulid your writing skills. However he does not believe in creative writing so it is hard to earn a A in the class if your a creative writer but, he tries his best
Material never clarified, things either turned back late or never, and a lax manner of holding lectures.

Really great teacher, topic can be a bit boring at times, but I really liked it. Very nice teacher and helpful, one of the better teachers I had in college. He is a cool guy, likes video games just like me!

I had this professor for English 161. Professor Drown is a nice man. He will go out of his way to try to help the student. In this university you always have to give that sorta effort a positive. However the guy is a really hard grader with a dry topic

the class material is hard, but he is a great teacher! although he's a hard grader, he makes up for it by being somewhat lenient in the end.... he's very well-rounded and knows a lot about the world in general.... this class is good if you want to gain knowledge and earn the grade... 2 exams, homework every week that are problems from textbook.

Omg, he is such a hard grader!! Very nice teacher but its is very very very hard to get an A. He is soo picky about grading essays my god. You will spend 7hrs writing an essay only to learn that you got a B on it.

I absolutely hated this class...he screwed me over many times...always lost my papers...returned them late...only me!...it was horrible...the class was boring...but in the end i got a B which i totally didnt expect at all...that was probably the only thing i was happy about...i guess he felt sorry for me or something lol.

I do not think Professor Drown is a bad teacher but, it is really hard to get a A in this class. Nice guy but overall way to bias when grading papers. If you can choose a different professor and you need to do it within 2 days or they wont let u change.

I really liked Professors Drowns approach to education. He was always there when you needed help and he would spend a few hours teaching you the material. Although the topic is boring i think the professor makes it worth while
BORING VERY BORING TOPIC
He was a good teacher who wasn't too hard on grading. The only problem I had was how long he took in grading everything and how boring the topic was, other than that it wasn't a bad class.
great prof

Dr. Puranik is truly the kindest, most understanding, and most intelligent professor I've ever had. His lectures are interesting, he doesn't overload you with information, and he takes the time to make sure everyone understands the concepts. I could not recommend him enough. If you have the chance to take his class, you will not regret it.

TAKE HIS CLASS YOU WILL GET A Dr. Puranik is hands down the best professor I've had so far, if a class starts to feel too dull or overwhelming, he'll end it early and he offers extra credit for attendance He's everything a great professor should be he truly understands the difference between just relaying information and actually teaching it.

You're graded on online HW assignments, group case studies, online exams, one paper, and participation. You should study the slides to do well in this class, as the HW and exams come directly from his slides. Make sure to participate in class and the case studies. Overall, the course is easy as long as you put in some effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor is really very understanding. He's really very good at explaining things and the homework for the class are very easy and easy to understand.

Prof Harshad is one of the best profs I've ever had! His lectures are easy to understand, the 2 tests & HW match lecture content, he's understanding, caring, gives extra credit, no textbook, even made the final take-home. There's 1 paper, really easy. Just show up to class & take notes, you'll pass. If you need to take this class take it with him!

idk what the student below is talking abt, this class was easy and prof malone's lectures were always helpful; i also suggest creating notes from the mini lectures helped me a ton for the exams! labs were easy and most were fun! only grades are discussion post and labs and iclickers and of course the exams :)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Wouldn't recommend. You should be ready to get cold called if you're in lecture. He's somewhat helpful, but barely. If you do decide to take this class, I'd recommend Massie as your TA for lab because she's honestly what made the class understandable and enjoyable.

You have many opportunities to catch up; exams are heavy but not impossible. Listen to optional online lectures and WRITE NOTES BEFORE CLASS, then you'll have a study guide to look back on. This was time-consuming but well worth it.

This was a very laid back class, I felt well prepared for all the exams and the lectures never felt boring as there was a strong emphasis on discussion. My only complaint was the pack back program used for homework. It used an unreliable AI to grade, and some assignments would be flagged as made by AI when they weren't, making students start over.

Prof himself is actually pretty chill and I didn't really have any problems with him. Class was pretty easy as well, though it gets boring. Played 2048 and human benchmark to not fall asleep. Labs were pretty straightforward though I didn't like them. The exams are hard I highly recommend doing the practice multiple choice questions to pass.

Not sure why he's rated low because he was pretty cool this semester! The class was interesting and the exams weren't too bad. He also gives out some extra credit. Just study for a few hours or watch the mini lectures he posts and you should be good. The TAs/peer leaders were fun as well.
Cool guy, easy class.

Pretty easy and laidback class. Labs were a bit boring sometimes and the lectures were ok. The homework was very easy. You learn some cool stuff in the course. But the exams were way too hard for a 101 level course, and the final exam being 45 percent of the grade was insane. You have to study a ton for the exams, but the rest of the class is easy.

I really enjoyed having Dr. Malone as a professor. There wasn't any graded homework, the iclickers he asked in class were very straightforward, and almost always pulled directly from the preclass material; you always knew what you needed to do to be prepared. He was very understanding and communicative outside of class as well.

Professor Malone was one of my favorite instructors I had at UIC. He clearly cared about his students and the course material. I don't think his rating on here is an accurate representation of the quality of professor he is and is rather a result of the high proportion CS majors taking the class expecting a blowoff class.
Gives great lectures and engages the class so it's not boring, easy to approach, and genuinely nice.

Was very enthusiastic about the course and responded quickly. Cared about students and field trip was fun, but the preclass videos were useless. Why make us watch them when you teach it anyways? They should be optional for students who need extra help. Tests were semi easy, and the blackboard page was very organized and had a lot of resources. 3/5.
Redundant workload (no point in watching pre-class vids), but organized and responds quick.
Hes a nice guy but his class is boring. The subject is cool and the work is manageable. But by god I will not be reading the pre class stuff. Asking TOO much man.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Boy oh boy where do I begin. Professor Malone is one of the best if not THE best EAES professor I have ever encountered. He treats his students with immense care and with a genuine and profound desire to help the succeed. Not to mention be be flee asl. He rlly ptso. Inshallah, he will be rewarded for his work in the hereafter.
too awful

This class is an annoying amount of work for a 100 level class. Extremely easy content but there is so much memorization that it is hard to do well on the exams if you are just putting this class to the side and working on your other courses.
Prepare to stare at rocks for 2 hours in lab. Take this class online at your local community college. Trust.

Professor Malone is clearly very passionate about his work and isn't bad. His class however does require some work outside of class, which are only ~10 minutes of pre-class videos. These are needed to understand the material in class and to answer the iClicker questions (which are graded). As long as you do these, you will do great on the course!

Professor Malone was honestly very helpful and great at pushing students to get better grades and attend lecture. I don't under why is score is low when all you need to do is watch 10-20 minutes of pre-lecture videos, do a quick weekly lab write-up, and take a nine question quiz every week. It's an easy class if you care and come to lecture. Tweaks

Honestly I don't know why Prof. Malone has such bad reviews but I really enjoyed his class last semester. He has pre-lecture material you can go through to understand what will be taught in the next class. There's quite a bit of work but it's not bad as long as you try to keep up and he's actually really caring and wants his students to learn.
Horrible man. Not accommodating at all. Do not take him if you do not have to.

Some advice, the exams for this class are very heavy. You can get 100% in every single homework assignment, participation, etc., but if you flunk an exam your grade will go down at least 10%. So, please don't take the easy homework for granted and leave it until later. Finish it all, don't let it pile up, and you'll be fine.

Malone takes this class too seriously for a 101 class. It goes into great detail for a 100-level course. I feel Malone knows people take it just to satisfy the gen ed requirement but still makes it super difficult.

I took this class simply because I was interested in the subject matter. It turned out to be nothing like the syllabus described. Professor Malone doesnt explain material - he reads slides. Too much material to go through for a 100 level course.

This is probably the easiest class I've taken. Literally, I do all the weeks work every Sunday and spend probably only 5 hours on it all . Anyone who complains about this course and "write ups" being hard are incompetent or don't know what actual tough courses are like. You don't even need to watch the lectures. Just google quiz questions... jeez.

Class is easy, but way too many assignments for a 100 level course. Class was online and prerecorded all lectures. TA's are laid back and attendance is mandatory for labs. Lots of assignments to complete every week, due different days with no late submissions allowed. As long as you do your assignments on time you will pass.

Has a lot of lectures that he puts out for us to watch throughout the week in which he goes in depth of each topic and he is really enthusiastic about it. The amount of work is really the only downside to this class where we have a weekly quiz, weekly lab quiz and write-up, and we have to ask and answer a question, but TA and Prog are great overall
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The transition to online clearly changed this class. Many people who came in this semester thought it was going to be easy based on others who said it. Was it as easy as they said? We will never know because the online version required us to do about six assignments do each week. He was nice enough to move the deadline from Sat to Sun, at least.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Malone is the only professor I took this semester who actually listens to and cares about students struggling with remote learning. Not to mention, the TA's for this class were the best (in all of my other classes, TA's were awkward, untrained, and disconnected). I definitely recommend if you're looking to fulfill some science credits!

Prof Malone's class has a good amount of work but I did not have any issues getting it done. He is really good at sending emails telling you what's due in the coming week. You just have to do the homework to do well in the class (show up to lab-attendance matters, lab write-ups, topic quizzes, discussion board, tests). Has a lot of office hours

reviews.comment: Really chill professor, learned so much and made homework and labs very accessible, even during the pandemic

reviews.comment: IDK what everyones talking about when they review him! He's NOT condescending at all he's SO sweet, teaches energetically; his lectures are not dull at all! Also teaches concepts in an easy way to understand! He draws things out, repeats information, responds well to questions... he was my favorite prof of that semester! & Im a POLYSCI major!

Dr. Malone is a really great professor. Good choice for a natural world gen ed because the content is very relevant to your life, particularly the coverage of climate change. He is NOT politically conservation and whoever claims it wasn't paying attention to the joke he was making. The bulk of your work is lab content so it's not too bad.

I wish there was another class I could have taken to fulfill my science course I needed. He doesn't respect students and is super rude when asking questions. Will not round your grade if you need it either. If there is another class or professor you can take, do it.

The worst Professor ever! He has no respect for his students. He indirectly treats everyone as if they were dumb. Very rude. He gives out activities in class walks around to make sure it is getting done, but does not take the time to work with you and explain things. Goes very fast on the slides. Tests are hard. He gives out a lot of work.

reviews.comment: He is clear and concise. Upfront about what you need to know and how to do well. You have to put in some work but going to lecture each day and asking Q's guarantees a good grade. Wants to help and excited to teach. Qualified and extremely smart. One on one he is genuine and SO NICE and SO FAR FROM CONSERVATIVE OR SUPPORTIVE OF THE WALL.
Very strict and sometimes uncaring. Course requires field trip. Cuts no slack.

reviews.comment: Very good lectures. Relatively low workload, maybe an hour a week including lab reports. Just show up to lectures, pay attention, and you'll do well. Bonus that he gives you half of the exam questions before the exam, so how can you possibly fail?

There's a lot of work for the class but, I have never learned as much as I did until I was in the class. Pre-class assignments were collected from random students so you had to do it; found myself actually learning the material and learning to think critically. Fieldtrips are made mandatory by depart., not professors. One day outside wont hurt you

reviews.comment: People complain about him, but honestly, he's not that bad. His lectures can be dry but he does have a passion for the subject. The material is pretty straightforward and the assignments are easily done in less than half an hour. I could have gotten an A but i just stopped caring about the class toward the end. Easy exams. He makes it very doable.

The amount of work in Malone's class was comparable to a 300's level course. He doesn't round grades and there's no curve either. On top of that, he wants to take you on a mandatory field trip that takes nine hours on a Saturday. His slides are packed with info so you can't understand anything. I've actually learned nothing in his class.

reviews.comment: Simply ridiculous. I found it more practical to get an A in a two-hundred level computer science class than this class. Work overload, exams are scaled to utter difficulty as well plus a mandatory field trip.

So I went to class everyday, did all the homework, and attended every Lab and somehow got a B in this in class, which is surprising since Malone's exams are super hard because there's no knowing what to expect, despite him giving a review sheet. I feel like I never knew what was going on in class and labs. Goes over the slides to quickly for me to take notes in class. Definitely need to put in work for this class.

Prof. Malone is chill, he loves what he teaches and lays out the whole class for you so there are no surprises. To do well you should go to class, keep up with readings, and study. reviews.comment: Listen to me. Don't take this course. Save yourself...

There are so many assignments that everything is extremely rushed. The lab questions are disturbingly cryptic and the class is so rushed that there is little explanation.

For a level 100 class, this course requires too much work and is scaled to be difficult. All the exams have gotten low scores and have been curved for the class. Labs are graded tough. There is a mandatory field trip on a Saturday from 8-5. If you dont go, you dont pass the class. Since a lot of people take this as a gen ed, dont take Malone.

Avoid at all costs. There is a mandatory field trip on a Saturday that takes up 12 hours. Its inconvenient because many people had to call off work to go, also bad weather. Test averages are poor for a level 100 class.

Prof. Malone is okay. If you do every assignment and put a little effort into everything then you'll pas. I never bought the textbook or payed attention in lecture and got a good grade. this man was a saint for my last science credit class. He had 3 tests, and every single question for the test was given out and studyable for like 5-7 days before the exam.
