Recycled videos made in 2020-2021 to use as his main lectures, which are not well made, and his class lectures were too short (50 min/wk) to cover all the material. You will have an extremely hard time passing class if you don't depend on outside lectures and resources to study.

Professor Sargis lectures very conceptually. Of course, this class is a 400-level so I expected it to be more on the difficult side. Despite struggling a lot, he reassured that we will all do great. I recommend watching YouTube videos to familiarize yourself with SPSS because that is where you will be analyzing all your data!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Loved him hes so nice and helpful, always happy to help. If you ask him a question he wont tell u the answer rather teach it to u. But he is an easy grader and if you do your assignments and study for the exams you will end with an A!

Professor Sargis is very clear and provides detailed examples in his lectures! For every hw he prepares a video that matches with that week's content to help you complete it. Exams are not hard at all if you just go through his notes. Very doable class, I did not study that much and still got As on exams just by completing at home assignments.
The class was great with all the video lectures he provided and walked us through every step! Also responds to emails professionally and in an timely manner! I would recommend 110%!

PSCH 343 is a stats class, so don't expect it to be very interesting. That being said, I have taken two other intro to stats courses, and Prof Sargis is by far the best teacher I've had. Lecture videos are short and concise. There isn't much busy work for this class. Everything you do helps you learn. I think he's a good guy too.

The material isn't too hard. But the professor is very apathetic. He will answer questions about the course but don't expect any empathy, or compassion from this man. We are in a pandemic and he still is giving 0/100 points for late hw. He doesn't even grade it for several weeks. he's just power tripping. Very uninspiring, dull and strict.

Its a week before finals and this guy really only has one grade in for the class. Everything is being done online and this guy doesnt even have lesson plans for us. I guess asking for our graded work back on time is too much to ask as well

I didn't think this guy could get worse but he is now he is literally doing nothing to help after this online to transition. No lectures, no classes, and a few badly edited videos are the best he can do. I wonder if he is actually getting paid to do this. He's really failed us this semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This guy should stick to lectures because he isn't useful at all other than that. He always seems to make his self-described "awkwardness" a problem for students. Stick to research then buddy. Student don't really care about your life.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: his gives 4 heavy conceptual exams, I personally not understand his powerpoint slides. A little bit confusing, maybe he tempts to use professional statistic languages, forgot student is here to learn the entire subject within 4 months, plug numbers with formulas are easier to me. He brings up his personal life during lectures, a lot. 7 homework.

Overall he's a good instructor he just tends to drift away from the subject alot of the times. He does Iclickers and homeworks. He focuses on the concepts much more than the actual formulas which is a plus if you're not a Math head like me.
A very cool. He was approachable and likable, but the poor thing had to teach a Stats class
He's an awesome teacher. Gives great feedback and always very helpful.

You must remember the formulas for exams. Short answers, with VERY minimal multiple choice. You do not have to take final, if you do good on your exams. Lectures were pretty boring, I really learned some concepts off YouTube, which helped me a lot on the tests. His slides are helpful if you look over them at your own time. Overall, good proffesor

Exams are easy if you understand concepts as well as study slides. There is no mc or true false on the exams. 30% of the class was homework and participation. He chooses the best 3 of 4 exams so you may not have to take the final. Overall, nice guy but lectures can be very boring.

Professor Sargis is a good guy. This class is not a lecture type class; it mainly consists of you working with your group & get help and feedback from him the TA, Olivia (the best TA!) This class is all research and papers; don't get intimidated by it; you will learn a long the way & will be fine. He is nice about deadlines and gives good feedback!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Doesn't use a text book and confusing power points. Tests are mostly conceptual but the homework is computations so preparing for the exams is difficult.

He's okay. He focuses more on the conceptual part, which is a bit weird. Didn't listen in class but his ppts are pretty detailed and sufficient for the exams. Got 100% on all 3 midterms, so dropped the final. Also has homework, iClicker, and discussion points. Okay class, however, there are easier professors.   **No formula cheat sheets for exams**
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not a fan. His lectures are confusing and the slides make no sense if you weren't in class listening to every word. He doesn't answer questions, and his tests are ALL short answer. They're really EXTENSIVE. He doesn't use a book so his lectures are scattered and annoying. Definitely avoid him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Avoid! Do not take him unless you have prior knowledge of the subject because it will be very hard to understand anything he says. You ask a question and he starts talking, gets distracted and wont answer

I went into 343 terrified, but Sargis teaches this subject extremely well--especially for how difficult it can be. He is a great guy, a reasonable grader, and I have gotten A's on both tests and each assignment so far. Obviously you need to attend class--that's a given. He's a great teacher, and I would definitely recommend him for 343
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very difficult subject, but he taught it well. Gave good examples, but could repeat things often
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: 343-STATS. His lectures are very conceptual. Expect to learn more about the meaning behind the calculations & not just calculations and formulas. Almost 70% of the content of the exams will ask why are you calculating for that specific formula. Homework was very helpful. Can only use pocket calculators for EXAM, no book needed. I-clickers required

He's one of my favorite (psychology) professors here. He gets a bad wrap because so many psychology majors are bad at math. He is a good teacher and has no problem re-explaining a concept if you ask him to, either in class or in his office hours. Ignore the person claiming there is no textbook. There is one but it's optional, so get it if you need.

Lecture was boring, TA was amazing. Class is easy if you pay attention in discussion. I pretty much never go to class and spend one night studying beforehand, 94% on first exam and 96% on second, he also drops your lowest test grade. Currently in it right now, don't know what all the rest are complaining about

You will learn nothing from him her talks about unrelated stuff his PowerPoints are worthless. My TA taught me everything. Have to study some for the exams but not too bad. The homework helps a lot attendance not so much. As long as you do well on the homework and understand he really wants you to learn concepts you will do fine.

DO NOT TAKE! I wish I could say something positive, but this is not a professor that seems truly passionate about teaching or students. Present at ALL lectures, not helpful. Slides are not detailed for those who may not grasp concepts readily.  No book was used to refer back to if you got lost. Unapproachable, not helpful. TA was a better teacher

I had no problem with this class. It wasn't easy but as long as you follow along with the lectures you will be fine. The homework is a clear representative of how well you're doing in the class so if you struggle with the homework, get help! Exams are concept based so just pay attention and you will do fine in the class.

Worst psych professor I've EVER had.  Lectures consist of him rambling on about completely unrelated topics (child, wife, research).  Due to the rambling, lectures become an exercise in maintaining consciousness--good luck trying to take notes.  I self-taught all material.  Expects you to memorize all formulas. SAVE YOURSELF AND STAY FAR FAR AWAY.

Stats with him was long. He's a nice person, but the way he teaches is sometimes not clear. He also tends to drift during his lectures, so it's easy to space out. You get credit for attending lectures and discussions, so those are a good booster. Tests, you really need to prepare well for them. A lot of conceptual questions. Overall, he's OK.

Okay it's stats so I get it's going to be boring, but lectures with him are terrible....I only went cuz he does iclickers. His tests are worded weird sometimes, I would go with another teacher. If you get stuck with his class it's not a terrible thing, just be prepared for napping until he does clickers

Lectures are long because the material is inherently boring, but his excitementexamples show how important it is. The way to pass this class is to actually try. It's really conceptual, and he's willing to break down the idea but you have to actually put in effort. It's not so much math, but the theory of statistics.
He is very very boring but if you study your lecture notes and also read the book, you can pass the exam with an A.
He's very interesting speaker. I loved his class and it was fairly easy.

He was amazing! Lecture can get long & boring but its stats! He made everything so simple & easy to understand! provided great lecture notes & examples. Very fair grading system. I recommend him for all the nonmath people. He definitely made it a lot easier than other professors. Do your best on all HW and exams and you wont need to take the final.

Terrible professor, he's the worst psch 343 professor ever. His notes were vague and did not help when you needed to study for exams. His lectures are boring and the iclicker points don't even matter. The exam questions are all conceptual and he doesn't use the book at all. Take a different professor if you can, 0/10 would not recommend.

Worse professor in my college career. Extremely boring!!! Test are hard and he doesn't curve them. His notes are vague, disorganized, and many times not helpful. I would not recommend him, take a different professor if possible.

This is an awesome class to take with him! He posts recorded lectures online and uses class time as a discussion and cancels discussions on Fridays. This really helped because you didnt have to sit through boring lectures and further covered the concept in class. He also drops your lowest test grade and the final is SUPER easy!

He's a really straightforward guy. He explains the concepts in a simple manner so that students who are not good at statistics/math can understand. I ended up getting an A and I dislike math with a passion. Just study the powerpoints a little bit each day, cramming is not the best for the class. Also, iClickers, so attendance is mandatory.
A good professor..better than the rest.
DO NOT TAKE HIM! he is the worst professor that I have never had in my life. He taught 242 the same material as 343 which is the stats class. He used exactly the same slides. DONT TAKE HIM
Do not take him, he is just awful, he is not approchable to ask questions. Even their t.a think he is bad at teaching. his exams are hard, and he does not curve. Take some one else if you can
i liked him. I thought he taught well and was helpful. The tests were a bit hard. But I recieved a b.

IMO. Cons: no lectures (only online lec. vids), no discussions, in-class exercises (unhelpful sometimes) Pros: TAs were helpful, drops lowest test score, no textbook. What to expect: Nice guy, knowledgeable, but boring. Gets mad when people talk. 10-15pg paper. A lot of material you're expected to study per section, but little of it on tests.

HORRIBLE. He takes his 200 level psych class entirely too seriously. He's not at all approachable so don't bother asking him questions after class, he'll just make you feel stupid. He uses lecture time for discussion, posts lectures online, and cancels the discussion section. Worst professor I've had at UIC.

I don't like his way of teaching. His TA taught better than he did. All lecture videos are on blackboard. You need to attend class only for assignments other wise you don't get credit. 15 page paper is required. Icklicker 2 is mandatory! Exams are difficult!!! He gets disturbed very easily.

1. Lectures are boring. 2. Notes are kind of confusing and disorganized. 3. Tests are hard and vague. 4. I did not find him really approachable to ask questions. 5. I would find another professor for this class.
Horrible teacher, doesn't know how to teach. Taklu ruined everything
Avoid please, can't teach for his life. This taklu ruined everything.

I was really excited to be in this class, because I absolutely loved psych! This class changed my mind. The teacher was great at first, but as the semester he was horrible. The tAs in this class are not helpful at all. Also, go to class for the clicker ?s not so much material, its better off learning on your own. I would not recommend this class.

If you put in effort you can get the A, other wise it's an easy B. He drops your lowest test or you can skip the final. HW assignments were a good grade booster, and he drops your lowest grade so you can skip one. Discussion is helpful for test review, and lectures are mandatory for clicker points, if you talk he will call you out

Take a different professor if possible. You'll get by with him, but it'll be an upward road. Lectures are boring and dull and the exams are exceptionally hard and the questions are vague. The TAs for this particular section were very dogmatic and dimwitted. There was absolutely NO communication between them and the professor.

As others have mentioned his lectures are not the most interesting, you will have to fight "head bobbing" because credit is given for attendance. He is also picky on class noise for some reason, but even after all that I would strongly recommend someone take this class. TA was awesome and notes/study guides covered EVERYTHING on exam.Generous w e/c
He is a bit boring, but he is a nice guy. Exams aren't hard. There's no paper. iclicker required.

Awesome professor. I took his class in the 4 week summer session and it was well worth it. His lectures are right off the slides and 10% of your grade is just showing up to class. His tests are open book and open notes but and if you put a decent amount of time reading the book, you'll be set. He's one of the best professors I have taken at UIC.
Really considers the students stress and teaches an interesting class. Great guy. Great teacher.
VERY BORING! gets nervous when speaking. but very nice guy. tests are very straightforward.

I have taken Dr. Sargis three times for different courses and he was pretty easy, however he screwed me in 312 one of the short answer sections was missing otherwise I had a 100 percent, he did not care and I ended up getting a C.
Gives out pop quizzes so you need to go to class. homework assignments due in discussion. no paper. material can get boring. optional final. If you keep up with the material you'll be okay.

303 - Psych Writing. I was told by many that Dr. Sargis is easy, but if youre taking 303  it doesnt really matter bc all the grading is done by the TA. So LOOK UP THE TA! Has 4 easy in-class writeups, be in class for those. Has 4-5 online quizzes, 12/15 he counts as 100%. they arent too easy though. Basically, 3 papers in this class graded by TA.

The bestttt prof at UIC. He is real nice and sweetheart. Don't bother to buy the book. I always studied his slides the day before exam and got 93% and above. paper is graded super easily. Lectures are not useful but are interesting because he tells his stories. Minute papers are the only reason for going to the lecture but its not bad atall.
PROS: easy tests, some interesting personal stories, dont really need the book-power points enough, Cons: boring, paper sucked, reads power points.

I thought this prof. was tough! The HW is easy (6), pop quizzes(?) are annoying. The (4) exams  are crazy!!Your never really sure what he means in his exam ?'s. Overall if ur Looking for an EZ prof. think again. u must work your butt off for this one. He tries to help but its not always successful when ur bad at interpreting #s in this class!
i went to class the first ten weeks but then realized that i didnt have to after taking 2 of his exams. Dont have to read book. Just study powerpoint... pretty easy!

Attendance is a must due to the pop quizzes he gives out.  The homeworks are easy points, and the exams are not that bad.  Overall, this class is pretty straight forward, and Sargis is a good professor.

i had sargis for social psychology. he posts all the lecture notes online so i would just read over those instead of going to class. tests are pretty simple and he gives you study guides which make them easier. a fair teacher for sure. he kinda looks like dr. evil though...

all of the other psych 242 teachers are MUCH easier! he gives pop quizzes in his BORING lectures and if you miss them then it automatically prevents you from getting an A. His tests got MUCH harder from last year since he learned a lot of students cheated on them..
To sum up Sargis and this class in two words: EASY and BORING!

Tests are very fair-more of explaining the reasoning.  Less math calculations and those are very easy.  He drops 1 test, 1 homework assignment, and 1 pop quiz.   Textbook is not mandatory-go to class and it's easy.  Take 343 with him!

The Professor is very Fair. His exams are easy...require studying but not bad.  Not multiple choice. Short Answer and solve math problems. There are pop quizes are are worth a lot of pts so come to class every time! No paper..just 6 hmwrk assignments that are very easy. He also doesnt like people talking during class so dont try or he'll call u out
Very fair teacher. Study guides are exactly whats on the exams. Easy A if you do the study guides and look off his power points. Would recommend for any class!

Great teacher.Knows how to teach; lectures and notes on exactly what's on the test to a T. His study guides are great. Class can get a little boring, though.And you have to attend class everyday b/c he has frequent pop quizzes.

Nice but the most BORINGGGGGGG lectures evr!!! I was so bored I had to leave and I never leave a lecture. I'm very anal about my grades but he is so BORINGGGGGGGGGG AHHHHHH monotone voice and he does not talk about anything
Cool guy. Class wasn't boring and notes are clear. Study a little for the tests and write a solid paper and it's an easy A.

Imagine a boring person who nags non-stop. This is Sargis in a nutshell. Tests are alright, classes lull you to sleep and do not bother buying the textbook- everything is on blackboard *this is a good thing considering the books are ~$100!

I had him for three classes, I had nothing against him as a professor, but he is very fair which can sometimes turn out to be a bad thing. On one exam, I forgot to answer the short answer question(the page was hidden) and he told me he could not let rewrite the answers. Very nice guy, excellent professor, I just wish he could take account the situa

Lectures are good, but sometimes his explanations take a long time to get to the point (ie how to do a problem). Homework, quizzes, and tests are all reasonable. No attendance in lecture, just occasional quizzes. Nice guy who seems to like students. Recommend for required Stats.
I thought he was a great lecturer. One of the only professors in the department whose lectures are pleasant experiences. However I thought his personality was kind of annoying.

Very Clear..exams are straight forward off of the powerpoints. He has pop quizzes, so go to class if u want an A.  there are hw assigments that are ok, not hard. You dont even need to use the book. Overall good teacher, very clear.

His class is VERY straight forward. Go to class always because he gives pop quizzes. You can get an A pretty easily if you turn in all your work and get good grades on them. His lectures are a bit bland. He puts notes on BB, so you can follow along when you're tired. I would take him for future classes.

decent class, study your notes and go to class and you will do good, quizes are a pain but just look over your notes before class and pay attention in class. there was no book for the class and if you want a good laugh try to make him do the math problems without a calculator.

Fair and knowledgeable.  Go to class and take notes on his powerpoints.  All you need to study are his powerpoints if you take good notes on them.  Study hard for first set of exams and then you will have a good grade and won't have the take the optional final.  One less final at the end of the semester is an awesome thing.
He's a little shy, but an awesome teacher. The class is really boring, but it's because of the material. The pop quizzes are usually about the lecture he's going to present for the day.

I enjoyed his class and his teaching abilities. Quizes were a pain in the b  but I learned that If you read befr you go to class an A you get all possible points with no prob. You had 2 study 4 the exams but were doable. Hmwrk were nerve-racking 2 but u had to do it and it helped a lot 4 the exams. Make sure 2 find a classmate to do hmw w/ it helps

He is a really good professor.  I would take him again for a future class I need. He's funny, fair, and very straight forward. He gives out quizzes & minute papers but will drop lowest scores at the end of the semester.

I had Dr. Sargis for Psych 303 and 242. As far as I am concerned he is a great professor very fair. As long as you make a effort you will probrobly walk out with atleast a B. I am taking him again for 312 that's how much I like this guy
AWESOME! One of my favorite teachers at UIC!!!!

This professor is great! I loved going to class, although it can be a bit boring sometimes.  The pop quizes are a problem though because they dont accurately measure if you have been attending class or not. I go to class every day and i havent gotten above a 50/100, except for one time. but overall, this teacher is great!! :)

The only reason ppl do not like him is because of those pop quizzes but, As I reflect upon the course based on the grade. I don't think I would have paid this much attention to the class if he didtn have them,

Well people say the lectures are really boring, I would disagree if your interested in psychology his lectures  are not that bad.  I mean I had Dr Pavone before Sargis and I thought he was rather boring so I don't think I am one to complain about professors.  Sargis was ok at lecturing. His tests can be tough
Very boring lectures, but fairly easy class. Go over your notes before class and you will do good on the quizes.

I really liked the class and all the only problem were those pop quizzes. I know the pop quizzes are soppused to see if you were here or not but, they did not measure this.  I went to every class and got Bs on the quizzes. He should have just have a mandatory attendence policy.  Overall  he is a okay professor.
easy but lots of memorizing 120 words per exam

Ok guys heres the scoop on this guy, Generally speaking he is a really awesome guy, very nice, will help you out whenever possible. In general his exams are very strait forward EXCEPT his statistics one. The wording on that exam is very ambigious.Otherwise its a pretty decent class, He is a pretty lively/interesting professor.

Compared to the other professors I have heard this guy is a better teacher. I would agree he really is a great teacher everytime you walk into his class you understand every word he says. The only prob with his class are the pop quizzes even if u go to the class but do not know the material ull not fair well.
good teacher.. fairly easy for 200 level class...very boring though...go to class. read notes and do good on pop quizes and u should be fine...exams are fairly easy...straight from the material
Class is extremely boring! but easy as long as you have the notes(which he posts on blackboard) there is no reason u should not get an A

He's a bit unapproachable, but his class is fair. He's good at explaining the material, and posting notes and material online. Overall the class is fair. The only problem was the pop quizes...:( make sure you go to class...

i really liked him. he puts all the lectures on blackboard so you really don't have to take notes during class. he's big on attendance tho and has "minute papers" occasionally to take attendance in lectures. there are 4 tests total, and he drops lowest score. 2 short, easy papers.if you do your work, you should be able to get an A easily.
He's okay. He's tests are esay and he's pretty good at explaing the material. It's a bit boring but he's always willing to answer any questions you have.  The only problem is those damn pop quizes!

Very good professor. Although his lectures are long and boring, it's not exactly his fault. Exams aren't too hard (multiple choice), but about 5 chapters worth of material is covered on each of his 3 exams. Cares about his students mental well being (had a personal issue that he was more than happy to help with). Papers are easy.

He is so BORING but so EASY. he gives "minute papers" at random times througout the semester but they are only worth 1 or 2 pts. so it's no big deal if you miss one. You don't really have to go to lecture because the slides are online and he reads straight from them, tests are easy.
he is hard and boring.
Very esay class.  His exam are directly off his lecture notes.
His class is easy but you have to go to lecture for the pop quizzes.  He lectured straight from the power point slides which can get kind of boring.

I had class with Dr. Sargis a while ago, when he first started teaching. I think he's great. He is very clear in what he expects and that is what makes the classes easy. His notes are clear and always available throgh blackboard. If I could I'd take him again. He may be dry but he makes up for it in other ways. If you can you should take his class.
Great. Very helpful.
He was a bit annoying, but he was very helpful when possible. For those who hate statistics, I would recommend him, just because you can get an A or a B with hard work.

He makes this hard class seem like a joke..very easy..exam avg are in the high 80's..extra credit..easy hw to boost your grade..but make sure you go to class..he gives pop quizzes which count for a lot. so long as you go to class..the least anyone can get is a B..A is very doable. Infact majority of the class got A's..Its like a 100 level class.
Kind of annoying, but gets the job done.

He sometimes goes off on tangent during lectures and if you don't sit near the front, you may fall asleep.  He's a new professor though, so cut him some slack!  Overall I think he's a good professor.  Fair.  He drops your lowest test score.

All his lectures are on blackboard, make sure you go to all the classes because he has pop quizzes, but the quizes and tests are straight from the notes and fairly easy, he drops the lowest exam and lowest quiz, The TAs grade easily and the homework is just easy points

The minute papers are actually only 5% of your grade. not 15%!!! And he drops one of those so you can miss and still have the 5%. He's helpful when you go see him. very nice, but women do freak him out. Over all I'd say he's a great professor and the class was not too difficult.

Dr. Sargis gives five exams each semester and the lowest exam grade is eliminated. The exams are multiple choice and essay questions. Dr. Sargis gives minute papers, which are worth 15% of your grade and to earn the 15%, you must show up to calss everday. He posts his lecture notes on blackboard.
Nice guy, but a bit aloof. Not easy to talk to one on one, especially with woman. Seems shy around woman.
Decent teacher.  Only one paper .. but a lot of exams 5 total including the final

She is a really great professor. I will be taking a second half of Business Law that she is teaching. One of the best UIC professors. Very intelligent and sarcastic. makes a three hour class fly by. If you can take her, don't miss out on the opportunity to have a great experience and learn from this great person.

Elieen's a great professor that knows her stuff. There's two exams work 50% of your grade each, no homework. Everything you need to know is covered in class. If you don't go, you're stuck reading a HUGE law book trying to figure it out. Definitely a class you WANT to attend because her lectures are amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: It takes an amazing teacher to make an 8am Business Law class the highlight of your day.. She's an amazing, hilariously sarcastic and intelligent person, lucky to have had her this semester. Also! TAKE THIS CLASS SIMULTANEOUSLY WITH MANAGEMENT 350 if possible; they're like the same class, what you learn in one will help you in the other.

Hilarious professor! Definitely a morning class I don't mind going to. The structure is weird because there's only a midterm and a final, so you really need to know your stuff. Insane amount of reading, but you can skirt around most of it if you attend every class.

This class was actually very easy. I don't know why people are saying she is harsh and the class was hard. Maybe it was before, but Dr. Pirozhenko right now is a very reasonable grader and if you just follow the prompt for the essays and complete ALL of her feedback suggestions, you will get an A! The fairytales were also very interesting to read.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Her class seems tough but put in your best effort and you will get a good grade. My class was pleasantly surprised by their grades.

Ok, she is the worst FWS instructor i've ever seen. No only does she give out very unclear instruction and a lot of work for a FWS class, she is arrogant and not helpful at all. She literally gives the harshest comments on your paper and never tells you how to improve on. One suggestion: DONT TAKE HER CLASS!!!

I had her for my freshman year writing seminar. She has very high expectations, assigning long, high-level readings. The class wasn't easy but it was probably the most useful class I've taken in improving my writing. Helped a lot for my college career. Her humor might be a little hard to get but she genuinely wants to help her students.

This class was a disaster. She turned something fun like reading fairy tales into math proofs This class was extremely difficult to get a good grade. The first exam average were around 70s, then the final was a 40% with no curve and we begged for one and never happened. The papers were no help. Only one person got a B and the rest c's, d's, & f's.

Dr. Pirozhenko's class required a lot of time, a novel was expected to be read each week, but her class was the best one I've taken at UIC to date. Awesome professor, truly invested in her students and their endeavors both in and outside of class. She's moving onto Cornell, unfortunately for UIC students, but I wish her the best!
Very picky on papers. Exams aren't too shabby, but 1000 pages of reading a week. The only easiest thing about her class was attendance. That's it.

She requires a lot of reading, but your fine if u sparknote it all, but it is an honors course, so what do you expect? She is an absolute doll, and explains everything and gives good backgrounds on texts. Amazing class!!! She grades fairly and honestly and you learn a lot.
Takes her job seriously. Very intelligent, teaches well. Class is too hard for a simple honors class. LOTS of reading. Must participate. She's a great teacher, though a bit condescending.

Worked very hard, everyone did bad in this class, was supposto be an easy class and it was very hard, grades very hard on essays, when she herself cant spell or write. Harsh grader, grades you on participation without telling you, everyone did badly in her class just pick any other teacher and youll be fine.

The essays can be tough if you haven't done any of such nature. This class changes the way you think about everything. If would recommend recording his lectures and listen to them before tests.

Engelmann is pretty boring. He's very monotone and doesn't have a set lesson. The homework he gave out consisted of readings. Readings are semi-interesting. If you attend every lecture and take notes you should get a B or above. The essays are pretty easy, just make sure you are on track. I wouldn't take the class again, especially with Engelmann

Took this class as a freshman and i loved it now I'm a political science major. lectures sometimes dragged but overall i really enjoyed his class. Loads of reading and you really have to attend lecture especially if you don't read. Test are not multiple choice.

It's a boring class, unfortunately. You just read a lot of dead people. The readings are a bit boring, unless you're a fan of political theory. In order to do well, you really should do your readings, which there are a lot of. His lectures are a bit longwinded and hard to follow. I understood the readings from discussion section with my TA.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! I hated it. It requires alot off reading from the 1800s & it just is so boring. We only have 4 grades so if you screw up one, then you pretty much are screwed. Attendence to lecture is also mandatory..

I really enjoyed this class a lot.Although, he is a very hard grader! I attended all classes and read all the texts assigned...Still did not receive the grade I wanted. :/ Overall, good professor and an enjoyable class.

Have to read over ten books, must be the ones from bookstore too. Must read a different book each week and write a paper on it for the following week. Two very large papers that cover multiple books. No final. Do not take this class. It requires so much work! The books are long! Understand that you will be reading AT LEAST one per week.

Only take this class if you have a legitimate interest in political theory. Otherwise you will be bored out of your mind. If you show up to class most of the time and can write a good paper you'll be fine. Readings can be dense but you'll learn a lot. He scans readings so you don't have to spend a ton on books which is really helpful.
Prof. was very help in explaining the text that was covered in class. Does sometimes ramble on, on off topics. Overall a good class. No textbooks assigned, just print-outs.

His lectures are boring and go off tangents a bit...but the material is interesting. Lectures and especially TAs help the readings be comprehensible. Gives a good grasp and good foundation of polisci. I suggest taking Cliff as your TA. I didn't really read the readings which are long and boring. I slacked off and got a B+.

I dont understand why all the comments about Engelmann are so negative. He's a great professor, my favorite yet. Hes very willing to help with anything and is really devoted to the material he teaches. The theories/ readings are not really hard, just kinda long and boring sometimes.But he's really clear on explaining the main points of the peices.

I think he's getting a bad rap. I am a freshman taking his POLS 120 course and I think it's going just fine. The midterm was really easy. I waited until the morning it was due to write my first paper and got a 75, what I deserved. If you do the reading and take notes, you will be fine. The T.A.s are also really helpful.
Make sure you NEVER take this class as a freshmen, his class is so hard and the papers are long and tough. He treats you like graduate students

I actually really enjoyed this class. The reading is a **** and lectures are sort of hard to follow, but the TA's help out a lot. Attendance was taken every lecture and discussion group. Midterm was easy if you do the reading. Papers are graded sort of tough so don't save to the last minute or you wont sleep the night before. And he's really funny

He talks too much like an academic, but his T.A.s are awesome. They help the students get what is going on in the class. If you don't read, you may have some difficulty with the class, but the T.A.s are there to help you out a lot. Bit of a train of thought note giver, doesn't make it easy to study for his tests, which is kinda bad. Good Luck.
don't take this guy unless your a poli sci major or had at least two poli sci classes in the past. he teaches like we are grad students. the TA's are really good though.

The T.A. is a real tough grader when it comes to the papers. The prof grades the test. When he graded the midterm he was very leniant, but the final he graded it really hard. I really got screwed over by the final!

Engelmann is one of the greatest professors at UIC. His lectures are often amazing. For 120, you must keep up with the readings (about 100 pages a week) and come to all of the lectures. It is difficult to take organized notes in lecture, but discussion clarifies the main topics. Take this class if you are prepared to dedicate some time to reading and analysing the texts.  As for 390, be prepared for about 400 pages of reading a week. One more thing: Engelmann very very rarely gives and A on a paper.
The best professor I ever had-I will remember him forever

This class is basically two exams and two essays, the tests (graded by a TA) were fairly easy and graded leniently, the papers however were not. His grading method may be suited to 300 level courses but is far to stringent for on intro theory class
Decent workload, interesting readings.  He grades the papers himself though, and he's a tough grader.

One of the best classes I've taken. Prof is well spoken and interesting. Readings were quite interesting and intelligently picked to demonstrate the themes of the class and were not excessive.  Paper topics were reasonable (choices!) and graded fairly leniently.  Midterm and final was easy.
No Comments
No Comments
medium workload and engaging lectures

Eni is such a sweet and caring person. She wants her students to succeed. This class is discussion-based, so participation does matter. There are 4 writing projects plus one mini presentation at the end. There isn't a lot of homework, and she is very flexible with grading and extensions. Make sure to fulfill the correct # of pages in each project.

Eni was so nice and caring; she is really passionate about the class topic, and participation does matter. However, she makes you feel welcome to share your opinions and thoughts about the topics discussed in class. There isn't a heavy amount of work to do, so it isn't a class that you would need to spend a ton of time on.

Eni is a really sweet professor. She also knows when to take a break, she sometimes has class over zoom or cancels it. She is passionate about what she lectures, her lectures may be a lot and she always expects participation but she makes up for it by being an amazing professor. She also lets us out usually 5-10 minutes early too.

She's so sweet, caring, and understanding. She's my favorite professor. She tries her best to make sure everyone is comfortable in class, and doesn't feel left out. Also, when you submit your drafts for papers, she gives feedback where it is needed, and it is very helpful feedback that helps a lot to improve the quality of your writing. :)

There wasnt an option but I took Engl247 with her. She was so kind and always accepted extensions. Her grading criteria is very straight forward, make sure you hit page count and always cite. Aside from that, doing the participation assignments will really make or break your grade. But she was so kind and funny and made for a great semester

She's very sweet. Some readings you need to do, but honestly aren't really mandatory, as long as you skim before class lol. 10/10, will take again. She's an easy grader too, as long as you have your academic sources and do the work right like if it needs to have 3 pages, then do the 3 pages. Doesn't have to be perfect though.

Takes a long time to grade, but she will always give extension and is super nice to talk to. She cares about her students a lot and is a very open to talking about ways to improve the class. She really only cares about you participation and willingness to learn.

Don't take the class unless you like the topic of the class. You will be reading a lot of passages together as a class, like popcorn reading that you did in elementary school. Also, be prepared to write 2-3 discussion boards a week on the reading. Finally, she takes forever to grade your second draft and ends up moving the due date back 48 hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class is very research and writing focused, be prepared for all the assignments. The exams are difficult and test your ability to apply the knowledge and interpret what the numbers mean. The professor is very good with the material. Yes, the lectures can be boring due to the amount of information, but she is willing to answer any questions.

Ellen Engel is the stereotypical example of what people think accountants are. Boring and Bland. I have never experienced a teacher with the most uninteresting lectures. I had to primary work for my A in this class harder than most just because of how bland she made the topics seem. Please avoid this teacher, there are other electives.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Be prepared to prioritize this class over others. Lectures are extremely boring, but they are really important for passing exams. The project is pretty difficult and heavy, and it doesn't help she's an extremely difficult grader. It isn't impossible to do OKAY in this class, but it will take large amount of effort.

She is friendly and very knowledgeable. The class is time-consuming due to lots of papers and group projects. Tests are lecture heavy and you really have to understand what you are learning rather than memorize. Tough grader but you will learn if you put in the effort.

Professor Ellen is great! Her lectures are easy to follow, especially if you take notes when she breaks things down into simple terms. The only caution would be the amount of individual/group work - research/memo writing heavy, get ready for that. She will give you everything that you need but honestly wish we did more in-class examples/practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Theres definitely a disconnect between the tests and material, but at least she cares about the subject? Wasn't my favorite prof, but she did curve and when I know what I should've gotten a C, she gave me a B. She cares about her students, even if the class is a little tough. Just do the work, participate, and you'll at least get a B.

HW&exams are not curved, she curves at the end. The grades are released so late &there is little to no feedback on why you got marked off. On the midterm she knowingly had a confusing typo, did not annouce it, expected YOU to realize it was a typo ¬ a trick question &ask her about it individually. If you like slow boring torture, take the class.

Don't take this class with her under any circumstance. So much homework, longest most miserable lectures you could ever think of, and little to no guidance on work. She refuses to record lectures, so if you miss class, you might as well drop out of her course. Be ready for countless, useless assignments that don't prepare you for exams whatsoever.

Two big group projects, irrelevant hw's, and assigned readings that no one reads. The midterm and final have nothing to do with the hw and there's just a disconnect as she rambles about acctg. standards. Assignments are due at weird times and I really wish I had a choice to take this w/ someone else. I actually hate acctg. research bc of her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Hardest class I ever took, but she is extremely caring and wants to help you learn.  Insanely passionate about what she teaches, which is really cool.  Had to do lots of work and studying outside the class.  She is fair and she grades on a curve.

If this is your first time doing some math after high school, I'll think twice before taking the class with her. She is great, very knowledgeable, smart and she will be there for you to help you out, but the workload is very heavy and you will spend way more time than what it is scheduled for this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I took the ACTG 500 course in Fall 2017. Professor Engel is very good, but this course ACTG 500 is extensive you need to be detail oriented. 1) You need to work hard and put in a decent effort. 2) Decent amount of home works. 3) Do the practice exams. Most term exam questions come from them. 4) Liberal grader. But many practice exams

Ambitious in exposing students to as much accounting topics as possible. Large amount of class did not feel confident with producing the fundamental accounting reports by end of semester. Each student has own takeaways at end. Tons of textbook exercises that ended up not helping with exams. Lots of individual effort needed outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Hours of reading and homework are assigned weekly. The homework is pass/fail with zero feedback. Your grade rests (almost) entirely on the midterm and final exam. She leaves no time for questions in class. She does not review areas where the class seems to be struggling (based on homework/tests) Advice: Her tests are JUST like the practice exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Requires mandatory attendance. The prof. Is nice and friendly. Most students end up with an A
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Absolutely no grade feedback is given until it is way too late! This professor also lowers your grade for not "participating", which means talking a lot. You have to come to every class as well, or at least most. A very tough grader for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is a great professor to have. However, like most art classes go, you are unable to check on your grade until after it is too late. So, work hard on your projects. Despite participating a fair amount, I found she was unforgiving about the participation in class. So, if you're taking an online class with her, please participate a lot!
Shir is a good teacher. Lots of fun but class is sort of tedious. Not take clique pictures. And really helps you evolve your photography. Only can miss 3 classes a semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Ziedan is very passionate and enthusiastic which makes it hard to feel like there is a dull moment in class. Models were explained in detail and the economic theory in the class was made very comprehensible through the lectures. Incredibly interesting, but a tough grader with some occasionally confusing test questions. Great class + prof

Favorite Econ class. Have not been a fan of the curriculum at uic but this class was definitely worth showing up to. Engy's lectures were both useful and engaging. Engy does a great job of explaining STATA, which looks great on a resume. Information in lectures is crucial text book won't provide all the answers
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Engy is very helpful. Lectures were very well organized, homework challenging. Tests were fine. Don't skip class and pay attention and you will get an A. She's always willing to help.

Lectures were clear and organized. The material was presented well and many examples were given which helped understand the more difficult material. Weekly homework, one midterm and a final. The exams were easy. As long as you keep coming to class and pay attention, the class is an easy A!

She is tough but very helpful. If you do not go to class, you will not do well(and she will say something to you). She takes attendance almost every time, but her lectures are amazing (so interesting and you learn a ton!). I got a B in econometrics but learned more than my friends who took the class with other instructors.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Honestly the least professional teacher I met throughout undergrad, and I had a much tamer experience with her than a lot of the other people in my class. There are many many horror stories about this woman out there, and she isn't fit to be in leadership/teaching position. Regularly made students feel uncomfortable and even unsafe in some cases.

Kathryn Engel was unhinged. When I met with her 1:1 to go over internship opportunities, she told me her life story about how she is ABD and about her mother holding her back. She later tried to ruin my chances of getting an internship. I think she was envious of how people open up to me (even her) and what that means for my career in psych.

I took Professor Engel's class and she let me join an organization that rehabilitates men who committed domestic violence. I was the youngest person, the only undergrad, and no one made sure I was truly ready for that level of work or that my mental health was okay.
She was incredibly disorganized. Huge ego. Challenging to work with. One of the worst professors in psych.
doesnt necessarily teach on material. very critical.
Kathryn Engel is a horrible professor. Run do not walk away from her.

Extremely intelligent professor. She knows what she's talking about and has experience in the field. The best class I took at UIC. It will hands down be the most applicable course in life. As a person going into this field, her feedback and knowledge of the subject is A+. You will leave the class more well rounded and with a better sense of self.

Professor Engel, is one of the most professional professors I have meet at UIC. She is  tough but fair. Is always open to students that stop by her office hours. I learned a lot of me through her. She is passionate of her work and is able to transmit that to the class. She is also very dedicated, answers emails even on weekends. Love her class!

This class was extremely helpful. I had a great internship, and the paper took up most of my time. However, because this class is front loaded, you're done by the end of the semester. Kathryn cares a lot about her students and wants them to succeed. Take this class with her and you're set for success.

Engel cares about you and wants to be of help in her field. I haven't had her for a specific class, but she is the Director of Internships and if you are an Applied Psych major like me, you will need to spend some time in her office for internship placement. She wants every student to have a good site match and to make the most of their internship.

Her lectures are not boring, but I felt the class was easy. We didn't do role plays like she said we would, but I got an A. I read the book on my own and just attended class. But I heard for PSCH 385 to not take her and she gives you a lot of work and other stuff how she's mean to students as well.

Had her for 381 and 385.  Very knowledgeable and straight forward.  Had issues with being dropped from first internship site-  she was very understanding about the situation and made realistic goals together on when assignments were due.  Ended up being hired by my site and have her to thank for invaluable interviewing and professional preparation.

This professor knows her stuff and I learned a lot from her class. However, do not attempt to ask her for a letter of recommendation for graduate school because she is very intimidating and I left her office feeling very discouraged.If you have a choice, ask someone else. Otherwise, approach her with caution.

She is a very good professor. If you did not do well in the class it is because you did not put  effort into it. The course itself is very demanding only because of the internship. She is very helpful if you go to her office hours and get to know her. She prepares you for the world after graduation. I could not thank her enough for her help.

I highly recommend Dr. Engel. Especially if you are a psych major, you should definitely take a course with her. She is extremely passionate and knowledgeable in the field. As long as you put effort, you will do well!

Everyone saying that she is a bad professor is focusing on the poorly structured class. She didnt really teach this class, each student was assigned a TA to write their paper with. She does a good job prepping you for the real world. While the class is very stressful and front-loaded, by the end of the semester, youre already done with everything!

If you are taking Psch 385, do not take it with Engel.  Avoid it at all costs.  It will make you miserable/frustrated/hate your life at the moment.  Very unhelpful and not understanding at ALL!  Intimidating nonetheless & rude.  Don't make the mistake I did. Take it with another professor if u can.

Word to the wise:  Do not take this course with K Engel.  Cons of this course:  Vague syllabus, disorganization,  no focus on the actual "internship" experience/process.  The whole class is about your applied research project, in a nutshell. Talks over you, not to you.   Which is not direct/helpful, but RUDE!  Loved my internship-hated the class

AMAZING professor.  I learned a lot in this course.  I was intimidated by the interviewing portion of this course, but she makes sure you are well trained before you do your interview.  I would highly recommend her for this course.

We took a midterm in this class and everyone did poorly...but in the end, it wasn't even included in our final grade? She is helpful if you ask for help. The book is not very helpful. She tends to attack you if you ask the wrong questions, and she also talks too much...overall a good professor though. I would recommend her for this particular class

It is amusing how she attempts to teach others the principals of professional etiquette when she herself has none. She is unorganized, unclear about instructions and rude. Do yourself a favor, save some nerves and take another instructor.

Took 381interviewing n she was helpful,understanding, n straightforward BUT not so much for this class. When u ask her for help,she answers u but not ur questions. Can be a bit condescending. The 3 cr hrs definitely DOES NOT equal the work load for this class. Too much to do while at the same time having your internship.This class is too stressful.

This course has tons of work and 3credit hours doesn't seem fair. Internship in addition to papers and projects.. You have to process her words 3 times to understand what she's saying. Confusing syllabus. Very disorganized. Appears like she's helping you but turns it back to you. Likes to flip her hair..

Completely unorganized. The syllabus is vague and does not prepare you for the class. She never clarifies anything; instead refers you to the syllabus. She ignores 75% of what you say and then uses her psychological voo-doo powers on you, leaving you completely frustrated when you leave her office. Get an internship and forget the course credit!

I had heard horrible things about this prof, but I actually REALLY enjoyed the class and REALLY liked her. I think some people mistake her for being rude when she is actually just direct & "to the point". Make a point of being nice to her, etc. and she will be very nice to you in return. I would also recommend the 4 week course.

She's cool and incorporates stuff about relationships and attachment styles into her lectures because that's her specialty. There are like 8 pop "free writes" throughout the semester. Paper is basically your entire grade. No tests! Amanda LaBreche is best TA.

Very easy class.  Horrible lectures.  All she does is stand up there and flick her blonde hair around while she talks about relationships....which has nothing to do with writing in psych.  The TA's couldn't stand her.  3 papers in all.

I agree that she is a confidence killer. She is a pruned up old lady w/ no sense of humor who takes herself way too seriously. But take her class cuz it's easy as hell, the one catch is listening to her talk and adapting to her ultimate weirdness. Thats all other than that, it's easy.

had her for psch 303 and her class make no sense, her brain in everywhere,and the TA-jennifer sucks.she thinks she is an english teacher and not a psch ta.she and the prof were on 2 diff pages.she graded what she wanted to not what she was told to.i talked to the prof and told her my experience, i went from a D to a B.ta sucks!take her,but careful

I had heard some horror stories about her prior to taking her class, but had no choice. She seemed nice enough, but she could be a real confidence killer. The class itself had very little structure. It was a psych interviewing class, and we were supposed to practice the skills at least once per week. We only practiced 3x the whole 16-week semester!
Engel is a great professor for PSCH 381 and 385! and very friendly!

she is friendly, but her class structure makes no sense.  The syllabus is jumbled.  Worst of all, her curve is based on a distribution curve.  It is difficult to get an A, but you can practically fail the class and get a B.  Not fair to students who actually try.  I would NOT at all recommend her or ever take her again.

if you do not like writing, this is not the class for you. the paper is about 40% of your grade! her exams are ok. attendance is a must because she talks about things that arent in the book. Lectures are boring. if i could go back in time, i would have avoided taking this class with her.
unclear in directions and unorganized

I'm barely a month in to this class and I already despise it. She seems to be quite taken with herself and impressed that she's so *worldly* and *unbiased*. She's so taken that she's looked past the fact that she's neither. Aside from this, the class is easy, boring, and not much more challenging than high school sex ed or intro to psych courses.

Took her during summer and loved her class. Very helpful, clear, and interesting. I was worried about the bad comments I read here but found out it was not relevant. Tests were easy and straight forward her teaching style was professional, I thought. Not bad to look at.

I thought her personal stories were relevant to the material being learned and clarified some concepts. Getting started early on the paper is important! Taking good notes and reading the book was helpful. I got an A.
Horrible.
She does not know how to teach!! She talks a lot about her personal life and her two kids.
Awful teacher.

watching her flip her hair and makes me so annoyed.  but other than that she does know what she is talking about in the agencies and companies you are planning to take your internship at.  the paper has choppy topics but do-able.  you don't meet for class the majority of the semester because you will be with your group prepapring for presentation

I swear she is a cyborg nazi! Most unemotional professor I've had. She really does talk like a robot and makes a really great topic like developmental psychology into the most boring thing ever. If you have her for this class read the book, you'll learn more from it than from her!

I think she is a good person. You can totally tell that she loves the subject. Her lectures though are incredibly boring, kinda unbearable. But it's difficult to criticize her because she's such a nice person. Her tests arent that bad and it's crucial to do well on the final paper.

One of the worst professors out there.  She teaches that being unbias in psychology is important yet she is the most bias professor out there.  She does not watch what she says and is not very helpful.  She talks in a monotone and makes the class unberable.  It's too bad she is the only professor teaching certain classes in the applied field!

I took her class and I hated it. She is a very difficult professor to please. Her paper were very detail oriented and very time consuming. She made the class seem like a graduate course. She says that writing is the key to everything and wants to prepare us for graduate level writing. Bottom line the class is too tough!
No Comments
Too bad "anything libelous will be deleted" because I could really go off on her.  She is mean to say the least and her class is very hard.  Avoid taking a class with her if at all possible.
No Comments
Rather boring and repeatitive.  Talked very slowly with a southern drawl, kinda annoying

A bit monotonic, but she is still a great teacher.  She likes to get off on tangets about her own children, but they only help us understand more.  Her exams come straight from the book.  I only attended 9 lectures, but ended up getting an A in the class because I read the text.
She teachers straight out of the book.  I did not like this teacher because she was stuck-up and talked about her children all of the time.  Her tests were easy yet her class was very boring.
Lecture is boring; she talks in monotone.  I pulled off a B by going to the classes before the lectures and talking to my TA about the paper.  HUGE grading curves.
No Comments

Kathryn is pretty boring during her lectures, but her exams are really easy.  there is only one paper for this class and reading the book is helpful. her lecture notes are not really clear cus she dont write any. you just have to listen.

Super nice guy, very helpful and will also help you outside of class to prepare for Job Interviews if you ask him. His class is 75 minutes long and he would talk about sports, politics, economics etc. for at least 15 minutes each class. Do not take the class if you do not like talking in front of the whole class.
Super funny teacher, smart, nice and easy A

This was a great class.  I learned alot from Ennuso.  He is a really interesting guy.  Runs marathons, was in the military, worked for many different companies, and travels.  His class was always interesting.  Theres a few quizes and a final projct worth about half your grade.  I recommend this teacher.  One of my top best.

The professor's lectures are engaging. Even though attendance is not mandatory, most people attend them. He knows a lot about machine learning. The homework helped me understand the topics better, but I feel like some of it was not necessary. I would highly recommend taking the class, as it is not hard to get good grades.
Chill professor, provides fundamental understanding of ML

I did really well on both midterms (top 5) and got 1st place on the final, but still ended up with a B. The instructor accused me of copying a homework assignment (which I did not), without providing any explanation or evidence, and used a threatening tone. Without a single doubt, he was one of the worst instructors I have ever seen in my life.

He was the worst professor I ever had in both my undergrad and grad semesters. His accent made him  aggressive. He accused students of plagiarism, provided no evidence, and even gave -30 on the HW he thought we used other students' work. He had a threatening tone and would not allow to object to his decisions. DO NOT TAKE ANY COURSE WITH THIS GUY.

He did not provide preparation material for the exam. Just some papers from previous years from which it was completely far
The midterm was ok but for the final exam he raised the difficulty to the moon. 
The second part of the course covered lots of topics in a very rough way, would have been better to focus on less topics but explaining them well

The professor is very exam oriented. He has 7 hws in the course which are only worth 20% of your grade whereas exams carry 80% of your grade. On top of that the exams were nowhere close to the past papers nor like he had claimed them to be. He turned the analytical based exam into a theory based exam which was opposite of what he had claimed.

Very exam centric subject (80% exams and just 20% HW). Past papers used to include mostly analytical and numerical questions whereas this year he switched it to a theoretical exam. The professor claimed the exam won't require extensive memorizing which was far from true. I would strongly recommend against this course unless he changes his approach.

The professor makes a strong attempt to explain on concepts in class by delving into details of the topic of discussion. The homeworks may feel a little tedious to do, but I found them super rewarding. Contrary to other opinions, I took the subject in my first semester and found it on the easier side.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: If your an ece or a cs grad this class is essential as a Ai/Machine Learning course. I liked it although at some points i wanted to dive deep into hot lava cause i wasnt able to do the homeworks. The grading is heavily curved so focus more on learning. If this is your first sem DO NOT take this class you'll find it very difficult to cope
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Homeworks and exams were not connected well, but other than that he has a knack for explaining tough concepts. He has improved the content of the course to include more relevant tools (pytorch, keras). He has a funny, blunt rapport with students

Course content is severely outdated. His homeworks repeat every semester, so people have posted solutions online. Hence everyone copies and median of some not so easy homeworks hit 100. But good learning curve, if you wish to learn the basics and work hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: A professor that listens to students. Talks mostly about the Nerual Network basic theories, I was expecting it to be at higher level, using existing libraries. You could skip one exam and one homework during the semester, that's nice. Exams aren't too hard so long as you pay attention in classes and do the hws(quiet a few, some not easy).

The guy has not understanding of what it takes to actually have students learn anything in a class. Then expects students to be able to reproduce results from something that was not covered in class or the book specifically.

Lectures are terrible and very boring to following along with. Many times he would just sit at his desk and read from a power point that wasn't even his own. No test prep materials, so the tests could be anything

The written portion of the test 2 is very very hard. The excel part isn't too bad if you do the labs. This class taught me some valuable excel skills which is great. There are a good chunk of lab assignments to do each week but they are manageable. Overall, it's a useful class but the tests can be pretty difficult.

Exams are hard, but there is a slight curve.

He's okay after this course I refuse to take another course with him. Maybe it's just because this course is super project-heavy. The books and projects are super expensive, get ready to spend close to $300, and they're very boring, difficult, and not really valuable.

reviews.comment: multiple attempts on the labs McGraw labs which was nice. There is a lot of content that needs to be learned and he only gives you 2 days to study for it. he drops the lowest grade for the labs. SHOW UP FOR LABS
Not a bad professor, but wasn't amazing. Lectures can be a bit boring, but attendance isn't required. Overall, a pretty safe pick though. Not a hard class, just do the work and you'll do fine.

Participation is counted at the end of the class based on a group effort. If she doesn't think its good enough, she will say it out loud. However, she does give a two week grace period for certain assignments. She's a sweet woman, but class is SO BORING considering its online and 3 hours...

Prof. Erdal is usually busy during the class session and might be hard to reach at that time so I'd advice that you email her with questions or concerns, she's a lovely women and very friendly when you meet her one on one.

This Professor was terrible. She would call people out in class and criticize your work in front of everyone. She also has a heavy accent that makes it difficult to understand her. She likes to embarrass people in class and will ignore you if she decides that she doesn't like you. Beware.

She's a hilarious diva, and her slides were well-made. She didn't make us take the final bc of what's going on in the world (ICE, ect..) and how worried we all were abt it. what a queen. very genuine and willing to work with you. I wish she did have a study guide for the exams though. She talks fast, hard to take notes. Very flexible- just communicate. Grading a little strict. Pro- little hw.

Favorite professor of all time. Her lectures were engaging, funny, & facilitated participation well. The group project is a breeze, but it's hard to organize 6 people. Lenient grades give lots of room for growth. The (1) test is well made to reflect the course. There is a lot of cool info in this class; Erielle introduces it in a relatable way.

Funny professor, but the group project and the one singular exam wasn't funny. Cumulative exam, unclear project instructions, hard to get contact info of group members. Rambles on and reads off slides...

I enjoyed that she engaged with her students and related to us making the class more entertaining, but lectures felt like when students read off a powerpoint when presenting. There's only one cumulative exam and when it came to preparing for it or for the group projects, it was a mess.

I found myself really enjoying her lectures, but once the group project and exam came around it was not fun at all. 10/10 Professor. A little rough around the edges, and the quizzes can be a bit ambiguous. Other than that, would take again. Very supportive of his students, and responds to emails super quick (sometimes even minutes).

He is very clear and concise about what he wants from you and to be honest, just coming to class and paying attention is all you need to do. He's pretty goofy too

Graded on only a few things, but Dr. Erez is accessible outside of class and will provide any help you need. Highly recommend taking a class with her if you can, she is very knowledgable.

reviews.comment: Dr. Erez is an amazing professor and person. She truly cares about her students and expanding their knowledge in Criminology, Law, and Justice. 10/10 would recommend.

When you ask a question, she answers you but doesnt answer the question. She just talks about unnecessary things that do not relate.

Dr. Erez is okay, but she does push her pro Israeli views a lot in class. If you can get past that without too much drama she is an okay lecturer.

She's really slow and says you are reliable to listen, comprehend, read book and ace.

Interesting topics with international examples

She is a very nice professor overall, very understanding. She doesn't really teach, she has others teaching for her; a lot of guest speakers. Everything on her exams is fair game. Interesting class! 2 exams (multiple choice) very easy as long as you read the powerpoints and take notes in class, lots of guest speakers, 1 GIANT research paper worth half of the overall grade as well as a presentation on your research. TA was really helpful and if you communicate with Mrs.Erez if you have any problems, they will be easily solved
Interesting class and discussions
Jung class is easy. She makes hard topics easy and very lenient on partial credit for tests. Her lectures are really easy to follow. sometimes she goes fast but very good

reviews.comment: She is pretty chill. She always uploads lectures to BB in case you miss class. You need to study the HW if you wanna pass her exams. They are kinda difficult but all the formulas are provided. Lab reports are in groups.

Professor Jung is concise in her lectures. She will inform you if something is important to remember. She also gives out a fair amount of homework, its not heavy but its also not useless, it heavily reflects what she teaches in class. The exams coincides with her lecture notes, and she informs you weeks before an exam what material it will cover.

Lectures were thorough and example problems included. Labs were easy but lab reports took a lot of time. HW was from textbook and fair. Exams are based from class content and HW. ME211 leads to grad classes, if you want to attain a grad level understanding you will have to learn on your own as well unless you just want a passing grade. Good luck

She divided her midterms into quizzes. They are super straightforward and follow her lecture notes. You can earn an A just by referencing the notes. She also made it so the labs are graded very easily. I love her approach.

One of the nicest professors that I've had the pleasure to come across. She genuinely cares about her students and is very understanding. The overall structure of the class is very organized and lectures are helpful for the weekly mini tests.

Clear grading, homework assignments are very indicative of test material. She does very clear notes and posts them online, so if you cant make a class you can still catch up on material. Great professor overall, would definitely take again!
Insanely good, pay attention and you be totally fine

While she has a slight accent, she is not at all hard to understand. I have had experience with other Heat Transfer professors and I can vouch for her being one of the better ones as far as teaching ability and setting realistic expectations. Very fair with grading. Fairly new to the department but Im sure she will emerge as a well regarded prof.

reviews.comment: Her lecture is hard to understand. She does not provide practice exam. She will not tell you what is going to be on the exam. (Tip: her second and final exam 1 question she likes to do derivation which has only symbols. no numerical answer)
She is super understanding and teaches subjects very well. She cares about her students a lot and it shows.
This professor is amazing and has a way of making math fun—even for someone like me, whose math skills aren't the strongest!

She is the best teacher I've had by far! Not only does she care about concepts and methods, but she also cares about students applying what they're learning in real life. The work done in class doesn't even feel like it's work. All the work done is very engaging and motivates you to pursue teaching using the methods we learn.

Professor Schubert is AMAZING. She is the best professor I've had at UIC. She cares about her students much more beyond the content. She made me fall in love with my major. Don't let the level of "difficulty" discourage you; Professor Schubert is amazing at what she does. Pay attention, do your homework, participate and you'll be more than okay! :)

10/5 stars, phenomenal professor! She's incredibly caring and empathetic, loves teaching, loves math, and makes me excited to be in my major. The most supportive professor I've had, and truly appreciates us as future educators. Participation matters but her classes are so fun. As long as you try, you'll do fine!
She made me love coming to class. She is truly the best professor. She is funny, caring, understanding, and influential. I recommend taking her for all your classes.

Coming from a life-long math hater, Erin made me actually enjoy a math class. She is hilarious, energetic, and motivating. Her way of teaching is super helpful and she's very easy to come to for any help. She doesn't talk down on you for not knowing "basic" math, she genuinely wants to help you improve. By far the best math teacher I've ever had!

Took this for my Teaching Math major. She is super friendly, helpful and understanding. Tougher class since it is for my major. We had homework every week. attend lectures as the content can be used to answer the writing midterm and final exams. By far my favorite class, easy with interesting content on Latino history. Highly recommend Prof. Diaz, very understanding and assignments are short and simple. Provides extra content to build on lectures. Always helpful and available for office hours.

The class itself was amazing. It is an incredibly easy class and personally I think that if you complete all the exams and asynchronous assignments, there is no possible way to fail. The professor allows you to revise your exams and is quite flexible with deadlines and attendance. Would definitely take again!

He is the best professor at UIC I've ever taken. I would gladly take him again in a heartbeat because he truly tries to get students to understand the material. He is very caring and accessible. I love love love Professor Estabrook. Thank you for making this my best semester at UIC.
