Like any other LALS class, there's A LOT of reading. If you try and go to class/discussion, you will do well. She is very passionate about the issues discussed and helpful to her students.

This professor is great. She really tries to make the class interesting and provides clear readings and assignments. The workload isn't too bad. I would say it is moderate with a combination of a few essays and a final.
One of the best professors I have come across
Quizzes are easy and exam is open book.

She is not reading and viewing assignments properly and give you feedback that your work is incomplete where I compare with my classmates, it is clearly completed and updated tasks. She does not reply emails.

This is one of the classes that reminded me why I chose to major in Economics. She's a great teacher, very engaging, records lectures in case you missed class, and wants to see her students succeed. Love her!!

She's great! Had her last semester and pretty sure that was the only class in my entire college career (now a 4th year) where I showed up to every single lecture. Her lectures are clear, workload is very reasonable, and she grades fairly. She cares a lot about you actually learning something as oppose to just getting a good grade which I loved.

You can get a lot of extra points in his class. She is a very kind professor, She will definitely try to help you. She prefers to give homework instead of exams. She gives homework every week, but you don't have to spend much time on it. Attendance to their classes is compulsory.
Prof Foteini is one of the best instructors I've had! She cares about every single student, and she puts so much effort into the class. You will never be disappointed if you take her.

Amazing professor! Establishes mutual respect from the start and is very understanding. Super passionate about the subject material and lectures are always engaging. Doesn't assign much homework but grading criteria is always clear when he does.
He is really rude and not ready to communicate with his students

Genuinely the worst teacher I have EVER had, this man is not only heavy on the AI from day one encouraging us to use it instead of learning how to write for such already simple assignments. He has NO regard for human life whatsoever from the zionism to blatant disrespect of his students from clear sexism and embarrassment.

This professor is one of the best I've had so far in college. He does not assign much homework except papers but are very easy and engaging to do. He speaks with so much passion about this subject, and it creates amazing and engaging lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Overall good professor. The grading of the 4 papers were clear and you knew what they were looking for when writing the paper. Weekly quizzes unless a paper was due that weekend. Lots of reading more than I personally believe is needed for a 100 level gen ed class.
Easy A if I would say.
A very intelligent man, I would totally take him again, because he is very clear with his assignment and is a very passionate professor. I would take him again if possible.
Took his class, as I was interested to learn more about the history of art, and this class was it. A very straightforward class.
I really enjoyed this class, he is very nice and always helps out his students during office hours. Very helpful, and I would say it's nothing too difficult. I would take him again.
Please take her, the class is quite straightforward and I love her class, because I am actually learning
Very nice and caring professor. explained questions clearly

I strongly recommend this professor, he's incredibly helpful. He made accounting enjoyable, genuinely cares, and actively supports struggling students through email. I've never had a more helpful and caring professor. However, it's essential to put in the effort in this class. Exams are manageable with proper study, but your commitment is crucial.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: ACTG 500- Easily one of the best professors I have had in my MBA. He genuinely cares about his students doing well and EQUALLY cares that they know what they are doing when they leave his class. His grading is fair. His expectations are clear. He truly wants to be the best professor for his students. I wish he taught more classes!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had him for 201 and 202. Homework saves your grade and all found on chegg. Most dropped class within the first month. DO THE ANNUAL PROJECT! Get tutoring if you can, exams are tough. practice ALL his whiteboard problems in class, and you can get a nice grade. he literally does them in class for this reason! Go to class!! take pics of the board!!

This guy doesn't teach! If you like going to class and hearing the sound of your fellow students copying down problem after problem for which he explains at light speed, feel free. If you want to learn something find another professor. He takes attendance and collects homework.

very great teacher. knows his stuff well. wish he could of stayed at uic, would have loved to take tax 2 with him. he goes over the homework and really helps you understand the material. and sets you up to learn the material for the tests. final was way hard, but it was a B i deserved. great teacher!!!

Good teacher, actually teaches. HW almost every class, not graded, really goes over how to do each and every problem. HW sometimes that is graded but is super easy. Tests are reasonable. I didn't find his ppt too useful, I preferred the book for studying/hw. Wish he was staying at UIC but another school offered him full time.

Nice guy, very boring has two tests based on homework and problems he goes over in class. He tells you what not to study for his exams, first 2 aren't bad but final is hard (It's cumulative) but he curves at the end. Overall decent class, if you do the problems before class, read the book and study the notes. More memorization then understanding.

He's the new tax guy, won't be back for a while but he's pretty cool. He is really boring but he goes over the homework in class and does problem creating memory recognition for tests. His tests are not to bad, and he's generally an easy going guy. Kind of teaches in a bad room but still learned stuff from his class which I consider valuable.
Best Professor at UIC. Easy A as long as you do the weekly discussion boards. He is entertaining in class and makes class fun. If you can take him!

Professor Forbes is one of the most inspiring professors I have ever had in my college career. He goes above and beyond to let his students know that he cares about them. He offers advice about the real world and uses his vulnerability to connect with his students and I think that's pretty rare. Go into class ready to be inspired and to learn.

Professor Forbes cares so much about his students and really wants us to be successful in life. We had weekly discussion boards that were a little irritating because we had to make a post in one day and then reply to 3 students in 2 separate days. You will get points off if its not separate. One group presentation and paper and an individual paper.

MKTG 455 - Amazing professional, taking him again for another class, not many assignments, every class he teaches take time to give advice on your future and career advice, very understanding, very funny, down to earth, 100% recommend to anyone even none business students too

MKTG455 - I would take prof. Forbes for all my marketing classes if I could! Had him for an 8am lecture he actually made them enjoyable and always had great stories. Weekly discussion posts, midterm and final online, semester long group presentation and paper (group members are usually people you sit around) highly recommend!

I took MKTG 480 (the course wasn't listed under options) with Professor Forbes, and he was a fantastic professor. His lectures are entertaining, and I would pay attention for the whole 2 and a half hours! He genuinely cares about his students and wants to see us succeed.

MKTG-455 Professor Forbes is one of the best professors I have ever had! He's hilarious and relatable! There is a semester long project, 1 Midterm that is online and a Final exam that is online. He takes a attendance and there is a weekly discussion board. Take him if you can.
Honestly the best professor at UIC, he is so entertaining in class and it helps understand the course better, keeps class engaging. I willingly go to class just because I enjoy it.
Good prof easy class

This Professor is one of the best. He makes class very simple and makes it fun to learn. Its not work heavy just weekly discussion posts and quizzes are online. Its an easy A and he is truly a good guy.

He would give good examples during lecture, and try his best to help everyone understand. Sometimes you will go over stuff in class that you will never see again on a test/quiz. Very accessible outside of class, and helpful at office hours. The reviews before exams are very helpful, and he gives problems that are usually on previous exams.

Professor Freitag is a great lecturer, he responds timely to emails and is generally accessible outside of class. He knows the material well and answers questions effectively. He makes the main points of the material clear and what students should be prepared to be tested on. Easy to get along with.

Freitags lectures were not very helpful. I felt I walked out of his lectures being more confused than when I walked in. Professor Leonard on YouTube is the best teacher for this course. It is what helped me pass the course easily.
I had a 6 percent attendance rate for this class. Those few times I did show up it was so boring. I would be in the back playing Clash Royale. Literally made me hate calc even though I love it.
Good professor

Professor Freitag is very passionate about math, and tries his best to incite the same motivation in his students. He is very clearly knowledgeable about this subject and leaves no questions unanswered. Generous grading, inspirational teaching, and a desire for students to understand the content make Professor Freitag an amazing professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I do not know how much of the class is difficult because MATH215 just is a hard class of information to teach or if it's his lack of teaching abilities.. I can say he is understanding of the difficulty of the class and grades accordingly which is nice. Lots of group work too which is helpful and also not helpful at times.
This professor is very friendly and teaches you like a TA , he makes sure that every is on the same page.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Prof. Freitag is humorous in his own ways but when it comes to work he makes you work for it in teams. He is more of a facilitator rather than a lecturer so if your style of learning is more productive from someone teaching and going through examples step-by-step, he might not be the best fit for you but overall he is good!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The good: Exams aren't difficult if you do the homework, TAs are really helpful. Freitag is a bit of a hit or miss. Sometimes he's really clear, other times he gets into a long winded example and doesn't make it clear what we're trying to accomplish. Seems unprepared when he arrives to class, occasionally late. Gives pop quizzes for attendence.

Professor puts minimal amount of effort to teaching the class, he likes giving lower grades to students without any commentary in order to appear as if he is grading the work, but just wants to Make it seem like he is actually trying. The class has a midterm and a final despite being a literature writing based class.

Gives readings as homework then reads them in class which gets boring, has exams which are unnecessary for a class focused on interpretations, and exam instructions do not cover what he actually wants in the answers. You have to participate a lot because it's the biggest part of your grade but there's a limited number of participants in each class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a very good professor he's just not so great at online classes yet but he is working to improve. He tells you everything you need to know for quizzes and exams during the lectures so as long as you attend class you'll be fine. Occasionally instructions for homework are unclear but just ask and he will clarify.

Took two classes with him, GER101 and GER219. He's very passionate about what he does, which came through in the in-person GER101, but he did not do well with online classes. Deadlines were unclear and lecture recordings were copied from previous semesters. If you have a class with him, be sure to take it in person.

Professor Fortmann is straightforward. He will let you know what needs to be done, when its expected, and will give you feedback once its been graded. While there was a lot of reading for the class I took with him, it was a class focused on fairy tales so that was expected. Go to the lectures, do the (short & easy) homework and the exams are easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Although this class had a lot of readings to keep up with, a lot of them had summaries online and Professor Fortmann broke down the readings pretty well during class. Occasional pop quizes (passfail), 2 easy exams, 2 reaction papers, and 1 final papergroup presentation. Overall this was an easy class and would def. recommend!
DO NOT TAKE!! Gives readings everyday and they are very difficult, long and boring. Class itself is boring as well!!

Alright, Fortmann isn't good for people who are not really interested or motivated to dig into the material for themselves. This is not most students, yet his grading is easy and generous. His lectures tend to be very german, factual and very clear not flashy. With that said, you will learn alot from this professor if you want. He will help you.

Lectures were long-winded, extremely boring, and sometimes off the point.  He assigns too many readings and doesn't do a good job clarifying the important points. Half the class stopped coming about midway through the semester, which is a good index of his teaching style.  Having said that, he is a nice guy that is there to help if you need him.
Very easy going and friendly, remarkably smart as well. His class isn't that hard as long as you do your homework.

As a disabled student, when I spot profs who view accommodations as an inconvenience, I don't waste my time. Course policies frame a specific type of abled "productivity" as mandatory and virtuous, and I do not recommended for neurodivergent students. Accommodation requests aren't "excuses," and I shouldn't have to defend my right to an education.

Freeman is the best. Extremely intelligent without the elitism that seems to plague the rest of the department. Surprisingly shy for someone who is such a great orator, but I think that's what makes her unique. She's not a tough grader either, very fair actually. Just do the readings, write the essays and she'll give credit where it's due.

If you are looking for an easy A or don't care about the subject material, avoid this class. 
If you actually want to learn something and care about what you're learning, I cannot recommend her enough.

Each class is a lecture so prepare to take good notes and listen carefully. Pay special attention to any excerpts of a piece of literature that she may recite in class, these are likely to be on a test. Also, prepare for some of the toughest grading you've ever experienced with little to no feedback. Overall, Freeman is an engaging, solid prof.

There are 3 papers: 3 page, 5, and 8 page. It doesn't sound like a lot but the grading is intense & the amount of reading you have to do is unbelievable for a full time studen. It is necessary to do all of the reading in order to pass the midterm and the final exam, both of which are incredibly difficult. They consist of ID's, memorization, essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Probably one of the best english professors I've had. Very understanding, motivational, and really into her work which makes her lectures interesting. Class is very fast paced so keep up with readings - she knows her stuff WELL so you will not do well if you don't at least skim. Exams are identifications of passages from texts.
UIC needs more professors like Lisa Freeman. Wonderful professor and person. Pay attention in class. Take notes. That's all you need to do well on papers/exams.

So she is a great lecturer and her classes are filled with analysis. Sometimes it gets confusing and you don't know what to focus on. Although she is very intelligent &I enjoyed her class,her exams are super long!The final required from me to fill 3 full booklets.We had 3 papers for this class,a midterm and a final.My advice:Take it with a good TA!
This professor may be very nice and helpful, but I find her lectures uninformative and her assignments noneducational. I think her students would benefit greatly if she updated her curriculum.
She gives the best lectures and presents interesting, thought provoking arguments for every text. Paying attention to lecture and discussion will help for her tests. A great professor.

A brilliant professor!  Her lectures are so jam-packed with interesting insight and analysis of the texts, that sometimes it's a struggle to keep up with my note-taking during lecture!  Highly challenging material, but she really helped me learn to think critically.  She expects alot from students, but hey, this ain't high school anymore, folks!

She is a great lecturer.  However, she isn?t so great when it comes to talking to her in person.  She?s very cold, abrupt and a little rude.  Though this is an undesirable trait, she still gives a great lecture, so if you have any questions, just stick to your TA.

She expects her students to be intelligent and to work hard. It's a vote of confidence. If you take it as such and rise to the challenge, her classes can change the way you read and think. I'm an English teacher today because of what I learned from Dr. Freeman.

She definitely does not take any nonsense.  She is very straightforward, but she is quite personable once you get to know her.  Extremely intelligent and engaging.  Highly recommend if you are interested in the subject matter.
I'm planning to take English 315 with this professor. From what I hear, she is a good teacher. I just hope that I can handle any type of difficulty in her class.Nonetheless, a good teacher.
Prof. Freeman is awesome.  That was one of the best classes I have ever taken.  She really challenges you and coaxes you to do good work.  I am glad she is here at UIC.
She is the BEST! She is SOOOO smart and amazing.
I took professor Freeman for my english survey courses, she is very dedicated and a great instructor.  I actually showed up for every class . I also think she is really passionate and loves her work.
humorous and friendly, Not so bad.
She sucks, do NOT take this class, I have saved your life my son.

Mr.Baker is a high school teacher who teaches at a college level. He's kind, helpful, and clearly passionate about the subject and his profession. His class is very creative based, and prepare for lots of dad jokes. He teaches the material incredibly well and is very flexible for those who struggle with it.

Prof. Franke was an amazing professor, he made sure everyone was well-prepared for the exams and had very fun explanations to break down concepts. Also the TA's are very helpful especially Alex. Overall this class was great and I would gladly have Prof. Franke as my professor again.

He was very fun to listen to and would always make sure that all students were prepared for exams. He was willing to review certain lectures multiple times if students were confused. Lastly, he provided a fun project that allowed you to skip final exam if you scored within the highest in the class.
Everything

Prof. Franke is one of the best professors for an intro CS course. He teaches the material in a manner where the student will know how to apply the facts on the 8 projects given throughout the semester! As long as you attend lectures, stay on track, and do your work then its impossible to fail the class—theres a ton of extra credit opportunities!

Prof. Franke was genuinely one of the best professors I have had. You definitely have to put in the work. Fair warning to anyone taking this as their first comp sci class ever (like I did) make sure you show up, don't be afraid to ask for help, this class def isn't easy so make sure you pay attention, do the work, and go to office hours!

Professor is a good person, but the graders were extremely unfair. Projects were left ungraded or received no credit for clearly completed work. When concerns were raised, the issue was never acknowledged. The grading team made the course unnecessarily frustrating and challenging.
Professor is really nice and assignments were fairly easy. Lots of discussion based work.

Laura Fugikawa, a visiting professor at Smith College, is one of the most incredible people I have ever met. She inspires me to be a better writer while continuing to grow personally and professionally. I would highly recommend taking a class with her. She makes you work hard for the grade, but she teaches you so much along the way. I love her!

She's really nice. Her tests are really tricky though. But she'll help you out. There's a lot of reading but you can still get by if you don't read. Easy A. She's half Japanese, half American. You can tell she is passionate about the Asian culture. Make sure to participate in discussionlec. Unless you want a boring experience.

Laura is one of the best professors i've had at UIC. She is fun, and her lectures are so interesting! I'm currently in her ASAM 210 class which is a bit more reading, but her ASAM 125 Intro to Asian American Studies is a great class to take! I love her.
Very helpful teacher.

Him+ GAs were harsh graders to the point where they had to curve the first essay because most got C's. At one point he said that the SoA gives out to many A's, which makes me think he arbitrarily gives out bad grades, especially bc there was rarely any feedback on our work. I don't feel like the tests were a productive way of learning the concepts.

Francesco is a great professor, and gives very good and clear lectures, despite them being super long and he doesnt stop for a minute.
Although, he does believe that his class is the only one everyone is taking, and thinks it is more important than even our studio with a crazy workload.

Francesco is a really harsh grader who discourages us to not to focus on our major courses aka studio. He told us to ask our instructors for extensions just to finish the work that he gave us. This class is lecture-heavy and he just talks nonstop, expects us to memorize all the information from the lectures. There are many in-class written exams.

He gives out really good lectures that are related to the class as a whole but he would not stop rambling about it! Doesn't have a good concept of time and prepare to be humiliated when speaking about an idea for projects. Gives out assignments like he's the only class you'll take.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Tough class, but great instructor! A lot of homework though.

I had to band up with three other students just to survive. Lectures are spent far too abstractly, and we were berated for lack of "participation." Exams went so bad that he had to create take-home halves for them just to fudge the class average higher. Sporadic feedback was only given on online exam halves and homework. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: You need to put a lot of effort into this professor in order to be very successful in the class. He has a thick accent and he explains things slowly, but if you pay close attention you will be okay. He is not a bad professor, but he focuses too much on the concept of problems rather than actually solving them. The good thing is, he tries hard.

This prof was not very great, I ended up dropping the class because I was doing so bad and just needed a new teacher. If you can, avoid him. He does not explain things very well and never really answers your questions. He is at the university for research so it seems like he doesn't care very much.

I can speak volumes about Prof. Furman.  His explanations are quite clear, but you really need to take the effort to listen to everything he says. His lectures might appear unnecessarily complicated if you don't.  On reflection, taking his classes enhanced my understanding of Mathematics better than any other teacher.  Highly recommended.
He is very good!
Sloppy teaching. Hard to follow his notes on the board. It was all over the place.

He is a very nice and helpful Professor.  Also, he is a genius and perhaps the smartest Professor in the Math department.   I seriously recommend him for any Math course.  Btw, Math313 which is Real Analysis is the hardest course in the Math department.

This is a good course, but it is extremely frustrating because it's very much a class of "do what I say" rather than actually learning R as a part of data analysis. It is also very much a class in which she intentionally divides people by coding ability, which sucks because it pretty much says to the students I like these people more.

Prof. Fusi is a great addition to CUPPA at UIC. She is knowledgeable and available to students who need the help. To be clear, there is a good amount of work expected for a 200-level course, as there should be. She may offer extra credit here or there but be prepared to WORK for your grade. Great lecturer and up to date Blackboard page, too!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: This class was not that hard, you just have to put time into the assignments and study hard for the tests because the midterm and final are worth almost half of the grade

DO NOT take PPOL 210 unless you want to always wonder why you took the class. I am currently taking this class as a credit/no credit and it is still awful. There is a TON of work throughout the semester (2 exams, a group project with 4 650-750 word papers in addition to a final presentation, 2 policy briefs and 4 short assignments). Avoid!!!
HORRIBLE! Wants very specific responses and for you to only think how she does. Avoid at all costs. Wonderful person, horrible class. Only memorized what she wanted to hear.

I took Biochem 452 in the Spring of 2018 after not having taken a science course in 7 yrs. I was able to succeed with her guidance and admire her approach. She emphasizes that students seek to thoroughly understand the material (knowing the "why" of concepts). You should take note of the *key terms* used in explanations on her quizzes and tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Fung really cares about you understanding the material rather than memorizing it. BIOS452 was definitely still a rigorous, content-heavy class, but her way of teaching provides you with the foundation to succeed with the MCAT, research, etc. She's amazing -- definitely a very helpful professor and truly cares about her students succeeding!

I hadn't taken a science course in about seven years, but Dr. Fung was supportive. She emphasizes the importance of thinking on a molecular level and having a strong foundation in physics. This is a conceptual class in an exciting field. Don't try and memorize everything; carefully attend and review her lectures and draw out structures and succeed!

She's a great professor! She really cares how well her students do in the course and wants them to truly understand the content. I would suggest taking advantage of her office hours because she's extremely particular with answers.

By far the best professor I've ever had. She's so passionate about what she does. She has the biggest heart of a professor that I've ever came across. She pushes you, but at the same time you learn so much. She was there for me when I felt like i had nobody in Gen Chem. Such a caring and knowledgable professor. Take her and you won't regret it!

Professor Fung is one of the only professors I've had that ACTUALLY cares about her students learning. Her lecture slides are well put together, and the way she lectures is very effective. Though I didn't do as well as I wanted to on the first exam/quiz, it helped me learn how to adapt my study methods for her class and I only continued to improve.

GREAT!!! Her exam questions can be confusing but not too bad. Study her lecture slides; know every single detail from her lecture slides. She cares for the students, which a rare thing at UIC. Big takeaway is to study for her exams like there's no tomorrow. The exams are worth 80% of the final grade.

Dr. Fung is an amazing professor. She takes the time to make sure you are really understanding the concepts. Anyone can just plug in numbers to an equation; Dr. Fung taught us why the equations work. Participation matters! When in class, she encourages you to ask questions to help YOU better understand the material.

Fantastic professor! The tests are very specific and are tough, but Dr. Fung really cares about making sure you understand the material. This is great for the MCAT because it extends beyond memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Fung is an awesome professor. Her way of teaching biochem is different from other professors in the sense that it is not memorization based. She wants you to really understand the specifics behind concepts. The best way to do well in the class is to take good notes and be specific on quizzes and exams. Do that and youll succeed in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dr. Fung is a professor that will make you read between the lines to understand the conceptual aspects of chemistry. Her lectures were off the powerpoint and the exams were very conceptual. Her tests were multiple choice and short answer, but the multiple choice is where she tricks you. Overall, not a bad professor, but definitely read the book.

She really cares about her students, and I'm really going to miss this class. By far the most genuine and best dressed professors of them all. It is clear that she is really passionate about chemistry, which makes attending lecture that much more enjoyable. She has truly impacted my academic career. I highly recommend taking Dr. Fung!!!

Dr. Fung, while most likely good for her regular classes, doesn't really translate well to the scope of Gen Chem 2. The tests are dissimilar to every other Chem 124 at UIC, and are heavily conceptual while being designed to trick you. If you're anticipating a light semester of plug and chugging, I do not recommend Dr. Fung.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is very focused on making sure you learn the important concepts and the principles behind them. Good lecturing structure, cares about students. One of the best, if not the best professor I have had.

The material was difficult, especially the quizzes. The exams were straightforward, and straight from the lecture notes. The difficulty of lab reports depends on your TA. This was my second time taking Dr. Fung, loved her class both times, She is both genuine and caring for her students. Lecture notes are very detailed. Would definitely recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Fung is one of the most fair professors I've ever met. She went out of her way to make sure sessions with different TAs are normalized. She is also very approachable. To do well in her class you have to make sure you understand the theories behind the lab techniques and procedures.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr Fung really wants you to learn, and she conducts her class in a way that is both student centered and information-focused. Be prepared to pay attention to the lecture, because she teaches everything you need to know in the lecture. Without a doubt, the most accessible, friendly, and flexible biochem professor. highly recommended

Lecture is  very helpful and illustrated the concepts behind lab and she led a very interactive class. She will truly make you understand the fundamentals. I recommend her if you want to learn in depth and critically think. Has accessible office hours and class material is made available for success on exams. One of my favorite professors.

One of the best professors I've had at UIC.  She genuinely cares for her students and wants you to understand the material.  She is very big on concepts.  If you're unsure on something just schedule office hours with her and she will gladly help clarify the material. At the end of the day she wants you to succeed.  I'd recommend this course to any1
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Let me tell you something about this course, it seems to be a big secret. The Lab Coordinator, The Professor, and the TA's all refuse to provide adequate material to succeed in this class. The class is a big old mystery, nobody has a clue of whats going on, and the refusal to provide material to study hurts long term. CLASS Average QUIZ+EXAM  F.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: After giving a lecture, Dr. Fung invites her students to participate in a conversation about the lecture, which forces you to tease out what you do and do not understand, which corrects any misconceptions you may have. You learn critical thinking skills and how to ask the right questions. The content covered is applicable in all areas of science.

Took 558 as an undergrad. Overall not too hard. She provokes critical thinking, so you have to understand the material, you cant just memorize and expect to do well. We had two tests which was the majority of the grade, but there are quizzes that are worth 1 point to let you see where you are. In all very good, take if you're interested in biophys.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Tough subject but Prof. Fung makes it her mission to make sure you understand the material. By the end of the course, you will have a deep understanding of biochem if you put in the effort.  A lot of MCAT material in this class. Easily my favorite class at UIC.  Tips: record the lectures and pay attention to the details.

Dr. Fung was a terrific professor. She genuinely cares about your success as a student and makes an effort to know her 100+ students on a first name basis. The exams aren't awful if you pay attention and participate in lecture and especially if you go to office hours. A lot of exam questions I only got right because I always went to office hours.

This class is for students who want to apply critical thing and ready to learn the basic concepts of Biochemistry. If you want to just memorize stuffs and forget them right after the exam, this class is not for you.  Be ready to attend classes and be prepare to discuss the concept . Amazing. You learn Biochem, Punctuality and organization. Success!

reviews.comment: Dr. Fung is amazing. Her class is the best place for critical thinking. She is very specific about the material, So her lectures are very important. While Dr. Fung is caring and she emphsizes participation, I don't like her style of teaching. Her lectures are disorganized and on exams she wants specific answers from you, making her a tough grader. Also, SHE DOESN'T HAVE BLACKBOARD. That means no lecture capture to get exam answers. You gotta lecture capture yourself.

I took Dr. Fung for this class and also Biochemistry Lab. She is a great teacher. She really cares about her students and she provokes critical thinking. The class Biophysical Chem is very helpful for anyone.. The class tought me all about amino acids, proteins, and lab techniques in detail. She is great. Great for ungrads as well. Highly recommend

Unconventional class. Found hard to adjust at first. Make sure you understand her lecture notes very well: even stuff she didn't stress on in class.  Questions she mentions during lecture are often on exams no matter how un-important they may seem so take note of them. Curve gets pretty low so like 75% for an A so if you work hard  an A is possible

Her exams are tough and you have to be prepared, but she is a very inspirational professor. The way she approaches the subjects is phenomenal. If you pay attention and ask questions, her classes are amazing. It was enjoyable for me to have her as my professor.

Dr. Fung is probably the best professor I've EVER had. Take her class and you WILL learn biochemistry. I don't think I've ever understood a class as in depth. She is very specific with the answers she wants from you. I think she is one of the best professors I have had in my college career. She is tough but also cares. She cares about you understanding and learning the material. Absolutely recommend her eventhough you will have to work a lot.
extremely good teacher, very fair. Make sure you study her slides thoroughly, exam question will come from there and the comments she says in class.

Dr. Fung's class requires students to understand the concepts of biochemistry, rather than just the memorization of facts.  Attending her lectures is mandatory, as well as having the book on top of the lecture notes she already prepares. She is willing to help answer any questions and is very approachable.

Dr. Fung  is a great professor. She focuses on understanding the material and thinking about it, rather than just memorizing it. The class is not easy, but it definitely increased my level of understanding of all my undergrad. chemistry and biochemistry classes, and sorta connecting them into drug and real life application.

What I love about Dr. Fung's teaching style is that she takes time to explain material "from the ground up". This is the most practical elective offered to chemistry majors.  This class is a crossroad for everything a chem major should know.  Strong biochemistry review with applications of physical chemistry.  This class goes beyond the basics of molecular interactions found in undergraduate classes. Also covers why drugs are developed along side why.

She takes personal care to ensure you understand the subject matter. She has an unique system of grading where you grade your peers but they remain anonymous. Her questions make you think and analyze the matter, not memorize it.  Besides, she is extremely approachable and also provides  great advise with regards to your career and future endeavors.

I think she is a very smart teacher. Due to her teaching style, it is easy for us to follow the material. She encourages us to share our opinion. She reviews the material before and after class and specifies the important points. She spends extra time to give additional support to students. I learnt a lot from this class.

She is a very good teacher and makes every student in the class understand the concepts. She didn't make us memorize/rote learn unnecessary material. Great professor and great class.I definitely learned and "understood" a lot in this class. She wants you to understand the concepts and learn how to actually apply them. Really informative class. Highly discussion-based, involved, and homework is pretty low.  Dr Fung is very focused on making sure you understand the main points of everything, which I appreciate. CHEM558 is high level, challenging and discussion-engaging: great course overall. CHEM458, not so much.

One of the most intelligent professors I've had at UIC, and also one of the interactive.  She cares about her students so long as they put in effort.  The text for this class is all webpages she'll provide.  If you have the chance to take a class with her, I'd say go for it.

She gets her lecture notes from Wikipedia and basically reads from those notes in the class. She also asks ridiculous questions all the time.

Dr. Fung is ridiculously smart, and very focused on making you understand the fundamentals of what she's talking about. She's a great teacher, and an extremely sweet and helpful lady. I wish they had her teach more classes! Fantastic teacher. Highly recommend.
Amazing.

She is a very nice teacher and I usually hate lectures but her lectures are actually pretty interesting. The quizzes seem to be pretty easy so far so I am not too worried. If you know the study guide she gives you, you should be fine.
She is wonderful! She obviously cares about the topic and is really helpful.
Tiffany was a great teacher! She's very funny and kept the class interesting. You can go to her with any problems you have about the class.
She is just awesome. Really loves what she does and always comes to class full of energy. UIC needs WAY more teachers like her.

She knows a lot about education and its easy to tell.I loved the class mainly because of her lectures, she brings awesome guest speakers. even though there is a lot of reading, the workload wasnt bad.grade is based on like 3 papers,and she gives you feedback so you can fix then and turn it in again.she treats us adults and the class all discussion.
Kay was very helpful and interesting. You should take her class, you'll learn a lot.

I believe that Kay was a great teacher. I was a student that always thought of solutions to the problems we were talking about in class. i dont think her assignments were unclear, she just was open to all our ideas. I thought she was absolutely wonderful. she was really accomodating when necessary and really addresses forgotten issues.

OUTSTANDING! Kay is an amazing professor with a gift to teach! Very thought-provoking and eye-opening. She challenged us with difficult readings, but isn't that what college is about? She is very very unclear. She assigned us things that we were not ready for. Like reading like 50,000 books that are at the PhD level, she even said that she is reading the book in her PhD class. She is great just pay attention in class.

Professor Fuzesi Finance 550 course provided a thorough and engaging introduction to personal finance, with well-organized lectures and practical applications that effectively illustrated complex concepts. I really enjoyed her FIN 250 class that I took over the summer. She cares about her students and genuinely wants them to understand the material while getting a good grade. Professor Fuzesi is fantastic at making complex topics easy to understand with real-life examples and teaches very valuable information that I will never forget. I highly recommend this course.

Take Professor Fuzesi's class! One of the best professors I've ever had. The material was easy to understand because she explained everything so well. this class is a must-take regardless of your major requirement. Mrs. Fuzesi is a phenomenal teacher who cares deeply about her students. She makes sure that every student really understands the lectures and assignments thoroughly before moving on. I would recommend her to anybody!

Professor Barbara is a great professor with a lot of knowledge in the finance field, she cares and encourages her students to learn more about personal finance and how they can achieve financial freedom in the future. FIN 250 is a great and useful class that all students should take no matter their major.
EZ
Fuzesi is an amazing professor, she has a very unique teaching style which took some getting used to but the content of the class it TOTALLY worth it. Real life application!

She is a very good professor and cares about the students. I really enjoyed her class. Definitely take this class! If you follow her during the class then you will be fine on the homework and the exam:)

good professor

she will not follow LOA incase you have one. she gets rude when she thinks people are questioning. the blackboard? a mess.

she is the most unorganized professor i have ever had. she gets upset easily and sometimes lashes out if you don't attend lectures or do assignments correctly. we were months behind compared in class compared to the syllabus due to her being unorganized. she was all over the place and each online class meeting, i feel like she was winging it.

If you are student that needs accommodations don't take her. She doesn't believe in them. Along with that she isn't organized at all and you will be more confused than with what you started. Just avoid her. She is a horrible professor

Amazing professor. Her advanced financial planning course is one of the most useful courses at UIC. The class only met up once every 3-4 weeks to present and the normal lectures were online. This is an essential class and will have you on top of your finances. Prof. Fuzesi is pretty cool, and I wish I learned this stuff in high school. Do your work and you'll be good.

I loved her class so much. Her class is a representation of how she is as a person, simply amazing. She cares about you, she cares about the material and she cares that you learn. She's the kind of professor people should aspire to be.

One of the best prof at UIC. Took 310 over the summer (4weeks). It had a 3 projects(which she shows step by step how to follow), 3 quiz and a small writing,  but overall was an easy A. If you get this class with her again next summer deficiently recommend.

This course is very simple. She gives you step by step instructions on everything. A lot of the homework seemed tedious but at least it was easy. She makes a lot of jokes which aren't funny but it's whatever. She offers a lot of extra credit. Blackboard was hard to navigate at first but you'll get the hang of it.

This course helped me to step back and think about my financial decisions at a much deeper level. I have downloaded all the assignments and class recordings that I will use it as a reference in my life.The professor teaching skills are full of humor and life events that made the class even more interesting.

Let me just say that Professor Fuzesi is an amazing person. Shes funny and knows how to keep your attention. However, shes a subpar professor. She also doesnt post grades until the end of the semester
The best professor at UIC. She loves her job and I will stay in touch with her long beyond my years at UIC. She cares and makes a difference
She is awesome. She teached finance with so much passion and also patience. She is immensely knowledgeable and I was lucky to be learning with her this semester.

Smart, funny and well respected. The projects and quizzes are straight-forward and pretty much all that is graded so make them count. She is very down-to-earth but also can get impatient if you do not follow her instructions or ask a question that has been answered or demonstrated already.

If you ever have a chance to take Barbara you should! The project we did in class has been extremely helpful during my internship when it came to financial modeling this summer. Best professor at UIC! I can say that I learned with Barbara what I didn't with other professors. I took FIN 310 and FIN 494 (personal finance) with her and got an A on both. One of the few professors that cares about her students. Take her if you can.

BEST PROFESSOR!

Barbara was one of my favorite teachers at UIC. As long as you attend class and pay attention you'll learn actual useful information for the real world and pass the class with ease. Everyone should be able to take 494 since these are skills that every American should have.

Barb is AMAZING. I had her for FIN494 (which is the same as FIN250). She really cares for her students and their well-being, financially. FANTASTIC! Everything she teaches us is 100% immediately useful + relevant + important. I will take every class she teaches.
Barb really cares that her students become financially literate in her 494 class, and learn everything that will set them up for jobs in the future in her 320 class. Best professor I've had at UIC.

If you are into any fiance topic, take her class and you will have the most out of the class. Barbara Fuzesi is one of the best professor's for Finance at the University of Illinois. In one of her Finance class I did Valuation project which was one of the best experience. Barbara is the best Professor and she is a great person. I really enjoyed the Advanced Fin. Planning class and would miss it. I learned a lot of things that can be applied to the real life. She is the best professor to take at UIC. If anyone wrote bad reviews then they probably did not follow directions. Her class consists of excel and her exams are fairly easy. Dry lecture, very hard tests. all i can say is good luck if you're taking her for finance 320. make sure to bring your pen and pencil and paper and calculator every single class. participation and attendance mandatory and just as big a part as test grades. seriously good luck
One of the best finance professor at UIC. Exams are easy as long as you attend the class. 5 Short homework and she drops the lowest one. 1 easy article assignment. She goes through the exam in class.
