reviews.comment: My favorite class by far. English 115 although an English elective makes you think in ways you wouldn't usually. The professor is supportive, caring, and definitely wants his students to pass. If I could I would certainly take this class. He is quite the character and he can be a joker.  Regardless of how intimidating he seems, he's  real caring.

He isn't a normal teacher by far and I probably wouldn't recommend him. Aside from the curriculum being difficult if you aren't an English major, he makes it difficult to fix your mistakes. He isn't specific when making grade changes and he send unnecessary emails regarding personal feelings/views. He is a smart man but I wouldn't recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I honestly loved taking Prof. Grunow for English 160 and 161. I was optimistic about him due to his "tough" grading standards at first. He acts strict but he makes you put in the extra effort to really advance your skills. He does say that no one gets an A in 160 but the final essays got my final grade to an A. He is one of the better prof. at UIC.

Good teacher, but he makes you work for your grade. Show up to class and follow his exact instructions and you will get the grade you want. After writing a paper, you are given the opportunity to do edits and rain your grade half a letter grade. Show up to office hours!!! even when they are not required, still go.

Teacher stares at the back wall majority of class time. When he asks where something is, it is either in the Longman, the syllabus, or the text, do not get the answer wrong or he will go on a tangent. Believes his jokes are funny, but they really are not. If you can find any other class take it. Teacher does not believe in A's.

He doesn't give out A easily. you have to earn the A, by participation, doing all his homework and writing good essays. If you have any questions, ask him he will definitely help you. He is very clear about assignment, and follow his format and the assignment is easy to write.

Mr G could be sarcastic at times but it's all fun in games unless you are a sensitive person and cannot take a joke. He doesn't like making eye contact with people so he'll stare at the back of the wall for the majority of class. He won't give A's unless he thinks you earned it by the end of the semester. He's very helpful & CLEAR on assignments

Mr. G is very friendly and loves to have conversations. His classes are very well structured and refers to the syllabus almost everyday. Students are split into groups for all of the semester and have group activities everyday. I enjoyed his class and recommend him to everyone!
Do not take this professor, he is always yelling and thinks Engl 160 is the only class you have.

Mr. G! despite him being such a tough grader, I absolutely, positively love this professor. He is so funny and overly dramatic at times. Did I mention he is super sarcastic? I love it. He made me really think about worldwide issues, like the Walmart argumentative essay. I am taking him again next semester for 161 ad 115. This should be interesting!

He's really strict on attendance, he doesn't hand out A's easily (doesn't believe you should  be getting A's because if you were "you would be in 161"), BUT he's really helpful & makes himself available for help. If you participate & go to his office hours when told you'll be on his good list. Gives lots of time to revise papers for a better grade.

Class is based off of Mr. Grunow's personal bias.  He says he does not give A's in ENGL 160.  A wonderful dramatized attitude problem comes along with this professor.  This class is apparently not the level most students should be at after high school according to him.  He also feels that your life should revolve around his class.

Grunow is such an amazing professor. I took him both for 160 and 161 and he helped me improve my writing GREATLY. His assgnmts are tough, especially for 161, but he clarifies exactly what he wants and always gives you feedback so that you can improve your grade. Seriously, take him. Every paper for future classes will be a piece of cake!

One of the best teacher I ever had! He is extremely helpful when writing essays. His materials are not easy; however, it makes you think about a lot of stuffs going around in the society. Be friendly to him and participate a lot because I got C's and B's for the papers but got A in the end. Talk a lot and you must go to his office hour.

Grunow seemed tough at first, but he's actually a really good teacher. He knows what he's talking about and he may seem a bit rude or dramatic when you ask questions, but he'll always do his best to help students. Definitely go to his office hours, it will be mandatory. When working on his papers, try to adhere to same of the sample essays.

Not the best or the worst. If I had a second chance I would have dropped his class. Mr. Grunow never clarifies any assignments and most of the time during and out of class you're left very confused. He likes to yell at the class when no one answers his questions two seconds after he asks one. Look into different teachers before settling for him.

Awesome professor! He made the whole class sing twice the semester I had him.Take the time to do his essays and you will get a good great.He is a hard grader, does not believe in giving A's. But if you work hard enough you could receive it.get ready for the fun, cause that is part of the class.

Good professor. Kinda weird and he can rub off as a jerk to some people, but he really knows what he's talking about. His teaching style is a little different than other english teachers. He's definitely willing to help you on essays. Take his class!

He is very precise on his papers if you have any grammatical errors even one he will take off a lot of points he is ridiculous when it comes to grading and he gives you an excessive amount of homework
Easy A. Very clear and precise as to what he wants.  If you show effort, he'll like you.  Ask alot of questions during your conferences.

Mr. Grunow is one of the challenging teachers but if your listen and see him about your essays, he offers much help. He's a great teacher, he knows how to teach his classes, he one of the teachers that actually want you to learn, and cares a lot about his students. I definitely recommend him, I got an A in his class.

Very intelligent professor! I had him for 160 and 161 and received A's in both. He requires you to go see him during office hours to discuss papers and this is extremely helpful. He does assign homework often. I would totally recommend him.

I got an A. You just have to participate, get on his good side. And do the work. You HAVE to go to his office hours, and there is a lot of work. However, this is one of the only classes at UIC I feel I'll keep the information I learned and apply it else where.
Terrible, don't take  his class if you don't have time.

Mr. G is sooo funny! He gives a lot of work and assignments but they are extremely worth it because they help you in the long run. He always is available for help on the assignments. Even though the class is hard, if you do the work you will succeed.
He gives homework everyday and e-mails you most days, basically you'll always have something to do for his class. At first his sarcasm is funny after a while.

He does give out a lot of work but it helps you alot when writing essays. He's very helpful and funny. He's very sarcastic but you'll get used to it. He's not an easy professor but if you do the hard work he'll reward you.
His class is difficult, but he is an amazaing teacher. He helps you out a lot outside of class.

I loved him! i learned so much from him. im not gonna lie it was hard work but its possible to get a good grade. i got an A and all you really have to do is show effort and kiss up. I never really read the books, just skimmed. He's a good teacher if you really want to learn. He can be scary at first but you learn to laugh about it.
no like he's STRICT but he grades MORE ON PARTICIPATION than the paper itself.
Requests lots of meetings for every assignment

Switched to his class topic for a day and I did NOT like his attitude. He's blunt and expects you to participate or else he'll call on you. Tough grader and pushes you to your limit. Must do work or else you'll fail. I switched out of his class at the end of the day to avoid his craziness. If you're up for him, good luck, he's a tough one.
He's a horrible professor, do not take him! He does not believe in giving As. He feels superior to everyone because he attends U of C. Taking this class will damage your GPA. Take someone else.

I did not agree with his grading who gives out C++. Otherwise he is a straight forward teacher in order to pass you do have to attend class. He does critize the students writing skills but it does help the student. Sometimes it does get frustating but as long as you try your best and work hard a decent grade is expected.
He is not clear on what he wants on his papers. He criticizes everything, and everyone.
Sorry, I meant writing skills.

For both English 160 and 161, he is extremely helpful. Keeps you focused and requires extreme amount of hw. Not for slackers but the workload is worth it. With him as a teacher, you can def. see your reading/vocabulary and especially reading skills improve. RECOMMEND THIS TEACHER! =D
Professor Grunow is an excellent teacher. His class benefited my use of the English language in all of my classes.This class is not for slackers, but the all the hard work pays of in the end.

He is a JERK!!! Says you can not get an A in his class, b/c an A is perfection and no one is perfect. SO matter how hard you try apparently he doesn't give out A's. Loves to give out C's. Makes you work very hard! Criticizes everything on your paper and your opinion. He favors particular students and makes it obvious. Don't take him!!!!

Very hard teacher. Harsh grader gives C++ even though that means a B. However he does allow you to revise papers for up to a 10% increase in grade, so a full letter grade. He loves it when you visit him out side of class and he gives you a lot of help. However, topics are boring, there is reading but he never really checks it.
He is a good teacher but gives a lot of work. He is helpful  though
He really gets tough sometimes.

Professor Grunow is very well organized, and knows what he needs to know to teach well. However, his manner was quite strange; he rarely made eye-contact with students, was somewhat condescending in his comments, and bragged about his own good grades while simultaneously sharing that he rarely gave out A's. Generally demoralizing.

Professor Grunow is an excellent teacher. I had him for both English 160 and 161. He is not strange, but rather energetic. Loved his classess. Got A's in both...Although there is a lot of reading.... If you are a good student and want an interesting english class than definatly take his. Extremely helpful and very fun.ATTEND EVER CLASS! or else!

Well, this guy is way different from all the other professors. He wants his students to be "scholars" and he is a bit weird. However, he is a pretty easy teacher. i did my papers 2-3 hours before class the day they were due and i got A's on ALL of them, and i got C's in high school. He assigns quite a bit of reading but doesnt check the homework.

Mr. Grunow is a character to say the least. He is a tough grader, yea, but his comments are always very helpful. He's really nice once you get to know him. He's tough on his students and insists we are all 'scholars' and should act like one. He does assign a lot of readings, though, but i really enjoyed having him for 2 semesters.
No Comments

Mr.Grunow is different let's say that. At first I did not really like him as a teacher, but then I got use to him. He is a tough grader, he checks your entire paper. Every little detail in the paper is accounted for. He helps you if you go to him, explains everything well. Just show up to class and you will be fine.
SEEMS WEIRD AND CRAZY AT FIRST BUT U WILL GET USED TO IT. JUST COME TO CLASS. EXPECTS A LOT OF READING FROM STUDENTS. SOMETIMES CAN BE EXTREME. OVERALL OK.
THIS GUY.......... Let me tell you he's totally horrible when he tries to explain compicated subjects. I WISH I NEVER TOOK HIS COURSE, skip HIM.

This professor was very helpful and concentrated on improving writing skills.  He can be a lot of fun, but make sure you show up to class or else he gets really mad.  He expects a lot from papers, so make sure not to write them the night before.
HE SEEMS TO BE CRABBY MOST OF THE TIME. HIS ATTITUDE TOWARDS WE NEGORES IN THE LOWER CLASS MAKES HIM HARD TO LISTEN TO. HIS INVOLVEMENT IN LITERATURE HAS MADE HIM UNPERSONABLE.
Very good class, the TAs help a lot.

Professor Gramsch is one of the best professors in the Chemistry Department. He genuinely cares about his students and their understanding of the material. Everything you need to know is covered in lecture as long as you are present and engaged. Exams are based entirely on lecture content, and grading expectations are very clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Gramsch is a great professor. His lectures are engaging, and he's very funny. You can tell that he is well-versed in what he teaches and genuinely wants his students to succeed. He grades very, very reasonably and is open to feedback.

Chem is a difficult subject for me but I retained way more in one semester with gramsch than in high school. He is happy to re-explain concepts outside of class and is incredibly receptive to feedback. His lectures are SO interesting. Lab reports and their scheduling was off by a few weeks and he didn't stick to the syllabus for labs.

He was an extremely kind and caring professor. You can tell he has a genuine love for what he does and makes sure that every student understands the content he is teaching as well. He was also extremely considerate to what students have going on in their personal lives and helps students to exceed no matter what. Had him for both 116 and 118.

Had for 116 and 118. This professor was made to teach. Very understanding, helpful, involved teacher that you can tell is very passionate while lecturing. Go to class and discussions or your work will pile up.

Very considerate of his students and is always looking for feedback on to help his students succeed. Overall the class is pretty straight forward if you attend lectures even tho he doesn't take attendance, he'll guide you on how to succeed on his exams. Definietely actively participate and you'll be fine, office hours are key for exam prep!
Take this guy he's awesome!!!
he's a great guy who cares about his students. he's a fantastic teacher and i'd recommend him to anyone.

Very nice teacher, and he loves showing us cool science facts in the start of class. He is also very considerate of your life outside of school and he truly cares aboyt the students. Totally recommend.
He is the kindest professor.

Great professor, really knows the material and is extremely helpful. Is willing to adjust class schedule and layout to better fit the needs of the students. All material on exam/quizzes is talked about during lectures.

Professor Gramsch is an amazing Chemistry professor. His lectures are so informational and easy to follow. This guy really knows his content and is able to answer any question you have in a really beneficial way. He is chill and willing to adapt his teaching style to better adapt to his students for that semester. Thanks to him, class felt easy.

Dr. Gramsch was my first chemistry professor at UIC, and I learned more in one semester of his class than in all of high school. His lectures were well organized, for studying on my own and studying for finals. Visiting his office hours twice a week after the first exam allowed me to master the concepts before the exams. Highly recommend!
Grading is not clear; she is unresponsive and unapproachable. The class is about culture and society, but she breezes past racial issues and does not give clear feedback on assignments.

I would never recommend taking AAH119 with this professor. The grading is unreasonably harsh, and the expectations feel like you're supposed to already have a full background in architectural history. Her feedback is often backhanded/ unclear, and she rarely admits mistakes/ takes responsibility. Canvas grades don't always align with final grades.

We learned design patterns, using open-source repos programmatically, building devops pipelines and many more. Most useful course I took!

Dr. Mark is very intelligent, thorough communicator, and above all, he's genuinely interested in his students. He knows how subtle and complex CS can be, so he takes his time reinforcing fundamental concepts and answering questions. He's got a fun dry sense of humor that develops throughout the semester. He opens his schedule to help. He's the best

Prof opened a new world to me - it is a new complicated topic that requires the good OS knowledge, theory of distributed computing, performance engineering, and ability to program using different frameworks. Very inspiring, captivating lectures. Learnt loads and was motivated to go beyond average in terms of learning and understanding. Very funny and understanding. Gave good feedback and was open to class discussions/disagreements and any kind of constructive dialogue.

He pushes you hard, harder than any other class you will ever take at UIC. You will learn more than you have in any other class. If you are truly driven to achieve great things, take his classes. It is probably the most useful class that I have taken, even though it did not  seem so initially. I learned an incredible amount of detail, how different companies like fb, google, amazon solve technical issues, how to present papers.

I have learned an incredible amount of information about programming languages. I can read PL specifications now, understand how to reason about languages, how to use lambda calculus for Java 8 lambdas, how to write reactive functional applications. It is like a whole new world opened for me. Piazza is heavily used. Bonus points are a bit not fair.

This class is an excellent introduction to cloud computing. It takes a lot of work to complete this class, but I was able to get a software engineering job at a company that builds cloud computing applications using what I learned in this class. Unreasonable, inflexible, demanding, Unhelpful!!! Don't even try to take this class, don't even bother, there's absolutely nothing to learn from this class, It's really a boring class.
One of the best prof at UIC to work for projects, he gives very good guidance and teaches very well. Very easily reachable for any clarification and doubts.

Prof.Grechanik is knowledgable and thorough. His explanations are crystal clear, I am learning a lot from this class.

Best CLJ prof in UIC hands down. Take her you won't regret it
She makes the effort to do zoom. Shes overall was a nice Professor, gave us all the Materials needed. We had to do this class online so shes super understanding I would say.

Meet deadlines and you will get credit for it. Despite being an international student, I managed to get an A grade because he saw that I was making efforts by going to the writing center and visiting him in office hours. Just make alterations according to his feedback, and you'll definitely get an A grade. There is an opportunity for "1" extra mark
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Antonio is hands down in the top three teachers I've had in my LIFE. It was an early morning class but I was always excited to go to class.

Prof Guerrero is a great lecturer and makes his class interesting. Never had an English class that connected TV, internet, and music to writing. His class really makes you think about how/why we say certain things. Rhetoric! Cares about his students and is super easy to talk to outside of class.
Extremely caring and engaging teacher - loves what he does and makes you love it too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Caring teacher, is there to help students and enjoys his class. Graded on four writing projects. Start off strong with them and you should be fine, he also provides a lot of good feedback on your drafts. Fix what he tells you to and you should get a good grade. Lots of short readings. Also you have to buy a book that we used like five times
A caring professor

He was a great professor. I am not sure what other people are talking about. He gives amazing examples, even through his strong accent. Most students don't understand, you NEED to PRACTICE and not just look at the notes. If you do...I promise you...you will get an A. Fight through adversity!
Really super hard to understand because English isn't his first language and he mumbles like crazy.  But his tests are fairly easy and the work pretty basic.

English is not his first language. He is a good teacher. I didn't do great because I didn't have good foundation in calculus. So, it is not his fault. I think it is best if you go to tutoring. They are pretty helpful. Andrew is a great ta. If you can pass this calc 3 is easier.

He is hard to understand if you are not used to hearing a heavy chinese accent. He is very nice and does try hard to clarify. But, I don't think I would have made it through the class without the TA translating the lectures.

Would not recommend taking class with this professor. It is very hard to understand him and his examples in class are not clear and rushed.  Just FYI, he does not create those test, its a committee that does so). Grading is also based on the overall math scores, not solely on his class. So get a good lecturer and this class would be easy.

Being a math major, you would think this class, is easy, and it would be if this man could speak English. When he cant pronounce derivative how do you expect him to teach calculus? His lectures are extremely boring, and useless He reads out of the textbook, and does the textbook examples. If you really struggle with calc, I would NOT reccomend him!

He is super friendly and willing to help out and clarify any questions. It can be hard to understand him sometimes, but once you are used to him you can understand him. If you are confused by lecture discussion definitely clarifies things. Overall, good professor!

Mr. Lee is a really nice professor. If you go to lecture and discussion you'll b fine. Tests and homework are pretty easy and if u study past exams you will be fine. Who ever can take him, should take him. Awesome professor. You wont regret it.
He'd be a good teacher if you could actually understand him. His lectures just stressed me out and confused me, but his tests are easy and the only homework is webassign and weekly quizzes. Easy A.

Is a tad steam-rolley, but that's only because she is so passionate about her work. Her lectures are never boring, and she has a genuine interest in fostering your academic and professional development. She is also very lax when it comes to grading and attendance. She wants you to succeed.
Very passionate about the topic but may get boring quick.
Lectures a lot. Class gets boring. Very opinionated. Mandatory attendance. No final or midterm. 3 papers

WOW! This is what a professor should be like! Fascinating, clear, caring, and altogether an amazing person. My only complaint is that she relies a little too heavily on class discussion, which sometimes dilutes our ability to learn straight from her lectures. Still, go out of your way to take this professor. You will not regret it.

She is probably one of the best professors at UIC (aside from Professor Mary Beth Rose). She is extremely helpful, enthusiastic, and knowledgeable. I loved every single day of her class because I wanted to go, I wanted to learn. She is amazing.

She is extremely knowledgable about course content.  Class was very organized, and she always went out of her way to make herself available to and help students.  Keep up with readings, participate in class, and proof papers.  She will mark down for grammar!

The lectures are too long and she goes around in circles, taking sometimes up to ten minutes to get to a point.  Her weekly questions are sometimes vague and if not asnwered exatcly to what they think, it's wrong. The averages are quite low for a 100-lever english class...

My favorite class! Lectures are well organized and clear, but very dense with information. I liked the format of weekly papers and no exams or projects. Recommend two semesters of college English before you take this.

I think that the professor is very reasonable. Her lectures are interesting and she is intelligent. She is willing to meet up with anyone outside of class and always willing to help. There are no tests but weekly 1 page papers. You gotta keep up with the readings and be diligent in keeping up with the papers.

She's patient and Kind with her students, she doesn't rush or drag classes, she cares about mental wellness in a student and she's available on request. She's easy to talk to and her classes are fun and engaging.

Professor Hamilton is super understanding & nice, easy to communicate with, and a very lenient grader. The lectures were engaging & she really wants students to have fun with English & write about their interests. Sometimes she would talk about her personal life, but not at length or in a way impeded learning. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: how you get this job…i'm wondering

NEVER responds to emails. She hasn't graded/put in grades for anything other than our first assignment. Class is not worth going to at all--she talks nonsense. There were few times where class genuinely could've been an email. If you're a commuter, do not take her. You will be wasting time and gas. Not surprised people stopped showing up.

Took the online version and it was an easy A up until the paper. Quizzes were all online and Packback I'd rly just open the textbook to a random page, point to a topic and write a 5 word question. You rly don't have to use the book if you don't want. The paper was a diff story. TA's grade it way too harshly and the final paper was 300 points.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very passionate about her work. She was beyond insightful, and very welcoming. Essays and exams were reasonable, and as long as you read a portion of the material it will be easy to pass.

She lived the life that she teaches us about. Course was incredibly interesting (and quite easy) Minimal use of textbook, but still required to read an artist text once in a while. She makes you feel a real connection to the artwork. Writing assignments were fun.

She was one of my favorite professors ever.  She is unquestionably an expert in her field of Modern/Avant-Garde Art and especially in Fluxus Art.   If you want to gain an appreciation and understanding of really how art pervades one's life, take this course.  Easy A, extremely illuminating.

She is one of the best teacher I've had at UIC. She knows what she is talking about and makes it interesting and fun. It's easy to get an A if you get involved. You have a weekly journal that's due at midterm and final, but you can make art for your entries or discuss the weeks readings. There is some dense reading but she makes sense of it.

Great teacher, she is an expert in the field and she is very interested in student participation and involvement.  Her new approach to teaching art history is great.  Recommended even if its not required.

class is easy, there are reflection ?s after every lecture but you can take them at home, these make up most of your grade. Theres 3 exams 2 are online anywhere & the final is online in class. Most exam questions are the reflection questions. Attendance is mandatory & graded. But his lectures are very boring & he doesnt explain things easily.

Very enthusiastic professor who tries to provide interesting lectures. There's only simple lecture quizzes and excel assignments that are easy as long as you pay attention to lectures. The exams are open book, online, and can be done anytime. However, there aren't much online materials that you can use to study on, so listening to lectures matter.

He was a very cool professor but your grade was heavily impacted by the 3 exams. Exams were hard but they were online. Practicums were homework but he did them with you so easy points. Extra credit for attendance and no group projects! Overall pretty decent class. I would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: MKTG 462 .Professor Hermosilla  does not following Blackboard rules ( can change exam time how he wish) without any updates. Also, he is rude and can not explain simple questions without becoming mad. Overall, class is good but not with this professor.

MKTG 462: Lectures are not really useful (50/50). Professor informs not always on the BB, but through email. Not supportive and seems like the main goal is to give hard exams after easy lectures.  I got B with 95% course completion... thats how the grades are being curved:)
Professor did not have very helpful lectures and most of the materials he expected you to already know. He was not the smoothest of professors with his teaching habits.

There was no hw, and we had 7 practicums that we completed together in class. However, that said, this is a lecture-heavy course, making it so you had to retain information from the lecture to do well on exams. He knows his stuff, no doubt, but would have liked to have more interactive exercises so we could actually learn the material.

Gives advice on how to plan for projects but no clear examples of a properly executed project. Honestly absent and bad at grading (received first grade after 10th week). Talks more about himself/ his start up than anything in lectures. Don't bother emailing he won't get to you. Professor for the research benefits not because he wants to teach

Was sick for a lot of the semester so it's hard to rate. In my experience with him, he offered a lot of detail when it came to creating proposals and slideshows. reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is very slow at returning reports (takes about a month) and grades pretty harsh, but a lot of the score is formatting. He never responds to emails so you should talk to him in person if needed. The clinical problems are interesting and cover diverse issues in BME. Your assigned group is the make-or-break for this class as it is project-based.

He doesn't give very good feedback on projects. There are little to no examples given on how to set up or format the projects and the rubrics are very vague, he just expects you to know how to write a product report. He is a very tough grader and does not explain topics well at all.

Dr. Hetling has good insight into teaching you how to work as a group. He provides clear, well-structured lectures designed to assist with solution developments and gives helpful feedback on ideas. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Your grade and sanity is based on the group you're assigned. I was unlucky so I carried my whole group through the semester. At times of conflict, he was sorta helpful but not really. Don't slack when it comes to reports and presentations, then it's an easy A.

This class is solely a group project class. Lecture is once a week for an hour. This class is either a hit or miss depending on your group. If you have a good group, you'll learn a lot. If not, you'll finish the project, but will be so frustrated with your lazy group members. Groups are assigned not chosen.

Im not gonna lie. Nobody pays attention in class; he's just very monotone. Homework isn't bad it's just typical Pierson. If you want to learn finance, don't take him. If you just want to pass with a B or A, take him!

He's always in a bad mood. ALWAYS. He seems mad at the whole world and it genuinely affects everyone else as well. He reads off the slides and doesn't do any examples expecting you to learn everything by yourself. I genuinely don't recommend this profesor to anyone.

He doesn't seem to prioritize student learning. During lectures, he mostly goes through the material while frequently checking the time, which makes the class feel rushed and impersonal. Really great professor. He implements real life situations into teaching. He's definitely passionate about teaching this course

Healy is highly detail-oriented and puts great effort into clear lectures. reviews.comment: He is okay. He grades the homework and quizzes pretty strict so stay on top of your level. His final exam took me 2-3 hours... There is also a final project. Healy is great, very knowledgable about finance.I found the course to be harder at the beginning but found it better towards the end of the semester. Beware of random pop quizzes. His lectures aren't exactly engaging, can be a bit boring, but if you don't attend lectures the class can be very confusing sometimes. Would recommend!

Professor Healy is very knowledgeable.  He is an Excel Super User. I wish he provided more feedback on assignments. This is not an ideal way to learn and demonstrate one's knowledge.
He is a mid professor. Tough grader on the homework and quiz. Unclear grading criteria, and if you don't show up to class you are LOST.

The best. He's great. All the recent bad ratings you see from November are from the same student. He is too lazy to study and do work, and just wants an easy A for doing nothing. This is college if you don't wanna learn don't go to college. Don't blame the professor and give him bad reviews. Healy is the best. A great finance professor at UIC.
Great professor. He knows a lot about finance and it really shows. I had him for both 300 and 423 and I learned a lot. I'm going to miss him when I graduate. Definitely take him.

This class is quite confusing for an intro class. He doesn't work out any of the problems and just reads off of slides. Exams aren't the worst and the curve helps.

From the reviews I've seen in the past this guy seems like he wasn't so angry before, but as of now he's an absolute hothead.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS PROFESSOR

reviews.comment: Currently studying his summer class and it's homework every 2 weeks. It's overwhelming for me but his assignment is explained clearly, but as a slow learner I personally feel like the homeworks is too much and it stressed me out.

decently easy class. all the exams are online. the lecture slides were good, & he solved problems on the board in class. the pace of the lectures was great; he never rushed just to get through something. he's not very understanding abt absences, but he doesnt take attendance every class, & he leaves room in ur grade for a couple absences

This is a difficult course. There is a lot of homework, be prepared for 8 quizzes, 2 midterms, 1 final. Take a lot of notes and start the homework as soon as it's released because you will fall behind otherwise. You will think it is an easy class the first two weeks but it will not be easy.
Its a pretty hard class but the professor is pretty good.
Homework, quizzes and tests were all online. The material was heavy and hard to learn. So many formulas and math applications. But overall the class is decent.

Professor Healy's lectures are very easy to get through and he is very knowledgeable about finances. Gives lots of homework but it's all doable if you follow the examples. Exams and quizzes were online and can be long so make sure to take good notes. Overall a very decent professor. Highly recommend!

reviews.comment: Professor Healy was alright. It's a finance course so there's a lot of info. The class is lecture heavy, and there was homework every week on Pearson. He is accesible out of class. His class is pretty straight forward. Assignments are based on my finance lab. Lectures are easygoing. Overall, I like how he teaches the class and his grading method.

reviews.comment: Professor Healy was great! I would take him again. 2 Midterms, 2 Quizzes, occasional pop quizzes, Pearson Homework, Tests were online also quizzes. Attendance isn't mandatory but he would take attendance a few times throughout the semester.
He is an amazing professor that conveys the material clearly and his teaching style will motivate you to kick start your career in finance.

I took Professor Healy online for Fin 500. He is very caring and helpful. He wants his students to do well. The Finance class itself is pretty tough, a lot of work and formulas. You do not need to memorize formulas, but need to understand them. Professor Healy is honestly one of the better professors I have had at UIC.

VERY SMART PROF!! Gives detailed descriptions of assignments (and updates), so nothing is a surprise. Lectures are easy to follow, & he makes sure that the test are problems reviewed in class/hw. Gives flexible deadlines for hw and extra credit opportunities. He even allows to take the exams at 2 different times for convenience. Easy A if you try.

Can definitely see how some students find him boring. Very lecture-heavy and to the point. I had him at an 8:00 class so I might be a bit biased, but the lectures could get super boring and bland. That being said, you can tell he's a pretty smart guy and has a lot of knowledge. If you listen to him, you could honestly learn A LOT.
You will learn a lot from the homework. Take good notes from the assignments, and you will do great on the exams. The hw offers a lot of help.

An absolute bore. All he does is "lecture" and by that I mean he repeats math problem after math problem. We could do this ourselves at home. There is no real learning, mostly just trying to stay awake while he reads the slides. Classwork is easy, should be easy A. Wish I took a professor that can actually teach so I learn what I need for my major.

Dont listen to the other ratings! Hes easy!! Theres homework assignments and also pop up questions in his lectures which are very easy and you can take them an infinite amount of times. 3 case studys (all easy) 2 midterms one final and 3 quizs. Sounds like a lot but its easy and doable. Finished with an A.

Very lecture heavy and personally, I would just skip them because he just goes over math problem over math problem. I was able to push through with the book and his homework problems online came with example problems so that's how I learned. Really tough and lots of homework problems too. Exams weren't as bad though.

It is almost like learning math equations, but each word problem is slightly altered from it.
Took an online class. Had to complete quizzes every week. Try to do it as early in week if possible. course material explained properly and tested on that specifically.

Taking FIN500 online with Professor Healy is a great option. He is quick to respond to emails and his grading criteria is clear. It is a pretty tough class, so be prepared to put in a lot of hours. Nevertheless, taking it online is a great option because the "lab" allows for multiple attempts on everything except the midterm and final exam.

Sometimes his lectures were boring but hey what are you going do to make finance fun. His exams were pretty hefty too most felt like we should have gotten more than 50 min to take his exam. But overall solid teacher who gives a curve in the end to help for his mistakes

Tom is so boring. he seriously does not show any interest in the subject. also tests are a whopping 75% of your grade. the tests are very very difficult and he gives you a formula sheet with none of the formulas you actually need.

Take this class! Assignments are clear and good feedback is given to ensure sucess in the class. There is a lot of writing but you get to pick how you want to be graded which is helpful. She is easily accessible outside of class and is super kind, wanting everyone to succeed.

reviews.comment: Dr. Van Heumen is the best professor I have had at UIC. This class is amazing and she really cares about her students. Participation grades are filling out a google form and that also counts for attendance. There are weekly reading quizzes online, but all quizzes and all tests are open notes and you can look at uploaded lectures.

Shes the most caring professor Ive had. The class is very interesting and the ta I had was so much help. There is 4 quizzes and 1 final quiz but its all open notes and al her lectures are posted on blackboard.

Prof. Van Heumen is such a wonderful prof.! She clearly cares about her students and she usually keeps lectures interesting. The readings are usually short and help you understand the material. Quizzes and exams are online (open notes), weekly reading engagements (kahoot or written on BB), 3 bigger assignments. Class was interesting and easy!
This is an easy class to fulfill a gen ed. You will have to read a bit, but its manageable . No tests, but there are open-note quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She might be one of the best professors I've had so far. She really cares every student's success. Her lectures are attractive for me, and her TAs are awesome, too!! No textbook used cuz she posts everything you need on Blackboard site. Grading is clear and there are a lot of extra credits!! Pretty sure you can get an A!

Professor Van Heumen was great! She made DHD101 very easy to follow and overall a great introductory class. She made me think critically about topics, giving real-life connections and examples. I could tell that she was passionate about what she was teaching in this class, as she was always thorough, organized, and prepared.

Van Heumen is a great professor! She is caring about her students and passionate about what she teaches. If you need anything she is there to help. DHD 101 is an interesting class and you will learn a lot!

I would absolutely recommend this class to anyone. It was not hard at all, and the professor cares deeply about the material and his students. You are allowed to revise each assignment; his lectures were engaging even though they were prerecorded. He is a great professor and very helpful.

Professor Healy is amazing! His passion for public policy shines through his lectures. Truly cares about both giving students good grades, and providing feedback to allow them to understand the policy better. I admire how he allowed revisions on every single assignment so students can learn and improve grades.  The best professor I ever had.

Shawn's class was engaging, inspiring, and empowering. He really knows the whole policy process as he has been working for years to get bills passed in congress for civic education. He encourages discussion and provides helpful feedback on assignments. Many times he has said he learns from us as much as we learn from him. He's awesome!

Do not recommend. I have had this teacher twice. I pray I do not get her again. Tough grader. Always score down for APA citation but I'm following the resources provided by the university. Very frustrating. 

Send inboxes and she is not helpful.

The HIM department at UIC needs alot of work and this professor is a main reason for it. It's unfortunate such an interesting field could be taught by someone so cold and harsh. She is an extremely harsh grader and almost uses AI for all grading and assignment instructions which make it so tedious to complete her requirements. Avoid at all costs.

Heavy reliance on AI to create vague assignment directions and provide feedback. Threatens students' grades for mistakes made by her. Incapable of taking accountability. Humiliates students who genuinely want to learn and ask questions. Please try to avoid her classes.

Heavy reliance on AI to create vague assignment directions and provide feedback. Threatens students' grades for mistakes made by her. Incapable of taking accountability. Humiliates students who genuinely want to learn and ask questions. Surprised she's been able to teach for this long without getting reported to the dean.

The worst Professor I had so far in the program. She takes of point for somthing she was not clear enough and blames students. Her responses are lengthy and confusing. She doesn't grade assignments quick enough. Her instructions are not clear enough. When you in HIM program be prepared for that!
Do not take this professor. She is insanely critical for every single assignment. Expectations for assignments are vague and extreme as she uses AI for grading and assignment instructions.
she's a very hard grader

She is very unclear with assignment instructions and gives us NO rubric or how points are distributed with labs or assignments. She takes off points for whatever she feels for. Not to mention the disorganized system for work/hw/labs. The course material is not difficult, but she makes it insane, jumping through hoops.

I had her for HIM101 and she was okay. Sometimes her feedback on assignments confused me because what she was looking for was already there...but as long as you do the work with some effort, have your camera on, and look somewhat engaged you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Where to begin, she talks down to you. Acts like she's always right. Very rude. Honestly just needs to retire already.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Throughout college, I've had demanding professors, but none as frustrating as this one. She's rude, passive-aggressive, and unclear in her instructions. Grading seems based on her mood, and feedback lacks consistency or explanation. Her condescending tone creates a hostile environment, making the course unnecessarily stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I have yet to have this professor but after reading the reviews I do not like her already.

I was never bothered by a professor enough to write a review on. This professor is very rude, unhelpful, she expects a lot and does not give clear instructions. She gives backhanded comments constantly and makes you feel belittled whenever you do not complete an assignment as if we are not in the process of learning.

Very unprofessional. Her instructions for assignments are vague and when you ask her to clarify/ask a question she will make sure to first degrade the entire class for not understanding. Your APA cit. better be absolutely perfect or she'll take off a whole letter grade even if the rest of the assignment is done good. Quizzes purely on vocabulary.

Very hard professor, she wants everyone to fail, there is no way you can succeed in her class. No instructions are given for assignments, once you submit it you get points taken of for nothing. Doesn't explain anything at all. Very very very hard class and professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a tough grader and is very picky about what she wants students to do. Relies heavily on the online textbook for the tests. Her class is manageable just make sure to study and attend class.

She is impossible to work with. SO rude and snappy. Completely unwilling to help although she says she is, when the time comes she will make it very clear that she is not happy about having to provide additional assistance. Don't try to email her for help because she will say you discussed it in class or that it is in the readings.

Overall this professor is not one I would ever like to see again much less take another class with. The grading rubrics for this class are really vague so that she can take off points as she pleases. The worst part is that in most cases when she gives you a bad grade there will not be comments, just rude remarks in class about how bad everyone did.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Quizzes riddled with mistakes. Vague in direction, but will not be bothered to clarify (this resulted in student discussion posts varying to the point of no one being on the same page). Her grading rubrics are not indicative of how you will actually be graded. You can tell that she puts the minimal effort required to "teach" a course.

Shes very unnecessarily rude. Barely replies to emails and when she does, its rude and usually dont make sense. Condescending towards students when they ask questions and doesnt seem like she wants us to succeed. Wont let you take a quiz late even if you have a legitimate reason. Unfortunately shes the only professor for this course.

Anyone with the option to not take professor Hitchcock's class should do so. Her grading rubrics were very vague. Despite this, she'd consistently make up criteria along the way and would get visibly aggravated when students asked questions. She took points off for minor spelling errors, yet had an illegible final exam riddled with mistakes.

It sucks being a guinea pig. The textbook we used had typos, invalid information, and false questions based on its own text. Professor Hitchcock is unhelpful in clearing up confusion in assignments or projects. I have heard her change her criteria for final group project 3 times, and both professors in this class do not communicate very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: FYI you do not have to go to Chicago for the project because she emails the rubric to everyone anyways. That trip was a waste of money bc you don't actually meet the professor. She will have you sit at Uic hospital and talk to the director and her staff for hourssss. And they don't feed you it was so boring and a waste of money!
A lot of work. Professor Lois will make you want to give up during your first semester. Uic has horrible professors in this program. Beware it doesn't get better. They are all rude

If you miss anything she won't work with you so keep up w/ the pop up assignments that aren't due on Saturday. She ignores emails. She'll make you feel like she knows you personally and has it out for you. I asked a question and got told, " I have over 100 students!!" I couldn't believe what I was reading. #unprofessional ;
Her responses to students are so rude and condescending. Glad the required course was online so I wouldn't have to be in the same room as her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is very rude but if you follow the rubric you will get a good grade. You will have the option of going to Chicago for the onsite interview, GO! Bc they will have the rubric to help you make a better grade. Everything in this course is time consuming but it's not rocket science. You can get an A. She compliments your work when you do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Connect is a horrible textbook, it is hard to understand. Professor Lois is very rude through emails and when communicating to students. She is not understanding at all no matter how nice you try to be. Assignments are not clear and she give you an F on an assignment for misunderstanding her vague directions. Longest 8 weeks but you can do it!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: The class itself was rather difficult, but if you're willing to work for it you'll do just fine. Be prepared to study a few hours a day. Devoted my time to it and got an A, follow the directions and you'll do just fine. Love this class, it's intellectually challenging, if you're not prepared for the challenge then stay away.

This professor is extremely condescending.  If you have a question and email it, the professor will not only answer the question but will also make you feel like you're mentality challenge in the way she responds.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Do not take this class. Extremely rude.

Discussion boards require a lot of participation with quality, follow the rubric otherwise, basically F. Final and quizzes worth a lot but information is basic. It's a lot of work for a 3 credit class. Not hard, but time consuming.

UNHELPFUL & RUDE. If you ask a question, even simple yesno, she throws it back at you & says "go look it up yourself." Completely hands off, complains about teaching "too many students," and makes lots of ridiculous requirements for assignments such as "you must be able to log in MULTIPLE times in one day to do the discussion." WE HAVE JOBS TOO.
Unclear about subject matter. Responds with a bad attitude when you have questions. Unwilling to help. If possible, do not take.

Very knowledgable in neuroscience and explains philosophy very well. He's a tough grader but is willing to help with writing or concepts. His lectures are very interesting. Attendance is required but his lectures are recorded. Class prompted lots of interesting discussion. I would take him again.

I found him to be funny, relatable, and a great lecturer. Even though sometimes it may take a while for him to come around to his point, his examples help clarify the material. He also helped me retake several missed exams and helped me get back on track after some life circumstances, which I greatly appreciate.

i was looking forward to taking this class bc of the description but it wasn't that at all. we spent almost little to no time talking about the topics that are listed in the description. exams are open note but very long:5 open-ended questions, 1 essay in 50 mins. he always curves the exam bc he knows he grades tough. didn't feell like philosophy
Great professor. Makes you work hard for your grade.

Very good professor, really has a passion for what he teaches and makes sure you learn the material. Attendance to discussion was only mandatory and you wont really need the book. The essays you have to write are basically summaries of readings and you'll probably score lower for injecting any opinion into them
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Good professor overall, really intelligent guy. Makes the difficult subject easier with recordings and one on one sessions before each paper you write. Pretty interesting class, go to lecture and go over old study guides for final that he posts. 3 papers, TA grades em, so the grade received is based on how nit picky the TA is.

I think he's an amazing professor, with an impressive resume and a real drive to make students understand philosophy I think that it's all about how interested you are in the class and how much effort you put in. The papers are not easy, but he gives you enough time. I am already looking for another class with him. DO go to class!

hilberts a nice guy and shares interesting and funny stories all the time. lectures can be hard to follow but he records them. go to class and read the weekly readings and you should be fine. wants his students to do well.

Terrible professor. Either doesn't reply to emails or takes forever to reply. Not dedicated at all. Disorganized. Failed to record lectures when he said he would. Probably learned more about him and his life than the course material. Stay away.
Like someone else said, he tends to stutter, but he's a great guy at explaining. was a fun and easy class. just study slides and read if u can. exams were open note and open book. easy A

great teacher but he tends to stutter, however the way he lectures is kinda interesting. lectures are always posted on blackboard so lecture isn't mandatory for attendance. exams are pretty fair - open note and open book: easier to have book notes whether then looking through book during exam. overall great class and prof.

Hilbert is a fun teacher, humorous and sincerely interested in his subject and teaching and sharing it with his students. I took metaphysics with him. Problem for me was that the content of the course was pretty much crap. Generally worthless gibberish propagated by contemporaries and likely his teachers as well. -- Sincere teacher, bad content. --

Teacher was nice and interesting. I showed up the whole time barely took notes, was almost impossible b/c his thoughts were all over the place! The 3 papers were hell except the first one that was fairly easy. The final exam was not as bad as I thought, he gives u a study guide with questions. Answer those questions before the final!! I got a B
Hilbert's great as long as you show up to class.
Hilbert is the man.  Take any of his courses for a good time.

i enjoyed prof hilbert as a teacher. he posts all the notes online but i found philosophy to be confusing so it's still helpful to go to lectures but more so to the discussions. i thought the paper topics were really difficult but he let us use our notes on both the midterm and final!
Cool guy and TA's are good its just philosophy itself thats a pain and complicated
No Comments
Very easy going. Everyone in our class got either an A or a B.
PROBLEM W/ SPEAKING STILL BETTER GUY MAKE SURE TO GET GOOD TA YOU WILL PASS THE CLASS WITH "A"
He is pretty easy. His notes are online so you don't even have to go to discussion. If you actually try then you get an A or B.
Easy easy prof. Admitted that he doesn't like giving students bad grades.
This was a great class. I think everyone got either an A or a B. Took it with 400, which is the writing class, and he did not make us do any extra work for that one credit.

Basically, if philosophy is about the brain, and the brain's neurons, and other logic and scientific yawn, this guy is the Prof for you.  I found his a-historical science approach to philosophy to be insufferable.
Out of all the Phil teacher, he's quite funny and teach well.  His notes are very helpful in this particular class.
Funny teacher, kidda ease out the boredom of philosophy..
Willing to help students understand things better. A very good professor with humorous stories to tell.
didnt understand anything
Terrible teaching.
cool teacher...
No Comments

He's ok, but really helpful. the material itself is difficult. You need to work really hard if you want an A/B, if you want a C know whats going on in the class and do homeworks. D or F...y r u taking this class?  The curve helped A LOT!

the profesor is nice and explains things very well..he is leniant and tries to help you as much as he can..his quizzes during his discussion sections are fairly easy if you do the homework and the readings.

Since he does Youtube, his lectures are so easy to follow. Since it's required for arch majors, you really have to follow along. The projects would be confusing at first but once I asked a TA for help it was easier to understand. If you are a BA major, this will be one of your first classes so you really have to follow along from the start.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very attentive and makes the project more engaging for the students

Don't bother taking his class just watch his youtube videos. Nice guy, nice subject, bad class Be prepared to be graded on notes by different people who all have different standards. The assignments are all kinda easy despite being confusing, but you could probably half-ass stuff and get decent credit. Class is a chore mostly busywork.

His lectures contained a lot of useful information but the projects were so unnecessarily difficult and kinda useless. He gives students lots of freedom and little useful instruction. He told us what we should do without instructing us on how we could do it. Everyone had their own project and uniques questions so most got little useful direction.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He looks down upon his students for asking questions that one may not be familiar with the topic. He lacks communication skills; for instance, I email him once, and his response is short and useless information that I do not need to know. He seems to put more effort into his video production on YouTube than his teaching career.
Makes the content super easy to understand. Drops lowest quiz, homework, exam and attendances too! She is the person to take for this course! Her pace is perfect!

Not concise at all, most of the time she is not clear in her explanations. She is also pretty rude and snapped at our class over tiny things multiple times. Doesn't post the HW on time and is honestly not great at math or teaching.
-Makes note taking easy. -Weekly assignments, not difficult if you attend class. -She's friendly -Discussions every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I loved her! Her lectures are guided notes so she is very clear in the notes and you literally have everything in the notes that you need for the exam. She is so nice and makes sure everyone knows that she will help you outside of class. I've always struggled in school and I'm going to have an A in this one. Highly recommend this professor!
She was great. i took her in the summer and she was very available and clear in what she wanted. she is so nice, talk to her if you are confused she will help you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She was very nice and funny but she was bad at math! In her example problems she would have basic math mistakes. Only take her stats class if you already know what you are doing because she will mess you up!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great professor. Content is difficult but she is there to help out in anyway. Absolutely loved having her as a teacher and would take her again.

This class was way too difficult and required too much work for being a GEO 100 course. No one attended his lectures because he would just read off his slides in a monotone voice. First exam screws you over. So much pointless work assigned and you have to read two books.

Good professor. Make sure to take notes during lectures and study for the exams. There is a lot of materials and videos to process throughout the course. Some exams are online and there is extra credit. Not an easy A class, but it is accomplishable.

Take Hicks! He is highly respected, does show videos in class to help you understand more. Does put up some of his lecture slides online in case you miss class. Easy A! As long as you do the work and pay attention in class. He does give extra credit and 2 of the 3 exams are online which makes it super easy. I would highly recommend!!!
this is for CS341. the second test was quite difficult, but he is a really nice guy and caring. The rest of the course was pretty straight forward.
Sweetest professor i have seen so far. Very helpful outside of class. Class is little tough and time consuming which covers lots of coding topics. Start projects early and labs are bit difficult.
Class is hard and very time consuming since the covers covers a lot of things. Start projects early and prepare well for labs. Such a nice professor and very supportive during help hours

Took class Fall of 2024. Gave me advice about feeling I don't belong in CS after crying figuring out pointers. Threw candy to his students during Halloween who answered his questions. Lectures are easy to understand - especially to those who took AP Classes in CS in high school though not required. 11/10. Would fight tooth and nail to have again.

PROTECC THIS AT ALL COSTS. Took him in Fall. Caring family guy I just want to teach me forever. Tests were straight forward, projects were tough but necessary, and overall the nicest professor in all the CS department. I was crying because I couldn't get some material, and he was consoling me and gave advice! NOW HE TEACHES 211 WHY I WANNA KEEP HIM

~5 projects, zyBooks, 2 midterms, and a final. Wish he uploaded his code in a single file on GitHub rather than individual files in the resource tab of piazza. If you have a fundamental understanding of C++ and pointers the course will basically be review.

He is a really nice guy but projects in this class were something else. First few were not too bad. The last few projects were really confusing and there were not many resources for us for help. I went to TA office hours and they were not able to help me with my code at all. Lectures were good but he went off topic sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: He's very nice, but I found the projects to be really unwieldy and tedious. I also thought that he rambled quite a bit. Despite this, though, he's a very nice man.
He never failed to give good feedback on course projects. The course itself is taught at a very manageable pace as well. Definitely recommend the course with Professor Hodges!
Easy

He is a nice professor; he is always available outside the class, especially giving you feedback in your projects. The bad side is that you will have to rely mostly in Zybooks since he does not get to cover all the material during lectures. Zybooks will be your best resource; just remember to do the practice problems because the labs are similar.

Pretty good class with clear guidelines. Get started on programming projects early so you don't have strange errors last minute when submitting. The projects are a big part of the grade so if you do well on those, you should be fine. Also, do all the Zybooks for easy points.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He seems very nice but he is not considerate at all!

Hodges was a very caring professor. The projects can be difficult but he is always there to help during office hours. Just start the projects early! Make sure to review the iclicker questions before the exams because the exams are tough.
very helpful and easy to talk to. good teacher and good at answering questions

Nice guy and good lecturer. I honestly don't know who is in charge of the course schedule but its like we are always behind the HW. Besides that, I have no gripes. He answers questions in lecture and pretty fast on Piazza too.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is really chill and takes his students needs into consideration. There's a lot of assignments but they aren't difficult. Lectures can be a bit boring sometimes but the group projects and presentations are engaging and interesting!
Very kind professor. His assignments and expectations are reasonable and straightforward. Just make sure you pick a solid group for assignments and group projects.

The most caring and nicest professor I've ever had at UIC. He was very considerate, as well as giving extensions for assignments when he didn't need to. Just be prepared for a few group presentations and a single group paper, so hope you get paired into a good group.

Dr. Hoiberg is a very kind professor and I enjoyed taking his BA200 class. He is a bit nervous when he lectures, but he knows what he's talking about and he backs it up with good personal stories. He is also very responsive!

He is one of the most understanding professors I've ever had, and his reviews from his time at Loyola are still true today!
Best lecturer anyone could ever ask for. You won't regret taking up her class.

Mary is a good professor but she may not give A's no matter how hard you work or go to her office hours.  Her lectures help a lot though! I learned a lot from her lectures which also helped me in writing papers for other classes. Sometimes she would be a really moody and spontaneous person in class, but overall she is a great but hard teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: TAKE HER! SHE IS AMAZING! THE UNIVERSITY SHOULD GIVE HER A RAISE. SHE IS THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER.

Ms. Hibbeler has amazing views and isn't scared to share how she feels. She's super open and makes you feel connected to her in a cool way. It's hard to get an A because she is a perfectionist but idk maybe it's possible (it has never happened to me). The best part about this class is you get out early EVERY DAY! TAKE THIS CLASS SHE IS RAW

I took her for english 160 but due to personal issues she left half way through the semester. Go to class and you'll pass, she lets you know what is expected. Very organized, has a class schedule mapped out, with descriptions of each writing project.  Never used the book that was required to buy (the little seagull handbook).

At the start of the semester she specifically told the class "I rarely give As" and she lived up to it. The class was tough and she refused to give a grade higher than a B max, no matter how hard you work. Don't take this class expecting an A.

Hibbeler is a great professor, and I would recommend her to everyone.  Her class was easy, and she told you exactly what she expected from each project. Just show up to class and you should pass. Some of the projects were boring, but she made them less painful. she was also very useful in her office hours. Do not buy the book, you'll never use it.

Professor Hibbeler is a great teacher. For an english class she makes it very interesting. She very straight forward when it comes to her papers, if you follow HER guidelines then you should get an A. Also go to her office hours!!!

Professor Hibbeler is truly a great professor. Not only does she show that she cares about her students, but is always there for any assistance if needed. Go to her office hours instead of the writing center!
Professor Hibbeler is very straightforward when telling you what she expects in papers. Easy grading and her feedback is great. She makes the class very enjoyable! If you can TAKE her class!
GREAT TEACHER. It is the first English class I LOVE. She makes it fun, she's easy at grading papers, makes the class interesting. Loved her 100%.

Straight away she tells you what to expect in this class and what you need to do in order to get a good grade. You need to work in this class like every class in college but Hibbeler will help you more than any other professor in this class. She tells you exactly what is right and wrong for your papers so do it right and get a good grade. Fun class

I learned a lot from her through getting personal help. She is not a easy grader but she gives you chance to revise.  Take advantage of revision/office-hours. Revision will change your grade but also you will learn a lot from it. I am not the best writer (not even close). But she will keep encouraging you to improve your english skills.

She tells you what she expects from you on the writing assignments. The downside of that is that she wants things her own way and when the student tries to be creative, points are taken off and are expected to be changed in order to get points for revision. Overall, good teacher and grader. I was bad at writing essays but ended up with a low A.

She's clear as to what she expects from you for your writing projects (4) and class.Just read the syllabus!There's an attendance policy but it's the same for all English classes.Try to participate a couple times since it could make the difference between an A and B.Do the readings and journals and you'll be fine.It was an enjoyable class.

She is a very hard grader on papers. The writing projects she does are for the most part boring. It seems like when we had a writing project we had to figure out everything for ourselves. She also thinks the world revolves around her. She also reads the reviews on rate my professor for what ever reason. But she is very helpful when u ask her for help and will help u with what u need.

She is a really hard grader! she hates it if you come in late and requires a lot of work for the class! its not a joke! you will have to work hard! if you like that then go ahead an enjoy!....I don't!

She gives quite a bit of homework and some participation points, in addition to 4 essays that make up the bulk of the grade. If you do ALL the work and are a good writer you will get an A. If you do all the work and are a bad writer you will get a B. If you don't do the work, well... Good luck kid.
She is really nice & really pretty. A really fair grader which I guess makes her hard.
Class is hard, but she is very pretty.  I write descent but i get like low 80's. Grades hard, but very fair.

She is a very nice teacher. Disciplined yet is understanding and always willing to help. She is very approachable. Gives many essays but gives us a good amount of time to write them. Take her if you can

I took her class when I was a Freshmen and kind of intimidated by "The collegiate atmosphere" but honestly she was a very cool Professor really liked when students presented their opinion and made me comfortable in college and being able to express my ideas without being shut down. Definitely recommend her for any class.
She is fun as hell. Spend just a bit of your time and you will get an easy A. Very funny and attractive. Best prof ever.

She is amazing! She is so nice, doesn't make you feel bad if your paper needs help, and she is so chill. The best professor I have had yet! Do the work, read the homework because she will quiz, but it's easy, and show up to class, boom, you get an A.

Ms. Hibbeler is the best! If you need English, take her class and don't even worry. Her homework is simple and her expectations are straight forward. You will write 4 papers as in every English class and they're pretty easy as long as you don't put it off to the last day. She's a fair grader and give great advise.
She's SOOOOO chill!!! she's easy.... and she's attractive haha

Very friendly and approachable. She lets you do rewrites which can help your grade a lot if you do. Not too hard of a grader and cancelled class a few times. I'm really glad I had her as my english teacher. Made transition from hs to college easy.

She was a good professsor! But she makes you write these 1 pg relection letters that are a bit pointless. She real funny too. Cancel class around the time you need class to be canceled. Show up to class & do the work & you'll be fine

She is sooo nice! grades pretty easy because i never spent more than two hours on any paper but always got over an 85%. she gives a lot of feedback and tells you exactly what she wants in the paper. shes awesome. take this class!
Such an awesome teacher! Also kind of funny. Make sure you have a good editor to revise papers and you will be fine. Definitely should take her if it's your first English class in college.
MAY SHE LIVE FOREVER.
