He's kinda arrogant, but still a good teacher. He gave graduate level reading assignments for a 100 level class though and he was sumtimes unprepared

He is a great professor for his first time (yes our class is his guinea pig) He knows how to convey information and keep class interesting. You MUST read the textbook and the outside readings he assigns in order to succeed in his class. Most of all PARTICIPATE in class discussions he loves debating issues with his students. the hardest thing: essay

When i registered for the class his name was Morrison but he changed it to Ifatunji. He is a cool n decent lecturer easy to understand. Doesn't give or put notes on the board at all you have to take your own. Exams are based on what was said in class. Like he will put points that he or students bring up on the exam so attendance is a good idea.

This class is easy during summer if you don't take other major classes with CHEM 222. Practice and do well on the Lab reports, you can easily get an A. Exams are heavy and kind of hard, but do more practice and you should be fine! He always gives extra credits on exams and after exams, so take advantage of that. Monotones so his lectures are boring

Although there is a lot of memorization required in this class, the lab work easily reflects the lecture material and makes it easier to learn. If you don't do well on an assignment Dr. Bolotin will reach out and make sure you understand it. Great professor and very helpful.
easy 200-level class for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: To understand homework/labs, I had to use my textbook + go to TA's OH. Quizzes given were BS, but Prof made most of them to be extra cred. There were also extra cred HW + 1 extra cred problem per exam (excluding final). Exams were, for the most part, easier than the HW. He made a mistake on the final so check emails occasionally during exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Igor is tough to understand and all over the place, but he's really nice and understanding, and a really smart guy. Pchem lab is hard with anyone, so good luck.
Awesome teacher. He makes learning a new language easy and fun.
Great prof. If all teachers had the same attitude about the importance of education, and actually helping students, everyone would be much better off. 5/5

I took Steve for English online!  He is super cool, and a great instructor.  He made me love English. I never thought that was possible.  He makes you work hard, but you learn from him.  You have to be an absolute idiot to fail his course. BTW, pic is hold.  Steve is buffed and hot.  TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!!!

Steve is the absolute best.  I took him for an online English class. He made grammar so fun and so easy to understand. It was a lot of work, but it was worth it. Steve provides so much help. You have to be an absolute idiot to fail his course.  TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!  By the way, the pic of him on this site is old.  Steve is buffed and hot nowadays!

Amazing teacher.  He was always willing to answer questions and help anyone.  There is no reason to get anything lower than an A in his class if you do what you are supposed to.  Very relaxed which creates an enviornment where you learn alot and dont even notice in till at the end of the course you know everything.  TAKE ANY CLASS WITH HIM YOU CAN!

Steve made 16 hours a week of German actually fun. He is very high energy and smart. He is also very understanding with assignments and deadlines. He does, however,  expect you to be engaged in lecture and do your homework. So do that you and you won't have a problem.

OMG STEVE is the best!...i absolutely adored him...hes the sweetest guy youll ever meet...i enjoyed class everytime i went...he helped us SO much...class is so much easier when you have teachers who actually cares for you...& Steve is one of those teachers who truly did care for us. try to take his class if you can...i recommend him.  THANKs STEVE!

Steve is awesome! our entire class loved him.he's so helpful and really wants his students to learn spanish. we all tried to trick our way into getting him again. awesome guy, if u don't get a good grade it's b/c u didn't do your workbook! he is definitely 1 of the best at UIC.will make extra time to help you, and actually cares

Such a great teacher, the best at UIC.  I couldn't have made it through this class without him as my professor.  Great demeanor, very clear, teaches background info too that you'll appreciate.  Such a great class, take if you can.

She does care a lot about her students. You are required to participate and talk in class. She is kind of a tough grader, but an instructor draft is required, and she gives helpful feedback on each one. My biggest complaint is she sometimes took forever to get the feedback out, but she is accommodating if you need it.

Very great professor. She is very caring and understanding. This class is very different from other science fiction courses because it not only focuses on imaginative elements but also on theoretical concepts. There are discussion posts due every week, in-class writing assignments, one presentation, and one paper.
this prof is not all good . She used to take too many holidays.

Great teacher! Participation and attendance are apart of the grade. 4 essays throughout the year that aren't bad at all. Gives GREAT feedback on all essays. Doing the readings is necessary and they are super interesting! She's a great person and cares alot about her students. She understands mental health and is super helpful outside of class!

Professor Meyer is very approachable and easy to talk to. Most of the movies are pretty interesting when you analyze them. Class is a little work heavy (not too difficult, just very time consuming). Make sure to attend class and participate consistently, or your grade will go down.

I literally got 1.5/3 on the first assignment and actually put a lot of effort into the homework. I made sure to go into detail and got a low grade. Lol so I decided to drop early this course in order to stop my GPA from falling.

She is a nice prof. but she wants you to really look in-depth into the films, when I really just wanted to say sometimes a pipe is just a pipe. I did enjoy the class, but there was a lot of participation for us, which if you are like me, can be tiring. The homework wasn't hard, it just took a long time to do (i.e. watching films that are 2+hs)

Three homework that didn't match the lecture at all and are weight heavily. Labs are very difficult. Don't be fooled CAD is Cadence (LTspice). She didn't even teach this semester since she on leave but forced due dates on us that we couldn't do. The TA struggled with us and is a pretty harsh grader. Highly don't recommend anyone taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great lecturer who introduces topics in a coherent and clear manner. Cares a lot about students and their success. Provides a broad range of evaluation opportunities (homeworks, in class quizzes, group and individual projects, exam). Fair grader.

Very knowledgable, great lecturer. Introduces design critical topics in a coherent and clear manner. Cares a lot about students and their success. Provides a broad range of evaluation opportunities (homeworks, in class quizzes, group and individual projects, exam). Fair grader.

Professor has designed this course very well. If any student is looking for a career in Analog and mixed signal track then this course is a must alongwith ECE 468. This course explains in great depth about signal integrity and interconnect modelling.

Very knowledgeable about the course material and easily accessible for questions. A tough grader with tough homeworks so always ask for clarification before spending hours trying to solve something you don't understand as instructions can sometimes be vague. Group projects are also time consuming so start as early as possible.

The course needs lots of improvements. Attend lectures, do some basic simulations, that's it. Department needs to purchase required libraries to carry out full custom design. It appears that not only this semester, recently during every semester the course was offered this way.

Her lectures are good. But I am disappointed by the quality of laboratory exercises. When other universities have tie ups with reputed companies like cadence etc for university programs, here labs dont even have good resources, libraries. With just basic simulations entire course was finished. No DR, LVS, parasitic extraction etc were carried out.

Investing thousands of dollars on this class is not worth it. I am not sure in which area the instructor is good at. Instructor should pick one area and teach good quality, industry standard subjects and offer connecting subjects to reach conclusion. Taking unrelated subjects is like leaving everyone in the middle of a tunnel without an end.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: I took this class because there was a good review. But disappointed. Though instructor is caring, the quality is substandard. There lab assignments are not at all worthy. We did not even do good project, draw layout, extract parasitic, did spice simulations etc. In fact department lab does not seem to have such facilities. Ctnd..
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Do not expect much from the course. Just like other courses offered, basic info is given which any individual can learn by reading general books, watching YouTube videos etc. A good real course which teaches designing various modules is missing.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This subject is a generic one, extension of EC467 and some of the topics are overlapping with ECE567. I wish there was a 'real subject' which matter to research and industry. In this internet age, video of any generic topic can be found in YouTube. Students join university to learn core topics, peripheral knowledge can be acquired individually.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Some topics are repetitive if one had taken ECE467, ECE567. In fact extra topics of this class can be covered with few additional lectures with ECE467. There should have been real subject in the area of professor's expertise.

No clarity in the course, and this should not have been a grad course in the first place. Professor expects students to do revolutionary projects, but if the current course and other related courses are good enough, then it will help students to at least visualize a concept of a good project. Need more commitment!

This course introduces modules present in an IC. Material is kind of general knowledge information present in general VLSI textbooks. Technically this course should have been a 400 level course and not a grad level.
Decent attempt, yet to catch up with the ECE342/ECE412/ECE465 standards though!

She is very knowledgeable and truly cares about the students (whether they understood the material). If you want to purse research in analog circuit design or on-chip power delivery, definitely take her class (it will broaden your view). Exams and home-works are in reasonable level of difficulty.

ECE 468: was a great course that I took in Spring 2018. Professor is very knowledgable and motivates student to think by giving practical constraints in sub-nanometer technology. The lectures proved to be turning point in deciding to pursue research in this field. Usage of SPICE tables in designing MOS circuits was the best part of the course.

She is a great professor in that she cares and she will really work with you if you put in the time and effort. If you ask she will tell you! The only real downside is the workload is more than people are expecting and the homeworks are hard! Be sure to pay attention in class because pop quizzes are a big part of the class. Overall shes great
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great teacher and a great guy. makes the class unnecessarily hard, but is easy to approach when you need help. He grades very harshly so you need to really understand the material or you will not pass. gives random attendance and four tests, all of which are very difficult if you do not know the material well.

By far one the best professors I've ever had! Seems hard at the beginning but once you know him, he is very nice and accommodating!! One thing though, do not think you will fool him. He is "well seasoned" professor and can smell slackers from far away. Take him if you want to learn and be a good engineer; Otherwise, you shouldn't be in engineering!

He makes this class unnecesarily hard, when the content is actually easy. This happens when he doesn't give formulas for the quiz. So you better do the HW to do good on the quizzes. He doesn't give partial credit for trying, unless you at least knew what you were doing. So please, study hard for this class.

Overall he was a straight forward teacher. The relies heavily on the book because he skims a lot on some things that he puts in the Midterms. Read and understand the book thoroughly and improve overall in the class and you will be fine.
great teacher. he doesnt collect homework but gives quizes every week. if you average a 90% or higher on them (which is easy to do) you do not have to take the final exam!!

Lacks effort, not very helpful. Slightly amusing sometimes in lecture but for the most part just reads the power point word for word. Adds little intelligent insight to the material, repeats himself. Could not figure out a problem from his own homework on one occasion, not a talented or inspiring teacher.

Keeps the class interesting with his jokes. Teaches what needs to be known on exams and quizzes through power point. Overall, very good professor! Homework's not mandatory and as long as you study his power points and book examples you're good.

Overall, excellent teacher. Makes the subject really seem applicable, as well as understandable. At the end of the semester, he took us to his lab to see the things he was talking about, which was awesome! He's stretched too thin though, and sometimes snaps at students because of that.
Nice guy ... but extremely boring class very hard quizes and tests
He has a great personality.  Very helpful for office hours and is fair when arguing for points on exams.  He uses power points which is somewhat boring.  Study hard, not studying results in easy D.
Prof Indacochea was my senior project advisor in 1986-7 and helped me get my first job.  Great guy and very good prof.

A good lecturer and he likes to answer questions.  Do the homework, as the quizzes are based on them and the tests are in turn based on the quizzes, so the quizzes will give you a good idea of how prepared you are.  The curve is pretty lenient and he doesn't test on things he didn't lecture on.

Material is easy, sometimes he goes very fast in lecture. His tests are straightforward, and as long as you follow and keep up, the exams are plainly straightforward and easy. Do well, and you don't have to take the final. Go to class! He takes attendance randomly that may affect your grade, especially at the end!
great teacher, helpful friendly, fuuny, all around good professor!

Material Science professor. Homework isn't graded. Quizzes every week on what is exactly covered during lecture (Keep note of any examples done during class!). Exams are straightforward. Indacochea takes attendance randomly. If you go to class, understand what he lectures, you barely need to do any studying to get a good grade (A or B).
good teacher and very friendly
Great person! Explains clearly and tries to help out. Also very understanding. Overall the best Spanish teacher and one of the best teachers I've had.
She is an amazing teacher and makes Spanish easy to learn. She is friendly and funny. I would take her again.

Great professor. I really enjoyed her class. She is very helpful, nice and fun. You can tell she is passionate in her teaching, wants everyone to do well in class and gets you into participating. I'll take her again if I can!

Inma was a good instructor but the Spanish program for general education sucks. Class is boring and filled with activities you don't really learn from. You definitely have to study and do your hw for a decent grade

She's OK. Easy to get a B, but hard A. She never goes over grammar, only does quick in class activities that you do with a partner, so if you or your partner don't know then you're "toast." The class is basically self taught.

Her lectures are not clear and does not really go over material before exams. Previous Spanish teachers would play jeopardy or any fun game of review before important exams, but not her. We have to study/review by ourselves. Mostly boring slides, sometimes they're okay. Only meets with you to talk about quiz/test, not to help with anything else.

Inma was great! She was always very fun in class and made learning a language enjoyable. Tests, not too hard. Quizzes, even easier. Homework is online and is a pain, but that's the same across the Spanish department. She always gives good feedback, will stop to asnewer any questions, and makes sure you understand. Love her! Take her!

One of the BEST teachers i've had at UIC. She is very funny, energetic, and very very helpful. I hated doing the online homework but it was easy. Her lectures are fun and really get you into participating. Quizzes and exams are easy, if you study. I would definitely take her again for my other spanish classes!
She is extremely funny and nice! Very clear and specific about the material. I hope to take another class with her if I can.
SHE IS AN AMAZING TEACHER, VERY FUNNY AND HELPFUL. YOU CAN TELL SHE LOVES WHAT SHE DOES. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

After having a boring class in Spanish 113, I was expecting another boring class but Prof. Strombom make the class entertaining, funny, and kept our interest. She prepares good presentations and post them online. Best teacher Ive ever had.

She can explain well by relating it to her life and giving examples. As long as you do the work, you're good to go! She's really funny and she cares for her students. If we have a problem with the homework or an assignment, she will actually consider it and not ignore it!
Great teacher. Clear. Helpful. Energetic. And hot. ;)

Ms Strombom is an amazing instructor, I wish I had her for all of my Spanish classes. She really wants you to learn and know the language. She's funny and beautiful with a down to earth personality. Do take her if you can!!!

I wish she taught all my classes. Not only is she an icredible instructor, but a great person and she has a genuine interest in her students.  I think all professors at UIC could learn something from her.  She has to be the most memorable person at UIC.   She really teaches you the culture and language of Spanish. She is the best.
Easy class, just do your online homework everyday and make sure you attend review days because she'll basically go over the questions on the test.
Amazing teacher! Hope i have her for 104. She's funny and really helpful. Take her!

Best spanish teacher ever! Must go to the Reviews the day before the exam. She is really helpful and even makes her own powerpoint notes to help clarify theory. Highly Recommend her, I will be looking for her when signing up for classes

I took AP Spanish in highschool so this class wasn't difficult. She is an amazing professor, explains everything clearly.  I would definitely recommend her for any Spanish course.  She has a pretty face so try paying attention to the material.
Highly recomemnded.
I will take her again if I am able. She is demanding, but fair and will do what she can to help. I recommend her class, for sure!!
Ms. Strombom really comes in prepared and seems to care about the students. I like her class a lot!
very good teacher. has a bit of an accent but nothing you cannot understand. gives very good examples and always e-mails extra help to her students. highly recommend her
She's terrible at everything in this class. I was looking forward to the subject but she made everyone feels so stupid when we asked questions. Avoid!!
I was really interested in taking this class and looking forward to it. I never felt like she cared to help and she always seemed to have an attitude whenever i asked her for help.
actually enjoyed the subject and was looking forward to taking the lab. she did a good job at making everything i wished for unattainable...

There were very few opportunities for feedback. Maybe 1-2 whole semester. The class periods were completely useless, and to no help whatsoever. I wish the hist Dept would go back to letting students complete their senior thesis in a 400 level course, and not this useless seminar. The teacher is kinda snarky as well. Tough grader?
pretty easy class. It was easy bc she basically went over everything that was in the book during lecture, so yes you learn.
This was a good class

This class is an easy A! But this teacher is so freaking BORING!!!! She is beyond boring...but take her if u wanna get an easy A! But remember that its kinda hard to understand her..her accent is weird..

The class was a super easy A. 2 easy papers, an easy midterm which she lets you know what will be on it ahead of time, and a fairly easy final. The only downside of her is that she's mean. Her accent is annoying too.  But you only have to go to weekly discussion to get extra credit points.  Going to lecture is foolish and a wast of time.

...besides her rudeness, the class is easy.the 2 papers are easy, you dont even have to read the books.She tells you exactly what ID's will be on the midterm and final.i went to discussion every week since its extra credit if you attend them all, but i only went to lecture 3 times and i got an A

personally, she is very rude.The one time I went to class and she asked questions, she wouldn't let students finish their answers/opinions by telling them they're abruptly wrong.Umm.. excuse me, but who is she to tell students they're wrong about their opinions, much less when she wont even let you finish what you have to say?I dont like her at all
she is ok

Extremely easy course, tell you exactly what is going to be on the exam. Two papers are required but make sure to have Michael Goode as your TA because he his very easy and if your on his good side, he may give u the grade you want.

Make sure you have the male TA. The female one is a hardcore witch; tough grader. The class is very easy. Only went class twice. She basically tells you what is going to be on the test (The IDs) and for the finals, she gives you "what exactly" is going be on the final. I just wikipedia the IDs. A lot stuff are commonsense.
No Comments

I think most of you are overreacting and being mean.  I think people just like to complain a lot. Sure she's a bit boring, but she's very smart, nice, and clear. My only real complaint is that the class was so easy.
Her accent is SOO annoying,boring class, but the tests weren't too bad if you attend all the lectures and know the ID's.
if this is the redhead teacher, she doesnt speak clearly, and her final was horrible...doesnt have any notes up either

She does NOT have a bad accent, her handwriting is very neat, and she's very nice. I can see why someone might see the lectures as being on the boring side, but the class as a whole is still good, and she's still a very good teacher and person.
Her class was easy.  She's much easier than other history teachers.  Take HIST 101 with her if you are taking 101.

Ina was very knowelgeable about each historical period.  The tests were also extremely easy, because she would tell you to pick any five "ID's" (subjects went over in lecture) and write about them.  Nothing new or unfamiliar was on the final exam or midterm.  If you go to lecture, you will get an "A
Can't understand her.
Do your work and she will be fine
I found her to be approachable and easy to deal with.  Willing to listen and is flexible.
No Comments
She has a horrible accent,half the time u cant understand her.Extremely boring class,but not too bad for the credit hours.

German accent. Note taking somewhat easy, uses terms and I.D.s. Bad handwriting. Midterm and papers easy, as long as T.A.s grade them (she's very demanding). Book choices good. Final to be a 15-page written, with I.D.s and 2 full essays.

One of the worst professors I've had, bad speller, bad at explaining concepts and instead just reads off of slides for over an hour. Lots of weekly homework and the "textbook" is 50-90 page PDF she posts weekly on blackboard so you aren't able to read ahead. As long as you go to lecture, complete the homeworks, go to lab, you'll do fine. Huge curve

This professor was honestly super nice and caring about students. This class had lectures online and in person labs and tests. She records lectures for you to be able to go back if you missed or didn't understand a problem which was super helpful! Honestly, she is a teacher that gives extra credit, and wants you to pass the class.

Her class was a very easy A. 85 or higher is an A. There are quizzes every Friday but they are pretty easy. She offers extra credit questions on quizzes and exams and doesn't do any surprises on them either. She is however picky on showing all your work and gets annoyed when you ask questions at times but overall is an amazing professor.

Today the professor stopped the class and started screaming at a student for being on the first page of the packet meanwhile he has a life outside of physics and was studying for another exam.
This class made me change my career path. The professor's favorite phrase is "you aren't becoming physicists," yet she always tests us like we are.

Overall, if you do the homework and you pay attention in class, you will be fine. There is a decent amount of homework; however, it does help a lot with comprehension of the course. The one thing that could occasionally be tricky was the weekly quizzes. As for Iordanova, she's pretty chill, and her lectures are structured well. Lab isn't bad.

she is a really nice professor, but doesn't really explain concepts and how they connect in great depth. there is A LOT of homework due every week so don't load up on classes when taking it or wait til last minute to do them. use the practice packets and group problems to study for the exams and youll do alright tho

i absolutely loved her! class has a lot of homework and there is quiz every week, but pay attention and study and you will do good. do the group problems and understand them, it makes the exams really easy. definetly find a study buddy to work on hw/study with. labs are pretty organized, just get a good ta.

One of the best physics professors at UIC. I used to hate physics but she genuinely made me enjoy it! She is hilarious and extremely helpful with questions. If you get stuck, go to her office hours and she'll always be happy to help. Don't be intimidated by this course, try your best and you can do it!

Listen, the class is hard, but she makes it harder. She hates questions and explaining concepts. Discussion is your only hope of passing the exams. Exams best reflect the discussion packets and practice tests she assigns. Advice to succeed is to study weekly and find a good TA to study with. Ishan is the best, literally saved my grade!

she is not a good teacher. maybe im just slow, but the she does not explain anything well. she snaps at students for asking questions and assigns 6 pages of homework every week PLUS a quiz every week. however, if you do well on the homework and the quizzes (even after failing all the tests), you can pass the class with at least a C.

Amazing professor. Yes, the course is intense and somewhat hard, attendance is mandatory, because there are Clicker questions every lecture, a lot of homework and quizzes every week. But lectures are interesting and clear, grading is fair. The professor is accessible outside the class and eager to help you.
Good professor, she explains a lot. You need to work for your grade. Fair and good grader. She does clicker questions every lecture so you need to attend lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Iordanova Fall 21' and my experience taking physics 131 with her was great. She's passionate about the subject she teaches and she cares about her students actually understanding the topics. She offers students lots of practice problems which is so so helpful and her lecture slides are helpful. Cannot recommend this professor any more.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Here teaching style is basically rambling. There's a quiz every week. I'm struggling to understand anything in this class and this will most likely be my first F. I highly recommend either taking physics with a different professor or at a different school. This the only class I've every contemplated my life choice and my major.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Bernblum was a good professor, but sometimes she wouldn't follow the class schedule. Her grading criteria for assignments were a lil vague, but I feel that is meant to show creativity, not confine us. She was very nice and understanding. She is very easy to talk to. I learned a lot and had lots of fun in the class. Overall a great experience.

One important features of being a good prof is being “down to earth”, as in, Iris knows our struggles as artists. She put that as a forefront in her teaching; she is caring, expansive, intelligent, resourceful, knowledgable, and generous. Her feedback to students work come from a passionate pedagogical place.

Iris was a detriment to my art practice and introduction to the school. She and the co-professor of our class allowed work that was completely plagiarized and bashed others' original pieces. She often made out of the blue rude comments to students outside of critiques. Very bizarre experience, would not recommend taking a class with her.

I noticed when I took her class, she was nicer to certain students than the rest of the class. And she mostly liked me but there was a time when she was rude to me during a critique where her feedback was useless and harsh for this one project we had. I feel like I didn't learn anything just how to pretend to understand or like an artwork.

Occasionally comes off a bit harsh during critiques (keep that in mind), but generally gives good constructive criticism. Coursework is sometimes more challenging than you'd think, so put effort into the assignments. Don't get on professor B's bad side. Overall enjoyable class.

Looks for realism, though she doesn't really teach how to do so. If you already have a certain art style that isn't "realistic", be warned that she may go hard on you, especially during critiques, if you don't meet her standards. She sends all of the assignments and their details through e-mail, so you always have to check your inbox.

Iris critiques bluntly/coldly, and struggles at times with different points of view. However she is very caring of students as individuals and is willing to compromise and understand your struggles. Iris did an excellent job of encouraging students regardless of artistic experience and was appreciative of effort being made regardless of outcome.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Her feedback is valuable, but she can come off as very harsh sometimes. Specific requirements for projects were not always made clear, either.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Probably the most useless class I've ever taken. I never really understood the purpose of the class and I don't think she did either. Pointless assignments that take you nowhere and useless critiques. Didn't learn a single thing. She is kind to almost everyone but not everyone. Tends to dislike certain students and makes it really obvious.

Professor Bernblum was a very harsh critic. If you had a different opinion as hers she will make it clear that your opinion is wrong which made it hard for other students to speak their minds. She will send and respond to emails late. Mostly reading and on your own learning. Choose a different professors if you get the chance. Good luck.

If there is an option to choose another professor, please do yourself a favor and choose someone else. There was little to no instructions on assignments- most you'll get is a LATE email with a sample photo. Very cold and harsh during critiques. Unreliable when it comes to help and advice on assignments.

Professor Bernblum structured the class to feel more like a group instead of a class, everyone is super comfortable with one another and the general vibe is very friendly. Photography is very subjective so you really have a good chance to show what you think.

Best professor I have had so far at UIC and this was in my third semester. Very worldly and tied historical events and current events to the material being taught. Overall was a really fun class and a great professor to learn from and discuss with.

Super nice guy, very down to earth. The class itself is really boring and most of the time there are only 6-10 people enrolled in the class, but he makes it fun. Be prepared for lots of readings. Exams are easy, he lets you use a dictionary.

I took his French 200 Literature class as a freshman and I have never been so moved by such an intelligent, personnable, and charismatich professor. The class is relatively easy if you read the texts, take part in discussion, and review for written exams. He's very helpful and there's no reason anyone should not get an A in this class. Loved it!

This man is the epitome of brilliance.  He is charistmatic, exudes charm, beyond wonderful, and is extremely passionate about his work.  He shares his passion with his students, whom he truly cares about and is willing to help in every way

He is a wonderful teacher and a very gracious, understanding human being.  I've had him for two semesters, and he has been nothing but awesome.  The lectures are engaging, he has a great sense of humor, and your french will improve!  Plus, he has an english accent! ;-)

This man is brilliant!  He's easy to contact, takes time to work with you, expresses himself clearly and is enthusiastic.  Grading is fair and there are no surprises.  You're cheating yourself by not taking a class with him.

One of the few professors who has actually made me think.  He expresses himself very clearly.  He got a teaching award recently, which he definitely deserved.  Always available for help if I needed it.  Very personable.

She teaches from outdated McGraw-Hill slides, and she often overcomplicates solving the in class examples. It's nice that attendance is not checked since you are better off teaching yourself. Her review sessions before the test do not match the test content. She does not weigh your grades in Blackboard, so you'll have to calculate your grade.

Yes, she is very nice, and exams are multiple choice but DO NOT BE FOOLED. She is a horrible professor. Does not teach well, slides have so much content you brain explodes, and the reviews are nowhere near as matching to the exam. PLEASE and I mean PLEASE AVOID. I took her taking MCQ's are easier than McLaughlin, I stand corrected. AVOID!!!!!!!!!!!
Be prepare for heavy lectures. The exams were all multiple choice and she does an exam review before the exams. Personally I did not enjoy her lectures because I were not able to understand anything
Grades completely depend on exams so if you bomb those be ready to say goodbye to a good grade. Notes did not help for exams have to figure it out on your own but she is a kind person

DO NOT TAKE HER. Often canceled class and exam review a day before the exam for literally every exam. Did not post any notes on blackboard to review. Her grade avg for every exam as a D...said we were the problem since we are used to covid learning..ma'am YOUR AVERAGE IS A D...take a hint.Notes were also confusing with no space to write. AVOID HER!

I would really advise you not to take her. She constantly canceled class and even canceled review sessions right before exams. Her lectures were also not helpful at all to the exam and neither was the homework. You basically need to do your own studying and just hope you get lucky enough to get a good grade.

She may be a nice lady, but this has nothing to do with her teaching skills, which are awful. She does not know how to teach, and also she is always sick, which means less studying and teaching. Our class even finished two weeks earlier. If you want to sit for the CPA exam, I advise you not to take with her. You are not going to learn a lot.

I took it online and it was a manageable class. Her lectures were very clear and concise. As long as you read and understand the material, you should be good. One thing I really appreciated about her was that no matter how trivial the question may appear, her responses via email were extremely detailed which helped me a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures are super helpful and she provides these "follow along" handouts that make everything so much easier! The majority of your grade will be on your test. Study the packets, do the homework and you'll get an A. Amazing Professor.

I continually got lost in her lectures due to her only reading off the powerpoints but I studied prior to exams to pass. The concepts in the problems are the exam concepts. I bombed 1/3 of 2nd exam and got partial credit to get B. 2% e.c for prof eval on top of your final grade which was kind. 2 quizzes and 1 in class assignment (turn in notes)

While she only reads off the powerpoint, you actually can learn a lot in her class if you pay attention. She breaks down the sections into manageable portions, and the 4 tests are on two chapters each. The tests aren't too hard and she only includes things covered in class. Homework is easy. Definitely a class you can do well in!

The class material is hard and challenging but the professor makes it bearable and understandable. Homework is very simple, she goes over half the homework problems in class. Overall, study lectures and handouts and you'll be well-prepared for the exams.

Overview: One hw assignment every two weeks(8-9 problems each). Four exams (two chapters each). One quiz. One in class assignment. Irene makes difficult material understandable. We work through half our homework problems in class. The tests are straight forward, but you have to read and study (focus on her pwrpoints, practice problems). Easy grader

Dr Tsapara is always available. She was the only professor having individual phone calls available 10 hours per week. The class was accelerated... I never thought I would be able to like statistics or to even understand it. I consider taking another course now.
LOTS OF WORK, IF YOU'RE TAKING THIS COURSE WITH HER FORGET ABOUT FOCUSING ON OTHER COURSES.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: An absolute sweetheart who will do anything to help you pass, as long as you show her you care. It was the first time this class had been taught in years, and she did an amazing job. Reasonable amount of homework, one midterm, one final, and in class assignments that are done together. You'll pass as long as you try.

This class might be tough for people with no coding experience, but she is so beyond helpful. She'd have 2 hour group sessions for students to meet with her, allowing us to collaborate on projects and hw. She provides and posts many examples and study material, ensuring you do well. Just make sure you don't cheat, bc she will catch you.

If you care, show up to class, do the hw, and try to *learn*, you'll be ok. There's plenty of extra credit to make up for how hard this stuff is. Her lectures are not direct quotes from the book, so it'll help to read the textbook and review notes she puts on blackboard. You're expected to work for it. And don't text in class; she'll call you out!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: She has a very bold personality which may rub wrong with some students but she is caring. She cares about your education. Even if you don't go to her office hours, she still posts extra content online to help you out. I enjoyed her class, very straightforward. Attendance is mandatory. Homework is the exact same across all Math110 classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I LOVED this class. People who didn't like her either didn't do the assigned work or tried to cheat their way through the class. She WANTS you to learn, and if you genuinely try to understand the material, complete all assigned work, take notes, and ask questions you WILL do well. She wants her students to succeed. Just put in work from the START.

She is incredibly disorganized, unprofessional, and downright rude. When you go up after class to clarify, she makes you feel stupid (even though it's often that she did something wrong and didn't realize it). She skips around on problems and no one has any clue what she's doing because she does the most simple things in the most complicated ways.

Dr T was the only reason we passed the course this semester. The TAs strike didn't affect our class as other classes, as she was there and willing to help us all, even with tons of videos and online lectures to bring us up to speed. She is fun and she cares about her students learning.

I took MCS360 and stat382 with her this semester and here are few suggestions for you: Attending the lectures because she may give extra credit in the end of semester Working on projects and hws ahead of time before due day Taking careful notes She has warm personality and she cares about students a lot. Some students really like her some dont

Professor Tsapara was super unorganized in class, and our lectures were always behind. She had a strict attendance policy and was very rude when approached outside of class about it. She was very unprofessional and disrespectful when I went to her office hours. The class overall is easy, but she was awful, and I would never recommend her.

Dr. T is adorable and funny!!! I don't know what it is but she is just very likable and easy to talk to. This class is very hard, don't get me wrong, you will have to work for it and do a ton of outside reading which is why I recommend you get the text book. But I feel with any teacher you choose for this course it's going to be a hard one.
Well, Not easy to say the least but if this class matters to you and not just the grade, she will push you and help you, but do not miss a lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I know it's not her making the exams all the time but shes not clear on what's ever on them. She doesn't offer extra credit which is very upsetting. She doesnt explain why she does certain things in problems. She also doesnt give us a break in attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is very unorganized. As she teaches she goes out of order and does not make any sense. We are behind every other math class and almost all the students in my discussion have no idea what is going on. She knows her math, but she does not know how to teach it. Do not recommend her!

Way too much for a basic stat course. She makes you write papers and do projects involving graphs. Does give pop quizes as well. Take Lia Liu, the other stat professor. She's much better and offers you a cheat sheet (write anything on it, even the practice exam) on the exams.

Very disorganized. Ocean of homework, projects, and quizzes that her lectures didn't cover. Skipped a lot of materials that we should learn, so self-learning. Hard working may not equal to your pay off. Wired exam questions with her strange and tough grading. Extra credit was useless and unhelpful because just worth little percentage.

Okay, Tsapera is so insanely disorganized, it's ridiculous. She changed around so many deadlines that we hardly ever knew when things were due. Her lectures weren't bad, and the material also wasn't bad. Homework takes forever but its doable. I would avoid unless you can deal with her lack of organization because that what cost me my A in the end.

LOTS OF HOMEWORK. Expect MyStatLab to take up your weekend (32 questions with 50 steps each problem per two weeks). She adds projects and online quizzes on top of that. Otherwise good teacher who is eloquent in discussing.

Lots of homework: Written homework, online homework, discussion sheets etc. ALL GRADED. She offers a lot of materials to help (lots of videos and lots of worksheets/practice problems). She has an accent so she is hard to understand at times, but she's very approachable, kind and understanding. There are attendance quizzes so come to class.

She is an awesome professor. You can read the book for extra help, but her lecture is basically the book. She provides examples very similar to the homework assignments. The homework assignments are good to prepare with for midterms. 5% extra credit is available on both midterms and the final exam. She is really easy to approach for help.

She's really nice and treats you like a peer, not like a student so she doesn't really get much done. Doesn't really explain the topics well but rather just breezes through it. Your grade will depend on how much you read the book. She really is nice and grades fairly easily but isn't the kind of person you'd take seriously.

Very clear in her presentation of concepts. She does a good job of keeping the class interesting as well. 3 exams, 5 easy assignments. Easy A, just memorize the handfull of formulas and you'll be set. It is surprising that she is a grad student, but the quality of her class is awesome. Very helpfull and approachable.

Professor  Goldbring's course has VERY HIGH  and UNCLEAR expectations, leading to tough grading. It's challenging to understand what's required for better grades. DO NOT RECOMMEND HIM AT ALL! HORRIBLE PROFESSOR!
Doesn't use complicated words to explain concepts. Take him if possible, he's really good.

So polite, a very nice person. Explains things pretty well. If you don't  understand something you can just ask him after class and he'll explain it in an even clearer way. I'm very sure if it were up to him he'd give easier assignments, unfortunately he doesn't get to completely decide what gets put on tests.
hard midterms,  no words of encouragement or feedback
His lectures are very clear and well organized. Lectures went hand in hand with the textbook making homework/studying straight forward. Would definitely recommend him.

I took COMM 425 with Prof Mukherjee for Spring 2025 and this was my second class with her and once again a pleasure to have been her student. She is incredibly helpful and supportive of her students. 425 wasn't hard, just do the work and reach out if needed, she is accommodating with her office hours.
She accuses students of using AI and doesn't take the time to actually read her student's work.

Take her!!! she is so nice and understanding, and cares. I had an issue where I missed a discussion, and when I explained to her what was going on she gave me an extension. She isn't a tough grader but you will have to put some effort. I learned a lot, and a lot of chances for extra credit. She really want to see her students succeed.

Amazing professor would reccomend to everyone. She has been super helpful, and it was easy to pass the class if you put in some work. She was super understanding because I had a few late assignments. I thought I deserved a lower grade on the final, but to my surprise she gave me a 92. She really cares about her students, and is willing to help
Dr. Ishani is really cool and laid back. Her 102 exams are easy and for our final she let us use our notes and book!

Professor Ishani is very caring, nice and real. However, at the same time, she knows her subject very well and is super intelligent. COMM 301 class is hard in general, but I am very happy I had her for this class because it made everything better. One of my favorite professors so far! Respected, inspiring and understanding.

Lectures could be on the heavy side. Random pop quizzes and she takes attendance randomly. What I did HATE is that she kept us 5-10mins extra passed the class time. She did this a lot, if you have a class far away, well good luck. If you take her just be aware. Otherwise she okay, tests are similar to study guide and get the book! you'll need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I didn't really care for this class, but 301 isn't a fun class in general no matter who the professor is. Ishani clearly cared about her students and wanted us to pass. She gave us several opportunities that would give us a better chance of succeeding. There was also three extra credit opportunities which was very generous of her. Take her for 301.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Ishani is the best! Her culture class was so intuitive, everything you need for the quizzes is pulled straight from her ppt slides. She is so helpful, and really wants you to do well. I wish I could have taken more classes with her!

I was seriously disappointed with the UIC COMM department until I took Ishani. Her assignments are clear and her lectures interesting. She is attentive to students needs, which encouraged me to do better. I have had her for 2 classes and would definitely recommend her. Take any class she's teaching.

Shes very very helpful and attends to all your needs. During speeches you are assigned shes a good grader and gives amazing feedback on what you can improve on. Makes class interesting and is very energetic/funny. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!! Shes the reason I choose Communications as my major.

Seriously the BEST COMM professor in this department. Makes class fun and interesting, has open note exams, and has interesting topics. She understands if you made a mistake like turning in the wrong paper, and lets you turn it in for credit even after 3 weeks of turn in date. LOVE LOVE LOVE. take her. she's amazing.
Do yourself a favor and take any class she's teaching.
She was awesome! Quizes are super easy and mostly open book, you get to watch some movies in class! She is funny and a fair grader! LOVED HER!
The best teacher ever! She gave good feedback on each of my speech topics. Easy, easy A!
She's an easy grader. There are a few quizzes and they're easy points. You can pass with a B without trying. Just follow the outline for the speeches, you'll get an A easily.

She is sweet, approachable, and intelligent! One of the best professors in the Comm department. Tests and assignments are easy, and she is a fair grader. Do all of the assignments and don't miss too many classes and you'll get an A!
Easiest class ever! If you have a chance to take it, take it!
Awesome teacher. She is an easy grader and very energetic. She is very good looking and has some nice...well you know if your a guy. EASY A!!!!

One of the best teachers I have ever had. Extremely nice and helpful. Turn in all the assignments on time and you are guaranteed to have an A. She grades very leniently on speeches, just make sure you turn everything in on time. Textbook is not required, nor worth buying. I had an easy 99% in her class. TURN IN ALL ASSIGNMENTS ON TIME.
Awesome teacher, very helpful! Highly recommend that you take her. Attend the class and do the assignments and a guarantee A!
If you keep up with the readings, you will do great.

Elaborated on the main biomechanical principles and how they related clinically. Gave us homework that was relevant to clinical care. Answered questions we had and spent time ensuring we understood each concept. Ensured each student was familiar with concepts before progressing.
Knowledgeable and fair. Available to help with course work or clinic cases.
Excellent faculty, very helpful and motivational with new ideas.

Manages to squeeze a lot of material into very little time and gave feedback on exams and quizzes. Material was based on classic and contemporary articles and gave a framework for continued learning outside the classroom. He's very eager to help any time, either in person or via email, and is receptive to feedback and makes improvements as needed.

She was one of the worst teachers I have ever had. She cancelled so many classes, left terrible feedback, and each lecture was opinionated and made women seem to be useless. WAY too many papers and she changed the guidelines ALL the time. I could barely keep up. Thank GOD this class is over. Hope to never see her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Course consisted of 5 (1-page) journals, case study (3-pages), final paper (7-pages), and written final exam. Professor never follows syllabus and the end of the semester is packed with assignments. If you have conservative views this class in not for you and you will struggle greatly with assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: Overall the course work was generally pretty easy. There was an assignment due every week, there was a book review & a GROUP PROJECT, which consisted of a collaborative paper. She is awful at communicating and ignored all but one of my emails, which I found inconsiderate since this is an ONLINE course and that is the only way to communicate!

She is very enthusiastic about teaching and is pretty good at it. She makes sure you're prepared by giving hints on what will be on the midterm and final during her lectures. Attendance is a must as it is put into the final grade and is worth many points, more than 10pts to be more specific. Awesome instructor definitely take her.

Good class, good teacher. Very clear in lectures. Has interesting info, observations, & experiences to add to material. You don't really have to read the book but will need to refer to some concepts for the tests. Tests are multi. choice. She gives pretty good study guides. She also specifies during lecture that some items will show up on the test.
Very fair teacher. She knows her stuff and makes sure her students understands. Great teacher! Would love to take another class with her.
She lets you know what will be on the exams. Not very hard but u have to take notes and u will b ok. She is clear on what she wants. 1 court observation. 4 internet assign. 2 tests.

Make sure you take notes, and mark what she says will be on the exam. U don't have to read but have the book because you will need it for the study guide. Memorize what will be on the study guide and go to class and participate and you've got yourself an A!

SHOW UP TO CLASS! Also, buy the book and follow along in class highlighting major topics. Test are multiple choice (with extra credit). Follow the book, show up, study a little, and talk once or twice... you WILL get an A. She can be intimidating, but don't be scared by her- Prof. Isom is really, really nice and easy to talk to.

She's funny, which makes class more lively. Explains things very well and makes sure everyone understands what she is talking about. Participation/attendance is 50% of your grade so GO TO CLASS. She won't force people to talk unless no one says anything at all. If you ace the exams and hw but don't participate, you can get an A. She's pretty fun

She was a very interesting teacher who had an ability to give you the information in a way you could easily understand it.  Only thing is you have to go to the class basically everyday and read the book.  Mainly, you need to take her notes and know the studyguide and every bit of it.  If you do that you'll do perfectly fine.
Easy going, clear expectations and does keep the class involved. She wasn't my favorite,but I would still recommend her.

This teacher is not that great, I was not even a point away from an A. I feel sorry for those that were close to a C and didn't pass because she is not willing to curve a point or two. good teacher has alot of personal experience and all the info u need for the test is in the book and she give you a study guide
