He is one of the Best Profs I have ever seen. He tries his best to make things understandable to the students. If you are late or not serious, you will not get good grade. But if you are serious, you can learn a lot from his class and most importantly, you will most probably get good grade.

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. Yes, he doesn't teach well (you might need to self study a lot especially if you haven't taken AP Chem). However, compared to to the other chem professors his tests are sooo easy. He grades leniently and gives you a lot of supplemental materials. Theres multiple choice too and his tests are literally all from the discussion HWs

Has an accent which is understandable at best. His tests were the worst. Get one question wrong and it drops you a letter grade an a half. Partial credit? Barely.  Had multiple choice questions that were worth a few points, but the main questions t meant passing or failing. Takes attendance right when class starts. Dont be late. Take Jursich.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Decent professor. He seems to care about lecturing however, since it was his first time lecturing he wasn't the most clear. His exams were easy, but his quizzes were brutal.  Exam questions were 80%+ from his review questions he gave which are found in the lecture. He curved the class 5% + curved many exams. Spent alot of time learning from book
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I know now what to do when I retake to get an A so listen up: exam short answer questions are from lectures. Sapling hw & discussion worksheets & modules questions aren't in any exam/quiz. Final exam is brutal! Final exam is EVERY old test/quiz question and lecture question example (not *really* 8 short answer questions like he said it would be)

Honestly, he isn't that bad. He makes a few funny remarks from time to time. He isn't the best at teaching but he'll get the point across. Iclickers are random asf so come to class and if you pay attention and study before an exam and or quiz you'll do fine. Also reuses questions a lot... SO KEEP YOUR OLD QUIZZES AND EXAMS

Pretty good professor. Follow his lectures and discussion worksheet and you should do fine on the exams. Clicker points for attendance. I skip most lectures and was still able to get a B. Posts all lectures online and has fairly easy tests (80% of exams are math based questions though) compared to other professors.

Mr. Islam was an overall good teacher. He usually tends to use both his powerpoint or his own notes in class to teach in lecture. His tests and quizzes are very easy compared to other lecture teachers.

He is a good chem teacher and his iclicker questions are always on tests and quizzes. EXACT SAME PROBLEMS. Most of the questions he does in lecture are on the test. He has a little bit of an accent but other than that he is really good.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Took this as an elective. A lot of work for a 100 level class. She's really passionate about what she teaches. Sign in sheet everyday. Not a bad class especially if you're interested in urban planning.
HOTTTTTTTTTT. Easy class

Ivis was a good teacher. Fair grader, genuinely nice person. Coursework includes 4 individual projects, the take-home midterm (very long), group project, and the final.  My only issue was with her grading scale.  Everything is worth 10 points, except the group project (20 points). The work is not difficult, but time-consuming. Not a blowoff class.

Well organized and engaging lectures. This 320 can be tough, but I could tell that the professor genuinely cares about all of his students and wants to help his students succeed. He's also very understanding and approachable. And he prepares you well for the tests.

Professor Coskun is excellent. His classes are challenging but he has the skill to make it so that challenge is productive rather than frustrating. You will learn a lot, his lectures are amazing and he knows how to balance mathematical rigor with applications. Take him if you get the chance.

Great professor, very helpful and always willing to work with a student after class when needed. The book was only really used for homework problems, though he assigned heavy loads of them. The course was pretty fast paced, though there is plenty of material that needs to be covered for MATH 320. Covered some interesting side topics too.

He is a genius and his classes are the best in the math department.   You will leave each day bowing to his math-God-like abilities.  He is also amusing and knows when to make fun of himself in class.  Hope he teaches more classes next year!
Awesome professor, but very challenging.  He's one of the most thorough professors I've had in any subject.  Don't expect an easy class, but if you do well you'll have mastered the subject.

His lectures are pretty fast, and his class was extremely difficult. But, he is probably one of the best professors I've ever had. I don't recommend you take him if you are not willing to work really hard (unless you're a genius). He is always available to answer questions. I find him very approachable. I really enjoyed his class.

The only thing I did not like is that she takes FOREVER to grade assignments, so most of the time you don't really know where you're at grade-wise. There were times I had to text her to ask her to post my grade on weeks old assignments.
She's a slow but fair grader and gives great feedback on assignments. Shes not nitpicky when it comes to grading. I would definitely take her again.
Professor Jahnke is one of the most understanding professors at UIC. I would retake her class again.
Her flow is easy, just get the work done. Not a nitpicker at grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prompt feedback.
Would take again! Understands work/life school balance.
Great professor. Encouraging
Hard to reach, slow grader
Absent. Very slow at grading papers and answering questions.

Iusco is very passionate about teaching and Italian. She's definitely a bit out there but she is very caring about all her students and wants them to succeed. I would recommend taking her for intro or after. Also fun to study abroad with!
She's can be pretty mean and felt like she would bully students. She's passionate about her work and her background but she can be a lot.

Maria Iusco it is not just an excellent professor but super fun to work with . She is so passionate about Italian that learning the language from her class seems easier than it is . I strongly recommend this professor ! You won't regret ! Not to mention she organize trips to Italy , can't go wrong with that !
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof. Iusco is very funny and creates a really interactive class environment. I looked forward to class because she makes going to class fun. There's lots of work outside of class, as learning a language takes practice! She is very passionate about Italian language/culture and is willing to answer any questions you have. I wish she taught 104 too.

Profesoressa Iusco is very energetic and always brings a good attitude to class. I was very hesitant to take a college-level language course, but I am very glad that I did and ended up with her as my professor. She is very caring of her students and somewhat laid back. She knows when it's time to get to business. +points she brings treats to class!

The class, itself, is hard but she does make it into an enjoyable experience. Attendance is mandatory, there's a lot of assignments, but she's fun. She's also really attentive to students and encourages you to reach out! Classroom environment is very interactive!

she was a great professor, very funny and passionate. however she wanted everyone to prioritize her class and her class only which isn't realistic for most students. very homework and attendance heavy. she also would accomodate for sickness but would be passive aggressive regarding the matter. great teacher but could work on a few aspects.

Professor Iusco is the best Italian teacher I have ever had! She seriously is so passionate and engaging with the class, and she also has humor which is a breath of fresh air for a college professor. I have learned so much from her not only from the material itself, but about the culture of Italy as well. I wish I could take every class with her!

Professoressa Iusco is the best! She is very passionate about teaching Italian & loves to talk about the culture. She is very funny and wants to see you succeed. She cares that you understand and are learning the language and not just memorizing certain parts to pass. Her passion about teaching Italian is what made her class the best&very engaging.
Class is just review of what we read on the book. She comes off too strong and is a little bit mean. I didnt really learn in her class, what I know comes from a book and the online homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Overall pretty great professor. Not an easy class per se but if you show up, pay attention, and do the work then you'll be fine. The book is needed 100% but she's chill and understanding. She's also always available if you need anything which is nice. Decent amount of hw, nothing crazy but you definitely gotta do it. You get what you put into it
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Getting used to her way of teaching because she really likes to involve the classroom and have everyone participate. Don't be scared to asl for help because she is willing to help you out and any time. Honest i love Professoresa Iusco, She is so caring she also loves to bring in snacks and have festive activities. Make sure you attend class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Shes probably the beat professor i ever had. Shes so passionate, energetic and super funny. You have to try really hard not to get a good grade in her class since shes super helpful and cares about students passing with a Good grade. I did her study abroad in the summer and i would totally recommend it. Youre going to have an amazing time!
Maria is a really enthusiastic and engaging teacher. With that being said, she expects you to participate. Homework is pretty easy. I would recommend taking her classes!

Let me tell you that if I had any other professor for Italian I probably wouldn't have made it. Professor Iusco may seem a bit crazy and hectic but that all part of her charm. She really does care about her students and will take time to help you when you ask. If it weren't for her, I wouldn't have even consider studying abroad in Italy.

She is a dedicated and great teacher of the Italian language. If you apply yourself and put in the work she will teach you so much! STUDY ABROAD! She will make you feel safe and it will be an incredible experience where you will learn so much more than you can in a classroom. Granted with her in the classroom you will learn a lot!

Maria Iusco is an absolute gem at UIC! I had the pleasure of taking her 101 and 102 at UIC and without hesitation took her 103 in Siena Italy. I had the most amazing experiences and she is a great teacher. I have her to thank for my knowledge of Italian and I am now an avid advocate for her study abroad programs and consider her a dear friend

Incredible! One of the best professors u want teaching u a language. Shes super friendly & outgoing, making it easy to ask her any questions or concerns you have Granted, she will tell you how it is, plain & simple, and doesnt mean u can slack off. If u put in the effort, youre guaranteed to pass. Study abroad in Italy as well! Unforgettable exp.

I took Professor Iusco for Italian 101-103. She is by far the best and most qualified to teach this course. She is very clear on what she expects out of you and makes it known early on in the semester what you need to do to get an A in the class. She also organized the Italian study abroad program, which I participated in. Unforgettable experience.

She is a great & caring professor that loves her job. She can be intimidating at first but overall shes great. She prepares her students for quizzes really well. The class has a lot of online hw and worksheet hw tbh. I studied for exams like 2 days in advance and got a B on them and got an A in the class. She is really helpful so reach out to her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Pros: She is enthusiastic about teaching Italian, and she lived there for a little while while she was in college, so she knows her stuff. Cons: She is not very professional and sometimes uses humiliation as an ( ineffective) teaching tool. It's okay to try to make class fun, but know the difference between a classroom and a circus.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: For the most part she will only go over things once so you really have to be there every day. Outside of classwork he was a joy to have as a professor. She was always full of energy and was happy to teach about Italian.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great Italian 101 instructor. Class only meets 3 days a week instead of the usual 4, so a little bit more at-home work/practice was expected of us. She really cared that we all succeeded and made the class a joy to go to (even early in the morning).

You have to work for your grade but the way she teaches is extremely helpful. Participation matters but she'll always try and help you if you don't know it. You can tell she's passionate about what she does which helps too.
Missing class really hurts your grade but if you show up and do the work, you'll be fine

This professor shouldn't be an Italian 101 & 102 teacher. She doesn't take the time in class to go go over the basics of the language. She expects you to know what you are talking about in class, and doesn't take the time to go much into questions . She rarely wrote the little info that she gave on the board in a comprehensible manner. I struggled.
Maria is a great teacher! She makes class interesting and has a great sense of humor. She's easy to talk to and very understanding. Took her all the way through 103, definitely recommend.

Profesoressa Iusco was one of the most fun and caring foreign language professors that I have had. She truly cares about her students if they put forth the effort. She is a great professor who is always willing to help. She may come off as having a strong personality but she has the students' best interests at heart. Bonus: she is hilarious.

This is the best language professor I've ever had. She is engaging, funny, and the best part of all makes learning a very enjoyable experience. No regrets of being in her class, and would definitely pass the word around for those looking to learn a new language.
gives extra credit and brings in a lot of italian food

She is very funny and friendly but I felt like I learned Italian on my own. You get two absences here and tons of homework every other day. I feel like I did not learn much and felt too unprepared to take Ital102 like I had hoped I would.

She's amazing. I took her for the first time for study abroad in Siena 2015 and I loved the class. Most of my roommates were in the same class as me so studying was easy. Don't get me wrong it, YOU HAVE TO WORK FOR YOUR GRADE. In class was fun and educational, you just have to study real hard for the final. Maria is down to earth and very helpful.

Maria is awesome!  She is very enthusiastic and  makes the class fun. Homework is almost daily, but the homework is not that time consuming. She gives you two extra credit opportunities. She clearly cares for her students and wants you to succeed. I enjoyed Italian so much that I decided to minor in it. I wish she taught all the Italian classes.

THE LITERAL BOMB DOT COM. One of the best profs I've ever had!!! She knows her stuff and wants to help you do well. I'm not good at learning languages (believe me i"m not just saying that) but she is such a help! I actually learned a lot from her! If you don't learn in her class it's because you didn't put in as much effort as you should have.

one of the bests professors in the Italian program. she motivated me to do so much for the Italian department myself.  even after my completion of 101 and 102 I am still in contact with her for further help. she is an excellent teacher and her ways are strict, but if you do not fight them, you will love the class. she should have perfect rating.

She is the best!I couldn't learn more, her classes are very interactive and she doesn't stay only in the book, she uses other resources to helps us learn. She was NEVER late to class - my both classes were at 1pm. I'm very sad that I'm not going to have her next semester, because if I could, I would have her until the end of my italian course

She was awesome! Always interested in the material we covered and was very helpful with anything we asked of her. Her grading is very lenient and she gives a lot of opportunities for extra credit. I advise to do the workbook every night though, because she calls people out in class very often. I definitely recommend her!

BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE HAD!!! She is so nice and really wants you to learn the Italian language and culture. Learning a language is really difficult for me (really I had a D in high school spanish) but I actually learned with professoressa Iusco!

Well what can I say Professoresa Iusco is an excellent teacher. She really made the class fun and interesting. She's a very energetic person which made coming to class enjoyable. The class has a lot of busy work to it but if you're fluent in another romance language(aka spanish.. etc) the class turns out to be really easy. Overall great professor!

She is a traditional caring italian women. Sometimes she comes off aggressive- it is all because she cares about you, she isn't mad or a bad person. She is a very good teacher and truly cares about your education of the language. I highly encourage you to take her. I enjoy walking into class every day
She is an excellent teacher that furthers your interest in the subject. I highly recommend her as a teacher

She is a very good teacher, she just moves a little fast but she takes a personal interest in her students so she will help you with anything. If you do all the homework and go to class you can get an A even if you don't do as well on tests. She does expect a lot though
Great teacher! Very helpful. Textbook is required. Exams are easy if you study. Attendance is def. required. And she gives extra credit. FUN CLASS! Funny teacher
She is a good teacher. She is not easy but she clearly cares about the students learning

I've taken both Italian 101 and 102 with her and I like her. She's not easy, she expects you to study and learn the topics quickly. The textbook and handouts are used everyday and she expects you to be able to speak a lot. But if you do all your work, come to class and see her during office hours, you're sure to do well.
THE TEXTBOOK IS USED EVERYDAY. ALOT OF CLASS DISCUSSION EVERYDAY. SHE MAKES YOU SPEAK ITALIAN EVERYDAY WHICH IS VERY GOOD. SHE IS FUN. SHE BRINGS SNACKS FOR THE CLASS ONCE IN A WHILE

She's not good. She does not explain anything, just has us do exercises in the book. She is consistently late to class and very disorganized. Those who said you might as well learn it on your own were right, that's what you end up doing anyway. She does not take the time in class to make sure students are getting it, she rushes through. Frustrating
shes psycho as hell!
LOVE HER!!  She is the best teacher I have EVER had at UIC.  As long as you make some effort in trying to learn she will make sure you understand it.
shes psycho
BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD! she is so helpful. I wouldn't want to take anyone else but her... and she gives alot of chances for extra credit and is leinant on due dates sometimes.
awesome teacher! cares about her students. if you need help she's willing to help.her class is fun. take her she's pretty nice.

Very easy to sidetrack.  Likes to talk a lot.  Not completely prepared for 103.  Answers questions during tests.  Not always available during office hours.  But very fun and develops strong bonds with her students.

let me tell what u do in her class. u go in, and she thinks u know everything so she starts talking to u and u do exercises. she does not go over ANYTHING in the book. the person who said u might as well learn it on ur own is right, cuz thats just what u do. she's nice and all, but dont take her if u wanna know italian.

Maria Iusco was one of the best teachers Ive ever had! She's smart, funny, and very understanding... had everything that anyone could ask for in a teacher. She knows what she's talking about and she's an amazing person. She wants all of her students to succeed!

not good at all. you might as well learn italian on your own, because all you do is read the book yourself and then come to class and she expects you to be fluent in whatever you just learned.  there are a ton of tutors and its near impossible to do well without them because in class learning is minimal.the italian prog@uic sucks.
I failed her class but i'm taking her again.  Awesome teacher!

She is an awesome teacher. Very passionate about the material and the culture and teaches you alot. She made me alot more interested in Italian than I was when I signed up. The class requires alot of work but it isn;t too hard or time consuming. Also if you are a cheater it is easy to cheat, some people in my class cheated off of me on every test!
No Comments

Very friendly and enthusiastic teacher.  Tries to keep class interesting by teaching more than just grammar and vocabulary, often includes lessons on Italian culture and life.  Loses control of the class easily and often.

She's a good professor, but you have to understand how she teaches.  Don't look for an easy ride.  But expect her to communicate to you like you are a human being and not just an idiot American student trying to learn a foreign language.  Class was great.

Spent too much time reviewing 101 material so we didn't get a chance to really learn/study new material in 102. She is very into teaching Italian, but always seems rushed.  Little Italian conversation in class, this could be more because of classmates instead of teacher.
No Comments

He was OK as a professor, if you are on time to lecture and participate (like once every other class) you will pass. He takes attendance at the beginning at class. He made discussing material almost pleasurable, even if you don't like it. He is quite up tight, but if you're not on your phone or doing anything unbecoming you should be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'd not recommend this class. Sometimes I thought this is a major class since you have to listen to the song, identify the genre, and its context. It sounds easy but imagine you don't know Spanish at all and you have to remember 10 to 20 songs and their contexts, which is just ridiculous. Like is it a language class? Not a good way to inspire ig

Not a hard class, but if you're looking for a class that's an easy A this is not it. You actually have to write essays, the final one is a 6 page essay. He expects a certain structure when writing an can be strict when grading the essays. There's also midterm and final. And yes, he rages when students go to restroom a lot or wear headphones.

The class was not all too difficult even if it is unknown music however the wrath from the professor on the students with some of the lecture consisting of the use of headphones, Ai LLM's and fits when a few students used the restroom. Ultimately not what i want to come to class everyday but it was interesting when he brough instruments and played.
Easy class. Semi strict professor. Easiest A i've received so far.

I took this class for gened thinking it would be easy, but it wasn't. You must listen to playlists he made and identify them in unit exams, and write 4-5 essays researching music (NO AI). Attendance is mandatory via an app, and the professor is strict about no headphones, talking, or leaving early because he will call you out in front of every1

Honestly, not a bad professor. Gets angry when students arrive late or leave early and he hates when students wear headphones. The tests are extremely easy and the final paper doesn't seem to be graded too strictly. Overall, very passionate teacher but his attitude can be a bit much.

This was a difficult course for me, McNally is a strict grader and a bit angry at times. However, he is very smart so if you're GENUINLY interested in music, he's amazing but if its just for a credit don't take ts, it's not worth all that. If you miss acadly 7 times, u automatically fail the course btw. even if u just forgot to click the button.
He is really knowledgeable so pay attention to him.

This professor is very rude and strict. He will call you out if he sees something he doesn't like. He doesn't allow people to use the restroom during his lecture. He is a tough grader. There are 4 papers, a concert report, and 6 exams. His class is easy, but it's just his attitude that's unfriendly.
This was an OK class, just boring at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Most boring class ever.
Amazing take this class

Very strict on attendance, starts right on the dot. Also, harsh grader this class is supposed to be on the easier side and his rubric is hard to understand and no late work is acceptable. He also doesn't let people leave lecture even for the bathroom, which ALL lectures usually do. He will call you out in front of everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: When it comes to work assignments he's not that bad "sometimes" but I do think the 5-6 concert reflection paper is a bit obscured. The bad thing is he's going to treat you like you are in middle school "no headphones, can't leave class early, even bothers you if your going to the bathroom" wouldn't take again because of his teaching problems

It was just an amazing class overall. The lectures were concise, and he shared slides, but he went into detail in a very passionate way. There are two exams that are open notes, 4 RC writings that take 2 pages at most. He shares music examples in between info-heavy parts to pace the class well. A professor who breathes what he teaches - wonderful!

The class was very interesting, and he made it better by being passionate about the material, the assignments were easy and should take too long and should get you an A if you just keep yapping about the prompts, attendance is mandatory so you do have to go to lecture, reminds me of a high school teacher, overall he's just a chill guy.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor McNally is very passionate in his lectures as he knows his Latin music a lot. He encourages the lecture hall to participate. Work was very easy at it was 4 short papers and one big paper as well as 2 exams. It's a very attendance heavy class so if you can't make it to class on time or choose to skip, it's best to choose another class.

Professor McNally is a good professor, he is passionate about what he teaches and is well informed about his concepts. Your grade is based on two exams, 4 reading responses, and 1 essay. All are easy assignments and the slides are helpful enough. I did not like his attendance policy for Acadly since we could not change when the app made a mistake.
Was an ok class. The papers were a bit tough since I was only taking the course for a Gen Ed and had no interest in the subject

Very little work. He grades very easy. Total of 5 RC responses which take an hour max. Test are not hard and are easy to find on slides. Free 100 on concert report as long as you can write decently. Assignments are not that bad, but make sure you work carefully on them. Very passionate teacher.
Amazing guy, EASY class. Just do your part. There is really no need in even watching lectures, just look at slides for answers for the exams.

There is a total of 4 RC responses consisting of 250 - 350 words, you will get the gist of it after doing the first one. There are also 5 exams that were easy if you write down everything from the recorded lecture. Honestly, the most annoying assignment was the 5 pages paper. Other than that, it is an easy GenEd and a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I did enjoy learning about the Latin music but the work was a little more then I was expecting but he was so kind and helped with optional online classes where you go join through zoom and ask for questions. It was a lot of longgg videos and lectures but the reading were interesting and fun to write about.

He is one of the aweful professors. I saw the rating and registered in his course but his rating is totally opposite. I would not suggest anyone to take his who is willing to take MUSC 127 as their genEd. He is very strict on grading and gives difficult assignments. I would recommend not to take his class ever.

I was going to write a fantastic review, but the review below mine is so wrong. Professor McNally was an excellent professor throughout Spring 2022. He had to go for parental leave, but left another professor in his place to contact. His grading guidelines were extremely clear in the rubric and forgiving. There are only a few papers, and aceable.

Course is very easy, but if you have the time for it really do listen to his lectures. They're really interesting, and it's clear he's very well-informed. Don't start on the ethnographic paper super late, it doesn't take long to write imo but may be difficult to find a video.

Prof. McNally is passionate about the material which makes lectures interesting and fun. He truly cares about his students and is incredibly understanding, especially with classes being online. One of the best professors at UIC!

The course was online so I barely interacted with him. But from the few times I did, he seemed like a good teacher who cares about his subject and students. If you just watch the lectures and write down what's on the slides, and know the listening examples, you'll get an A+. Semi-interesting class,

Honestly the best professor you will ever get. He made my semester the best one I have ever had (even through this pandemic). He is seriously the most caring and respectful professor at UIC. Lectures are super interesting as well! There are four writing responses (short papers), listening exams & the final! Easy A
He is very professional. His lectures are engaging. He genuinely cares for students. Best MUS 127 professor.

James!! I loved this man. He actually wants you to learn and have fun. VERY passionate and get ready to dance in your seat when you get to Brazil. He does random clicker quizzes. Reading responses you can bs the morning of and the listening exams are SO easy. The online exams come directly from the slides. Just show up, its really fun. :) Hi James!

Very great professor that makes lectures interesting. He is super passionate about the material he teaches. Class is very well organized and listening exams are easy. Come to class and you will get an easy A.
Professor McNally is my absolute favorite teacher at UIC. 10/10, easy A and such fun lectures.
Professor McNally was great! He is very considering about grades. He gives easy assignments and lectures are super fun. This class was something I did not have to worry about!

The semester was very tough. I went into this course expecting an easy A, but it turned out to be one of my hardest courses yet. I had to put in much more effort than necessary. He's a very strict grader and expects absolute perfection. If you don't go to his office hours, you can kiss that 4.0 goodbye. Would not recommend.

One of the English Professors in the department. Dr. Kessler gives amazing lectures, feedback, and had a clear criteria for each class assignment and reading requirements. He can be a tough grader, and takes forever to grade. But, he's a really cool teacher who wants to see his students succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor, I had him for HON 142. Very interesting class, very engaging, very passionate about what he teaches and cares about his students' well-being. Would definitely recommend and would take again! Thank you so much Professor Kessler!
a little of a tough grader but not where he would give a failing grade

Very good professor, choose him if you can. Has clear criteria and if you put the work in (which is very doable and not hard) he will help you succeed. Only 4 or so assignments but he reviews your drafts and gives ample help.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Kessler is such a good professor! He really knows his stuff. He gives very helpful feedback on papers to prepare students for their final portfolio. He also presents engaging material to students for everyone's learning styles.
Such an awesome professor. Gives great feedback and is always willing to give helpful advice during office hours. Criteria is clear, rubric is clear. Love this professor- 10/10 learned so much
Prof Kessler is a great professor. I wasnt very fond of this course in general, but he made it bearable and I can tell he is a great guy! and his cat is cute
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Gives big assignments that are worth of a lot of points. Was not too bad, pretty understanding and is willing to give you an extension. The examples used in class are much easier than the ones in homework.

reviews.comment: He's never boring. He genuinely cares about his students' success. He has no ego, and he will never make you feel stupid for not knowing something even if you learned it in second grade. You won't regret taking a class with Dr. Kessler.
Hes really great. super easy to talk to and gives loads of feedback. Papers build off each other and he lets you write about what you want to
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Great guy, really wants you to pass the course. Only 3 essays but helps us along the way. Even accepted rewrites for the 2nd essay. Completely down-to-earth and understands the downtrodden circumstances surrounding students today. Also grades us by attendance, participation, and some hmwk assignments. You can get away w/o reading anything.

Professor Kessler is amazing! He gives really good feedback and wants his students to improve as writers. He's really understanding and genuinely cares about everything he's teaching. The work we did all lead up to the final research paper which made the class easier. The topic for the class was really interesting too.
Great professor, willing to work with students and gives great feedback on work. If you are willing to put in the work this class is an easy A.

Professor Kessler is a brilliant, well-organized intellect. He is very helpful during and outside of class, and provides useful feedback on work. He was also very understanding of the circumstances going on outside of class. He is straightforward and heavily relies on the rubric so you know what is expected of you.

Kessler is a pretty understanding, brilliant intellectual. His feedback is generally helpful and he will actually go out of his way to help you. I have a pretty high skillset when it comes to writing essays, so his class was easy to take. He lets you have a 24 hour extension on any assignment and 1 revision to make your papers better.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Kessler and the topic for his English 160 class was really interesting! He gives great feedback and truly wants you to succeed! He knows how to make assignments fun!

Professor Kessler's class is constructed very well. His theme also had endless opportunities for research which made it enjoyable. He's very straightforward with what he expects from your writing. He's pretty reasonable with deadlines too. You have to go to class though in order to understand what's going on.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: He was okay, sometimes let's class out early. Based on what I heard about other professors, his research paper was not required to be as long as others. Take him if you need the credit for gen eds and be a better writer if you apply yourself. Also, don't buy the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: MEGA CHILL AURA. he is not just a professor he is a lifestyle! test was online and take home. I am convinced he wants us to succeed more than we do it felt less like a class and more like a paid vacation with occasional emails. Attendance is mandatory but keeping up is easy. Honestly would take class again just for emotional support.

Mega chill aura. All the tests were online take home. He gave us every week off anytime we had a test. Attendance is mandatory, but the class was very easy, and he explained everything very well if you paid attention. I would take him again 100%. There are a few group assignments, they are easier if you work together, but you can also do them alone

He kinda has a chill aura, good prof., felt like he was knowledgeable in what he was teaching and was real when he wasn't sure about things. One thing is- he doesn't reply to my emails much, maybe bad timing so probably double email during weekdays, if important.
His class is easy to pass and get A. Exams are online, he is pretty relaxed and easy-going. He gave class time for you to get ready for exams or do homework. A few in-class activities.

Professor Parker is an awesome professor! This class has clear grading criteria, mildly tough exams, get extra for attending class, and lectures are kinda boring in regards to the content. This professor reaches out to students if they need help, is very understanding, and is well respected. Anything that a professor should be, this is him!

He is one of the best professors I've taken at UIC. The course brings creativity into the assignments that he gives out every week. The assignments are not challenging at all. They're extremely fun! Lastly, the review that said he doesn't care at all must be living under a rock. Maybe work a little more to get that A.

This is the first professor I have had that I felt I definitely needed to leave a positive review for! Professor Parker was a great instructor! Every class was interesting and the material made me want to learn more. He explained the homework well and had no tests or textbook. If you like creativity and learning more about it, TAKE THIS CLASS!

Not understanding or caring at all, does not give helpful feedback. He is funny but not a good professor.  I am an A/B student but received the worst grade of my college career in this elective course and did not learn anything. Gave me so many failing grades on the weekly assignments, I really regret taking this course, brought down my GPA

He is not as bad as some of the other reviews are saying. While he does grade kind of tough, he also gives good feedback and really wants you to understand the concepts he teaches. The workload is not bad, you do one assignment per week which can be done generally in a couple of hours, and there is only one exam in the course.

This guy is terrible! He grades so unfairly and is incredibly subjective. You do an assignment each week due Friday and you can do exactly what he asks for and more and he will still grade you worse than someone who puts in no effort! I've had over a 3.7 GPA my entire college career and this is the worst professor I have ever came across.

Very easy grader and overall all professor, however, if your class average is better than past semesters he will not offer a curve. Make sure you study for the exams, turn assignments in on time, and email him if youre confused.

Prof Parker has been great (class is ongoing). Everything is online bc of Covid and there aren't live lectures. Very detailed slides/lectures and super helpful. Offers a curve/extra credit. The work is really simple and he's so accommodating. 2 exams, an assignment every week and group assignment, but all fairly easy. Def take him!!!

I literally made an account bc he deserves better. He is the most caring prof I've ever met. Did pretty bad on the first exam (20%) but thats because I forgot to print out a cheat sheet. Ok on the 2nd(online due to covid) With all the goup work and mandatory attendance(3)and EC I still managed to get an A. Take him if u can Email him if u need help

One of the most nicest and caring professors you will meet at UIC. 2 exams, some in class work, and one final group project. This class focuses on research, something very useful in the marketing field. On top of that Professor Jeff is hilarious. Highly Recommended !

Great guy, but I can't say I really learned anything from him. Good professor if you're an experimental filmmaker. If not, he might not be for you. Never had such vague assignment descriptions before this class--kinda made me feel like I was never doing it right.

This feels more like a discussion class than a writing one but you're able to pull away something from his class at least. He's great if you want a broad amount of ideas and endless possibilities. He hasn't graded one thing in Canvas all semester so I don't know how to exactly improve on my craft.

He does not believe in grades, but he does believe in voluble, extended digressions. He goes wherever without really filtering his artiness for his audience, which is good and bad: he's a fountain of information and ideas, but he becomes a bit too bohemian and eclectic at times. He doesn't use Canvas and will probably just give you an A.

This professor did not grade any of our assignments until the latest possible date nearly a month after classes ended. He was not clear on assignments and seemed like he was always making stuff up as he went along. He did not follow the syllabus as he is not good at being timely. He is a fun person but terrible at letting you know your grade.

If I could give a zero I would. There is no option to write a review for his other job at Milwaukee, so here I am. I thought he was funny but that is the only thing he got going for him. I never received one grade in canvas. Nothing. He gave vague feedback but never told us how we could improve. The class work was random and unorganized.

If you've ever taken an art class where sit around and have a round table discussion about things and you enjoyed it, this class is for you. I took his class at UIC and although he does tend to get into dense ramblings about things he does a good job of trying to get other students to speak up about what they think.

(I don't go to UIC and I didn't take Art190, but there's no option for UWM students to leave reviews, so) I took Film 118 with Jesse at the University of WI Milwaukee. I loved the class & thought Jesse was a great teacher. He's very knowledgeable & showed great films in class. Gave helpful feedback on projects, he's very approachable & funny.

Avoid taking his classes-- disorganized, rude acting, gives TONS of busy work and his lectures turn into long rants that make no sense. Never responds to emails or gives help if you need it.

I took ENGL161 online with her, and do not regret it! Her lectures were recordings, so we never met face to face, but I can tell she is a very kind and genuine person. Avoid if you can but, not a big deal if you can't. Jennifer is overly difficult to work with for a general education course instructor. reviews.comment: She gives great feedback and direction. Her fashion sense is a plus! :)

Professor Lewis is my favorite! She is very clear on what she wants and doesn't want. Willing to check your progress on a writing project just approach her and she will help you. Really enjoyed her class topic! I definitely recommend her.

Best Professor for ENGL. whoever's complaining is just not smart enough or has not interest for the class. Huge on MLA. Critiques your work in order for u to improve. Theres not much points in this class so you gotta get an A on all assignments to get an A in this class l wouldn't recommend her to a friend there's other engl profs to choose from

she's kind of a tough grader but listen to the comments she makes on your papers and fix them. She is really nice and appreciates and notices hard work. I would definitely take her class again.

I really enjoyed this class. I would say be prepared to write a lot, but most ENGL 161 class require you to since you're writing a research paper. I did not find this class hard at all. Just be aware of the number of days you can miss and you'll be fine.

reviews.comment: She's a great professor. She is kind and provides good feedbacks on paper. I strongly recommend you go see her during office hours. Show her you put in effort, and you can get an A! Would take her again!

She is the best English teacher. Her class is kind of boring but she gives you a lot of time to write your papers. She is very nice, you can almost ask her for anything and she will say yes. Take her class and get an easy A.

I had her for Utopian Literature rather than usual English. She looks and sounds very much like you'd expect a creative writing teacher to. She is very intelligent and her feedback/writing improvements were invaluable. Noticeable difference in writing ability and enjoyable class. I won't say much about class since its not her usual English ones.

LOVED her and her class. She does a good job of providing feedback and chances to revise papers. I received an A in the class and on all of my papers. I would definitely take another one of her classes.

reviews.comment: She's the best English teacher I've ever had. Incredibly understanding. Not only is the subject matter interesting, but she finds different angles to approach it from. reviews.comment: total of 5 papers the entire semester, very easy! She tells you exactly what she wants to get an A. VERY approachable and is willing to sit 1 on 1 and answer any questions. Prof. Lewis is an amazing English teacher! Not only is she super understanding when students request extensions, but she gives you multiple opportunities to revise almost every paper, including the final paper! EXTREMELY empathetic and understanding. Attendance matters and only allows 4 absences. Participation wont kill your grade if you have good work. Shes a very easy grader because theres a lot of drafting. Great professor and highly recommend. Shes always available outside of class.

reviews.comment: Good
She gave us all gum in class. And she is really funny and energetic. She clearly cares about how well her students do

Syllabus is more intimidating than the actual class. Only read the main novel (Working Poor). The side readings are useless. Once a week we had to summarize a relevant news article in 1-2 pages. For each paper, you have 3 chances to get the grade. First day is peer review. Then she returns it with her comments. The 3rd draft is actually graded.

She was a great teacher that could make her class laugh, but she was a tough teacher. Her objectives seemed confusing until she gave feedback on the rough draft. She had a lot of assignments that may have not been worth reading based on your desired, writing topic. She is smart and understanding, yet I think she could talk more on writing skills.
Try not to take her class. She doesn't follow her syllabus. Confusing instructions and   her correction is terrible.

She is an amazing teacher that knows what she is talking about. But, her grading is super tough. She makes you work for the grades. I don't know if it was particularly this semester, but she would cancel class often and still expect you to stay on top of readings and homework without getting in class time to discuss it.

I definitely recommend her. I thought the topic of the class was interesting and fairly easy. She gives good feedback and is not as hard as most of the english professors for 160 and 161. Take her if you can!
She is a fun grader, and excellent professor! Strongly Reccomend
Best English professors ever! She was easier than my 160 class and I improved a lot on my papers. Highly recommend.

Professor Lewis is the best english professor I have ever had. She gives very good feedback and emphasizes the paramedic method a lot. She makes class interesting even if the topic is boring. Always willing to help and tells you exactly what you need to work on. Not the easiest nor hardest english class. I recommend her.

Professor Lewis is a great professor. She makes it clear as to what she expects in an assignment, will let you redo your papers, holds frequent office hours, and takes a no-nonsense approach in telling you what you need to work on. Most importantly, she is approachable

The books she chooses for the class to read are hit or miss but when they're good they're really good. She's super lenient about due dates and takes the class's opinions into account. Her feedback on essays is super helpful. Class can get boring at times but that is only if nobody helps keep the discussion going. She's a great instructor.

she was really nice, some boring reading and writing but bs-able. grade is attendance and papers. shell extend deadlines, cancel some classes, and is helpful. put time into papers and youll ace the class.

Professor Lewis is an amazing teacher. Her enthusiam, helpfulness,and intelligence make this a very pleasant class. Read, write,don't be lazy, and you have an A! Highly recommend Lewis to anyone willing to be more passionate about writting. In this class, I improved my writing skills and receive great feedback on assignments. LEWIS IS THE BEST! :)

Professor Lewis was great! She didn't drown us with useless homework or readings. Our grade consisted of papers, and one of them was the final paper/essay which was a minimum of 10 pages. She was really easy-going and fun to discuss with. She also did a really good job of telling you   how to revise your paper.
Really tough grader.

She's a very good professor. Enthusiastic and she has funny analogies/metaphors. The best thing about her is she actually cares. She REALLY reads papers but she isnt harsh. She really just wants you to write the best you possibly can. Not exactly an easy A but I definitely recommend her if you actually want to be a better writer
She's fantastic. Intelligent without being overbearing, and enthusiastic without being weird. I thought I would hate the class but I ended up loving it. Also, she's hot. That's doesn't hurt.

I had Lewis for ENGL 160, 161, and 101. I loved her class so much I purposely took her an additional two times. If you have the slightest interest in literature, she will broaden it. She transformed me into a fantastic writer, which is rare for engineers. Do not take her easiness for granted. She is so good, do not waste her teaching!

Lots of reading, but fun reading.  Kind of all over the place (which I dig), cancels class ALOT (fine by me!), but a total sweetheart, and really smart too.  She really bridges the gap between the professor-student dynamic in class, as she is very personable and friendly.  I loved her!

Instructions are not too clear, it even seems like she changes them out of nowhere.  She never follows the syllabus and likes to play favorites with the students she already had before.  I always got the feeling she was judging me behind my back.

she's a very friendly teacher. she talks a lot but it's interesting. i don't think her class is boring at all. she cancels class a few times. she comes a few mins late to class. some of our assignments were taken off because we were behind. she does grade a little hard. but she is very helpful and loves what she does.

Great professor who actually teaches you what you need to know to become a better writer. She likes to have group discussions on current topics that pertain to her class agenda. she is fair but only to a certain point.

Good professor doesn't follow the syllabus, but that's agood thing because due dates get delayed she even canceled one of the assignments because we were behind. She comes late to class sometimes and sometimes cancels class, but there were dull moments in her class. Comments on essays were useful. You get to redo paper also.

Great teacher! She's funny and intertesting. 4 papers including the 10 page research paper. The class has had its dull days, but she's a good teacher and will become a better writer. Also, we turn in a rough draft to her and peer edit so it's hard not to do well.

This is the second time i have taken a class with this prof. the topic had no interest to me when i signed up, i only wanted to continue with this teacher. by the end i loved the topic, i was sad to leave. very helpful.
No Comments

Amazing professor, her energy in teaching about language easily transfers on to you. The class is very interesting, and this is the perfect professor to teach it. The assignments are straightforward and open ended, as long as you follow instructions and criteria, you're set for this class.

This prof has been my favorite I've taken in my 3 years at UIC. The course work was a lot, but her lectures were illuminating and so fun to attend. The type of teacher that loves what they're teaching, and gets you to love it as well. Also very understanding grader

Professor Hallett really made a class I thought would be dull so entertaining and engaging, her passion really came through and made this class a joy to be in, I genuinely think every student should be taking this class.

One of the nicest professors I've met so far at UIC, and incredibly interactive with the class, so her lectures really depend on your classes participation. Great professor, I've taken two of his classes. Very empathetic of busy students.  He dives very deep into the subject matter, which makes the lectures very engaging. reviews.comment: Professor Jin is great for GLAS 100, he is very understanding towards his students. He was also lenient this semester, presumably due to the pandemic. The class is very reading and writing heavy, but what else would you expect? Overall, great professor!

Really cool professor he cares about the class and wants everyone to learn. Mainly readings and papers but it's not bad if you like reading/writing. He's very accommodating and although he may seem strict, he's not bad. I would definitely recommend this class and this professor!!

reviews.comment: She is incredibly kind and passionate about teaching, and she is pretty lenient about due dates. I would recommend people to take her class.

She was alright. She provided all her handouts and formulas for study material. Her lectures were a little bit unorganized since she wrote on the corner of the whiteboard. reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You must follow along with lectures and take notes in order to do well in this class. Exams were reasonable, and homework is not too bad. Sometimes she doesn't explain something because she assumes that we learned it in a previous class, but of course that is not always the case.

Her lecture notes are pure chaos. I used online resources to learn the material (I'm paying for this class...right?)  since I couldn't even follow her extremely sloppy and disjointed notes. When you have questions she acts like it's a nuisance to answer them. "You should have learned this in a previous class" is her favorite response. Avoid her.
Very Difficult.

"I want you guys to understand the material. It's not just about exam grades." Meanwhile 70% of your grade is decided by three exams. Does the bare minimum to prepare us for exams. SO MUCH MATERIAL!!! Lecture notes are 20 pages long for just ONE SECTION! You have no idea what to study or how to study since there are dozens of formulas. Avoid her!

Difficult to follow lectures. Does not always explains things because she says you should have learned it in whatever previous stat class even though students outside stat department  are taking this course.  Do not recommend taking with her

Posts all lecture notes online but requires attendance. Such a sweet lady and always relates the work to the real world. HW is due once a week, but its not difficult. Exams were also fair in difficulty. Beware that 10% of your grade relies on coding projects, and she's not the best at explaining it, but she does give helpful example codes.

I really enjoyed Professor Wang's style of teaching. Exams were long, but she graded it fairly. She also shows you some R code that is quite useful, and she is very knowledgeable about statistics. Recommend everyone to take her (p.s. meet her during office hours, very friendly!).

The person under me is talking about someone different, but Jing Wang in the Stat department is great! Lectures are nice and meaty. She is nice and really helpful during office hours. She can really answer any question you can think of. Tests are very fair (no surprises) and similar to practice exams.

The course is pretty much 50% quizzes/exams. The homework is on the blackboard and is EXACTLY like the quiz, except the numbers are different for the most part. The exam is also just like the homework. The labs vary depending on the TA; some will offer as much help as possible, while others will straight up refuse (labs make up 20% of grade).

He speaks very quietly and has a thick accent, so it's hard to understand him during lecture. He goes through HW problems and they are the same as the quizzes, just different numbers. All quizzes and exams are open note and on Blackboard. The labs were the hardest part, just make sure you have a good group. He was okay, but the class is easy.

reviews.comment: This is the most poorly designed class I have ever taken. Everything is automatic blackboard submission, and your grade depends heavily on assessments, to the point where every question you miss is -1 point from your final grade! He just mumbles in class and projects one page from the book for an hour. Everyone cheats on the quiz so they can leave.

Yes he did start taking attendance that he didn't in previous semester but it was great. It brought incentive for students to get involved in lectures. All tests are online, can use anything. Lectures are pointless

Spring 2025. Hw not graded. Quizes and Final are online, quizes have 2 attempts, final only 1 attempt. Attendance taken on the Monday after every quiz. Good professor.

Amazing professor who is willing to help students. He normally teaches ECE 350, 317, 341. Definitely take those classes with him. Especially 341 because the other professor for that class is known to be harder.

Taking this class was not hard at all. His lecture are straight forward. Exam ACTUALLY based of the study guide. If you get stuck you can meet with him or the TA. One of the best experience I had at UIC.

wasn't as bad as I thought but definitely some shortcomings. He is hard to understand, makes some mistakes in lecture, and doesn't have a sense of when he is going too fast. The only way to learn is reading textbook

one of the best professors at the UIC, I took with him 350 and 311 and I wish I could take more with him. he understand any situation you have and he tries to help you to work it out. he just awesome

Love this guy!  Best Prof I've had at UIC.  Homework is 40% of your grade.  Exams are straight forward if you go to class.

Great professor, takes the time with students and cares about them.

He gives 10% curves on exams and curves the final grade at the end. Few professors are this generous. If you took AP Micro and did well, expect an easy A. If you took micro in college, work harder.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Tauras is a great lecturer; he is clear and tells you everything that will be on the exam. If you don't pay attention or don't show up to class, you're going to fail. He gives very generous curves, so if you don't get at least a C, you're doing something wrong. You don't even need the textbook, just take notes in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 2 midterms worth 50% Final is worth 35% No power-point + doesn't upload notes. SMH. Obviously I am not the only one who feel this way. I took him 2019 Fall, EACH exam was curved 10-12%, in the end he also curved the ENTIRE CLASS(except for A's and B's). C70-80 ---> (60 or 65) to 80  C ( he didn't tell us how much was the final curve)

Class is based on 3 homework assignments (15%), 2 midterms (50%) and one final (35%). Homework is easy but tests can be rather difficult as they don't coincide with the lectures. I highly suggest reading the book, as I did not. and it hurt my grade. He did, however, curve our midterms and final. Attendance is not mandatory but don't skip.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Tauras' Microeconomics class was fantastic, albeit difficult. The three homework assignments were very easy, however, his exams are another story. After doing poorly on his first exam, I had to pay close attention in lectures and read the book to bounce back. He is very helpful and approachable, and I would gladly have him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really nice and cool professor that gives really good lectures and is very clear-cut with the grading.

No attendance, but if you dont go to class, good luck getting a good grade. You gonna have to put in a lil work in for a good grade when it comes to exams. He only has 3 so it is important that you show up to class as much as possible. He doesnt really post lectures as most of the notes are handwritten.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He really knows what he is talking about that is for sure. Unfortunately the tests are pretty tough. Honestly I did poorly on 2 of the three. The homework is fine he gives you a week to do it. Find someone who took his class already and ask them to prepare you for how he tests. Good Luck. He does NOT offer extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lectures are fast paced and a lot of material is covered in one class. The grade is mainly based on final exam which is almost 30%, the remaining grade is based on other 2 exams and only 5% grade is homework. He curves the class though! Sometimes you need to rely on textbook to get a better understanding than his notes.
Great lectures

A lot of people in my class didn't like Professor Tauras. He was very clear about the material and tried to teach it in a way that made sense. He is VERY knowledgeable, and he is willing to meet up to answer any questions. Micro isn't the best, but I found his class interesting on the theory. If you find this class hard, econ might not be for you
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Taurus is a fantastic professor -In economics 220, I found his explanations to be really clear and well worded. he does his best to use analogies and real world explanations to root the mathematics and theory in something real which is nice. The course is tough though, and I can't emphasize enough that you will learn something new *every lecture*.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is Great! Makes you work, wants you to learn. This is the way college is meant to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: His lectures are super straightforward and clear. Everything in the lecture was on the test, so you dont need the textbook. 2 tests, 3 homework assignments, and 1 non-cumulative final. All multiple choice. Study your notes well, and youll get an A. TA was also helpful in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: His lectures are amazing. However, he writes them on the board and doesn't post them on Blackboard. Make sure to attend class. The book is useful for clarification but not mandatory. Make sure to go to office hours if your feel confused. He encourages participation and gives few assignments (3) and tests (3, including final). Ask questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Is not very available.

Good guy, knew his stuff, and a good lecturer. I guess where I had problems was where he would teach us the concepts in class which he was great at, but on exams and homework he would use numerical problems which we wouldnt really cover. This made the class extremely difficult, for me at least.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Tauras is a really respectable guy. Grade is dependent on 4 equally weighted exams throughout the semester, but they're all multiple choice tests so not bad at all. Don't really need book for class, just show up to lecture. Material is pretty straightforward so if this class gives you a hard time, economics probably just isn't for you.

No homework,  just four  all multiple choice exams and taking notes during lecture .  But study for the tests, you can not "logic through" his exams  like other econ classes. He asks very detailed questions and often the correct answers seem contradictory. So study his notes very well. He gives hard exams  and moves quickly through material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's a good lectures. Explain very well. Took Econ 220 with him before. Though, would not recommend you take this course. 215 is very condense. Exams are hard. No study guides. Basically memorize and understand all his powerpoint if you want to pass. Anything you expect won't be on the exam will be on there, especially the concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best prof I've had at UIC.  Very smart, friendly, and makes econ interesting.  Took both micro and health with him.  He covers a ton of material  - go to class and take notes.  3 exams and 3 homeworks in both classes.  Exams are hard, but good size curves.

Had both for micro &health. Health was super boring with a HUGE load of detailed info. on PPts. Exams are very hard and mainly based on the PPts. He does not give any hints on how to prepare other than "know my PPts in &out". Generous with curving. Quite dull professor in my opinion. Lectures as if he had everything memorized. Not very creative
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is the best Professor I have ever! He knows everything about economics and explains the concept pretty well. I really enjoy his lecture.

I really enjoyed him. He always presented Econ with an interesting take and made everything clear with examples. I especially enjoyed how he talked about his research and work. The class is easy if you pay attention and take notes.
Took for both health and micro econ. Really clear in explaining material and really makes econ more interesting. Very tough grading structure but curves a lot to help with tough subject matter.

Easy class but no help from the TA or professor. I think I emailed them both over a dozen times with no response. He doesn't bother to show up for exams- the TA distributes them so don't expect to ask any questions the day of the tests.
Great Professor. Really helpful and genuinely nice guy. Tests are challenging, but the curve really helps.

UIC is lucky to have him. Tauras is hands down the best lecturer I have had during my time. His class is difficult though, but if you come to class everyday, pay attention and take notes on all of it, you should be able to do well. Makes sure to answer questions well if you don't understand, just ask.

Many of the concepts were similar to introductory microeconomics. The book is not necessary, since the professor's notes cover all the material that should be on the exam. Therefore, go to class, seriously! Three exams with curves for all of them. Professor is a nice person who knows the subject and explains it quite well. I would recommend him.

It's econ218, not exactly riveting unless you dig econ. Good professor, knows what he's talking about and will go over concept if you ask him. Long class. Doesn't let out early due to the amount he has to cover but not too bad. 2 midterms, 1 final (non-cumu) huge curve. Don't really need the book if you take good notes and pay attention in class.

I liked him. You NEED to go to class and take down all of his notes. Even if you don't think you will need something, write it down because it will help you understand later. I didn't use the book at all. To study I re-wrote my notes and then just went over those. I thought the tests were on the easy side. He uses a HUGE curve in my opinion.

He is pretty good at explaining the material for the class. You NEED his notes to study for his exams though, so you really have to go to class. The class has 2 midterm tests and 1 final, and that's it for grades. Study a lot for his tests, they aren't the easiest, but he does explain the content well.

Awesome professor. His lectures are super helpful and he covers everything you need to know. You take lots of notes during class. I used the book a lot before exams to reconfirm my notes and as a study guide. His exams are difficult though so study, study, STUDY.

Seriously the nicest professor I have ever had. The material can be pretty dry but he does a pretty good job of keeping your attention. The tests were difficult although he gives a pretty good curve. Always made himself available to answer questions. Overall I really enjoyed having him as a professor.

Really knows his stuff. I had it twice a week so you really don't want to miss many classes. His notes are vital and he moves really fast. They're all done on the white board, no powerpoints. He will go over things if you ask questions. Only grades were Midterm and Final. He does curve the exams.

Tauras is an amazing professor and really knows what he's talking about. He explains things well and makes it easier to understand. You have to go to class everyday in order to do well though. The only two grades are the midterm and final, and he curves both of them. Study like crazy for the tests.
Best Prof. I've had.  Very clear lectures, very organized, makes micro-econ interesting - tough to do.  Highly recommend!

Good professor. Gives clear lecture notes and bases exams on them. However, some questions can be tricky. Only 1 midterm and final. If you go to lecture EVERY day, and take notes/understand him, you shouldn't need the book. It'd be stupid to miss lectures. The material itself though is not as interesting as the intro econ courses Curves are huge.

His lectures are very informative but he only gives a midterm and a final nothing in between. I need some type of practice problems to help me study but if this works for you you will be fine. His first curve for the midterm was huge 10/36 was a D so so no one failed it

Well, this was a step up from econ 120/121. if you attend his classes and pay close attention to ur notes, then this class should be an easy A. Just know what he is talking about and you will do fine. He is willing to spend as much time as possible to make sure that his students understand the subject. Really good professor.

He was a really good teacher but Micro theory is a lot tougher then it sounds... His curves are huge though.  A 0 out of 30 was a D so impossible to fail.... No one should get lower then a B if they come to class and do the readings
He is a great teacher. His lectures offer clear directions and explanations. There is no homework for the class but tests requires intensive studying. Overall, it is a fairly easy class.
No Comments

He is the GOAT. He might seem like a strict professor at first, but then you realize that he genuinely likes his job and likes talking about the things he likes. He is a yapper, but personally, the stories are fun and impressive. The class itself is very easy, 5 quizzes, 2 midterms, and all of that is open notes. Four presentations in total.
cool dude recommend him

He is my GOAT. He looks a bit strict, but he really isn't; he's very chill. His class is very easy, and you can keep up with everything. Group projects aren't difficult, and you can always read off notes or anything as long as it is reasonable.

Professor Wang was great. He assigned several group projects throughout the semester, but I learned a great deal in his class. He's actually very kind and funny, the more you get to know him. He's just very serious and passionate about his class. Find a good group for the semester, try your best, and be respectful, and you will do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: hes calm and nice. his class is boring and the class he taught me was just basic sense. this class is project based so get yourself a good group stat because thats all that matters in this class. as long your nice your chill.
The class can be overwhelming with the group projects, but it was interesting at times.
Be prepared to do group projects every week. This course is very project-heavy for just a 3-credit-hour course, just saying. He's nice and gives good group feedback.
Lots of projects, and he's great

Professor Wang's BA200 is project-heavy but manageable. Quizzes can be tricky, so stay on top of your grammar. unstuckstudy proved helpful for study prep. Overall, an engaging class with a knowledgeable professor.

The class is very easy but there's a lot of group work and presentations. In fact, its all group work there were no individuals assignments the whole semester. The professor is pretty good. Its a pretty easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Assignment are easy since there is a lot of examples and the TA is available to help. He is quick to respond to emails and give feedback. The course is very heavy on group projects. That being said be careful with who you choose as teammates, you'll be working with them for the rest of the semester. You can request a change, but not always granted.
Very nice professor! Group projects very easy and a few papers. However, be aware of the quizzes because those can be tricky.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Prof. Jie is a good professor! There are 5 quizzes, and all the assignments are based on group projects. This is one of the best professors I have ever had.

Professor Wang is very knowledgeable about business communication since he consulted for companies for many years. He shares his experience working for companies in his lectures, which is really helpful for a course of this nature. It's good to have a professor that can connect the classroom with the real world. Take him and you'll learn a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Wang is overall a very nice professor. You will work on group projects the entire semester. The group projects are pretty easy, however, he gives out bi-weekly quizzes on grammar which he doesn't teach at all during the class. He reviews the quizzes after the fact, but I don't recommend taking this class if you're not good at grammar.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Wang is very knowledgeable and very helpful. He makes sure everyone understands the assignments and is reachable outside of class. You will walk away from this class knowing that you have learned something. He is a great professor and I highly recommend his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class is group based so be prepared to work with others. Professor Wang is extremely helpful and straightforward. He will explain exams, projects, assignments, etc very throughougly to make sure everyone understands. He is very intelligent and knowledgable about what he teaches. Awesome professor!!

Professor Wang is exceptionally knowledgeable in business communication and provides numerous opportunities for students to develop both professionally and personally. The emphasis on group work makes this is one of the most valuable and insightful courses I've completed so far. Great professor!

Professor Wang is very knowledgeable about business communication. He often talks about his experience consulting for companies. There are two major tests and five quizzes in the class, plus a bunch of writing and presentation assignments. He's a fair grader and gives many extra credit opportunities. Take him, you'll be glad you did.
One of the harder professors to take. Tests and quizzes were very difficult.

Professor Wang is a good professor. He explained things pretty well and had clear grading criteria. The class is very group oriented, so choose your teammates wisely. There's also a good amount of presentations but he grades nicely. I would take him again and recommend that you take him for BA 200

I thought this class was good. You have a lot of group projects so make sure you get a good team. The two tests were super easy if you read his chapter highlights. He offered a fair amount of extra credit that few people took advantage of. He took attendance every time. The assignments themselves weren't that difficult, just be ready to write.
The rating distribution speaks for itself honestly. Just make sure you send your work to the TA before submitting it to Dr. Wang, it literally makes the assignment a free A.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor and he makes the class very engaging. Attendance is mandatory. The majority of the coursework is group work, so join with people you think you would get along with. There are also 4 grammar quizzes and 2 tests. He also offers extra credit from time to time. Overall, he makes the class really enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher! I definitely learned to be a better writer! A doable class where you actually learn skills for the future!

Fairly simple course. Grammar, writing, communications oriented. Make sure you choose a group with the right people.
