This was the only thing that made me frustrated in this class, not having an adequate team. Stick with people of the same major. Quizzes are online and open book. Presentations are fairly simple.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor! Group projects make up a huge part of this class, so be sure to choose people you can depend on. He is very accessible through email, so don't hesitate to email him if you have any questions. Read the syllabus, ask him for clarification, do the work, and you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: He is a awesome professor. And gives extra credit opportunities. Take him you wont regret.

Prof. Wang was awesome. He gives amazing feedback on rough drafts so when you turn it in, its at 100%. The whole entire course is basically a few group projects with two tests. You will have to study pretty hard for the tests, but some of the questions are common sense. Pick a good group for the semester because you will have to do a lot with them

The class consist of group works/presentation. I'm a really shy person but this class helped me with being comfortable to present and work well with large groups. This class is super helpful in the long-run. Assignments can be slightly overwhelming so pick the right people in your group.

Great professor who shares lots of valuable knowledge. Group projects are a really big part of this class so make sure you communicate well with your group. Make sure to study for the grammar quizzes since they are easy points and have a big weight on the grade. Aside from that, just show up at the lectures and that's all you really need.

Although it was in an online setting, Professor Jie was accommodating. I would argue that his class structure was among the cleanest. Everything was outlined from the beginning; anyone would most certainly appreciate an organized syllabus like his. He also takes pride in teaching at UIC which makes me feel like he truly cares. Great professor!

This class is very group project heavy. You will be put in group projects in the second or third week of class and your stuck with that group the entire semester, unless that group doesn't do any work. Overall, the professor does care about every students success and gives lots of extra credit opportunities.
Super informational! Fun class, I wish I took it in person. Great professor and knows his content, take notes because he won't post them on blackboard
Professor Wang cares about students in lectures. Doing the class is helpful to pass the class and useful for other lectures.
One of the best professors in UIC, he is very professional in BA. I regret that I only took one of his classes. A professor I highly recommend.
I think the bigger issue is not his teaching, it is what he assigned. Multiple group work is not it, my groups have so many problems with agreeing, and it is not a fun experience.

Dude took BA 200 way too seriously. Most of this stuff was common sense but made it so much harder than it had to be. Very opinion based assignments and quizzes. Would not take him if you don't have to.

Make sure you find a group mates who are willing to put effort. He is reachable outside of class and even provides good feedback. He is a respected professors and knows exactly what he should teach. Make good connection with him! I liked the way he makes use of group projects and quizzes. Quiz can be tricky if you don't study.

All of my classes combined had as much work as his one class. Way too much work, lectures twice a week, multiple projects at once. My group members were useless morons who did absolutely no work on any of the assignments (there were about 10). I let him know multiple times with evidence and he did nothing. Too much work, not worth it.

I took this class due to the high ratings. Not disappointed. Prof. Wang spent a lot of time making his syllabus, and it is extremely useful. Even though I purchased it, I did not need a book as everything was given in class. Most large projects are group based, so find the strong person in your group to make the magic happen. Would take again.

Let me be clear, he's a good teacher. But, when presentations are the goal of the class, the grammar quizzes make no sense. I never got above a 7 in the quizzes despite getting a 720 on Eng. SAT. I had a group where I basically carried each present. I think we should choose our own groups, and why do we need to know whether to capitalize Fiscal?
Great professor. Really helpful and genuinely cares about your success in the class. lots of extra credit opportunities.

Great Professor! You get 2 unexcused absences, but he has BB days where you do an online assignment instead of coming to class. Pick a good group, I had a tough time with mine. Study for the grammar quizzes! Professor Wang responds to emails faster than any Professor I've ever had and cares about his students and their success. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prepare your presentations well and do online discussion posts. Do not miss assignments. For the online quizzes, you do need to study a bit. The in-class tests were very easy, provided that you prepared well for them. Attendance sheet is passed around, and you get 2 unexcused absences. Remember, perform well in presentations. Choose good group too!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This course requires you to do three main group presentations. It is important to choose wisely for your group because you will have to work with them for the entire semester. The class is an easy course if you put the effort to study for two tests that are multiple choice and prepare for the presentations.

Professor Wang was by far one of the best professors out there. If one thing is for certain you will learn something in this class, usually quite a large amount. The class has a good amount of group projects/papers so make sure to choose your group wisely and follow instructions closely to ensure success. Would take this professor again 100%

He is a great professor! Show up to class and follow examples because that is key to getting a perfect score! This class is group project heavy, so make sure you choose your TEAM wisely. Class has only two tests, all multiple choice, and 5 online grammar quizzes. Also offers multiple opportunities for extra credit.

This class is work heavy. But you will learn so much from this class than any other class. Professor is easy and an easy grader as long as you follow his directions. You work in you team for every project/presentation/paper so choose your team wisely at the beginning of the year. 4-5 presentations & 1 term paper at the end. Fun class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Wang is by far the most clear, attentive and effective professor I have had at UIC thus far. Many students underestimate the importance of excellent communication in business. It is obvious the Wang is very focused on fostering your skills and professionalism. He has high expectations, but is fair. You WILL learn in this class.
He is an amazing professor. Just make genuine efforts and follow his instructions, you'll be good to go for an A. He also gives many opportunities for extra credit. He's a great person to learn from!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Wang is a really easy teacher! He clearly states expectations for each assignment or project that is given to you. PAY ATTENTION TO THE SYLLABUS! Its honestly so helpful with everything, he puts links to examples of what you need to do for the assignment. On the days we have quizzes, there is no class because theyre online.

This professor is very reasonable with many of the assignments he provides. He clearly outlines all the expectations and guidelines on blackboard so there should be no excuse for missing assignments. The tests are made very easy because he literally provides highlights for the book so you don't have to buy and read the book to study from.
Great professor, group projects are interesting and helpful. Very knowledgable and has many years of educational and practical experience.
Professor Wang is very knowledgeable about business communication and gives valuable feedback on assignments. Take the class and you'll learn so much.

This class was so fun and one of the only classes I will actually miss. Professor Wang is a very helpful, knowledgeable professor and is willing to give you feedback on things outside of classwork as well. The things you learn in this class are extremely useful and relevant. Make sure you pick your team wisely at the beginning of the year!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor Wang is a great professor and is always willing to give valuable feedback.
This class is seriously so beneficial. I'm glad I took it for my first semester at UIC. Professor Wang is always available and willing to give back feedback. He was great.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Awesome teacher! extremely understanding and the material is actually interesting. Easy A!!

Basically this class is composed of 3 group projects. At the beginning everyone presents their background and work history and he allows you to pick a group. You will be with this group the WHOLE semester, choose carefully. Presentations are easy, and graded leniently. Read the chapter highlights on blackboard for the tests and you're good to go.

He was a great professor. Very organized and helpful outside of class. There are a lot of presentations but he makes the process really easy. 2 exams that were pretty easy if you paid attention in class. Overall, he taught it very well and this class will definitely help you in your career.

He is an amazing professor who is very knowledgeable and very patient. One of those few people whom gives you chances and wants you to succeed. You will learn a lot in his class and have a great time.

Prof. Wang is awesome! This class is easy. Just go to class, read his notes from the textbook to study for exams, and extra credit. There are 4 grammar quizzes and 2 exams. Go to his office hours if you need help. He is very nice!

This class will help you long term. At first he is hard to hear but you will get use to his level of speaking. Tests are easy because he provides summaries. He required text for only one assignment which required reading the text. Group project heavy. Work well with others in order to succeed in his class. Attendance is counted for points.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The only thing hard were the online grammar quizzes. Just have the grammar guide up on a different monitor. In short, this class is comm 100, but with groups. All his notes are online. No need for a textbook. He's really nice and gives A LOT of valuable information as for as business etiquette and professionalism. He's very knowledgable.

You'll get an A as long as you put in some effort. You'll learn valuable information that you can use outside of the classroom and Professor Wang is always willing to help, especially if you go see him during his office hours. Few online quizzes, discussion posts, tests and group projects, but they're easy. He's a sweet guy, take him!

Professor Wang for BA200 is the definitely the way to learn Managerial Comm. You think you now english grammer huh?! It was a really fun class, pick a good group you can work with and the semester should go well. Make sure you work hard and use all extra credit opportunities! Overall: Outstanding
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Teaches you useful  important things that you will utilize throughout your business career and does it in a fluid and fun manner. Just put the effort, work together with your group and you will be thankful you had such a great professor.

Very easy flowing class overall. A lot of the class work however is based on the group you assemble in the beginning of the class, so a good group will lead to a good semester. Wang is very easy going and is willing help. Show up, do the easy assignments, and you'll get an A.

He is extremely helpful. Most of this class is with group projects other than taking the five not so hard quizzes and two tests. I would say this class is very helpful when studying business and will teach you a lot. He also gives you many options throughout the semester to take part in extra credit.
He's a beast. Reccomend his class.

90% of this class is group projects throughout the semester with the same group. Good group  good grade. Only complaint is that his assignment delivery is chaotic. You'll see a list of assignments on blackboard, due dates on another page, and assignment details in a third location. Organization is a must. Very thorough otherwise and kind.
Class is fairly easy, most of the class was based on group presentations and working in teams. 2 easy tests, 4 grammar quizzes, participation, and extra credit at the end.

Dr. Wang is one of the best professors at UIC. His lectures are easy to understand and informative. He includes little grammar lessons that come in handy when you're working on assignments. And he gives clear instructions and quick feedback. Definitely take his class!

Professor Wang is one of the best professors UIC has to offer. If you need to take BA 200, take Professor Wang. He is nice, understanding, and above all, easy to understand (as opposed to a lot of other professors at the University). The work load is not bad either. As long as you pay attention in class, you will do great in this class.
Nice, easy going guy. Lots of group work and presentations, but they are not very difficult. If you put in the effort and time, you could get an A.

Professor Wang is great. Overall the class is easy, but if you hate presenting try to take another professor. There are about 5 group presentations throughout the semester, 2 pretty easy tests (just read the chapter highlights he provides), and a term paper. Highly recommend taking him, he is very nice. And he gives extra credit.
Always look at Chapter Highlights for exams. The class is basically like a speech class. Not too bad, dress appropriate for speeches.

First and foremost - great speaker (you'd hope so). His class didn't even feel like a requirement to me. Everything was very methodical, clear, and specific. Assignments graded in a transparent and timely manner, and announced plenty ahead. Often inserted mini-lessons on English and the modern business world, very handy. Great sense of humor :)
Great professor, very clear and concise. While presentation questions may be a little tough at times, he does so to get the best out of you. Would definitely work with this professor again.
Great professor! Teaches you many valuable things that you will use in the business world. I highly recommend this class

I learned a lot from his class. There are a lot of presentations but overall this is a great way to gain experience. He is a semi tough grader, and his tests are quite difficult but I would strongly recommend him.Great guy overall.
Great professor, there's no way you can fail this class if you do all his assignments. It is NOT an easy A, so do all his extra credits!

Easy if you just do your work. Also offers plenty of extra credit opportunities. There is no way you can fail team presentations b/c he grades individually even on those. Good prof., the class isn't hard at all, I don't know what some people here are talking about.
If you will take BA200, Wang is the best choice! He's very easy going and clear and helpful. Very few homework, basically most of them are team work. Extra credits are up to 10 points. Recommended!
Mr. Wang was amazing! Very helpful, very interesting class def take Wang i f you have the chance!
Mr wang does an awesome job at teaching, the class is easy as long as u pay attention to his lectures. It was amazing being in his class

Wow! Another amazing professor at UIC! I got an A in his class, but worked my but off! If you want an A, do ALL the work he assigns on time, and ALWAYS dress up for presentations! The material you learn in his class will be helpful not only through the rest of your college career, but also when you graduate and get your first job! A+++ Teaching!

He's decent but not as great as everyone says here.  If you want to get an A, you WILL do the extra credit oppounrities.  He always just give out B on assignment unless you're super outstanding.  Overall, you can actually learn things in this class - Recommand

The workload in this class compared to other BA200 classes is huge. I had friends taking the same class with other teachers and they didn't have to do anything! I felt like I had to do so much work to get an A. I am surprised by all the positive comments about his class. Yes, he is a decent teacher, but if you want an easy A go for another teacher.

Easy A.  Thats all you need to know.  His test are straight from the notes.  The test can be tricky.  And he may be a little stubborn giving out perfect grades but with his EASY extra credit, I managed to pull the A.
he is extremely awesome. Dr. Wang is extra-ordinarily helpful and knowledgeable about what he lectures too. everything he said in class will surely be helpful in the business world.

Awesome teacher...one of those teachers that is really knowledgeable with their subject...Really helpful when it comes to needing help, and straightforward...he will make you sing if you miss an extra credit point.

Jie is a great guy. He understands students needs, and is definitely there to help his students understand and grow into professionals. He cares about each individual student, and it shows in his teaching style. If you want a teacher that wants you to learn/succeed in business communication, take Professor Jie Wang.

Do not let his foreign name scare you away! Professor Jie Wang is a great public speaker, who can teach you the right way to communicate in the business world. His lectures are very straight forward and helpful for exams and presentations. He is one of the few teachers at this research school who prioritizes teaching and his students. This was evid

If you take good notes during class and do all the assignments you should be able to finish with a A or B.  There are quite a few presentations but nothing to loose sleep over.  He knows his material and is overall a great teacher.

He is down to earth and funny, but you can tell he is knowledgable about the material. The class isn't hard but you have to be prepared to work in groups for the whole semester and do presentations. He gives a lot of chances for extra credit, so he's really generous about that! He's also Jerry Wang's dad, so that's definitely a plus!

Very useful class. If there's a "blended" (partially online) section I highly recommend it. Fair grading and easy to reach. There is a LOT of work to be done but as long as you do every assignment and pay attention to his easy to follow syllabus, you'll be surprised at how much you can do. You WILL become a better communicator after this class.

Professor Wang is a great teacher! For all of you business students who have to take BA 200, make sure that you take him. You do have to work hard in the class, but thats college. Just make sure that you get all your assignments (even powerpoints) checked by him before you turn them in. Great teacher and extremely helpful outside of class.
Will humiliate you in front of everyone during class if you use bathroom during, even if you return quietly.  Extremely rude and condescending.
Professor Wang is a good teacher. He is very helpful and even takes time to help you if you need help. His assignments are kinda boring.
Wang is a great teacher.  He teaches stuff that is actually useful.  Cannot pronounce his R's though.

The workload in this class is big, but he will help you and plus it is COLLEGE, you have to WORK. If you take his advice, follow instructions and listen, you should have no problem. He is very informed about current events and takes interest in students. How many other professors do that? TAKE HIM, you will take away valuable information.

This class was an excellent yet challenging experience. Prof. Wang has been extremely helpful, understanding and inspirational throughout the entire semester.  I would strongly recommend this professor!!!
Pretty anal grading but otherwise good.

Mr. Wang is a good teacher and is always ready to help his students for any thing which they are having trouble with which is really a good thing about him. It is hard to get an A but if you try really hard you can definatelly get an A in his class. Yeah, I agree second test is harder then the first one. overall, it was fun so good luck to u all.
The class is fun and his teaching style is good too. But grading is big problem. I was couple points for an A but he gave me B. I worked pretty hard too...

Overall I would say a fun class, the 2nd test is much harder than the first, its fun to be in class but he takes grading to a new level and places way too much emphasis on detail. I head Kohler is a good teacher look him up instead.

hes ok. its hard to get a good grade but hey d's get degrees!!! have 4 presentations and couple assignments. 2 tests although 2nd one is much harder than first. gives extra credit pts once in awhile but u must read wall street journal in order to have a chance at answering his questions. and oh yea jie wang loves his son...jerry wang...google him!

On one hand, Prof. Wang is an excellent teacher.  On the other hand, it is very hard to get an "A" in his class.  Assignments include business memos/letters, three 10 minute presentations, and a final 15 page group paper.  Prof. You must put forth a lot of detail; however, Prof. Wang is always there to answers questions and to help you.
very hard!
No Comments
Very strict.  Very difficult to receive an A.  Moderately fair.

I don't know what happened to him, but in my opinion he's one of the hardest graders at uic...it's virtually impossible to get an A in his class. You might have everything done right but if you don't follow his exact format on the memos or other assignments, he'll make you pay by turning your paper completely red. I definately would not take him again.
Very hard to get an A. He's not as easy as everyone thinks. He's very picky.

Prof. Wang is one of the smartest professors I have ever had. He is very clear as to what he expects from students from day one. You do have to work very hard for an A in his class though! Get with your teams at least 2-3 times before a presentation, it will ensure a good grade. His extra credit is hard to come by so do not slack on assignments.

This is why I chose the b-school at UIC!This is a terrific class. I learn so much with this class. He is extremely helpful outside class and you can get in contact with him anythime. Wang does a great job in showing you the real scenario of business. If you wanna be motivated and learn alot choose Wang he will start your business career!!!!

Jie Wang is a true business communication pro. He is very strict, but an excellent teacher. He rarely gives out A grades and makes you work very hard. In some circles he is known as the Dragon because of his Chinese heritage and tough grading. He is an excellent person to learn from.
This guy is great! Hes also funny as hell! Basically no work except for easy memos and a huge report! Easiest BA 200 class at UIC! OMG! But its hard to get an A!
Wang is one of the toughest graders there is! Getting an A is out of the question after the implementation of the new grading policy.

Due to the "new standard business grading policy" Wang Mostly gives out C's. He is a nice professor. helps out. alot of group work. take this class you will at least get a C. My speeches sucked ass and i got B's most of the time.
Go to class every day and do the projects and you cant get below a b or c. He's pretty cool, but there were a lot of projects (although they were graded lighter than other classes).
Easy Class. Way to much work. And come on - Group memo writing? Could it get any easier.
He is super thorough with explaining assignments & what he expects. Lots of projects but since they are done in groups, it's easy!
Very easy class. Professor is very easy going and helpful. Easy grader.
just dont look down at your notes during presentations & you'll get an A, everythin else is easy, VERY nice guy
This is one of my favorite classes.  There are a lot of group projects, but he makes sure to prepare you for the future.  Good teacher!
He's great.  His class is my favorite because you learn so much.  It's alot of group projects but you learn from them.
I got an A in this class, very pleasant man.
Very clear for non-native speaker or anyone for that matter Very approachable.

A very caring professor who teaches in a fun way. No drama at all, meaning not too many reading or assignments or hard-to-understand grading systems. The grade is based on assignments (40%) and tests (60%). The professor is young, so it is much easier to understand what she teaches and connect with her. I had a very pleasant experience in general.

Professor Prims was great. Super quirky and made class pretty fun. Exams were easy if u just look at the slides and very light other assignments. Super chill and sweet person who means well for their students.

JP wants their students to succeed. Their lectures are interesting and engaging, and I recommend going to lectures as they are very good at explaining concepts, even though they don't count attendance. Two exams plus a final, but the lowest is dropped. I have taken them before and can say they are truly one of the best professors!

JP is an amazing, high-energy professor who keeps lectures engaging and oddly comforting—chaotic in the best way. There are three exams, but if you do well on the first two, you can skip the third. No essays, just 8 important homework assignments. Attendance is not mandatory but highly recommended.

JP is wonderful. There are three exams, and the top two count; even the final exam might be converted into a project. They give excellent exam review, which makes the exam easier, and you are even allowed to use a cheat sheet. The discussion classes are essentially extra credit. It is easy if you understand the material. TBK was not used more.

JP was a really great professor! If you're scared about taking a stats class, I recommend JP. They are great at explaining information clearly and does not over complicate information. You can tell they genuinely want their students to do well. One of our tests grades and 2 homeworks gets dropped, and Jp and the TA's are very accomadating.

JP is a very cool teacher and I love how they structured this class. its very easy and has built in safe shoots. they allow extensions if within a certain period before the assignment is due. they also only test on the practical stuff you do need to know, nothing hyper-specific and they give you a clear outline of what to study. highly reccomend!

A great professor if you're intimidated by math; while this was not the case for me, as I already had taken a stats class prior, I still found their lectures engaging and informative. One page cheat-sheets are allowed on exams, but they never felt like a crutch. The discussion sections are great, both the TAs and Prims were very understanding. :)

Super bubbly and bright personality, there's weekly homework but its very small, you get automatic short-term extensions as long as you ask for it, you can use a cheat sheet during tests, overall a very understanding teacher. I was really worried as I am not great with math but they were super helpful :D

JP values the success of their students above all else and will go above and beyond to help you if you have trouble. While it's important to attend lectures because the material builds upon itself, attendance isn't mandatory, and attending discussions gives you extra credit. JP and their TA's are lenient exam graders and drop the lowest exam score.

Loved JP! JP truly cares about students and helps ensure you succeed. If you're anxious/ with math, take JP. They're kind, patient, and happy to explain things multiple times. They provide formula sheets and allow an open-notes "cheat sheet" for all exams.

I absolutely love JP. Their class was for sure my favorite this semester and it was not difficult at all, just make sure you go to lectures. Attendance is not mandatory for either lecture or discussion but you get extra credit if you go to discussions. Two lowest homework grades get dropped, and lowest exam grade gets dropped, cheat sheets allowed.

Stats can be complicated but JP tries to simplify and explain material. They're very patient and makes sure to answer questions students have until they understand. Lectures aren't mandatory but extremely helpful for understanding material. There's 3 tests and 1 final, lowest is dropped. Provides lots of practice and resources to help students.

JP is such a good lecturer, they are very silly and make lecture fun. The lectures in this course weren't too hard to understand and if you have any questions, JP will keep answering until it is clarified for you. The only thing to pass this class really is just do the homeworks which isn't overwhelming, and attend the tests and you will do well.

They're absolutely amazing and literally do everything in your favor to get an A in the class. Cheat sheet of your own during exam, front and back. Math in this course is pretty simple, you can just follow the formula sheet and be fine. Just study the stat tests and become familiar with their purposes.
JP is a great professor. Very energetic and passionate about Stats. Didn't make class too stressful and is very relatable.
Such a good professor, I have never been good at math so taking stats was scaring me but I passed with an A. Go to the discussions if your struggling it helps a lot.

super caring professor, answers emails really quick and is good at lecturing. basically tells you what's on the exam, provides a formula sheet and everything. 8 hw assignments, lowest 2 get dropped. 4 exams, lowest gets dropped

They are amazing! Their methods of teaching makes a "scary" class become something to look forward too, exciting. The examples are awesome and jokes as well, it keeps me interested. They're extremely patient and clear in all explanations/answers to questions. I am so glad I took this class with JP.

They are one of the best professors in the psych department! I always try to take her classes for most of the required classes. It is not required to attend the lectures but I highly recommend you do as the assignments will be very easy to do. There are three exams and one will be dropped. Don't take the last one if U are satisfied with your grade.

They are so kind and understanding. Cheat sheets on the exams, 3 exams, one dropped and if you drop, you have to replace with a final exam. 2 lowest homework grades dropped. Lectures can drag but they are recorded. If you have to take 343, take it with JP, and attendance not mandatory but if you suck at stats (like me) go to class!!!!!

JP is an amazing professor I highly recommend them especially if you're no good at math like me they break the complexity of statistics in a simple manner, which is easy to grasp. They are always willing to communicate and accommodate any issues you have. Their office hours are super useful, they will try their best to make sure you understand.
She's childish and not understanding

JP is the best prof you can take for psych stats. Their lectures are engaging and they actually care whether or not you understand the concepts. Stats is not particularly easy but they really try their best to teach the concepts in an easy-to-grasp and broad picture way. Answers emails super quickly and provides lots of extra credit opportunities.

JP is high energy and great at letting you know exactly what info you need to succeed on homework & exams. Always quick to reply to emails & fix mistakes. Great at handling feedback.  As long as you do the homework and make a good "cheat sheet" for the exams, you'll do great even if the content of the class is a little hard to grasp
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: JP is the best possible teacher for this class. JP brings in lots of interesting examples and explains things very clearly, so even if math is a subject you hate or struggle with, you can succeed in this class. Prof is also very caring, genuinely wants you to succeed, and has gone out of their way to give you the best chance at understanding.

Attendance is not mandatory and they record lectures, but you will not receive access to them unless you ask JP. The exams are pretty straightforward to the lectures being taught, 4 exams (1 is dropped, so no final if you're good with the first 3). Homework is also solid based on lectures. Easy A if you pay attention to the material being taught.

JP is a great professor. You can tell that they care a lot. I took 312 with them online. One thing I will say though is that the students talk so much in that class and distract the prof which can sometimes make everything kind of confusing and extremely annoying. Just mute the group me and you're good to go. Lots of extra credit opportunities.

Prims was by far the best professor I have had so far. Not only were they super flexible and fun to be around, but the class was well taught as well. The material was easy to understand. As long as you did your homework and paid attention to the lectures - you did perfectly fine in the class. Highly highly highly recommend Prims!!
JP was a great prof. for 343, and I also had them for 312. Stats as a subject can be dry but they try to present it using applicable psych research, and they always explained things clearly.

JP Prims is honestly one of the most genuinely caring professors. They try really hard to make lectures engaging even though stats itself is boring. It's easy to get lost so if you can, try to attend lectures in person though it wasn't mandatory. They also respond to emails really fast and will help you with anything. Would definitely take again.

Class is boring but they really try to keep you engaged, which is appreciated. Very understanding and makes it very difficult to not pass. Some one the tests were made too long but they fairly admitted they were and curved them accordingly. There was also a lot of hints given on the tests and you can use notes on them.

I took PSCH 343 with Prims and the class itself is extremely boring. It's all just stats in psych. Lowest HW grade was dropped, lowest exam dropped (dont need to take final if happy with grade before final exam). Attendance "wasnt" mandatory but you do have to watch lectures and submit an attendance sheet to receive attendance credit

attending class is very boring but you get rewarded with extra credit. nothing comes out of lecture and you will have to self study all the content but doing so is easy as he just uses homework questions for the tests. shea honestly doesn't care about being a good professor cause he shows up 5-20 minutes late to every lecture
He is very chill. The class itself is so easy as long as you do all the homework he assigns. Do your studying, and u will succeed.

Quizzes are open notes, and exams are exactly like the homework, which is so easy, and you can expect the questions to be like 3 to 4 questions on the quiz, and for the midterm and final exam, 6 to 7 questions, only multiple choice. Fun teacher to be honest, but you have to teach yourself rather than depending on him.

He comes 10 mins late to every class (including quiz days). Quizzes once a week that come directly from hw. He once printed 1200+ pgs of exams 10 mins before class and the printer got jammed (who would've guessed) and had to postpone the exam to the enxt day. Very irresponsible and poor communication on his end

He doesn't stay on topic, so lectures aren't necessary. He refuses to release the formula sheets for exams until the day of, so study the hw and slides. Also says “time is money” so he doesn't allow late work, but is 5-10 minutes late to every lecture, even on exam/quiz days.

If you actually want to learn finance, do not take Justin. Never stays on topic or addresses homework/tests in class. Quizzes/tests are doable if u study the homework. People usually skip unless it's a quiz or test day. Randomly takes attendance and you teach yourself pretty much everything.

Very laid-back; the class is easy, but he does not go very in-depth about the content. Homework is open until deadline, so you retry it until you understand. Quizzes allow a cheat sheet; quizzes and exams are exactly like the homework. Fun teacher but you essentially teach yourself since much of lecture is spent googling things in the stock market.

The class is easy, but Shea is not a good professor. He cancels classes last minute and one time had to push our exam back a day because he was trying to print it 10 minutes before class and ran into printing issues. He does allow cheat sheets on quizzes, and quizzes are just like the homework. Easy class, but you need to self-study.
doesn't teach that well, chronic yapper, and the material he tests students on is barely ever talked about in class. Very inconsistent but he's kinda funny lol
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Amazing Professor, best teacher I've had yet at this school. Exams are quite easy as long as you practice the material and understand the formulas. Lectures are great and attenda
nce is not required

Knowledgeable and laid-back professor. Has a friendly personality, but the majority of class time is spent discussing current market trends and prices, which is cool and all, but there is no depth on how to apply the concepts he lists, and so if you don't self-teach, you're going to struggle on tests. Respectfully, I'm not paying to teach myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Shea is a great professor. He understands if you have other commitments and accommodates you according to that. His lectures are clear, and his quizzes and exams are simple. His grading criteria are very clear, and he provides multiple opportunities for extra credit. Overall, a great teacher and an understanding person.
One of the best professors in UIC for Finance, he's teaching methods are so fun and understandable and he also helps you with the Homework.

There were a lot of extra credits to be earn in his class, take some time to learn the formulas and you will be good. He let students get away with a lot of things that probably would not fly with other professors, he's a good man.

He always keep talking about chipotle stocks , he grades the quizzes and the midterm late you have to wait at least 2 to 3 weeks maybe a month , tough grader to all people majoring in Finance please do not take with him you need at least an 80% to pass the class

He's an awesome guy, the course is mild difficulty. He doesn't show how to apply the formulas, he will just talk about some general ideas during class. During the end of the semester, class can get difficult as there is more advanced concepts with no actual teaching on how to apply them

He is an amazing human. His teaching style may not be for everyone, but the work is straightforward! He made me love finance even more and is one of the best finance professors at UIC. He is amazing to speak to and such a resourceful guy. Take him!! A lot of extra credit was given when he really shouldn't have.

He's a very fair grader and really understanding when it comes to turning things in. He gives a lot of chances to redeem your grade, which I appreciated. His lectures focus more on outside financial concepts than exactly what's on the quizzes, but he does give study guides for the exams and will go through anything you're confused about
This man is really goated, can answer any question about finance, makes sure you understand the material, and is accessible whenever you need it.

If you're serious about finance, you need to take a class with this professor. You could ask him any questions you have about financial markets, and he'll have an answer or point you in the right direction. His experience in the industry equips him with valuable insights beyond the course material scattered throughout his lectures.
Knows a lot about finance but he's not very good at teaching but he's a really great person to talk to.

If you want to get Fin300 out of the way take this class, he does tend to yap. But the mean reviews are awful and untrue. He is a genuine dude and loves finance. He's super understanding if there's any issues with homework and quizzes. Best advice, do good on the homework, quizzes' and its an easy A.

I don't really have anything overtly positive to say about this class with this professor. He does care about finance, but lacks a true teaching method that conveys it. All the materials were either directly from the textbook with little explanation or application practice, or from other professors- lack of personal touch. I learned on my own.

Professor Shea was very lecture heavy. I know a lot of students did not like being in class. Sometimes he would get side tracked. Just do the homework and quizzes and you will be fine. You will need to learn a lot of the material on your own.

Professor Shea is a good teacher, although during his lectures he tends to talk a lot about other topics not fully related to the contet, the homework is difficult but doable, and he is definetly very understanding with the due dates. Overall, if you show up to the clasess and finish your excel work, this class should be an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Justin Shea is a good professor, he's very understanding and knowledgeable about Finance as he was a quantitative analyst before teaching here. He does tend to read off my slides and show real-world examples that don't necessarily aid in doing homework. The quizzes and homework don't always match up which is annoying. Overall, an empathetic guy

the class was made up of a few excel assignments that weren't too hard, like 5 quizzes which were pretty difficult you have to teach yourself for those, and a midterm and a final. The midterm was literally just the review so it was really easy and he allowed cheat sheets too. The lectures weren't really interesting, he just reads off pearson slides
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor is nice overall, but I personally felt like the lectures were not interesting. I think the connections between lectures and homework/quizzes/exams could be better. I did feel like I was teaching myself but its not super difficult. The exams are exactly like the review, so make sure you do the review. He allowed cheat sheets as well

Lectures are not helpful but he is genuinely a very nice guy and wants everyone to succeed. Light grader, excel assignments, my lab assignments, quizzes, 1 midterm, and 1 final, not a difficult class but have to put some effort outside. Offers Excel Assignments for extra credit and gives test corrections.

Lectures are not useful at all. What he teaches in class is totally not related to what he test stuff in quizzes and homework. SELF STUDY is a MUST. 
You need to prepare for quizzes yourself.

One of the best professors out there! He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. His slides are helpful, and he explains everything well. Exams can be challenging but regular class attendance and the study guide help. Weekly group case studies but he almost gives full grades as long as u participate. Can't recommend him enough
He's a great professor. Class is way too hard, though. Wish he made better power points and study guides/outlines. Exams are hard.

Definitely take Judd! Very passionate about what he teaches, clears up any confusion and is very understanding under special circumstances outside of class. Always looked forward to his class, and as long as you pay close attention and go to class you will be fine. Accounting can be tough, but he made it bearable.

Professor Judd really cares about Auditing and you can see it in his lectures. Attend all classes as a lot of the material on tests comes from lectures. There is a homework and case study almost every week, but he does drop the lowest of each. His tests can be difficult but he is willing to curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is a great and involved professor that loves what he teaches. I regret taking him at 8 am because I missed and that cost me many points; exams have questions on stuff only covered in class and lectures are not recorded. Most work is completion based but the questions will appear on the exams. A fair bit of homework but it is easy if you attend
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was not horrible. There are only 8 assignments and 7 discussion boards. She takes points off for small things but if you read the rubric and make sure you do it correctly you will be fine. Assignments are time consuming but there is plenty of time to get it done. There might be better instructors but she is not SO horrible.

This professor is disorganized, takes forever to reply to emails, is unhelpful, and openly uses and encourages the use of AI for a RESEARCH COURSE!!!! She does not explain/cover the key topics of the class we should cover, doesn't understand research, and is an awful teacher.

RUN. Worst professor I've ever had: rude, WAY too much work for 1 cred class, inaccessible outside of class, no feedback on assignments, forced us to respond to every little question on zoom. This was supposed to prepare me for my capstone but w/ no feedback on assignments, I had absolutely no clue if I was on track. Run ... no, seriously.

The professor does all the homework assignments but fails to realize that students take multiple other classes. She said an assignment should take a few hours as we should read multiple 20+ pages for our research, not including the homework from other classes. This was also a one credit hour class.

By far the worst honors college professor, this was supposed to be a p/f course but instead, you were fighting for your life in this class. she wanted her assignments to be completed in a specific matter which was unnecessary. She grades harshly for no reason and takes off way to many points to where you need to redo them.

She's very strict about attendance and gives so much homework. She gives everyone one unexcused absence, and if they miss another class without documentation, they fail the course. She won't even excuse someone who was clearly very sick and bed-ridden but still joined class at the end. This class is too time-consuming for a 1-credit course.
Super bothersome class, literally made me want to drop honors college all together. The professor is really mean and gives a lot of busy work which got in the way of my courses that mattered.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: She would take away your attendence grade no matter the situation. She was the toughest grader that I have ever met in my entire life. She's nice on class but terrible at grading and giving out assignment.

The entire class got an assignment wrong and she blamed us for it. She's nice during class meetings but doesn't care about the students' situation or understanding in the class, she expects you to get it the first time around. Also her instructions are very confusing to read.

I had her for ARAB 101 and 102, I had no knowledge of Arabic before and it will be my 4th-ish language. She is an amazing professor and I wish she still taught higher levels. You cannot fail, there are many extra credit and re-do opportunities. Hiya mumtaazah

Best professor ever. I'm so sad she's not teaching 103 next semester. I would take her again if I could. She is very sweet and provides a LOT of extra credit opportunities.There were weekly assignments, 3 exams, and 2 oral presentations (video submission). She is very interactive so be prepared to work with the people around you every class.
she is so amazing and very caring !

She is genuinely the best professor I had in academia period. She kept the class very productive every session. Homework was minimal, but everyone including myself still learned at high pace.

I strongly recommend her, especially for non-native speakers. She never makes you feel dumb for asking questions and gives great feedback.

One of the most sincere, and caring professors I ever had. She was so sweet, and made sure everyone was learning everything. Languages can be hard, but she never makes you feel like you're alone. She is also an amazing professor, I never struggled because her teaching was able to make me learn right away. Take her, she's amazing!

Out of my four years here at UIC, Jumana was the best professor I've ever had. Exceptional teaching style, great personality, and she is very caring. The course load is easy, if you pay attention, you will learn. And if you have troubles, she is genuinely interested in ur learning and will put in effort to make sure you don't fall behind in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: i am only 2 weeks into Mrs. Jumana's class but she is such a down to earth, caring professor. Having taken 101 at UIC, it was not very enjoyable but I stuck with it and I am glad I did, I can already tell that Jumana is very caring, easy to reach out to outside of class, and well organized. Take her if you have the chance!

She is incredibly kind and always willing to help with whatever you need. She gives valuable feedback on homework, which is very helpful. As long as you pay attention and attend most of the classes, it's an easy A. I highly recommend taking her class!!

Best Arabic professor ever, she has extremely clear instruction, is very good for non-native speakers. She NEVER makes students feel dumb, and everything we do in class is productive and has a purpose.I learned so much in this class, would 100% recommend taking this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor if you are COMPLETELY new to Arabic. She has a methodical approach to teaching language--lots of facilitation and guidance. She also does a great job getting her students to speak in Arabic. We never had a boring class!! Jumana was funny and sweet and I would 100% take her again.

THE BEST ARABIC PROFESSOR AT UIC. Shes really kind and caring with all of her students in her classes. Shes also really good at explaining lessons in class. Her quizzes tend to be a bit hard so make sure to prepare thoroughly for them, but shes also a very generous grader so dont feel too bad if you think you messed up on an exam.

Jumana is such a sweet professor. She understands that all students will begin at different levels, but sets a goal to get everyone where they need to be. There are some extra credit opportunities as well!
Walked out of class feeling like a native speaker. Amazing teacher even better person.

Professor Jumana is sweet and caring. She is very understanding and wants her students to succeed. Just be prepared to be randomly called on during class to answer questions. Overall, she is a nice professor and I would definitely take her again!

Professor Jumana is a great teacher, she understands that this isn't your language so she is very tolerant when it comes to homework. Exams are easy as long you study the material and do the homework also extra credit is given.
She was a great professor, she gives a lot of chance for extra credit. Also she is a great grader, very lenient when it comes to deadlines. I would highly recommend taking her class for beginners.

Ms. Jumana is an amazing Professor. She genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She has weekly guidelines to guide you every week when it comes to quizzes and assignments. However, just be prepared to be called on randomly and have your camera on during class. Also, make sure to turn in your assignments on time.

Jumana is an amazing professor. She doesn't accept late homework but she doesn't give too much and when she does it's easy. I had her for 101 and had so much fun going to her class. She's such a joy and her presence just radiates good vibes. I'm going all the way to 104 just so I can have her as a professor again. One of the best no doubt!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, very understanding and helpful. Treats everyone as if they were family. I took 104 and I learned a lot and enjoyed the class. I speak Arabic and took this class to help me with my reading and writing and it did. There are hw but not too many. She understands that not everyone is at the same level and teaches accordingly.

This is my second semester taking Jumana and my opinion hasnt changed. Still by far the best prof for Arabic. 102 is definitely a lot harder than 101 but she makes sure that we learn. As a non native speaker she went out of her way to make sure I understood everything before she moved on with the lecture. Take her at all costs. JUMANA IS THE BEST

Mrs. Almahamid is an amazing teacher. She is very respectful to her students and genuinely cares about every student doing well. She makes herself available outside of class and gives good feedback on homework. I've never learned arabic as well as I did with her. Definitely recommend!

102 is a huge pump up from 101. It does get challenging but you'll definitely make it if you put in the effort. In my opinion, plurals was probably the hardest thing to learn in Arabic, but once you get that out of the way, the rest is straight-forward. Also, Arabic Speakers beware because she will definitely call on you at least once a day.

Jumana teaches very well and cares a lot about her students. She is very nice as well. When I say she cares, I mean SHE CARES!!! Take her class, you won't regret it a bit! Expect homework almost every night but doing the homework will really help you ace your tests.

Jumana is the best professor there and my favorite. As long as you show that you care and actually try you will get an A. When I say she cares about her students I mean that she acts like a caring mom more than a professor. I would take her 10 times out of 10. I am going to take her for every arabic class. TAKE HER

Jumana makes the process of learning Arabic easy for beginners while also challenging some of the native speakers who are not proficient at reading the language. The professor makes it easy to learn to learn Arabic while also earning a decent grade. As long as one usually comes to class and completes all of the HW and studies, they'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is one of the best language professors I have had. She genuinely cares about her students and wants everyone to pass. Her homework and quizzes are really easy if you pay attention in class. Honestly hated waking up at 9am for class but she made the class so fun. There will also be a lot of native speakers to help you in class.

She is a really nice professor and really wants everyone to do good. She's always available after class to explain things and sometimes calls students to stay after class to talk about their performance or common mistakes. Definitely would recommend.

Jumana is the best professor I have ever had. She teaches incredibly clearly and is willing to help every single student improve. She is also very nice and I loved every second of the class. You also cannot pass this class without participating in some way, but either way she will put you on the spot which helps you so much with the language.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Her Polish history lectures have my attention the full class period. She often incorporates tidbits of current events, explaining their context and importance. She is also nonjudgmental, unbiased, and respectful when discussing controversial topics, making sure to represent and explain both sides, given that Poland's politics are very polarized.

Dr. Stauter-Halsted is funny. Not always in a laugh out loud way but her class was always entertaining. The readings she chose and the topics the class focused on were always interesting. The essay topics were relevant to the class and fun to write. Expectations were clear. No tests, ever.

Professor Stauter-Halsted is personable, knowledgable, and cares to deliver her lecture material in an understanding and clear way. The course is very interactive and there's a bond between the students. I fell behind in the assignments due to personal things and Prof. SH worked closely with me and encouraged me to finish the course with success

Professor Halsted is an incredibly passionate professor with more to say than the standard class period allows. She's an incredibly fair grader that lays out exactly what she wants from a paper. Admittedly, she seemed to push a political agenda during the 2016 presidential election but that's to be expected from a history professor. Great teacher.
Very knowledgable and a fair grader.

She is an excellent professor! She’s always clear and helpful—always willing to help you or break things down if lectures become too complicated. Class was compromised of quizzes, two exams, and two essays. As long as you attend lectures and read the books or articles given, you are guaranteed an A!

Excellent professor. She is very clear about what is expected of you. The quizzes are simple & straightforward if you pay attention in class. The essay topics are also relatively easy if one keeps up in the class. Btw, she is hilarious :)

She's very dry. People might think she's interesting, but really, she uses powerpoints for pictures and talks the full lecture time. She will have her TA grade everything, which means no rubric, and every little mistake is highlighted. She posts a lot on blackboard, but never updates the grades, so you're left guessing until the end.

Fantastic lady.I missed the midterm because I had the flue and she let me make it up on my time because she knew I had other midterms as well. By God this woman is so considerate.She is a published author,VERY knowledgeable,extremely nice,RESPECTFUL to students, and conveys historical information in an understandable way. I highly recommend her.
She was an amazing professor! I would recommend her class to everyone

Brilliant, informative, intelligent, and funny, Dr. Stauter-Halsted defines the meaning of an ideal professor. Her extensive knowledge of Polish history and culture and her passion for teaching make her class an enjoyment. She is great with working with individual students cares for their learning experience.
Great class.  Even if you have no prior knowledge she conveys the information in a way that makes you feel comfortable the complexity.

Professor Whyte clearly knows what he is talking about and is obviously a very smart man, but he doesn't organize his class in a structured way. Very unorganized. But, you will learn a lot in this class. Even though attendance isn't mandatory, there is a huge benefit from attending class.

(I actually took him for MATH 445 not MATH 442) He was a very good professor! He thought the course in a very visual way and really wanted everyone to understand the concepts and took a lot of care in teaching them. The 2nd exam was very difficult though and threw me off, but overall, I would definitely take him again!

Kind and accessible outside of class. However his example driven teaching style didn't work for me. Doesn't say the topic of the lecture before the lecture and does examples before introducing the concept in a way that makes taking coherent notes rather hard as he doesn't record lectures.

This class was a little challenging because I didn't take real analysis before this. The only prerequisite for this class is Calculus 3, but you are expected to be comfortable with proofs, especially epsilon delta proofs. I wouldn't recommend taking this class unless you are good at math or have taken MATH 313 before. Professor is generally okay

Professor Whyte was extremely considerate and flexible, very well adjusted with COVID. He gave us many chances to redeem ourselves if we didn't do well on homework or exams. The class is tough, but he is always available to answer any questions.

I love this guy, and he focuses on learning in his teachings, not passing exams or learning equations. However, this makes his class labor intensive, although very rewarding. He's a proficient teacher, but he really shines as a combination math search engine and teacher so ask lots of questions. DO NOT take him for an easy grade, take him to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He certainly knows his stuff, but it's extremely hard to learn from him as he doesn't explain things well or in depth enough for a student. I don't recommend him, but if you wind up having him, learn a lot during your discussion and your own independent studying. In lecture, you can get a lot out of him if you ask questions.

All he did in lecture was go over the homework questions people had (which was optional) and if you didn't questions he lets you go early. His grading is SUPER harsh also. If you make a mistake at the beginning of the problem, the whole question is wrong and you get 0 points. The whole grade is based on the tests. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HIM.

Save yourself! This class is hard enough and when a professor can't teach..... what can we do?.. He does answer questions, but it always confuses me even more. Please if you care about your GPA and it is mandatory to take this class.. DON'T take it with him.. I wish someone told me this before.... but then again... it said TBA.. CAREFUL! :(

If you value your education avoid this professor. He almost is always late to lecture and unorganized. His exams are completely unreasonable (the averages are usually a 20%) He employs a what he calls "student lead Lecture" but really it is more  like you teach yourself.The only thing I will give him is he's smart and will answer any question.

This is the worst professor in the world. If you want to learn something or try to pass the class, don't ever try to take this profession. He always skip the steps when he was trying to explain, that makes our life much harder. Never prepare for class. Overall, he doesnt worth a one.

The man is genius. Grades extremely hard. Class exam averages were around 15%. He answers questions and is very helpful. Abstract algebra is a hard course and it was made harder because he would throw theorem after theorem and do an example once in a blue moon.

Clearly brilliant guy.  He's good at explaining difficult things, and really wants you to understand.   Not very careful about homework deadlines, and will not notice that you need help unless you ask for it.   Exams are very hard but with a generous curve.    Highly recommended, but only if you are motivated and want to put in a lot of time.

I am graduating this semester, and this was THE WORST professor i have had. His tests where unrelated and impossible. Lectures where boring and unclear, and all over the place. He was never ready for class. THE ONLY time i got a B at UIC was in his class. DON'T TAKE HIS CLASS!

I would recommend that you do NOT take this professor, he knows his stuff and he will help.  But learning from him is difficult because when he speaks, he whispers.  He knows about his problem too but he doesn't seem to do anything about it.  If your taking him, read the book and learn from it, it will be your teacher for this semester.

Cons-monotone voice, unexpected exam ?s, no h/w (guess that can be a pro but it's hard to learn that way), availability, you have to work hard as hell and teach yourself. Pros- goes at class' pace, lectures on what needs to be lectured on and you get the hell out (even if it's two hours early), one take-home final that you get to revise

prof whyte is really smart but lacks personal skills. when u schedule he usually cancels. he bases the class on two tests and if u fail one u fail the class. good luck if u have to take him otherwise choose another prof
Ask questions, go to his office hours.

This was the only class i have gotten a B in so far from High school. The guy's notes are impossible to follow. And,  he just did not show you how to solve the problem. He went though every last detail in why these things exist. Who knows, i had a few friends that didn't mind him. No quizzes made that class even harder to stay on top of.

Whyte is exteremly intelligent.  He teaches the class w/o notes.  He is always willing to meet outside of class if help is needed, and he even gives help via email.  He is very patient as well and will answer any questions asked, no matter how dumb they are. He is very into having students understand the "why" behind the mathematics.

i loved Matthew so much, he is a great professor, teacher, lecturer (you name it). if you come with interest for the subject he will definitely amplify it and keep you engaged throughout the semester. enjoyed his classes tremendously

Kendall was an amazing professor. I took his RUSS 115 and left remembering basically everything taught due to his amazing lectures and course material. Plenty of reading, but he's not entirely strict about it. Participation is fun and inclusive and there's not much work that's graded. He's sweet and understanding, also really funny. Take the class!

reviews.comment: loved him so much. very interesting material, very lovely soul, attentive, enthusiastic. taking a class with him again next semester

reviews.comment: Matt was an amazing first impression for me as a freshman. I liked his way of teaching some historical events so we have something to keep in the back of our heads while tackling some readings. He prefers to postpone quizzes in order to not ruin the flow of the discussion of the previous sessions, which is a very nice addon to being with his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Best gen ed I've taken at UIC by far! He's very good at building up to the point that he's making with the assigned readings, but you really have got to read the readings, which can be a lot. He's also very clear about what will be on the exams as he's teaching the material. This was a discussion heavy class, but he doesn't do cold-calling.

reviews.comment: If you need a world cultures gen ed I can't rec this class enough. He is incredibly nice, and his discussions are engaging. It made me interested in the culture of this time. Quizzes, exams, and ChatGPT critiques are easy and straightforward. Just make sure you come to class with the reading at least partially done.

reviews.comment: SO friendly and so chill. Weekly hw assignments due at 8am for some reason but not hard at all. Group project heavy so a good group is necessary. Participation matters or else he will pick on you. But so nice take him for sure and the class is chill too

Easy class with easy weekly homework consists of reading and reflecting on them. A great professor who cares about students and is ready to accommodate their needs in the class. Take him if you can for BA 320

Keith Lewis is an example of what the future of teaching needs. Effort and spirit. Although he was in one of my minor classes necessary for graduation, I will not forget the wonderful different point of view he gave me in BA320 through readings and real world comparisons.
He thinks his class is like an actual very hard class, and thinks too highly of himself, has a big ego and will ignore your emails most the time.

This class was amazing. I wish other pre-rec classes were like this. There was rarely any homework and he doesn't penalize for late assignments. I had no academic stress with this class. I highly recommend that you take his class.
falksjdbffasdf

IF YOU ARE ANY MAJOR OTHER THAN MUSIC, PLEASE DO NOT TAKE MUS118. 
Psych major with pre med track, the listening guides in this class took WAYY LONGER to complete than any of my other classes. I had to decode each lyric and describe it. All the other assignments were fine and could be submitted anytime during the semester! Loved that!
He will give you a zero on a paper and claim it has “hallucinations of AI”. Stay far away.

This was a very easy class. He was very enthusiastic about the material. I liked how he held his lectures via podcasts. He has a class Discord where you can ask him questions, but don't ask dumb questions where the answer's in the syllabus. He frequently sent reminders and was clear on what assignments are due. The exams are also easy if you study.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's pretty chill, not too much work tbh. He's accessible through discord.

Drags on grading assignments, and ignores your emails if he doesn't deem you worthy enough for a response. I have never experienced this level of frustration with a professor. I reached out twice and asked if it's possible for me to pass this class, and he hasn't responded once. I missed 1 assignment btw. :)

I HATE this professor with all my heart!! I couldn't submit ONE paper due to a technical error, and that dropped my grade from A to D. I spent my entire winter break emailing him, asking him to reason with me, 'cause it wasn't even my fault, but he literally did not care. He was really rude and did not care that my GPA dropped BECAUSE OF HIM.

This course was very easy as long as you turn in assignments and have a good idea of the content. The course load is very bearable, listening guides (majority), unit quizzes and final - mostly all multiple choice, extra credit. Didn't have to contact prof Kamps at all, but he was very clear with assignment expectations along with HW reminders, etc.

Professor who thinks too highly of his curriculum and himself that he grades and conducts class as if it is a higher level course when in reality it's an entry level course taken by people who just need to fulfill an easy general education requirement. Easy online class that is only held back by the professor himself.

Kamps was great! There were 5 total assignments: 3 listening guides and 2 miscellaneous assignments. His late policy is also lowkey a lifesaver. If you turn a listening guide late he takes off 5/100. Also, he goes over the important stuff in class, so if you can't afford the book, attend lectures. Just write good notes and you'll be fine.

reviews.comment: He is such an L professor he would literally give exams before any assignments which means you have to watch to make sure when it is unless you will fail the class he is just a walking L ngl. but an easy A and online class every semester
Great guy with an obvious passion for what he teaches. Very friendly, communicates office hours. The slides aren't accessible outside of class so you have to show up to take notes.

He makes the content very accessible online. You do have to read the book but he also talks about the content in podcast form lectures which can take up to 1 hr to get through. Discussion boards every week pertaining the chapter on Packback. There are 3 essays (1-2 pgs). If you keep up & try to finish everything early in the week you will be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He has a discord where people ask dumb things that are easy to google. They also try to argue that Wikipedia is a valid source, even though he said it isn't. All homework is due at the end of the semester, with the listening guides only being deduced by 5 points if not turned in by their soft due dates. Pretty mid professor, but not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kamps provides a very easy and simple course that fits with any schedule regardless of number of credit hours. The assignments aren't time consuming with the occassional research essay, but there's a lot of given time to do it so it's okay. Kamps is also easy to contact, using Discord, and he's caring.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Very good guy. The class had 2 exams, a final, and 2 listening guide papers. There was also a weekly discussion post on packback that was easy points. If you just do the assignments you will get an A. The exams are on blackboard and are straightforward. He has a discord where people ask dumb questions that you can find the answer to by just looking
Professor Kamps is cool! He is very clear on his grading criteria. Easy A class if you do your homework! Def recommend his class.

Kamps is a great professor that passionate about music, and he is very accessible outside of class so join the discord provided. The material for the class is really straightforward as there are 3 tests, 2 papers, and 3 homeworks which he is very flexible about them. There is also Packback, where you ask 1 question and reply to 2, easy points.
Exams are hard but overall not too bad. Reach out for help if you need!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He's alright but he grades harshly. He didn't make it clear that Packback was every week. You have to do it every week. He took off 15% one of my papers just because I messed up the formal part. That was the only mistake. I don't think that was worth taking of a full 15%. He's just annoying I guess.

One of the easiest classes at UIC, fully remote as well. The assignments like pop-up assignments and short papers can be turned in anytime with very little penalty. The exams are timed but the content is mostly through the text book which you can download for free. Professor holds office hours and can be accessed through Discord as well.

His lectures were a perfect mixture of learning and humor. Not only was the class subject interesting but he talks in a way that makes the class engaging. Exams and homework were a complete breeze since the exams were online and all of the homework becomes due at the end of the semester.

Good professor and available outside of class. The class itself is very interesting but does have some tedious work that takes some time to complete. Very lenient with deadlines on all material except for exams.

Honestly this class was very easy. There were 3 easy homework assignments that he gives you till the very last day of class to complete. 3 tests plus a final which you can pass pretty easily. 2 listening guide, and packback are easy but very annoying. there is also extra credit

This professor thinks extremely highly of himself and does not have much regard for his students. Class is an easy A if you don't mind doing a ton of tedious busy work weekly. Do not miss any tests by mistake as he will not open them for you.

If its online then this class is SUPER easy all you have to do is read some pages of the textbook and write three 1 page research projects and you're guaranteed an A. Since it was fully online I didn't really have any interactions with the professor but based off the materials and resources he gives out he seems like he cares about his students.

This class is an easy A whether you go to class or not. He is so chill and all you do is listen to music. Notes are recommended but you really don't need to take any because they don't really go with the homework. All tests are online and you get about a week sometimes to take them. 10000% recommend. Don't buy the textbooks, no need.

Course load was manageable and material was actually pretty interesting. Professor has office hours and can reach him through Discord, which was pretty cool and very useful. Pretty lenient grader and homework is rare.

Listening guides are annoying and tedious. This is 100 level but he makes it seem like its a 300 level course. Takes forever to grade, although he seems a genuine professor. Exams are based off the book, not TOO bad, but not easy. Does offer some credit. and you have to do packback. decent class, but you have to work for it. dont expect an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Not a difficult class, only three papers and about four unit tests. He does ask you to read A LOT of pages from the textbook, but that's pretty much it. There's also a weekly hw assignment to post a question on this website called packsack and respond to two classmates. Professor Kamps is great. Such a joy and free spirit. Very funny!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Kamps changed my life and molded me into the man I am today. He is so amazing, inspiring, and handsome! Also his brass band is killer!

Super easy class, exams are all online and open notes. He doesn't post lectures online so you have to go to class to get the notes. 3 song papers that are super easy and he helps you a lot if you go to his office hours. Weekly Packback (1 question, 2 answers) that's super easy to do. Offers extra credit for Packback and exams.
