reviews.comment: Kamps is a great dude who teaches a great class. The only thing is that you have to show up for lectures because he doesnt post them online soooooo that's that but all in all a great dude!
Don't listen to the others, they're just jealous. Excellent professor, great lectures. Probably the smartest man I know.

Pretty decent professor. His lectures are often dry, but the exams, which are all online, are easy since you can rely on your notes to take them. Also, on a serious note, PLEASE DO NOT JOIN A GroupMe chat. Several students were caught by him. DON'T DO IT. Besides, there is no need to do since the class is super easy. Trust me.

Overall, he's a good professor Unlike the person below, I disagree with the issues he has. Instead, he is super nit-picky on the song papers. For example, if you forget one super small detail about a song, he'll deduct points. But, otherwise, the class is very chill and thee exams are take home and can be found using your notes. Still recommend.

He was great in the beginning, but he ended up really disappointing me. He is really selfish, doesn't care about his student's well-being, all he cares about is people showing up. I had COVID-19 and he didn't even email me back like my other professors for accommodations. He also grades hard on what should have been an easy A, got a B for ITALICS.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Kamps is one of the most entertaining professors I've ever had. He teaches great useful material and makes going to lecture fun. Attendance isn't mandatory but since quizzes and exams are based on lecture, you should definitely go. He's a fair grader and offers extra credit on certain quizzes. His class has been a blast.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If you love American pop music, then take this class. It's very easy, fun, and interesting. He's a nice and funny professor. Somewhat disorganized, though. 3 easy 1-2 page papers and Packback due each week. Easy online tests. Do your Packback, go to class, get your notes, and take your tests. Extra credit is offered. No attendance is taken.

reviews.comment: Pretty funny, 4 tests including final, not too hard, have to go to class for the notes, and weekly online homework is given but it's easy.

Professor Kamps was a very fair professor. I liked the class because it was very interesting to learn how music evolves through time. Lectures were a little boring, but all of the assignments were easy--even the paper. An easy A class for sure. Everything is outlined in the syllabus and he runs a very tight ship. Not an intimidating class or prof.

reviews.comment: EASY A class. Just go to class and do the assignments. I only went to class because attendance was 10% of the grade, you can be on your laptop. the assignments were easy and the paper wasn't that hard either.
Pretty Easy A. Exams/Tests were online and there were like 3 online homework. There were 2 papers. He uses iClicker for attendance.

Mus 118 was so easy. You would get a couple of iClickers each day to get attendance but other than that participation doesn't matter. You receive a couple of tests which are easy bc you can google the questions (tests are online and so is homework)

reviews.comment: Class is easy. The hw and test are done through bb; he does pop quizzes which are credit for the attendance part of your grade. The pop quizzes are 3-4 questions of that day of lecture. I found his teaching very medicore.

The class was an easy A, I relied on his lecture slides, he mainly pulls everything from the book so you don't need to buy it. Hated the class!

reviews.comment: Very nice professor who is enthusiastic about teaching American popular music. The exams and papers are very easy. There are pop "attendance sheets" so beware of that. But, overall the class is an easy A+

Very nice teacher who I think realizes that barely anyone who ever takes his class is actually at UIC to study music. I don't like classes like this but I barely went to class and everything is online including the tests and even the final exam.

Jordan is engaging, exciting, and refreshing. Being such a young professor who connects with his students on a social level, but still maintaining an authoritative grip on his class is his teaching style. Very funny x easygoing, and attractive. One of my favorite classes.

Jordan is fun, energetic and ready to teach! He is helpful in answering all questions and incourages his students to participate and speak up in class. He assigns 4 projects that are easy enough and he explains everything upfront. Amazing teacher that loves his job!

He's a really nice guy who's super interested in music. He's a reasonable grader on papers and exams and gives out extra credit like candy. Music 118 is a great gen ed class to take. If you have even the slightest amount of brains, you'll get an A

Professor Kamps is AWESOME ! Literally helps you out so much ! There are 4 exams and the final, one of the exams gets dropped. HE LITERALLY GOES OVER EVERY SINGLE QUESTION A WEEK BEFORE THE EXAM AND TELLS YOU TO WRITE IT ALL DOWN ! Basically hands you the A and it's up to you if you reach out and grab it. Absolutely the best professor !
Interesting Class, Tests are multiple choice (just review class power points), three two page papers (just albumconcert reviews) EASY A!
Basically my easiest class at college. I didn't know anything about music before the class, I went to most of it but I never needed to study and the easiest A ever.

Having played 2 instruments growing up, I expected this class to be zero work and I was wrong. It's not that hard, but if you're looking at this as a class to put no work in whatsoever because of prior music experience, you're wrong. He's a great teacher and willing to answer ?s. Not hard to get an A in, but homework can be somewhat time consuming.

Professor Khurram is honestly one of the stay chill professors I've had. He keeps class super chill but still makes sure you actually learn something. He doesn't stress over small stuff and is pretty understanding if you just communicate. If you want a relaxed class with a tuff and nonchalant prof, he's the one. Definitely "Zaddy Khurram" energy.
Just trust me on this and take the class. You will NOT regret it.
Amazing professor! He is very knowledgeable and funny at the same time. Interacts well with students and is a very chill professor. He's flexible with grading and ends class early.
PLEASE TAKE SOC 105 WITH SAJID!!! Super chill guy and an easy A.

Amazing person and professor! So far the best professor i've ever had and a super super easy class as long as you take the notes he tells you to take and just attend class. The homework is super easy and you have like a week or two to complete a few questions which are common sense most of the time.

I LOVE HIS LECTURES. He is very understanding. His way of teaching is interesting and fun. I had quizzes or reflections every other week, a midterm paper, and a multiple-choice final exam. Just show up to class and take notes. The concepts he teaches can be a little challenging but not impossible to understand.

I took this class as a gen-ed therefore I was not the most excited to take it. However, I am so grateful Sajid was my professor because his teaching style made me like Sociology more than I expected! He is so chill and easy-going yet simultaneously I learned so much from him. 10/10 professor :)
He's pretty lenient and an easy grader.

this man is the TOP G. the class is easy and the lectures are engaging. i wasn't initially excited to take this class but he makes it easy to understand and enjoyable at the same time. take him if you can

Prof. Khan is a good professor, I had her for ENGL 161 which is naturally a boring class, as you're just writing essays, but we did have some interesting discussions here and there. She's very nice and understanding, and gives good feedback. The homework was a bit confusing sometimes, but she's a fair grader and I ended up with a 100 in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is a review for ENGL 223! Obviously there's reading it's an english class. The class was overall easy and the prof understanding, not a lot work besides reading, only two papers. Attendance is pretty lenient but don't miss too much still. Most of the books can be found online. Prof Khan is a very chill and sweet person, please respect her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super sweet and understanding. In my experience as long as you try your best and get things turned in on time you will get a good grade. I believe there are about 4 projects each warrant 3 drafts, but I only ever did the final draft and still got an 100% in the class. A lot of peer editing in class on days first drafts are due. Overall good prof.

She is really sweet herself, however her class is really boring. Most of the times I am on the verge of sleeping in class. We read a lot like a lot!!! However she grades really easy and barely any assignments. The books are boring too tbh. Its a discussion every class from the readings and sometimes its silent and she doesn't know how to fix it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is probably one of the most boring classes I've ever taken. I like her, but it feels like she doesn't know how to fill silences or facilitate discussion. A lot of times, it feels as though she only engages with things she agrees with, which takes the fun out of the socratic style of the class. Most of the books chosen for class are zzzz.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I genuinely have met fewer interetsing or qualified people in the English department here. Within the first two weeks she'd cut me off multiple times and discarded everything I was saying or the point I was making. Also the course itself is run poorly, it's socratic, which is fine - discussion about books is good, but the books are hs level.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of the best English professors!! She is super caring and gives back great advice. There are 4 papers in total. Each paper builds off of each other. She requires you to submit a rough draft for each paper, and gives you feedback on the paper before you submit the final version. Great professor!!

i highly recommended professor khan!! she was so nice and caring and understood if anything came up. the class was mainly based on the 4 writing projects so we would write one project take a break then write the second one and so on. it was somewhat difficult but it was getting easier bc all the papers revolves around your topic. HIGHLY RECOMMEND
She is super caring and one of the best professors, I had in my life! Do take her class!!!! HIGHLY RECOMENDED

He is really kind and homework/ exams/ iclicker are alright. But the lectures were very hard to sit through, he just reads off the slides, circles a bunch of words, and it is not very engaging. It was easier to teach myself.
He is really understanding and ready to help. Problem sets and exams are both easy; just pay attention in class, and you get a straight A.
The lectures are clear and easy to understand, but the tests are somewhat challenging.
If y have passion for Econ, he is not for you. Just slide show and read, not giving any interesting study cases.
His lecture slides have all the information you need, but all he did was read off the slides. He was a really sweet person though, iClicker was extra credit, and he rarely gave out homework.
Gives decent lectures however he reads off the slides. He does explain stuff in more depth sometimes when it isn't on the slides. He also gives extensions and extra credit.
One of the best professors I have had for ECON. Even though the HW was worth a lot, he made sure the homeworks weren't very hard. Would definitely take him again!

He is a nice man, but the worst professor I have ever had. The class was ridiculously disorganized and he made it so much harder than it had to be. Do not take this class with him if you can avoid it. I do not know how he is for other classes, but he was an awful lecturer. His feedback did not make sense. Do not take classes with him.

Learning GIS was challenging but Prof. Kheir made the information as accessible and interesting as he could. While the course had a TA, students were also welcome to reach out to Prof. Kheir as well. I also appreciated his level of enthusiasm for the material. I would definitely take another course with Prof. Kheir.
Dr. Al-Kodmany is an expert in the field but provides a fun, thorough class. The class is well-designed and achieves the goal, students learn complex material.

The professor has put tremendous efforts to facilitate and deliver a high-quality learning experience in an atmosphere of open collaboration and communication. He also provided valuable feedback throughout the semester for assignments and projects. I was taking this class as an introductory course to the program and it has left a positive impact.
Very passionate about the topic and teaching. Spends so much time helping students during and outside class hours. Super responsive and provides useful feedback.

Prof. Al-Kodmany is a super encouraging, passionate professor with deep knowledge about GIS. I was really intimidated before taking this class but by the end I felt confident using GIS for my final project. The homeworks are super helpful to build your knowledge about the program, and although they take a while, they are clear and reasonable.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Kheir is very knowledgeable on GIS. He comes with a lot of GIS experience and knows Arc Map like the back of his hand. This class is challenging but he always walks through the homework assignments during class which is very helpful for grasping the concepts. He's also accessible outside of class so it's hard to fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This class was a master's-level studio course (conducted online due to Covid) working with ArcGIS to spatially analyze large datasets for a comprehensive, semester-long group project. Professor was growth-oriented and took time to give excellent, useful feedback, and structured the class in a way that made the workload feel manageable.

I would take this class again! We overcame the challenge of working virtually and eight people produced over 150 maps for a thorough and comprehensive spatial analysis of the impacts of COVID-19 and racial inequities throughout Chicago. Kheir has a really great grasp on GIS and his lectures were extremely helpful for a new GIS analyst.

Professor Al-Kodmany is very knowledgeable and can handle any ArcGIS issue you have for him. Much work and effort was put into this course so that students can practice GIS in the classroom. Information and assistance from Kheir is always available and he reviews fundamental GIS techniques.

Dr. Al-Kodmany made our zoom class experience amazing with the amount of assistance he provided in ensuring we understood GIS. As a first-time GIS user, I felt comfortable asking questions regarding the program and our final project.
Great professor. He made the course loveable and enjoyable. Thanks Professor for everything.

If you really want to be proficient in ArcGIS, take his course! Professor Al-Kodmany is a true expert and is always willing to give you opportunities to explore your research interests in class, especially in the final project.

Dr. Al-Kodmany was a great professor who really cared about his students. He takes the time to give honest feedback, which is appreciated as the final project is pretty in-depth. Ultimately, if you put in the effort you will do well in his course.

Professor Kodmany is a really kind, patient and fun professor. Took him for an intro to GIS course, and although it was virtual, he made the material super easy to understand, provided lectures and recordings and examples, and made it a completely worthwhile class. He really cares about his students. Can't recommend him enough!
Professor Alkudmani is my external PhD committee member, he extends a great support and shares his knowledge for his outstanding experience in the subject of my Research.

Prof. Al-Kodmany is passionate, engaging and fun. The course is well structured to enable students with no experience with ArcGIS to navigate a very complex software system with greater self-sufficiency and confidence. Prof. Al-Kodmany is clear, puts great forethought into structuring his lectures and assignments and very accessible outside class

Kheir is a wonderful professor. He and TA reply to your email really fast and give you useful feedback. This class is quite hard for a person who did not have many GIS experiences in the real world, the weekly assignments and final project need to spend many hours and days to complete but you have plenty of time to finish them.
Great Professor. Take him!

This was the first GIS course I've ever taken, and it was difficult for me. Learning ArcMap is like learning a foreign language. You are expected to create maps every week for homework, and this is how you'll grasp it; by diving in and getting your hands dirty. Kheir is brilliant, well-respected, and cares about his students. Highly recommended.

The course is fairly easy to follow along but popping into TA office hours will really push your grade over the edge and help with weekly assignments. The professor's excitement for the course is pretty infectious even during lecture-heavy classes.

Fantastic dive into ArcGIS. Professor Kheir taught a well structured online class. He cares about the subject matter and students by being interactive in the lectures and answering questions outside of class. TA's also very helpful. Homework and optional readings aided in learning and appropriately challenged me. Technical class but essential.

As we switch to the online format during the pandemic, some professors struggle to convey interest in the course. Professor Al-Kodmany is not one of these professors. He clearly cares very much about not only what he is teaching but also about his students and how we learn. He is funny and engaging, and loves ArcMap. He is a fantastic professor!
The class was really interesting and the whole credit goes to the way Professor Kheir Al-Kodmany.
Lecture attendance mandatory- but he gets you started on the assignments.

I am so lucky to have Kheir as my professor to teach me this course. I learned so much from the UPP557. You will not only learn about spatial design and methods but also the way of thinking. He is the teacher that everyone deserves. I have been in CUPPA for two years, you just can't find a better teacher!

Professor Kheir Al-Kodmany was very helpful, flexible, and patient. He was able to teach the course materials to all students regardless of their field of study. The course was very informative and Professor Al-Kodmany was dynamic and enthusiastic. I was able to use GIS efficiently by following Professor Al-Kodmany instructions.

Kheir is sweet, patient and understanding and will work hard to make you feel really at ease. He will teach you to think beyond passing an exam and Quiz. Rock solid knowledge, engaging, crystal clear, enthusiastic and makes urban planning so interesting! I really want to say thank you here from the bottom of my heart. May God bless him.
Such an outstanding professor! Immensely knowledgeable in urban design, urban planning, and architecture; knows how to transmit that knowledge to his students. Highly recommend!
An amazing professor!
It was an important experience for me!
Great professor. Great lectures. It was a very meaningful class. We learned a lot from his class. I would highly recommend this class. Dont hesitate to take it

Peofessor Kheir, is amazing, he was very helpful and supprtive in many ways. I am generally a shy person, and I don't usually go to professors and ask for help in any way. However, with professor Kheir, he was very supprtive and helpful in an inspirational way. If it wasn't for him I wouldn't make it in the master's program. I owe him my future.
Great professor. Great class

There is only 6 homeworks, one group project, this is class was amazing you get to learn a lot. The best professor I have ever taken in UIC by far for my bacholers & Masters. Totally recommended. Easy A

As a PhD in architecture student, This is absolutely the most valuable and significant criticism and feedback I ever received on my work. It shaped up my desperation and considerably increased its value. I will always be indebted to professor Khair for his caring.

Professor Kheir is very nice and patient. He is the nicest professor I have ever met in CUPPAespecially to international students. It's such a privilege to become his student. I wish him the very best in Chicago.

TERRIBLE. This was a visualization class that was supposed to utilize software such as illustrator, CAD, GIS, + SketchUp to 'visualize' planning and development. We took photos and made power points the entire course. We used the most basic textbook and only used ONE CHAPTER OF IT (Lynch, visualizing the city). Terrible course, terrible instructor.

You will get to learn so much in this class because this professor is always so excited to teach,. You also should like working in groups and talking in front of people. That is the only way how you will survive this class, but it is very easy to get an A if you just show up and are willing to participate.
Amazing energy, always motivated us to push ourselves and get comfortable being uncomfortable. Would 100% reccomend her if you are taking BA420.

she's lowkey not that bad idk what some people here r talking about. she's nice and she's very energetic. she almost teaches "theater" imo but its an easy A. She does however care so much about attendance so choose what time slots u need wisely! she tries to make class fun and homework is pretty decent.
Talks about her self a lot. Doesn't know what she's doing.

Prof. Kimmie is amazing, & BA 420 is truly unlike any other class. I highly recommend her. The course is improv-based, so it pushes you outside your comfort zone. There's weekly homework, but it's manageable in about an hour. Attendance matters; u often leave early, & the textbook is provided. All hw must be done by the end of the semester to pass!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I really love her class. It's definitely not the conventional business class we're used to, and that's great if you want to get out of your comfort zone. I enjoy her teaching style, and the homework and assignments are light but still meaningful.

I'm someone who hates public speaking classes, but I really ended up having fun here. Professor Kimmy creates an environment that's open and accepting for all students, which allows me to be more confident when participating. Some assignments were long, but she occasionally allowed us to leave early to work on the homework.
She is just not fit to teach this class. Just because you know theatre, doesn't mean that you could teach professional development. Didn't learn anything from but her random stories!
She doesn't care about professional development and only talks about herself and what all she has achieved.

Shes more than a professor; she's a mentor, friend, and will treat you like one of her own if you participate and care about the class. This course material is very easy, and she makes it very interactive and enjoyable. Never in my life would I think I'd be so impacted by a course and professor like Kim. If you can take this course with her DO IT

her class was awesome and she made something sound intimidating, fun. There is a lot of homework especially the reading but if you complain about it enough she might give extra points for that specific assignment. if you participate enough her class will be super fun
The class is OK, but participation matters a lot, as well as homework can be time consuming. Prepare everything ahead it should be an easy A.

An amazing professor who knows how to make the class lively and fun. Although if you are shy it may be nerve-racking at first to participate in the activities but the benefits from it all are worth it. The homework was not too difficult, but can be time consuming. So make sure to plan your time wisely. Turn things in early!

My honest opinions with Professor Kimmie Warner. Overall, she is a very nice professor. Her BA 420 class was a class like no other I have had before. It was an engaging class with everyone inside. For a BA class though, it was too much HW on a weekly basis, involving lots of writing and research and reading from a chapter book occasionally.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This porffesor is great, she gets you out of your comfort zone and treats you like an adult. She does have a strike system but if you follow the format instructions, show up to class, and do presentation you will be fine. This class was the easiest out of all of them just do the work and show up and you will receive an A+

She was a terrible teacher, she really loves handing out strikes like it is candy. Always make sure to stare into the camera and never look away, she's watching your every move! She is very unforgiving and very strict with her work especially for a freshman ba100 class. 3 strikes and your removed from the class, Just don't take this class with her.

Her Ba220 class was helpful. The class was really interactive but ultimately helped you prepare for interview questions. It's eight weeks and had little work for it. Homework included recoding interview questions or making a top ten list for interview questions. Final presentation was discussing your takeaway from the class. She's a solid professor

Absolute waste of time and money. She makes you turn in papers at a very strict like without helping or responding to questions. If you mess up a small detail on a paper you get a strike. 4 strikes and she automatically fails you. Not to mention if you have questions she doesn't respond. Do whatever you can to avoid this professor.

Professor Warner is a wonderful instructor and makes a 3 hour class feel like an hour.  I felt like I actually LEARNED something.  She gives great real world advice.  She is the best professor at UIC!
Great professor, this class is about opening up so lectures, group work and ice breakers are 90% of the course. She made an almost 3 hour class feel like 1 hour

Professor Warner is a really good teacher!  You need to show up and turn your homework in on time (just like what the real world expects).  You need to be present in class and cannot phone it in.  She is one of the best professors Ive had.

Very strict on basically everything. Homework has to be turned in 24 hours before class! Will make you drop assignments n stuff to her office. Half the time you just stand and do ice breakers like every other class. Similar to comm but longer and weirder. This class literally tries to teach you how not to b awkward in public.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Life changing class!  So much fun.  She loves what she does and it shows.  She pushes you out of your comfort zone and challenges you to become your best.

I have taken 101, 102, 103, and currently 104, all A's so far. Her expectations are clear from the start. The course is a bit heavy, but it definitely helps you improve your proficiency quickly. There is daily homework, projects, exams, but also extra credit! Prof. Kim is nice and always willing to answer questions. Study actively and you'll be ok!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The course is very poorly designed

If I'm being honest, she's not a bad professor at all, it shows she cares about what she teaches... she takes it really seriously in fact. She can be hard on grading and if you don't come prepared to class she will get annoyed or mad at you. As long as you do your work (which is a lot) and don't slack off, you'll be on her good side.

I wanted to learn Korean so badly, but her classes were always full. It took me a year to get a spot, and I learned so much from her class. It was a lot of work, but I can't express how much I learned from her.

Just a warning for anyone thinking of taking this class: you watch movies on your own time and come to class just to listen to lectures. Even though this is just a gen-ed class, there's two presentations and an entire 5 page essay you have to do, among other things. I feel like I'm in English class all over again...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She's a pretty good professor, she can occasionally be passive aggressive. She's nice overall, and usually understanding. Expect presentations. Unlike other reviews, she was always very attentive to presentations and often asked questions or offered feedback after. Expect papers but easy grading + participation and attendance matters.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment:
I took her for KOR 230- Korean Popular Culture
Like some other reviews, she is very passive-aggressive and does not understand any situations of students. She will call out students. Expect a lot for being an elective course. Had one group presentation and one solo presentation with an essay about it. Otherwise, it's fine.

She is very clear in her expectations. It was a very content heavy class, so I suggest not taking 20 credits like I did while taking this course. There is homework everyday so make sure you study everyday and do the quizlets because those points count a lot towards your final grade. Her exams are open note but are very difficult.

I loved her class. She's very clear with what she expects. In order to be successful, you have to participate and do the homework on time. She's very understanding with deadlines as long as you communicate. Sometimes she can seem mean but she really just wants all her students to be successful. It's fun as long as you put in the work! :)

I like her so much but be aware that she can be rude and very passive aggresive. Sometimes people would ask a question or make a comment and she will give you a passive-aggressive response if she does not agree or thinks you asked or said something dumb. lol she kind of scared me just listening to her w other students. but overall she is great

only take Korean if you're serious about learning. the class moves decently fast and you have to be in class. but if you're genuinely interested in learning the language and are willing to put in the work/do the assignments, then it shouldn't be too bad. make sure to do the homework though because she will cold call in class. learned a lot though!

She's a very good professor, her class is very interesting and informative. She's well-prepared and we have good discussions in class. One movie per week, which is pretty decent. If you watch the movies you'll pass.

Professor Kim's course goes by super fast so if you aren't putting in 100% you will not do well. Although exams are open book/note, make sure you are organized because there is a lot of content on the exams. Be ready to step out of your comfort zone because everyone is forced to participate (everyday). STUDY YOUR VOCAB. She's super friendly & fun!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Be very careful. Very rude professor and will criticize you aggressively when your pronunciation is not up to the standard. And seldom pays attention when students are doing presentations. She puts no effort in grading students's homework as well...

Prof. Hanae is one of the nicest teachers I've ever had. Yes there is a lot of work, but what would you expect, you're learning a new language. Of course there's a lot to learn and she has to teach in a pace that aligns with you finishing the textbook. If you do your work and study, you'll pass. Plus, there's a lot of extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Kim is one of the best teachers here at UIC. Icant wait to take Korean 103. It was a bit fast, but with the book and time available, it madesense. She is open to your suggestions and she made a lot of changes in Korean 101 and Korean 102.  After taking two classes with her, I think I can say that1) Dont expect to come to class and just
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This professor is unnecessarily rude and passive aggressive. She acted bored during students' presentations and would be on her phone. She did not actually care about any of the topics covered in the course and assigned a tedious amount of work for a class she did not care about and would complain about having to grade things.

Her class is fun if you're engaged it's not a class where you just go in and get an A in the korean language class but that's what to expect korean is originally hard she makes it interesting. She's actually one of my favorites at UIC I'm going into the fourth and last year of her korean class and had her in a korean film class which was an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Honestly, there's so much work and it is hard to grasp the material since it's very fast-paced. Hanae has a bit of attitude and doesn't know how to control her facial expression when we pronounce something wrong. You should know the Korean alphabet by week two. And have perfect pronunciation when you come to class.
Worst professor ever. Super rude and clearly doesnt like teaching students
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Ridiculously overworks students even in the midst of a pandemic, as if her students dont have to deal with other issues BECAUSE of this pandemic besides having more time. She is passive aggressive towards students she doesnt like and is overall just a horrible teacher.
She is very patient and a great teacher. The book is the worst though, even she doesn't like it. If you need help do not hesitate to ask her!!

Taken 101 &102 so far. Will take all her classes. Like any language class w/daily hw & pronunciation practice in class, but she grades hw for completion only & doesn't care how well  you speak. Lots of extra credit! For all tests, she lets you do corrections for an additional 1% to your overall grade. Video proj. isn't hard. We all get full points.

She makes learning really fun. Just make sure you do all of your daily assignments and participate in class. The quizzes and exams aren't that hard. A lot of talking in class(pronunciation practice?) and also a group project. All in all it's a really easy and class.
1 group project, quiz, tests, midterm test, and final test. Offers much extra credit opportunities though.

Although this course is largely student-led, Professor Keiso provides useful lectures and is approachable if you have any questions. She is extremely clear on grading criteria, gives feedback on midterm and finals drafts before you submit, and is deeply knowledgeable on class content. If you stay on top of things, then it is super easy to get an A.
The most caring and understanding professor I've ever had at UIC. She's so sweet, and it's impossible to get a bad grade in her class unless you really don't try. I would take any class she offers!

This was an online course that was very easy while interesting, attendance over zoom participation. There were weekly assignments with 2 group projects, mid-term, and final - which were all fairly easy. Take advantage of the draft opportunities as she gives direct feedback of what needs to be fixed exactly. Easy grader and communication between TA.

Such a sweet professor! This class was online, and was very easy to keep up with. Weekly assignments, no exams, and 2 group projects. Grading and due dates are very clear in the syllabus. Great TAs too!

This class is very manageable with other classes. The professor and assistant professor give very clear assignments and due dates. There is a 10 minutes project due at the end of the semester but it's very easy to reach the 10 minute mark based off the requirements. Highly recommend!
Prof tiana was very very caring and nice. Her class is very easy if you just do the work.

Very easy class and interesting for those interested in healthcare. Online meetings with weekly hw assignments, 2 group presentations, and 2 exams (midterm and final). Dr. Kieso is very knowledgeable, caring, and gives great feedback. Thoroughly enjoyed this class and cannot recommend her enough for AHS200!
Great professor, nice, caring, and easy going. You have homework due once a week, two group presentation, and 2 exams. No busy work so this is a great class.
This is a great class and an easy elective. I highly recommend this class to anyone. Very easy and interesting material. 1 assignment a week and group projects and take-home exams
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a very good Prof. with a very kind heart. She really cares about students. I would really recommend taking this prof. for AHS200

Group projects could be cumbersome, the homework involve answering questions that she highlights from articles, and tests are relatively the same business. All you need to do is show up for classes for attendance. Other than that, easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: one of the easiest classes I have ever taken at UIC. It's just weekly reading assignments, discussion posts, PowerPoint presentations, and 2 take-home exams. The class is very boring but super easy. If you need to take a super easy 200 level course, then this is it. NO WAY you can get a B unless you never go to class or you don't do the hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: Great professor. She really works to have students understand the material. Do the homework and attend class and you will get an A.
Dr Kieso was a good professor. She really wants the students to wrap their minds around the concept of integrated health. She does have group projects, but they are manageable. Easy A too.
She's a easy professor, and this is one of the easiest classes at UIC . Just attend class and finish homework you'll get a easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She makes the class interesting by getting outside speakers to talk about real life healthcare stuff. Class material is really easy. There is no textbook or chapters. You are learning from articles( No papers to write). Exams are take home. All you have to do is just show up and do the assignments which are easy.

Prof. Kieso is a really laid back professor. Everything in this class is pretty straight forward. Exams are take home, and there are 2 presentations you do in class. Attendence in mandatory, but you do get 2 excused absenses. Overall, it's a chill and laid back class. Easy A.

The class wasn't challenging in the traditional sense; instead, it made you think critically. The class engages you in interesting conversations, and the professor is genuinely invested in the material. He's very understanding, and being engaged in the class is what makes it enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: all participation grades funny and caring teacher has some pop quizzes though
not a harsh grader, caring for accommodations, funny and engaging, take his class you'll learn something new.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: It was one of the only English classes I actually enjoyed going to. He is very engaged with the students and keeps the class entertaining. He is also very understanding regarding assignments and accommodations, You won't regret his class at all.
One of the best English teachers I had, a very easy grader and a lenient person, attendance was and wasn't mandatory, but I still enjoyed going to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really good professor. First English class I've ever taken where I actually looked forward to attending each lecture. Each lecture was an engaging discussion where he made an effort to challenge your thinking.
Super great teacher. He was very easy going, and understandable with at home situations. Also super flexible. Just take him, its a good time.
just take him you won't regret it

My experience with Professor Bergstrom is pretty disappointing. He doesn't put any of your grades on blackboard therefore you have no explanation of your final grade. He doesn't respond to emails at all and it's also worth noting that he only takes paper copies of every writing assignment.
Very understanding teacher. A lot of readings, but genuinely cares for his students well-being. No tests, but there were a few vocab quizzes and some short papers.

He talks very sophisticatedly so sometimes it's hard to understand what he's talking about. He's not a bad professor but only thing is HE DOES NOT PUT GRADES IN BLACKBOARD, it's currently at the end of the semester and I have nothing in blackboard so I don't know my grade. But I know he's pretty lenient when it comes to deadlines.

class is easy. just make sure to do the papers and you'll be good. you have to schedule a 1v1 meeting with him before you turn in your final paper so make sure to sign up for those quickly as the worst times get left behind
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You must write about 4-5 papers during the semester, & he sends an email later for you to sign up for a 1v1 meeting with him for feedback before you turn it in. He is very passionate about how he instructs. If you need an extension, he is very understanding and gives you one. He is very welcoming to students' opinions on any topic being discussed.

He seems very weird at first but the more time you spend in his class the more you realize he's pretty funny. Sometimes he could go into a monologue or ait for students to respond to him for a while but he's really personable and understanding. Keep up with readings so you can contribute to class/pass vocab tests and it will go smoothly.
Interesting personality. Really good professor though!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Bergstrom was an amazing professor this semester. The assignments were easy. The only thing I had trouble on was the research paper but I ended up getting an A. I thought I did way worse. But he gave us time to turn in any assignments. Probably the easiest class this semester.

Professor Bergstrom was a very understanding teacher. He wants the best for his students and is very lenient with most things. There weren't many papers and only 4 of them were mandatory but pretty easy. I loved his class and he was very helpful. I'm very glad I chose his class.
Professor Kian is very understanding and lenient. Complete every assignment and you should get an A. Responds right away if in need of help.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: He is an amazing professor. The attendance is not mandatory but the lectures are usually fun. Do the homework and you will pass with an A!
He really cares about his students. If you don't do your homework, he will give you some extra time to do them without losing grade.

Kian is honestly hands down one of the professors I have had all semester long and definitely would recommend taking him for any english class he teaches because his classes are soo chill and basically a huge stress relief for me. He really cares about his students and will is very lenient with deadlines so you don't have to worry much about papers

Kian I the best teacher I've had during my stay at UIC. You can tell right off the bat that this man cares about what he does and about his students. He doesn't bother teaching you anything that is useless and envokes interesting questions and discussions.

Kian is hands down the best eng161 teacher at UIC. He does not bother with any pointless grammar or writing lessons and instead gives great talks on real-life issues. His class is very relaxed, he's very understanding, and is willing to help you with anything you need. In terms of writing, easy essay topics, easy A. Take him you'll be glad you did!

Overall, Professor Bergstrom is a so so professor. He postponed every single assignment that was due and lagged behind on grading and putting in grades. Look for PDFs of the book before you buy them. Show up to class and answer his questions and you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I had a great time in his class and he is one of my favorite teachers.

This class in general is difficult. He was such a sweet professor and responded to all of my emails in a timely manner. I had some family issues come up and he was more than accommodating. You just have to put in a lot of work to do well in this class, but I personally didnt have a bad experience with him!

This professor was extremely unprofessional. In his syllabus he said he was going to drop your lowest homework, quiz, and lab grades to which he didnt. He only curved the class for those who failed. He NEVER responded to any emails, regardless of the importance of what was on the email. He tested on content that wasnt suppose to be on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Compared to my high school phys teacher I 100% choose Klie. There's both online and written homework, BUT they really do help to understand the material better. not only that but it's also a good boost for the grade (15%). Teaching-wise he had examples but doesn't really include numbered calculations which makes it confusing since eqns get long.

There are 2 kinds of professors, ones who teach and ones who show. Prof. Klie is the latter. He gives basic info, but throws work at you expecting you to figure it out yourself. Even when i thought i was understanding the material i still got bad grades. Point is not everyone learns the same way. If you're a visual learner: hard pass on him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Bottom line: physics is hard. Klie is a good professor for physics. He outlines the chapter for you but it's ultimately up to YOU to ask questions, do the homework, etc.
Class was very hard, in my opinion he didn't do relevant problems to the homework. The exams where also nothing like what he taught would not take his class again.

I was retaking physics 1 thinking I would get a better grade but I think I may be worse off than my last prof. Dr. Klie has already left the country twice and it is week 5 of school. His lectures are obscure and he kind of just throws the info on the board without much explanation. Also makes math mistakes which leads students to not trust him.
Very clear, linear lecturer. The class was very reasonable. Klie is a good professor.

His english is better than other phys105 profs.He doesnt go over examples you see on the hw,where he only gives you 3 tries.His exams are impossible(30%class avg) but i notice that he puts in hw/quiz examples.My suggestion is to copy all the equations from the book and hw problems on your cheat cheat so you can rack alot of points.BTW, hes hot!!
sorry didnt mean to call him a wack job.. he's a nice guy, but too strict..

If i knew what a wack job he was, I would've taken Bernstein. She teaches it so you could understand it. He derives equations all class long. It gets boring. Plus bernstein doesn't have quizes, Klie does and Bernstein gives u 10 chances to answer a HW questions online, Klie gives u three chances and everytime u get a mistake it lowers hw score.
Very nice guy

My girl Laura is incredible. Very intelligent professor with well organized lectures. Two field trips required for the class but they are pleasant. Lab attendance required and make sure you attend lecture to make life easier for yourself. Exams are online, low stress class, helps to make friends in lab. Didn't use the book but take notes!

Laura was a joy. Her TAs were also amazing , there is a lot to learn from her class. Show up to class once in a while and stay up to date on what is going on. Be ware of her surprise E&Es , they will hurt your grade if you do not do them. DO the extra credit, it is easy and it doesn't hurt even if you have an A.

Easy class. Must attend all the labs. 2 papers, 2 online exams you can do at home. Interesting Lectures. Is clear with what she wants. Makes you interested in anthropology even if its not your major. The papers are based on great topics and she literally gives the format she wants during lecture. gives random quizzes for extra credit during lecture
2 papers and 2 exams, ez.

Pretty easy course. Lots of extra credit as long as you remember to do it (worth 7%). As long as you are there for half the semester you will get attendance credit. Online, open-note exams. Labs are okay. 2 papers (where you go on a trip): Field Museum and Zoo. Teacher is super reasonable and chill (will push back deadlines if necessary).
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: My favorite professor ever by far. Every class was funny and clear and everything was well understood. Thank you Prof. Klein.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER, POINT BLANK! Prof. Klein made me fall in LOVE with logic. I tried to take this course with a TA teaching in during the summer, and it was as if he was speaking a foreign language! Prof. Klein's teaching style is amazing. Within the third week, I could literally do logic with my eyes closed. Overall, I ended up with an A =)

Great professor. He really made philosophy interesting, esp for the science/neuro majors in the class. His lectures are pretty clear so even if you didn't do the reading, topics are understandable. Take notes and do well on the papers, you'll get an A.

This guy makes logical arguments seem like 2+2=4. His in class examples are not only relateable but awesomely hilarious as well. His class has made me want to take more Philosophy classes. Truly one of the most exceptional teachers I've ever had.

This guy is awesome. Loves logic and his enthusiasm for the topic is contagious, even to the most uninterested students. Very clear and designs the class so that if you go to class, faithfully do the homework, then its an easy A. Highly recommended!
For me, his lecture is very helpful. Assignments are important for doing well on the tests. if you can do the homework, the tests are easy ^^

Klein DOES post his lectures online, but he does so AFTER the papers are due, so if you don't go to class, you don't have the notes to write it. The TAs are tough graders, but they're straight-forward with what they want.
a

His lectures are posted online so there isn't much to gain by attending class. Colin's a genuinely nice guy though and even gives you extensions if you're having a hard time with a paper! 75% of the grade comes from the 4 papers(2 short and 2 long) which you MUST work hard on! The TAs are tough graders! Overall, a decent class.

He's great. Even though his lectures are not the most exciting, he's still awesome. He gives good examples that help soo much. And he has his lectures recorded, so the option to go or skip lecture is there.

Klein is an excellent professor; he gives great examples for the readings that relate back to things you can easily understand. He makes philosophy seem simple and easy by the time you're through with this class. He makes jokes all the time too and he's just a really nice guy. I learned a lot.

I really like this guy. I barely went to lecture just because the material is second nature to me, but when I did go he was very clear and interesting. He has a great radio broadcast voice that makes you listen. He's also really intelligent and amiable. He explains things in such a way that everyone can understand. You can't help but like the  guy.
He was a great professor! He kept things interesting and his lectures were actually enjoyable. He even tried to be funny sometimes! :) If you have any interest in Philosophy- take his class.
No Comments
Great Professor!!!

I got a B in her class but if you actually do the homework and read the chapters before class, it's definitely an easy A. The tests aren't too difficult, especially the final. The only problem with the class is the confusion with the names and dynasty
She is an amazing professor! The class was very fun and interesting. You will need to read the book, but the topics covered are very interesting. I loved the class!

This class was very easy. I would skim through the chapter right before we took the quiz and would get a B. The assignments due on Wednesdays are really easy. She gives study guides and if you know everything on those guides you will get an A.  Relatively easy class.

Great professor. Lays out exactly what she wants. Expect to use the book for her quizzes, but if you read they are extremely easy. Exams can be aced by using the power points. Makes the material interesting and offers extra credit. Great class, even better professor!

Professor Klein is a great instructor!! Her quizzes became easier this semester and don't require too much extra thinking. Read the textbook (A MUST), do the extra credit, and the class is an easy A. If you don't like to read then this class is not for you because all your quizzes rely on reading. Her power points are excellent for exams though.

Very nice person, really knowledgeable, but doesn't make this dry material interesting. She makes every dynastic period seem the same. I think it would help if she got more into the culture not just the same boring review of facts for each period. If u just need it 4 the history credit, take a different class. The class is tedious and repeatitive.

There was a significant amount of materials to learn in this class, but it was alright.  She uses Blackboard frequently.  Her exams are very comprehensive and covers a lot of material, but if you attend the review sessions beforehand, you will do great.  All in all, she is a great professor with a great deal of knowledge.
Very cool guy
Very cool dude
Take this teacher now. Thank me later.
This professor made my life easier. He is very knowledgeable, and you can ask him basically anything. He is very funny. Haters, go away!
This professor is my favourite professor and you guys should take him. Haters, back off
I took this professor for my Calc2 course and it was insightful. He spent so much time and effort in assisting, and he is like a library in himself. 100% recommend. HATERS,  BACK OFF!
Great teacher would take again

So good!!!!!!

LOVE IT.
Amazing teacher, learned a lot and was very engaging in different methods to solve mathematical theorems! 10/10!!!
Although I got not the best grade, it is absolutely amazing to get him.
Great teacher
I took a grade 8/9 private tutor lesson from him. Absolutely splendid.
Top-tier teacher.
So good. Look at other professors before you comment please.
Best teacher I have ever seen. You can't find someone better when you know him well. Haters, go away.
Ok DO NOT CHOOSE THIS GUY AS YOUR TEACHER man. I want him fired and and I wanna have a strike against him. He is useless, weird and u organized. All he teacher is random logic !!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Took Math 1120 at Tulane. His lectures are vague and disorganized and if you only go to class you won't get an A nor will you understand the material. However, if you go to office hours, he's great 1 on 1. It did make me understand calc better. DON'T TAKE if you haven't taken calc 1 in high school or are looking to fill your math prereq  .

Took MATH 1210 at Tulane University with Klaff and boy was he a difficult professor. Much of the learning will be needed to be done outside the classroom and he is very disorganized. I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND.

He's a really different type of professor that you'll either love or hate. He's disorganized, doesn't follow the textbook, and I learned more from YouTube than from his lectures. However, having the ability to have discussion periods during the test was beneficial. Overall, this class wasn't the best experience, but it certainly wasn't the worth.

Dr. Klaff is a great instructor and he teaches math through the use of examples, humor, and he actually makes the class exciting! Had him for a summer semester (3.5 hoursday) and there was never a dull moment! His tests were very fair and he expected you to put in effort in order to pass. Great professor!

Worst teacher I have ever had he does not teach anything but rather you go to a white board and work with other students. He also has a favorite group of students that he will spend all class with talking to while neglecting the rest of the class. I wish I could have taken Shulman's class he is a great teacher.

Seriously, everyone complaining about Klaff for 215 completely missed the point of the class! The class is meant to help students transition from memorizing formulas to thinking mathematically. For me, this was precisely what happened. I have a new found understanding of how mathematics is done. Most of these people just didn't want to put in time.

He teaches different than what you are used too. He encourages a lot of group work & has some interesting ways to help you succeed. One example would be making you generate homework problems by working backwards from a solution. Another would be giving you tips for error checking techniques. I agree he is disorganized, though he is a god among men.

If you like a professor who is linear and is all "organized" then take another professor. Klaff was the first professor who had a different teaching style. Its not just attending lecture and take notes. You work with your classmates, you talk and work things through.  The material is sometimes challenging but Klaff would take time to explain.

Be prepared to spend a lot of time in study groups outside of class. Dr. Klaff is not the most organized professor at UIC, but he's no sadist. He threw a lot of material at the class within the last few weeks of the course, but he also spent a ton of time outside of class assisting students in the tutoring center. He's very committed to his class.

I had a very pleasant experience in this class. The lectures keep your interest and the class seems to go by quickly. You work in groups most of the time. Studying with group members helps a lot. We hardly knew our grades going into the final but many of the questions on the final were what we've seen before. I enjoyed having Klaff as a teacher.

One of the worst professors ever! He can't teach at all.  I agree with the comments below who did not like him and fully disagree to those who liked him. You want to know why UIC is known for having low class averages in math? It's all because of professors like him who care more about money than the quality of the students' education.

Klaff is one of the greatest teachers and role models I've had at UIC. He's tough, but you learn a lot in his class. He connects with all his students and is super helpful and guiding you to the answer but still making you figure it out.
He teaching technique is weird but you will changed your mind about math. I like him a lot I used to hate math but he made me love it and want to love it more and more. His class is rock

Extremely unorganized and irresponsible. He has his own opinions about how and what students should learn, and that is what he talked about mostly in lectures. He has no syllabus or a normal expectation of what students can answer after spending most of the time listening to his judgments. He is not a professor who'd guide you through.

really cool guy, friendly, highly social-able. as a professor who needs to teach? not so much. i don't know what he is thinking but if we knew how to prove things already we would not be taking classes to 'learn' them.

Bad professor. He forces you to answer insanely hard questions on the spot. We had to present difficult presentations and a difficult cumulative final exam. Class average has always been failing. No curve. Avoid him or else be sorry. Taking him due to schedule conflict is butt kissing.

Really you have to present proofs instead of being taught? I swear if UIC does not fire Klaff for terrible teaching skills and failing class averages below 40%, then UIC math should be boycotted. Have fun not being prepared for advanced math courses with this sadistic man, who makes UIC look bad.

Take him and you'll be sorry. Anything who says you learn a lot from him are nothing but butt kissers. You never learn anything at his class. The average has always been failing and I studied so hard, so did everyone, yet still failed or got a D. There was no curve and he needs to be fired or punished for worst teaching skills. Avoid him or else.

This guy cannot teach anything at all. He forces us to give up on everything just to study math with other students. He needs to be fired. He, along with Chris Glomski and James Drown, are the reasons why UIC is currently ranked last place.

He doesn't know how to teach. Thanks to this jerk, nobody at UIC wants to be math majors. The class average was failing and he never curves and we begged for a curve. He had a butt kissing TA named Landon who is also sadistic. Please UIC fire Klaff because UIC math is nothing but a joke.

Interesting professor, but he will make you look and think about mathematics and mathematics teaching differently after you finish his class. I really enjoyed the class, but had to put in all my effort to get an A in the class.

With Klaff, you either love him or hate him. I thought he was an amazing instructor who made us rethink our understanding of mathematics. Every time I walked out of class I had questions and wanted to find out more about math!! Made me love math even more!! He is unorganized and eccentric, but his passion for teaching makes up for it.

His method in teaching is very unclear. It is hard to keep up with what he is teaching in class. Also, he doesn't follow the syllabus at all. He will change it if necessary. He is a nice person for sure, but his teaching style is not for me.
I have to tell you, his class is REALLY HARD. Please respect him because he is a really nice professor. I worked really hard to get an A.

Dr klaff is a mad man.Its seems like he has no direction. but i have to say there is a method to his madness. He is one of the best teachers at UIC. His class requires A LOT of work and there is no curve.  I would recommend taking this class if you are planning to take higher level math classes . Do not take him if you are working on a math minor:)

I really did not like Professor Klaff's method of instruction. For 215, you do EVERYTHING on your on own or with a group. Time is wasted away in class presenting the proofs when we could be learning. He is nice and helpful, but he makes the class unnecessarily hard. You learn a lot, but it is mostly with your peers. He is alright.

Klaff was my professor for my first math class at UIC back in Fall 2008. I was ready and willing to learn but the way he taught was so unclear. He would occasionally provide examples, but if the example was supposed to take 8 steps to finish, he would do it in one or two. It was impossible to keep up in the lecture and the discussion didn't help either. I studied so much for each exam and still did poorly. At the end of the semester, at least 1/2 to 2/3 of the class failed. Poor teaching skills.

As a person, LOVE Klaff. As a teacher, he's tough. He's very funny and easy to get along with and approach for help. This class is DIFFICULT though, and Klaff will challenge you a LOT. But I think you emerge as a better student if you get through this class. As long as you attend regularly and participate, you can't fail. Seriously.

First couple weeks were pretty scary because he gives out so much information and there is no other reference except for his notes. Yet, after taking this class with him I found it interesting and full of sense. I also liked the thing that he cares for his students. I recommend taking this class with Pr. Klaff. There are much more opportunities.

Klaff is a nice and funny guy, but I did not like his teaching style. He doesn't use the book, and doesn't even give out a syllabus. The problems on the midterms are not what we work on class at all, and expects everyone to devote all their time outside of class to work on problems with other students. Not highly recommended.
hes great, easy to understand and explains what he does perfectly. he is also pretty funny.

Dr. Klaff is one of a kind.  He cares about his students and puts a lot of effort into teaching his students. He's the nicest guy and very funny. Ask for help and you shall recieve! Explains everything he expects from you. Tests are material you go over in class. He tells you what to expect on the exams. Ppl who dont like him barely put any effort.
Very knowledgeable on math topics, but that did not translate into being an effective professor. I personally will not take another class with him.

I thought this would be the worst math class I'd have to take thus far but it was actually my best.  Klaff is an amazing prof, really helpful and he has a good personality.  This class was difficult but good preparation for future math.  I hope he teaches higher level math classes.

Compared to other prof., this professor def. makes you work for the grade.  Dont expect an easy A without putting in some effort.  He's VERY helpful, smart, VERY CLEAR, has great sense of humor, the best of the best. If u want to understand what youre learning rather than getting an easy A u dont deserve, take KLAFF.  He will prepare u very well!

I was terrified of taking this class but I think I lucked out having Klaff as a prof.  He was enthusiastic, helpful and made this class really enjoyable.  With response to the person below, this class needs to be abstract and difficult in order to prepare you for future math courses.  He was crystal clear with what was on the exam.  EXCELLENT!!

Klaff gave the class zero structure, he never made his expectations clear, he yells at his students when hes in a bad mood (once a week), not helpful during office hours (off on tangents and weird analogies) and makes class more difficult and abstract then it ever needed to be. Do yourself a favor and take it with Kauffman and stay away from Klaff

I think anyone should consider themselves lucky to come across a teacher like Professor Klaff. His enthusiasm and analogies for the course are unmatched. If you find this course hard - that's because it is. You are writing proofs not half truths - what did you expect? Highly recommended.

I came into this class thinking proofs were going to be the death of me.  I love this teacher.  He is always willing to help whenever you need.  You have to be willing to put in some work tho.  It's not too easy.  HE IS HILARIOUS!! class is never boring. As hard as the class is, I am happy he's our teacher.  THE BEST!!

The most ridiculous teacher ever.  You get 'short' quizzes MWF which are all 1 point.  and 'long' quizzes every thurs(4 points)  Binary grading system for short quizzes meaning all or nothing deal. Expects your answers to be PERFECT. even thought they are 1 point, they stack up.  Tests are decent. Memorize theories, word for word! for short quizes.

I don't like him. I don't like the fact that he prejudges everyone as a slacker and devises his own study schedule for us to follow (daily quizzes). According to him, I am a slacker, so I dropped his class and switched to another professor and I got an A. Klaff, some of us have different studying styles than yours, that doesn't make us slackers.

This man is amazing......He makes this class so fun...I like him alot and will miss him..I hated calculus but he made it so fun and I actually like it.....HIGHLY RECOMMEND him.....great super amazing teacher....he has a great personality and he is a great person overall. He prepares his students really well.....
He really know his stuff but if youre not ready to put in many hours for his course, dont take it. He doesnt like slackers and is hard core.

This professor is one of the best professors I've ever had. He teaches the material extremely well and articulates well. He is the only teacher with sense also. He gave questions that were things he cover extensively or was important. He also lightened up on us near the end because he knew we had final projects and other tests. A very fair teacher

I would recommend professor Klaff if you like a challenge. His class forces you to read the math book instead of just doing problems (i know how could you read a math book) His short quizzes come right out of the book and long quizzes keep you on top of things. I loved going to his class. The only that got me was the grading: All or nothing. so try

He's a very demanding professor, he expects you to be well prepared for every class(gives daily quizzes) but is AMAZING at explaining everything and really knows what he's doing( one of those rare people who can both do and teach). He's also very dynamic and fun/funny. loved his class!

He is such a funny guy and makes calculus fun...The tests are made by the department....He does give hard quizzes....There is a short quiz everyday when you go to lecture...but this helps for you to stay on top of things....I hated calculus so much and I was ready to withdraw but I stayed in and I'm so happy I did ... now for some reason its easy .
Stop reviewing yourself, Klaff ... You're not fooling anyone.  No one talks like that in your class except you.

By far the greatest math teacher I've ever had. He wastes absolutely no time in lecture giving 110% effort to teach the course. His explanations are concise and his advice is incredible. Be advised! If you don't truly KNOW mathematics...stay away from this course. His teaching style is for students who truly care about their education and future.

Absolutely amazing professor.  he definitely knows his stuff, and loves to take extra time out to help anyone in need.  very understanding and a great professor overall, both in quality and depth, and ability to help his students out with problems.  If you actually want to learn, take his class!

Greatest mathematics professor I've had at UIC to date. I understand why others would consider this a hard course, especially because most people need it as a requirement and aren't good at math....His analogies are dead on, his advice is excellent, and his teaching style may come off as "random" but I absolutely adore his integrity for learning.

This guy's waay too strict.  Really? ASSIGNED SEATS?  Memorizing theorems word-for-word?  etc... No thanks.  Take Marian, Kobotis, Cohen instead ... Those guys are way better professors than this guy.  I took his lecture based on time schedule, but I'll gladly take another class off my time schedule to get someone who understands how to teach.

Business Calculus has so far been the HARDEST class I have taken at UIC and I am a Pharmacy major!Despina (one of the TAs)was late EVERY single time with 15min.The professor goes WAY too fast and does not check hw even though he assigns it.If u dont do the hw, practice,and do the special assignments u will fail.I went tutoring a lot & still failed!

He's a nice guy, but he doesn't work effectively as a teacher. He never uses a projector in a big lecture class, his writing is too small and the eraser leaves smudge marks. He assigns homework online, and unless you go to his website your in trouble. If your in his class you should just get the book and answers boo and teach yourself. Or trouble.

He knows what he is talking about, but I found the class difficult because he explains a lot about the theory behind the math instead of doing more examples. I am a person who learns better by seeing examples, instead he would spend all class period talking about theory and only did 1 or 2 examples..Depends on how you learn I guess...
Very good professor. Very reasonable. If you have questions, go to him. He explains everything very well.

his explanations are very clear, and in detail. the way he articulate proofs and examples he provides are fascinating and interesting. his tests aren't easy, but it is doable if you study, do homework, and go to class. he is not very sociable kind of teacher, but his teaching and lecture sessions are invaluable in excelling in exams.

I've had him three times and have had to drop his course once. He's pretty straightfoward and fair on exams and grading (undergrad or grad). Grades exams right away in full detail. Just make sure your mathematical maturity level is good and don't overdo your schedule.

Professor Knessl is extremely smart. He will lecture straight from the textbook, show you the proofs, and do minimal examples. He wants you to succeed in his class but expects you to work hard (very hard). Take him if you want to learn, but be prepared to study!

He is one of the worst professor I had at UIC.His lectures don't help at all,they just confuse you.Doesn't post any HW or practice problems but his quizzes are fair if you study.I actually regret taking his class.

Don't expect to learn anything from his lectures; he follows the book word for word. All you need to do for this course (diffEQ) is to learn how to solve examples (from book or other sources) and go to the TA with questions (don't just say "I don't understand; teach me.") And never mind all the proofs he goes through in class unless ur a math major

Professor Knessl is definitely one of the best instructors I have ever had. I took four courses and an independent study with him and got an A in all of them. He is awesome and I have not only learned mathematics from him but also how to teach.

He is not as bad as people make him out to be. If you had an easy time with Cal 1 and 2, then you should be just fine. If he also asks a question in class, if your going to answer make sure your correct because he has a tendency to give you an annoyed look.
Just a really great guy.  Everything done in this class is very easy and he is very understandable.  Definitely take his class.
Quizzes are noticeably easy once you have studied with the textbook. If you just read the textbook and do homework, then you'll be fine...as to all math classes.
Good teacher if you sit in front, further than 4 rows back though you're not going to hear a word the man says.

Really bad teacher. Whatever he says is only comprehensible to him and to the few kids who are sitting in the first 2 rows and have previously read the book. Tough grader on exams and exams are kinda difficult. Can ditch class but have to study for the quizzes. Make sure you go to Discussion, thats where u learn everything u need to know.

You must be willing to work very hard in his courses.  If you do so, you will learn a lot and do well.  He goes fast and expects you to keep up.  His presentation style at the blackboard is a bit messy, but he does a great job of communicating the main ideas, so pay attention and go to class.  If you want to learn mathematics, take this professor.
Challenging material in a straitforward way.  Explains subtlety of notation, other details well.  Exams are reasonable.
No Comments

The powerpoints are extremely long and over-loaded with information, its very difficult to make sense of what she wants you to know for exams! I attended every class and ended up having to late-drop because I was petrified about getting a "C." Homework and essays are easy, other than that AVOID AT ALL COSTS! (FROM A DEAN'S LISTED STUDENT!!)

She's not as bad as some people said. Her stories/examples really help you remember some of the material for the exam. The only bad thing about the class is that lecture is 90 mins long, which can be somewhat boring. This class is fun and interesting. Don't take it if you're really lazy, becuz there's a moderate amount of work that can't be BSed

The class is really easy. I went may be like 20 times out of the whole semester. her stories can be a little random since her time is much different than our. you can fail the first midterm and still get an A since one exam is drop.One advice i can give you is before the final go see your TA!!! the final is the previous exam just mixed up!!!
Awesome teacher
She's a very nice lady, who has many stories in her book to tell. It was a fun class. I missed my A by few points, but you can get an A if you complete homework on time.
She clearly has a ton of knowledge and experience in the field.  I found the lectures to be fairly engaging-- a more relatable version of the text.

Her exams are right out of her lecture notes, if you attend the lectures, take good notes and go over them, you are garneted to get an A or a B.  The homework?s are also easy, if submit it on time and write the whole 2 pages, you will get full points.  There are two papers, which are graded leniently.  Over all I liked this professor a lot, would h
Sometimes she does not go over material that IS on the exam and she expects you too have "enough common sense" to figure out the correct answer...
considering this prof always goes off topic, I'm not surprised the class avg was a low C.. the ta, justyna is a moron who will not help with anything.
No Comments

Ok--she is NOT a good lecturer. You really don't have to buy the book either cuz her lecture notes are like a book. She puts so much stuff on there... if yiou go to class and read your notes you should be ok but be on top of really learning the material yourself. She reads of her slides so don't think that going to lecture is enough.
Her power point slides are really long but overall she is a  great/nice prof who really knows her stuff. Great class!
I would definitely recommend professor Knight, GEOG100 was a very easy A, as long as you took notes during lecture and read the lecture slides you would be guaranteed an A.

professor Knight was a nice and good professor. He cares about his students and wants them to do good. I wouldn't call this class an easy A, but if you do your work on time you'll be guaranteed to get an A

He's a nice guy. The course, in general, is tough for a 100 level course. He tends to mumble a lot which makes it hard to hear him at times even if you're in the front row. He can be very vague at times, just a confusing course overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy
