I needed to get an A in this class and even though I never got an A on any of the tests I still received an A in class. The class includes 2 tests, project and quizzes and in-class assignments. It can get overwhelming but if you attend class you will get an easy A

She's a great professor. Her lectures are very effective. She's also very lenient in her grading. The exams can get tricky. If you study smart for this class, then you have a better chance of acing it. The only thing I disliked was the group project. Don't recruit any slackers in the group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Her lectures are very helpful, and she'll take the time to really explain things in depth if you need it. Tests aren't too difficult if you study. There are quizzes but she lets you use your notes and offers extra credit. Great professor!

Professor Martin is by far the best Professor I've had at UIC. Her lectures are crucial to doing well, she breaks things down completely and makes things super easier to understand. 75% of your grade is based on two exams and the final project (very intensive and difficult) BUT it's an extremely enriching course. She is fabulous!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: All you have to do it watch everything he provides each week, do the discussions, and a few exams and you have an A. Great teacher, and he has one of the most informational online courses I have ever seen. I have not seen a professor have such an education online course before, you can tell he likes teaching.

Amazing professor! Best class I have ever taken at UIC. Prof really cares about his students, has amazing discussions and lectures, and is super accessible outside of class too. Really interesting material, and does his best to be inclusive and cognizant of the current political atmosphere as well. Synchronous classes but honestly was the best.
He is an amazing proffesor who is genuinly invested in the success of his students and has great passion for his crafta 10/10 honestly you won regret taking class with him

Prof. Siciliano is absolutely AMAZING! TAKE HIM IF YOU HAVE THE CHANCE. He is extremely well informed on the subject and his lectures are based off of the book, but he also incorporates every day issues. He also holds open discussions on current events and is open to different opinions and loves to hear what students have to say about issues.

Professor Siciliano is a smart person. He is always willing to help you work through all of your assignment, i.e. policy memo, Cost-Benefit Analysis paper, final policy paper. Participation in class is highly encouraged as it may affect your final grade.

Professor Roitman makes PSCH 262 easy and fun to understand with the way he engages with the class and makes it easy to understand the material. Attendance not required, but you should go you get extra credit for it and easier to understand the material. Take this class with him amazing professor and interesting class.

Professor Roitman was funny and gave really informed lectures. Attendance is not mandatory, but I recommend going if you want to succeed. He makes class interesting. The exams are hard, but he curves, and if you use the study guide powerpoint he gives, you'll be good.
Best professor ever! he cares about his students a lot! attendance was extra credit and he made all the lectures and slides accessible to students.

Lectures were all available online if you couldn't make it to class. Class sessions were great, and Prof Roitman is extremely knowledgeable and down to earth. He definitely gives you all the tools you'll need to succeed in the class easily. His study guides are thorough, and the tests were not super difficult

Best professor ever! Most interesting lectures I have ever attended, and his online videos are also very helpful when looking back at the material. He always has some jokes up his sleeve and is very engaging with students. His exams 100% match his lectures, and studying for this course was actually very fun. Attendance is also extra credit!

Hands down the best professor I've ever had. I love this class. Dr Roitman explains the material clearly and goes through it a few times so you can fully grasp it. The lectures are great/easy to follow (recordings are posted beforehand), the exams are fair, and he gives extra credit for every class you attend! Take this class, you won't regret it!

Great professor! Attendance is optional, but you can earn up to 20 points of extra credit (1 point per class attended), & they help a lot. Just watch all the online lectures and take notes on the greatest hits slides he shares, and you'll be fine! Don't get lazy and skip the pre-recorded lectures, and you'll enjoy a very fun and easy class overall

This professor is awesome! He's provides very detailed examples of the content and explaining in a more understandable way. He's funny and sometimes brings in guest to show us a live demonstration.Exams are semi-difficult but it is curved by a lot. After a while people stop attending lectures and it makes me feel bad:( He's a good professor!
best teacher/class ever
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: fav professor ever
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great lectures. Content wise class is hard unless you are really interested in biopsychology. Start studying early. He gives 20 pts of extra credit for coming to class, you should use all of them because class gets hard as the semester proceeds. Make sure to start off on a good note or it will be hard to pick yourself back up. Great, funny guy
Really great professor, which others could be like him. He uploads all lectures ahead of time so you can watch them and learn better, I think that is one of the best things about his class.

Easily my favorite UIC psychology class. Dr. Roitman is organized, engaging, and extremely generous throughout the course. Attending class is 1pt extra credit for up to 20pts. He posts prerecorded lectures & reviews the important stuff in class (go to class! It helps!). Exams were a walk in the park IMO. Few assignments, so your grade is exam-based
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall good professor and gave extra credit everyday you went to lecture but the test were very hard and the study guide didn't really help.

What an amazing professor. Everyday that you show up you receive an extra credit point. He posts lectures and slides, and the tests are very easy if you watch the posted lectures. There is one informal essay due at the end of the semester that is very easy. I appreciate his dad jokes. I wish I could take every psych course at UIC with him.

A great professor that do really well in teaching. His lecture is fun and open to questions and ideas, there would be jokes and fun/interesting videos in the class. No Homework, exams are great that if you study you get an A.

The professor is alright, but the exam-only format of 262 is challenging. Bad test takers should avoid it. Despite curve and extra credit for selfies, I struggled. Information overload in class made it hard to keep up. "Don't sweat the details" when you hear that you should be trembling.

He is very funny and does his best to keep his lectures engaging. His lectures are easy to follow and he makes the slides very easy to study from. He also goes over the stuff he needs you to remember for the exams. The course fully depends on the exam grades and it is tricky but as long as you use the extra credit opportunities, you should be good!
The content is not easy and the tests are hard. Reach out for help if you need but keep in mind that there is  a lot to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Roitman is sooo amazing. The content in class can become challenging but he is so good at explaining and making sure you understand and are following. I did so great first half of the semester because of him. He also does some pretty interesting demonstrations in option lecture extra credit. I recommend him for this class!

Roitmain is such an amazing professor. Considering the class content can be challenging at times, he is very good at explaining and prepares you well for the exams. Attendance is optional and gives extra credit for it. I recommend him for anyone choosing an easy/interesting gened. He is very passionate and very helpful for anyone who has a question

Hands down one of the best professors at UIC. His lectures are not long and boring but instead very engaging and fun. This class is what you make of it. You definitely have to study and WATCH THE LECTURES ONLINE. The exams are pretty straight forward. Plus, the class is curved based on the average grade of the class as a whole.

Dr. Roitman TAUGHT this semester very well. His exams were fair and the fact he provided extra credit for just showing up to class is very generous. I would take his class again and again and AGAIN. I will miss him and his inquiry about 'any questions, comments, concerns, criticisms' during class. 

- Signing off a fellow PSCH262er-----

During exams, Prof Roitman is expecting you to remeber every single word that he teached you during class, meaning that exams are very heavy and not open notes. He offers extra credit, you have to take one selfie during his class and send it to his mail and he will give you only one point.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor, the definition of a dad. He is super engaging. 4 exams are tricky if you don't watch his recorded lectures. Offered 20 extra credit points for attending 20 of his discussions. He does curve exams if the average is low. But he will not discuss your final grade, "you get what you work for" is his mentality.

Professor Roitman is awesome at giving lectures. They were interesting and overall explained concepts clearly and made them easy to understand. Assignments were easy if you paid attention to the lectures.

Professor Roitman is great. His lectures online and in-person made understanding the material so much easier. As long as you pay attention to his lectures the exams are pretty straightforward. His lectures are also pretty fun.
Really easy going and especially during the pandemic, there was no struggle in this class. Super cool. Would recommend

Roitman was by far my most favorite professor in college so far. Initially, I was dreading this course because I struggle with science and this is a very science-based course (behavioral neuroscience). However, Roitman made the subject very understandable and had a very consistent assignment schedule.

Super cool guy and it wasnt assignment heavy. He let us do open note exams which helped a lot. Overall a great professor. Weekly quizzes, exams, and a couple of check ins are what makes up your grade. Quizzes are only 5 questions and open note as well

Professor Roitman was truly great! I liked his lectures because I found them interesting and he makes the information very easy to understand, just make sure you watch and understand the lectures and you will be fine. He doesn't give out a lot of assignments, just quizzes and exams/a final paper.

Class is straightforward (5 mc quiz every week, 3-4 written response tests; both match lectures exactly + open notes); Dr. Roitman posts both lecture ppt and live recordings. If youre not confident in your bio (this is a bio + psych course), dont worry, because Dr. Roitman simplifies and repeats concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: dr. Roitman was absolutely great! He made everything very easy to understand and always added dry humor to make the lecture a tad bit more exciting.

Prof. Roitman is seriously one of the best professor you will ever have at UIC! He is very understanding and extremely passionate about what he teaches. I was scared to take this class because of the rumors of it being hard, but he seriously helps you understand. His grading is fair (no tricks) and straight forward. I highly recommend!!
This is an average professor. Cares about students to a certain extent. Quizzes very week, and none are dropped. No extra credit. Essay exams without clear instructions on what they want or expect.

One of the BEST psych teachers I've had at UIC. I was super worried about taking this class because I'm not great with the other sciences but he made it really easy. There was a book but I never looked at it. Attendance is not required, but I went and I think that is how I got away with not opening the book. Gives great SG and there is one paper

Dr. Roitman is by far the greatest professor I have had. I took this class in order that I could declare as a neuroscience major and Dr. Roitman ignited my passion for neuroscience even more with the way he teaches the class. The exams are super simple if you pay attention. When he says the "take home message" KNOW THAT. Amazing professor
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Extremely incompetent and unapproachable if you have questions for him after class. He is monotone, and if you ever have trouble falling alseep just listen to your classmates voice memo because he does not lecture capture. He likes to kick students when they're down. If he is the only option just wait until next semester, it is not worth it.
I really look forward to his class since he makes the class SO interesting! Never a boring moment in the class. BEST PSYCHOLOGY PROFESSOR!

Hes such a chill professor. He enjoys what he teaches and it can be seen through his lectures. Hes engaging with students and makes class fun. Roitman tells us exactly whats to be expected on the exams and gives us the materials to succeed, no tricks

Professor Roitman is the BEST psychology professor I've taken. He is very good at teaching all the hard concepts & making them very easy to understand. He is also extremely fair on what he tests us on. Exams are pretty much from the powerpoints.  There is a paper in the end. He's very caring as well and always makes time for his students, nice guy!

Dr. Roitman is the best Psychology professor I've had at UIC! The class may seem overwhelming, but he tries his best to make it simple fore everyone. He clarifies hard material in lecture and is willing to answer any questions. To get an A in this class, come to class and write notes. Whenever he says "the take home message here..." expect that to be on the exam. I got 98% on first exam and 100% on second just by going over notes and PowerPoint slides and I'm an average student. He is hilarious too. Definitely take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Hilarious--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great professor who cares about the topic and is ready to teach with clarity and passion. He makes an interesting subject even more interesting and is respectful of students time during lecture. I think to get the best grade you need to come to class, as questions and study for the exams.

He's a good professor, he knows his material, just show up to lecture and you'll can an A. The class itself is not difficult, as long as you attend lecture you will pass. You do not even need the book.

By far one of my favorite professors at UIC! Great teacher that is always giving off positive vibes and makes lecture as interesting as he can. Go to class and study his lectures and you will fly through this course with an A. Don't hesitate to ask him for help he is a great help if you want it. Definitely taking his lab!
He is very helpful and clear. Information is hard and exams are tough. If you work hard, go to class, take notes then you will do good! Learned a lot!

His class was great! This class has a lot of material that are covered on the exams, but he will explain it with real world experiences and show you videos to show what the content is about to clarify. As long as you study the material you'll be fine. He's a great professor! loved him, he made lectures fun and interesting :)

Dr. Roitman is an amazing professor! This is my first semester at UIC and he definitely made it a memorable one. His lectures are very interesting and he goes out of his way to make sure no one is lost at any point. He's also very funny and nice, I highly recommend him!

He is one of those professors that take the time to actually help the students in understanding the material. And that is really important because the material is not simple. He provides plenty of examples and will repeat the things that appear on the exam. Highly recommend this professor for this class.

THE BEST TEACHER EVER! HARD CLASS BUT WORTH IT AND FUN IF YOU PAY ATTENTION, TRY YOUR BEST, STUDY AND COME TO CLASS. TEACHER IS EXTREMELY NICE AND APPROACHABLE. PEOPLE WHO THOUGHT OTHERWISE PROBABLY NEVER CAME TO CLASS.
He is a great, down to earth professor. By no means is this class an easy A, you need to show up and study. His exams are not tricky, in some questions he even spoon feeds you the answer.
Very difficult exams, trick questions. Lectures are great and he is funny and entertaining, but if you take him prepare for a hit to your gpa.

One of my favorite classes. He's an awesome teacher and teaches the subject really well. Sometimes it can get boring because he keeps explaining things over and over and over again, but if you come to class and pay attention you should have no problem getting B. I barely study and am getting an A.

Wow. Best teacher ever. So clear and helpful. One of the best teachers at UIC. I hope he stays and spreads his awesome and fun way of teaching to many more students at UIC. People who didn't like his class probably never came and don't like the subject itself. He made this hard subject so easy and fun to understand. Thank you Mr. Roitman!

He is a great professor! Definitely one of the best at UIC! The material is very interesting and the way he explains it makes it even much more interesting! I always enjoyed going to this class! He is very funny as well!
BORING, dry, impossible to pay attention
My favorite professor. He clarifies his powerpoints so well and always summarizes to make understanding easy for you. He's so chill, and is hilarious. He reminds me of Adam Sandler.

Loved him! He's a great professor and knows what he is talking about. It's worth going to class, because powerpoints alone may not help and the book is too tedious to read. Curves grades. Only negative thing is that he says umm a lot but still is an awesome professor.
Great teacher.. he is alweays willing to answer you questions even at 8am clas he is up beat.. i also ahd him for 363 and he was graet there too. Overall i highly recommend him.

Great professor!! Love his lecture slides (most of them had very funny pictures and videos) and loved the course. Just study the slides and you will be fine. Only cons about this class was that your entire grade is ONLY based on 4 exams, the class is always at 8am, and that he says "uh" A LOT during his lectures lol. Nonetheless, awesome professor.
hes a great teacher but the material he teaches is pretty difficult. he cares alot about the students and encourages them to go for extra help if needed.
SIMPLY AWESOME! I would definitely recommend him!

Nice guy. Lectures are a bit dull, but he tries his best to make it interesting with clips and cartoons. Very straightforward. Just 4 scantron exams, mostly from the lecture notes. It's a lot of material, but if you go over the notes, you should be fine. Grades on a curve. They are posted to Blackboard immediately.
Great prof.  Too bad he only teaches half the course.  Like the other rating says, he cares about individual students.  I guess the cynicism that gets to professors has yet to hit him yet.

He explains things very well, and presents the material in a variety of ways. He cares about each individual student and will go out of his way to discuss any questions about behavioral neuroscience or any current research in the field. He is friendly and can relate well to the students. I would highly recommend him!!

Hard class but great professor. He made lectures easy enough to follow and posted his notes, hw solutions, and quiz solutions on Blackboard every week. Exams are pretty difficult but manageable with enough studying.
Good professor; gave extra credit opportunities, though he had tough exams.
The lectures are easy to follow and he explains the topics and concept with additional details to provide industry vision for students.

I took ECE 545, and it was a very interesting course where I learned a lot of technical material relevant to my research. Prof. is always willing to help and guide. Also, the exams were practical examples that gave you insight into what is happening in the industry.

I took this ECE545 course and it was very helpful, informative and interesting. It has group project, which is very interesting and lot to learn. I would definitely recommend this course. Professor is very supportive and knowledgeable.
He was a great professor. It was very useful.
He is very knowledgeable and supportive. Listen to his lecture carefully and do the given homework yourself to succeed in this course.

Great professor, lots of examples and man real life applications. The lectures by the professor is great, learned a lot and will take other courses offered by the professor. So far the best professor I had at UIC.

Great lectures and lots of examples in class! Following the lecture notes will be the best source for exams and quizzes! He is a great professor with lots of knowledge in circuits and electrical engineering.

All tests and quizzes are open book/note but still tough. Homework had problems not covered in lecture and could take 3+ hours. Grading scale isn't clear, everything's out of 100 on Blackboard, so you must calculate your own grade. Don't rely only on your notes, learn the material.

Did lots of examples to show many different circuits and the different techniques to analyze them. Exams were open book and he even allowed you to have electronic notes pulled up during the exams. A lot of people took advantage of this by not actually learning anything and then struggled in the next class, ECE 340.
He is a great professor with a lot of knowledge on power electronics, PV systems and control. I have learned a lot and published my course project in an IEEE conference.
A lot's and a lot's of Homework and Quizzes. Very demanding. But you will learn a lot at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He records his lectures, I highly recommended that you back to them because they give you more insight of the topics he covers throughout the semester. More importantly always do the study guide and review your notes every night, this will become helpful for when you have to take the exams.

Amazing Professor! His lectures are summarizing difficult topics into an easy (and fun) to understand manner. Encourages questions, even if they go a little off topic he will answer with respect to time. Lets you know class standing after every exam, and exams are always relevant to the study guides. Do your part to study and you'll enjoy the class

It's not an easy class to take if he's your teacher. Hes very engaging and tries to simplify big topics to the best of his ability while still remaining in a university manner --keep in mind he has a PhD, so you know how those professors are. Attendance isn't mandatory but he gives extra-credit every class to help students' grades. Would take again

best prof ever! i am most def taking lab for this class bc he teaches it ! class may be hard, but stay on top of the material/use his study guide to study exams you should be good! i have a hard time focusing, but hes really engaging and funny! his slides dont include everything you need to know, so go to class and take notes or watch recordings!

if you show up, study, and reach out to the TA/ professor you will be fine. you must show up to class to earn points, however after a certain point they become extra credit and you can earn up to 15 extra points. yes, he is lecture heavy but they are entertaining and he has a good personality. they are recorded so you can go back and rewatch.

This professor was very hard and just not worth it. The grade is literally based on exams, so if you struggle with exam taking, don't take him. He grades off of attendance, 3 exams (50 points), and the final exam (75). NGL if you like ur GPA don't take him. I paid attention each lecture and still got okayish grades on the exam,Q's didn't make sense

Difficult class, especially if you are coming in from a psych background and not a bio/medical background. There's little out of class work/reading, but most of the grade is determined by large exams, which can be difficult. He is a good teacher, my main issue is that the exams often feel extremely in-depth when the lectures do not go as deep
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Funny, respectable, understanding, and chill with final grade curves. He gets to know everyone's name in class and is always cracking jokes. The class has lots of research paper writing, grading was a bit tough imo, but go to office hours and he will be able to help. Overall great professor, if you're looking to take a psych lab he's the prof.

I really enjoyed this class. Definitely make sure to study for the exams using the study guides he provides and definitely attend class. Not an easy class, but one of my favorite classes at UIC. The content is really interesting and you can tell he really enjoys it. Would definitely recommend him. I learned a TON.

He is such an amazing and fun professor! Has a great sense of humor! very passionate about what he teaches, extremely knowledgeable! His classes are NEVER boring! the lectures are heavy so pay attention, the exams are not that hard. He always gives Study guides. Study well and pay attention and you will be good. He loves Tiramisu a lot lol

He is a great professor! He is really passionate about what he teaches. Class is very lecture heavy, all exams are based on lectures and slides. Everything is recorded though, so if you just study 3 days in advance you'll be fine. No homework, some small in class assignments. Attendance not really required, but he does clickers so I recommend going

Professor Ragozzino is extremely lecture heavy, however, his tests are mainly on the lecture and he mostly just reads off the slides during lecture BUT the tests are challenging. He curves every exam. I didn't mind him at all, some people seem to mind him but I think if you put time in and study material presented to you you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing human being. I wish I could take him for every single class. Dr. Ragozzino is a very fair, clear, and straightforward professor. Take him if you ever have a chance, hell bless your semester!

Dr. Ragozzino is an amazing professor at UIC. I enjoyed every lecture of this class. This class is not an easy one, but, if you pay attention to what he's saying, you'll do well. In fact, if you sit in the front and listen, you'll find that he is very genuine, and passionate about what he teaches. He's also very funny & sweet! Take him if you can.

Ragozzino was a great teacher who consolidated info that would have been hard to learn on your own. Tests can be challenging but they are curved. One paper, 3 pages, not too bad. Go to class because he says info that isnt on the PPs and also you will learn better. Overall a good class and i would take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Makes a dense subject manageable. It seems like a lot of information to study and may scare you to wonder how difficult the exams may be, but the exams were surprisingly not bad at all! And he curves so that brought my C exam grades up to A's!  Easy 3-page paper. Although attendance is not required he will have random assignments in lecture.

Ragozzino was alright. I wouldn't say he was my best professor I've had, but definitely not the worst. He's sometimes funny, but I mostly dozed off in his lectures. His tests are something you should really prepare for, especially because the final is cumulative, but he does average out the grades. He pulls a lot of his lectures out from the book
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed his class and learned a lot of cool facts from him. He does speak in a low voice so be sure to sit in the front. Some of his test questions are kind of random but if you skim the book you'll get them.  Don't rely on the fact that there is no set grading scale or the curve for a good grade, just go to class and do your best.
Talks in a low voice, very detailed lectures, unfair exams, curving is unfair too compared to class averages on exams. avoid.

Dr. Ragozzino's lectures were very detailed and interesting.  The class is definitely an easy A if you show up for lectures, do assignments (there aren't many), and just look over your lecture slides.

you should go to class, but attendance is NOT mandatory. I went to class the first few weeks, but as the semester progressed I got lazy. Class was early and I couldn't get up. I got B's on all 3 exams and ended up with a B in the class. Study the power points extensively. If you get at least Bs on the exams and go to class , you'll have an easy A.
Great professor. Really funny. Show up to class and you'll be fine. I studied the PowerPoint slides and got a's on his tests.

The class is entertaining and straightforward. He is funny and nice during lecture, but not the friendliest of people outside of class. If you want to get an A, know the powerpoints from lecture very well. Every detail from those is fair game for the exams

You must go to class! everything from class is used on the tests, take good notes. There are 4 tests only 40 question 5 short answers, lowest test gets dropped. The paper is super easy only three pages! If you wanna do well in this class just go to class I didnt buy the book and got a B.
Go to class, study it once a week or so, take smart notes if its not on the slides write it down.  Great professor, your a moron if you get less than a B with the way he teaches.

well the problem I had with him is that he likes to test on the little details that he mentions in class. I attended class everyday and still got the answers wrong. He is not a bad lecturer just wish he would be more fair on his exams(ask from the book and slides)
Funny and energetic. He tells you what you need to know. If you go to class and read the book you will probably get an A. Paper is easy. Tests are confusing.

I went to every lecture and still wound up getting a D in the class. Majority of what he says in class appears on the exam and this info is not on the slides. As the previous rater says this is completely unfair because even if you show up to lecture you have a chance of getting the question wrong.

I think one reason people do very poorly in his class is that it is at 8:00 am. I stopped attending lectures and recieved a C, however I thought the class was interesting nonetheless. He says things in lectures which appear on the exam which I think is unfair even if you went chances of you getting it right is very slim.

Wow I would never take a course with this guy again, his teaching methods sucked(he talked in a low voice). On top of that he is a extremely hard grader on the papers and exams. A class that should be fun/interesting he turned into a living nightmare. Horrible professor.

Hard class - class avg. was pretty low. I ended up with an A thanks to the curve at the end. Dr. Ragozzino is ok - kind of quiet, though, so sit near the front or record lec's. He is very fair, so don't expect special treatment (i.e. extra credit). Most of the material is interesting. GO TO CLASS! Nearly all exam material comes from his lectures!!!

Ragozzino seems a bit dry at first but actually is funny, friendly, and helpful to students. He seems to really like teaching this stuff. This is not an easy class, but it's very interesting and definitely possible to get a good grade if you work at it.

Dr. Ragozzino is AWESOME! This class can be challenging but it is fun. You must attend lectures, he always posts the slides on blackboard but gives important additional info and explains things better during lecture. Tests are kind of tough, most people don't do well, but if you actually study, you will be able to do well. Loved him!!!

He is a good professor, class i very hard if you have choice than i will recommend not to take it. his exams are very very infinite very hard. It is true that the study guides never help, it just see and throw them in trash cans. If you can than don't take it otherwise you will be getting D or F in the class.
This class was really hard. I would recommend avoiding it if possible! The tests are really hard, and the study guides that he gives are not too helpful for the exam since the test is very detailed.
go to class. dont buy book. you can get an A

Physiological Psych is hard as it is.  Dr. Ragozzino's tests are not easy, although he does drop the lowest score of the first three exams.  The class average on exams were 67.  Go to class, this class is not an easy A.

Good teacher. He is kind of boring sometimes but the class was really early so it's not all his fault. His tests are hard partly because they do not have many question but if you study you can get a good grade. He curves if he feels the class needs it. Very nice, approachable, and funny. I would take more classes with him.

The topic material was very interesting and he knows how to teach and explain it very well. Tests are hard, you will have to study and go to class to take notes. He does post his notes online but still go to class. Not an easy A, but well worth the effort
Great professor. Very easy class
nice teacher.

I loved Ragozzino...he is so corny, but very nice. His tests are hard, but fair if you go to class and read the text. I recomend going to lecture, which may be hard because he teaches very early classes, but he covers a lot of material on the tests in lecture and he explains it well

This class sucked because it was at 8am and the material was torture. But he was great. His lectures were easy to understand and he tried to make it fun by cracking a few jokes. He is actually really cool if you talk with him in person. Very approachable and down to earth. However his tests are tricky but there was a large curve at the end.

BEST professor EVER. Even better to work with in his lab. Good, subtle humor. But- you gotta be awake to catch it. Sometimes, he throws corny "Dad" jokes at you. You can't be lazy, hard material, but not impossible. Don't expect to get an easy A- you gotta work at it... way to go, Rago!

His voice is soft and flat which makes his lecture hard to sit through. He explains material well but you have to grasp the concepts on your own. There is no homework to turn in expect for a paper. My TA was a very picky. He is a nice guy and willing to budge on issues the class as a whole may have. I failed every exam we took and still got a C.

Good Professor, but you must do the readings and study his notes well ahead of time. Biological Psychology is extremely tough. There is a lot of memorization. Also, he does not give you Extra Credit to boost your grade. Still, very helpful and willing to answer any quetsions concerning the material.

I do agree his final was difficult.  Some questions that were not in the notes were placed on the exam in order to give more credit to the people that showed up to class.  However, he is quite alright.  He tends to be fair to others and does a good job in explaning the material in class and answering questions.  Take him, but study.

He is nice, but OMG he is so boring to listen to....his voice puts you right to sleep.....I don't recommend taking the class with him, because the lecture material is boring and listening to his lecture makes it even more boring.

He is the worst teacher ever! I went from two high B's on his tests to a very low F on the final. Made his tests uneccessarily hard. He sucks. Unhelpful. TA's cared about the students more then he did.

Wording on the tests is extremly difficult. His final is insane. He might be getting back at the students for not showing up to his lecture. He would have been a great teacher if made his tests easier. The material is boring and difficult to understand.
Tests are VERY confusing.
A little late to 8:00 am lectures

He post notes online, but still go to class. He won't give all the details on the notes, and he will have exam questions on it.  Some of his questions are confusing, so make sure you know the concepts/definitions well. He is a good profressor, I recommend him! He had good examples from research! Discussions were helpful. My TA was awesome!

Pretty boring teacher but I think thats because of the class not him. Study the slides he puts on blackboard and you will do well. Research paper is easy because he almost does it for you. Helpful if you need it. He has some great stories and gives interesting examples from his own research. Reccomended.

He is a very straighforward teacher. 3 tests, 1 research paper (he gives you topic & sources!), discussion attendence and thats it! Tests directly from slides which he always posts on blackboard. He can be boring in the lecture but outside of class he is very funny and down to earth if you approach him. Take him for any psych classes. UIC's best.

He's a good teacher but the class material is extremely boring. Just about everybody looks as if they will start to snore at any second during the lectures. Tests are multiple choice but worded in a tricky manner. Good at posting materials and notes online. Discussion groups are a complete waste of time but the TA's are very nice and helpful.

Nice professor. Sit in the front because he may put you to sleep but he is very clear in what he wants from you. He does not assign much work. Study hard and you should walk out with no less then a B.

I highly reccomend taking a course with this instructor. True the exams are tough and you really have to study and grasp the material to do well. But he is ALWAYS availible to talk to if you need him. His lectures are good. Easy to understand. I actually liked going to class.

His tests are very hard and some of the questions are tricky. But he taught the class well and if you need help he is approachable if you wan't to see him after class. Study hard for the tests and take good notes and make sure to attend the lectures b/c you will get confused on your own.
He is a good teacher, but his tests were very hard and the wording on them was ambiguous. He's helpful though, but the class was pretty tough.
Very good class! material was very interesting and the professor was rather enjoyable to listen to. highly recommended!

He is a nice professor if you get to know him. I just wished he would engage more with the students than just go over the notes in class. I also wished he give us extra credit opportunities, in order to improve our grades. The bilological material was difficult to understand in the first place.

I have never met a professor so invested in making sure his students are up to date and relevant on current tech like professor mohammed. The class is fair, plenty of extra credit. Lectures are very good, and attendance is very strict but makes sense. It's a class that's very beneficial to get experience from and easy to get a good grade.

This class was confusing, which he would not help with. He wouldn't answer student's questions correctly because he didn't understand them, and his lecture slides were confusing and had AI descriptions. The class wasn't too hard, but you need to keep up with weekly assignments that can take 2 hours.

The class is lecture-heavy, and attendance matters since your grade can drop if you miss class. All assignments are AWS-based and online, which can be stressful without much guidance. Exams are in person but online, all multiple choice, with a cheat sheet allowed. There are also lots of extra credit opportunities, and it's great for your resume.

He is a great professor who always wants to get students prepared for the future by providing many resources. This course was great for learning SQL and is very AWS-heavy. AWS assignments are easy to follow, and SQL assignments helped me learn a lot. Make sure to study hard for the exams and also review the slides on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lecture heavy. He drops your grade if you don't attend class!! All of the assignments are online AWS related. At times can be very stressful because there is nobody to guide you through them and they're all online. Exams are online in person all MC, allows a cheat sheet, and countless opportunities for EC. Very beneficial to your resume!

He's a good and passionate professor who genuinely wants his students to succeed. I think his attendance and participation policies are a bit overbearing, especially for a lecture based class that doesnt have group projects and nearly 100 students in it. He puts a lot of effort into exposing us to up to date technology related to the field.
He's alright
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Decent. Provides a lot of chances for extra credit and all homework and assignments are pretty easy. Really wants his students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He's a pretty chill teacher, the attendance doesn't count but I would recommend staying in class… He goes over all the course material in videos, lectures and gives out past exams for a good way to study. Cares about his students and offers an optional final exam.
good professor, lectures were helpful, very straightforward  class
Amazing and makes biology super clear

Mike is easily the best professor at UIC. He never makes a huge deal of things and is easygoing. Just watch the pre-recorded lectures before class and memorise the quiz answers and the iclikcers the are very helpful for the exams. Practice a lot of exam papers before the exam and you can easily score above 90%.

Prof Muller is one of the best, if not the best, professor for intro 100-level biology courses. He's very kind and informative during his lectures. His tests are a bit tedious not because of him, but because of the material. Please use all the resources he provides from p.p lectures to pass exams; they will ensure you pass the course with an A.

It is the best and the most straightforward class if you can pay attention and have fun with it, as his way of teaching is the easiest I have ever experienced. The work amount is moderate and easily manageable.

Great professor although he would sometimes ramble in lectures he was very understanding often he gave extensions and quizzes were easy. He also provides study guides for every exam, which are all multiple choice and final was optional.

He's pretty chill. Just let him know if you are going to be late or miss class, he doesn't really care if you do tbh. It may seem a little weird at first but it's a fun class overall. Also be ready to defend the points you make in class bc he will push you, not bc he's trying to be rude but j bc that's part of the class.

A very interesting class with a very engaging and funny professor. If you do the readings, discussion posts, and participate in class you'll be just fine. The class is discussion heavy and sharing your thoughts is highly encouraged. Professor Murphy will typically offer another look at your opinions which helps when it comes to writing the essays.

By far my favorite class ever! Professor Murphy is one of the smartest people you'll ever meet. He is SUPER engaging and encourages students to take a strong stance and back themselves up. If you participate in homework and in class, you'll be set up for success. VERY interesting topics that'll never lead you to boredom. Highly recommend! :)

I love Dr. Murphy. He is not only hilarious, but the way he presents ethical topics is unique and engaging. The class is structured in a socratic seminar style, so students mainly discuss the topics. Be sure to participate, and don't be afraid to give your own opinions (as long as you can defend them)! The most fun class hands down to debate in.
His class is very interesting. It is my favorite class I've taken so far. He is such a smart professor and everything he says is always genius.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: funny

Loved Dr. Murphy. His class on the ethics of human body modification was so interesting. He always stimulated great conversation with the most bizarre topics. I will miss that class. Never a dull moment.

This ethics class was such an interesting course! Dr. Murphy is very entertaining and the topics discussed in class were really interesting. It was imo the easiest honors class as we only had three essays and participation points for our final grade. He wants students to form a strong opinion and be able to back it up. Highly recommended!!!

This was such an interesting class. We talk about interesting medical developments and ethical viewpoints on the use of them. Dr. Murphy is hilarious and says interesting things and  presents the material in interesting ways. He can get really intense playing devil's advocate to be sure you can hold you own opinion and give it right back to him.

This class was one of the most interesting I have taken at UIC so far. Really interesting, thought-provoking topics, and Dr. Murphy really knows how to get a discussion going. Essays are pretty easy just explain your position as you would in class, and grade is mostly participation-based. Overall, a great class thanks to Dr. Murphy.

Murphy absolutely LOVES playing Devil's Advocate and really make you think about how you present your viewpoint. I agree with earlier comments about this class being heavy on the discussion side. Prof. Murphy really makes you think and advance as a student. He is a tad quirky but very likable

Prof Murphy is a little intimidating at first, because it seems like he's always trying to find a loophole in your views... but you get use to it and learn to enjoy his quirky personality. He picks very engaging topics for discussion VERY laid back class with only 3 essays, though most of the grade is participation. EASY, FUN, INTERESTING CLASS!!

Dr. Murphy is extremely nice and very well read. He is probably one of the smartest in his field of biomedical sciences. The class discussions were really fun and we talked about many controversial medical issues. If you are a talker and like to express your ideas you will love the class, and you will get an A. TAKE THE CLASS!!!

He's a good guy who always makes you think in class. The class discussions are very fun and entertaining. You'll cover aspects of body ethics you never thought about before. You have three papers and as long as you fully explain your positions, you shouldn't have too many problems with the class as far as grades go.
This is by far the most interesting class i've taken at UIC. Dr Murphy is a funny, guy who conducts a thought-provoking class. Don't expect much homework. This core class is a fun time guaranteed.

His class was both informative and interesting. I learned about something I knew absolutely nothing about, biomedical ethics. Def. an interesting and good choice for Honors College freshman. One of the easier core classes. Three essays (short 2-3pages)- only homework other than reading assignments.
He really knows his subject and presents it in an interesting way. He's hilarious too, quirky and kinda lazy. Only two essays the entire semester. Ethics is my new love because of him

About medicine and ethics; a really enjoyable class. Lectures by professor are very informative and show science at a different level as compared to what we normally percieve. Topics covered in this class are very intriguing!  Assigned readings are crucial; only 3 essays in the entire semester! Great class and a nice professor! Love it!!

Prof. Kim is a very nice person but has no idea whats going on in class. The TA needs to save the day half the time. 3 Group Projects that build off each other so make sure your group works well. Mini projects and quizzes every M/F so make sure to show up. Terribly run class, but made it with the easy grading from the TA's.
Instead of major exams, this course has multiple small weekly evaluations. That helps to reduce stress, as other quizzes could compensate for some low scores.
Weekly assignments and group work. The practice problems and Octave are very helpful for assignments.
Good feedback
Waste your time if you take the class.

Her class is easy but not knowledgeable. Her explanation is difficult to understand. I should have retaken Reckinger's class to fill the gaps. If you have an option to choose a professor, go with him, not her.

The class has several group projects. The projects were complementary and helped to understand the dynamic systems and control. The Matlab was well explained. She reflects constructive feedback from the class.

I have no idea how Dr. Kim turned the most notorious class, with a solid 2.4 GPA average for ME courses according to UIC's grading data base into an ez class. Dr. Kim turned her 3 exams into three group projects that build off one another. Once you write the report for project 1, there is minimal work left. She posts ALL matlab functions you need.
Her lecture comes with practical skills for engineering including Matlab. She cares for the students. HW heavy.
She is awful professor ever. I do not understand her pronunciations and her explanation.
It is a graduate class and the class is heavily based on project work. On the other hand, she promotes self-grading so the class grade is heavily based on peer reviews.
He is obsessed with control and he is inflexible. Do not take the class!

I was excited to take this IDS course, as it allowed me to select it as my MBA concentration. I was quickly discouraged from pursuing this concentration, as the professor made it very stressful to learn the material. His teaching methods were not good. Thinking about transferring to another MBA program. I fear the other IDS classes will be the same
Professor Selva knows Operation Management very well. Great Teacher...
lots of material with equations and problems. tough case studies and assignments. gives feedback though. midterm was easy if you understand lectures. final was hard. prof's teaching was okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: An excellent  researcher but definitely not a good teacher

Professor knows the material , but lacks teaching ability . I had to learn on my own with youtube and online resources. The class will take up a lot of your time. You have to show all of your work for Homework , Test , and group projects . Will not reply to emails . This classed burned me out and discouraged me to continue my IDS interest in my MBA

Selva is enthusiastic about the material he presents in class and is readily available outside of class hours. Be aware, he does assign A LOT of homework, paired assignments, & cases. If there is not an exam, likely something is due. Course moves quick, so keep that in mind for selecting other classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great Prof. Tough course but teaches very nicely with a bit of humor.

Overall, very tough grader, you WILL get points off on homework or exams for something small. You have to pick up your exams in class, can't access it digitally on gradescope. He doesn't want you to fail though which is why I'm rating him good, he's just tough at grading. However, avoid taking him if you're bad at proofs.

Ex.Cred-if u attend class

Teaches from the book, very strict on grading, grades take a while to be put in, difficult to reach by email at times.

Don't take the class if you're new to math proofs, as the harshness of the grading expects you to be somewhat familiar with them.
His grading is tough. I am not recommending you to take a math class with him especially Math 215 unless you are very into proof in math.
had no idea what my grade was going to be until i received it. he's very very nice and a very good teacher but could have clearer grading rubrics and grading scale. exams are most of your grade.

Professor Nagloo is kind and open to questions, but the course lacks structure outside class. No notes, recordings, or posted grades. Grading is harsh with no rubrics. Limited office hours, no TAs, and no email replies make it hard to get help. Homework is on Box, not Gradescope. Class moves fast but is manageable with enough practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor ever, yells at students with no respect. Surprised she hasn't been fired from uic yet.

I contacted this professor about a grading discrepancy in the course. Rather than explaining the issue or correcting it, the response felt dismissive and discouraging. I did not feel supported when asking a reasonable question about my grade.
Never showed up other than the first day. It's more for involvement than anything. Easy class, just take the time to do the events.

This class is mandatory for freshman in UIC that are majoring engineering. She only shows up for the first day of class, and lecture is every other week. The only downside is attendance is SUPER mandatory and the assignments aka joining club meetings/events that circle around engineering is mandatory if you want to pass the class.

Simona isn't even a professor; she has no PhD, and instructs an engineering class that has absolutely nothing to do with engineering, yet grades harsher than 300 400-level professors. She gave me an incomplete for three semesters and then tried to fail me. I literally had to get the dean involved; the dean confirmed that she's incompetent.

Never saw the teacher after the first day of class, the rest of the semester was taught by TAs. TAs were helpful, but honestly, the class is a waste of an hour. We had to attend Activites over the semester to pass, one activity we couldn't do because the building wasn't open, another activity lasted only 10 minutes, walking took longer than that.

If I could give 0 stars, I would. She talks to students with such disrespect and she didn't even show up  for the first day of class. Instead she sent a different teacher in her place is having the class taught by TA's. The class is mandatory so you're going to need it but if you can avoid her do it AT ALL COST.

I find it frustrating that I didn't anticipate this professor's rude behavior before enrolling. If I had known, I would have chosen a different course. The instructor's lack of respect negatively impacts our learning experience and engagement. I wish I had been more informed before making my decision.
Unvaluable course, talks to students without/lack of respect, generally an inconsiderate person. Try and avoid connection with her at all costs.

This class is the worst possible start to an engineering students education here at UIC. Instructor and the Engr100 Team are completely unforgiving and neglect basic necessities that a student needs to pass a course. The class teaches absolutely nothing to the student during the hour and a half time you spend there, telling us to CHATGPT out essay.
Terrible Professor. Made the class way more difficult than it had to be.
generally just a bad person

Fall 2023. Course was online, so I never met the professor at all. She only sent out an introductory email, and the rest of the semester was taught by TA's. Course only lasted 8 weeks. You had to make sure to log into the blackboard course at least once a week for attendance to count. Just login and do the assignments on time, and it was an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: ENGR 100 honestly sucks, this professor was only there for the first day and the rest was taught by TA's who were late almost every day. You have to do a few bogus assignments to pass this class, and they grade so strictly that you likely will have to redo the assignments and ask the TA's for extensions multiple times just so you can pass.
Condescending person. Try to not take it with her. She does not care about you and does not know how to write emails like a normal person.

Absolutely atrocious. Class taught by TAs, never met the actual 'instructor' until after the semester when she failed me on one assignment at the last possible minute, thus resulting in an incomplete grade. Unable to effectively communicate with her, felt like talking to a condescending brick wall. It's an abomination this institution employs her.

she doesn't care about students, somehow managed to mess up extra credit even though was giving 100% and spoke to me in a condescending tone, and didn't even give me a chance to explain regarding the issue and cut me off every single time. just don't bother attending her office hours and definitely avoid having her
not the kind of person you want to associate with . . .

Professor is very condescending & spoke to me in a belittling way. Your job is to help students. Not make them feel like crap when something isn't understood. Regardless of how you feel! I'm having to retake a entire course because of misinformation spread by her teaching assistants. She's shown no empathy nor compassion in any of our interactions.
Rude, condescending, doesn't respond to mail for months.
very unhelpful and rude to students

I have no clue what is this class even about and the professor is just never there to teach always a TA teaching the course and the only time I needed to talk to her was through a Microsoft Teams chat and that was because I submitted a paper with no replies until I contacted them.

She is incredibly condescending and only has this job because of self-interest. She must have over 40,000 emails since she never responds to them. I am surprised that more people don't complain to the Dean of Engineering about her behavior. I am waiting for the day that she gets fired.

One of the courageous one without any knowledge on the topic on how to help future engineers. Just has a loud confident and NO caring about the course and communication with students. One of the toxic (negative impression on UIC) faculty member who does not help UIC to grow. Hope next time, UIC provide better and inspirational faculty for ENGR100
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: she is awefull. she never respond to emails and if she does she directs you to an email address that doesnt exist. and if you say anything she responds with anger and bad attitude. class is trash, you learn nothing out of it like the class is designed to waste your time. the amount of homework is hilarious for 0 credit class.

Prof Narubin wasn't very organized throughout the semester and was condescending in emails. When asking a question about the ENGR email in the beginning of the semester, she responded, "Have you looked in the Blackboard content? On the syllabus? In every single announcement made for the course? At the bottom of every page in the learning modules?"

ENGR100 is a super straightforward class introducing you to UIC and engineering. While the course can feel like a filler, it does definitely force you to look around learn about UIC and any related engineering services or clubs. My section of ENGR100 was online (no lectures), so it was super simple quizzes along with a short essay.

She gets a bad rap. When you teach a class that every engineering student is required to take, it's bound to be a bit of a mess. Just make sure to read the instructions thoroughly, and you'll make it out just fine. She clearly cares about the work, and I respect her effort.

incomplete simply because they do not grade on time. This is extremely unprofessional and I do admit that she gave an opportunity for students who didn't complete their work to pass but more students were complaining about being marked as incomplete when they completed all assignments and on time. *2

Don't get me wrong this class is quite easy to complete and I had no troubles with the material itself. The issues lies in the grading. Simona doesn't respond to direct emails so you must email the department itself and they aren't that useful. I had completed every assignment ad turns out that Simona grades myself and a bunch of others as *1

Office hour link doesn't work, she hates talking to students. Don't become a professor if you are going to complain about students asking for help. She has no sympathy at all and treats people like robots. What a great introduction to engineering.

Absolutely terrible experience as a new student taking Engr100 with Simona. She has zero intention or motivation to engage with students and gets angry if you attempt to contact her directly. Very unprofessional and surprising that she still holds a position at the college.

Had her for ENGR100, it was awful, never met a more self centered authoritarian- never replies to emails either. Now for senior design she's in charge of Expo and her website is terrible. It hardly works & there's no communication. She ordered a bunch of souvenirs nobody wanted- so wasteful. I'm just glad I didn't have to see her in person.

She didn't lecture at all. The assignments seemed easy but she's an incredibly picky grader. I had late assignments and I turned them into the Dropbox, and she didnt respond for 3 months even though I emailed her 2 or 3 times. Her job required minimal effort and she still did it terribly. She clearly doesn't care about or respect her students.

She doesn't actually lecture so I can't rate her as a teacher. She doesn't keep up to date on grading and contacting her is a mystery. Not through email because she told us she had 4000 unread ones. Not via the blackboard messages because she doesn't want to read those. I completed all assignments and still have a U in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Quick, easy, learn a couple things about campus and engineering. It's 1 credit hour. The entire class takes 10 hours the whole semester. If you can't get an S in this class idk how you expect to get through engineering school.

The class itself isn't hard but Narubin never responds to emails and will get mad at you for contacting her by phone. Some of the projects instructions are unclear so when you fail it, its apparently your fault for not understanding the instructions. She is also a stingy grader where if you don't include everything she asked you fail the project.

Simona Narubin is terrible, never reply ur email on time. U must wait 2 weeks to get her reply. You also cant call her office phone. She will tell u she was busy and let u wait 2 weeks to get her reply.

Not flexible with what we can choose for our assignments and contradicts herself many times with what is allowed and what isn't. Never responds to emails and if we call her office number she gets mad that we are intruding her business.

I only had Simona for an 8 week 1 credit course and she was not the TA assigning or grading so I cannot rate her on that, but she was the only online instructor I've had so far that actually asks how we're doing and tries to engage with us and help us. It seems like she genuinely cares when online school usually feels so impersonal.

she takes the most simplest of classes (engineering orientation) and turns into a 500 level course. she get irritated if you speak a word during a 300 student lecture and she will fail you for missing more then 1 class a semester. shes just mad she couldn't become a real professor.

Harder than difficult classes because you know that you are wasting time sitting in ENGR 100 while you could be studying for one of your hard classes or just catching up on sleep. She brings in guest speakers every week that have absolutely nothing to say I haven't already heard 10 times. This class serves absolutely no purpose and she knows it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Absolute joke of a class. She literally wants you to buy a children's picture book as the textbook for the class. And then she reads it out loud to 200 students. Other than there is hardly anything to do other than listen to boring speakers from UIC clubs and have students argue them in the middle of class. She takes attendance via location app.
Very boring class it was such a huge waste of time. Professor is fine but get ready for the most useless class ever.

Simona has made me dread Tuesdays. I never wanted to go and listen to her irrelevant guest speakers, and sit through 75 minutes of doing nothing. She claimed almost every lecture that her class is the most important one we will ever take, but I honestly cant think of a bigger waste of my time than ENGR100.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Engineering 100 is a pointless class. The professor doesnt actually teach you just sit through presentations from various other departments on campus. Pass/fail class just do the bare minimum to pass. Dont buy textbook waste of money only used once. Attendance points most important.
She is really rude and loud as she has eaten a microphone. Taking with this person  wasting your time and money! Lectures are really boring, and you must show up to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Easy A, but you have to show up and not be on your phone, she will 100% call you out. Easy projects, class ends midway through the semester. Facilitates discussion, but since she is a brand new professor, she hasn't quite figured out how to teach effectively yet.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Intelligent and hardworking, but takes it too personally when students don't pay attention, even if they aren't disruptive. I actually did find lectures informative until she would interrupt them to call out students. Talks about self a lot, but did have good insight. Grading is all P/F assignments and attendance, so show up and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Passing was easy just show up and submit the homework (which was really easy btw). I felt bad for the kids that were working on other stuff or playing on their phone or talking bc they got called out in class but what do you expect? Go to class and not pay attention? Im glad she stopped people from talking and being distracting bc thats annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Class is SUPER easy, arguably a waste of time. Simona made it a painful to sit through. Probably knows what she's talking about the sheer amount of overconfidence was too much to handle. Good luck if you have her
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 75 minutes long each lecture. You are not allowed to do anything except for listening to her nonsense on those lectures. Taking ENGR100 with this professor would be A WASTE OF YOUR TIME AND MONEY(tuition  her salary).
Good luck
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Assignments are easy. Good professor, sets up lectures and presentations from resourceful centers to help offer resources and guides to lend you a helping hand in succeeding in your field. Sympathetic as long as you communicate. Try not to miss more than 1 of the class else you would need to visit during office hours to compensate for absences.

reviews.comment: She does a good job of explaining what is expected of you during class. Sets up assignments that were easy to complete.

reviews.comment: Thankfully, Simona only lectured 4 or 5 times. She was rude, full of herself, and did not command the room well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Neel is an amazing professor who does notes with his class and makes sure that you are not just having to read off all of the slides to get lost later on. Honestly I would take ANY class he teaches, and he is always willing to accommodate if a student has issues. Prbly one the best easy going professors UIC has to offer.

Honestly one of the best, most Gen Z professors I've ever had. After taking his class, Accounting 211 feels super easy. His lectures are amazing, he's funny, and he somehow manages to use Dunkin in almost every example.
amazing professor, the best in uic to be honest. very hilarious and his lectures are always entertaining!

Literally the GOAT of the accounting faculty at UIC. Easy to understand, his exam reviews help prepare for his exams, and he seriously cares about his students. Prof. Patel is an all-around great professor! One of the best!
Acc 211 is difficult, but he was a great professor! Truly enjoys what he does and is well-versed in the subject. Would recommend taking him for accounting.
Take Neel Patel for ACTG 211. He makes learning fun and is sometimes funny. Overall, he makes the content easy to understand and makes an effort to get to know most of his students.

I'm a person who sucks at math and accounting but Patel makes the content digestible. Even if you struggle, it's easy to get back on track with a little studying and meeting him outside of class. He knows what students care about and only teaches the essentials. 

He's always upbeat and respects students who try their best.
The best professor that I ever had, although that is not easy. But if u work hard, u will get A for sure
One of the best professor to study with.

Professor Patel is amazing! He's easygoing, loves to talk about the "language of business" and how it can be used to analyze real world events, and covers only the necessary stuff from the workbook. He is a very nice professor. If you pay attention, the class will be easy and he walks through practice questions in class. The exams are pretty straight forward and the final isn't cumulative. All the quizzes were online and they were open for two days.
The professor is great and loves to teach students.

Such a fun class! I wasn't really expecting it to be easy, but the professor has an awesome personality and made every chapter so much easier to understand. Super interactive and kept things interesting the whole time. Definitely one of the most enjoyable classes I've taken.
Patel is kind and energetic ! He makes class go by quickly while creating an ideal environment to learn in. Just donut talk during class, take notes and you'll do great !
Patel is an amazing professor. He is always willing to help any student who is struggling with concepts. Class is very engaging and mandatory. Overall, great professor!

This is my first time writing a review, and I couldn't think of a better Professor to write about than Professor Patel. He is truly one of the best Professors I've ever had. His classes are so engaging and fun that I never wanted to miss a single one. Professor Patel is simply amazing!

Professor Patel is the nicest and most caring professor ever. I wish he taught more classes so I could take him again. He is very understanding and will help you when you are lost. He is one of the only professors that genuinely cares. He's just as good of a professor as he is a person.
He's the best guy, very nice professor. His class is also very interesting.

I hate to not give him a 5 because I think he is a nice guy and very caring of the students but you just dont learn anything in this class. Patel was such an amazing professor, I really struggled this semester with accounting but he's probably the best professor that actually tries to help you understand the content. Really chill professor, but it's really a group presentation class. Didn't really have to do too much with international accounting, but otherwise a good class. It was a fun class and was super easy but you dont really learn anything about international accounting Its basically a public speaking class Youre graded on 3 presentations there are no exams But the presentations are super easy so I wouldnt worry about that Just be prepared to be questioned about anything after you present He is very nice as well

Professor Patel is one of the easiest professors to talk to at UIC. He made ACTG211 seem easy, and used a lot of real life situations to connect the material. He's very kind and considerate, giving students a chance to succeed in his class. Strongly recommend taking one of his classes.

ACTG has been a hard subject for me but Neel broke it down so well. Super straightforward with what we need to know. Gave us plenty of resources for the quizzes, exams, and group assignments. The class structure is pretty manageable if you attend class and keep up with the hw!

Professor Patel was very helpful, understanding and easy to work with. He explained everything really well with very good examples and focused more on nailing a concept down which made exams and quizzes a lot easier. He is also always open to people attending office hours for extra help and will definitely aim to get the best out of you!

He's the nicest guy. Lots of projects. No exams. Lectures do not seem to have anything to do with the subject matter. Not sure if he has relevant experience in international accounting. He is very caring and wants class to be fun.
Straight up amazing. Nothing more needs to be said.
W Professor. Everything you'll need, he gives you. No Complaints. Best Prof at UIC no doubt!

This guy is nice so I want to be as fair to him as possible. With that being said, in class we rarely had relevant lectures about the course material. Professor Neel is an amazing professor. If accounting is not your strong suit, I would recommend him because he is good at explaining accounting concepts and making them easier to understand. Best professor I've ever had. He gives you hope about UIC's business professors. Made ACTG211 seem easy, and genuinely cares about your success, as he reminds you that a lot. Hands down one of the best accounting professors I have ever had! Professor Patel will always make time for his students and make sure they understand the material. Honestly, if I had to take this course again, I would with him.
He's the best professor I've ever had. He cares about each student understanding what he's teaching, and makes sure each student isn't completely lost.

Professor Patel is one of my favorite Professors which Ive had at UIC. He is very understanding and helpful towards his students. Do not hesitate to reach out during his office hours for help. Makes lectures easy to understand and offers extra credit through the semester.

Professor Patel is a great professor and super nice! He does example problems as he is teaching, so it's very helpful if you're a visual learner. Go to class (pay attention!) and do the exam reviews. One of the best professors at UIC, makes accounting genuinely more tolerable.

Professor Patel is one of the greater professors I've had at UIC. He teaches the material very well, is very reachable outside of the classroom, and is very passionate about being an educator. 
He made the material very easy to comprehend, despite me being so worried about managerial accounting.

Professor Patel is one of the best professors I've had at UIC thus far. He explains concepts clearly and tries his hardest to ensure all students understand. He is a professor who cares about his students and will help you in his class and with advice for the outside world. Absolute great teacher but an even better person!

He's one of the best professors on campus. He goes through the concepts at a good pace and does examples from the book step-by-step for the class to follow. He is one of the best professors around UIC. Absolutely fun person, goes over problems and really help you understand the content really well. I would absolutely 100% take his class again, or if he were teaching a different class, I would take that too.

OMG, where do I have to start?Hes so nice&chill!I haven't seen a professor like him before in 4 years.He always makes sure that all students get the concept of the topics.Throughout this semester his lectures were not boring at all.He is not the type of prof who just reads the lectures.Definitely, he is born to be an accounting professor.He's 5/5.

Patel is the absolute best! Admittedly, I used to be scared of accounting and never got the hang of it. Patel is so caring and compassionate, and through that I became such a good accountant. I wish i could add more stars to his rating. He is so understanding, kind, and collected. 10/10!!!!

Amazing, caring, and respected!! Dr.Patel is as good as professors get - he is kind, calm, and collected while lecturing which creates an environment of easy learning. He really is passionate about wanting his students to do good in his class and is overall one of the best professors I've had. He is passionate about teaching and truly cares about his students. Teaching style: combination of taking notes and doing example problems. Take good notes = can use for quizzes. Professor Patel was born to teach accounting he's a great teacher but to get an A you have to put in the work, just make sure to show up, do your best, and be engaged in the class, which won't be hard because Professor Patel will find ways to make everyone learn and have fun at the same time. Overall GREAT professor!
Prof. Patel is an amazing teacher, he keeps the class involved and makes sure everyone is understanding. Just keep up with the homework and show up for class.
Amazing Professor, I hope more people take ACTG 211 with him. He's new but he's better than most of the professors already.

Professor Patel is the best accounting professor there is at UIC. This was his first semester as a professor and he did not disappoint. Accounting 211 can be a difficult class but he truly cares for your success and is willing to help you with whatever you need if you reach out.
Best Professor! Always helping students. Not a lengthy course, with easy exams, and easy grades.
Love this guy! He is extremely willing to help and support his students. If you want an easy A but a truly enjoyable class, I highly recommend him!
Very nice guy and very caring. Best professor for sure I have ever had.
Just started his class in the spring semester. He is an excellent teacher because its clear he loves to teach.

He is the best professor for ACTG 315 at UIC. He is a great lecturer who makes it easy to follow and explains things very thoroughly. Study guides are extremely similar to tests! He's also a funny guy.
