Best accounting professor I've taken so far! The reviews were SUPER helpful for preparing for exams!! Nekrsov is the goat. He is also funny at times, and always attempts to create a welcoming environment. I reccomend every wait a semester to register with him. As he once said "An immortal sin in accounting is double counting, DONT DO IT" lol.

Professor continues to help students by answering questions and never makes them feel bad about the questions they ask. Makes class a welcoming space for learning and growth. Great professor

i liked nekrasov for actg 315. he uses his own notes and attending classes is beneficial bc that's where he explains and does the notes along with the class but class notes are posted at the end of the week. Have to use Connect every week to complete a Smartbook and graded homework.

she is a nice professor for edu 200. the articles were usful that she assigned in her class

Professor Brown has an incredibly interesting perspective on literature and politics.  I wish I could have taken more classes with him. Great professor. Probably one of the most understanding English professors at UIC.

Insanely amazing class, I actually was excited to go, like bro is the best teacher of all time.

Objectively, the course was very straightforward and if you could ace the homework and iclickers the midterms would not be stressful at all. Course was well structured.

Super kind but needs to restructure the class. Pop quizzes when you may miss class unexpectedly is defeating and the homework are challenging and graded harshly. The class honestly should be curved with the class averages.
5 midterms and a final, one midterm dropped, but do study for them as they do contain questions that are a bit more challenging, attend class for the iClicker grade, and you'll do fine :3
She's very organized. In order to succeed in this class, you just need to show up and actually do the homework. I honestly do not have anything bad to say, she's great

This is her first time teaching 201. The homework was  super time consuming, Past professors gave out 2 problems a week which would take an hour, she gives 10 so 3-4 hours of hw which would get discouraging after a while. Random quizzes. Good teacher, bad structure. maybe she will fix it for future semesters.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Class is very structured, everything is pretty much laid out for you. 400 level CS classes lack this so I am very grateful. 2 chapters per exam so your retention is fresh. Really cares about her students succeeding by providing a lot of great resources to learn off of. I learned a lot! Awesome professor she's cool.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Really understanding and caring professor. She genuinely wants to see her students succeed. Exams are easy as long as you understand the homework.

The Ohio Sigma's mewing stats show a 95% confidence interval that Gyatt levels peak at 2 a.m., causing a significant increase in alpha-nerd behavior 😏.

On a serious note, she's an amazing prof. Her lectures are very interactive and easy to follow. Her exams are not cumulative and she provides plenty of study material.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Instructor Brynne Nicolsen is a sigma, she definitely mews.

This class may seem daunting at first due to the large number of video lectures and exams that happen almost every other week. Still, this professor does drop your lowest exam and the course structure is organized in my opinion. Overall the course material is difficult, everything is laid out for you, you just need to put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's a great prof. Everything is easy to understand, 10/10 recommend.

She is a really good professor, and the class structure was really good. The tests are extremely hand-holdy, as she gives formula sheets and even definitions for you to do the test with. I think the only problem is that the class was too easy, and possibly does not properly prepare students that will take a higher level class after this.

Disliked the teaching method: She has you watch 3 lecture videos and do 3 quizzes weekly (I spent an hour taking notes before class), she doesn't review what was on the videos, assumes you understand, lectures are I-Clicker questions based on material in videos, 6 exams 1 every 2 weeks, entitled and would stop class if someone was talking. DNR

Professor Nicolsen is an excellent professor! Although she is new to UIC, I believe that schools would benefit from having more fresh instructors like her. She implements a flip system, which involves watching short videos before each class. The homework assignments are clear and easy to follow, and Professor Nicolsen is always available on Piazza.

Dr Nicolsen is very amazing and articulate! She is very clear when explaining concepts, and she gives assignments & exams that reflect ONLY the concepts covered in class. Very fair and lenient in grading, and offers extra credit.
5 exams(1-2 chapters on each), 14 HW(drops 2, gives 50% attempt, 50% correctness), iClicker w/extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Nicolsen is great! Lectures and class material are interesting. She is also very responsive if you have questions, even during weekends. The structure and the content of the course is very clear as well and structured as well. Homework and workload is reasonable.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Nicolsen is a phenomenal professor. For IE342, the class is structed in which you watch a 10-15 min video before class everyday about the subject and practice the skills in class. This format works great for everyone I know. Her teaching in lectures is great and she always explains every concept throughly. The tests are very fair!

Doctor Nicolsen has become one of my favorite professors at UIC. She has the class structured so well. One homework assignment a week, 5 exams (fifth being the final) which I prefer because you focus on two chapters per exam. And you watch 10 min lecture video before each lecture. I think more professors should follow her  lead.

Overall lacked interaction. It had good material and substance, I just felt tired for the entire 90 minutes. Super strict about electronics and is not scared to call you out. Things got dicey when I presented a report I spent 1+ week on and was accused of plagiarism simply because I can write collegiate-level words. Don't recommend :(
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A very engaging professor! Just make sure you prepare for the exams! In the case that you are majoring in political science and you are interested in Politics, this is a beautiful class for it. Although yes, you aren't allowed technology in his lectures, he makes an hour and 15-minute class feel like 40-50 minutes. He's a very great person.

He really sets you up for success. If you
show up and listen, you will pass. Others
have said he is dry in his lectures, but
honestly his style is very clear and it is
obvious he is knowledgeable on US
politics. His tests follow readings & lectures
perfectly. Don't be afraid to ask questions-
he will do everything he can to make sure you get it.

Had him for a writing class that fulfilled the writing in the discipline requirement for POLS majors. The class is more reasonable than the 3-4 other options that are available for undergraduate students. Instead of working on a semester-long 20 page research paper, you get to write three smaller 6-7 page papers throughout the semester.

I think in a traditional setting Kaplan would have been a wonderful person to learn under, however he is not fit for online instruction. He is dry in his lectures, unclear on expectations, and unreliable in communication. The true shame is that he is brilliant when it comes to the US congressional system, but no one in my class learned anything.

He wasnt bad but wasnt the best. Lectures were very dry and a lot of reading. He also never responded to emails unless he needed questions from students answered. The class itself wasnt too hard or too easy. I wouldnt recommend if youre not into politics
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Kaplan is quite the interesting fellow. I think that of all the POLS professors at UIC, he knows the most when it comes to American politics. He is genuinely knowledgeable about U.S. government. In my experience, also a good grader. However, lectures are long, likes to call people out who use phones, and has interesting voice/ticks.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He likes to hear himself talk which would be great if he were interesting but he is not. He can also be very condescending which makes him unapproachable as a professor. He is smart but his delivery of information is very monotone and boring. He could use a personality change which would make for a more effective teacher.

Doesn't use blackboard all semester, so you don't know your grade till the end which gives you no chance to figure out why. Wasted a lot of time into this class just to get a grade I felt I did not deserve. I would not recommend to someone who doesn't know much about Congress. Smart guy and knows his stuff but just a little difficult w/o technology

The lecture is very dry, although he requires you to be there it doesn't really help much with the midterm or final you basically rely on the book. There is a group project which is not so bad as long as your group can write a decent paper. Otherwise he's an okay guy but does want to see you pass so take him but be ready for reading and lots of it

This professor is a nice man but the class was very dry. The class meets twice a week. There is one exam and two 8 page papers that require a lot of citing and clarity. I would suggest that he revamps his teaching style to make the class a bit more interesting. Overall, not a hard class.

3d is one of the hardest classes youll take all year That being said Norm does a good job of taking you through the course. He could be more clear on details for how to succesfully navigate projects, but mostly the directions are straightforward. Most important of all is do the work but there will always be opportunity to resubmit for more points
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There were many inconstancies regarding the criteria for the projects. It would change or something would be added midway through the project causing stress and annoyance in many students. His critiques would be harsh, but doesn't help on how to improve it. There's a lot of downplaying on how challenging a project would be, and he lacks passion.

Heavy project based workload. Frequently failed to explain projects, glossed over important information/requirements to talk about unrelated details. He frequently moved due dates with little warning for his convenience. His feedback was brutally honest (emphasis on brutal). He demeaned students who were struggling and was honestly flat out cruel.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Throughout the semester, Norman didn't follow pacing written in course schedule, so expected work progress and deadlines were unclear. Instructions for Project 3 were especially unclear. Confusion on this project was greatly heightened by the fact that he went on a trip in the middle of the semester and wasn't present for the beginning of Project 3
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Noll is absolutely fantastic! Her classes are always interesting and she does her best to make it relevant. Participate during class, even if you don't have something mindblowing to say-- the only thing that upsets her is dead silence. She makes herself available outside of class, and there's barely any works aside from the skimmable readings.

First of all you're lucky if you got a spot in her class- they fill up pretty fast. So far my favorite professor at UIC. Do the journals well, but really focus on the 3 papers and you'll pass. Go to her office hours, she is immensely helpful and you'll get an A easily. A lot of reading- sparknotes will come in clutch- but please make some effort

Noll's Utopias & Dystopias class is very enjoyable. She assigns A LOT of reading but most of it is easy. She leaves lots of room for discussion and engages well with the students. Three papers determine your grade, but Noll is an easy grader and she gives great feedback. If you have time for the reading, I would highly recommend taking her class.
I only had her for an honors college freshmen seminar but she was really excited to show us the university's options. Very eccentric and caring.
Very energetic and engaging, easy to follow and fun to listen to.

I love Brianna. She's very passionate about literature. While she assigns a good amount of reading, little is informational/from a textbook, most was fiction literature, so it was less dry. She's quirky and fun, likes to have discussion-based classes rather than lectures. She allows a reasonable amount of absences.

She is an incredibly sweet teacher who wants you to excel.  There is an abnormal amount of reading, but just be sure to do a couple of them and you can always write about those.  Overall its pretty simple.

Dr. Noll is amazing. Make sure to do all the work because there aren't many assignments, but all assigned readings are interesting and lectures are intriguing. She's friendly and sweet. I came to her for help on my final paper and her feedback is extremely helpful and the reason why I was able to bring my grade up to an A. She's willing to help!

The class I took was called Foundations for the Future and I learned a lot. This class is designed to help prepare you for the Capstone Project, as well as prepare you for life after undergrad. Dr. Noll is very helpful and helped guide me for my Capstone as well as post-graduation. Whether or not you have her for this class, you will learn a lot!

Professor Noll is fantastic! She is intelligent, witty, and a thoughtful instructor and person. I took an Honors course with her called Superheroes and Cultural Mythology. Really enjoyed the course. Read comics for the first time! She goes out of her way to give thourough feedback on assignments. Gave five excused absences and lienant grader.

Her lectures are very well delivered and full of insight. The class is discussion based and when it comes to assignments she offers a lot of help outside of class. Overall, Dr. Noll is a great professor

She's a fabulous professor. Just make sure you stay on top of your reading. You want to be able to participate in discussion because class and lecture notes will help you with journals and papers. Don't BS the papers. She stresses the fact she is willing to help you on them so utilize it! Very encouraging and respects your opinions.

Hard Truth: I took this class without reading any reviews on Brianna, and it was the best decision ever! You are guaranteed an A in this class if you try on the 4 papers. Also, she's the most lenient grader. The final is an easy writing portfolio which is comprised of 2 previous papers. You will luv her personality. She is engaging, funny, and HOT!

Best english teacher I have had so far at UIC! She made discussions really interesting and class was very interactive! Very fair grader and willing to explain anything. Great stories about anything and everything and definitely very passionate about what she teaches. I'd love to take another class with her :)

Brianna is AWESOME! She is probably one of the nicest and most down to Earth people I have ever met. She is SO willing to help you get an A that it's almost impossible not to if you're trying. She does do pop quizzes but as long as you do the homework readings you will be fine. She's definitely a great instructor to have!

Awesome teacher! I will admit sometimes when you come to class, it is a little dull. But you HAVE to give her credit for trying to make the class fun and interesting! Great and helpful, she's really there when you need it. And she's not only helpful, but really nice! As long as you read your short texts and come to class, do your essays, easy A!
Brianna is a great professor and very willing to help anyone who asks. I was in her Intro to Poetry class and I enjoyed it very much. And the workload is totally manageable!

Brianna was a great teacher. I had her for English 161. She assigns a LOT of reading  and short homework assignments, but those wind up being good tools for your final research paper. She is incredibly helpful & makes an effort to make sure everyone knows what they're doing.  Do the work, you'll get an A for sure.
Nice and easy, just gotta do the work and you'll get an A. She's easy on the eyes too!
she's a really awesome teacher!If you put in the effort you'll get an A. down side is she gives alot of homework.
My fave TA at UIC! She's kinda hard but would do anything to help her students.

Norwood is by far one of the worst TA's I've ever had for any 100 level class. She speaks with the air of someone who thinks she is imparting great wisdom, but is in fact telling you absolutely nothing of substance. Her discussions assignments are ridiculous and betray her complete ineptitude at teaching basic concepts.

I got a good grade in this class with the help of the extra credit she offers, which were interesting  and fun. Although, this professor was very rude. She treats her students as if they were back in high school, with no respect for the adults that they are. The material of the class was fairly easy to understand but the exams were difficult.

she helps but is very rude. She has a lot of extra credit but because she knows the students are going to need it. She is very brief in her powerpoint and goes through them too quick to capture everything. Exams are tough if you don't study extensively and do extra work.

The tests are rather hard but if you just study the jeopardy board, and read the material, you'll be good! If you are not the test taking type,  then I would advise you to do the copious amounts of extra credits that she gives out in the class. It involves going on tours to different courts and jails, but it's easy points and will raise your grade!

HORRIBLE TEACHER DO NOT TAKE HER! Spent HOURS and DAYS studying for the midterm and the final only to get a 40% on them. her tests are HARD. she goes way too fast on her power points and she does not post them online! her power points are crucial! next to literally reading the chapters to detail. basically a self-taught class.

She is a great teacher. She offers extra credit which comes in handy. Her tests are worth a decent amount of your grade but if you go to class and study the jeopardy boards you will do fine. She is very approachable and has projects that you can do outside of class such as prison tours. Great teacher for a great class
Melanie had an interesting class, she is a real nice professor. And she does assigned several optional projects that engages you in the Criminal law field.

She's ok. Doesn't seem to care much about students. Generous on extra credit. The quizzes are not helpful, especially since they are random. Review sessions are not that helpful. Treats you like a little kid and does not take well to criticism. I would take someone else over here, in all honesty.

This class is a lot of work to keep up with if you want a good grade. She makes you do a lot of "out of classroom" projects and does random pop quizzes that make up a chunk of your grade. She's kinda difficult but if you're interested in this material it's not too bad. If there's another teacher to take 240 with, I'd recommend that instead

I liked this class. We had to do a lot of stuff outside of the classroom but I like how she tied it with the textbook stuff. I learned a lot from the out of classroom projects. She was always quick to respond via email too. She made it interesting.

This was a waste. I taught myself. SHe's a horrible teacher and only curved becaue over half her class was failing. I passed with a B BUT it was hard work and required reading reading and taking my own notes crossing my fingers that whatever i studied would be on the test.
i like her she has the same attitude as. she is not politicly correct and will tell you if your full of it no b.s approach i dig it
If you can not self teach she is not for you. Lectures have nothig to do with the test. Reviews for test are given, but basically student taught. Nice woman, bad teacher for a 100 level class.

Please don't take this teacher. By mid-semester, I learned that going to class isn't really helpful. If you do take her, take notes out of the book. She loves to show videos instead of lecture. Make sure to take notes from the video. I think she gets her test questions from the book's website's chapter tests.
she is kind of random.  depends on videos more than actually teaching

Well, I wouldn't refer this teacher to anyone unless you are willing to spend all of your time trying to come up with questions on your own that might show up on the tests. Class is more like a debate and talk hour than learning stuff relevant to police work. She's a really nice woman, but the teaching quality honestly was not good.
I wasn't sure I'd like this class but she made it really fun. She took us to Angola and tries to make lectures interesting. Her tests aren't all that hard either.
Absolute nightmare. This women is a beast and there is a presentation required at the end of the semester as well.
I took her Cj 101 on the internet and passed.  She os a great teacher and explain when needed.  Even though it was an internet course I still got to talk to her and understand the class.

I took this class cause I needed a gen ed and I had a late orientation. I really suck in history so I was hoping that this class would go well. Lectures are mainly the professor talking while following an outline she has on the board, which you can access on blackboard. If you go to lecture everyday and take good notes. Discussion was mandatory.
If you do not get the book you have to go to every lecture in order to get good grade on the exams. Not much work is graded to offer help with boosting your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Terrible class. The TA's aren't any help either. Lectures are extremely heavy. She doesn't allow any questions only until lecture is over. The book is $110 but helps on going over material. Prof reads off a sheet every lecture. Its up to you if your able to catch every word she says or not.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very easy class, just show up to lecture and discussion. She lectures with an outline on the board. She just talks and class takes notes. Anything that she repeats or puts an emphasis during her lectures is usually on the exams. She is very knowledgeable and knows what she is talking about. TA's are also very helpful and flexible.
not an easy A

If you want to "learn" history take this professor, if you want to pass choose another. There are slides that break down key events etc. Grading is unknown because the TA I've got didn't tell you what was wrong/right.  Mid term  1 ID & 1 Essay . Final  2IDs  & 2 essays. You will also be given another essay to do during the semester (4-5pages).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is a very relaxed and easy going professor if you are on her good side. If you are on her bad side, good luck getting an A. Getting an A is very easy in her class as her exams are basic and she lets you know what the main topics are. You learn a lot from her lectures because she lectures for 40 minutes and not 50 minutes like everyone else.
Her lectures are so boring and the slides are just a brief outline. Rarely went to lecture, discussion always helped. Pretty easy.

She may be easy for 100 level classes and some 400 levels, but her 300 was dissapointing. Almost felt like you were never good enough because you're not writing at her level. I've heard she was difficult but experiencing it myself was shocking.

This is not an unfair or hard professor--she wants you to succeed. Any unkind review posted here sounds like sour grapes.  She may miss a film day--but that is because she has seen it countless times.  Films--you get to see at least three different weeks!  They are great! Take this class! You will appreciate it on your next trip to Paris / France!

This is an excellent and highly professional professor.  I highly recommend this professor and course if one is interested in France, but also World War I, relations with Hitler's Germany, and World War II.  You don't find knowledgable historians of France to this degree.  She is also accommodating, and will understand if you slip up.
This class was very enlightened. I was able to have a greater understanding of the era. Professor Jordan is a pro in the French subject area and assist students when asked.

This class has led me to become a better researcher and writer. Professor Jordan is very knowledgeable in her field and assist students when they ask for it. Do the readings and if you are swamped with essays, if you ask she will work with you. Very helpful.

One of the worst professors I've ever had. Although her class was fairly easy, she turned out to be very mean and critical. She has a very "I'm much better than you" attitude and it shows. Attendance is a must! Never mind if SHE doesn't show up to class, it's you who has to show up!! Can't miss class - unless you are in your hospital bed..
Tests are based off lecture notes.  Go to lecture, take good notes, do well on tests and get an A.  Simple as that.  Relatively easy class.

Very good teacher.  Lectures keep you awake and they are very interesting.  Don't bother buying the textbook because you don't need it.  Do buy the class packet though.  There are only midterm and final which are not hard.  They are based very heavily on the lecture notes.  She is also very nice and answers questions after lecture.

This Prof. doesn't show up too much, won't help you too much, and is condescending when you can't do the kind of work that she can.  At least this is true for the 400 lvl classes.  I wouldn't recommend.

Not an easy teacher, but really knows her stuff. a very interesting speaker, but no class participation can make her lectures' go stale. If you want to learn history go here, if you want an ez A, try elsewhere.

Difficult for 100 level course but Jordan was a good teacher.  Getting a good TA is important.  I got an A but you have to work for it.  In class lecture/discussion is crucial, textbook usage is secondary.  Focus on lecture notes.
I had Ben as my TA so I ended up doing good. Took it as a Pass/Fail class.  Very easy.  Did barely anything at all.

don't really have to read the textbook or weekly readings.  1 paper ~4 pgs., not 2 bad.  1 mid and 1 final.  lectures are very helpful, really the basis for the class.  Midterm structure: 1 ID (~2 para.) and 1 ~4 blue-book pg. essay; she gives ~5 options.same format X2 for final  very nice person and very enthusiastic. gotta keep up w her for notes
Good teacher, writes everything on the board before lecture so it's very easy to follow her. She gave cumulative final question well in advance (but it was kind of hard).

I had Noelle (Nicole?) Jordan for a Nations and Nationalism History class. Three of us were in the class, but it wound up being a one-on-one because the other two were never there. History was not my field, so I struggled to keep up with her, but I hope she sees this to know that her meant a lot to me.

He is such a wise man. Very funny and helpful. You're allowed to have 4 unexcused absences and there's one paper that you work through the whole semester. Must pay attention in class and read through the book; there's a lot of material to cover. The T.A. is also very helpful!
Very good professor, MUST READ book. Recommended to go to class. Exams pretty easy, and class overall not hard. Very funny guy

He doesn't give you any notes you have to basically write them all while you are talking and he doesn't include half the stuff you are supposed to do in the syllabus and takes forever to respond to your emails. Avoid him it is a waste of your time.
The most intelligent professor I have ever had. He was clear about expectations and explanations. I hope Berkley realizes his genius.

Very knowledgeable about his stuff. He is not an easy professor by no means, but he is fair. Also, if you get above 90% on both of your midterms, you probably will not have to take the final. (which is cumulative) I didn't!
No Comments

Nice, helpful, kind, encouraging, cares about students! Accommodating and understanding of genuine emergencies. Always does her best to answer all kinds of questions. Japanese is hard, but I think Obana-sensei teaches it as simply and thoroughly as possible. 210 was taught in a mix of JP and EN, and both were simple and easy to understand.
Is very patient with students and has a good teaching style.
My favorite class and professor of all time.

Best Japanese professor I've had. Is very accommodating and helpful. Textbook is absolutely necessary for this class, and the workload is constant, but she answers all questions and does what she can to help you understand. Focuses equally on homework for all modes of language (speaking, writing, reading). Be prepared to participate in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: If you want to learn Japanese (a normally difficult language) you NEED to take her class. Across my 4 semesters of class, I learned a 4th language and she was my best teacher EVER for any language (sorry mom, sorry highschool spanish teacher), and one of my favorite educators. 10/10

She just came to UIC last Fall and I've gotta say I'm glad she came. She is the best professor ever! She's straight forward with her teaching, very enthusiastic, very helpful when it comes to grammatical mistakes, and I could go on. Everything helps: HW, quizzes, review guides, etc. She really sets you up for success in the class!

Obana-sensei is a great teacher! She's really good at explaining things. Assignments aren't too difficult. The occasional homework, quizzes, and tests. The hardest thing is the oral exam but that's only because I get nervous speaking on the spot. Great instructor! She makes Japanese fun!
I absolutely LOVED her!!!!! One of my faves ever! SO SO SO AMAZING, cannot recommend her enough- truly one of the best! She is a fabulous lady and so incredibly passionate.

Although the class itself is somewhat easy, she comes across as rude at times and even made me cry after one meeting. She gives criticism to students in front of the whole class on their assignments, and its uncomfortable for them. Attendance is required, yet she spends the time reading from slides and discussing her personal experiences.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Carmen is exceptional. She cares for all of her students, and it shows through her interest in individual student's well-being. Her passion for psychology makes learning very easy. I wish I could take every psychology class with her as the professor.

Dr. Ochoa was amazing! I have taken multiple classes with her and she is always superb. She only grades based on attendance, 1 paper, 1 exam, and 1 group project. She is very knowledgeable and cares for the futures of her students. I recommend taking a class with her as she is very experienced in her field.

Professor Ochoa had some of the best psych lectures I've ever heard in my scholastic career. She really cares about her students and emphasized the importance of mental health in college. Her exams are very straightforward because her study guides are made with great detail. Take this class with her if you are able to!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof.Galindo does not want her students to fail; however, in order to pass her class you have to put a litlle effort.  I recomm her class, she teaches base on her experience; definitely take her. Assistance is take base on minute pappers, they are random. Overall, good class

Professor Ochoa-Galindo is one of the best professors I have had at UIC. She really takes the time to explain material and wants you to do well in the class. PSCH 382 consisted of 5 short journal entries on blackboard, one paper submission, attendance, one group presentation, and one final exam that she gives a study guide for.

LOVED Dr. Ochoa-Galindo for PSCH270! She's so real and funny. Very knowledgeable and has interesting stories. Her lectures were also pretty interesting and exams were straightforward. Attendance is taken through 'minute papers' which are randomly assigned at her discretion throughout the semester. Great class!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Respected

reviews.comment: She will go over material if you don't understand. Attendance is required. textbook is required but not really used but i suggest getting it because it is 100% useful and is exactly what the class goes over. take 2 interview reports. she is very bold but not personally.

There is a lot of reading in this class around 2 chapters per week in the summer. Focus on reading, make sure you know the study guide like the back of your hand. The study guide is really straightforward and you will likely get an A. Although she can be a little rude at times, the class is pretty easy.

Her lectures are awesome! She talks about her real-life experiences. Some say she's "rude" but they're wrong! She challenges you to think more critically and that's good! You have "minute papers" which you don't know when will be given so it's important to show up to class. Honestly, though I never missed a class as it was always so interesting!

The class is easy. Put a little effort in, and youd get an A. Problem is with the Professors mannerisms. She isnt the nicest, and is one of those profs where the only excuse you can have is when youre in a hospital bed. Were literally experiencing a pandemic... You gotta be flexible because she definitely wont be.

She is so passive-aggressive. She does not make the test available when she said it should be and does not admit to her mistakes. We are not allowed late work or excuses, oh but she gets to have excuses. She does not upload presentations on time. There is a lot of homework but the grading is easy. Her live sessions are just rants.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Ochoa is seriously the most honest professor you will ever take and as you can see below some people might not like that. If you are ready to learn while also building a lasting relationship with a professor you need her in your life. She knows the ins and outs of this profession and will give you helpful advise.

Even though the class was an easy A, Professor Ochoa-Galindo can sometimes be really rude to her students. Additionally, she doesn't really lecture any of the class material, instead she uses lecture as a time to complain and give annoying mom lectures. Lots of homework, but an easy grader making It an easy A

I liked this class because she was understanding and wouldnt drown us in work. For test it was open note which is amazing, and she is picky on the way she wants her assignments done though such as APA style

Easy A if that's all you care about. I found her incredibly boring, rigid, and inside-the-box. She harped on and on about proper APA citation, prioritizing commas and periods more than the actual subject material. Topics were ones I'm very interested in, but she left me completely unimpressed. Had no original fruitful thinking. Very annoying.

Prof. Ochoa-Galindo is seriously the best of the best when it comes to psych. She is very funny and keeps you engaged with the material. She is not a hard grader and is very understanding. Participate! it is not mandatory but you will enjoy the class more if you do. The material is interesting. This might be my second rating on her.

Shes one of the best psch professors at UIC. Shes very knowledgeable in all the subjects she teaches and can easily relate a topic to real life situations. Shes one of few professors who actually has clinical experience in the psychology field. She also gives lots of extra credit. Shes very easy to communicate with!! 3 exams. 1 paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The professor is humorous and bold. However, she will make it known when she doesn't agree with you.

Boring lectures. Skipping will hurt your grade because she gives those mini quizzes to keep track of attendance. Participation does not matter - at all. You could raise your hand everyday in that class, and she won't remember who you are. If you're looking for an easy pass, this class is perfect. You'll learn nothing and come out with an A.
Professor Galindo is such a wonderful, charismatic professor who is very understanding to her students and grades fair. I would definitely recommend her.

She's super kind and full of knowledge. She talks about her personal experiences a lot, which makes class super fun and engaging. She opens up the class for discussions, which makes the class really interesting. I don't think there has ever been a boring lecture with her. She's helpful outside of class as well and wants the best for her students.
People say she's mean, but she's super honest and doesn't take excuses. She's very blunt and direct which I appreciate. She's funny and personable and you can tell she knows what she's talking about.

Pretty decent professor overall. Three exams, which she gives amazing study guides for, and a 5pg final paper make up majority of the grade. There's also 10 random in-class papers throughout the semester which make up about 20% of overall grade. She's always late, but lectures usually aren't boring. Also offers EC at the end of the semester.

in the beginning she may seem rude and act like the class is really hard, but one on one she is really nice, and the class is pretty easy. 1 paper, which is actually kinda fun. 3 test, use the SG, they are great and she writes the exam right off if them. 10 random in class papers, passfail for attendance does the lowest. Up to 45 CE points
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The lectures are interesting and exams are based exactly on the study guide she provides. Its helpful to have a textbook if you don't go to class because lectures are not posted on Bb. Her notes are almost copy pasted definitions from textbook and her class is very interactive filled with discussions. She gives extra credit too!

Hands down one of the best profs at UIC. She is very straightforward & can come off as rude but really she's just so honest and laid back and cares. She's very smart and experienced in the field. attendance not required but she has 6 random check in papers (minute papers) which give you points. 1 paper & 3 exams. You won't regret taking her!

Very intresting Class, I learned a lot just by coming to her class. All the materials were clear and the exams reflects the lectures given. The course was based on 3 Exams and one Esaay. If you pay attention and attend to class you will pass.
The lectures was well prepared and gives all the information that is needed for the exams. The class was based on 3 exams and one Essay.

This class was so easy compared to the other science classes at UIC. He reads off lecture slides in lecture, pointless to go, but occasionally he will give hints for exams during the lecture. He's monotone, so if you're not interested in biology it will be boring. I got an easy A in his class. The optional final is a combination of 3 previous exams

hes very hard, you have to know your stuff! bio is my major so i ended up with an A but it was one of the hardest A's i have worked for. he comes up with some ?s on the test that you dont know where they came from so read the book even though he says its mostly on lecture notes. uses lecture capture program

worst teacher at UIC. he needs to go back to school and learn how to teach his tests all SUCK his lectures all SUCK, the only good thing about this class was my LAB TA and thats IT. AVOID NYBERG your life will be miserable if you DONT its suppose to be BIO 101 NOT 401. WOW. i made a big mistake.

His lectures are pointless and boring with little to no reference to the text book.The lectures jump around from topic to topic with everything on power point. What information we were being tested on was not clear at all. Super boring and tough to follow. DO NOT TAKE!

The course if fairly difficult but more so because of the tests. Some of the test questions seem irrelevant to lecture material. The professor goes strictly by his powerpoint lecture slides and it makes for a very boring class. Especially with his monotonous voice.

Do not take this class whatever you do! I hear the professor was terrible but due to schedule conflicts I was stick. Worst class at UIC! Boring, pointless lectures, didn't learn anything, tests were way to hard for a 100 level class. DON'T TAKE NYBERG's CLASS!!!

He is the worst bio prof I've had! Nyberg opened up EXCEL files, showed his  facebook fishing pics, put random equations on the board without explaining them, etc. I felt like i was taking intro to excel and not ecology. He mentions maybe 2 things from his lecture handout. My advice- read the chapters and memorize his handouts- lecture is a waste.

Very unorganized, powerpoints were useless, lecture notes barely helped. In order for me to understand the calculations I had to look back at bio 100 notes from my roommate. He was a nice guy but he really didn't have a clue as to how to teach this class. Going to his office hours didn't help much either. For this class, try not to take him.
He is not a good teacher and his lectures are not organized. I would avoid him if you can.

I nearly answered 40 out of 44 questions on the final mentioned below me... I DREAMED, NYBERG! Regardless, Nyberg is pretty bad. I agree with the student below--all he does is ask questions to get students thinking, when in reality, all of us end up sleeping. His lectures are very ambiguous and deviates from the book at times. Avoid him if you can!

Nyberg was not that good of a teacher. Powerpoint slides were weird and seemed short, discusses the notes very briefly. I didn't find him too mean, but he is boring. His tests were pretty tricky which I thought I might fail the class. But thank god for his optional final which are just recycled questions from the 3 exams.

Nyberg really expects students to think critically and henceforth does not really clarify what material needs to be known. He promotes this ambiguity and his lectures basically consist of him asking irrelevant questions no one even acknowledges. His lectures contradict with the book a lot and that's one of the worst things a professor can do.

Dull, extremely quiet when lecturing, doesn't seem to really teach. His lectures rarely seem to deal directly with his notes. Also, I find him incredibly disrespectful at times, he recently emailed the class with this quote: "should you answer more than 40 of the 44 question correctly (dream on)". I just find that incredibly rude.

OK...i'a a senior now, that means 4 years of bio at UIC!!! looking back, Nyberg was the worst of all the bio professors! Boring, hard for no reason, and RUDE!!!! a 100 level class is not supposed to be that hard. If you can, stay away from him! And don't let him intimidate you!Biology can be fun!
Don't take him! He is mean and hard! He knows how to make a easy class hard. The exams are 50 mc but tricky. His lectures are BORING. Take Molumby.

I actually liked this teacher. His tests will seem hard if you try to memorize the slides and read the book a week before. I was not interested in biology but I think he made it kind of fun. I got a B and didn't go to lectures very often, maybe you should. And he was helpful giving important hints and review questions for the exams.

Rude, boring, and mutters to himself. However, people that say he is difficult are not putting in effort. Tests are almost all from the powerpoints -- just memorize those and you've got a B already. 2nd test is hardest of all but Nyberg gives optional final which is 100% old questions.

He's not as bad as some people make him out to be. He can be helpful if you approach him. Don't bother asking detailed questions in lecture though. His tests were relatively easy as long as you study his powerpoints, and read some of the book. The workload wasn't bad either. I'd say he's worth taking if you're willing to put in some effort.
Nyberg's cass is really boring, and you really don't need to go.  The tests come straight from his lecture notes.  Memorize these, and you should be fine

read read read before and after coming to class. refers to all kinds of crazy essays in the chapters on the exams. not weighted and very unsympathetic. lectures are incredibly boring, even for this bio major. just go to class!

ok so for all the bio mafor if you acctually start with this class u will hate the rest of ur UIC bio path that lies ahead.... this teacher is the most boring menber of the departement and i wanna guess of the school. He found a way to make clear material hard. The lectures are pontless and his slides are more of an outline.pick another teacher!

You need to basically memorize his slides word for word. The third optional final saved my grade. You can make sure you get a perfect on his prblem sets by asking for help during his office hours. But the labs are a mess and the TA (Graham) didn't do a good job clarifying instructions.

To get a good grade in his class you have to attend the lectures, read the text, and go over his notes. This isn't an easy class, he doesn't curve and the class average on the exams were between 40-46 out of 80. The lectures are boring b/c he reads the notes word for word. It difficult to get an A in this class, this class is 2/3 math.

I had to use my math skills more for this class than think about biology. If monotone professors put you to sleep, don't go to his lectures. You're better off memorizing everything from his lecture slides. Memorization is the key to passing this class instead of actually understanding it. Sad isn't?

If you have an intelligence greater than that of a second grader, DO NOT take this class. It will drive you insane. Nyberg is boring, mean-spirited, tough on grading though the material does not warrant it... all in all, worst class I've ever taken. Save yourself now.

yeah, so the class is boring, and his voice is annoying. but if you got to take the class I suggest print the lecture notes and just study from them, you dont have to come to lecture. the TA that i got would explain certain problem in discussion, so that helped. what you get in the class you probably deserved.

Just annoying, wouldn't bump me up to an A even though I did his extra lab report and got an A on the final. I only missed one by 2 points. He reads his lectures straight from the power points however his voice is remarkably annoying.

horrible...pointless to attend the class. Rather stay at home and make your time usefull. He will only read the notes to you he is posting on line. It's easy to get an A though...but you will have to teach yourself the material couse he will not do it for you

Ok, this guy was only boring because he teaches BIO 101 with deals with stats and population (of course its boring compare to BIO 100). In his lectures, just listen because it'll help u understand the material better when u read the book (which no one does). Study the book and slides. I actually failed every exam we took and still got a C.
sooooo boring!...Make sure you read his lecture notes, and memorize them. I never even opened the book and got an A...

It is not really Nybergs fault. Biology 101 is kinda dry and boring... If you compare him to molumby i think you can prolly see nyberg is a piss poor teacher but, he does scare students away from biology.

Nyberg doesn't teach.  He reads directly off of his notes which are simple and just common sense.  When a student has a question he passes the question onto another student to answer.  His test is not hard if he would word the questions in a better manner.  I am wondering what he is asking about 80% of the time when taking a test.  HE IS HORRIBLE!!
Just because a class is posed, does not necessarily mean that he has a right to disregard it.

This man has no business teaching. The comment before mine is right--he HATES teaching, and he treats students like crap. HALF the class just failed the first exam--that should never happen, and would not happen if Nyberg was a decent prof. The lab book is full of typos and incomplete instructions. AVOID THIS CLASS.
Nyberg is rude and openly hostile to students, and tests are almost impossible to pass. he obviously resents having to teach, and taskes out his resentment on his students. AVOID HIM AT ALL COSTS.

so he wasn't all that hard......u gotta study ur ass off but hellllloooo it's college.....his exams aren't bad if u study his notes. u have to study the nit-picky details that normally you would just skip over.  no need to read the book cuz there's only like one question from there on the test.  his lectures are unbelievably BORING but learn 2 deal
Take molumby

One friend told me that she took his class, and she hated it. She also told me that Dr. Nyberg one time yelled at a student for not showing up to the exam on time. I agree with those who thought that he was bad. That is why I hate Biology.

Alright people..if you're in his bio 101 class.Go shoot yourself.I can safely say if it wasn't for the TA's everyone would've failed his class..exam average is a failing grade. make sure you take all the labs..Don't go to class..you're not missing anything..unless you want to sleep..he will put you to sleep. I swear he will..suck up to the T.A's.

okay i was told this class was going to be easy. its not easy, but technically it shouldnt be. people hated this class because they put no effort into it. if you even put the slightest amount of effort it, it will pay off. hes not as bad as everyone says he is, you are all stupid.

At the begining of the semester, i didn't think it was at all possible to make the lectures any more boring, but as the semester progressed, Dr.Nyberg proved me wrong. You wouln't know by coming to his lectures that he has any interest in what he teaches, nor does he care for his students. Thank God for good TA's !

The absolute worst UIC professor I've ever had! He makes this class so much worse then it is.  We were actually told by the ta that the more caffiene you drink, the better your grade will be! How sad is that!
ahhhhhhaaaaaaaaaaaaaa kill me!!!!!!
terrible lecturer, worst i have ever had

A truly horrible man.  Genuinely surprising because every other ecology prof I've had has been so nice.  This guy doesn't even pretend he cares about this class.  Treats you like a waste of his precious time.  Avoid this if you can, but it is pretty easy to ace, just cause he doesn't care enough to make it hard.
This man is repellent. He takes a moderately interesting subject sucks the life out of it.

He's not that bad. The class is boring but come on, it's simple biology. If you have a good background in biology this class should be simple for you. He's not as interesting as he could be but he does try to supplement the material with his own experiences.
Just sit in his class to laugh at his lecture style.  That's about it.

This guy isn't as bad as people make him out to be.  I believe he is very much into conservation and environmental issues though I may be wrong...  His exams were not that bad either.  People say he was boring though I don't think he was (that could be bec
he is the worse prof at uic. i had him my fr yr and i was sooo disappointed. he was rude, mean, boring, and his lectures were horrific
boring but exams were easy as hell

He's one of the most boring teachers to listen to. He's extremely obsessed with prairies, as had been said above. I almost commited suicide in his lecture. Do NOT take him if you want to get a good grade without busting your @$$ for nothing.
his lectures were very boring...the tests were hard...but i suppose going to class would be fun...but i dunno..his lectures are gruesome to sit through

WORST TEACHER IN THE WORLD.  SO BORING YOU'D WANT TO KILL YOURSELF.  I'VE EVEN CONTEMPLATING BURNING HIS SACRED STUPID PRARIRE BIOS IN GOLF, IL.  I NEEDED A B, and I WAS OFF 10 points, JERK DIDN'T ACCEPT ANY OF MY ANS WHICH I FELT WERE IN THE BOOK. NO B.

Wasted $100 on book, test was only off his notes. Very unhelpful. A student asked a question in lecture and he said, "just because a question is posed doesn't necessarily mean it's a good one." You can get an A with hard work, but find another p
Take this class with someone else. Possibly the worst prof ever.
Boring! Obsessed w/praries and everything plant related, most likely you'll have to cut.
Not a cool professor

He's pretty easy but very boring. Always have an angry face on. He would read directly from the powerpoint and he had horrible spelling! But best of all, his notes are online, so I never had to go to lecture for the first half of the semester.

possibly THE worst science teacher ever. He scheduled the review session during my lab time, didn't respond to any emails, and his lectures were disorganized and hard to follow along. Unless you are REALLY interested in prairies, skip this one.

This professor is the least caring professor I've had at UIC. I could go on and on, but during COVID we were not reached out to at all by him. To him: Research > Teachin

reviews.comment: At the beginning of the semester, all the lectures were uploaded. We had 4 quizzes with unlimited retake but his grading system was awful. 16 points from the quizzes and the rest is from the final, and originally wanted 76-80 points for an A. He offered no resources to prep for the final and wasn't very present for this class and was rude by email

One 10 minute long prerecorded lecture for an entire week of material. No assignments, only auto-graded quizzes on blackboard. Tried to change the syllabus a week before finals so you could only miss 2 questions (4 points in the entire class) to get an A Didn't include the final exam date or format on the syllabus and when I asked he got angry.

The class is lecture heavy and very boring. He uses a micfrosoft word dock as his lecture slides. He usually does not teach the entire hour and 15 mins of class. 3 Exams, a group project paper, and small activities. Using the book is helpful, but not neccessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very passionate about what he teaches. Very kind and helpful when things are difficult to understand. psych

-Difficult to understand and hard to stay awake. -Lecture presentations are specific to him, and difficult to follow at times. -I stopped going and just read from the book & reviewed the slides with friends.

He is a very nice professor but his lectures are pretty boring which causes students to stop showing up half way during the semester, which in turn causes him to cut lectures short. his class is very easy all labs he gives for hw are very easy points if you just complete them. study power points for tests and you'll be fine.

Professor Ohlsson is a pretty unorthodox professor. His lectures end early and exams are only 20 questions. 40 of the 100 points in the class are basically completion points and the other 60 are exams. For the final, you have the option to retake exam 1, 2, or both aside frome exam 3. Class is all concepts and boring at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This guy is a great professor, obviously knowledgeable on the topic. Lectures were supposed to run for 75 minutes but he would be done in 30-45 on average so meeting 2X was chill. Exams are all conceptual, so truly need to understand the topic. BOOK NOT NEEDED! BEST ADVICE: go to lecture and truly conceptualize all the examples he gives & thats it

Overall, I found this course to be interesting. Prof Ohlsson does a good job at explaining the material. I never really went to lecture and still managed to get a B. The book helps a lot with understanding the material so it is highly recommended to read and keep up with his lectures.

If you need this for the bio psych requirement then I suggest you take this class. It's pretty easy, but at times lectures were boring and the professor would be done with the lecture and go on and on. He's a cool professor; however, I am just not a cognitive psych type of person. Overall, it's pretty easy, just do all the assignments and study.
Professor ohlsson doesn't care about his students at all. I'm coming from experience please don't take any class with him or else you will regret it.

One of the most horrible professor I've taken at uic. He doesn't explains well. On top of that his syllabus isn't clear at all. He have written assignments on which its barely impossible to pass since he don't explain them at all. And once you write them up instead of giving feedback he fails you on it. He treats every student unfair.

Professor Ohlsson really knows his material and makes the content easy to follow during lectures. I really enjoyed going to lecture it helped me a lot to do well on the exams. There are 3 exams and during the 3rd exam you can retake the previous ones for a higher grade. Homework assignments are easy. Cares about the students succeeding! Funny too!
He is a helpful professor, but nothing special. He has his own point system, which makes it very hard to get an A, but easy to get a B.

The topics discussed in this class are very interesting.The exams are difficult because there's so much material to go over. Some questions are so detailed; it forces you to not only know a concept, but to also have the capability to apply it to test questions. I do recommend this class and professor if you want to learn.
Great professor. Interesting class. Multiple choice exams with relatively easy material as long as you pay attention.
Not that hard of a class. All assignments graded off completion, not content. and out of the 3 exams, you get to retake the first 2.

Great Professor- and very witty humor which keeps class interesting. Very helpful and does a great job making sense of difficult topics. Never read from the book and got A's on the tests-most of everything comes from the slides. Would recommend him- he is a wonderful Professor
He is a great professor!!! I enjoy his lectures and his exams a quite easy for those who attend lecture and read the book. Highly recommend him!

This is by far the most boring class I have ever taken. I never attend class because it is sooo useless and boring. The assignments are also really ridiculous, like a 3000 word learning report that he basically just wants a recap of his book. Arrogant and terrible teacher. Do not take this class!!

I thought he was medicore at best. I took him for 352 and really liked him, so I decided to enroll in his 354 course. I was rather disappointed with the course. Contray to what the others ratings claim, you have to go to class to get an A, but pulling off a B is easy.
Dr. Ohlsson is a great teacher.  He's such an impressive scientist and he enjoys passing on his knowledge to future researchers.

I agree on his arrogance, but when I ask him a question or need help, he is always responsive. 354 is a little bit more dry than 352, but you really don't need to go to class , just read the handouts and the ppt slides and you will be golden.
Take him! He is interesting and the class is not very hard. There are 2 tests (20 multiple choice) and a final. He is very nice and the subject is interesting.
He is kind of arrogant, other than that  the class is pretty cool.

Boring class but he can be funny sometimes.  The tests are pretty tough-confusing questions and only 20 questions.  The papers are graded easily and the online homework is really easy. Testbook not needed-just need to buy a code for the online homework.

Stellan is a great lecturer , makes you want to go to class. The class is very easy compared to other psych courses and if you do the work you are bound to get an A. I went to every lecture and received really high grades on the exams. I think the first exam is pretty tough, but they get easier.
Professor Ohlsson is great,so is his British accent! The material is very interesting and extremely helpful!Tests are fair assignments are easy and interesting!

This guy is boring as hell...I mean the material is not very interesting to begin with but this guy makes it worse...However the class is very and if you study and do the stupid assignments you are bound to get an A
Great Professor.  Lectures were both engaging and fascinating.  The tests were interesting, but not that bad.  I looked forward to going to this class even though attendance was not required.

nice guy/interesting class. I agree his exams are necessairly the easiest since they go outside the norm of most psch exams(He tests on what you understood rather then memorization). I recieved a 17/20 on all 3 of the exams just do your work and u should get a A

I don't know what to make of this guy. As a professor he is really good makes you want to go to class. However outside of the classroom I found him to be a little atrrogant. Overall this class was very interesting but, I don't know if I just have a bad impression about him or if others feel the same way. I found him to be a little hostile

Memory and Cog thinking is a hard subject to understand, but this prof made it easy to understand. Loved the lecture experiments he'd perform on us, loved the writing assignments (no big res-papers like the other psch courses), & loved his grading scale. Even thou his exams were hard, just do all the CogLabs and hw for an easy A. Mr.Ohlsson Rocks!!
very nice man. lectures were a little boring and all notes were posted online. online labs were easy points.

I like that the class isnt just based on exams. U still have to do work to earn a good grade, but it's not all that hard. Lectures are kinda boring but he posts his notes online and the questions are straight outta there
i like him alot. he basically gave u the opportunity (thru optional activities) to get an A if u were willing to work for it. i would take a class with him again. he also is very nice n helpful.

He was a great instructor, but the wording of his tests were vague and confusing. I honestly think that if it had not been for the activities, a lot of people might have either gotten C's or D's in his class. At least the other points besides the exams helped. Thank you, Dr. Ohlsson for a great semester.

Good professor, though I do agree that his exams are difficult. However, if you do all of the cativities, veen if you do not do well on the tests, at least the remaining 5 points will help you pass the class.
I never had him in a lecture course, but I've worked as a research assistant for him and he's a really great guy.  And please note that his first name is NOT Steve, it's STELLAN.
Exams are tough even if you go to lecture, but he makes it so that you will at least have an 80% by the final week of class.

She was an amazing lecturer. Albeit she would make occasional mistakes while solving the sums, but she was very clear in what she was teaching. She is also very lenient. I did not buy the textbook because I learnt the syllabus by doing homework on my math lab. Just make sure you try to score 100% on quizzes and homework and you'll be fine!

Professor Oh is a nice person but that doesn't mean she's the best lecturer. She knows her stuff but she has sort of thick accent. TAs weren't a great help. Homework after each lecture. This class is the definition of "I'll just teach myself at home."

Make sure you do the assigned homework prior to coming for lecture otherwise, it will be difficult to follow. But the teacher does teach at a relatively slow pace so it shouldn't too bad. There are around like 8 quizzes but the 2 lowest quiz grades are dropped.

This is one of the worst professors I ever had. He was a harsh grader and I wrote my papers around his comments and still got bad grades. No students should take this professor unless you like getting bad grades for no reason.

It was hard to understand what he wanted from you. I was entirely disappointed with this professor. This is literally the worst professor i ever had my entire life. He doesn't clarify much at all when it comes to the papers and is even worse when you go to him to ask for help on an assignment. Very inspirational

Best professor at UIC, really cares about students and whether they pass or fail. He's very helpful and always willig to explain things, take advantage of his office hours.

One of the best professors at UIC.  PHysics is not an easy class, but with Ogut it is made easier.  He knows exactly what he is doing and explains things very well and clearly.  He is the best professor I have ever had thus far at UIC.  He takes the time to help every student if needed.
Very clear and helpful!  Great teacher, even at 8:00 AM.

take him before the class gets full, makes physics so much more clear and even better to understand

Took him my freshman year (2017-2018) for ECON 120 and 121. I've seen a lot of reviews about how his online classes were terrible, and I can definitely understand that. In person, his lectures were pretty easy. As long as you pay attention and go to exam reviews held by the TA's you should be fine.

Save your braincells and take this course at a community college and transfer the credit instead. Seriously.
