She's average and talks about things that doesn't help relate with the lecture. Prepare to work alone if you can't find a group with excel projects or discussion board. She takes long or doesn't respond to any emails u send her.
Yaps about random stuff and talks way too much about stuff that doesn't affect the class. Nice lady but average teacher.
A good teacher, she is pretty cool, nothing to be super aware of. Her lectures are mostly group work, having to do Excel projects or discussion boards with your group that she assigns.

She is the sweetest woman ever! She's really passionate about teaching and wants every student to succeed. A lot of assignments in this class are on Excel, but the peer mentors and the prof will help you if you ask. The exams are identical to the homework. It's not a hard course if you actually come to class instead of doing attendance from home.

Mr. Wilson is lecture heavy and notes aren't posted online so making a friend in that class is crucial. Other than that, it was somewhat easy. The whole day is just slides with notes. You get a cheat sheet for each exam including the final and there's extra credit too.

Attendance is important because he doesn't post the notes and writes them in the smallest font possible, making it hard to read. He distributes a study guide with a large amount of content, covering only about 5% of the material that will be on the exams. If you are a STEM major, consider reconsidering whether to take this class.

Attendance matters. He won't send his notes, and since there is no textbook for this class, you have to attend class to receive the content. He provides a study guide for the test that lists the terms you should know, but it doesn't cover everything that will be on the test. Overall, I really enjoyed this class because he made it interesting.
Has anyone take IDS 400 from him?

Super fun professor, easy grader, very light course load and relaxed class environment. Although Shin's very knowledgeable on his subject matter, he doesn't really teach much in his classes. He also does not offer written feedback on your work explaining your grade, which can be difficult. He's very understanding and chill with his students though.
He is a very chill and funny professor, easy grader and won't expect a lot from you in terms of quality of work and won't assign a lot of work either.
Very easygoing and a genuinely good guy. I hate literature and his fiction class has been the only English class I liked at UIC.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was easy and boring. But very nice guy. Animated, funny, and sincere. Don't mess around though. Shin genuinely loves his students and understands them being lazy, but will never give you A if you mess around. Just be frank with him and he will help you. To me, he has been the only professor who seems to know how students feel in college.

He was funny and very chill. Sometimes it did feel like he had favorites though. I participated more than most in the class but for some reason, I got a sense that he did not like me. I did well on all of my assignments but still somehow ended up with a B in probably one of the easiest classes I've ever taken in my life. Super strange.

He really values participation of any kind, he's super lenient with deadlines and overall a really great person. He's willing to get to know students outside of class and takes time out of his schedule to help students who are struggling. Thing about his class is actually a lot of reading and attendance. Just show up, talk to him. You'll be fine.
Easy A. 4 writing assignments and homeworks are mostly readings. Some of those are tedious. Just don't make too many absences and submit everything on time.

Tries way too hard to be liked by students. Takes off points without telling you why + he tries to blow it off like it is no big deal when u ask him. Turned in extra credit but didn't put them in and when I asked him to bc he said I didn't need them. Easy class but if you want the A put effort in your essays. He gives you 6 absences
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took 160 and 161. Very nice teacher. If you hate this guy, you must be jackass who really try hard to fail or want A without doing any work. He will give you reading and writing assignments (some of the reading were difficult and some writings were tedious) but it is a guaranteed A if you don't mess around. I will take his class anytime if I could.

Professor Shin creates a safe environment by being kind and relatable to many if not all of the students within his class. Due dates for assignments are crystal clear, though the grading parameters are loose. Shin would like students to have a meaningful take away from his course that isn't just the content that is laid out by the university.

Shin is one of the sweetest, most respectful, yet the dorkiest professors on campus. Take a class with him and talk to him if you have any chance. I never expected that I would like an English teacher. Expect some reading and writing but he makes them easy. My friend in his other class had crush on him this semester but sadly he will never know!
He is too sweet and you might need a dentist

The best english teacher I had in my life is from Korea lol He made time outside of class for me as well as the entire class. He not only helped me with the essay for this class but also my philosophy class' essay. When I missed most Wednesdays and frequently Fridays, he sent me an update via email. He even came to watch my basketball game!

Just an absolute sweetheart, reliable man, who genuinely cares about his students. Expect some writing but if you stay on top of your work, it's a guaranteed A. Plus, he will listen to you. You'll want him to be your brother.

He is such a good guy. I would turn in things late because I do not like writing essays but shin always understood and he would always cheer me up and encourages me to do it. If you have a choice to pick English 161 choose him

LOOVE HIM! dropped 161 before and taken this for the second time! ATTENTION UIC PEOPLE: take his 161 classes!! his class will save you from the messy semester. you can't ask for better man! hes such a good man who loves his students. plus he really reads your paper

Shin is a friendly guy. He gives a lot of slacks to freshmen? This class was literally the only class that I did not have to worry about anything lol He is a fair grader though. And wants you to do your work. Just do what he says and give him things on time. He gives good feedback especially when you work on the paper. It is either an easy A or F.

Labs are brutal, they take forever so be prepared. Straightforward, no tricks and exams are very similar to study guides. Attendance is marked per class, 55 total and each absence is subtracted by 55, but its only worth 5%. I am not sure why everyone keeps talking about his personality, he is a monotone strange guy and crashes out occasionally.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great professor. He's super chill & funny. He tries to make class as engaging as possible. using Kahoots for most of his lectures which makes them so much better. Workload is pretty balanced though it can pile up if you don't pay attention to it. He's very knowledgeable on the subject & likes to talk about his work a lot which is a nice touch.

One of the most kind-hearted CME professors by far. Makes the class pretty straightforward and easy to learn while letting you retain important engineering knowledge. He posts all his lectures in full every day in case you missed anything. He does Kahoots in class which are extra credit as well to make sure you pass. Schulenberg is a GOAT

Though the professor has extensive knowledge of statics, I feel he did not properly pass the knowledge to the students, which resulted in extremely low exam scores.  I felt students were basically to teach themselves but then come to class just to do practice problems for the content he did not teach yet. I wish he explained while he did examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is highly unorganized. He copied the syllabus for this course from last year, did not change any dates at all, meaning all of the dates for our homework assignments, essays, quizzes were all wrong. Rubrics aren't clear, takes points off for things not on rubric. The structure of the class just wasn't it. He gave two final essays.
If you put in the work and do all of the assignments then youll get an A easily. The only thing I disliked is that you cant pick your own groups.
Best professor in the department. Gives weekly quizzes and assignments and two projects through the semester. Has a lot of videos to help with them as well. Easy A
i didn't learn a lot from it.

This Professor is awesome. he is very straight forward about what he wants students to do on the assignment and grades fairly in class. very easy going. always ask for help when you need it he'll make things easier definitely would take it again

Breeziest class Ive ever taken. This class is definitely an easy A if you put any type of effort. His weekly assignments do require some programs but youll be fine if you have windows or a MacBook. He also uses excel a lot so you might wanna learn the basics of it but this class is still very easy.

Hands down the best teacher at uic. Even though this class was online because of covid, he made it run smoothly and was the easiest class out of all my classes. Labs are kinda tough so make sure to spend time on it. Quizzes and 1-2 discussions every week. Lot of assignments but theyre not too difficult. I would definitely take him again
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Labs are hard, but make sure to choose your group, otherwise you'll end up with someone who doesn't want to do anything. Use TA office hours. Quizzes are easy and similar to homework, pay attention during review sessions.

Nice guy, good teacher take him if you can. Labs are very hard though, especially if your group members aren't the best. Take advantage of TA office hours on hw and labs. Quizzes very similar to hw. Tests and quizzes aren't bad, but you still need to study
Straightforward.  Clear from day one what we would be evaluated on.  Will retake for 311 if possible.
Material is tough. Study hard. He is a good professor. I did very well in class by reading the book before lectures and studying by doing sample problems out of the book.

Professor Schulenberg is easily the best teacher I've had at UIC. He does an excellent job letting you know the course material that is most important and pertinent to your future scholastic and professional career. If you get a chance, definitely sign up to take a course with him. Just one of the nicest guys I've ever had the pleasure to meet.

Best engineering teacher i've had at UIC. He is easy not because he cuts corners, but because he is so clear and easy to understand. About as reasonable as they come.Do the homework and take notes. The inclass problems are the key to the exams.
Best Professor I've had in any engineering course. Study from the in-class problems.
Easily the best professor I've had here at UIC. The in class problems he hands out are what you can expect to see on tests since he writes them.
very easy teacher and easy all the way
One of the best teachers I've had. He makes the material easy and easy to follow. Do the homework, and pay attention in class and you'll be fine.
He's actually a very good professor.  Do homework because he takes attendance based off of it.  I recommend just paying attention in class and reading the book.

This guy is a pretty good teacher. class gets held up a lot by stupid questions but he does his best. DEFINITELY do the HW, and come to class to pick them up. its not worth too many points but he does attendance based on who was in class to get their HW back. Take him if you can.

Although extremely knowledgable in her field, she was an extremely harsh grader and did not accept any excuses for misunderstandings, a minute past deadline, or even if she didn't provide proper instruction.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Came back to review the course after Fall 25 and highly recommend!
I am currently enrolled in her course. So far, so good! I will come back to do a review after the Fall 25 semester.

Took PSCH 381 and was nervous about it with 47 students in it and hearing about the course. I really had to get out my own head! The course is challenging and the professor was caring and made it her way to connect with students. Lots of extra credit and tons of practice if you want to work with people for your career.

Just take the course! She is direct, approachable, and gives a lot of feedback. She also asks about feedback during every lecture which relieved me and my classmates. It was a challenging course but there was extra credit, curved grades, and no one received less than a C on any assignment, even at your worst.

I wanted post about PSCH 381 after grades posted. I enjoyed the course  lectures, the TAs, and her passionate talks about her work. I did not have paperwork for my anxiety and she met with me multiple times when I reached out about the class, even after hours. I see myself as a counselor now after our interviews!

If you are trying to go into the counseling field and a mentor, take her course. I asked around before taking her course because of my disabilities and I honestly thought she was the most direct, kind, flexible, and fair teacher in the psychology department. She also curves assignments and gives so many extra credit points!

Professor Searcy was a great professor. I really enjoyed the in class activities as well as the labs. She was always accessible, mentored students, had outside speakers come in the course, and gave a lot of opportunities for extra credit. 

I would highly recommend taking PSCH 381 or 382 if you want to go in the psychology field.

Best psychology course taken at UIC! Professor Searcy is extremely personable, and truly cares. 

Grading is fair and she is attentive to all student needs despite the rigor of the course.

I would take again!

Extremely tough professor. Students had to beg for a rubric. Sample papers were provided, only to be told later that it is  "b" paper and should not be followed. Needlessly strict about participation (i.e. if you step away for more than 5 minutes, you will lose points). No leniency at all. Be prepared for wanting to rip your head off
The professor is hard and doesn't accommodate to students situation due to not "babying" us.

Dr. Searcy offered valuable insight into the field and her research/work as a whole, which was super interesting when she talked about it in class! However, her rubrics were impossible to understand and she made communicating with her outside of class difficult. Additionally, her grading was unfair and unclear. Super cool person but meh class.

Dr. Searcy was an ok lecturer but often deviated from the lesson or syllabus. We were told we would be given sample papers to use as a guide for assignments, but we were never given any and left to figure it out based on questionably written rubrics. There were opportunities for extra credit, but they were sporadic and not guaranteed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Searcy is amazing and very approachable! She offers extra credit and as long as you engage and make yourself seen you will not have a difficult time!

Professor Saka was an amazing professor. He really cares about his students and wants them to succeed. His teaching is also very retainable and not boring. His class is very engaging and participation is important. The class structure is also very well laid out. Take his class! :)

Honestly one of the best professor I've had in UIC. He is super nice and caring for his students. He some how finds way to keep everyone active and engage in a fun manner. I recommend this class for sure! Attendance is not needed but you would have to go to understand the content better. 2 exams and a group project that lasts the whole semester.
He is always caring students. And class is pretty easy. If you like to communicate with other students, you must take his class.

Great professor! Take him. Very easy class, very interactive, participating is fun because he's very welcoming and nice. Exams and presentations are very straightforward. He Acknowledged rate my prof, which to me is a green flag! LOL
Take his class, he is the coolest professor! His class does not need a textbook, but for me, a textbook would help much for exams. His lectures were fun and understandable! He is amazing!

Professor Saka is one of the best instructors at UIC. He's extremely smart and it's easy to tell that he enjoys teaching. His lectures are engaging and insightful. Trust me, you won't be bored in his class. He gives amazing feedback. The class is well-organized. 3 exams, and a fun group project (paper). Show up, take notes, and the A is yours!

Professor Saka is the best professor I've had at UIC. He cares about his students and is very easy going. He gives great lectures that are relevant to current day subjects and the course itself is not difficult. He was understanding when I had two big mishaps during the course, and I wish more professors were exactly like him. Take his course!

He's a super chill dude, doesn't have any homework for this class besides one Marketing Failure Assignment which was actually fun to do. There are 3 exams just utilize his slides and you'll pass they're extremely easy. There's a semester-long project and you present for about 5-7 mins at the end of the year as your final. A 10/10 professor!

Professor Saka was one of the best professor I ever had! He was super friendly and offered help. One of his classes he talked about how to interview for internships. His final project was fun and, he is a easy grader. There are 3 take home tests but, not hard just pay attention/read slides. Also, he is easy on the eyes :)

Best Professor I ever had. Super understanding and, gives amazing lectures. I am never bored during lecture. He gives extra credit but, I don't think you will need it the class is easy. One big project at the end of the semester but, gives class time to work on it. Overall, recommend this course and professor :)

Took Professor Saka for MKTG462 this summer, though it was only offered online. Just do the work, and youll get an easy A. Weekly quizzes, and quite a bit of writing to do but not lengthy. He responds quickly on emails if you have questions and grades quickly too. He is very detailed about what he wants and would highly recommend taking his course

Kate is absolutely amazing. Her teaching can be kind of intense, and I know a lot of students tend to take it personally. As long as you do the work and communicate with her often, you won't have a problem. I'm grateful to have had her as an instructor. I learned so much from her course that I'll definitely be taking with me into my own classroom.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Has this rule where if you are late 10 minutes twice, it will count as a full absence. The class is an hour and fifteen minutes NOT fifty. I was late completing student observation hours and travel time on the cta is an hour and 15. I got to class at exactly 12:10. No grace and I lost a day I could have used in case of an emergency. Good luck
Kate was one of the best professors that I've had the pleasure of having at UIC. If you're in the teaching of English program, do yourself a favor and take her class; you won't regret it.

Although I appreciate her help, she can come across as really passive aggressive. Whenever she reviews my work, I get some good feedback... amongst a lot of nit-picky comments. She is assignment heavy despite knowing the "rigor" and time student teaching requires. She also struggles with meeting students where they're at in terms of mental health.

this class is about teaching HS but she treats you like you're in HS, nice person everyday, but lacks empathy when it counts, cares only about deadlines & bottom lines, hw overload, something due every class, if you're someone who struggles with mental health, she will sympathize to your face but still hit you with a B/C, think she likes that too

UIC should really consider on who they hire for their English faculty. My friends and I witnessed passive aggressiveness from her and uncomfortable vibes. It was times she would talk over you and will ignore what you say not to mention she moves at face paced for no apparent reason. UIC I am disappointed!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: dr sjostrom is very nice! she can be a little over eager, and oftentimes tries too hard to relate to students, but i much prefer that over a prof who doesn't care. she gives a good amount of time for every unit and takes pleasure in giving specific feedback that will help you improve. i learned a lot from her so far!

She's very intelligent professor that I learned a lot from. She definitely knows her stuff; however, she is a really tough cookie when it comes to grading. She is very specific and nit picky when it comes to little things like grammar and clarity of sentence structure in writing. She is super sweet and fun in class if you get on her good side.

Professor Shaw is an inspiring professor who encourages students not only to understand the material but also to truly engage with it in ways that make it applicable to our own lives and future educational and career aspirations. Beyond that, she truly does care about us!!

Lectures were amazing. Make sure to be in class because she assigns random in-class activities throughout the semester. Dr. Shaw is extremely knowledgeable and makes difficult topics very approachable.

Dr. Shaw is one of the most considerate professors I've had at UIC. She prioritizes student safety, especially regarding ICE resources. Her lectures are engaging. Attendance isn't required, but it helps since ~12 in-class activities occur at random. Three exams (skip the third if you ace two) and five papers with easy early parts.

I would not have enjoyed this course as much as I had if Dr Shaw hadn't taught it. Her insight and knowledge of community psych is fascinating. She is a genuine, kind person with real compassion for other people. Def recommend if you are interested in psych/pub health/etc. Don't take if you plan to skip lecture, lots of in class assignments.
SHES AMAZING!!!!!!!! I 10000000% recommend her !!!!

A great general course or psych course to take. The way the course and grading is set up truly helps every that takes this class succeed. The professor is marvelous: she provides free readings for the course and is very understanding.

Professor Shaw is a very good professor that is beyond anything else professional. She addresses her TA's as an "instructional team" and her students as "colleagues", which I feel helps in preparing students for the future. Your grade is determined by 3 essays, 3 tests, a Topic of Interest, and 12 In class participation assignments. Lowest dropped.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was very annoying and always talked to us like children. She and Professor Abu Naser would switch, but their lectures were very boring, and no one would really pay attention. They grade you on so many things, and you have to use iClicker, but they hide the questions so you can't see them from home. If this class is required, don't take it.

Professor is very nice and caring however, she puts way too much brand new information in just one lecture, doesn't really give students enough time to comprehend the information. If ur not a science major, the material is so hard to genuinely understand. if you want leniency u have to keep in communication with her.

This professor taught the class like it was a preschool class and I mean that in the best way possible. Having more difficult topics explained to me in that manner stripped them of their intimidating nature, and made harder subjects feel more approachable. The class always had a good vibe to it and tests were always straightforward.

Super sweet and caring and makes sure to get to know students! The homework wasn't too bad. The exams weren't too hard, but I don't think she prepared us too well for them. I made a lot of friends in the class, though, and I really liked it. The pacing is good and you learn a lot.
Very kind professor who does a great job getting to know large classes personally. Although a bit off track sometimes, overall explains ideas clearly.
she really cares for her students and wants them to succeed.

Very sweet prof, but I am being so sincere and honest when I tell you not to take this class for your gen ed. It is a lot of work, and if it's a major requirement or major elective, I wouldn't even be mad about it - but it isn't for me, so I am fighting for my life over a gen ed class.

i took this class as a science elective because this is supposed to be an easy class but she makes the class harder than it needs to be. it doesnt seem like a 100 level class, even my cs classes seem better compared to her class. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS UNLESS YOU LIKE THE SUBJECT.

She is very nice but treats students like we are 6. The quizzes are honestly difficult. Sometimes, she doesn't make it through slides; SO MANY useless clickers. Confusing material at times. 4 Quizzes, 3 Portfolios (They're easy), 1 Project/Presentation, many blackboard check ins. Also, the lab makes no sense half the time as in the lab packet.

I currently have Professor Sit for EAES 111. Yes, she's very sweet but I am struggling so hard in the class. She has favorite students and seems to favor them. When I would email her and ask a question, I would get passive aggressive/condescending emails. She does not respect our time and never gets through all of the lecture slides.

This professor treats her college students like elementary school kids. She doesn't know to explain content and makes 40 slides a day but doesn't even make it through half of them. On top of that, she has no respect for our time, she makes us stay 5 minutes after class and doesn't even notice it.

I loved this teacher and anyone who says otherwise didn't try in this class.I HATE SCIENCE but this teacher was really engaging and always ready to help out. She gave the AMAZING choice of taking the exam or making a presentation. The presentation isn't much easier because you have to understand what you are talking about, but good choice to have.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easily the sweetest and kindest professor I've met at UIC so far. If you actively listen and collaborate in lectures, you should be able to get an A. When I had to reschedule an exam, she welcomed me into her office, I took the exam, and we walked to class together and talked about movies. 3 assignments a week which all take roughly 10 mins + lab.

This professor treated us as if we were middle school students and focused only on select students whose names she could remember. Although I took this course for credit, the workload was very heavy, but the materials covered were quite straightforward. Additionally, she made simple topics unnecessarily difficult to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This professor treats her students like they're in kindergarten. Not accommodating. Says they won't put certain topics on the test because it wasn't covered in class but still includes it on the test. Picky grader. Takes way too long to cover material (30 slides for the day but will only get through maybe half of them). Wouldn't recommend.

She is very kind and wants people to participate in class. She will call on you even if you are not raising your hand if she knows your name, so if you go to office hours prepare to participate in class. The material is very simple, you can either take an exam or do a presentation and it's so easy to fulfill the guidelines.
Completely over the top with homework and since its a lab course, it feels like taking two courses at once.
The worst professor ever!!! Avoid this class at all cost.

This class is way more harder than it needs to be. The professor puts so much effort but with heavy lecture and long labs it feels like you are taking two courses but in reality it is just one course. I do not recommend this course because it was literally harder than calculus for me.

Professor Sit speaks to her students as if they're in preschool but I find it relaxing. Her lectures are easy to understand. There was a short, multiple choice quiz for each lecture, each allowing three attempts. If you attend lecture, these are easy. She makes an effort to learn everyone's name, making the class more welcoming and enjoyable.

I loved Prof. Sit! Her lectures are super easy to understand and she is really good at answering questions. She says to get the textbook but I didn't and did just fine cause her lectures are very informative. My TA was great as well and the labs are easy if you pay attention to the TA. There aren't lab write ups so it's mostly participation.
Not very helpful nor supportive

Attendance is mandatory but is a small fraction of your actual grade. She says you need a textbook, but I never used one and passed perfectly fine. She's a decent teacher but talks to her students like a kindergarten teacher. Overall, the work isn't a lot if you don't procrastinate. Tests are relatively easy and the labs are INCREDIBLY easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She's ok, expects a lot out of you
She recommends getting the book, but it is really unneeded. Try to pay attention in lectures and keep up with the weekly assignments because they impact your grade more than you think.

Professor Sit is great! Lectures can get boring at times but the course is overall easy. There are blackboard check-ins after every lecture that help you review for the quizzes with are usually every other Friday. 3 portfolios that are usually pretty easy just time-consuming. Overall great course and a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Light coursework and easy class. Important to attend lectures to complete lecture assignments. The teacher is nice and learns student names. A good class to take to complete science prerequisite. Great class if you want to learn about rocks. If you attend the lecture you will be able to get a good grade.

Nice professor and good lectures. I don't know why people are saying she gives a lot of work because it takes around one hour a week to do everything. Other than that, show up to class and you should be fine.

Took EAES 111 online and as part of my EAES major. She is very friendly and her lectures are straightforward for the most part. There is lots of work due each week but it's expected as part of my major. Lab was also not too difficult. She is very passionate about environmental sciences. I think she is a great professor overall.

If you are thinking about taking EAES 111 then dont take it with her. Though she's a very nice person but is a very tough grader and assigns a lot of work as if all of us are earth science majors. This class takes up more time than my major classes and requires way more effort than it should.

A ridiculous amount of work for an intro course. This class took up more time than my major classes. 3 quizzes a week, readings, lab notes and write-ups every week, difficult iClicker quizzes every single class (I lost so many points on these), & presentations. Very tough grader too, I put so much effort in and it still felt impossible to do well.

I decided to take this class despite what people said about homework. I was wrong smh. 3 quizzes each week, labs every week, tests, projects and she expects you to devote 12 hours on this class for each week despite the fact we have other classes, jobs, etc. Wayyy to much for an intro level course.

Professor SIt is a great professor and an even better person! She is caring, flexible, and understanding, a refreshing change from other Professors. The mood is always bright around her and it creates a great learning environment. The course does require work, but it's really not all that bad... I think people make the workload seem more than it is

Either she is oblivious to how much work she is assigning for an intro level course, or she enjoys giving students an unnecessary amount of useless homework each week. She was nice as a person and clearly put in a lot of effort into the class, but what ruins it is assigning an insane amount of hw for an intro elective. Avoid her if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: There is a lot of work for this class, so if you're just trying to fulfill a gen-ed, you might want to take 101. However, Professor Sit is very nice and on top of grading. The lectures are clear and sometimes her dog shows up on camera. She will drop multiple of your lowest scores.

Prof Sit , and her dog, are awesome! Her lectures are very informative and she makes sure you really understand the things you learn in class. However, this course requires understanding A LOT of information and it can easily become overwhelming.

Just simply do not take any class with this professor. I don't know why Sit believes it is necessary to assign so much homework for her students. I also do not understand why she averages your scores of the review assignments instead of taking your highest score. Just terrible.

This professor made this course so hard for no reason, especially during a pandemic. She didn't care that some of us have jobs or a LIFE outside of school and she gave so much unnecessary work and assignments that weren't relevant to the course material. The labs were hard and didn't match the material covered in class too. Don't recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Sit was super cool. She had very good lecture recordings and the test were what you learned in class. Only reason I got a B was because of lab. Lab is not that hard but they are very tedious. Stay on top of deadlines and you will be good. Very interesting class too you wont get bored.
Stefany Sit was an amazing instructor. If you have the chance to take a class of hers I would highly recommend :)

I don't know what to say other than she was an intense and sometimes, a pushy professor. She increases the amount of work you to to challenge yourself. I'm not allowed to curse on this, but simply put, absolutely won't and will never take her again.

PLEASE DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. She may look nice, but she requires much more homework than all of my classes combined. As many people have mentioned, she always posts the powerpoints late, frequently after assignments are due. The labs are super long and can be very difficult. I DO NOT RECOMMEND HER.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Attendance is based on accuracy of iclicker questions which most of the times are about things we have just mentioned in class without analyzing. I dont know how she expects students to get those iclicker questions right. Other than that shes a professor who makes students actually think critically although she doesnt always do it effectively
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She has the potential to be a good professor but the class took a nosedive after the first month. Gets too personal with students and makes things awkward. Gives really vague figures for exam short answers. MUCH HARDER than EAES 101!! Field trip lab report is extremely difficult. Do NOT take for science gen ed - far too much work and difficulty.

Probably one of the worst professors i have taken. There are lots of homework, and she posts powerpoints necessary for review assignments after they are due. She makes you work for the grade. Absolutely disliked this class.

Started strong early in the semester, typical subjects of an Earth Science class. Her lectures got strange, she started wasting time constantly. She spent one of our ENTIRE class periods condescendingly "teaching" us what cheating is. She consistently wastes our time asking redundant questions and chatting about inapplicable subjects with students.

posts powerpoints after lecture, often times late. attendance mandatory and recorded through iClicker (which is based on accuracy of answers). review assignments, pre-lab assignments, and labs due every week. labs are long and boring, kind of hard also. mandatory fieldtrip to starved rock takes up an entire saturday. fieldtrip report is worth 10%
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Really glad I took her during spring 2019 since it was the semester that the tas striked. Because of this, she decided to make the field trip optional. For the field trip, you were supposed to go to this forest and observe rocks for the whole day. Thank heavens it wasn't mandatory. Sit teaches in a monotone and makes you strive for the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took her class last year, and I was really stressed in class. In fact, I gained 10 lbs because of it. She gives you more work than necessary
Regret taking this class. More work than i expected. She pushes you to try harder.

I really didn't like the class. She posts powerpoints after every lecture. We have review assignments due on 8 am on Monday, and sometimes, she uploads the powerpoints necessary for the review after the review assignment is due. SMH. a lot work too
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Attendance sort of mandatory - better to go to understand what the lectures are about. I got lucky this semester because of the strike and didn't have to go on the mandatory field trip (really hard). Overall, she is very sweet and understanding. You have pre-lab due 8 am the day of your lecture and reviews due mondays at 8 am.
This class has a lot of work for 100 level course. Should change it to eaes 333

You have a review assignment, a prelab assignment, and a lab report due every week. If you don't buy the book but you have to go to lecture. Her attendance is based on iclicker questions. There's a mandatory field trip which if you don't go to you don't pass the class. If you're not into geology then this class will be extremely boring

You have to attend lecture or you lose participation points. You will have homework every week based on the lecture and also labs because they are long. You have to know what's going on or you will be lost. For a level 100 class there is a lot of work so, don't think you can slack off in this class. You have to learn the material yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I can see why all the past reviews are usually 5 star ratings! One and a half months into the school year and love this class!!!!!!!
Great teacher who makes class interesting and was a great clinical instructor. I would want to be in her clinical group any chance I got.

Her lectures are amazing. She is a really nice person and always ready to talk to outside of class. It is always clear when her office hours are and if she will be gone for something. Very well thought out class and solid schedule.
Easiest class I have ever taken. Professor Sit is super engaging and cares about her students. The material is easy and you can learn everything from lectures.
Professor Sit is the Michael Jordan of teaching. Outstanding performance and presence in lectures.

no attendance but ICLICKER PARTICIPATION :) he's very sweet and knows a ton abt cs; i took the law combined section,him and prof warner (law prof) are the DYNAMIC DUO; reading is from zybooks, pay attention to it, practice a lot on your own; LAB QUIZZES CAN PULL YOUR GRADE AND THE QS ARE RANDOM SO GET THAT STUFF DOWN AND STUDY EASYPOINTS#
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Sloan is a great professor, he takes time to explain things; however I found lecture extremely boring. Do your projects and tests are open ended questions. I was in the CS 111 section combined with Biology, which was terrible in my opinion. It was like taking Bio and CS at the same time, both of which are difficult topics.
Wonderful professor. Quirky, in a way, but extremely good at getting material across and answering questions. This guy wants you to succeed, and if you take a class with him, you probably will.

This teacher is not that bad.  Although he may expect a little too much from his students.  He will usually assign a program and it doesn't matter if it will take 5 hours to complete or 30+ hours to complete you usually only get a week at most to finish.  Other than that he makes CS201 very easy and understandable.  He is also a pretty fair grader.

Be sure to do well on the three test. The course was good. He grades on a curve. Good teacher he even emails the slides/ notes if attendance is good. Take him... a good elective and gives u a good understanding of how the economy wrks
I will tell you this: This man is a gift from God.
easiest class of my life if you dont get a a or b you must suck at life cause theres noone easier than him so if you have to take econ 218 take it with him
He's nice and good at teaching. Very patient with students and you will get a good grade for sure!
this was my favorite professor this semester hardly have to do any work for a good grade and he curves like crazy
TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! If you want an easy A without having to surrender a lot of time and effort, take this class! very very easy and you'll learn a lot too.

Professor Skorburg is a great teacher. He grades on a curve so you are bound to pass the class. He also gives extra credit and the tests are not hard as long as you read and attend lectures. He gives a review and lets you know whats going to be on the test too! I highly recommend.
He's easy but he really tries to help you. He is happy to answer any questions, gives clear explanations and examples, and he brought treats to class!
No doubt he is the best professor ever.  He is very knowledgeable and extremely nice.  His class was a real pleasure.
Take him! If you do at least a little of studying, you will get A easy.
This guy will make sure you get an A in his class. Must take his class. Easy A
One of the best proffesors ever
u gotta take this class...easy A....easiest class in UIC
If youre a Fin Major, take this class! Three easy tests and a take home final... about 90% of the class got an A or B.

Awesome professor.  His class is as easy as a 300 level class can get.  He posted all the notes on BB.  He gave us at least 4 extra credit homework assignments, that just took minutes to do.  Each exam had a freebie extra credit question, on one of the exams I got a 103%.  He also gave us a take home final and allowed us to turn it in early.
For ARCH106 : Avoid him at all costs. So disorganized - you'll be confused the whole time
Very good teacher. very helpful
Excellent instructor.A lot of work but its all worth.

Teddy is a great guy, and an amazing architect. He is often unclear in what he wants, however this is no different than any of the other architecture professors at UIC. He is a fair grader and if he sees you trying your hardest he will reward you--whether or not you are talented. I highly recommend!

at the very beginning he seemed like a real jerk.  i learned that this was only because he demanded a high level from all of his students.  he pushed everyone and tried to get them to their full potential and this is why he might have been a jerk sometimes.  hes a really cool guy and very knowledgeable in the field
Weekly non multiple-choice quizzes, a lot of terms to memorize, interesting class.

Professor Williams was great! I took this as an elective and I love the course. There are quizzes every week and those grades make up the majority of your grade. If you miss less than 5 classes, she gives you 5 extra credit points at the end of the semester. One 10 page paper at the end, but easy guidelines. To get an A, SHOW UP AND READ THE BOOK.

Attendance taken every day. Prof is friendly & knowledgable, however often late to class, esp. later in the semester. She also had obvious favorites, so she would spend the most class time at their table rather than walking around helping everyone. When she did lec. on the material, she was kind of all over the place, which was a little confusing.

Great professor!  Class is very simple as long as you review the material.  You take a quiz every week.. only 20 questions in lab where you name parts of bones.  There's a total of 14 quizzes and 2 can be dropped. The things she wants you to classify are on a sheet she emails you every week.  Also, there is a final paper.  Simple class
She makes the class fun and is great at helping students learn the material.

Absolutely goated professor. I highly recommend taking his class. Any claims about tough grading are valid, but this shouldn't affect your grade drastically (it's hard to get a B). You can tell he loves teaching and wants to be there, which really makes the environment conducive to learning.
bless this man

The topics we did were interesting. Class is on writings from slaves and people in prison. The professor was nice, super helpful & gave good feedback on the assignments. There's only one short homework every week plus a final paper.  No tests!

This professor is the toughest grader I've ever had. It did not matter what I wrote I would never get above an 80% on anything. We only had one thing per week that we were graded on and if you did not say word for word what he said you would not do well. I would go over my assignments with my friend I get 5/10 and she got 9/10. Super harsh grading

I guarantee he will be your favorite professor of the year. He always starts class with jokes and is just genuinely a nice man, everyone loves him. There is a decent amount of reading, but he uploads pdfs, so you don't have to pay for anything. Even when the material seems a little dry, his enthusiasm for it makes the class more enjoyable.
Very nice class and helpful professor, hes caring and works hard to make sure everyone understands. Would retake again because of how awesome he is.
I thought the class was interesting and it had a good structure. The discussion questions we wrote weekly were helpful for writing the final paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Good professor, Mike is a great guy. Understanding and genuinely cares about his students. Class is on the Orient, mainly concerning Middle East/Russia. Make sure to check in with him periodically for feedback, especially if you get a bad grade on something. Understand Orientalism well, put effort into your assignments, and you should be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Course  Oriental history, art, and literature. Super interesting, but sometimes dry bc history heavy. 3 reflection questions every week. No quizzes or exams. 1 presentation, 1 final paper (5 pages). Slager is super chill and v nice, cracks lots of dad jokes. Very caring human and accessible outside of class.

Mike is the guy. He's genuine and cares about his students. He explains things when we ask and makes the effort to help us get that A. The class as about the orient, stereotypes and Russia and was an easy topic. The class is based on weekly discussions and a final paper. THATS IT. If you can, take this class and this professor, you wont regret it
Extremely easy and chill. learned nothing in the class and passed the class. He is understandable when it comes to late assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He was a really cool professor to have as a teacher. He was very understanding and helped us with our assignments or with anything else we needed. We didn't have many homework assignments, just needed to show up and do the assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He's rly understanding and gives the most amazing feedback on essays. Feel like I actually grew as a writer after taking his class. He cares a lot about the class & asks for constant participation. Nothing bad to say! Very accessible outside class & responds to emails fast. Great sense of humor too! New paper due every 2weeks on personal topics.
Great professor and really wants you to succeed. Also has an amazing sense of humor
Russian is a hard language to learn, but the instructor is really cool. Just come to class and turn in homework and you can get a good grade.
Great teacher. Very calm and understanding. Truly one of the best.
Really nice guy and he likes the subject. Grammar is sort of boring but a fun class.
The best Professor ever!
I took this course in spring 2016 and it was awesome. He explains linear algebra concepts very well. Quizzes and tests are heavily based off of homework so make sure to do it!

A high quality  professor. A notes driven class so make sure to ask if writing is unclear. Tests are a wild card, not really based on homework and and only somewhat based on notes. You can expect two or three unique problems on each exam and questions on exams are harder than quizzes or homework. Curves though and is lenient on partial credit.

If you've had your share of bad math professors at UIC, you'll be ecstatic to find out Kostya is one of the best professors out there. He is a genius and teaches the subject very well! Just going to lecture and doing the homework/suggested problems will get you a good grade in the class.

I highly suggest you take this professor if you see his name on the class roster. He is literally one of the best professors ever. I will be straight forward- the A is not easy to receive. This is a difficult math course after all, but he does an absolute outstanding job explaining the material as long as you ask questions. Super nice guy.

His quizzes are based off the homework that he assigns, and the homework doesn't need to be turned in. Quizzes are straightforward and simple. He gives you sample problems to prepare you well for his exams. Definately recommend him, he's a great teacher, and can be pretty funny sometimes. Don't need to attend class, just keep up on your own.

He is a decent teacher. Goes a bit fast in class. Sometimes uses anotations that leave you questioning what it means till you ask. Handwriting is hard to understand sometimes. He is a good guy who is willing to help, but you cannot slack off in this class. Exams are easy, final was very hard though. You cannot slack off. Quizzes and hw every week.
If it's not required to take this course, don't take it with her.

This class was so difficult to pay attention and take seriously. Her class was one of the most disorganized classes I ever took, it seemed like she made up most stuff the week before and did not have a clear plan. Her use of technology was dysfunctional and made the class harder. She was also super defensive when students would bring up issues.

Prof. Smith had semi-interesting zoom lectures with enthralling subject matter, but had none of the organization needed for it to be functional or fully engaging. I wish she hadn't switched our class to an online course 2 days before the semester started, and I wish the exams actually matched up with what we learned in class.

Do not take! I repeat do not take!!! She says things once in class and if you miss it you are screwed. She assigns 2 mandatory outside class event that you have to attend and I'm a commuter student (1.5 hours one way to campus) and I work 25 hours a week, I don't have extra time on campus. Doesn't post lectures so you cant review. Don't take!!

reviews.comment: A joke of a class. Most pretentious teacher Ive ever had. Her lectures are terrible and the weekly quizzes are a waste of time. If youre not 5 minutes early to class you get marked absent. The whole class is disorganized and badly managed. There are much better 100-level electives out there.

Her lectures were very heavy as well as her exams; she spoke very softly which made it quite difficult to hear her; It was alot of vocab and analyzing different paintings so you really had to be on top of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is very knowledgeable about art history, but she is a horrible professor. She forgets that a vast majority of the class is not an art major. Assigns many readings and constantly changes the syllabus schedule making it so hard to keep up with the class. She has such a pretentious and cynical attitude and tone. Take this class pass/fail!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Worst professor at UIC. Thinks everyone is an art history major and she thinks her class is the most important class. Will make you go to museums to write papers. Wants you to memorize all the vocabulary in all the chapters for her exams and wants you to describe a painting exactly like she does. Recommend taking this class with a dif professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is by far one of the worst professors I've  had. She speaks in such a low voice you can barely hear her. She literally whispers. She expects you to know all the stupid terms and practically the whole chapters for the exam.

reviews.comment: Even though he had a major accent, he was super helpful if you went to his office hours.
He has a very strong accent and is very had to understand.  Drops a lot of notation on the board, and invents his own.

He has a outrageous accent so if you need to hear the math he teaches you are out of luck. For me I enjoyed his class because he was very detailed with the steps it takes to do the problems. Minimal written homework. He's willing to help as long as you don't shrug him off because of his thick accent. He's also a nice guy. Not the best though.
Could not understand a word he said. Avoid this guy at all costs. I'm an engineering student who earned an A in precalculus and had to drop this course because I could not understand a word he said.

This guy was completely useless.  Terrible at teaching, doesn't follow what the book teaches.  His reviews were terrible, and his office hours inconvenient.  When I did make it I was surprised to find how reluctant he was to help.  Horrible teacher, period.

Horrible! I had the worst experience in this class. The professor barely speaks English.. At one point I thought I will fail the class, and considered dropping. But thanks to my friends encouragement I survived. P.S. Math was my favorite subject prior to the class and received straight A?s in high school.

You can barely understand what he talks about because of his accent. He keeps on writing on the board with his back facing the students. He talks to the board for 50 mins. You'll find the TA very useful.

He has a really heavy accent, and he moves extremely fast. The  first exam is usually really easy and everyone pretty much fails the second hah. there's written and online hw too and quizzes during discussion. I pretty much learned everything frm my TA. So just do the hw.ace the quizzes and read the book and it shouldn't be too bad.

stay away from him if you can. iv had teachers with accents at UIC but this is BY FAR the worst. cannot understand a word, he also mumbles. be prepared to learn from your book or go to other prof's lectures like i did. good luck if u get him though
Man, was this frustrating. He is very nice, but his lectures are useless. Unless you have no other option - stay away from him. HE IS A MESS!!!

His accent was impossible to understand, but the material itself was not that bad.  The book I had for the spring semester of 06 was absolutely amazing, Idk why they changed the edition. His exams are reasonable easy, at least he doesn't throw some random problems like some of the other math professors do.

Very heavy polish accent, but this guy knows his stuff. He goes quick thru his lectures at times but he knows the subject very well. He's always willing to answer questions. Mandatory graded HW but it doesn't count for much. 85% was an A. I got a 68% on one of the midterms but a still managed to get an A in the class b/c I dominated that final man

His class was extremely difficult to understand.  I went for extra help with his every week.  His help was very usefull be he is only good when on a one on one basis.  I held a strong B throughout the class and ended w/ a D. The next semester I took Dale Embers class, had a blast, and got an A. Look for Embers or Cabrera.

This has beeen the most frustrating experience for me math-wise. I would definately recommend never ever taking this class unless you speak Polish. Virtually no one listens during lecture and opts to read the book because they dont know what is going on. He is energetic but totally incomprehensible. Go with Dale Embers or Chris Atkinson.

Professor Small has a clear interest and for metaphysics. The material can be dense at times, but Professor Small kept the class engaging and interesting. If you do the readings before class and make an effort to participate, you'll succeed but also find it interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Small wants you to understand the complex readings you'll encounter. That's great! My only downside was the somewhat strange grading criteria. Very accessible, kind, has a "prim and proper" British accent, and he's funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Definitely lecture heavy, but the material was so difficult that explaining it in detail with examples was the best way help people understand. Some people might find long lectures boring but his royal British accent kept my attention. He also is genuinely invested in the students understanding the material, and is overall helpful about exams, etc
The class is very lecture-oriented, but the man's a genius and will really help you understand the material if you pay attention.
Just a terrible professor. He is a tough grader and disallows technology. He always ended class 5-10 minutes after the required end time. Ridiculous
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Nice professor however the most boring lecturer ever. Would zone out a lot in his class and sometimes fall asleep.
