He also likes to end class 5 min late
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Small has pros and cons. He is kind and willing to help you. However, the lectures are very long, often times, the class ends 5 minutes after it is over. He is relatively a hard grader. Also, he disallows laptops, and therefore, you have to print all of the readings. Some readings are very long, and I wasted a lot of printing money.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She was awesome. Highly recommend!!

Dr. Smith was a very engaging professor. She loves what she teaches and wants nothing but her students to find interest in Anthro as well. Smith is very big on participation and has little (fun) activities in most classes. Her exams are very self-explanatory as long as you follow the lecture slides that she provides every week. Take her!!

L. Smith was a TA for my ANTH 105 course Fall 2022. She tries very hard to make the class fun, especially for a 9AM lab. Not a difficult grader, as long as you look at the lecture notes in some capacity you should do well. Attendance is mandatory but willing to accommodate if you communicate!

She was so helpful, she was my lab instructor for 105 and she helped me a lot with understand and if you did not finish on time she would let you stay for office hours. She always did the most with jokes and made the day easy, You do have to read and go to lecture to understand, and you did have to be thorough with your labs but it was fun.

Prof. Smith was a pretty good teacher, very approachable. Gives out pop quizzes in lectures. Does not believe in extra credit so don't even ask. Two long papers in this class but she lets you choose what to write about. Gives out a lot weekly readings to discuss in your sections so make sure you read. Quizzes and exams were online.

I took this course thinking it would be an easy way to get a gen ed. It's way too much for a 100 level class  imo. There is so much material you need to be responsible for and her grading style is a little tough. You need to be very detailed in order to get a good grade. I did not enjoy how particular she was with points either.

Professor Larissa Smith is one of the best professor I have ever had! Her enthusiasm is what draws me to her class. Although she has high expectations for her class, she helps EACH student obtain those expectations. She is an awesome professor and is knowledgable of the content.

What should be an easy A is a difficult, confusing task. Quiztests are online with purposefully deceitful questions, but you cannot see your mistakes after! She forces you to attend lectures, dreadfully dull and boring, or risk losing 20 points. She expects students to be experts, making the paper assignment a true abomination. Only labs are ok.

He is a great professor by all means but his workload is very heavy. He expects you to do weekly discussions/ weekly assignments and on weeks you aren't do that you're doing a group project where some people don't participate fully. This is what takes up most of the grade. Exam weren't that bad. He does care and will push back dates if he needs to.
The most chill and laid-back prof ever. Tries his best to make class interesting, knows what he's talking about. Semester-long group project, so get a good group.

Class is like an unpaid internship. The group project is a semester-long project for a real company. Tests (2) are very difficult. Doesn't grade in time. Don't expect to know where you're fully at grade-wise until near the end of the semester. He is good at getting back to your emails though. Expect to WORK in this class!
She is very tough to crack. But she knows a lot.

Professor Smida definitely isn't messing around and isn't there to make your life easy. She's a good lecturer but sometimes skips over topics pretty quickly, thinking people will catch on easier than they do. If you put work in though, theres no reason why you shouldnt do well. The tests aren't that hard and are the exact same as class examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her final exam was unnecessarily difficult. I don't think anyone in the class was able to finish on time even though it was open book, open notes. I don't think she listens to her students' needs, like other Profs. at the College of Electrical Engineering do. Her notes are almost impossible to read due to her sloppy handwriting.

She is not willing to post extra material on blackboard. She makes you feel stupid in office hours and is sometimes lazy to go over problems in office hours. Her class notes are not detailed. She skip steps in examples many times while lecturing. She also relies on slides heavily.

Her lecture was amazing, it showed visual of what happened in communication. If you miss her lecture, the book is a bit hard to follow. Quiz every week, looks just like the hw. She will do review on midterms and final and the problem she reviewed will be on the exam. Also, she allows any resources except phones for final.
Smida is a badass. Very tough class but I put in the effort and got an A.

Heidi is a caring professor and class was very chill and mostly discussion. If you show up and participate, you should be good. Some of the readings were really interesting and we only wrote one paper the entire semester. She is very chill and we talked about anything. If you are looking for an easy gen ed, this is for you.

If you do not like writing, take her. She is very easy and a nice person. Many times would end class early and writing projects were simple and clear. Some papers are long but she has a way of making it seem like its only a 2 page essay. Very nice person and is humurous.

Professor Smith is such a nice woman who makes her class interesting and not difficult for her students. She clearly and descriptively goes through how to write a paper which really makes them easy to write. Rarely had readings for homework and only had 3 easy papers throughout the semester. My whole class received an A. Highly recommend!
I freaking love Heidi
Love her. The best!!!

Best class! All you do is read books and talk about them in deeper meaning. Professor Smith is so intelligent, caring, and overall hilarious! She does get disappointed if you don't read or skip class since that is most of your grade (along with discussion boards, 2 essays, and a presentation). Read the books and participate, it's an easy A!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's such a sweet soul. She say textbook is not needed in her class because she say it costs too much. She really cared for her students, no exam either, easy A.

I absolutely love Heidi. She genuinely cares about her students and how well each of us do. She's careful, understanding, and makes sure everything is going well in class. Very thorough throughout essays, and it's very easy.

Professor Smith is the realest professor I have ever met. She says her attendance policy is 5 absences, but ONLY if you're a bad student who doesn't do the work, if you do every assignment and keep up with papers, she doesn't mind if you skip. The papers were a nice length, like 1-5 pages MAX. Very incredible professor, if shes open, snag her up.
Its a fun class and she is really cool. Easy homework assignments, no exams, 4 papers. Easy A
Heidi was awesome! Best English professor by far, she was very helpful, understanding , and overall nice.
Heidi is an amazing teacher, she made the class super easy!

I would never ever take her for a class again. She is extremely inconsistent and likes to argue. Half of our classes were listening to debates because someone would disagree with her and she does not like that!!!
Dr. Mckeever know the work but the studies have to applied themselves.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is well informed however is always over the place. She doesn't provide consistent instructions.  Do not question her.  She is very moody and will embarrass you.  She knows a lot but is not a good teacher.

I had Professor Smith-McKeever for both policy and research methods. The topics are the hardest in the MSW program and so very stressful to take, but I learned the most from her classes of all the ones I took in the program
this prof. was super knowledgeable and enthusiastic about social policy.  I never knew about the huge role policy plays in our life before i took her class.

She was the worst part of my first year experience. Her hostle attitude and bi-polar tendances left students anxious, angry, and distressed before, after, and during each class meeting. She is inconsistent, unclear, and inflexble about assignments. (Even tho she claims she is all of the above). She is unprofessional and plays favorites. GET OUT NOW
Hard Professor, but know's her stuff... very confrontational but she is a nice person. Assign lots of work but hey i got an A! She didn't Tenure so more than likely won't be teaching next semester!

She was not only the worst experience of my college career, but also a horrific advisor.  Switch out of her class and change advisors. Also, get whatever she promises you in writing.  She will say one thing and then deny it and tell the Dean you were lying.  She created enough problems for me that I almost transferred.

Worst professor ever & a disgrace to the field of Social Work. Student inquiries were unwelcome, classroom tenor was hostile, assignments unclear, & material was delivered poorly. 6 years of complaints to the Dean and UIC offficials & lawsuits pending b/c of her. If she ever teaches again, avoid her like the plague.

She was definitely the worst professor I've ever had. She was really rude to students, mood fluctuated rapidly, was unclear in directions, assigned papers over material not covered yet, humiliated students when they asked questions and ridiculed students for complaining to the dean about her. How she ended up in social work is beyond me...

This woman is by far the worst professor I have ever had. Get out of her class RIGHT AWAY if you have her. There were many students that had to switch tracks just to not have her. She is hostile and made the class unbearable. It is sad that this woman is teaching people who want to become social workers when she has no social skills of her own.

This professor has been complained about since she began teaching at UIC. For some reason, the Dean and other members of the administration refuse to get rid of this problem. After speaking to the Dean about this teacher myself, I was only told that I could switch out of her class but nothing happened to the teacher. She is awful. AVOID AVOID AVOID

Avoid this professor if possible. She creates a very hostile learning environment that leaves you feeling tense and on edge the entire class. Her moods fluctuate rapidly. She becomes angry at students who ask questions and does not allow opinions different than her own. I do not know how she still has a job.

Everything you need to know is in the book. She confuses the class and is upset by questions and opinions that differ from hers. She does not make her expectations clear so make sure to find out somehow. Her mood changes rapidly and she has favorites in class. I learned a great dealin this class, but from the BOOK! If possible,avoid this professor!

Say what you want but she knows her stuff. She may seem scary but once you actually talk to her she's great. I have seen that after the end of the semester people love her. And her lectures are funny.

Prof. Smith is a professor you should take if you are very passionate about marketing. He has a ton of experience in the field and knows what he is doing. If you show the passion he will reward you and guide you. His lectures consist around really cool pop culture, sneaker head, hip hop culture. HE CAN BE UNORGANIZED, but nothing detrimental

Horrible person and professor. Clearly has no idea what he is talking about. Assigns pointless assignments. Very unclear about assignments and then sends emails out on Sunday night explaining what to do. You have to go to office hours if you want clarity on assignments, but that still does not help. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!!!!

often comes to class late and/or unprepared. he gives very vague assignments then grades them for things he never specifically mentioned. Never updates the grades online. Takes off participation points if you dont participate in class. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR, you will regret it. I promise.

Bragged about forcing his other class to make PowerPoints bc they were a little unengaged. Badmouthed our class about how we 'zone out' It didnt click that its bc he jumps to topic too fast and rambles He gives us so much work but gives so little-never goes over upcoming HW and quizzes He throws work at you and thinks jobs done no need to teach.

Okay let me break it down to ya'll, AVOID THIS PROFESSOR! Literally he is the most passive aggressive man I've ever met. He gives so much workload! And he doesn't even grade anything! The grades are never updated until the end. He is never clear and takes like 30 minutes to answer a yes or no question and is soo unorganized. Take another professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Avoid this man!Hes very disorganized/makes you do useless assignments like deep dives/groupwork for each chapter then presentations but didnt put in the final grade so he wasted our time. Doesnt give guidance on case analysis/RFP leaving us annoyed. Sent a 12am Email Monday over break about presentations leaving students scrambling and pissed!

A bit disorganized. HOWEVER this course is extremely useful and beneficial for anyone struggling to find courses that connect real world scenarios with textbook content. You will pass the class. Professor Smith cares about his students. His passion will drive you to care about the final project. You will leave feeling accomplished.

There are so many things due at once. whether it is the same week or same day sometimes. Very unorganized. changed the class schedule multiple times. the class itself is super easy he makes it harder by assigning so many unnecessary assignments. Do yourself a favor and do not take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Not the worst professor, he's more of you get what you give kind of person. If you give it 110% he will give you 120%. Its a lot of work if you are taking four or five other classes I would avoid him. But if you are dedicated to the course materials and like to add to the discussion he would be a good option. He also flexes his Jordans way too much
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Case Analysis #3:create Jay-Z song list, watch Crazy rich Asian/read synopsis,interview sales worker at high-end store about behavior. write a paper with these CORE CONCEPTS( there's MORE on that doc WITH LINKS). Lectures are rambling and no quiz study guides. Group/individual work each chapter. We have RFP projects. No one should suffer this

Her lectures are boring and she doesn't know how to connect with the students. I showed up in her office hours, she can seem passive-aggressive and dismissive of students' concerns. I missed a few classes, and she failed me, stating in a  I did not deserve a higher grade. How could professor be like? They are there to help and support students!
its ok. dont expect much

Her lectures were very boring, dull, and hard to sit through. She would talk over and interrupt students in an often passive aggressive tone. Despite this, the class itself was easy, the criteria and how to succeed is always made very clear. She was always open to help and answer any questions, giving lots of feedback on papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: As a professor, her grading is clear, and her feedback for all your papers is very valuable, and if you do revisions based on that, you are guaranteed a good A on that paper. In general, she might come off as off-putting. She has the tendency to talk over her students, which is very frustrating. I would take another teacher for this course.

If you do not like presenting, I do not recommend this class. You have to do a presentation every other week. There are 4 papers, including a conference presentation. Overall, the professor is nice, understanding, and helpful. Be prepare to participate and read a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: She is very friendly and straightforward. She makes the grading criteria very clear. Feedback on papers is offered through blackboard. She cares and is there if you need help or want to discuss papers. Procrastinating is not great b/c of deadlines for firsts drafts and final drafts overlapping. There are 4 papers and a film conference.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Zabic is very friendly and makes grading criteria very clear. Feedback on papers is offered through screen recordings which helps a lot in comprehension. Procrastinating can be troublesome for paper deadlines but other than that the class is relatively straightforward.

Professor Zabic is straightforward, but her lectures can feel long. One thing I'd note is different paper turn-in times often overlap, so I'd avoid procrastination. Nonetheless, the rubrics are clear on the paper requirements, and discussions are also straightforward, so no need to worry.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: English 161 with her was not bad. Just make sure to stay on schedule with your drafts and it should be relatively easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Zabic is a nice person but I couldn't learn anything the way she taught- she'd write the lessons on the white board and talk without any way to know if we actually picked up on the topics. There were also back to back papers- the draft of one essay would be due before the final version of the other, so there were times you were writing 2-3 papers.

I wanted to give her a tag but she is very middle of the road. You get the sense she is just teaching a topic she really doesn't care that much about, and you're just there to take an easy class. Regular homework every week that 's tedious with a healthy amount of essays throughout the semester. However, she is a very easy grader.

Worst teacher I've ever had. Her lectures are super boring and don't even pertain to anything going on in our essays. Dull, monotone, dry, etc. She's a teacher at Wilbur Wright now too, I believe she shouldn't teach English if she isn't going to be enthusiastic about it, she even acts like she doesn't want to be there.

shes not a very hard grader at all. as long as you show up to class and do the homework (which there is very little of) you should be fine. the papers were all easy as well, i am not a very good writer at all and even i was able to get a b on all my papers.
Her prompts aren't clear, isn't very helpful, avoid.

Do not take her!!! Her lectures are boring and dull. She is not clear on any assignments. Her feedback is awful unless you go to her office hours. She isn't so bad one on one but she still grades very harshly. Avoid at all costs

Great professor if you like rock music of any genre because almost all writing assignments are music-related. You can write about any music group you want for the final research paper. There's no final for the class. She gives frequent homework, but collects it when projects are due. You'll have homework daily which is a pain, but its all easy.

I am an English major and she literally makes me regret that this is my major. She's such a dry professor who seemingly despises her job. She never has any fun, she's dull, and makes me hate going to her class. If I wasn't so interested in English, I would literally change my major- I hate this class because of her THAT much.

Certainly not the best English teacher; acknowledges the basics of research and inquiry in ENGL 161, but requests things be done in a very specific manner; critical when it comes to feedback; lacks enthusiasm when teaching

prompts are not clear at all. currently taking her class and in each of the first three essays i would think i was writing a perfect paper until she passed them back and found out that she was wanting the focus to be on something completely different. really have to go in to office hours or stay after class to talk with her and see what she wants:(
You will have to work in her class.
HORRIBLE!!! Avoid at all cost! She will bring down your g.p.a. She gives no feedback. She is the worst T.A. I have ever encountered!

She is definitely in the wrong profession. She's an incredibly tough grader, well at least on my work. The entire class hated her. The class is not bad but do ANYTHING to avoid having her. Once again a teacher not only ruined the class for me, but most likely my GPA.
Worse ever!Absolutely no feedback. She's so boring and hard to understand! Grading does not make sense.

Worst Professor ive had, or teacher for that matter...she has no clue what is going on the whole semester, her grading process is so confusing also. I never knew what grade i had in her class, and she cant speak well enough to teach english...DONT TAKE HER

Don't care what anyone nor their mom has to say, this instructor is caring, he wants the students to succeed, and he always apologized to the entire class whenever he made a mistake. It was evident that he was a little tech rusty, but the philosophical history lessons were cool. Easy A class, slower pace but lots of self learning. Grampa did good!
the lights are on but nobody is home

This was honestly the best professor I have taken at UIC. His lectures were amazing and I learned so much. Professor Goatworth's lectures are pure gold and he deserves so much more recognition. HIGHLY RECOMMEND TAKING HIM FOR A COURSE.

solworth is one of the best cs professors at uic. he gives lots of resources to help students succeed and makes sure to select the best teaching assistants to help teach the class. i think the other more critical posts should be disregarded, and you should take solworth if you want a professor that is caring and takes his job seriously
if you do project well u end up getting A
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I don't know why the reviews are so bad he is a human too. He teaches CS so of course the materials hard, but don't blame that on him. You cann't major in CS and expect it to be easy and then complain if it gets hard. The bad reviews are from lazy students. Like study do the work and you'll earn at least a C. I would take him again.

The worst professor in the whole department.  
Reads slides, releases homeworks/projects late,  reliant on his grad Tas to run his class for him.
The exams are a mess which required changing questions on the fly.  
Whenever he is asked a ?, he just thinks and talks forever
Expect to be required to learn anything/everything by hand.

Publishes hw late and makes it your problem. He does not know how to use proper methods of grading code. He instead auto grades your print statements and forces you to waste time checking white spacing. When the auto-grader provides no feedback, he is lazy and only tells you to reread instructions. Anyone can teach better than him. Should be fired.

Horrific. He continuously shows that he does not understand the material he is teaching. When students ask for help due to his terrible auto grader, he just says "reread the instructions to make sure you followed them" rather than provide useful feedback. He also uses other professor's work to teach. He doesn't read the languages documentation.
WTF. This professor needs to actually learn the course materials before teaching it. Useless. DO NOT TAKE UNLESS YOU ARE TESTING THE WORST PROFESSOR TO EVER EXIST ON THE SOLAR SYSTEM!

One of the worst professors that I have ever had to take a class with. Never graded any work submitted - just gave us a letter grade at the end of the semester with no clear reason on why. Doesn't know his own ethos OS that is mandatory for the prog hw, and left it up to us to figure out why HIS OS installation didn't work for anyone in class. 2/10

Absolute worst professor I've ever had.

Took his CS 341 class in Fall 2023. Lectures were worthless, invisible on our Piazza discussion board, nearly impossible to reach outside of class, and would change assignment requirements and publish autograders only a few days before they were due.

He simply should no longer be teaching.
This guy is hilarious! Puts a lot of time/thought into his lectures. His lecture slides have funny cartoons that really make lecture interesting. Highly recommend!
The class was very unorganized. Taught us the most useless languages (C++, F#, GO), unlike other semesters. If you want to learn the material, do not take him. but you can pass easily.
One of my best memories in UIC CS was Prof. Solworth's Graduate Security class. Felt like an average joe talking to us, but in reality it was like learning the violin from Mozart

I dont know why this people is saying he is a gem. He does not know what programming is, cannot code and reads the slides line by line, very slowly. Ask students to explain him what is in the code because he does not know (he uses someone else slides by the way). More than half of the class got together to complain but nothing was done. Huge waste!
Professor was generous, but the course structure was a mess
One of the few hidden treasures in UIC's CS department, you will learn well from him! Don't let the noise cause you to miss out on a great learning opportunity.

The professor is certainly not a gem and if more than half the class complains about you, then you are doing things wrong. The homework assignments are not hard. The projects are unorganized and it's difficult to understand what needs to be done. Structure of the class is horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Phenomenal professor! Don't understand the negative reviews at all. So what if a few assignments changed a bit during the semester, you get better each time you do it! He has a lot of experience and it shows!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Truly a gem. Not sure what all the complaints were about. Sure there were some changes to homeworks, but he gave extra time, and they were not hard. Always there to help, can't wait to take compilers with him next term!

The course is a chaotic mess; the professor is hands-off, leaving everything to unhelpful TAs. Assignment requirements change constantly, and accusations of cheating are based on flimsy evidence. The final exam ended abruptly, 30 minutes early.
Just terrible. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The content itself is not hard, but the professor is not great. The tests are kinda simple , but expect a random question. The projects and homework are often changed a couple of days before they are due, and these changes are major setbacks. The professor is lost and unorganized most of the time. 3 projects, 4 homework (1 drop), and 3 exams
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was the worst professor I've had at UIC. Lectures were unhelpful, he got distracted easily. The assignments while not too difficult were vague. He usually modified the requirements a week into the assignment, negating any progress you had made. I would strongly suggest not taking anything with him if you want to learn something from the course

This professor makes CS341 far more difficult than it needs to be. Brace yourself to learn independently using YouTube videos or other resources because the class is incredibly dull. Additionally, be prepared to decipher the projects, homework, and test questions. The guidelines and requirements for homework and projects are always confusing.

This class is a joke. He is under investigation for the engineering department and being reported by several students for the lack of knowledge on what is going on. half of the class is "hmmmm ~reads the slides~" and the other half is "I dont know, you have to ask the TA".................

Only 2 weeks into the course.. I would like to write a review & hope this professor turns around from the negative view I and others have atm.. I will update again at the end of semester.

- Organization has been awful.
- Lectures have been the worst.
- Many technical difficulties.
- Difficulty accessing files for class. No clear instructions.

He doesn't do a good job explaining in his lectures. He often assigns labs with topics that haven't been covered in lectures yet. At least he responds on Piazza. He often makes mistakes like sharing wrong window, leaving the projector off. For the whole semester he shared the wrong window on iClicker, which shows the answer (actually a good thing).

Absolutely awful. His number 1 class policies "ask me lots of questions if you wanna succeed," and "poke around online long enough and you'll figure it out I'm sure." He also eschews proper, concrete lesson plans because he doesn't wanna accidentally teach us things we already know (???). It's all just his excuse for being a crappy tenured prof.

Terrible instructor. Unprepared for every lecture. He may be smart but has no idea how to teach. Shows no care for students whatsoever. Does not answer any emails, questions, or concerns. DO NOT TAKE ANY OF HIS CLASSES! Taught myself C language throughout the entire semester. He took all our concerns as a joke. Every student I spoke with agreed.

every day when I had to attend lecture to catch what little updates on projects we got (he did not use blackboard for announcements about anything) I hoped I will get under the train tracks and it will end this misery of a course. I think a kindergartener would teach better than professor solworth. an example of tenure != teaching ability

Do not take this professor! He doesn't teach anything. You gain nothing by going to lectures. You're better off teaching yourself. He doesn't respond to emails. Getting information about your grades or information about the class in unnecessarily difficult. Save your self the trouble and find a different professor.
Could not get a hold of him outside of class at all. No response to emails and really could care less about students. Lectures are just bad, it sounds like he is new to his own slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: most of these bad review are just left by bad students who expect the professor to be their personal stackoverflow. The assignments are challenging enough to make you learn the material, but easy enough to were they can be completed on time. Tests are comically easy. Lectures are a weird and you could probably get just as much info from the slides
not a good prof. doesnt know how to run a class

Homework/Project assignments have vague descriptions. If you ask a question outside of class hours, it is 99% likely that you will never receive a response. The prof is unprepared to teach during lecture (reads off slides). Poor explanations. Rarely gives feedback to students. Disorganized and may update assignment requirements last minute
Material learned was not difficult. Exams were ace able and the professor curved like a mad man. Easy A
good material but very poor explanation, need to improve very late or zero feedback poor conversation

Does not give feedback almost ever. Not accessible outside of class. Participation does not matter (he himself is not prepared to teach the content). Not inspirational. Very unclear grading criteria. Gives exams on topics he teaches very poorly and scarcely. Awful lectures. Not caring (relatively). No extra credit. Lazy, procrastinating grader.
He is the worst professor so far

He is not empathetic towards students at all. Does not consider how many other classes we take as students and makes last minute decisions like we have all the time in the world dedicated to his one class. In my eyes it does tarnish my thoughts on UIC, letting people who cannot teach like Diaz too. They dont care about students they like money.

Where do I even begin? Solworth not only doesn't care about his students, he ACTIVELY disregards their concerns. There have been many unanswered student questions on piazza. He is a jerk and is the most disorganized professor I've ever had at UIC. Never in my career at UIC have I had such an aggravating class. AVOID AT ALL COSTS SERIOUSLY!!!!!!!!

This class is great from the perspective of being thrown to the wolves and having to find your own way to survive. From any other more sane perspective, this class is simply bad. By his own admission he did not know what he was doing and this burden would always be placed on us students. If you think you will learn or get a grade you deserve, nope.

Worst professor I've ever had. He didn't care at all about the course. 90% of our questions would go unanswered. All the assignments were vague and on subjects, he didn't teach. Exams were just as bad. Exams would have typos and even his answer key was wrong. He also never answers his emails so good luck getting a hold of him. Avoid him!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is one of the worst professors I have ever had. He gives assignments on things that he did not even teach us and they are the most vague descriptions ever. He changed the pdf for a project the day before it was due. He never answers questions on piazza. The assignments are easy but it takes longer to figure out what he wants than to do it.

Terrible professor: Doesn't use blackboard at all, very disorganized when it comes to projects, due dates, etc, and isn't understanding of students. Example: changing project details the day before it's due, not able to answer necessary questions about the project, very vague project description, and blamed his students for being unprepared.

Avoid him if you can for cs341, he is very disorganized. Have no idea what is going on in the class, all the project/hw descriptions are very vague. His lectures also make no sense at times and are extremely difficult to understand. I repeat AVOID HIM!

Most disorganized class at UIC. No syllabus until week 3. Only professor that won't use Blackboard. File names on Box are ambiguous. Most Piazza questions go unanswered, which is insane because his assignments and projects don't provide evaluation criteria or rubrics. No skeleton code. Sometimes autograder, sometimes not. Bad communication
Assignments are vague, professor doesn't care when majority of class is complaining about vague assignments. Get ready to teach yourself. If you cant read the professor's mind you won't do well.

I could write a 6 pages essay about how bad Solworth is. You could find more care from someone thats kidnapping you than Solworth. He ignores our questions always, he gave us a homework in Haskell and didnt bother to explain how Haskell works then blamed us for not knowing how. Its 6th week and i already hate life because of this. DO NOT TAKE HIM
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Avoid Professor Solworth at all costs. I have never in my whole life had a worse experience dealing with a person before. It is unfathomable how irresponsible of UIC it is to let Professor Solworth be the instructor for this course. You won't get a syllabus until after deadline!

Professor Solworth didn't even give us a syllabus until the Friday of the second week of class. In his lectures he just reads off of someone else's slides and clearly for the first time right along with us. He seems smart but he is unbelievably, ridiculously, embarrassingly unorganized. DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM! You'll only be teaching yourself

He might be up there with the worst professors of all time. I don't think he even knows what's going on based on how his lectures go. If I were to take a shot for every time he said "um" during lecture, I would be dead 10 minutes in. Also he didn't give us a syllabus for 3 weeks and had no excuse for it. It's just kinda embarrassing tbh...
Had no idea what was going on, it was the ya who ran this class not him. He was awful.

He read straight from the slides, and it definitely seemed like he was reading the slides for the first time when he showed up to class. Lectures didn't help with homework at all, and exams were extremely difficult.

He didnt have sylubus ready at the start or even 3 weeks after class started. Never graded anything. Lectures were mandatory but you never actually learned anything from the course from them. The homeworks given would only be do-able if you understood lab which was the only way to learn. Never used piazza and didnt show up one day and didnt notify.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was a mess. He reads off the PowerPoint and gives clicker questions, but often forgets to give the correct answer and an explanation. Any questions in class take several minutes to answer (long pause, um.. explanation) and his answers can be unclear or difficult to understand. Smart research professor, and not a talented teacher.
Great Prof! really friendly! loved every lecture!
Great Prof. Great Lectures. was completely worth all my time!
This professor is amazing! Take him when u can!
Hands down the best class I have ever taken  made me a significantly better programmer by the end of it. Absolute pleasure, extremely inspiring.

I took this course and didn't learn absolutely anything. Nothing new and interesting. Very boring class. A very few unfortunate people attend his class and I was one of them. He has his own complicated and extremely monotonous operating system which he would be using in his course. Go for Stephen Checkoway's Security course rather!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is the worst teacher at UIC. I honestly regret taking this course. He talks really slow. You can easily fall asleep in his class. He gives marks only to those students who attend his hackethon. There was no midterm which would not give you a second chance to improve your grade. Take other 500 level courses but not this. You would regret a lot!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lectures are powerpoint driven, will most likely put you to sleep; talks very slowly and takes long pauses. Topics and homeworks are interesting, but you'll have to do a lot of digging and searching online (and anywhere you can) to be able to do the homeworks (they can be tough). One exam on the last week of class, relatively simple, and no final.

Prof. Solworth, though one of the prominent faculty members, could not develop interest in this course. Attendance was not compulsory. Only one HW assignment was given along with a presentation on a paper at the end. No final exams! So, it was way too easy for a 500 level course. You can decide to take this course but he can be unpredictable!
The lectures can be a bit boring at time but uses a few good examples to explain the principles.

Your grade is based really only on 1 exam. If you get an A on the midterm you don't have to take the final. So just make sure you do well on either the final or midterm. Otherwise the class is very boring, he teaches from a powerpoint.
No Comments

You will not learn much from what he says in class.But absolutely the most wonderful course I took at UIC.If one class can improve your coding skills by leaps and bounds this is it.  I pretty much didnt get any sleep during the whole semester and lost quite some weight(No.I am not kidding).It is that tough.Be ready to spend some allnighters.But was it worth it?Absolutely
He will totally eleminate the interest you have about the class topic. If you really learn only by yourself, you may register his class.
He's the GOAT. I don't need to say anything more.
He's a very kind professor whose lectures are easy to follow, and he makes the material engaging and enjoyable to listen to.
very good and kind dude. easy 2 keep up.

Content was straight forward but heavy towards the middle/end of the semester. He's a good professor and knows what he's talking about but sometimes hard to understand what he's saying. But overall an easy class, more work for lab. He also does extra credit pop quizzes near each test date during lecture.

Dr. Ale runs this course excellently, making you more likely to succeed. This course consists of field trips, papers, attendance, and quizzes (which are insanely easy). You can get an easy A just by showing up every day. I loved this course and would take it a million times over again if I could.

Ale is a great professor (probably the best biology professor); however, 230 is very exam/quiz-heavy. Most of your grade will be based on exams and quizzes, which are pretty simple but still tedious (some exam wording would complicate me). Overall, he's very kind and passionate about his work. Would recommend. Just be prepared for exams/quizzes.

Grades based on 1)Quizzes, 2)Participation, 3) Field Trip Report, 4)Foraging Experiment. Quizzes were super easy and could be studied the day before. Tips were on the weekend at 7am, i believe upcoming semeseters will be 4 field trips. Lab report took long and the foraging experiment only needed to be done across 3 days and a report was needed.

Would like to start off by saying that hes a really nice guy. Hard to understand, lecture slides are pretty useless. Few chances at extra credit but not many. Pop quizzes usually happen before the scheduled exam. Pretty overrated on here, but as I mentioned, nice guy.
class is mostly easy just memorize the slides and understand the vocab words and you should be good. dont be like me and not pay attention in lecture and study all the slides last minute though lol.

This is an easy A class. The lecture duration is pretty long because you have this class once a week. After every two or three weeks you will have a quiz so make sure you study the main concepts of the lectures he has gone through because you will be asked about it. There are two field trips, you only really need to attend one to write your paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Ale is a very funny guy! i never knew i'd enjoy ecology this much. Two mandatory field trips. His lectures are not bad at all, but your grade strongly depends on the TA you have

Som is a really fun guy and you can tell he enjoys what he does. His lectures are a bit disorganized, but as long as you follow along you shouldn't get lost. The 2 mandatory field trips aren't as horrible as you'd think. 2 research papers that DRAG, 3 written assignments, 1 presentation, and 5 quizzes (one drops). Take it if you need 3hr lab ONLY

The class is composed of several small assignments and 3 large reports. One of the reports is on a mandatory field trip. I would definitely recommend taking this class in the warmer months since both of the field trips are all day and outside. There's a lot of extra credit and the lab reports carry your grade so an A is easily obtainable.

genuinely one of the best professors to have in the first semester of college. hes not a tough grader at all, just make sure you show up and do the assignments and you'll get an A 100%. he gives A LOT of extra credit points in participation and attendance too
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: Professor Ale was pretty funny, really only came for the lectures and the field trips, otherwise the TAs did the rest of the work. the field trips are very early in the morning so be warned and you have to write 2 really long lab report. Quizzes and hw were pretty easy and so is the class overall.

He is truly one of the very few professors at UIC who loves to teach. He is a kind human being who cares about students getting a good grade (an A). The grading criteria is very clear, and he is very fair with extra credit points. If you do not get an A in this class, it simply means you did not care at all. For the lab section, get a nice TA.

Professor Som was funny and his lecture slides are good way to study for the exams which are easy. But, you have to understand the concepts not just memorize. Be aware of  pop up quizzes He gives 2 extra credits questions in each exam. It is an easy A in his class as long as you attend labs, do your assignments. 
He cares for his students.

Professor Ale was a good lecturer and cracked jokes here and there making lecture engaging. Powerpoints are a bit messy but I think that's more because the creator of the textbook made them and not him. As long as you follow the powerpoints to study and attend lab this is an easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He's so sweet and his lecture slides are all you need to study to do well. A fire alarm went off in our class and we missed ten minutes of the exam so he gave us all 16 extra credit points. He's very reasonable and gives pop quizzes for extra credit. If you put in the effort, you will get an A.

This was the perfect class to have during the very first semester of my first year of college. The professor was great as they were accommodating and knowledgeable. The course was very fun as the professor explains the concepts really well with jokes and stories.

Yes you may not understand him sometimes because of his accent, but that's okay everything important is on his slides. He was a very kind and funny professor, his lecture slides were also interesting. If you study the lecture slides and homework you'll do well on the exams. He allows extra points as well. I think he is the best option for BIOS230.

Best professor i have taken at UIC in all my years there. Super passionate about ecology, and inspired me to pursue the field that i am currently doing. 
He is wise so take his advise serious.

The professor is so engaging and funny! His lectures are so clear and he takes the time to explain things, and always gives examples. His quizzes are directly related to the lectures and what he talks about in class. Take him!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Som Ale is very kind. Also, he tries his best to entertain the students. Lastly, he cares about students and goes beyond to assure they get a good grade.

I took the 4 week course. It was so much work but he gives a LOT of extra credit. Just listen to the lectures and youll have an A on all quizzes. My TA was Natalia and she was nice and helpful throughout. She wasnt a tough grader and she explains everything nicely

He gave quite long lectures, but he was entertaining and explained the content very well. The exams reflected the content he covered very well. Overall, there's a lot of memorizing, but with Dr. Ale, this class was easy.

I love this professor he's a funny dude and just in general loves what he does. However... the TA's.. are in a whole different league of their own. There are 3 TA's for this class and none of them are on the same page. How they grade is different for all 3 TA's so be sure to check with the TA you have on what they are looking for.

He is the best professor in Ecology and Evolution field. He is very patient and cooperative with students. His lectures are very impressive and engaging. He is very down to earth person unlike other professors. Just take his class, and you will feel like you have learn something. Exams are easy as long as you attend the lectures.

I loved Professor Ale's class. It was my favorite class the first semester of my first year. He's a great person with extremely interesting stories and a great sense of humor. He loves participation and will be very clear with you if he likes what you are turning in and contributing.
Hes is a great teacher I really enjoy his lectures, he has a weird but funny sense of humor and his voice keeps you awake in class. No tests just quizzes and lab reports
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class is very interesting. There a good amount of quizzes and lab reports, however your grade will hugely depend on the TA. Som Ale is a very nice and charismatic professor.

I enjoy his lectures because he makes them really interesting through his mannerisms and jokes! Labs are short & easy. Exams can be challenging because you have to be able to apply concepts/definitions you learn to real-life examples, so I highly suggest skimming through the textbook and finding examples of all the bolded words in each chapter!!

2 lab reports for 2/3 field trips, 1 experiment lab report, 5 quiz drop lowest and 4 assignments. A 300 level class will require more work than a typical lab. Field trips are on Saturdays, are mandatory but remember the professor and TA are humans so talk and explain your situation to them. Lecture is standard, meet new people and learn about life.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Class is amazing and so is this professor! His voice and mannerisms are unique - it makes his lectures interesting. He cares. Students are given every chance to get an A! Exams are multiple choice. Final is optional to replace a bad exam. Exams reflect book and lectures (all on blackboard!). One pop quiz is dropped. I skipped 3 of 5 and got an A+!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Enigmatic professor, he moves around a lot during lectures and tries to engage the students. Textbook is highly encouraged but I passed with an A without even looking at it once. If you pay attention to his lectures, you'll do fine. The discussion/lab is fun and super chill.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Very intelligent
one thing about the subject is lots of paper and field trips but overall it's a great subject with a great professor. He is funny and science became more fun with his lectures.

I took this class for the credit hours but I didn't realize how large the course load would be. The lab reports are very tedious to write and data analysis was confusing at times. There are 3 8AM fields trip on Saturdays that you HAVE to attend. Som is great and really enjoys the material he lectures on, but this class really depends on your TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He's so funny and makes class fun! I loved having him last semester. He's very fair with his grading

Dr. Ale is definitely a character, and he tries to make his lectures interesting. He's very excited about what he teaches both in class and on field trips. Labs are pretty long and stats analyses are quite confusing, your success will also depend on how helpful the TA is. Winter field trips are brutal.

Dr. Ale is a wonderful professor! But be warned this is not an easy lab by any means. Unless you enjoy using Excel, performing statistical analyses, and writing lengthy 10+ page papers, I  not recommend this lab. Otherwise go for it. Fields trips are cool, 5 quizzes, 4 homework assignments, & a presentation.
I took for my Major, Bios 331, this was amazing class  Please take this class you won't regret it D

He's really passionate about ecology and funny. Kind of hard to understand if you don't sit in the front. For quizzes, just make sure you read the lecture summaries he posts online. Field trips are fun. Lab reports are long but not bad if you have a TA that will grade it fairly.  Total of 5 quizzes(1 dropped), 4 easy hw assignments, 3 lab reports.

He makes MATLAB look effortless and explains every topic so clearly that everyone in class stays engaged. Honestly, he teaches better than most professors. He's quiet at first, but once you ask him something, he goes above and beyond to help. Definitely one of the best TAs at UIC

He really knows MATLAB inside out and explains everything in a way that makes it simple and fun to learn. He's always ready to help and never makes you feel rushed or confused. His calm attitude and clear teaching style make the lab sessions something to look forward to. Easily one of the best TAs at UIC

He's extremely knowledgeable and explains topics even better than the professor. He makes every concept engaging and easy to follow. He's quiet until you talk to him, but once you do, he's incredibly helpful. Every student at UIC hopes for a TA like him  truly the best

Trust me, never take his class. He is really a very strange professor. His classes always have a lot of bizarre rules, and his lectures are very boring. If your first language isn't English, it will be difficult to follow his class because he has a strong Indian accent, and his classes often run over time.

Professor Das is a great professor. He really cares about students and wants them to do well. You can tell that he is passionate about what he teaches and it makes the lectures more interesting because of it. He always makes sure that everyone understands and is also willing to give extra explanations if asked. Uses Smartbook homework and readings.

Very lecture heavy. He makes it difficult for students to be comfortable enough to ask questions. He only goes over a few questions in the exam review and does not hand our exams back once they are graded for us to look over and see where we went wrong. His teaching is ineffective I had to always go home and reteach myself
Really good professor. He has good knowledge of what he teaches. Makes class easy through his teaching. Good for those who loves accounting.

His slides are very unorganized and consist of bright neon colors that are difficult to read and look at.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Das was great. Every lecture we had, I stayed after for 2-3 minutes to have insightful conversations regarding anything to do with Accounting. The course work for 210 is just as expected, but he offered a lot of extra credit at the end. He cares about his students, and it shows during lectures and outside of it.
DO NOT RECOMMEND TRUST ME

Took ACTG210, and overall the class wasn't difficult. His lecture style is composed of explaining the concepts and then doing practice problems on the board. Mandatory attendance, weekly homework, and 6 quizzes throughout the semester. He does post the practice exams which are very similar to the actual exam. Also, offer extra credit at the end.

It difficult to see the board even if you sit at the middle. He teaches okay for the first half the semester but it was getting messy to follow in the later half. Quiz schedule is not great. He is available to communicate with emails, he not trying fail people but it's difficult for most students that don't really like accounting in the first place
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He teaching style is just confusing and does not go into much depth. You cannot ask him questions by email and cannot seem to get the help I needed to be successfull

Highly recommend for Accounting 506! He is one the kindest Professors I have ever had. Course appears to be tough for accounting beginners but if you genuinely make an effort to learn and participate you will be rewarded. Grades with a curve which is a good thing due to the course's level of difficulty.
Das was one of my favorite professors at UIC. Sure, he's not easy. Yes, he gives quizzes. But he's an excellent teacher especially one on one in his office. Keep it up Prof!

I had absolutely no interest when I initially took Prof Das's class. After taking it, however, I realized how amazing and interesting I actually found it. Prof Das really helped me when I found him after class. I found it easiest to approach him by asking questions, rather than complaining about test scores as other students may do.Loved it ProfDas

Prof Das is in fact a very good teacher. Because he does not appreciate people who slack, skip class, or are otherwise visibly uninterested, he may seem distant and unhelpful to people. his class is soooo boring, as someone already said its hard to stay awake, anyway you have to go to class because he gives pop quizes. dont even read the book, study his notes and you should be fine.

Das's class is very hard and boring.I could barely stay awake in his class. He is very unapprochable and not helpful even when you come to the office to get help on project.There is no text book in the class, so you only get what you get from the class listening. Try to avoid this class with him,but it's mandatory.He is a tough grader too.
Das is not a happy person.   You will not be either of taking his class.  He is unapproachable and unhelpful when you actually have to talk to him.

Only complaint would be the EXTRA LONG READINGS. For EACH article (10+ pg each) you had to submit summaries. There were 2 weekly readings, none below the 10 pg mark (EVERY WEEK). The quizzes/discussion boards were easy but part of the discussion board did include the readings. DONT take this class if you hate reading/don't have time to sit and read

reviews.comment: You can tell he is really passionate about his work. He seems nice and pretty chill, only thing I didn't enjoy was weekly quizzes, two summaries, and discussion boards each week.

Professor Solinis is really energetic and fun- he knows what he's talking about and engages a topic with students efficiently. Attendance is required because he has weekly quizzes but they're 3 qs. You have an independent reading presentation and then a group poster board (final) but no exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I was intimidated by this course, but after studying & actually putting the effort into the class, I ended up with the grade I wanted. Expect homework, pop quizzes (ab readings), & exams. Mahesh comes off as strict, but he's actually a very caring professor, and I think he's unintentionally funny. If you put the work in, you will see the results.

I HATED this class and if I am being honest the TA taught so much better than Professor Somashekahar. During lecture he reads the slides but it is not helpful at ALL. Also do not get me started with the homework which was out of 3 points but required so much work. Try taking this course with a different professor if you can!

Prof. Somashekhar's class is very convenient as he records his lectures as well as posts the slides so it's easy to catch up/follow along. He isn't the best at understanding/answering in class questions so it's best to save them for lab. Lab's were the most helpful with understanding the course. TA was a lifesaver. Not too hard of a class.

Wasn't able to pass this class without the TAs. Prof. Somashekar knows a lot about stats, but is not the best at teaching it. As long as you try and ask questions and go to lab you should be fine. Just know it's not an easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I've also had Mahesh for stats. His classes are lecture heavy, but he prepares you well for the tests. There's usually two exams (non-cumulative) before the final (cumulative). Whatever class you take with him, DO NOT procrastinate with homework (they can be very long at times!). Overall, easygoing funny professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Take him if you want to be overwhelmed/stressed out all semester long. Never taken a more ridiculous class. Mainly grades tests and a teeny bit for participation. He has his funny/understanding moments but usually was in a mood for no reason. Average for tests were about 60% most of the semester, and study guides were minimally helpful. Good luck!

Dennis Sparta is an excellent instructor who brings real enthusiasm to the neuroscience of motivation. He speaks quickly, but it reflects his excitement and deep knowledge, making lectures engaging and fast-paced. He balances a casual, approachable style with strong rigor and presents the science realistically, including its limitations.

Dr. Sparta does research at UIC and is very educated in his field, however, he is a fast talker and lectures are very in depth, but all necessary sources are posted, so achieving an A is possible if you love neuroscience and are motivated. Exams are made up of 5+ slideshows with 40-50 slides each, so don't procrastinate!

Professor Sparta is a great guy, but lacks as a teacher. His lectures were often based on upwards of 70 slides, which were read extremely fast and often rambled through. Every lecture covers an intense amount of information. His TA, Mack, is AMAZING, make sure to attend his study sessions as they're the reason you'll pass this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor! He talks way too fast and does not explain the course material in a way that is understandable to someone trying to learn it. reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Do NOT take this professor under any circumstances. 

He speaks at literally 4000000 words per minute while mumbling, spends 30 seconds on every slide, and does not know how to teach. His class is insanely hard with test averages no higher than 65% and he sees no reason to change!! Save yourself and take literally anyone else!!!

reviews.comment: his lectures barely reflect the exams. the homeworks and quizzes are pretty tough sometimes. but go to his office hours! he is so helpful, the structure of this class just sucks really bad.

H's a nice person and there are decent examples provided. I will say that the solutions and the explanations are the worst I've ever seen. Studied by myself

If you can, I highly recommend taking PHYS 132 with Professor Spille.

The quizzes are very similar to the group problems and homework, and in my experience, the tests actually felt a bit easier than the quizzes.

he will give a lot of homework you will have all to be done with by the end of the week and most of the homework will not be based on the lecture because he will never do any example problems so we can see how to do the question. so basically the class is self taught you need to study all by yourself, at least he should elaborated his lecture
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I highly recommend visiting the MSLC and getting help from the TAs regarding the hw and quizzes. I rarely read the textbook pdfs provided, but if there's something on the hw that wasn't covered in lecture, it's most likely there. Go over hws and quizzes before exams. He also posts practice exams that are quite similar to the actual exam. He is cool

PHYS 132 is HARD. It's a completely different beast from PHYS 131. Professor Spille explains concepts in a simple way, and then the homeworks/quizzes are supposed to make you apply those concepts in order to do well on exams. He always goes through specific HW problems, stays after class, and is caring. Take him over Espinoza! Funny and kinda cute.

I have always had serious trouble with physics but, this class was honestly amazing. Spille was always staying after lecture to help students with the homework. I used the textbook but, i know many students who did not. The quizzes were the only negative about this class because they difficult but, altogether I honestly loved this course.

His lectures are not based on slides and consist of quiz questions for points. The labs and homework are manageable but the weekly quizzes are extremely unrepresentative of exams and lecture. During lecture he never goes through a full problem and, since his notes are hand written on the spot many of his explanations are confusing and unprepared.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Spille is an absolute gem of a professor. Physics is a relatively hard course as it is but professor Spille does make it bearable. His lectures are pretty decent and he works through all of the problems with you step by step. He's super caring and genuinely wants his students to do well in his class. I would definitely take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is definitely one of the harder classes. He is a nice person but you have to put in the time and effort to make good grades. Hws and labs are lengthy. The hw and practice problems will be the most relative to the exams/quizzes. Go to office hours and make use of every resource possible.
Christof Sparber does a good job in lectures, if you pay attention during lectures, take good notes, and do the homework. You will do well in the course.
Excellent lecturer. Very well-prepared and responsive to emails and requests for help.
This professor clearly knows his math. He's good at explaining if you have any questions. Be aware, his tests are much tougher compared to the other professors.

The man is a pure genius.  He is a researcher at the Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics at Cambridge University and has published over 30 papers.  His intelligence can get in the way of his teaching seeing that he can skip certain steps or make assumptions that students "know" certain things.  Overall he is a good professor.

Great professor, but all his examples are directly from the textbook. You don't even have to show up for class since you will know what's gonna be on the board. His quizzes are fair because IT IS one of the problem on the stated on the syllabus.

Ryan is very passionate about Sociology and his biggest goal is to ensure that all his students learn and enjoy doing so. He tends to grade things in a timely manner so grades are always actually up to date. Not much homework, but what is assigned is always for a grade.
Horrible professor ! extremely tough on grading and attendance policy. So much to do for little or no credit.

There are no exams for this class, just quizzes on the assigned readings, 3 section summaries (of your choice), and a final group project. Ryan is a good professor who genuinely cares about sociology and wants to help his students learn. Would take another class of his again.

There are quite a few 4 page papers you need to write for his class. As long as you read and do well on the quiz then you will surely pass. Participation really helps to boost a grade. If you find you are having trouble with the readings or writing shoot him an email or go to his office hours.

Great educator and good guy. Ryan is a graduate student and he'll be at UIC for two more years. His class was fantastic, he analyzed the government, society, and the state. He has no tests but quizzes  each class period. Quizzes are easy, they're only 5 questions and if you read you will pass them. Reading is a must.

Amazing professor. I have thoroughly enjoyed taking Lin alg with her. Some of the midterms are a bit tough, but overall the class is very well structured. Only complaint is that I wish they used Canvas instead of Moodle, it is annoying to switch back and forth between platforms for different classes.
Took linear algebra with her. Really good at giving an intuition for the concepts. Also does recorded review sessions for each exam: real lifesavers.

I LOVE JENNY SO MUCH! Math gives me awful anxiety from high school to the point where I had to take a medication just to handle going to class. I was scared of the class at first but after taking this professor she truly helped me excel in this course VERY CARING SHE DOES NOT MAKE YOU FEEL STUPID AT ALL I got my first ever A in a math class w/ her

There is homework due every week (worksheets based on lectures, webassign). The quizzes easy as long as you do the homework as they are very similar to the homework. She is super nice and understanding.

Professor Srikant is such a great teacher, answers everyones questions and does multiple examples if you still dont understand. It was a great experience. Exams are pretty easy if you do your work and show up for discussions.

Jenny has been such a great teacher. During COVID I took her online 100 class and not only was she able to meet outside of class, she was available by email with quick responses and video examples when I had questions. She is extremely clear and goes through problems step by step. I hope i can take her again!

She literally is the best math teacher I had since Middle School. Taught at a well pace, answered everyones questions in full details even if they are the same questions repeated like 50 times. She genuinely cares about her students and will delay hw due dates for people if they need it. Exams are not hard, you go to the review session and ur good
the best professor ever. very clear and made me love math more than I do. explains everything well and tells you what to know for each exam.
Although Im terrible at math, I loved her class! Shes kind and caring. She is accessible outside of class.

Decently-paced lectures and discussions, great at teaching and explaining things. Straightforward, clear, very sweet, attentive, and understanding. Prepares us well for the exams. Hosts helpful exam review sessions and office hours. My only criticism is she needs to be more strict with the loud and brash students in our lectures and discussions.

Fair grader, great class.

reviews.comment: BEST PROFESSOR AT UIC!!! sadly I was in her last class at uic! She is soo nice , clear on expectations, gives you enough time to complete assignments, doesn't grade tough. Overall such a good experience. Also gives an extra credit opportunity
10/10 class, Titi is so caring!!

Titi is a great professor! As long as you try your best and communicate with her, you'll be fine! I honestly slacked on the Final and got a C on it but it was def my fault. I recommend taking her class!
Titi was a great online teacher! A fairly easy class thanks to her great organizational skills. Her lectures are shorter but super informative.

I loved her lectures! They were short but informative. She had engaging quizzes based on her lectures. The instructional lesson plan was a bit confusing. But nonetheless it was a useful class to take.

She is awesome, very clear lectures that are 5-8 minutes each. Says all you need to know in each one. Very clear on what is expected and the format on Blackboard is easy to understand. Work is due once a month, 3-4 weeks are due at once but its not hard to get it all done in a day.

Titi goes out of her way to make sure that every student feels comfortable. She does a good and entertaining lecture, before class she'll upload a "note-taking" power point to follow along which I thought was very useful.

Titi is an awesome professor who really cares about her students. Her lectures can be long. There is one paper in this class, a group project, and three exams. If you show up to class you get easy points. Great teacher!
She is passionate about teaching. Her lectures are super long. Feedback on assignments needs to be better
I love her so much! Such a great teacher and very fun. The class is pretty easy. You'll love her

She is super sweet, she truly cares about her students. She apologized for not knowing a student's name even though it's a lecture. She's super funny, take her class, you will enjoy her as I enjoyed having her :)

She definitely keeps your attention during lecture. She's funny and enthusiastic! Easy to talk to and caring. If she can't answer your question, she goes home and researches it and then answers it for you in the next class! No textbook needed, she gives you every answer for exams and preps in her powerpoints. Attendance is taken every day.
Explains statistical concepts and applications in public health well. I am taking more classes from him.
Good teacher
Very good prof
Excellent prof. Will take another of his class next semester
This class is important for my research. He is doing good job. I also will take his BSTT401. I was told its another good class
Good professor. Teaches algebra, stats, and programming well. Exciting and approachable. Breaks down concepts in steps. I will take his next semester big data class.

Professor Konda is a terrible lecturer. He is kind and approachable but he does not know how to explain concepts in a way that is logical organized or clear. He likes to show students how to perform calculations but he fails to provide conceptual information, making his lectures very confusing. His slides are also a MESS. He is a Terrible teacher.

When you take your exam online, you cannot go back to the previous question. I was not the only one who complained about this class. I do not recommend

Great class, attendance is not mandatory but will base participation on your attendance. Two papers and three exams. Take good notes and read because of pop quizzes 4 and lowest gets dropped. He is a tough grader, but were in college now. He's only pushing us to be our better selfs and be better writers. He's grading us the way they should grade us. If the work was easy then we wouldn't learn anything. He knows what hes teaching. He is pretty understanding. He's always willing to help JUST REACH OUT. Test arent too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This isn't a CLJ class it's an ENGLISH CLASS. This professor focused more on writing than actual class content. And to top it all off, he actually prides himself on being a tough essay grader and is happy that few people get As on them. Don't be fooled by his online open-note exams--they're hard. Tricks you with wording and questions are specific

I dont recommend him at all. He grades harder than my professors with PhD degrees. He treats this class as an a English or writing intensive class. 3 exams, very hard even if you read. Also, they are wordy and tricky. He doesnt explain anything, always referring to the syllabus. 2 papers. He also assigns articles & they are BORING. 4 Pop quizzes

I really enjoyed Professor balachandran. He was a nice professor, responded to emails quickly and you can tell he wants you to learn. His class is a lot of work and the exams are kind of hard but they are reflective of the assignments. Also he is not harsh while you're presenting. He's not rude but will give you feedback to not read off a notecards
Nothing to say, even though I did good all semester he gave me B

Professor Bala's class is content-heavy — I took the most notes here. If you want to actually learn, attend class, follow the schedule, and do homework. Not an easy A. He's not super friendly, but he is good at teaching, gives good examples to help understanding. Heads-up: he'll call you out if you talk in class.

When the individual assignments are due right before class begins and the lecture right after would then cover the material for those assignment, leads you the believe that waiting to turn in the assignment late would be better than consistently scoring half points
Except that turning in late equals zero points so now I'm capped from an A on week 6

Not such a nice guy, kind of rude and harsh. The class is a lot of work but it is not so hard to pass as long as you do all your work. Also if you have thick skin you will be fine because when presenting you and your group will be roasted by him guaranteed. I wasn't offended but keep that in mind. This class is an easy pass though because it curves

Avoid him for your intro course. Too much course material, forcing you to self-study. Poor teacher. Expect weekly homework and bi-weekly quizzes, along with a difficult group project. Subjective grading on participation and presentations.. His strict demeanor and stringent grading is off-putting. Opt for a lenient professor and you will thank me.
