reviews.comment: There are objectively better electives to take than 493.
Professor is awful not helpful at all. Unmotivated me to be in accounting and is an extremely harsh grader you are scared to speak up because he shames you if you don't know the right answer.

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Prof Balanchandran is probably the best professor I have met in the accounting department. I wish he taught introduction courses because he knows how to break down complicated accounting topics in layman's terms. He also gives good insights on practical work skills since he has worked in public accounting before. Only downside are tough exams.
Phenomenal professor; responds on a timely basis. He is always willing to meet with students outside of class and help them succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There are many quizzes and homework. You can drop one of the quizzes. But, He doesn't grade quizzes until the end of the term. The grade is mainly based on the participation rate which is very subjectively.

A really smart guy from business Harvard school, know his stuff well and know how to teach. Course materials can be hard and time-consuming to read, but most of them are interesting accounting/corporate case. No regret taking the course. He's also passionate about accounting and has experience in the field. Would Recommend it to anyone.
Prof Bala is very responsible. He has a good pace to teach us. I have learned a lot from his class and slides.

He is awesome! So passionate and always ready to give feedback. Yes, his course is hectic. You have to read a lot. But the text is so vast, I don't blame him for eventually rushing in the end. He is always up for questions and encourages people to do so. He almost made me want to change my Major!
Tough professor but excellent teacher if you pay attention

All accounting teachers should be as passionate and enthusiastic as him. He has great life experience in the field. There is case homework and quizzes every week, you need to participate in class, and do not slack on the final project (or you'll be miserable). Even if you get a B in his class, ACTG 525  is 100% worth taking.

Weekly you read a chapter or 2 from the text, attend lecture where the professor partially goes over a few of the prior week's homework problems, then goes over the following weeks powerpoint presentation - which is from the text, including the SAME examples. You WILL teach yourself accounting. Attendance is only required due to pop quizzes.

Really knowledgeable and helpful professor. Class requires lots of reading of cases and the hw can sometimes be tedious. Pay attention and participate in class. Final project is a bit hard, so don't wait till the last minute.

You are assigned to read the chapter from the book each week and then figure out the homework on your own.  He doesn't teach lessons, the entire class period is spent going over homework problems and in the last 5 minutes he flies through powerpoint slides of the next chapter.  Refuses to hand back exams in class. A nice guy, poor professor.
The class was interesting case studies. Ine homework assignment a week
I almost forgot why I took ECE in the first place till I took his course. Too bad it is my final year. He is an outstanding professor and belongs at places like MIT.
Best course I have taken in my graduate studies. Very good professor.
Comprehensive soft switching course
This is a tough course and he teaches at a high level

By far the best ECE class I've taken at UIC.  I learned more from him than any other class I've taken. If you want to learn a practical EE subject and are interested in power electronics definitely take it. Be advised tho, you will have to work a lot for this class due to so many quizzes/labs/simulations but well worth the effort in my opinion.
Awesome professor! Knows his stuff! Class participation is very important to understand the topics! Guides and provides help outside class! Very helpful!
Highly recommend the professor and the course.
He is an excellent teacher. Never shows off even though he is so reputed in research. A truly caring person.
hes good
Gem of a teacher.
Tough course. Had to read a lot. Great professor.
Mr. Power Electronics! The guy just loves it and it shows. Amazing range. He should write a book.

i have not taken a course with so many tricky exams. but the prof taught us so well that the class starting doing good after a few quiz. he raised my level and created an interest in me for power. he explains things so well. makes it so simple to understand.
I wish he taught some earlier ece courses in my junior year. I have a great appreciation for electronics systems because of this course. He makes it so easy to understand. Simply best.
the best course ever. the prof is too good. ece is lucky to have him.
Superb teacher!
He teaches ece 445 at a higher level than a basic course. Covers a lot more than my comfort level. But, the teaching is real good. He does not need any book.
Good course. Worth taking.

This is not a easy class. I mean the prof is great but the number of homework and labs and tests makes it a tough course. If you have some background in control and device it helps. Watch out when the prof says conceptual exam. Those are tricky.
Teaching is real thorough and prepared. Some exams are hard. Simulator is good but the ece sun machines are slow.
ECE 442 exams are not easy, but the course is useful. Take it before ece 445. Professor teaches really well.
Outstanding. Knows the subject. He gives practical examples. Could choose a different text book.

I was not sure after ECE 346 if I wanted to take another device course. I am glad I took ECE 442. Although the TA was not good for the course, the prof was simply great. He knows the subject really well. The book was tough though.

Took the device course with the prof. He is a class act and at totally dfferent level. But, he makes you work real hard to get the grades.  Don't go to his office unprepared. Anyway, if you can stick around, you will really learn. I guarantee.

I received A in ECE 210 and found the prof exceptional. I know why some r nasty about the Prof. One there were 5 students who did very well in the class and much better than the rest. So, the prof. had no choice. Second, many of the students were from other non-ECE departments and hated the prof for teaching the 8 or 9 chapters (required per syllab
This professor is the best in the department in my opinion. He really knows his subject. He is considerate to the students. But, he is strict and his grading is a mix of curve and absolute score.
Knowledgeable, dignified, and considerate.
Lecture heavy, just do good on homework. Good professor and passionate abt his content. Quizzes should be free points. Study lecture review problems for exam. Curves at the end of semester.

He is good professor I already took his two classes. he does try his heart to teach and patient with student's question even in the lectures. I learn very well. Please rate this professor for honestly.
He gave no curve to the class! Like what

The Professor himself isnt bad, does a decent job with 50mins lectures. He doesn't announce homework, doesn't answer emails that well. I felt this class was kind of disorganized, HW questions help with exams. No equations given for exams so it makes it difficult to do well on exams. Overall okay Professor, he could improve on a few things.

worst professor ever. expects u to memorize 50+ equations for exams and no lecture slides or anything given to study. His lectures are just him reading of the book which all of us can do ourselves and his exams are just too hard as he expects u to know all of the formulas, density values, etc. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR.

reviews.comment: Prof Anand, while decent, isnt great. The class is tough, his lectures are quick, and he seems to expect each student to progress at his rate. Hes kind and considerate, but a little unorganized at times. My largest gripe is that homeworks were rarely announced, so you must be a hawk to see if something has been assigned. Overall, ok, but not great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Prof Sushant is a great professor, truly kind, and always there to help and support you. Thermodynamics is a tough course that requires lots of studying in general, but he makes it easier and interesting. He responds promptly to emails, and genuinely cares about his students success, and he'd answer all questions in lecture and office hours.

Professor Anand is very knowledgeable on the topic of thermodynamics and does a very well job of explaining his concepts. That being said, he does not assign homework on a set schedule and does not inform students about homework. Furthermore, for the final he only allows 1 front side sheet with no diagrams allowed.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He makes Heat Transfer a fun class to attend, even though it is one of the hardest ME courses. Very easygoing and explains concepts well and really tries to make you understand the material. Great professor

Professor Anant is very supportive. He replies to every email timely. His course is very easy and the exams are not that hard. Every question is straight from the course materials. I would definitely recommend taking his class.

Professor Anand tries his best to make Heat Transfer a bearable class. Heat Transfer is definitely one of the hardest courses in the curriculum, which entails a lot of study hours and stress, however, Anand grades the exams fairly and leniently, offers extra credit problems, and makes study videos where he thoroughly works out example problems.

Heat transfer is hard & students say the professor didnt do a good job explaining it. I disagree. He explains well enough for a 50min class period. The key is to take time out your day to read the book! After receiving a 32% on my first exam and an 88% on my next exam, I found reading the book & reviewing his notes is the how to pass. He curves to

The material is tough but the trick is to study the homework problems as they appear exactly the same on the exams. He might switched up values but they're the same. No point in putting in more work than needed. Grading scale is curved so a B in the class is easily accessible. You won't learn but you'll definitely pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Anand is very intelligent and well respected... however, the lectures will make you want to bang your head on the wall, the homework will make you want to subscribe to Chegg, and the exam questions are taken from homework assignments. He cracks a few jokes here and there and was a somewhat fun class to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: The course material is incredibly tough, and this professor doesn't make it any less painful. Lecture is practically useless as it only focuses on showing the book derivation without necessarily helping us understand the concepts. HW is very difficult to understand due to the lack of examples shown in class. Exams have 4 questions but you solve 3.

reviews.comment: Great professor who's obviously passionate about the subject. He makes the lectures enjoyable and helps digest tough material. Definitely would recommend a class of his if you can take it!
Boring. That's it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Disregard the person under me; this course is a breeze. Literally just come to class, take some notes, and do the weekly homework. That's all it will take for an A.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS IF IT IS NOT REQUIRED OF YOU !
I took this class to fulfill one of my gen ed, biggest mistake EVER, the class takes up a lot of your time and it's hard for a level 100 class. it dropped my GPA and is not worth it I was unable to drop because it would cost me financial aid, I wished so bad I had never signed up.

Professor Sutherland is very kind and very passionate about philosophy itself. The class itself is quite enjoyable but your grade depends on very few things (3 papers + 1 final). Attendance is mandatory but you get 6 absences. Find the book online and you won't have to pay for it. Grading could be better but heavily depends on your understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My favorite professor. I actually learn things from his lectures. He seems like a cool dude in real life too. The course is not difficult, he focuses on understanding rather than assigning lots of work.

If you like philosophy of mind this is the class for you. The class structure is simple - weekly write-ups on the readings (summary + your evaluation), meet once a week for discussion, no final paper or quizzes, lecture is informative, you're encouraged to ask questions and participate... basically the ideal philosophy course.

AMAZING! i was hesitant to take this course bc I saw mixed reviews, but his philosophy of death course was so interesting and amazing. He cares for his students and is very nice and understanding if something comes up. He made interactive lectures and is HILARIOUS, so its impossible to get bored in his classes! 10/10!

There are 3 essays and he is a tough grader. This class can be difficult if your English isn't strong. Although this class has no pre-requisites, the professor assumes you have philosophy basics. The class is graded on a curve which is why students with a philosophy background usually score higher than those who don't have a philosophy background.

Dr. Sutherland is a good professor but his grading scale is the problem! You have 1-2 quizzes A WEEK yet the 3 papers + final are worth 80% of your grade. The papers have weird prompts AND the TA's grade the papers harshly and leave little to no feedback. So there is almost no way to improve your grade. You also don't know your grade until the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Sutherland is an amazing and caring teacher. He really does wants you to succeed and his actions speaks louder than words with the time commitment he takes to help us students during office hours. Logic is generally not an easy class but Professor Sutherland and his three sexy TAs helped make it much easier to gasp.

GO TO OFFICE HOURS! I cannot stress that enough. Daniel is an engaging professor who really pushes students to understand the content. Daniel finds ways to help students understand Logic. If you attend lecture, participate, go to office hours, and do the homework you will definitely do well. Also, don't be afraid to ask for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very nice professor but the course load is really heavy so if you're not willing to work for the A then don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This guy is extremely intelligent and funny. I always wanted to take a philosophy course and am so glad I took his. Straightforward and teaches well. TAs were excellent, too.

I was scared to death of this class before taking it. By the end of the first week, I was so enthralled by the subject, and everything just started coming naturally to me. I did so well in the class I got an A and was exempt from the final, and I have this man to thank for it. He found a way to explain a very difficult system with absolute clarity.
He is very clear and very helpful. The course is not difficult.

Don't take PHIL 102 if you don't have to. It's VERY HARD and there is a tremendous amount of work that you'll have to put in!!! However, if its interests you take it with  Daniel Sutherland. He is THE BEST professor I've ever taken.  He is extremely helpfull, explains things clearly, and he is super nice. He's also extremly intelligent.

Extremely hard class!! no joke, read the book before going to class,don't miss class,  read it again after class, study almost every day, make study groups, go to his office hours, go to the TA's office hours, do the homework, read it again... and then, only then will you get it!
best instructor I had in a looooog time, if you like math u will probably love this class
If you want to take this class, take it Pass/fail. Otherwise, it might damage your GPA, since this course is very tough.

I'll be honest...This is a really hard class...If you're not willing to put in a lot of time and effort into this class, pick another one...If you like puzzles, word problems or math, this is a class for you, although there's no real math involved in this...You'll know what I mean if you take the class...The guy isn't hard, it's the material...
This class is very hard.  It is just like taking another math class...and most of the times it counts as math credit.  Its a nice change from math but it is very very hard.
If you don't like math, then don't take this class.
Do not take this class. It is super hard and the professor gives way too much work. He does try to help by forming study groups, but sometimes they're on the weekends. Not cool!
He was my favorite teacher this semester!  The course is very hard, but he puts in the effort to help!  I mean, how many professors know 100 names out of a 150 students?  Great guy!
Freaking hard!!!!!!!

This guy is freakin' nuts! He gives more that twice the work of other teachers teaching the same class, and he expects students to give up some of their weekends to meet with him just so they can pass the class. I took it twice and still only got a D.
Funny, clear, interesting, helpful.

He has a great sense of humor. His lectures are extremely interesting and keep you engaged. He loves it when you contribute your ideas, although sometimes, he can put you on the spot. The exams are in essay format, but he tells you the questions ahead of time.. which is really nice!

really keeps class interesting. lecture isn't mandatory but HIGHLY recommended because the exams are so much easier to take with class notes. it's easier to go class having read the reading assignment to understand what's going on in lecture. gives essay questions ahead of exam to prepare

This professor is simply amazing. The passion that he has for the subject inspires you so much! The best thing about him is that he encourages so much discussion during his lectures, allows freedom of opinion, and actually debates with you during lectures. I wish he taught more courses. He's definitely one of the most intelligent profs at UIC.
awesome guy. take him if you have the option
He is a very good teacher. Take him if you get the chance.

This prof is great!! His class is soo easy if you attend all the lectures. He tells you everything you need to know about the prior reading, and then for exam reviews, he tells you all the essays that will be on the exam AND gives you the answers. So easy, and actually a really interesting class.

Go to class, those lectures are vital...I didn't even have to read because they were so good. He gives you the questions for the exam prior to the test and basically gives you the answers...so unfortunately, if you want a challenge, this isn't your guy. But, it's thought provoking and a good gen ed if you're looking for one.
If you want to take a class with a true thinker then; take his class.  One of the best professors at UIC!

Svolba is great. Go to lecture and take good notes and you should do fine in the class! Loved going to this class because of the enthusiasm he brought to his lectures. Oh yeah, and he is so damn sexy! :)
hes definitely not hot, girls...please don't raise your expectations. he looks like he doesn't even shower. besides his uncleanliness, he is a very good professor, very easy.

Best Prof at UIC- We learn a lot through in-class discussions which are very well conducted- If you come to lecture (no reason y anyone shouldn't because it is that good)and study the Reviews - you get an easy A - What more do ya need?  Worth every penny spent on the course- I feel like I have acquired lot of knowledge having completed this course!

This guy is great! Philosophy was very interesting taught by him! But, his TAs sucked! It is mandatory to take notes because his exams are based on his lectures. It's not mandatory to attend lecture. I recommend him! =) -thumbs up-

Extremely interesting and pretty easy class. The professors amazing! Take his class!!! Attendance and participation aren't mandatory, but you need the notes for tests. He gives out the study guide before the test and is willing to look at answers and help you with everything!
cOOL
good

Well glad to know im not the only one who thought Prof. Svolba was good looking. His lectures are great! I actually looked forward to going to class. Wouldn't want another Philosophy teacher. Very satisfied!
the best prof ever!!! trust me!!!!! you are gonna love him! he expects you to come 2 class but then rewards you at the end :):)

Bloody great professor! Was always so nice and friendly, made the lectures entertaining as possible. Exams were easy because he would give a study guide. If you can, get the Cameron Brewer as your TA, and there is no reason for you not to get an A
The guy really is great! Lectures are engaging and entertaining for sure. The material is tough, but Svolba makes it easier to process by making it current and relatable.
wow hottie! hot hot hot!!!  He is soo good looking. I had the biggest crush on him.. hands out study guides... just study that till you know everything and you will do fine..

This is the best looking professor at UIC! He is dashing and handsome like George Clooney. I used to day dream in his class about him. *wow* His EXAMS ARE SO EASY RIGHT OFF THE STUDY GUIDE which he hands to us so just memorize that for 20 mins.. Multiple choice on the exams can be tricky but if you study the guide you will get an A & go to class

Easily one of the GREATEST professors out there! His lecs are the only lecs at UIC that I love attending. He's funny, witty, & is a great teacher. Only 2 exams, 2 papers, & some hw. Gives out notes and study guides on his site! TAs are cool. I didnt care for Phil/Ethics at 1st, but now I find it very fascinating thanks to this class. Great course!!
Well, I think he doesn't grade fairly. Over all, he is a good professor.

Honestly, Svolba is one of the best professors at UIC.  He is very knowledgeable on the subject and same goes for the TA's (I personally had Brian Casas, but I heard they were ALL great).  He puts thorough lecture notes/exam study notes on his website.

The lectures were very straight forward, and the exams were quite easy. Well... except the final exam. I got absolutely crushed by the final exam. It was a very difficult take home exam. Nonetheless, I really enjoyed the course and would recommend that one would take him as a professor. However, he does not teach at UIC anymore.

The professor is really passionate about teaching and explaining. That said, the way he structures the course is incredibly demotivating. Exams 1 and 2 were fair and matched the material. Exam 3 and the take-home felt like a complete scam, totally disconnected from what we learned. It felt like the goal was to trip students up, not test knowledge.

Switala was a great professor. Attendance was completely mandatory, but he's a great lecturer and is clearly passionate and very knowledgeable about linear algebra, so I almost never wanted to skip. However, the only things that determine your grade are three exams and six homework assignments, so you do need to lock in and score well on them
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The take home final was a scam. They intentionally nit picked everyone's final to take off as many points as possible, it was my lowest test score out of the 4. The rest of the class was okay though.

He's a good professor, but make sure that you go to the classes cuz it'll help you a lot. He posts lecture notes every week and only one that does it. There's 3 midterms and 1 final exam (take home exam) and 6 homework's. He teaches good. Practice problems for all 3 midterms & extra practice from every 2 weeks. Also go to office hours.

Attendance is not required, but he doesn't post any videos of his lectures. He has really detailed notes that are extremely helpful if you do miss a class, though. Exams count for 80% of your grade, but the questions aren't bad at all if you do the questions on his exam practice problem set.

He's really energetic which is something you need for a math class. I got away with not going to class but for exam prep, make sure you actually try to do the homework and watch the examples, that is how I passed the class with no attendance.
Explains everything well and can answer any question that you have.
He explains everything clearly and will answer your questions in class if you get lost.

He's an awesome instructor! He's very enthusiastic about the material and always willing to answer questions in class. He's the only instructor who actually made me look forward to going to lecture. The course itself was not hard at all, just study for the exams and you'll be fine. I personally found the material very fun, so I had a blast.
Great lectures, exams were easy if you did the reviews, final exam was tough but he ended up curving at the end. Would take again
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Man Im ngl this professor is my favorite math one I've had. He answers every question and spends tome actually teaching the material instead of just going over lecture notes. Would recommend this to a baby who who doesn't know how to walk.

I loved this professor!! He is extremely nice and it shows that he does care about his students. His notes are extremely helpful that you don't even need to attend class to understand. His lectures weren't boring, and you actually walked out understanding the material. Exams are very tough but homework is easy.

Worst professor, doesn't grade good at all. So insensitive. Exams are bad and the professor teaches awful. I got A in all my math courses so far (180,181,220,210) but this one is tricky. Material is easy but exam and checking is super hard.

Best math professor at UIC by far. He likes math and teaching so you won't hate your life being in the lectures. His notes are clear and easy to follow, and he answers questions well. Note: I now have him in MATH 310, and he's still awesome.

Prof Switala is nice, respectful, and knowledgeable. His notes are very helpful. Quizzes are fair, he outlines what will be on it and gives practice questions. However, his exams are overly difficult. He gave us the previous semesters' exams, but the exams we got were way harder and different than the previous semesters'. This was very frustrating.

Good teacher but the final exam was extremely hard compared to other math classes. Only 5 HW assignments and one gets dropped. 5 Quizzes and one gets dropped. Attendance not required. Managed to get a B without attending a single class.

Your grade will largely depend on how well you do on the midterm and the final, which artificially makes the course hard as it heavily depends on that current state of knowledge, however professor Switala himself is a wonder to take. Every lecture (attendance not mandatory) was extremely engaging, and you learned things that where used on the test!

favorite professor at uic ever! his style of teaching makes everything so easy to understand and he will always answer any questions you have. 5 quizzes, 3 exams, and 5 hw assignments which are all pretty easy. He's literally the best professor and wants to see all of his students pass. his online posted notes are awesome if you cant make class.

Professor Switala knows how to teach well. He was always willing to help and knew how to get content across to students. Calc wasn't a class that I was good at before, but he was able to teach well enough that I got an A without really needing to study. As long as you pay attention during class and diligently do worksheets and hw, you will be fine.
Easy if you show up to class and put in the work. The professor was good at explaining

Professor Switala made Math 310 one of my favorite classes, he made all the lectures very detailed and easy to understand. The hw was very fair, one homework and one quiz based exactly on the hw a week. The first exam was quite easy and reflective of the material. The final was much harder because the material was more theoretical but still fair.

Professor Switala is a really good professor for MATH 310. He is a very good lecturer and always explains things very clearly, in addition to having really good lecture notes for each topic. As long as you follow and understand the lecture notes you will do great - no trick questions.

The class was easy until the second part of the semester. The final was extremely difficult, and the class average was only 54%, meaning that many students had problems with it. However, Switala blamed us for not knowing the material, even though most of the final exam problems were neither in our homework nor in quizzes.
Professor Switala's class is very well structured and he makes the material incredibly easy to grasp. 10/10 would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The GOAT

Cares about the students. Always answers every question asked. Posts previous exams and which is great way to study since they all follow the same structure. He puts so much energy into teaching, it's hard not to listen. One of the better professors I had.

Dr. Switala does a great job and taking such a complex topic like linear algebra and breaks it down so it is easy to learn. He's enthusiastic and loves math. All of the notes can be accessed online. He's great at meeting after class/office  and the whole linear algebra department is consistent , meaning all the professor in math 310 are amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Switala is hands down the best math lecturer I have had thus far in college. He has so much enthusiasm during lectures and posts all his amazing notes online. The course is mainly graded by exams (70% are exams), the other 30% being HW/quiz. He can be a stickler for some points on exams, but he does give out partial credit. I highly recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This man. DA GOAT. Absolutely. He talks to the chat like a twitch streamer does, and still gets through the whole lecture. My other classmates take the other professors, but they're somehow struggling to keep up with us in terms of pacing somehow and their professor speed runs everything. This guy is a real gem, curved the final grade quite nicely.

Swalita is an amazing professor at UIC who enjoys what he is teaching. His lectures are really informative and he will answer questions and make sure you understand the topic. There are only 3 exams that make up 70% of your grade and they are really tough but as long as you pay attention in his lectures then they should be fine.

Homework and quizzes are in My Open Math, he stays after class to help, uploads clear notes for each lecture, 85 or lower for an A. Was genuinely surprised how accommodating this class was. Some downsides - tests are worth 70% of your grade, lectures aren't recorded. But he's super chill and answers every question - wish he taught more classes.

Professor Switala is simply the GOAT! Lectures are amazing, he has a very inviting charisma, and the material isn't too hard because he explains it in a way to make it easy to understand. I wish he could teach all my classes!

The exam are pretty hard and written homework can be too. You will have to remember many formula and the exam problem he gives are very special cases that you make not know how to do it. The amount of stress from this class is very high.
Nice guy who knows how to teach. Great lecture notes as well

He seems to be a nice prof and person. His lecture slides are very well organized. However, it has nothing to do with the written or online HW. The whole math 310 teaching team expects you to know a theorem and use it on any kind of problem. They give no examples of that theorem. Though, I think he is the best prof in math 310 selection.
he does not help when it comes to online related class issues , and is quite hesitant when with queries , emailing him isnt going to do it as expect a delayed response

Switala is a great professor. His lectures aren't boring as he's an animated guy. His notes are prewritten out and talks through them, using good examples. My only issue is that he goes a little too fast for me. But he makes up for it by always leaving time for questions. Very accessible outside of class, definitely recommend his office hours.

Dr. Sward has a little different personality and is kind of nerdy, but really nice and funny when you take the time to get to know him in office hours. He definitely wants his students to succeed and get good grades though because he gives a lot of extra credit, some test curves, and his grading scale is very gracious. Awesome professor!

Tests don't have exact material learned in class on them.  Not very open to meet other students.  Very boring, yes he does crack a joke here and there but there dull.  If you thought math was easy, think again. :(

His lectures were very organized and he explained everything pretty clearly.  It was easy to do homework from his notes.  Also, he posted the HW problems online so no need for the book.  He made math enjoyable and seem possible to understand.
Good guy, all the hw is extra credit, very clear and lays everything out well.  Take his course.

his examples from lecture do not compare to what is on the exams; also, once I scheduled an appointment with him to answer some questions and he told me that I needed to come back because other students randomly showed up, it didn't seem like he wanted to help me as much as he should have, I came for help not to burden him with 12 following emails

Dr. Sward is an excellent professor. Very passionate about what he does. I actually felt like he wanted us to learn and understand the concepts. The examples he gives in lecture are not much like the exam problems but they do help in understanding the basic concepts. He is funny, willing to help, and has an awesome beard. Avoid Jin Du as a TA.
Sward is an excellent human being. very knowledge and knows math like he knows his name. He is also very funny. When you meet him tell him you like his Beard!!! its cool!
AMAZING, HE IS THE BEST DFQ TA IN THE WORLD. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!

The professor clearly expressed his personal frustration with the class. Despite what I felt were great discussions, he made it evident that he was dissatisfied. Made it evident that he took our opinions very personally, reacting with frustration during class, discouraging my participation. Difficult to tell when he was being sarcastic or serious.
Funny and provides interesting material to read for the program. Grading was generous, although done by a TA so don't expect a lot of feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was really straightforward on what you had to write, but the TA often would submit grades almost a month after submission. There should be a set day when they should have grades put in blackboard. Overall very simple class but not great organization on the TAs part

Professor Swirsky is actually a very good professor and overall good guy. However, the class falls in the hands of the TAs. They are horrible graders and barely give any feedback. I had many assignments get graded unfairly but thankfully Professor Swirsky was nice enough to grade them more leniently and fair. Other than that, overall pretty easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This course is heavily based on essays and writing. Prepare to write a lot! Besides that I think the grading was pretty fair. A lot of my friends got an A as well and the professor is pretty lenient on late assignments. This course was also asynchronous but interesting. The material is also easy to understand.

Professor is sweet, & the lectures are interesting. Since it's not my major, the workload is a little challenging FOR ME. On each assignment, you get feedback. TA was a detailed grader, but overall not too bad. Don't skip an assignment. Complete all of your work, & you'll be OK. Mostly an essay-based class. Resources are provided to you too.

Prof Swirsky is a great prof and provides amazing lectures. You must go to class to pass, he cares about his students and wants you to succeed. There are not many assignments about 7 the whole semester so its important that you do them very well and ask for help in advance if you are confused.
Great professor. The case studies are fun and entertaining.

Professor Swirsky is a funny and amazing professor. Just make sure to do all your assignments and watch his lectures to help you. He is also accessible outside of class to help you. As long as you put in the work there is no reason for you to not pass any of his classes with a good grade.

Watch his lecture videos instead of reading the chapters, i'll be so much easier. If you do that all the assignments should be very easy. He is not a hard grader. If you have the chance you should stop by his office hour. He is a great and funny guy to talk to.
recommended
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: best professor for this course
really nice

one of the best professors I've had if not the best. he's super nice and caring. he truly wants his students to succeed and his course is well planned. in this course, we learned a lot about healthcare and we studied real situations. he'll definitely be a professor that you will not forget.

One of the best professors I've had. His teachings, personality, and perspectives will not be forgotten. One of the rare courses where I felt I was learning information with real substance rather than just trying to pass. Just show up to class, do the work, and learn. Wish there were more undergrad courses offered by this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great teacher. Make sure you don't miss class because it will cost you big points. Half of the class is online which is awesome. Lots of group work so be prepared for that. He really makes you think in the class and shows you other aspects of the medical field most don't think about. Great class. I learned a lot. Do the work and show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Swirsky uses the course prepare you for the ethical situations you will experience in the health field. Lot of group work and attendance but 1/2 the course is online. To get as much as possible out of the course, do the readings and participate. Do that you'll get so much more than a good grade. Courses like this make paying tuition worth it!

Great teacher! Funny in class--takes the material seriously but does not take himself too seriously. Class is loosely tied to the book, which is annoying, but there is not a lot of reading and the book reinforces what is tight. There is no attendance policy, but you cannot pass if you do not attend since most classes have graded labs.

I loved this class and Swirsky! He was always available to help and respected feedback when you gave it. We had a book, but his lecture slides were great. One major paper that he gives workshops for all semester that pulls the paper together easily. First day he did come off as arrogant, but once you got to know him, he genuinely cares

I found this class very interesting and he definitely has a lot to share on ethics! Fun class, and yes he does provide good feedback and will always be willing to help if you ask. Although I was quiet in class, I still found it very enjoyable, and I learned a lot. Good professor, would recommend to anybody, also cracks some pretty good jokes.

He tends to come off as arrogant and like a "know-it-all", but he's a very knowledgable, helpful professor. The class work is not very hard, and the book was not necessary. As long as you do your work, you will pass. If you need any help, he's always willing to help clarify. He asks for feedback on class (graded), and there's only one paper (final)

Amazing Professor! It's not always the easiest class for me since English is my third language! He's a great teacher. He keeps his students engaged through the whole class and is sincerely passionate about English and about teaching. One of my best professors ever! Highly recommend!

Dr.L Swain, a very enigmatic tough teacher, who will do just that-Teach. His understanding of the material that he taught helped me learn tremendously. Dr.Swain makes sure his students are challenged. His style of teaching his class is one of the uniquely best I have seen. I would definitely take any class he teaches!

Swain is super nice, but Engl 101 with him was more work than any other class I took. You have to read The Lord of the Rings, Bewoulf, The Pross Edda, Pearl, The Aeneid, Sir Gwain & The Green Night...it's too much work for a 3 credit hour class..but if you do take him keep up with the readings and it should be an easy A

Class is fun, Swain is nice to everyone and is good at keeping converstations going. he gets to the point and as long as we have good discussions he lets us out early. Also, when asked questions, even about a topic for a research paper, he is very helpful and will not leave you clueless and desperate.Awesome Class, Awesome teacher.

I LOVED his class! The topic for the section was Epic Literature. He made it interesting. I didn't read a few of the books he assigned, but it didn't matter. His class was easy. He made one of our papers extra credit...I think it was the summary one. I got an A.
He is a good TA, but can be a bit chauvanistic. Keep up with the reading and participate in class. Remember there are almost no 'right' answers, just be able to defend your interpertation.
No Comments

I took this course during the 8wk summer session. The book is easy to read, and she has power points for each lecture. She loves class participation, so just read, show up, and talk. The tests were based on the book and class notes, nothing insane. The final was online (meaning open book, open notes!). Do the extra credit and SPEAK UP!

She was a phd student, and it was her first time instructing a class. She was very well prepared for lectures. The midterm and final will be hard if u dont study. I recommend to study almost EVERYTHING she lectures. Also, she gave extra credit, so that was helpful.

Very interesting. I learned so much and Evanka is very nice and understanding about the assignments. She helped when it came to mid-terms and Finals and she keep the class interesting and not like any other lecture. Lectures are very informative so i suggest not missing class

You won't regret taking this course with Dr. Szpunar! He makes cog psychology so much fun. He is caring and very accessible to students for extra help. The assignments are a bit tricky so don't rush through them. He is very clear about what will be on exams (gives thorough study guide questions). I wish he taught more classes!

Amazing prof! Really cares about his students' success. 3 mini assignments, 2 midterms + exam (that he calls midterm 3). His lectures were also super interesting - he uses a lot of cool examples that apply to real life. Useful info, not overly complicated. Come to class, take lots of notes, review the slides for midterms, and you will do very well!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Attendance is a must, his lecture slides that are posted on BB are super vague so you have to go to class but he makes class so interesting. He is great at explaining all the concepts that you dont even need a book for class. One of the best professors I've ever taken!

lectures slides are blanks, you have to go to the lecture filled them up by yourself while he talks. The exam has an approximately 32-33 question, seems fewer compares to other course exams, multiple choices, T/F, filled in the blank, but the main problem of the exam questions are extremely tricky, both confusing questions and answers.

By far the best professor I've had at UIC. He makes lecture super interesting but attendance is a must. He has slides to follow but those are very vague. Have to attend lecture to get the concepts down pact. Overall wish I could take him again. He Loves what he teaches.

Karl is such an amazing professor. He made the lectures interesting and easy to understand. You really don't need the book in his class, just attend class and take notes. Exams were based off of lecture. Sometimes he would end class early which is also a plus. Totally reccommend him, hes great.

Overall, it was very interesting. He does a good job at explaining, and its better to go to class to fill in the powerpoint slides, he does give extra credit on the homework assignments which are very very easy points! He does show videos in class to grab your attention and in most cases you leave earlier than expected. I would take him.

this class was really interesting and he taught it so well that It will have a lasting impact on what I learned about the brain. very knowledgable and does a great job at explaining the content. his video examples are funny and helps to understand the topics. whatever is in the study guide will be on the test. HW was easy. Fair grader
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Incredibly personable, friendly and accessible professor who genuinely wants his students to succeed. While the subject matter wasn't my favorite, he lectured in a manner that made the information stick. Attending lecture is essential, as that is where all the test information comes from. Absolutely take the class with him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Would definitely do again, whole lot of fun!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is the best professor I've had at UIC. Extremely caring and puts in a lot of effort to make sure everyone feels included and enjoys the class. Participation matters, but discussion topics are fun and interesting, so it never feels forced. The class was my favorite part of the semester. I wish she would teach more classes.

She is the best professor at UIC. Anna really cares for her students to succeed and will help you pass her class with an A. She is very passionate about teaching and you can tell by the way she starts each discussion. Anna makes sure every student is engaged and interested during discussion. She is a very caring and modern professor.

She is the best professor I have had at UIC, as well as an easy grader. There is some homework so just make sure you do it and you should end up with an good grade. Lecures were never boring. There was always something interesting to talk about. Take her :)

AMAZING POLISH INSTRUCTOR. Motivated me to go study abroad to Poland this upcoming summer. Also helped me with an interview I needed to do for my Healthcare class. Very open to any discussion, also took her students out to dinner as one of grades for the class. Very fun and interesting. Taking her again for POL202. Easy Grader.
Great professor for both ME 308 and ME 320 with lots of feedback and clear direction during the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
While this is a required class for MechE at UIC, it doesn't really matter who your professor is since the class is handled mostly by the TAs anyways.

That being said she has a really annoying voice that not only makes you want to rip your ears off, but also puts you to sleep. Just do the homework on time and pray for competent groupmates.

This class is required for mechanical engineering at UIC, and if I'm completely honest most of the lectures are really boring. However, she's given clear examples when it comes to group projects and laid out rules for certain tasks within the project. I say just be prepared to do weekly homework and pray you have teammates that communicate.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This is a requirement for mechanical engineering if you go to UIC. While the work isn't hard, having teammates who care about it makes it easier. I hate her voice; she talks and talks and talks, chipping away at your work time with said group. Writing this in class and hearing her voice makes me want to rip my ears off.

Her blackboard is one of the worst I have ever seen. It is a cluttered mess considering she is a person that wants to be "organized". Everything is all over the place and will have the TA's do all the grading very harshly and they are very vague in what they want. It does get better as you figure out what they are asking for exactly, but annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: In ME 250, the class is primarily run by the TAs. Dr. Szwalek is not a fantastic professor, but she is definitely reasonable. As long as you stay on top of your work and communicate with her, when necessary, you will be just fine. She can be a bit moody at times, but it is not that bad. Just a standard professor, really.

Doesn't personally teach anything of actual value and has the TAs do most of the work especially for CAD tutorials. The group projects are easy but only if your group members bother to do any work. Also, be prepared to study a bit for the weekly CAD and Arduino quizzes. They aren't difficult, but they are a pain if you wait till the last moment.

For an intro to CAD class, Jamie spent roughly half the semester on non CAD related topics. I took the class to learn about utilizing it in engineering but instead spent over a month on useless lectures and homework on topics that are fully covered in other, non CAD classes. The class would benefit greatly with only TAs running it.
This class was fun and interactive. Workload isn't bad if you have good teammates that do their fair share of work. The weekly cad and arduino check ins were fun and informative.

She is truly amazing, she makes the class so fun and honestly breaks everything down so well. the first 3 months you spend doing Solidworks, and then you kinda move into matrices and more lecture material, and then the last month you spend learning ANSYS and FEA's. 2 big quizzes, 1 final, a few short quizzes, 2 big projects, 8 In lab assignments

The hardest class I have taken at the University. Provides a lot of work and the grading scale never made any sense. Homeworks worth more than projects and were heavily graded. Takes off a lot of points for anything she can or cannot find. Answers questions in the condescending tone. Has a good personality but was not willing to help. DO NOT TAKE!

Dr. Szwalek really cares about student success. In her 347 course, everything is very straightforward. The bulk of the work comes from major projects, with a small amount from weekly homework/quizzes. I rate 4 stars instead of 5 only because the grading system seemed to confuse many students, but other than that her course is fantastic.
This class is a lot of work and time consuming but the work isnt hard. Start your assignments early and youll be fine. 85% is an A. Szwalek is really nice and offers plenty of help.

She says this course requires around 15 hours outside of class which is a lie! She gives multiple things to work on weekly that you end up spending way more than 15 hours. I guess she measures with her pace not the students'.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: So many meanless thing during this course and not respect enough for student My suggestion is DO NOT take her any class
She didn't surprise again, and spent all summer on how to add more work to our schedule.

I think she comes here and reviews herself. She thinks this is the only class you are taking the entire semester. There is a ton of homework equivalent to a 4/5 credit class, definitely not a 3 credit. We voiced the workload when taking ME 250 back then, and she totally shut us off

She is very demanding,cuts points off depending on how many minutes you are late to class. Even the notebook has to meet her standards. TAs were also rude,would yell if you don't understand smt. Take it from Hatami if you can, he is so chill, you can go to his next class if you miss yours, still an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: I've had professors at 3 different universities, including UIUC, and Dr. Szwalek is by far the best I've had. She presents everything you need to know in class, gives you homework more difficult than the in-class material to prepare you for anything, and then gives exams that are about the difficulty of the in-class stuff so they're a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: She's awesome. So funny and laid back. Helpful and let the students do what they please as long as it was for her class. Does count attendance so don't skip! Easy A. Would so take her again.

Had her for ME 210 and ME 308, she's the best professor you could take in the ME department. She goes at a students pace and really care if you are understanding it or not. Definitely take her if you can.

Best teacher in ME dept. I'm in third class with her and I know how it goes. Must go to class, then HW is redoing her examples. No book needed. Interesting classes. She breaks it down and goes at a student's pace. HW can be a little long, but she uses Piazza to answer questions online to you or others. Eeeeeasy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Attend the class, pay attention to lecture and do the homework by yourself, if you pay attention in class you won't need any extra help however her office is always open, she changed my perspective towards college, you don't have to learn everything by yourself if she is your teacher. Also had her for ME320, same thing

One of my favorite professors I've had. Professor Szwalek is very helpful and goes through problems step by step in lecture which helps in the homework and exams. She loves teaching and has engaging lectures. Also she is available and ready to help during office hours and put helpful examples on blackboard. I made sure I took her next semester

She's simply a great teacher! She's the best teacher I had for ME.. If you go to lectures there's no way you won't get the material. Just do what she says and you'll surly be very happy with your grades. I'm taking 2 classes with her, Vibrations and Mechanics, and also registered for computer aided design. And I still wish she taught more courses!

Took her for ME308 and ME320, Great professor, super helpful, understanding and very enthusiastic about the subject. She made some mistakes in class because it was her first year teaching here, but she corrects and explains them well. Definitely one of the best professors at UIC, do not hesitate to take.
Best teacher at UIC. She explains the material clearly, has a great sense of humor, and she gives great feedback on assignments. Definitely recommended.

I like her I really do. She has a bubbly personality and a smile that can make anyones day, but the fact of the matter is she does not know the subject thorough enough to explain well. She is often corrected by students and constantly questions her self which in turn makes students wonder whether or not the information being provided is accurate.

Have her for both 320 and 308. great professor, very clear and enthusiastic with teaching. If you show to lectures and take notes you do not need the book except to do homework from for 308, while the book for for 320 makes you more confused than just paying attention in lecture. Very helpful during office hours. Extremely fair grader.

Simon is the best professor I've seen in the German department and probably the best language professor I've had. He is very patient,  is very willing to offer his time to students in need and most of all is great at teaching. I learned so much in his class! Take him if you can!
He was very helpful and tried to make the class interesting. And yes, he was a bit nervous, but for good reasons perhaps. He puts a lot of effort!

This was his first year and you could tell. He tries so hard and keeps the class interested. It seems like teaching is his world and he likes to be sociable with the students. He's kind of strict and nervous, probably because it is his first year.

Derrible was amazing. He was very inclusive to all of his students and gave them useful real world applications of the material. There were a lot of fun field trips in the class to observe infrastructure. His lectures would always keep you engaged. On a side note you couldn't be on your phone he minded it alot, pay attention and enjoy the lectures!

5 essays, mostly completion, 2 500 word essays, 3 1000 word essays, 4/14 quizzes dropped all true/false, and a weekly reading he wrote and weekly zoom call. No final, midterms or any tests(all of your grade is from Essays, quizzes). Easy class if you get your good at managing deadlines.

I sat in the front row, showed up to class everyday and participated. Professor Derrible was by far the most passionate professor I have had at UIC. He cares about his students and wants them to learn. I highly recommend taking him for Water Resources. Don't expect an A if you don't participate in class.

Great professor. Homeworks are very useful and the lectures are easy to understand. His class is rarely boring. Exams are ok but a bit too long. Unlike many professors, he'll actually reply to your emails and answer questions. Highly recommend.
Great lectures, fair homework and fair exams. Which makes for an excellent professor. When I was lost, he was there to answer questions!

Good guy.  New at being a professor. Lectures aren't unclear but could use a little more.  My only problem is with how long his tests are.  Other than that, he just needs to get into the swing of being a professor and he'll be great.
Not bad. Not bad at all..

She's a an amazing teacher. It was great to be in her class. She is willing to push back deadlines if the class needs it. Attendance is taken each class and you can only miss 3 times. You can easily get a passing grade but if you want an A you do have to put in work. She's funny so the class is never boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She makes you for the A though so put in work in your essays!

Sylvia is one of the best teachers for ENG 160. She is caring, funny and disciplined at the same time. You will always feel that she is one of your peers and is a good friend to bond with. I will always want to take her class again but can not as she teaches only ENG 160

This class does require a bunch of readings, however they are not the typical super dry sociological readings, it is actually quite interesting, and will severely change your ideas on the quality of our "food" here in the U.s. I think the other reviews were a little harsh, as I really do enjoy this professors class. Only 2 papers, and only 2 tests

She claims that attendance is mandatory (TA takes attendance) but it does not affect your grade. She gives the possible questions for exams at least a week before but they are all essay questions. She's really boring, gives soooo much reading homework but if you find time to read, there's no need to attend lecture. overall, pretty easy.
She is boring and does very little to help you.

the worst teacher I have ever had, she doesn't do powerpoints nor does she write on the board she literally stands in front and lectures the whole time! if you don't like reading this is NOT the class for you, the exams are fairly tough NOT to mention if you don't know the vocab or terms your doomed! Nice woman BUT horrible teacher, dropped it

This class requires a lot of reading.  If you read the readings you should do fine on the test.  You learn a lot in the class, if you are looking for an easy A this is not it.  If you want to learn than this is it

She does not use power points nor does she write on the board. All lectures are mainly based on her talking and a few clips from movies which are no help. You need to really read and understand the terms she gives in order to do good on the test. She's one tough professor but you can still survive the course.

It's the kind of class where if you actually go and take notes, you'll do well since the exams are all terms and  questions she gives to you beforehand. There is one paper that most people did ok on. Easy if you actually go.

Yes, she is boring. Yes, she has a monotone voice and does not really engage her students. But I thought that the class material (medical sociology) was incredibly interesting--you just have to be willing to read the material on your own time and teach yourself. It is an incredibly EASY class--basically the STUDY GUIDE she gives a week or two befor

Not a bad class, but you really need to keep up with the material each week. She talks a mile a minute; hard to follow, LOTS of reading. She gives a study guide a few days before the exams, which forces you to learn more than you need. Aside from the massive note taking, the class turned out pretty well. Decent curve, nice lady...not bad.

she does not use powerpoints or overheads. she does not repeat anything (not even definitions for key terms). she hardly writes on the chalkboard and has horrible hand writting when she does. the subject would be interesting but Halpern killed it. i don't even understand how she even got a job as a college professor.
the class requires work, but its very interesting.  its like you're actually in college.  so, don't take this class if you don't want to be challenged.
Terribly boring class. She just stands and mumbles for an hour-fifteen, as noted below.  She doesn't know how to teach, and grades with a confusing curve.

most boring teacher at UIC. she doesnt use powerpoints, she stands there and talks for an hour and 15 minutes straight and you have no idea what shes talking about and whats important to know for the tests.
No Comments

Can't use your laptop in class, however she posts the lecture slides with fill in the blanks (prior to lecture) on BlackBoard. It's a great strategy. Kept me focused, and engaged during class. Material was also enjoyable to learn and the professor is lively and keeps your attention. Highly recommend this course and this professor!

She's a great professor. She gives extra credit and she is a fair grader. Watch our for her exams, use the test reviews in the book and you should pass. Do NOT use your phone while in class, she will wait until you put it away. She doesn't allow laptops during class. *For every theory make your own example so that you remember everything!

I think she is overall a good professor, she ties in a lot of research and examples to help teach. lets out class early a lot. shows pretty interesting videos. drops lowest test grade. would take again
Sooo much homework. 3-4 lengthy assignments a week, not managable for someone who also works.

This instructor can be somewhat disorganized at times. The material itself is not very difficult. She occasionally makes mistakes or gets confused during lectures. However, her exams are very similar to what she teaches in class, which makes them easier to prepare for if you pay attention and keep up!

This is the most disorganized professor I have ever had. I've already taken a statistics course in high school, so I already knew the material. If you are learning stats for the first time, take someone else. She often makes errors and confuses herself while teaching, or stands by her mistakes. The content is honestly not hard.

One of my favorite professors I have had. She is so engaging with her lectures and preps students so well for the exams. The exams are exactly like the practice exams she provides, and she tries her best to give out partial credit points. This professor made me enjoy statistics. The material isn't too difficult if you attend class and take notes.

If you attend class and do the assignments you'll get a good grade. The exams are entirely based on what she teaches in class. Her lectures are easy to understand and they are recorded so you can watch them if you miss class. She doesn't like people talking in class.

Took her time to move at an inconsistent pace and had unorganized notes on blank computer paper that were hard to decipher during lectures. She wrote in pen, so be wary of many mistakes. Unless you are learning the material outside of class, I would suggest finding another professor to better learn.

Took her recently for IDS 270, she as a person is nice. However, I did not like her style of teaching, she moves through power points too fast, gets off track easily ( spends about 30 min side tracking and lecturing us about something else). She's okay. But I will say the reviews done were exactly like the exams( just changed a bit).

Honestly, I struggled to learn during her lectures and I would zone out or do other things. I would basically just teach myself the material a couple of days before the exam. Professor Talukdar is really nice though!

The class wasn't too hard since the homework was easy to get done but the professor herself was very disorganized, she writes in cursive during lecture, and moves on really quick between topics, she was an alright professor, take someone else if you can.

Personally did not like her class found it quite challenging. Lectures were unorganized majority of the time it was just her doing practice problems. 2 exams 1 final each one has like 3-5 questions and they are in person. Attendance was not taken for lab and videos how to complete it posted. Each week there was a multiple choice hw and quiz on bb

Professor Talukdar teaching was not for me. I only missed one class the entire semester, but I found her lectures to be disorganized and disjointed. She often seemed to lose track of where we left off in the previous class. Most of the time, I had to rely on the slides and examples to understand the material, which was still challenging.

Professor Talukdar teaches the concepts in this class very well. I thought this class would be difficult but if you attend lecture, take good notes, and review them you'll easily get A's on the exams. The content isn't very complex and she prepares everyone very well for the exams.

Professor Talukdar is a very compassionate lady who cares about the success of her students. She is an honest professor, who will work with her class in a respectable manner. Her passion for statistics is evident through her lectures and material.
I think this class can be easily dismissed as easy and simple. The exams contained maybe 5ish questions. Lab assignments required. Attendence done through Acadly. Great professor- very lecture based.

Lectures are easy to follow if you prepare before class; She provides us with recorded lectures (from a different professor), so if you miss a class, you'll be fine. She tries to explain things clearly and answer questions by giving real life examples. Textbook is only required for the homework questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Talukdar is an amazing professor, and very experienced in stats! She is very kind and ready to listen to your questions and respond so you understand. Attendance is required. Her course is strict - but in a good way where the learning objectives are clear and concise. If someone tells you she is a bad professor - ask if they attended class lol

I took Talukdar only because the time suited my schedule better, but was a mistake. Take Sparks. The only reason I was able to pass this class was the fact that she posted his lectures and reviews. There is no curve, there is no extra credit. Her lectures aren't helpful but mandatory. Her exams are only 3-4 questions.

Knows what she's doing, really passionate about her job. Always ready for students' opinions. Little to no leniency regarding due dates. If you're taking this course online she'll post lecture videos, old study guides, she'll try her best to always be available. Since the course was hybrid, the lectures were online but the exams were in person.
Love her. Class is so easy but you have to study for the test. Tests are easy.

TA's and Professor were very accessible outside of class. Great professor. The professor was very clear and fair regarding her grading criteria. She dropped your lowest exam score and gave extra credit points for completing the instructor evaluations. Does not round. Only con about her is that she can be very snappy and a little rude at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: you have three tests, an optional final, and a light project. Your performance on these assignments determines your grade. I recommend studying the study guides before the exams because most of the questions are on there. I recommend taking this class alongside heavier courses because the workload is light.
Shes simply the best. You will be good in class as long you do the study guides.

She wasn't really a memorable professor to me; she was just there... and wasn't helpful when it came to understanding content outside of class. Gets snappy if you're unsure of an answer, but she is smart. The poster is super easy. but there not a lot of points in this class.

Professor T was one of the nicest professors I've ever met. She is super understanding and caring. I've never even used rate my professor to give any teacher a rating but I created an account just to give her a 5 rating.

This class is very easy as long as you follow a long for her review sessions. I highly recommend her, she is very caring and explains the review slides very well. I recommend making sure you understand each part of those slides in the review and answering them in detail. I only went to class for the exams and still got an A. Highly recommend!

Dr. Tchernookova is honestly one of the best professors I've met here at UIC, she makes things concise and focus on the study guides because its VERY similar to the exam. Make sure to attend the review sessions and ask any questions on them. She is very kind and willing to help. 100% recommend

Great professor overall, very knowledgeable, and passionate about what she teaches. Your grade is based on one poster project and 3 exams (4 but you drop the lowest grade). The class itself is very interesting and the study guides are very helpful for exams as well. She talks a bit fast but lectures are recorded and always available outside class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Tchernookova is passionate about neuroscience so she does go on some tangents during lectures, which can be interesting but she talks fast so it is hard to keep up sometimes. That being said, lectures are recorded so that makes it slightly better. Your grade is based on 3 exams and a project so you need to do well on tests to get a good grade.

Your grade is 3 exams and a poster project. She drops one exam. Exam 2 is the hardest and I think it's because at that point no one showed up to class (10/250 ppl) The poster project is easy to get 100% on if you go to office hours.
