Cared about our success and gave many opportunities for participation bonus points. Also frequently put the material in a practical context so that we could see its usefulness in industry.

Dr. Yang is very responsive and helpful, however, you need to make sure you're asking questions if you're stuck and need help. During lectures he can move a bit fast, and will assume you are following along if you don't stop him. He pauses and asks if anyone has questions often, so make sure you participate. He gives bonus points every class, too.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Yang is a caring professor who grades very quickly, always responds to emails, and gives bonus points for things such as answering questions. The exams are close to the sample exams and he's a bit lenient when grading homework(which is a bit tough). Solid choice, but he often does lack in explaining things in an enlightening way. Ask questions!

He gives really helpful reviews before the exams. This was a difficult class, but he was a good teacher considering the material. He does tell you to "try by yourself" often before teaching you how to do something. So it's necessary to buy the book.

Professor Jie Yang is a good professor. He explains the material well. The class is all about solving statistical problems for clients using R software and presenting the solutions. The projects are a lot of work, but the material is useful and interesting. I recommend this professor and class.

Very clear lectures. Very kind, approachable, and cared about students. 

Remember, professors never do the grading. The TA incorrectly marked HW and midterm answers wrong. Went to Dai after class and got my points back. No trouble getting an A, even before the curve.

Statistics is a dry science and certainly isn't easy. Others are simply biased.

Just to clarify another comment gave by someone in 2015, her research is worse. I highly doubt that she understands and ever tried using what she is teaching, her teaching seems like she is giving a presentation of what she just read. Feels like she is a good student just got into the field, not a professor, not even senior PhD student.

Lectures are worthless to attend. Reasonably simple material is presented in such a convoluted way that I would recommend actually NOT coming to class. The grades are curved, but it is never made clear what grade you may have, relative to the class. I strongly recommend trying to get another stats class transferred into your program.

Professor Dai, while very nice, is a very soft/quiet lecturer and isn't very organized in lectures. She often writes out example problems and proofs of things on the board, but between the dark lighting and messy mid-problem thought tangents, if you have any problems with attention you will need to self-study (a lot). The tests are from the book.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Its hard to understand her. shes good with office hours. read book, can get an A.

She is a decent person and probably an excellent researcher, but she's not meant to be a professor. She doesn't know how to explain things to students, and she never pauses to see if anyone has questions. Her lectures are useless, but the class is exactly based off the book, so read and study the book carefully and you should get an A.

She is the best teacher to put you to sleep. Her voice is to low and her slides are to boring. She does not care if anyone is understanding or not. The course i took with her was hard but she made it impossible  to lear anything.
If a person goes by judgement and not by performance then she is no teacher! Shame...
She is one of the coldest person i have ever seen. She should not teach. Stick herself to research

He cares enough to really want students to come to office hours.Tests reflect homework & practice exams. It takes 10 hours per homework every week.Even midterm week. 

UCSD academic senate says 1unit=2hrs work, he stated in class that 10-15 hours of work (not including homework) is fair.Ridiculous.Doesn't give nearly enough example problems either.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: His lectures are very boring, but attendance is not mandatory. All exams are take-home with the lowest dropped. Labs are interesting and easy. I definitely recommend taking this course with him.

Great professor that's super knowledgeable and wants students to succeed in the class. Grade based entirely on exams and final, but they were very straightforward. He goes over everything you needed to know during the exam reviews.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Overall had a very great experience with Zheng. He taught the class in a way that made it interesting. Exams were very straight forward. Class wasn't homework heavy. Made the topics in Integrated Circuit very interesting.
Fantastic Professor, makes the class interesting and cares about how you do in the exams.

Great professor, for his exam reviews he'll tell you what will be on the exam and what to study and won't give you something outside of what he spoke about. As long as you go out of your way to study the material that will be tested you'll get a good grade.

It was a summer course so the lecture were long and heavy, accent didnt help. Post questions and solutions for homework (not graded) and old tests on blackboard. Do the hw and tests reviews and you will be fine, but hes a very strict test grader, lose a lot of points for wrong final answer. All in all a good summer class.
Worst professor ever.

He is very strict in his grading criteria. Gives difficult exams and grades strictly. He doesn't hesitate to give D and F grades. Very stubborn. No make up exams, no home works, sticks to his tough grading. Gives bad grades to almost half the class. I will never take his course again
Too stringent, spends too much time not talking about lectures, hard to understand. not recommendeda
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I do not know about the other guys, but this is by far one of the most enjoyable classes I had. Professor Yang is a little hard to understand sometimes because of his accent, but he is extremely knowledgeable, and  he is always willing to help his students out after class and during office hours. Easy class. 1010 would take a class with him again.

He is a great person and he really cares about the students, but he is used to teaching at a much higher level so he kind of gets your hopes up for more interesting material. Sometimes he is a little hard to understand but, get to know him outside of class, he does really cool research and he knows a lot about the semiconductor industry.
Teaches everything from his notes so no text book needed. Very tough grader.
Not Worth attending
was least interested in attending his lectures , boring and was very bookish !!!
For summer, don't take him.  There are a lot of mistakes in the book, his tests are hard.

Professor Yang-Clayton is very acomplished and brings that to the classroom. She works very hard to tie the problems you see in the news to each class. She also made an effort to get to know each and every student.
All readings will be online and doesn't require you to buy textbooks
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Kathleen brings a lot of real-world experience to her class, enabling students to connect the lectures to the real world. She brought a lot of really interesting guest speakers that made class fun. She shares exam questions beforehand which allows for students to ask questions and clarifications to prepare well. Doesn't share lecture slides though.
Wants students to learn as much as they can and gives insightful lectures.

The class is easy to pass. I strongly recommend to attend class because its graded heavily on participation. Make sure to take notes because her lectures arent uploaded to BB. Also, make sure you prepare your answers for the exams ahead of time to help you when writing the exams. The exams are written portions only. There are also a few papers.

She was an amazing professor that brought in a lot of guest speakers who would give us a lot of outside materials we could use on the test. There's two papers, two blog post, and the midterm and final which are both written. It was very insightful and she gives out lots of opportunities for extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor gives no instruction on assignments and relied us to understand the assignment by a vague description on the syllabus. Also lectures is her complaining and we have learned little
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: If you're looking to be thrown to the wolves and not guided in any way, then this class is for you! You have to buy books just for the obscure assignments, you are never told specifically what is a good essay in their eyes, you arent given resources or help of any kind, the teacher is inaccessable she just wants you to talk to the TAs, never her.

The grading criteria is never ever clear, the students are not given any advice or any supportive tools to write an essay that measures up to their obscure expectations. Yang-Clayton prattles on and on for the whole class then basically throws the students on the TAs and the TAs are not really helpful they just wanna get their credit and get out.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is not for someone who wants an easy elective. There are many unecessary assignments which she fails to explain well. Also you have to buy two expensive books which you have to read for assignments. A big chunk of the grade comes from a policy campaign that you have to do and there is no help with finding sources.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I really love her. She cares about students needs and is always willing to extend her contacts and connections. One thing she required all of us to do was to visit her in office hours.

Kathleen is an amazing professor, by far one of my favorites at UIC! She gives lots of real-world examples to connect to the material she teaches. She also works on a lot of outside projects and brings in her experiences to share with the class. However, you won't do so well in this class if you skip lecture or discussion. Overall easy A.

Very opinionated and goes on and on about her kids and her kid's school. She makes this class a lot harder than it needs to be and gives you a bunch of busy work that is not needed. I would never take her class again because she always goes off on tangents and does not help or curve your grade. It is an easy A but not worth the trouble.
BEST PROFESSOR EVER!

Professor Yang-Clayton really cares about what she teaches, and is always updating us on what's going in education policy in Chicago. Her class is really easy, there's only like four papers total. I definitely recommend her class!!

Lot's of reading but manageable, overall we had four writing projects including the final. Very funny guy and is caring for his students. Just make sure you do the drafts because they are super helpful. Take him if you don't mind reading!!

He's a really caring person, he understands the students, even the new freshman, and is very lenient with assignments because of his knowledge of every college student that has things going on, overall a great guy

He is a good professor who will give you great feedback and make class far more interesting then it is. He's extremely caring for his students and makes an effort to make sure that they're alright. His class isn't difficult at all, submit one thing a week and go over it and that's all. It really is an easy class with him and also very enlightening.
He is one of the best professors in the entire UIC. You just have to submit your work on time and you will be good for an A.

Professor Yencich is by far one of the greatest teachers I have had in my entire life. He actually looks out for his students and reassures you that your mental health is extremely important. While there are textbooks for the class, he always reads over the exact same assigned course readings in class. He also gives extensions and is very patient.
Hes super chill and such a nice guy! You should definitely consider him as your teacher!

Hilarious, great teacher. Took intro to writing poetry. Easy class. One poem every Sunday night due, Tuesdays are workshops and Thursdays lectures. Great feedback on papers, really cares about students. Super nice and fun to talk to. Funniest guy around and class exposes you to looking at poetry in new ways when you critique other peoples work.

Perfect professor for intro level econ! she explains things very clearly and i found the homework and iclikers very helpful. so much extra credit available which is nice for bad test takers. lots of lecture but she makes it fun!

I had her for ECON 121 and she was great, she actually teaches the material and it's really easy to follow along with her. We had 2-3 assignments a week but they're short and to the point. There was only a midterm and a final, both covering exactly what we learned, and we were allowed an index card. Definitely recommend taking her!

Very friendly professor, uses very realistic examples related to economy to explain students.( Dont have idea about higher level classes). Would definitely take again if I have to but it was a general elective for me.

When you are taking with this professor, make sure you come on time to class every single day, finish lot of her homeworks, and the exams are very easy if you just study hard. All of the Iclicker, Machill questions will cover the exams. She is an amazing teacher! You are going to like her a lot.

She takes attendance through IClicker, but if you join in the first few minutes of class, you don't need to be there. I showed up like 5 or 6 times through the semester and still got an A. you only need 900/1100 for an A and she has so much extra credit.

She is very reasonable and she doesn't ramble on and on about the material, in a way, though those Iclicker questions are a pain for the most part, they are necessary if you want to actually learn the material. Overall, she is very clear and you'll do great if you keep it up!

She offers a lot of extra credit work which really helps out a lot. Can be strict sometimes but is never rude. She likes to add a bit of humor in her lecture slides. As long as you take good notes and do all the assignments, this class is very easy to pass.

Dr. Yektansani teaches amazingly, she provides many examples and clarifies all the subjects. She cares about every single student (the most caring processor I've ever seen). You should attend the class and pay attention though, but that's a great investment as you learn a lot.

Professor Yektansani is very nice and she has great humor in her lectures. I will say that if you don't go to lecture then you will not understand what is going on but the class is quite simple and the criteria is layer out clearly from the very beginning. She also gives weekly updates on what to expect every week. She is a bit picky on attendance!

This professor is extremely nice and super passionate about what she is teaching. Her class is very interactive but if you miss one lecture, I am sure you will be super confused so just do not miss lecture. I do think she is quite considerate and there is a lot of content in the class so it is a lot to take in. Lots of extra credit opportunities.
Professor sets very tough examinations and is not helpful

Salama is by far the hardest teacher that I have had at UIC.  His examples/sample exams do not reflect anything on the exams. The exams are very hard. I would avoid taking his class if at all possible.

I had no problems with him. If you do homework and attend classes - it's not hard at all. His examples are clear, homework is helpful. Need more help - go to T.A. He is not bad at all, just do what's requered and there should be no problem. Tests are OK, quizzes are pretty easy.
If possible, do NOT take this professor.  The material is difficult, and he is not helpful at all.

Salama was a very difficult prof.  He expects a lot from his students.  He makes it seem like this is the only class you are taking.  He doesn't write big enough, and he doesn't like to use the entire chalk board.  Very deiificult professor.  Exams suck.
this class is hard and Professor makes his tests extra hard.

The professor is a real trickster. The quizzes and HWs are 25% of the grade yet they're all unannounced. His exams are easy IF YOU UNDERSTAND THE CONCEPT. Exams are multiple choice but there are still a lot of small calcualtion problems in there.

Pretty hard teacher. He is funny, but he always gives pop quiz and hw which you are expected to have for every class(try soffer. shes cool). I thought he was boring(when he wasnt making jokes) and hard to understand.

So he is a little tough and can be a hard ass sometimes, but honestly, I learned a lot in his class. I like his teaching style too. He lectures and writes on the board, which facilitates good note taking. He's loud and serious, but the occassional wise cra

This man is EVIL.  I failed this class because of him.  Half the time you can't understand a word he was saying.  And he told me that if I got a B on my final, he would pass me.  Well, i got a B and he didn't pass me.  When I aksed him why in email, he didn't respond, and when I asked him in person he said he didn't remember saying anything to me.

Doesn’t prepare students well. Salama doesn’t tell what will be the curve until the end of the semester. Tests are hard, quizzes are very easy though. I did better when I focused more on the book and daydreamed in his class. Why is that man so mean?

A hard class made harder by an incompetent Salama. The man could have taught the concepts much better. Salama goes off in many directions leading many students to confusion. I don’t care if he is a little mean, but he really should communicate better. My semester was hellish due to his class. Avoid him for any class!

The class could be challenging. Attended lectures thats what has helped me, i didn't bother with HW and reading. Although I would recommend that you read the chapters before class therefore you will understand the lectures better. I did very well in the class.

this professor knows his stuff too bad he cant communicate it to his students.  I couldn't understand anything from this professor, that is what made my experience with him horrible, dont take this professor,LISTEN TO ME.
Class is fairly challenging. Professor knows his material although his exams are fairly though. Attend lectures and take notes and you should do fine.
Very knowledgable...If you do the homework problems or at least problems in the workbook and attend the lectures everyday, you're almost guarenteed to pass...Maybe even get a B or higher...
he's a good teacher. very clear and concise. tests are not too hard, as long as you go to class every day.
Test are hard and you have to read the chapters before coming to class to understand the lectures.
one of the worst teachers i ever had.  and to top it off, at the end of the year he changed the grade that he declared would be an A.

prof teaches as if EVERYONE is an accounting major, so his tests & quizes are HARD, no joke, if you try, you can get a C no prob, but he is very knowledgable about acc & is a nice guy- if it weren't for this class....
No Comments
He is very passionate about his teachings, however the class is ridiculously hard.
Very Good Teacher. Go to leactures, u will learn a lot. take notes. has an accent. does not use powerpoint. gets class involved. Class is hard like all other actg. classes. very hard.
No Comments

Awful. Exams were awful and had too many questions on the exam for a 50 min class. Quizzes were open note and not too bad but were made confusing. Attendance is mandatory and his accent makes it hard to comprehend. Take someone else if you can or take it at another school because the managerial accounting professors at UIC are awful.

reviews.comment: He is amazing
Terrible. The quizzes are hard and the review for the exam is over 50 slides and each problem has a gazillion steps. You only get to miss class 2 times.

reviews.comment: I don't know why the rate is low here because his lecture was great. However, the general contents were difficult. The exams were hard, but most were from the review right before the exams.

Course was very difficult and based on the average exam scores it was bad for the majority. You could tell how frustrated everyone was due to how difficult this course is. Textbook is online and the homework. Quizzes are in person and open note but with how he teaches it was hard most times to pass the quiz. Exams are horrible so good luck......

His lectures order the content in the most confusing way possible and he gives us another professors test which is so different that what we take its barely considered the same class at this point. He sees that our quiz averages he gives us are really high but he's blind when we fail the exams and wont curve. i wish I dropped the class I really do
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: lectures are long and dont make sense and he gives other professors test. doesn't curve either even though averages are low.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is not a good lecturer or teacher. Mr. Young will continuously lecture about one topic or point about the guidelines of a paper over and over again without any productive feedback, all the while speaking as if you had already messed the whole assignment up. He doesn't email back timely or even read emails for student concerns and inquiries.
The only bad thing about Andy is that he doesn't reply to emails and it would take him a long time to send the stuff after class.

He is a great professor. Very understanding and took the class day by day. There is a lot of drafts but he gives great feedback so ur papers come out really good. He also likes to talk a lot. Take him!!

Andy is pretty chill and funny. You get a certain amount of absences in his class so just show up most of the time and you'll be fine. He's not too tough of a grader and he's really understanding. There isn't really ever any hw and there's only a few papers. He mostly just talks. Like I said, super chill
If you don't plan to retake this course, then sign up with a different professor. He failed total 5 students in the class I took in Fall 2016.

reviews.comment: Okay, he does many drafts and will let loose on what errors you did on the paper. As long as you follow what he does you should have no problem getting a decent grade in the class.

Andy is honestly not the most enthusiastic professor but he made English 160 a breeze. I never really knew what the topic was but he said it was "Prepare for English 161". He was very straightforward and his assignments weren't terrible at all. For his papers, he told us EXACTLY the formats he wanted.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He's definitely a hard professor. I honestly regret taking him as a freshman. He's very strict on grading and strict on what he's looking for in papers. I did well in papers in my high school but in his class, none of that matters. In his perspective, it's college and you should know what you're writing already.

As a senior now at UIC, I can now say he's the worst professor I've had thus far. He's far too critical when grading papers, pay in mind that he's also teaching mostly freshman. Has little patience, you'll notice that with the brutal audio revisions. You can tell he's tired of his job, he's very discouraging if anything and constantly sighs.
Andy is very particular about correctness. You should increase your awareness for silly mistakes and grammatical errors in order to maintain an average grade.

Most people say he is a tough grader but he outlines all mistakes  you made for you. Fix everything he marked on the paper and you a guaranteed and A. I struggled at first and recieved a low grade on the first paper and started doing very poorly on the draft of my second, but going to office hours was extremely helpful and it saved my grade.

He's all over the place. You can never get a clear answer to your questions and when he explains something, he leaves you hanging. Doesn't answer emails and makes your papers look like his pen exploded. Nice guy but not a good teacher.
He marks EVERY mistake on a draft of a paper, which looks super daunting and discouraging but honestly helps so much.

This prof seems okay at first, but one week in and you'll probably hate him. He grades harshly, and is never 100% clear. There are no tests or graded hw, but there are online quizzes every week. His edits on your paper will probably want to make you cry at fist. Avoid his class if possible. I tried very hard just to get a B in this class.

Andy is a tough grader. The class was honestly stressful. He  does not explain things well and most of the time you have no idea what to really do. However, if you ask him for help, he will help you. If you want to pass the class you need to ask for his help and do exactly as he says in his essays. Good luck!
One of the worst teachers I've ever encountered. He once drew a picture on one of my papers instead of actually grading it.

Ok, I hate how he expects us to all have a Ph.D in English. He grades really harsh and makes you feel like your a complete failure. Also, he critisized my writing a couple times. In the end though, he was reasonable, he gave extensions, made it easier by better explaining.
He is honestly an awful teacher! Great guy but he grades way to harshly! All you will ever see in your papers are red marks and him basically stating that you are dumb! Just plain awful

fall of 2013.He is a terrible teacher. He is an over-dramatic diva, and he grades as if everyone will be an English major. He closes his eyes when he whines, and is not understanding at all. I don't understand how he has a job as a teacher. He has the worst social interaction skills ever,  and he always comes off as condescending. Avoid him!

Do anything in your power to avoid this teacher. Every essay I ever turned in was "stupid" and apparently I had "serious issues." He crosses out everything and makes you feel dumb. Don't do it to yourself.

Andy is a fair teacher. The  grade you get in the class is truely the grade you deserve. He can be weird at times but whatever. He has 4 writing projects. I got a 50% on my 1st, 70% on my 2nd, and then I went to him for help on the last two and I ended up getting a A+ in the class. Simply put, you pay attention and ask him for help, youll get an A.

He trashes his students' writing by marking up papers with red ink, crossing out whole pages and his criticism is hardly constructive. Avoid his class if possible. It's very difficult to write a paper that he will approve of and his quizzes are insanely detailed.You'd need to memorize his worksheets to do well in his class.

Andy likes things done his way! Seriously, just follow his instructions and you will pass that class with flying colors. Many students complain about him because his grading and hand-writing are horrendous, but he just pinpoints every mistake in your paper. Ask for help if you need. He is very thorough! Just do what he tell you to do!
not good. poor teaching skills. he will fail you if you don't do things his way.

AWFUL! My essays in high school used to be all As and Bs and then I came to this class and started getting Ds on everything. His grading is ridiculous (literally everything is marked up). Please don't take him because it will definitely ruin your GPA.

Andy is an okay teacher. His grading is insane so if you think your writing is good then prepare to get your dreams crushed! I was in awe when I got my first paper back. There were scribbles, X's and lines all over the place, and it wasn't only mine, it was everyone's.

Andy is a very understanding teacher He grades hard, but you just gotta follow his instructions I wasnt doing to well in his class at first but i went to his office hours and worked with him He extended one of papers one time I ended up with a C but i was still ok with it cause i was failing at first. If you build a relationship with him you r fine

At first Andy seems like a nut who only wants you to write how he wants. Although that's kind of true, this class will actually help you in the long run. My writing improved because of this class. Just be prepared for a lot of red ink.

Professor Young is a very ;aid back teacher. Most of the quizes are based on memorization. He grades very hard on  essays. On my papers almost everything was crossed out. In high school my essays were all As and Bs. Now my essays are usually Ds. He grades very hard compared to to other english professors.

THE ABSOLUTE WORST TEACHER EVER IN MY LIFE. FOR A BASIC LEVEL YOU FEEL LIKE YOU ARE STUDYING TO BECOME A LAWYER. please do not pick this professor if possible, it is not worth the stress on papers just to receive a 75%
He takes his class way to seriously for a basic level english class.
Please do NOT take this teacher. Take anyone else. Too much unnecessary work and scribbles your papers in red pen. If you are going to take this class, best of luck.

Avoid him at all costs! Turns back your rough drafts two weeks late.  I normally get A's and B's on papers but he gave me C's and D's.  He doesn't explain the papers before he has you turn drafts in for his grading.  Also likes to lecture the class when we don't write like he wants.

WORST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD IN MY ENTIRE LIFE. Basically, you can only have sentences that he wants or else your paper will be wrong. In high school, I never got lower than a B on my papers, with him I got papers back completely crossed out saying I have "issues" and need to work on my writing....

I would spend hours on his papers, and he still believed I didn't try hard on it, which was very upsetting. If you are a very experienced writer, then take this course, but if not find a different teacher.
He plays favorites all semester. If you dont write like he wants you to then you fail. If you write too much and try to explain, you fail. He is a horrible teacher

DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!!! Got an A on three of four essays and did all the homework and STILL got a B in the class! Unless you want to lower your GPA, DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!!! I should have listen to my RA when she warned me about him.
good teacher... u have to work just like every class but he's there to help and he is very understanding... i miss this easy class!

This professor knows how to teach. His grading is a bit harsh but fair. If you read and listen to his lectures, you should be able to do fine. He is a very understanding professor; so if you have any problems in class, always tell him. I ended up with an A in his class but I worked really hard and I learned so much.

English is my second language, and i still got a B. If I could do it, you can do it, considering the fact that English is my least favorite subject. You WILL learn grammar in his class, and you WILL improve your writing. He's a bit of a tough grader. All it takes to get a good grade is care about getting a good grade and put 100% effort into it.

Ok...well he is no picnic...but then again it's college! You got to work hard! He gives a lot of homework as if you didn't have other classes to worry about. He gives out a lot of grammar homework...what are we in second grade? If you like English a lot maybe this class is for you if not? Stay away from this guy.

This is the worst class I've ever taken. He gives a lot of work and gives low grades. Yeah the tests are easy, but they only account for a small portion of your grade like 10%. Also, he forces students to buy things that we don't use. I felt like I lost IQ points just by taking this course. The best part of the class is when it was over.

He's a cool guy, thats undeniable. Loves to help students, but he expects A LOT. More work than a 3 hr class should have. He also grades hard. I agree with 1 of the previous comments, don't take this class if you have 5 classes.

DO NOT GET THIS MAN!!!!!!!! no matter what you do, he will still grade hard on you. Less papers, but there are sometimes where he has NO IDEA what he is talking about. If you want to boost your GPA, avoid him at all costs.

omg dood it is like the hardest crap i've ever gotten myself into. if ur not up for workin hard and stuff get out b4 its too late. i mean i would b doin good in his class if i was like a genius in english or something. ur gonna need alot of grammar skills (which i dont have alot of apparently)
Cool teacher, but expect a lot of work. If you plan on taking 5 classes, don't add this class to your list.

Avoid him at all costs! Super Challenging class i will spend hours on papers and still get extremely low grades. Do not make the same mistake i did pick a different teacher they cant be much worse then him

thanks to previous comments, this spring semester we get sooo much work. more work than a 5 hour course. grades hard but hes a cool guy, but i;d take a different topic and prof, i dont think he really understands that we have other classes.
Little to no homework is given and when  it is, it takes no more than 15 minutes. Grades papers tough but fair. Do what he asks and an A is yours to lose.

I had Andy for 152 and loved the class so much I took him again for 160. The coursework as about the same, pretty easy. He was pretty uptight though. Only advice: You have to learn how to write how we wants you to. He grades the papers very hard but very fair. I would still recommend him. He really helped me inprove my writing.
i hated this class pretty much because if you dont agree with him, he takes it out on your grade! He is easy yea, just nod and agree with everything
One of UIC'S best teachers. Learned  the fundamentals if writing and the calss was a breeze. Not much homework and easy test and quizes. Extremely easy A
he was really helpful, always there after class to help out. did not give much of a work load, most of the assignments were completed in class
He is very nice.
this teacher is really cool, he doesnt give a lot of hmwrk, and as long as he sees that u care somewhat about his class, ull get an A.. the quizzes are eaaasy
just take his class ...man...he's fantastic!!!! trust me....
Good teacher, Funny guy, Probably one of the greatest teachers I ever had.  If your reading this keep going with your teaching, your great. (:
This guys very cool. He dosent give alot of work and understands that english is not the only class you have. Also this professor is hillarious

This professor was so unengaging, it would be her just talking at us monotone. She would ask us questions and when no one would answer, she would answer her own questions and move on. Also, this is not a critical thinking class. It is straight up a public health statistics class. Be prepared for statistics the entire semester, I wish I had known.
If it wasn't for Dr.JA Herrmann co teaching, I would've failed. She's very knowledgeable, but she's hard to follow. I don't feel prepared even when I study. Serious lady, but passionate.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She never answers her emails. I have tried to contact her about assignment and work we have had throughout the semester, and she has never responded. She also does a terrible job at explaining the content and just zooms through everything.
He's a great professor he teaches very well, but participation matters a lot, If you dint participate your grade will tank, even if you do well on the exams.

Very good professor. You're graded on 3 exams, participation, attendance, an online HRM simulation that you pay $50 for, a short (report) essay, and assignments. The exams come directly from the slides he shows in class. The simulation was fun but overpriced. He only teaches this class unfortunately. The class is really easy if you try.

I wish he taught more HR classes, because I wouldn't take any other professor over him. Attendance is mandatory but he excuses absences really easily if you just communicate with him. Graded on participation in class so get ready to say at least one thing every class. Only teaches in fall, I think.

he seemed like a chill prof at first but he takes things so serious. participation matters for every class. i never scored so low on a decent presentation bc he was so picky. maybe it was bc i took this class at 6pm, idk.

He is one of the best professors I have taken at UIC. He is very accessible, he gives extra credit opportunities, and his grading criteria is fairly. Regardless your major, I definitely recommend take this course because it is a useful tool to keep in mind at workplace.

A very straightforward professor, instruction and expectations are clear, as mentioned he is quite strict with deadlines, but besides that aspect, a very doable A. Tip to pass his class is to simply do his work on time.

Great professor. His class is easy going as far as the workload & pace. The only con I have is that he is a stickler when it comes to grading. You can literally do everything he ask & he will still knock you down a point. Complete every assignment b/c they are worth a small percentage. One assignment won't hurt ur grade, but it won't help it either
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Knows how to teach and engage students in the class.

He is the most understanding professor in the world. Will extend your deadlines if you need it. The test and quiz information is straight from the lecture slides. Participation is heavily graded so be sure to submit on the discussion board twice a week. If you don't pass this class with an A though you didn't even put in the bare minimum effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Your whole grade is based on 4-5 assignments that are relatively easy to do. They are graded by a TA and the TA I had just gave out 100% to everyone for completing it on time. The content of this class was pretty boring but it was an easy class to satisfy my world cultures gen ed
Does't respond or care about students. Can't even talk to her outside of class or in class. She rushes out and then says to email her
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly just a great professor all around. She's knowledgable about what she teaches, and gives room for class discussions. You also have the freedom to request your most preferred group topic, and she grades leniently (she graded the final a bit harsher than other assignments). Just be mindful because your entire grade relies on 3 assignments!

She's a great professor. She is very nice, sweet, and sometimes funny. However, her powerpoints are vague, and you need to participate in and attend class. Also, see her during office hours if you can. Try to do as well as possible on the essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Zhang is an awesome individual. She always makes the class laugh by telling a joke; and she will talk about her experience from Brazil. She will give two written exams, a final paper and extra credit paper. she is a decent woman and I recommend anyone to take her class.

No tests. 5 homework assignments.  Every assignment is very black and white and takes little effort.  Final project took me like an hour to finish.  She says that attendance is mandatory, but really it's not. Class wasn't very interesting, but it is an easy A if you have any mental capacity.

Loved her! She helped me grow more interest in learning about urban politics. Although she expects you to read every single text she assigns, it's fair game for her exams. Lenient grader and very nice and funny! i got an A in the class.
I really didn't understand what was going on but I showed up everyday and did all of the homework and got a B.

Professor Zhang is awesome. I've taken 210 and 312 with her and loved both. She is extremely fair and her exams are very straightforward. If you don't read it makes it more difficult but not impossible since she uses powerpoints for every lecture. She made me feel like she cared about me personally, which is hard to find at UIC.

Prof. Zhang is really nice. She is a really fair grader & is very interested in personally getting to know her students. She made me more interested in urban politics. Go to class because she does take random attendance & participation is a part of your grade. There are 2 tests and a paper. her lectures are really nice because she uses powerpoints.
Has difficulty accommodating to student needs and intense reading. Does not allow notes on tests.

Refused to record 1 hour of a 3-hour class, saying it's too hands-on and is essential for managing behavior, implying you can't be an effective teacher without her course. She also said, "Just take out student loans, it's no big deal." Ironically, she works in SPED yet won't individualize for her own students. I miss an hour to TEACH btw.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is great! She really helps you instead of just grading you!

We don't see him much in the class. He teaches online through videos. He is a cool guy though. I went to his office hours once or twice. He gives out a test in the middle of the semester, around week 6 and we didn't get the results til week 12. He is mostly just online.

Very flexible if you miss things. I missed a quiz because it was due at class time instead of 11:59. Talked to him after and he opened it right up. He likes what he is teaching and it shows. Don't go in it to get the grade. The material is very interesting and not that hard to grasp. The readings are quite advanced but just set aside a few hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Great professor, but you can't miss class because pop quizzes and in class group work. Exams are essays, and they are relatively easy. You have to pay attention in class to succeed. Lots and lots of out of class work and always be prepared.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is an amazing professor and the discussions in class really make you think about life, concepts that you are not exposed to anywhere else, concepts and ideologies that are not discussed else where. The class is challenging but he is always available to help. If he had other courses I would take them as well!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took this professor for Philosophy and Food and he is very caring. He does go on tangents in class. Just speak up and discussion will be interesting. Homework and quizzes are tough, but he provides notes on all the readings so you just have to put in the work. Not sure what my grade is though because he doesn't believe in putting them in.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: If you are lucky enough to take Zarnitsyn... do it! I currently have him for Philosophy of, and in, Film. He is SUPER caring, understanding, and he actually listens to you. We had weekly quizzes that were pretty easy and discussions on readings that weren't too long, and he always offered notes on the readings too.

clueless as far as explaining lessons and answering questions. He didn't enter grades for the whole semester and when we asked about our grades he would give us a confusing point value. He's not technologically inclined and didn't even use and email account associated with the university (he has a gmail specifically for teaching )

This course was a philosophy class about individuals and society. He assigned long readings every night to discuss the next class. If someone asks a question, he usually turns the question back around on the class. This is good for critical thinking, but we never got a clear answer in the end, and he often rants.

Highly recommend him but only for Food and Philosophy. There were only five short papers, 12 quizzes (lowest 6 dropped), and 2 presentations. (Sounds like a lot, but it was very manageable) We read one novel that's actually enjoyable. Philosophy readings are usually short--he explains them well in class. Participate! Very understanding professor

Aleks is great! He's not a professor (like what he said), but he's doing better than a professor! Go to his class and do the homework and you will get a good grade. You don't have to read the book because he's good at explaining. Unlike what logic class should be, his class is fun and interesting!

very easy to get an A all you have to do is attend and do the hw. if you still struggle then you have to do the exercises that he suggested and then some.he is very clear at explaining so as long as you go to class you will understand. he is a great teacher and i will take him again if i can.

Take good notes and read material b/c the he quizzez often. Review the study guides to your very best- usually word for word.He explains and answers topics very well, he is quirky though. Bit of a tough grader
Excellent teacher, I highly recommend him. He jump started my interest in philosophy. If you're looking for an introduction to philosophy, he's the perfect teacher for it.
He was awesome! He was very thorough and his lectures are easy to follow! His energy was always so warming.

I loved my PHIL 115 class! Prof. Harmon has such good energy, making the class both enjoyable and informative. On top of that, tests are straightforward and easy to study for, which makes it less stressful to prepare. Highly recommend this professor if you want to learn in a fun and stress free environment!    :)

He's very knowledgeable about the topics he covers and always open to hearing about students' thoughts. He's very respectful and can be funny in class! I took it as a Gen-ed and recommended it to my friend next semester. Discussion sections are very opinion-based. There isn't any right or wrong answer unless it's about a specific theory.

Zach is a real gem. His class doesn't have any exams. Just homework and quizzes and as long as you read before class and participate, he will be extremely generous and understanding if you ever need anything. He's a guy that truly cares. Attendance is mandatory and taking good notes will help you a lot for the homeworks. That's all!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Zac is extremely knowledgeable and conveys that knowledge in a way that is accessible, engaging, and often very funny. There is a decent amount of reading, but as long as you do said reading and participate in discussions you should be fine. I took his class on a whim and ended up really enjoying it and learning a lot. He is also very cute.
love the guy

Attendance isn't required but you have to attend class if you want to pass. Class isnt too hard to pass but you will need to put in tons of work for the A. I had family related issued during these months so I dedicated almost no time to this class besides going to every lecture and doing the homework which barely gave me a C after a heavy curve.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He likes to give pop quizzes but the quizzes are fairly easy if you pay attention in class. Provides lecture notes on blackboard. Open book and open notes exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: decent enough
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment:
Professor is very egotistical. Doesn't understand student circumstances when taken as a masters class with other commitments. He thinks our life should revolve around this class and it's our problem if something goes wrong. 
Made us grade each others hws

Not the easiest to follow during lectures, and the homework is somewhat harder than what is shown in lecture. Same pattern with exam questions being harder than homework. Nonetheless, the professor is helpful during office hours even for simple questions. Grading is lenient. Participation and effort recommended for a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Material is quite difficult. Compared to the other professors that teach this course, Milos' class is significantly more difficult. The exams have questions way harder than the homework and the grades averaged between 50-60%,but his grading is lenient. I would recommend to wait a semester for another professor to teach this course and take that

Do not take this Professor. He assigns way too much hw, the notes he gives in class do not prepare you to solve the hw or exam problems. And he’s not very good at answering students questions. Avoid him
Exams do not reflect well from the samples he gives. Homework comes from the book and his notes don't provide much help to the assignments.

Professor Zefran has an elitist attitude every time I have asked a question or seen a question asked on Piazza he belittles the question and makes it seem as if you should already know the answer. He is not very understanding and I would not say he respects his students. His teaching style is lecture heavy with very little practical examples.
PLEASE PROFESSOR, if youre reading this, use examples. I have no clue how to use the equations he gives us.

Rambles in class; most of his lectures consist of derivations which are useless for the homework & exams. Learned next to nothing about robots in 'robotic controls & algorithms'. Our three projects were crammed in at the end and used some of the cheapest robots you've ever seen. Ours was broken out of the box, and so was its replacement. Huge curve
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Tough material. The book is actually free off a wiki. Impress the professor with your project, do above average on the homework and you will definitely get an A.

If you attend this professors lectures, you will learn the materials, guaranteed.  This course ties together a lot of topics that we had learned in previous courses and expands on it.  The professor will answer any questions that the student has and he also seems to always have great TAs that are also very helpful.

Although I am a graduate student and already obtain a solid background on controls, I learnt a lot more than my expect. Also, I came out an research idea from this lecture. So Dr. Zefran is the best lecturer on controls at UIC without doubt for not only the high score you will get, but the knowledge well delivered from him!
Great professor and great teaching style. Very good TA selected for the labs. Takes care of his students. Passing hw and labs is required to pass the course but he is a great professor.
Great Teacher

I absolutely loved Profe Zevallos's class! He was great at teaching, funny, and genuinely interested in us as students, which made class easygoing and productive. Almost all of his instruction was in Spanish which I liked, I only wish that Spanish speaking amongst students was more enforced. It's challenging but would've helped us grow faster.

I honestly liked him as my professor, he led the classes well and had decent amount of homework that helps us better understand and practice the spanish language. he'd reopen assignments that were passed the due date if I really needed him to. attendance is highly effective on your grade which makes sense for college.

When I asked for an extension because my car was stolen from me he said there was nothing he could do if the homework was past due on blackboard, and showed no sympathy. All of my other professors helped me out and I was able to complete their work.

Great professor! Really clear lectures with powerpoints. Tests come straight from the lecture with only two questions from the outside readings which you go over in discussion. Great class for POLS majors and he really knows his stuff. Try to get his TA, Ryan Manness if you can. Really easy going guy and fair grader.

He is a really nice person. REALLY hard grader. Easiest way to sum it up. Don't let his nice demeanor fool you. He is very particular about what he wants and he will shred your work to pieces. Not an easy professor at all.
He was awesome! Really funny and very clear. the test were kind of difficult

Just dont do it...He is really a hard teacher....Theres 2 texts. Daily readings of both. His midterm was impossible, mostly on people's ideas instead of on facts, which i thought was stupid...theres a huge research paper that if u ask him about he is kinda no help....avoid if u can. terrible terrible. plus tough accent.
Boring and sometimes is hard to understand. Lectures can put you to sleep and i do not plan on taking any classes with him in the future.

The tests in this class are pretty hard.  It is very hard to study for the tests in this class because the information in the notes and textbook aren't the best help.  You can still do well as long as you attend all lectures and go to all sections to get the attendance and participation grade.

Professor Haftel is by far my FAVORITE!!!!! he is very  funny, and approchable if you need help. hes not a hard grader but his class is very difficult when it comes to the exam. I would suggest taking his higher level classes 200 and especially 300

I found this class to be quite difficult. It is extemely dense information and requires allot of disection to get to the core. He presents with powerpoint but will not give you them, very hard to write everything down and listen to his lectures. Get a recorder and spend your class time writing. DO THE REVIEW QUESTIONS! Requires significan effort...
The professor is not that bad. He tries to help out as best as he can. In order to do well, students need to be on top of the readings and go to lecture. His exams are pretty difficult
Prof Haftel is ok. The class however is not that interesting, and the tests are difficult

Professor Haftel is hard and you have to WANT to be there. I have never worked harder to get an A. He makes himself available to you and agrees to read drafts of your final paper. You MUST read the book because that is where all the test questions are from. The favorites are the ones who come to class, participate, and show effort.
interesting at times but he had his favorites

Well prepared material for the class but he is biased towards certain students I felt. Tried very hard to get an A, even approached him but I felt that I got little support as if his mind was made up already. low score on the term paper without appropriate explanation downgraded me to a B from an A. Thanks Prof !

DE FURY! ~ you'll find out... I dunno, I liked his class.  Very organized and clear in his explanations, expectations, and PP. Make sure you do Friday discussion readings and review your PP slide notes and everything should go smooth.

Professor Haftel is an amazing teacher, and a great person. He likes to keep things interesting by cracking a few jokes as well, which is definately a plus. He offers a lot of extra credit, so if you do bad in this class, in no way is it anyone's fault but your own.
Great and easy class.  Exams are pretty clear cut and its easy to get extra credit.  I would recommend the class.

He reads straight of the PP so take notes and it's real easy. His accent is unintentionally hilarious. Fury = Theory. Really easy class if you study the day or two before the tests and show up to discussion. Plus, the TA Matt Powers is smokin' hot.

Good teacher. Notes are clear and concise. Some students found him difficult, but all you have to do to be successful in the class is show up to lecture. Tests consisted only of material covered in class; also offered helpful study guides. Good, interesting class, good professor.
No Comments
He grades lightly and is generally pretty lenient
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Had him for HIST 219. The class itself was an easy A. The class is really graded based off of the midterm and final paper, with the occasional class discussion (graded by participation). If you miss class or a deadline he's really flexible and easy to approach. Lectures can get a bit dry or boring at times but its not the end of the world.

Talks pretty quickly in class, but otherwise very easy. Requires weekly response papers on last week's material. Guaranteed A if you go to the discussion and take a bunch of notes. Final paper was pretty easy, very chill grader.
Excellent professor with clear and interesting lectures. All tests were essays based off the lecture materials, but reading the textbook in addition made the course a breeze.

Prof. Papakonstantinou was great; his expectations were clear, and he provided study guides for the weekly readings. His class allowed me to explore Herodotus on my own and sparked my interest in ancient history. I definitely recommend taking his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Simple way to put Dr. Z's classes. Any kind of history/political science major  Just read the Wikipedia summaries for the terms and your Gucci. Everything one else  ^

If you have taken any type of Greek class before this, this class is an easy A. I took two Greek classes before his and everything he went over was review from the two classes I took. You definitely have to put effort into this class because you get graded on one midterm and a written final. Those are your only grades for the whole semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great lectures, very in depth and descriptive. If you pay attention in class you'll do fine on the tests. I've been trying to take another class with him because I enjoyed this class so much.

I loved this professor. His lectures were amazing, interesting, and really explained what people and society were like in Ancient Greece. He is like an encyclopedia with his knowledge!! His analysis really explained why things were going on, so it made events made sense instead of just having to memorize dates. 2 exams with IDs /essay and 1 paper.
Great professor. I would love to take a class with him again.

Class was approachable but not super easy. Solid lecturer and good at giving a big picture understanding. I took this as a gen ed and found it to be pretty reasonable, although it required a non trivial amount of effort. If you show up for class and put a little effort into the paper you should get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is super boring. I can never focus in class. He uses powerpoints but there is usually only pics of maps or 1 word on the slide. It is hard to tell what he wants on tests too and he is not clear on how he grades. But if you take advantage of his office hours, he tells you exactly what you need to improve on and what he expects.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Highly recommend! His lectures are very easy to follow and midterms are a breeze if you attend class regularly. Also very helpful outside of class.
Boring, distant, limited educational - teaching skills
This professor is knowleadgeable and enthusiastic about his subject. He is always very eager to help students. If you attend class regularly and follow his instructions you will get an A

Terrible professor. He rambles on and on, never engaging the class or trying to make it interesting. Students fall asleep, use their phones, etc and he doesn't care. 2 tests and 1 paper, but he doesn't clearly explain what he is looking for on either. If you attend class and take notes you don't need to read the textbook (but will need it for paper

She's an amazing prof. Lectures are engaging and hilarious and assignments are fairly easy/manageable. The quizzes though can be tough if you are not actively taking notes or watching recorded lectures (my class was hybrid). Most of in-class time is used for discussion which is based on personal experience/overall just very engaging. I enjoyed.

This professor was awesome! She always came in with so much energy and you could tell she loved to teach. You mainly work in your discussion group. Quizzes require a deep understanding of concepts but hw was very simple. You watch weekly lectures on your own and then attend class once a week for discussion. I would highly recommend this professor!!

She is an excellent professor and asks for very little. Your grade revolves mainly around going to class and participating in your small group with activities happening once in a while. She makes lectures short and easy which is manageable to watch and classes engaging.
Easy class! Exams were online and she was not dull at all. I recommend prof. Zinsser!

Professor Zinsser was amazing! Super approachable, and flexible. Her lectures and all class materials are online. All exams are online as well. She makes the material easy to understand using lots of videos and supplemental resources.

She cares about our understanding course material. She encourages to visit her office hours. Her PPs are attention getting and so is her enthusiasm which is AWESOME. Exams and quizzes are online. I love her and I love her class, I definitely recommend taking her class!
She is great! Keeps class super interesting and clearly goes over info. All the slides are on blackboard and there's easy group points every week. I definitely would take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: MY FAVORITE PROFESSOR YET. Dr. Z is a seriously amazing human and inspiring professor. Don't miss this class.

Funny and engaging professor who knows her stuff! She is happy to help and clarify things if you ask questions. To get a good grade just come to class, ask questions and dont leave the observations paper until the last minute. You use the textbook but she gave it to us for free in when I took the class.
Great professor, you can tell she loves the topic. She makes it interesting. Hint... do the extra credit! If will make a difference at the end of the semester.
She keeps you engaged in class. Her observation papers are tough. Have her look over them beforehand or else your grade will be destroyed. But overall, she is super cool.

My friends told me to take this teacher because she is awesome, great, smart, funny and easy and also they learned a lot from her. But sadly I can't say the same. I feel like she was too focused on trying new teaching strategies that she forgot the actual teaching part.  I didn't learn anything, was confused, and all the work I felt was worthless.

Extremely nice professor. Very engaging during class and always trying to get kids to laugh. Down to earth. Keep up with due dates for assignments and attend class. One of the nicest people you'll meet at UIC.

She is the best professor I have had so far! Her class is interesting and she is always energetic and positive. She made me extremely interested in Developmental Psychology. Tip- don't need the textbook
She is awesome. I wished she taught more classes. She has a great sense of humor. Gives you plenty of points. She really is dedicated to getting everyone interested and involved.
The class was interesting if you want to really learn about developmental psychology  then take professor Zinsser's class she is interesting their is 4 quiz's in her class and just 2 short papers.
She is a awesome professor and always willing to help her students. NOT an easy A, but you should be good as long as you go to class and try.

She made the class really easy and the assignments on the side were also easy too. She's kind of awkward but she's more than willing to take the time outside of class to answer questions and other concerns.  I appreciate her effort for trying to make it an engaging class. Four quizzes and an optional final and her slides were clear.

Love love loved her. She makes you do all these miscellaneous assignments, but they're not difficult to complete. 3 "quizes" and an optional final. Attendance taking randomly but usually when we're having a group discussion. She's really interesting to listen too and always answers any questions right away

Lectures are useless, only way to get the answer to the problems is to show up to class and copy down what he wrote but he barely speaks English so idek. He basically gives everyone a B so just take the class and you can easily steal a B.
Professor Zou is a very nice. This class is lecture, quiz and homework heavy. Exams directly relate to both notes and homework. But try to stay awake during the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Had him online. The class is pretty interesting! He is really nice and fair. Exams reflect lecture slides and homework, no tricks. Labs are not too bad. I'd definitely take him again!
His classes are way interesting yet little difficult.
Can anyone tell if he is a good teacher, and his grading?

He is ONE of the BEST professors I've had in a very long time. I have learned so much from him, his teaching method will make you see certain things in a different way. No exams, 3 journals 750-800 words, final exam is journal 4 which is 1200 words. work load is manageable . Go to Class for iclicker points!!!
Very good teacher, he's passionate about the subject. Class consist of 4 journals and one final longer essay. He's great take him

I absolutely loved this class, and I learned a lot about race and ethnicity. Much of what I learned throughout the semester I can take with me for the rest of my life. Furthermore, I actually enjoyed reading the textbook! Many of his other required readings were very insightful. Bradley is an awesome teacher!

Absolutely love this class. If you do not read or bother showing up to class, you set yourself up to fail! Would take this class over again, he is a pretty cool professor, chill, laid back, all you have to do is participate and read and TRY!!!  Readings were dense and challenging but fun to go further in depth when we discussed key concepts.

One of the best professors at UIC! He is very knowledgeable about the class topics and explains everything exceptionally well. He goes out of his way to help students when needed. If you follow his directions and put in the work, you will get an A. Highly recommend taking any class with Professor Bradley!!! He's Awesome!!!
Bradley was one of the best professors I've had at UIC. He knows how to explain concepts that were really unclear and really cared about what he taught. Very knowledgeable man and very approachable.

Brad was a pretty good teacher and since he was young, students responded well to him. He does have a bad attitude and if you get on his bad side he will arbitrarily change the grades you received throughout the semester. He did it me the day after our last class and I lost all trust in him. Beware before taking him
Had him for 4-week summer session. BEST teacher!! Really helpful, understanding and relates well with students.  Too bad sociology is not my major--I would love to take more classes with this guy!!

AWESOME PROFESSOR! I was really scared to take this class because i know it had a lot of reading and writing but Bradley makes it better because of how he teaches! My FAVORIte PROFESSOR AT UIC by far. He is clear on what he wants, the way he teaches is amazing and he is EASY on the eyes! THe best!
4 week summer session he made a bearable.  Completely helpful gets makes his points clear.  Really nice and funny.  Great class!!
He is so nice, and funny. He kept the 3 hour class interesting for a 4 week session.
Bradley is extremely nice and a great professor! He really knows his material and even though social theory is hard to understand he makes it easy.  Best professor I have taken at UIC.

Best professor ever! He is truly an amazing teacher! He knows his stuff and makes class so much interesting! And he can be pretty funny sometimes! Lots of reading in this class, and they are confusing but he explains them in class. Take this class! You will not regret it!!

He is an awesome teacher :) Tests are pretty easy you just have to look at power point notes, don't really need the book. One paper with social problem of your choice no midterm or final. He is very helpful and nice

Really awesome and easy class. The tests were multiple choice, completely based off the readings and powerpoints. Go to class and study the stuff and you should be fine. I got an A. He's also helpful if you talk to him outside of class. Plus he gives A LOT of extra credit.
Great class! I would def recommend it! Class was not that hard but it's not that easy either!

I'm a Russian major but after the first weeks of this course ,Im debating on changing my major. Although  I have decided to change universities and by that professors. Hopefully my love for Russian will re emerge after this experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Awesome instructor with awesome class.
If you have something that you couldn't understand, don't just skip it. Visiting her during the office hours is very helpful. She will explain you very thoroughly.
She is very enthusiastic.
Many quizzes are take home and she lets you correct all quizzes and tests. I think she was quite helpful.
This class was a lot of fun. Prof. Zotova explains things well and is very understanding of students.

I just have 1 thing to say, Mrs. Zotova Rules. There is no reason anybody can give me to say otherwise. She teaches really well, gives great examples, and makes learning the language really fun and easy. Without a doubt anybody interested in learning russian should take her. She is very nice.

She is so much fun! Her teaching style is entertaining, she sways from side to side and moves her arms around. Never boring in class. Just study charts before exams. Even if you do bad she lets you do corrections on EVERYTHING even hw to get a better grade. Very helpful and funny person. Typical Russian sense of humor, I believe. Loves Johnny Depp.
I loved her so much. She made the class so much fun and if you just paid attention, you learned the material very well. Take her above all else!!!
Helped me leverage my knowledge of Urdu into a successful Russian learning experience.
Great prof that never cares if you are absent as long as you have a good story.  Listen in class and you'll be fine.
Prof does not know her subject well. She gets lost when she tries to explain even simple concepts.

She evidently didn't care much about the class, or she was just too much of an airhead for her own good. There were a ton of assigned readings for the Ethics class, but we were never properly quizzed on them, so almost no one read them.  It's evident she is very intelligent but don't ever take her for a formal CS class, she can't stay on topic.

couldn't learn much about the subject in this class as prof strays off the topic every moment she can. grading is hard. only two presentations are the part of grading criteria. latex coding is needed to write reports. VERY particular about citations.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Seems like Computer Ethics is a nice fit for Professor Zuck. The class wasn't bad at all (primarily discussions). But there was a LOT of reading material. Attendance is taken in this class. And there were 2 papers and a presentation. Easy!

Professor Zuck cannot teach. She knows the material, clearly. However, she doesn't realize that we don't. We went to that class to learn it, not because we know it already. Many people dropped like me and the people who stayed are mostly failing or at least on the low C range with no signs from her of a curve. Avoid her at all costs.
I love this professor. She is one of the best Spanish instructors ever. she's attractive, helpful, and kind. The only downside is that she doesn't teach advanced Spanish courses.
The most helpful professor I have encountered at UIC. She is VERY easy on the eyes and the nicest professor you will ever have. TAKE HER!

I wasn't so excited about SPAN 113 but she made the class pretty fun. She's from Spain and she's extremely attractive. But besides that she's very helpful with anything you need. She's clear with everything she teaches. The assignments are pretty straight forward. She makes students participate in class as well. Take her class if you can.

She is an amazing teacher! Very nice and helpful. She is a super easy grader! She never corrects you all bogus and she really makes you comfortable enough to participate and read. I always did my papers 20 minutes before class and I'd always get 90's! She's also really hot!
Awesome. Very sweet, patient, and easy. Also very attractive as well.
Amazing teacher! Do your one letter in Spanish a week, study for those little quizzes and you're good! She is very helpful and very nice, take down notes!
Great class even better professor :)

The class was challenging but helpful. The professor was understanding, knowledgable, and relatable. One of the best classes I ever had the pleasure of taking. Would recommend to all who are interested in perfecting their Spanish
this teacher was amazing! easily one of the best teachers i've ever had! also, she is SMOKING HOT! she should be a model instead of a teacher.
She was very helpful and the class was not too hard because she explains the material very well. I would have loved to take her for 114 as well. If you get the chance to take her, do it.

By far one of the best Spanish teachers I had. She's enthusiastic about the subject. The only downside is that she is extremely attractive so it can be distracting even intimidating. Overall great professor.
She is great, patient, understanding, and really seems to want people to learn. Also very nice person
600lbs of pure evil

If you can avoid him. I got a good grade in his class but no thanks to him. He chooses his favorites in the beginning and acts childish the rest of the year, giving those he likes most grace and privilege. I have never seen a professed at UIC act like him. I plan to report him to the head of the department.
He forced students to spend extra money and told us we should be able to afford a printer

Dr. Tot is serious about music, and if you show up being serious about music then you'll get along just fine. He's a great educator and knows how to teach all aspects of music theory. He will not baby you, which is best if you want to honest feedback and to be successful in music.

Dr. Tot is a very talented Jazz guitarist with a lot of musical experience. In class, he makes it seem like he hasn't had a lot of experience in human interaction...but get him alone at office hours and he turns into the most helpful man in the world! He really cares about his students and their problems and does everything he can to help!

She doesn't push you to be a better student or to learn more. It's all up to you. People say her lectures are boring but I found them interesting. The exams are extremely easy. She tells you exactly what will be on them. If you get lower than an A in this class then you just wern't putting in the effort it required every month or less.
She's very good instructor. She'll tell you what will be on the exam. Also, her lecture is fine. Highly recommended.

I would recommend Ina. I loved her lectures. Even though I was taking it as a general ed elective, still I never missed her lectures. Exams were easy. She tells you what is on the exam, so you are prepared. 2 papers on small novels related to the history of western civilization. TAKE HER!!
